0x00401130.name: ShortComputation
0x00401130.label: FreeContainedPointersAndRelease
0x00401130.summary: Frees three optional pointer allocations at this+336, this+340, this+344 via FreeWrapper_7bcf if non-null, then calls ObjectReleaseArrayIterator to release the array at this. Used as a cleanup/destructor-like function for an object containing multiple sub-allocations.

0x00401340.name: VehicleSuspensionForceCalculation
0x00401340.label: Wheel-ground suspension solver
0x00401340.summary: Computes suspension contact forces between wheel collision geometry and ground surface using ray-sphere intersection tests. Iterates over suspension struts, queries spatial grid for collision features, and calculates response force components along contact normal with gravity compensation.

0x00401910.name: SweptSuspensionCollisionDetection
0x00401910.label: Sweep-strut contact solver
0x00401910.summary: Advances wheel positions along velocity direction (Euler step), then performs swept collision detection for each suspension strut by sampling multiple travel positions and selecting the one with maximum contact force. Calls VehicleSuspensionForceCalculation and TireForceSolver at each sample to evaluate contact response.

0x00401c90.name: PhysicsNodePropagationWithDistanceFalloff
0x00401c90.label: Force propagation with distance falloff
0x00401c90.summary: Propagates suspension and tire forces through linked collision geometry chains with distance-based falloff. Calls SweptSuspensionCollisionDetection, applies TireForceSolver/TireForce/TireGripLateralForceCalculation per strut, computes contact force attenuation as a function of distance between strut center and collision feature, and records the maximum propagated force.

0x00402220.name: sub_402220
0x00402220.label: VehicleWheelContactHeightCheck
0x00402220.summary: Computes wheel contact patch position and penetration depth for a vehicle wheel. Given wheel parameters (this: vehicle state, a2: wheel transform, a3: output contact position, a4: contact type 0/1), calculates contact point via spring length scaled by steering direction, then queries SpatialGridQuery twice (bottom and top of wheel) to find terrain height. Computes suspension compression and lateral wheel tilt from terrain contact differences.

0x004024f0.name: AIWaypointPathCheckerRenderer
0x004024f0.label: AIWaypointPathDebugRender
0x004024f0.summary: Iterates over linked waypoint nodes starting from this+308's linked list (via +272 next pointers), renders debug visualization for each edge. Computes vertex colors based on surface grip (multiplied by -254, clamped to alpha), draws colored contact patches (sub_402220 + sub_4CEFA0) and white wireframe edges. Validates the linked list does not exceed 12000 elements (cycle detection). If no nodes, logs "Incomplete waypoint path" debug message.

0x00402690.name: sub_402690
0x00402690.label: ParseTrackWaypointDatabase
0x00402690.summary: Parses track AI database files (.AIW / waypoint data), reading features (pit lane count, starting grid, pit/garage spots), grid positions, pit/garage coordinates, waypoint array allocation, and per-waypoint properties (position, width, groove, branch IDs, events). Writes parsed data into the track database struct.

0x00403350.name: F_3DBufferMeshMemoryAllocation
0x00403350.label: MeshBufferAllocFromDimensions
0x00403350.summary: Allocates and initializes mesh buffer memory for a 3D object based on dimension fields. Frees any existing allocations at this+336/340/344, computes new buffer sizes from this+348/352/356/360 (vertex/index/batch counts), allocates three buffers (stream, index, batch) via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, zero-fills each, and returns. Sets stride-based layout offsets at this+8/12/16/20.

0x004034d0.name: ObjectReleaseArrayIterator
0x004034d0.label: SubObjectArrayRelease
0x004034d0.summary: Releases an array of sub-objects at this[77] (pointer to 316-byte stride array with count at offset -4). Iterates backward through all entries calling EmptyStub_0170 on each, then frees the allocation via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Zeroes this[76] (count) and this[77] (pointer) on completion.

0x00403540.name: IndexRemappingWithStride
0x00403540.label: SubObjectGraphLinkRemap
0x00403540.summary: Iterates over all sub-object entries in the array at this[77] (316-byte stride) and remaps three pointer fields (+272 parent, +268 child, +276 sibling) from absolute array-index references to direct pointers into the sub-object array. Invalid or out-of-range indices (-1 or >= count) are zeroed and reset to -1.

0x00403640.name: sub_403640
0x00403640.label: Nearest-neighbor spatial query with plane test
0x00403640.summary: Finds the closest physics strut or collision node to a query point using both Euclidean squared-distance and a signed-distance plane-proximity score. When a starting node is provided, walks its linked collision geometry lists to find the nearest neighbor; then scans all active struts to find the globally closest candidate that passes the plane test.

0x004038e0.name: SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest
0x004038e0.label: Nearest-strut query with plane rejection
0x004038e0.summary: Scans all active suspension struts to find the one nearest to a query point, with optional strut-type filtering. After locating the closest strut, applies a plane-normal / height test to decide whether to return the strut pointer itself or redirect to its linked collision child node.

0x004039c0.name: BVHNearestNeighborQuery
0x004039c0.label: BVH chain nearest-neighbor traversal
0x004039c0.summary: Traverses a linked chain of physics nodes (BVH-style) to find the closest node to a query position. Computes squared distances between query point and each node position, accumulates path length along the chain, and terminates early when child distance exceeds current best (spatial culling) or cumulative path exceeds 200 units.

0x00403cd0.name: sub_403CD0
0x00403cd0.label: Track spline data lookup with interpolation
0x00403cd0.summary: Looks up position and orientation data from a track spline array indexed by node index. If the requested entry is zero-initialized (invalid/missing), walks backwards in steps of 2 to find the nearest valid entries and performs linear interpolation between them; falls back to first entry if no valid pair exists.

0x00403fc0.name: IndexedStructDataRead
0x00403fc0.label: 2D-indexed struct data reader
0x00403fc0.summary: Reads position (3 floats) and orientation (3 floats) from a 2D-indexed array of 28-byte (7-float) struct entries. Computes linear index as `a2 + a3 * width_stride` and copies the first 6 floats of the entry to two output buffers.

0x00404030.name: ZeroVectorCheck
0x00404030.label: Non-zero vector check
0x00404030.summary: Tests whether two vectors (one 2-component XY, one 3-component XYZ) contain any non-zero element. Returns TRUE if any of the 5 tested float components is non-zero, indicating the compound data structure is not zero-initialized.

0x004040a0.name: AIDatabase_Init
0x004040a0.label: AI Difficulty Database Initialization
0x004040a0.summary: Initializes AI driving parameters from a database file: loads track-position speed curves, sets difficulty-scaled aggression values from a slider (dword_7D01A0), and opens the AI database file from disk. Part of the AI difficulty configuration system called at game init.

0x00404250.name: SurfaceHeightfieldCollisionCallback
0x00404250.label: WheelSurfaceCollisionSolver
0x00404250.summary: Solves wheel-surface contacts for vehicle. Computes grip-based friction scaling factor, runs per-wheel sub_4FB260 (friction) and sub_4FAF60 (suspension) callbacks, allocates memory, then performs spatial queries (SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest) for each wheel to detect terrain collision and compute contact height and surface normal. Updates neighbor pointers and contact data at offset +276/+296.

0x00404460.name: MultiPhaseProcessingStateMachine
0x00404460.label: VehicleWheelPhaseProcessor
0x00404460.summary: Three-phase state machine for processing vehicle wheel updates across multiple frames (time-sliced). Phase 0 runs friction callbacks (sub_4FB260), phase 1 runs suspension callbacks (sub_4FAF60), phase 2 runs proximity queries (VehicleProximity). Each phase processes a batch of up to 20 wheels per call, advancing the phase index (this+0x170) and transitioning phases when all wheels are done.

0x004046b0.name: MemoryAllocation
0x004046b0.label: WheelContactHeightSmoothing
0x004046b0.summary: Iterates over all sub-objects (wheels) in the array at this[77] (316-byte stride). For each wheel with a valid neighbor pointer (offset +276), updates contact height (offset +76) based on the neighbor chain. If the neighbor's node type (offset +300) is below a threshold (this[4]), queries SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest for terrain height and averages with parent contact height. For type==1 nodes without a parent, walks the linked list to accumulate contact heights from ancestors.

0x00404790.name: ShortComputation_4790
0x00404790.label: WheelArrayIteratorUnregisteredCall
0x00404790.summary: Iterates over all wheel entries in the array at this[77] (316-byte stride, this[76] count), calling FAILNODOCENTRY for each. Serves as an unregistered/bulk dispatch helper within the wheel collision pipeline.

0x00404850.name: PathStringUtility
0x00404850.label: PathStringValidationAndCopy
0x00404850.summary: Copies/validates a path string from a struct field (offset 0x38) or a default global directory path if the field is null, but only if the string is non-empty.

0x00404890.name: RaceModeSetup
0x00404890.label: RaceModeTransitionSetup
0x00404890.summary: Configures race mode session transition: saves previous scoring/race-mode global state, sets new race mode value (2), applies timeout overrides, sets session transition flag, and computes scaling factor based on UI slider or difficulty threshold. Non-race mode path simply sets two byte flags.

0x00404970.name: ConditionalSoundRenderDispatchOnParamCheck
0x00404970.label: ConditionalAudioRenderDispatch
0x00404970.summary: Conditionally triggers audio render setup and mixer initialization when a struct parameter (field at 0x20) equals 1 and the render fade alpha is positive.

0x00404a50.name: FAILWRONGTRIAGE
0x00404a50.label: StructAllocAndConstructor
0x00404a50.summary: Allocates an 88-byte object via heap allocator, zero-initializes most fields, sets some fields to -1 and offset 24 to 3.0f (float), stores pointer in caller's struct field at offset 0.

0x00404ac0.name: RenderNodeListDestructor
0x00404ac0.label: RenderNodeListDestructor
0x00404ac0.summary: Destructor that frees a linked list of render nodes (each with optional conditional data cleanup), followed by freeing up to three auxiliary buffers at offsets 0x28/0x30/0x38, then frees the main object itself.

0x00404b50.name: ShortComputation_4b50
0x00404b50.label: ObjectFlagsZeroInit
0x00404b50.summary: Zero-initializes three fields (offsets 0x14, 0x15, 0x1C) on an object obtained by dereferencing the this pointer.

0x00404b60.name: sub_404B60
0x00404b60.label: MultiSessionSetupDispatch
0x00404b60.summary: Dispatches session-specific setup logic: handles race mode (type 2) with state comparison and threshold accumulation, server mode (type 5) with conditional audio playback, and bitmap/game-command validation with main-menu check.

0x00404d10.name: FieldAccessorAt0x20
0x00404d10.label: FieldAtOffset20Getter
0x00404d10.summary: Returns the dword value at offset 0x20 from an object obtained by dereferencing the this pointer.

0x00404d20.name: sub_404D20
0x00404d20.label: FloatFieldAtOffset18Getter
0x00404d20.summary: Returns the float value at offset 0x18 from an object obtained by dereferencing the this pointer, promoted to double.

0x00404d30.name: ShortComputation_4d30
0x00404d30.label: FieldAtOffset18Setter
0x00404d30.summary: Sets the dword at offset 0x18 on the object pointed to by this to the value of parameter a2, returning the object pointer.

0x00404d40.name: StructFieldSetter
0x00404d40.label: FieldAtOffset20Setter
0x00404d40.summary: Sets the dword at offset 0x20 on the object pointed to by this to the value of parameter a2, returning the object pointer.

0x00404d50.name: ResourceListCleanup
0x00404d50.label: ResourceListNodeRebuildFromDirectory
0x00404d50.summary: When activated (a2 non-zero), frees all nodes in a linked list of resources, clears the list head, then rebuilds the list by enumerating directory entries from a resolved path. When a2 is zero, only sets a flag and returns.

0x00404e60.name: LinkedListNodeInsertion
0x00404e60.label: StringLinkedListAppend
0x00404e60.summary: Allocates a string copy of the input, creates a linked list node containing it, and appends the node to the tail of the list stored at offsets 0x40-0x4C of the target object.

0x00404f00.name: ByteFieldExtractorWithShift
0x00404f00.label: Indirect byte field reader
0x00404f00.summary: Reads a single byte from offset 0x14 of a target structure accessed via an indirect pointer stored at `this+0x0`. A simple indirection helper for retrieving a flag or status byte from a referenced object.

0x00404f30.name: MainMenuTransition
0x00404f30.label: MainMenuTransitionRestore
0x00404f30.summary: Handles transition back to main menu: restores previously saved global state (race mode flag, scoring gate flag), applies timeout overrides, resets a flag, and conditionally dispatches a virtual state reset. Mirrors the save logic in RaceModeSetup.

0x00404f70.name: ConditionalFreeWithBit0Flag
0x00404f70.label: ConditionalBufferAndNodeFree
0x00404f70.summary: Frees the inner buffer at this->0 if non-null, then conditionally frees the container node itself if parameter a2 has bit 0 set.

0x00404fe0.name: OneTimeInitializationWithAtexitStyleRegistration
0x00404fe0.label: StaticSingletonInitializer
0x00404fe0.summary: One-time initialization of a static object at unk_5EA440: checks init flag, constructs a generic vtable-backed object, registers an atexit-style cleanup/load-path wrapper, and returns the static buffer handle.

0x00405050.name: ShortComputation_5050
0x00405050.label: ResourceIDStringResolver
0x00405050.summary: Resolves a string parameter to a numeric resource ID: tries direct name lookup first, then attempts prefix-based extraction or numeric string formatting, writing the result to an output parameter.

0x00405160.name: MemoryAllocation_5160
0x00405160.label: ResourceBackedMemoryAllocation
0x00405160.summary: Allocates/reallocates memory for a resource with mode-dependent sizing: looks up resource node for base size, falls back to linked-list search, then calls sub_58C724 with computed parameters.

0x004053e0.name: ShortComputation_53e0
0x004053e0.label: MultiStageStructInitializer
0x004053e0.summary: Initializes a struct by zeroing field at offset 0x4, setting offset 0x8 to -1, zero-initializing fields starting at offset 0x30, initializing at offset 0x34, then calling camera view struct initializer.

0x00405410.name: MultiStageCleanupWithFree
0x00405410.label: MultiStageSubObjectDestructor
0x00405410.summary: Multi-stage cleanup: runs conditional dual-free cleanup, calls sub-object destructor, virtual-table-backed destructor at offset 0x30, and conditionally frees a heap buffer at offset 0x4.

0x00405440.name: CameraViewStructInitializer
0x00405440.label: ViewStructDefaultInit
0x00405440.summary: Initializes a view/state struct with default values: sets several fields to -1 or 0, copies a default directory path string, runs virtual cleanup, and zero-fills a trailing block.

0x004054a0.name: ConditionalCleanupWithDualFree
0x004054a0.label: FileHandleAndBufferCleanup
0x004054a0.summary: Conditionally closes a file handle at offset 0xC and frees a heap buffer at offset 0x18, then reinitializes the struct via CameraViewStructInitializer.

0x004054e0.name: BinaryDataDeserialization
0x004054e0.label: BinaryDataDeserializationDispatch
0x004054e0.summary: Reads binary data at a given index from a file/buffer handle: parses a 40-byte header, extracts type field via bitfield, dispatches type-specific deserialization (type 0 = raw offset, type 1 = threaded object creation with SEH, type 2 = direct seek).

0x00405630.name: StructInitWithVTableDispatchAndZeroFill
0x00405630.label: StructResetWithVTableDispatch
0x00405630.summary: Resets a struct to default state: sets offset 0x1C to -1, zeroes several fields, runs virtual cleanup on sub-object at 0x30, dispatches vtable method at offset 0x34+4, and zero-fills trailing region from 0x44 to 0x70.

0x004056a0.name: MemoryAllocation_56a0
0x004056a0.label: WavHeaderStructBuilder
0x004056a0.summary: Constructs a complete WAV audio file header (RIFF/WAVE/fmt/data chunks) in a buffer at offset 0x44, using audio parameters extracted from a 40-byte input header (sample rate, channels, bits per sample, flags).

0x004057f0.name: ViewProjectionStructInit
0x004057f0.label: AudioProcessingConfigInit
0x004057f0.summary: Initializes audio processing configuration struct with Miles Sound System vtable, sets sample rate (44100 Hz), volume/pan factors (0.5, 0.975, 0.01), copies file path string from caller parameter (or default path), and zeroes state/sentinel fields.

0x004058a0.name: ObjectConstructorWithVTableAndSubFree
0x004058a0.label: ObjectCleanupWithVTableSwapAndSubFree
0x004058a0.summary: Releases audio resource, removes node from linked list by key, swaps vtable pointer, and conditionally frees child allocation at offset 0x4.

0x004058d0.name: DestructorWithVTableAndFree
0x004058d0.label: DestructorWithVTableSetAndConditionalFree
0x004058d0.summary: Sets vtable to swap vtable, frees child allocation at offset 0x4, and conditionally frees this object itself when flag bit 0 is set.

0x00405900.name: MilesAudioSamplePlaybackSetup
0x00405900.label: AudioSamplePlaybackSetup
0x00405900.summary: Sets up Miles audio sample playback — checks collision/spatial response first, then on first call allocates sample handle via spatial query, configures sample file and loop count (infinite vs single based on mode), and optionally applies 3D sound positioning update.

0x004059f0.name: ShortComputation_59f0
0x004059f0.label: AudioSampleEndAndReinit
0x004059f0.summary: Ends current Miles audio sample playback and reinitializes the sample handle, then clears the sample handle pointer and its reference back-pointer.

0x00405a30.name: sub_405A30
0x00405a30.label: AudioSampleStop
0x00405a30.summary: Stops a Miles audio sample if the sample handle struct and sample handle are both valid, using AIL_stop_sample.

0x00405b00.name: AudioResourceRelease
0x00405b00.label: AudioResourceRelease
0x00405b00.summary: Calls vtable destructor at vtable+8, decrements reference count on a shared audio resource block at this[23], frees it if ref count reaches zero, then removes node from linked list by key.

0x00405b50.name: FAILTriageMathUtilButIsAudioStatusPolling
0x00405b50.label: AudioSampleStatusPoll
0x00405b50.summary: Polls Miles audio sample playback status via AIL_sample_status — returns non-zero (loop mode flag) if status is DONE (4) or STOPPED (16), otherwise returns 2 (still playing/other).

0x00405b90.name: F_3DSoundPositioningUpdate
0x00405b90.label: 3D Audio Position/Attenuation Update
0x00405b90.summary: Computes 3D spatial audio parameters (distance attenuation, stereo pan, Doppler pitch shift) for a positional sound source relative to a listener, then applies them via Miles AIL API calls (volume, playback rate, position). Part of the Miles/3D audio subsystem.

0x00405d70.name: MilesSoundSystemFilterOpenByIndex
0x00405d70.label: AudioFilterOpenByIndex
0x00405d70.summary: Opens a Miles audio filter by index (0-3) — looks up filter name string via sub_404FA0, enumerates Miles filters to find a match, opens the matching filter via AIL_open_filter, and stores filter handles in struct fields.

0x00405e60.name: PhysicsCollisionResponseComputation
0x00405e60.label: ComputeCollisionAudioFeedback
0x00405e60.summary: Computes collision response intensity for audio feedback. Copies collision position/velocity parameters to struct, evaluates collision intensity via virtual function calls, clamps to [0,1], and either cleans up (no collision) or computes distance delta for audio triggering.

0x00405f80.name: ScaledDotProductWithClamp
0x00405f80.label: ScaledOrientationAttenuationClamp
0x00405f80.summary: Computes orientation-based audio attenuation factor from scaled dot product ratio between source and listener orientation vectors. Clamps result to [0.125, 8.0] range. Part of 3D sound positioning system.

0x00406020.name: SmoothstepInterpolation
0x00406020.label: AttenuationSmoothstepThreshold
0x00406020.summary: Computes smoothstep-style interpolation for audio attenuation with a threshold. Returns base scale value when linear parameter below 1.0; applies inverse-blend attenuation when above. Part of 3D sound positioning system.

0x00406060.name: DotProductWithScaleOffset
0x00406060.label: DotProductScaledPanBias
0x00406060.summary: Computes [0.2-0.8] range pan/balance factor from 3D orientation dot product with fixed scale (0.6) and offset (+1.0, *0.5). Maps dot product to stereo position range. Part of 3D sound positioning system.

0x004060c0.name: MilesSoundSampleProcessorSetup
0x004060c0.label: MilesSoundSampleProcessorSetup
0x004060c0.summary: Configures Miles Sound System sample processor and filter preferences on a sound sample handle. Sets sample processor callback and optionally applies filter preference when filter index is not -1.

0x00406100.name: ShortComputation_6100
0x00406100.label: GuardedAudioInitCompute
0x00406100.summary: Guarded initialization and computation for audio subsystem. Checks sample info pointer validity before performing one-time registration and delegating to a computation function.

0x00406130.name: MutexSynchronizationObjectInit
0x00406130.label: MutexSyncObjectInit
0x00406130.summary: Initializes a mutex synchronization object with two-phase setup: first as file-based mutex (3 file path entries), then as thread mutex via CreateMutexA. Sets vtable, timeout value, and config parameter. Called once during object construction.

0x00406250.name: ShortComputation_6250
0x00406250.label: SynchronizationObjectDestructorCleanup
0x00406250.summary: Destructor/cleanup for synchronization object. Resets vtable, removes from linked list, closes mutex handle, and frees allocated string buffers before reverting to base vtable.

0x004062b0.name: SortedStringListInsert
0x004062b0.label: SortedStringListSlottedInsert
0x004062b0.summary: Inserts string metadata entries into a slot-based sorted list, or clears and repopulates slots. In insert mode, finds empty slots and copies string data; in clear mode, resets all slots and rebuilds from input array.

0x004064c0.name: ViewCameraReset
0x004064c0.label: SlotDataResetWithMutexAcquire
0x004064c0.summary: Resets slot data entries to default (-1/0) state and optionally closes audio stream if handle is non-null. Acquires mutex lock at end after initializing default path string into each slot.

0x004066c0.name: MutexProtectedValueReadWithTimeout
0x004066c0.label: MutexProtectedValueReadWithTimeout
0x004066c0.summary: Reads a mutex-protected integer value from the object. Waits on mutex with configured timeout, reads value from offset 0x4C, then releases mutex. Returns -1 on failure (null mutex or wait failure).

0x00406700.name: MutexLockWithTimeout
0x00406700.label: MutexProtectedValueWriteWithTimeout
0x00406700.summary: Writes a value under mutex protection. Waits on mutex with configured timeout, writes input parameter to offset 0x4C, then releases mutex. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure (no mutex or wait failure).

0x00406750.name: AudioStreamCloseAndCleanup
0x00406750.label: AudioStreamCloseAndCleanup
0x00406750.summary: Closes a Miles audio stream if handle is non-null, performs additional cleanup via sub_406A70 when a slot index is not -1, and initializes a structure from sub_4080B0 result.

0x00406790.name: sub_406790
0x00406790.label: AudioStreamOpenAndStart
0x00406790.summary: Opens a Miles audio stream from file path or track index, registers a settings-save callback, starts playback, and sets volume levels under mutex. Handles both first-time open (byte flag = 0) and track-update scenarios. On stream open failure, resets slot entries.

0x004069f0.name: sub_4069F0
0x004069f0.label: Mp3TrackFilenameBuilder
0x004069f0.summary: Builds an MP3 filename string from track index and stores the formatted string result handle at offset 0x5C. Frees previous slot resource via sub_406A70 before overwriting if slot was active.

0x00406a70.name: sub_406A70
0x00406a70.label: SlotResourceFree
0x00406a70.summary: Frees a slot resource handle stored at offset 0x5C by calling sub_58C331 and resets the slot to -1 (inactive). No-op when slot is already -1.

0x00406a90.name: ShortComputation_6a90
0x00406a90.label: TrackIndexPairGetter
0x00406a90.summary: Reads and returns two integer values from offsets 0x18 and 0x1C through optional output pointer parameters. Simple getter function for a track index pair.

0x00406ab0.name: GenericObjectConstructorWithVTable
0x00406ab0.label: AudioStreamObjectConstructor
0x00406ab0.summary: Constructs an audio stream object: sets vtable to VTable_StreamObject, zeroes all data fields, initializes specific parameters (count=1, float=1.0f, index=2), and allocates Miles sound samples.

0x00406b30.name: IntegerSetter
0x00406b30.label: FieldOffset4Setter
0x00406b30.summary: Simple setter that writes an integer value to offset 0x4 and returns it.

0x00406b60.name: MenuSelectSetter
0x00406b60.label: TrackIndexSelectorSetter
0x00406b60.summary: Simple setter that writes an integer value to offset 0x54 (track index/selection) and returns it.

0x00406ba0.name: ComplexDestructorWith4LinkedLists
0x00406ba0.label: MultiListDestructorWithVTableSwitch
0x00406ba0.summary: Destructor/cleanup for an object containing 4 independent linked lists (audio objects, stream objects, and two generic object lists). Frees all nodes, calls virtual destructors where applicable, then zeros all list pointers. Audio system; swaps vtable at end.

0x00406cc0.name: AudioDriverInit
0x00406cc0.label: AudioDriverInit
0x00406cc0.summary: Initializes Miles Sound System digital audio driver. Calls Miles startup, selects sample rate based on stored index (11025/22050/44100), opens digital driver, sets HWND and file callbacks on success, or shuts down on failure.

0x00406e50.name: AudioSystemShutdown
0x00406e50.label: Miles Audio System Shutdown / Cleanup
0x00406e50.summary: Tear-down function for the Miles Sound System (AIL) audio manager: iterates four internal linked lists of audio resources/components, calls virtual cleanup/release methods on each, frees all nodes, closes the wave output device, and calls AIL_shutdown to terminate the audio library. Guarded by an active-flag; does nothing if already shut down.

0x00406f90.name: ObjectArrayLinkedListWalk
0x00406f90.label: ObjectArrayAndLinkedListWalkDispatch
0x00406f90.summary: Walks both an array of 20-byte object entries and a linked list of objects, dispatching virtual method calls on each (vtable+8 for array entries, vtable+12 for linked list nodes). Used for iterating all active objects.

0x00407070.name: ArrayLinkedListVirtualDispatchIterator
0x00407070.label: ObjectArrayAndLinkedListWalkDispatchAlt
0x00407070.summary: Same structure as ObjectArrayAndLinkedListWalkDispatch but dispatches different virtual methods (vtable+16 for array entries, vtable+20 for linked list nodes). Iterates both data structures for an alternative processing pass.

0x004070e0.name: SpatialQueryWithWeightedDistanceSelection
0x004070e0.label: SpatialQueryBestCandidateByWeightedDistance
0x004070e0.summary: Queries an array of spatial entries to find the best candidate based on weighted distance comparison. Each 20-byte entry has an object pointer, LOD value (used as 2^LOD weight), and distance. Selects entry minimizing (2^LOD * inputDist^2) / (distance^2 * 2^a2).

0x004071f0.name: AudioSamplePositionVolumeSetter
0x004071f0.label: AudioPositionVolumeVectorCopy
0x004071f0.summary: Copies a 3-component position/volume vector from input pointer to object fields at offsets 0x7C-0x84, then delegates to a computation function.

0x004072e0.name: MilesSoundSystemSampleAllocator
0x004072e0.label: MilesSoundSystemSampleAllocator
0x004072e0.summary: Manages Miles Sound System sample allocation: frees existing sample array and AIL sample handles, allocates new array of 20-byte entries with allocated AIL sample handles, and initializes each sample via AIL_init_sample.

0x00407450.name: LinkedListInsertOperation
0x00407450.label: LinkedListStringInsertUnique
0x00407450.summary: Inserts a string into a linked list if not already present. Part of a string-list management system that maintains a unique set of strings with head/tail/cursor pointers.

0x00407520.name: LinkedListNodeInsert
0x00407520.label: FileResourceLinkedListInsertByKey
0x00407520.summary: Inserts a file-backed resource node into a linked list by integer key, skipping if a node with that key already exists. Part of a file resource caching system that loads file data into memory and manages file handles per node.

0x00407810.name: LinkedListNodeInsertWithAllocation
0x00407810.label: ViewProjectionLinkedListInsert
0x00407810.summary: Allocates and initializes a view/projection structure (108 bytes) via ViewProjectionStructInit and inserts it into a linked list. Part of a 3D rendering or camera system that manages view/projection data structures.

0x004078a0.name: LinkedListNodeInsert_78a0
0x004078a0.label: MutexSyncObjectLinkedListInsert
0x004078a0.summary: Allocates and initializes a mutex/synchronization object (96 bytes) via MutexSynchronizationObjectInit and inserts it into a linked list. Part of a thread synchronization management system.

0x00407be0.name: LinkedListNodeRemovalByKey
0x00407be0.label: LinkedListNodeRemoveByKey
0x00407be0.summary: Removes a linked list node matching a given value pointer by key. Optionally calls a vtable-based release method on the node's data object before freeing the node structure. Two-pass traversal: first finds the node, then finds its predecessor for unlinking.

0x00407c90.name: LinkedListNodeRemovalWithVTableRelease
0x00407c90.label: MutexSyncObjectLinkedListRemoveByKey
0x00407c90.summary: Removes a mutex/synchronization linked list node matching a given value pointer. Same pattern as LinkedListNodeRemovalByKey but with struct offsets shifted by 0x10 for the mutex sync object list (head at 0x18). Calls vtable-based release on the data object before freeing the node.

0x00407d40.name: ShortComputation_7d40
0x00407d40.label: AudioDirectionTrigFromAngles
0x00407d40.summary: Computes sine and cosine of an input angle and stores them alongside 3D position/angle data (3 ints + 3 floats). Audio spatial positioning helper called during sample position/volume setting.

0x00407dd0.name: ShortComputation_7dd0
0x00407dd0.label: TraverseListAndTriggerConditional
0x00407dd0.summary: Traverses a linked list and calls ConditionalMatchTrigger on each node's stored value. Called during settings save to notify each element in the list of a save event.

0x00407e10.name: ShortComputation_7e10
0x00407e10.label: TripleDwordGetterFromStruct
0x00407e10.summary: Reads three consecutive DWORDs from struct offsets 0x94/0x98/0x9C and writes them to three output pointers. Simple inline getter for a triple of related values.

0x00407e40.name: ResourceNodeLookupByStringOrID
0x00407e40.label: ResourceLookupByStringOrID
0x00407e40.summary: Looks up a resource node in a linked list by either integer ID (offset 0x10 within data) or string name (offset 0x04 within data). Dual-mode lookup where a3 == -1 selects string mode, otherwise ID mode.

0x00407f10.name: ResourceIDLookupByNameString
0x00407f10.label: ResourceIDLookupByString
0x00407f10.summary: Traverses a linked list looking for a node whose string name matches the input, then returns the node's integer ID at offset 0x5C. Returns -1 if not found. Nodes with ID == -1 are skipped (treated as unregistered).

0x00407fb0.name: LinkedListSearchByID
0x00407fb0.label: LinkedListIDExistsCheck
0x00407fb0.summary: Searches a linked list for a node whose ID field (offset 0x5C) matches the input. Returns 1 if found, 0 otherwise. Boolean variant of the ID lookup pattern.

0x00408000.name: LinkedListTraversalByID
0x00408000.label: LinkedListFindByIDAndInvoke
0x00408000.summary: Searches a linked list for a node with matching ID (offset 0x5C) and calls sub_406A70 on its data when found. Find-and-invoke pattern with no return value.

0x004080b0.name: sub_4080B0
0x004080b0.label: LinkedListFindByFirstDword
0x004080b0.summary: Searches a linked list for a node whose data's first DWORD matches the input value. Pure lookup with no side effects.

0x004080f0.name: MemoryAllocationWithBufferRead
0x004080f0.label: StreamReadToAllocatedBuffer
0x004080f0.summary: Reads element count from a stream at offset 0x0C, allocates a 4-byte-per-element buffer, then reads each element into the buffer. Zero-initializes allocated buffer before fill. Returns 0 on full success, non-zero on failure.

0x004081e0.name: UtilityFunction
0x004081e0.label: ConditionalPointerCleanupAndFree
0x004081e0.summary: Checks a flag byte at offset 8; if set, performs multi-stage cleanup on the pointer at offset 0 then frees it. Conditional destructor helper for objects with resource management.

0x00408290.name: StateInitWithGlobalConstants
0x00408290.label: StateInitWithScreenDimensions
0x00408290.summary: Initializes struct fields with screen width (dword_5D6D60) and height (dword_5D6D64) as floats and sets a byte flag to 1. Called during camera manager restart to reinitialize display state.

0x004082b0.name: FloatClampWithEventDispatch
0x004082b0.label: FloatClampWithEventDispatch
0x004082b0.summary: Clamps a float value toward a target bound with exponential cooling/lerp, dispatches conditional events based on zero/non-zero state, and renders 2D fill rectangles for UI overlay. Part of physics/UI integration system.

0x004083e0.name: StructInitWithConditionalNotify
0x004083e0.label: StructResetWithConditionalNotify
0x004083e0.summary: Resets struct fields to defaults (zero, except offset 0x08 = 1.0f). If the byte flag at offset 0x15 was non-zero before reset, calls ConditionalBranchByFlag(1) as a deactivation notification. State-change callback pattern.

0x00408420.name: ReciprocalWithSignCheck
0x00408420.label: ReciprocalWithPositiveCheck
0x00408420.summary: Computes 1.0/a2 when a2 is positive, otherwise defaults to 1.0. Always initializes offset 0x04 to 1.0. Simple guarded reciprocal utility used by sound, menu, and loading systems.

0x00408450.name: SafeDivisionWithZeroGuard
0x00408450.label: SafeDivisionWithZeroGuard
0x00408450.summary: Computes safe reciprocal (1.0/a2) guarded against zero/negative input; resets timer to 0 and triggers clamp+dispatch on invalid input. Part of physics timing/integration system.

0x00408490.name: ShortComputation_8490
0x00408490.label: FloatMultiplyByGlobalConstant
0x00408490.summary: Multiplies the first float field of the struct by global constant flt_5BE8F8 and returns the result. Simple scaling utility used by steering/physics computations.

0x004084b0.name: ShortComputation_84b0
0x004084b0.label: LargeStructConstructorWithVTable
0x004084b0.summary: Initializes a struct with vtable pointer at offset 0, zeros all fields, sets offset 0x34 to -1 and offset 0x50 to 2. Object constructor for a managed type with vtable dispatch.

0x00408520.name: VtableEntryNotifyCleanup
0x00408520.label: VTable Entry Notify Cleanup
0x00408520.summary: Switches vtable to VTable_59E60C, iterates 9 sub-object pointers at this+0x10..0x30 calling virtual function (arg=1, one at +0x28 uses arg=3) on each non-null entry, then switches vtable to VTable_SceneNodeChain. Acts as a notify-and-teardown sequence for child nodes.

0x004085f0.name: sub_4085F0
0x004085f0.label: Parameterized Sub-Object Dispatch
0x004085f0.summary: Selects a sub-object pointer from this[4..12] or computed offset based on mode field at this+0x34, then dispatches parameterized ShortComputation and CollisionCoefficientApplication calls based on arguments a2/a3/a4 (-1 or 1). Controls rendering parameters per sub-object.

0x00408740.name: FloatKeyedFieldSelector
0x00408740.label: FloatKeyedFieldSelector
0x00408740.summary: Switch-based field selector using float-as-integer key (LODWORD); selects from 9 struct fields, applies degrees-to-radians conversion and trig computation. Part of camera/view vector processing system.

0x00408870.name: CameraPositionDefinitions
0x00408870.label: CameraViewDefinitionInitializer
0x00408870.summary: Initializes four 3D camera/sound-emitter view definition objects (2-seater, 3-seater, left-of-pits, right-of-pits) with preset FOV, near/far clip, view angles, and positional offsets for the camera system.

0x00408de0.name: ConditionalSubsystemCallWithParameter
0x00408de0.label: ConditionalSubsystemCallWithParameter
0x00408de0.summary: Conditionally invokes a subsystem operation and optional render draw with clipping, guarded by an enable flag and a sub-object pointer. Part of camera/view render pipeline.

0x00408e20.name: CameraViewSystem
0x00408e20.label: Camera View System Initialization
0x00408e20.summary: Initializes the camera view system: opens an audio stream, iterates camera definitions, creates 3D sound emitters for each named camera view (swingman, cockpit, TV cockpit, nosecam, localcam), allocates dynamic view arrays, and applies session-manager camera positions.

0x00409440.name: ViewCameraModeDispatch
0x00409440.label: CameraViewModeDispatcher
0x00409440.summary: Dispatches camera/view mode changes based on player input — handles cycling through cockpit/TV/external views (modes 0-2), direct mode jumps (3-8), sub-option cycling within modes (case 4), and copies UI state globals into sub-objects for replay/monitor modes (7-8). Triggers audio feedback on mode switch. Camera/UI system.

0x00409770.name: sub_409770
0x00409770.label: File Load And Dispatch To Sub-Objects
0x00409770.summary: Removes read-only attribute from a file, loads its content into a temporary struct, then dispatches the loaded data to up to 4 fixed sub-object pointers and a variable-length array of sub-objects via vtable+8 calls. Returns 0 if any sub-object received data, 1 if none.

0x00409890.name: sub_409890
0x00409890.label: MirrorRearView Render Setup
0x00409890.summary: Searches for mirror bitmap in linked list, checks a flag bit (0x40000) to select rearview vs mainview mode, stores view parameters, and dispatches conditional render pipeline. Called during camera/director update for mirror rendering.

0x00409970.name: ConditionalRenderPipelineDispatch
0x00409970.label: Conditional Rearview Pipeline Dispatch
0x00409970.summary: If rearview data is present (this[2] non-null), converts camera scale factors from degrees to radians, sets up render pipeline with camera transform and flag reset. Part of mirror rendering system.

0x00409a00.name: CameraModeViewportUpdate
0x00409a00.label: CameraModeViewportUpdate
0x00409a00.summary: Switches between camera modes (0-8: chase, cockpit, replay, etc.), applies 3D coordinate transforms, Euler rotation adjustments, mirror/flip logic, and renders the viewport per frame. Central camera/viewport system.

0x0040a610.name: UtilityFunction_a610
0x0040a610.label: Sub-Object Array Accessor
0x0040a610.summary: Returns the sub-object pointer at this[4+index] for index 0-8, or 0 for out-of-range indices. Simple array-like accessor function.

0x0040a680.name: FilePathListSearch
0x0040a680.label: FilePath List Search
0x0040a680.summary: Searches a hybrid list (8 fixed entries + variable-length array) of file path entries for a match against given path string a2. Returns pointer to first matching entry or 0.

0x0040a890.name: MultiFieldMembershipCheck
0x0040a890.label: Multi-Entry Membership Check
0x0040a890.summary: Checks if given pointer a2 matches any of the stored entries (8 fixed + variable array at this[8] with stride 200). Returns 1 (true) if found, 0 (false) otherwise.

0x0040a910.name: MenuSlotActionDispatch
0x0040a910.label: Menu Slot Selection Dispatch
0x0040a910.summary: Matches a2 against stored slot entries (8 fixed + variable array), dispatches ViewCameraModeDispatch with corresponding mode index (0-8), and optionally calls virtual update callback at vtable+16. Stores variable array index in this[15] when a variable entry matches.

0x0040aa20.name: F_3DTransformObjectAllocator
0x0040aa20.label: 3D Transform Object Allocator
0x0040aa20.summary: Lazily allocates up to 5 3D sound/transform objects via F_3DSoundEmitter (4 fixed 200-byte + one 204-byte variant), initializing rotation angles to 360.0f and default transform parameters. Ensures each sub-object is allocated exactly once.

0x0040ac00.name: StructInitWithVTable
0x0040ac00.label: UI Object Constructor
0x0040ac00.summary: Initializes a struct with VTable_UIObject_59E678 and zeros 5 fields. Acts as a constructor for a UI object.

0x0040ac40.name: VTableSwitch
0x0040ac40.label: VTable Switch UI To SceneNode
0x0040ac40.summary: Temporarily switches vtable to VTable_UIObject_59E678, calls sub-object virtual function (arg=3) if present, then switches to VTable_SceneNodeChain. Acts as a vtable transition sequence.

0x0040acc6.name: TripleFieldSetter
0x0040acc6.label: Triple Field Setter
0x0040acc6.summary: Sets three consecutive fields (offsets 0xC, 0x10, 0x14) to the same value a2. Simple bulk-assignment function.

0x0040acd0.name: MinimumDistanceSearch
0x0040acd0.label: Minimum Distance Search
0x0040acd0.summary: Searches a stride-160 array at this+0xC for the entry whose float at offset +140 is closest to EmptyStub(a2). Returns the index and minimum delta via output parameters a3 and a4.

0x0040ad60.name: LinearSearchWithStride0xA0
0x0040ad60.label: Linear Search With Stride 160
0x0040ad60.summary: Linear search for pointer a2 in stride-160 array at this+0xC with this[4] entries. Returns matching index (0-based) or -1 if not found.

0x0040ad90.name: BoundedIndexSetter
0x0040ad90.label: Bounded Index Setter
0x0040ad90.summary: Sets this[5] (offset 0x14) to a2 only if 0 <= a2 < this[4] (the upper bound). Returns a2 unchanged.

0x0040adb0.name: CameraShake
0x0040adb0.label: Camera Shake Computation
0x0040adb0.summary: Computes camera shake reaction: retrieves current camera entry (stride-160 array at this+0xC, indexed by this+0x14), checks proximity to nearby vehicles, handles collision response if threshold exceeded, and updates camera rotation angles and float parameter.

0x0040b030.name: StaticCameraSceneLoader
0x0040b030.label: Static Camera Scene Loader
0x0040b030.summary: Loads static camera scene data from file: initializes 128 temp camera entries on stack, searches for "MainView" string, opens audio stream, reads static camera entries (up to 128) matching "StaticCam", allocates persistent storage, and stores the allocated array + count in this fields.

0x0040b450.name: LookupWithOptionalCallback
0x0040b450.label: Lookup With Optional Callback
0x0040b450.summary: Searches for a2 in the stride-160 array via LinearSearchWithStride0xA0, stores the found index via BoundedIndexSetter, and optionally calls virtual callback at vtable+16 if a3 flag is set. Returns 1 on match, 0 on failure.

0x0040b560.name: StructInitWithVtable
0x0040b560.label: Object Constructor With VTable E6AC
0x0040b560.summary: Initializes struct with VTable_59E6AC and zeros 5 fields (offsets 0x4, 0x8, 0xC, 0x10, 0x14). Acts as a constructor.

0x0040b5a0.name: VTableSwitchWithVirtualCall
0x0040b5a0.label: VTable Switch E6AC To SceneNode
0x0040b5a0.summary: Temporarily switches vtable to VTable_59E6AC, calls sub-object virtual function (arg=3) if present, then switches to VTable_SceneNodeChain. Acts as a vtable transition sequence.

0x0040b6f0.name: ShortComputation_b6f0
0x0040b6f0.label: Bounded Index Setter With Callback
0x0040b6f0.summary: If 0 <= a2 < this[4] (offset 0x10), sets this[5] (offset 0x14) = a2 and calls virtual callback at vtable+16. Returns a2.

0x0040b710.name: CameraTransformComputation
0x0040b710.label: Camera Transform Computation
0x0040b710.summary: Computes camera transform for current camera entry (stride-208 array at this+0xC, indexed by this+0x14). Applies vehicle velocity data, matrix transform, position/orientation processing, and camera angle updates. Part of camera processing pipeline.

0x0040b850.name: MainView
0x0040b850.label: Main View Loader
0x0040b850.summary: Loads main view camera data from file: initializes 128 temp camera entries (stride 208), searches for "MainView" string, opens audio stream, reads "TrackingCam" entries (up to 128), allocates persistent storage, and stores the allocated array + count in this fields.

0x0040bd10.name: MultiLineTextDraw
0x0040bd10.label: File Load And Dispatch To Camera Entries
0x0040bd10.summary: Loads a file (removing read-only attribute), dispatches its content to each entry in a stride-208 array at this+0xC (count at this+0x10) via vtable+8 calls. Returns 0 if any entry received data, 1 if none.

0x0040be20.name: ConditionalVirtualCallTriplet
0x0040be20.label: VirtualTripleRelease
0x0040be20.summary: Calls virtual method at vtable[0] with argument 1 on up to three stored interface pointers (offsets 0x18, 0x1C, 0x20), then nulls each. Used for releasing/chaining cleanup of three polymorphic objects.

0x0040be70.name: KeyboardInputActionMapper
0x0040be70.label: KeyboardInputToCameraActionMapper
0x0040be70.summary: Iterates array of input action codes (word_7CB21C) and maps each to a camera action: target race leader, track current vehicle, or switch camera mode. Gated by CameraLockCheck and GameActionStateMachine per action.

0x0040c070.name: RandomStateMachineWithTimerAndTrigger
0x0040c070.label: RandomCameraModeTimer
0x0040c070.summary: Countdown timer that, on expiry, picks a random camera mode (0,3,4,5) and transitions via GameActionStateMachine. Optionally targets race leader. Called per-tick from camera director.

0x0040c140.name: sub_40C140
0x0040c140.label: CameraConfigLoader
0x0040c140.summary: Loads camera configuration from "cams.cfg" and "default.cfg" into a camera manager object. Allocates and initializes the manager on first call, dispatches game state after loading.

0x0040c240.name: SceneFileLoadByCurrentIndex
0x0040c240.label: CameraSceneFileLoader
0x0040c240.summary: Loads a camera scene file based on current scene index. Allocates a scene loader object on first call, constructs path from SceneArray entry by replacing extension with "cam" suffix, then loads it via virtual dispatch.

0x0040c3b0.name: ModuleAssetPathResolver
0x0040c3b0.label: CameraModuleAssetPathLoader
0x0040c3b0.summary: Loads a second camera module asset file by constructing path from current SceneArray entry (replacing extension with "cam" suffix). Identical pattern to CameraSceneFileLoader but stores result in this+0x20 slot instead of this+0x1C.

0x0040c520.name: sub_40C520
0x0040c520.label: CrossLinkSceneAndModuleObjects
0x0040c520.summary: Cross-links two camera loader objects stored at this+0x1C and this+0x20 by writing each other's pointer into offset 8 of the opposite object. Establishes bidirectional back-references between scene file loader and module asset loader.

0x0040c5b0.name: CameraModeChangeRequest
0x0040c5b0.label: CameraModeChangeSubmit
0x0040c5b0.summary: Requests camera mode change to mode 5 when current player differs from current vehicle occupant. Queued mode (value 2) is gated by queued mode flag.

0x0040c610.name: ConditionalModeDispatchWithGlobalGate
0x0040c610.label: CameraModeConditionalDispatch
0x0040c610.summary: Dispatches camera mode request based on queued mode flag. When queue active, only mode 1 passes (mapped to mode 2); when inactive, modes 1 and 2 pass (mapped to mode 0).

0x0040c650.name: CameraViewAssignment
0x0040c650.label: CameraViewAssignment
0x0040c650.summary: Assigns camera view mode based on comparison between target entity (a2) and current vehicle occupant. Modes 1-2 dispatch through gateway; mode 3 has special handling requiring a player vehicle flag.

0x0040c720.name: CameraLockCheck
0x0040c720.label: CameraLockCheck
0x0040c720.summary: Returns whether camera lock is allowed for given mode index. Mode 3 specifically blocked when player differs from vehicle occupant and both byte_7CFE88 and PlayerVehiclePtr+13388 flags are set.

0x0040c780.name: ScoringGateConditionCheck
0x0040c780.label: ScoringGateDelta
0x0040c780.summary: Returns a float delta based on scoring gate state. When gate equals 2, computes absolute difference of scoring data; otherwise returns a default float constant. Used as timer decrement by callers.

0x0040c7a0.name: CameraTargetUpdateOnPlayerChange
0x0040c7a0.label: CameraTargetUpdateOnPlayerChange
0x0040c7a0.summary: Updates camera target when player changes vehicle. Compares current camera target ID against current player's vehicle field; on mismatch, stops/transitions audio effects and computes new camera mode based on dispatch mode selector and vehicle state. Called by camera director during player vehicle swap.

0x0040c870.name: VirtualDispatchHelper
0x0040c870.label: VirtualDispatchHelper
0x0040c870.summary: Dispatches to a virtual method at vtable+0x18 on a component object, with early-out on cached result. Part of component-based dispatch system used across rendering, physics, and particles.

0x0040c890.name: TracksideCameraTargetLookup
0x0040c890.label: TracksideCameraTargetLookup
0x0040c890.summary: Resolves a camera target name/ID by querying three registered loader objects in sequence (config, scene, module) via virtual method at vtable+28. Returns first non-zero result.

0x0040c8d0.name: StateCheckWithTernaryLogic
0x0040c8d0.label: CameraModeStateResolver
0x0040c8d0.summary: Resolves camera mode from stored state fields. Falls back to sub-object field when primary is zero; maps value 1→1, 2→queue-dependent result, else→0 or 3.

0x0040c910.name: ShortComputation_c910
0x0040c910.label: FetchFieldFromSubObject
0x0040c910.summary: Returns dword at offset 4 from a sub-object pointer stored at this+0x8. Trivial field accessor.

0x0040c920.name: CamMan_Init
0x0040c920.label: CameraManagerInit
0x0040c920.summary: Initializes the camera manager: resolves main view string, clears game state flags, loads scene file, module assets, camera config, links loaders, and sets a global init flag.

0x0040c9e0.name: CamMan_Restart
0x0040c9e0.label: CameraManagerRestart
0x0040c9e0.summary: Resets camera manager state for restart: logs entry, reinitializes state via global constants, clears stored player ID and byte flag.

0x0040ca30.name: MainCameraDirectorUpdate
0x0040ca30.label: CameraDirectorPerFrameUpdate
0x0040ca30.summary: Per-frame update tick for the main camera director — processes player input (keyboard or AI random state machine), switches camera modes, tracks player vehicle position and velocity, and renders particle effects on mode transitions.

0x0040cce0.name: CamMan_Post
0x0040cce0.label: CameraManagerPost
0x0040cce0.summary: Cleans up camera manager: zeros main pointer, releases three virtual loader objects (config, scene, module) via vtable[0] release pattern, resets state, and clears byte flag.

0x0040cd60.name: SessionPhaseDecode
0x0040cd60.label: SessionPhaseDecode
0x0040cd60.summary: Decodes session phase identifier (0-4) from a session pointer into a stored field, or sets fallback code 5 on mismatch. Used across audio, random state machine, and session dispatch systems.

0x0040cdd0.name: SimpleSetter
0x0040cdd0.label: SimpleFieldSetter
0x0040cdd0.summary: Writes argument a2 into this+0x8 and returns it. Trivial setter/assignment helper.

0x0040cde0.name: GameActionStateMachine
0x0040cde0.label: GameActionStateMachine
0x0040cde0.summary: 10-case state machine dispatching camera mode changes and audio effects based on action IDs (0-10). Manages state pointers, transitions, and conditional virtual dispatch. Part of camera/view/input system.

0x0040d090.name: VirtualDispatchConditionalAudio
0x0040d090.label: CameraEffectReset
0x0040d090.summary: Calls virtual method at vtable+16 on a stored effect object (this+0x8), then zeros two collision geometry state fields at offsets 420 and 424 if the collision handle is non-null.

0x0040d0b0.name: ModeDispatchedSubsystemCall
0x0040d0b0.label: DispatchModeSubsystemCall
0x0040d0b0.summary: Dispatches to a subsystem via UtilityFunction_a610 with argument selected by DispatchModeSelector (0→2, 1→1, 2→0, 3→3). Uses stored object pointer at this+0x18.

0x0040d100.name: GameStateBranchDispatch
0x0040d100.label: GameStateBranchDispatch
0x0040d100.summary: Dispatches camera mode and game action based on global dispatch mode selector (dword_7CFDC4 values 1-4). Branches to ViewCameraModeDispatch and GameActionStateMachine with paired mode/action IDs. Part of game state management system.

0x0040d1b0.name: SessionPhaseDispatchWithCascadeChecks
0x0040d1b0.label: SessionPhaseDispatchWithCascadeChecks
0x0040d1b0.summary: Attempts cascading lookup across three dispatch objects (menu, callback, resource). On first match, records the matched object pointer, sets dispatch flag, decodes session phase, transitions game action state, and optionally triggers a virtual callback.

0x0040d240.name: GameStateDispatchChain
0x0040d240.label: GameStateDispatchChain
0x0040d240.summary: Coordinates game state change: sets player vehicle index, updates camera target to player, assigns camera view, resets camera effect, triggers AI out-of-track event, and calls completion handler.

0x0040d290.name: CameraTargetRaceLeader
0x0040d290.label: CameraTargetRaceLeader
0x0040d290.summary: Resolves race leader's team ID based on current player's vehicle and a direction flag, then dispatches game state change to target that leader.

0x0040d2ca.name: VehicleSelectionCyclicShift
0x0040d2ca.label: Cyclic vehicle selection shift
0x0040d2ca.summary: Shifts current player index forward (a1=1) or backward (a1=0), wraps around vehicle count. Dispatches game state for newly selected vehicle and refreshes all vehicle visual entries via sub_4F0D20.

0x0040d360.name: ShortComputation_d360
0x0040d360.label: RandomRangeCompute
0x0040d360.summary: Generates random value within configurable range. Accepts min/max parameters, clamps/stores them, computes random int in [min, max) via LCG, stores result as float. Returns quotient from random division (side channel of LCG call). Used for randomized timing or parameter selection.

0x0040d3c0.name: ShortComputation_d3c0
0x0040d3c0.label: ShortComputation_d3c0
0x0040d3c0.summary: Conditional session-phase-aware action dispatcher: stores decoded phase, triggers game action for IDs 7-10, sets activity flag, and computes reciprocal with sign check. Part of pit stop / session management system.

0x0040d410.name: ShortComputation_d410
0x0040d410.label: ShortComputation_d410
0x0040d410.summary: Complementary action to d3c0: decodes session phase, dispatches game action for phase range [7,10], computes safe reciprocal, and clears activity flag. Part of pit stop / session management system.

0x0040d450.name: StateResetOnCondition
0x0040d450.label: StateResetOnCondition
0x0040d450.summary: Checks if state field equals 3; if so, resets to -1 and triggers GameActionStateMachine with action code 3. Used by TrackTemperatureDisplay for temperature state transitions (e.g., resetting overheated state).

0x0040d470.name: SimpleSetterWithSubCall
0x0040d470.label: StructFirstFieldSetter
0x0040d470.summary: Sets first DWORD of struct (likely vtable or parent pointer) from parameter, then calls StructFieldInit to initialize remaining fields. Returns `this`. Used during camera director reset/init.

0x0040d4c0.name: RaceCommentaryDirectorSystem
0x0040d4c0.label: CommentaryDirectorStateInit
0x0040d4c0.summary: Initializes a broadcast/commentary director state machine from a configuration data block, parsing action types (camera, commentary, gridwalk, flyover, etc.), target entities, timing, and probability fields. Part of the race broadcast/cinematic commentary system.

0x0040d980.name: GlobalDataStructInitWithFilePaths
0x0040d980.label: GlobalDataStructInit
0x0040d980.summary: Initializes a global data structure: stores four global pointers (session manager, pointer table, game state array, unknown) into pointer fields, zeroes counters/state fields, sets a max-size sentinel (-1) and a byte threshold (124), and calls sub-initializers for constraint solver and pointer array sub-structs.

0x0040d9fc.name: SubObjectDestructorChain
0x0040d9fc.label: SubObjectDestructorChain
0x0040d9fc.summary: Destructor-like function: frees this[34] if non-null, calls LinkedListDestructorWithInnerFree on this+19, then reinitializes this+5 via ConstraintSolverParamInit.

0x0040da30.name: CameraDirectorResetInit
0x0040da30.label: CameraDirectorResetInit
0x0040da30.summary: Resets camera director state: saves and clears a byte flag at 0xA0, sets state to 1, zeroes counters, conditionally dispatches an in-progress session phase and updates player/vehicle index globals, then ensures the sub-struct pointer at 0x88 is valid (re-initializes existing or allocates new), falling back to error state -1 on allocation failure.

0x0040db00.name: CameraTargetNameResolver
0x0040db00.label: CameraTargetNameResolver
0x0040db00.summary: Compares argument string a2 against known camera target names ("Original", "Last", "AnyTrackside", "None", "Player") and returns the corresponding camera target pointer from this's fields, or delegates to TracksideCameraTargetLookup. Returns 0 for unrecognized/empty strings.

0x0040dbc0.name: ModeValidationCheck
0x0040dbc0.label: ModeValidationCheck
0x0040dbc0.summary: Returns TRUE if the current mode (this+0x0) equals 3 or 4, FALSE otherwise. Acts as a gate to allow processing only in specific modes.

0x0040dc00.name: StringPathExtensionManipulation
0x0040dc00.label: StringPathExtensionManipulation
0x0040dc00.summary: Builds a path string from CurrentTrackPath (or default directory), concatenates with a dot-extension string, finds and truncates at the last '.' to strip existing extension, then appends path separator word and extension bytes. Passes result to FunctionCallWrapper_dbe0 and frees the temp buffer.

0x0040dcd0.name: StateMachineInitializer
0x0040dcd0.label: StateMachineInitializer
0x0040dcd0.summary: Two-phase state machine init: phase 1 (state=1) initializes a sub-struct and stops audio, storing audio result; phase 2 (state=2) runs cinematic event state machine. Returns success only if both phases pass, else reverts to error state -1.

0x0040dd30.name: ConditionalDelegation
0x0040dd30.label: ConditionalDelegation
0x0040dd30.summary: If this[34] pointer and its +4 field are non-zero and ShortComputation_adb0 succeeds on both, delegates to RaceCommentaryDirectorSystem with the computed value. Otherwise returns 0.

0x0040dd80.name: ShortComputation_dd80
0x0040dd80.label: ShortComputation_dd80
0x0040dd80.summary: State machine with 7 states: states -1/0/1/5 block (return 0), states 2/3 dispatch a virtual call and transition to state 4 (return 1), state 4 is active (return 1). Default transitions to error state -1.

0x0040ddf0.name: CinematicEventStateMachine
0x0040ddf0.label: CinematicEventStateMachine
0x0040ddf0.summary: State machine for cinematic event playback: states -1/0/1 blocked; states 2-5 search the "CinematicEvent" string-linked-list and attempt to start the race commentary director system. On success resets to state 2 and clears counters; on failure sets error state -1.

0x0040de60.name: sub_40DE60
0x0040de60.label: Session State Machine Event Processor
0x0040de60.summary: Processes a queue of timed events for a game session state machine (phase 4). Dispatches actions like player vehicle assignment, message display, physics init, car selection, and state transitions based on event type and timers. Part of the session/game-mode state management system.

0x0040e170.name: TickUpdateDispatch
0x0040e170.label: TickUpdateDispatch
0x0040e170.summary: Tick update dispatch: conditionally initializes engine subsystem if a sub-struct flag at offset 0x24 equals 10, calls a vtable method on a pointer chain through this+0x8, initializes a buffer with defaults, then resets the camera director.

0x0040e1f0.name: GlobalVectorOffsetUpdate
0x0040e1f0.label: GlobalVectorOffsetUpdate
0x0040e1f0.summary: Iterates scene graph children and packed array vertices, subtracts a 3-component offset vector from each vertex, recomputes bounding boxes, and clears flags. Part of scene graph / mesh transform system.

0x0040e2b0.name: AudioPhysicsMixWithLerp
0x0040e2b0.label: AudioPhysicsMixWithLerp
0x0040e2b0.summary: Computes averaged vertex position from packed array, lerps with bounding box center using blend factor (0.35 for mode 2, 0.70 otherwise), then applies triple-field offset and updates global vector. Part of audio-physics scene graph integration.

0x0040e480.name: LightFrustumClosestPoint
0x0040e480.label: LightFrustumClosestPoint
0x0040e480.summary: Computes bounding box, calculates center point and radius. Then performs a 5x5x5 grid search (125 sample points) across the bounding box volume, finding the point with minimum distance to the nearest element in a packed array. Returns closest point in a2 and radius in *a3.

0x0040e710.name: ShortComputation_e710
0x0040e710.label: ShortComputation_e710
0x0040e710.summary: Switch on value at this+0x1C (modes 0-5): writes parameter a2 to a destination field. Cases 0/3/1/4/2/5 all write a2 to offset 0xD0 within a sub-struct pointed by this+0x20; default returns immediately without writing.

0x0040e770.name: ShortComputation_e770
0x0040e770.label: ShortComputation_e770
0x0040e770.summary: Multi-mode dispatch function: toggles scene node visibility, optionally calls audio-physics mixing for modes 0-2, computes dual matrix transform, dispatches virtual method on sub-object with matrix data write, then calls cleanup subroutines. Part of camera/view/scene graph system.

0x0040e860.name: ShortComputation_e860
0x0040e860.label: StructFieldSetter_e860
0x0040e860.summary: Writes three struct fields: WORD at offset 0x8 from parameter a2, DWORD at offset 0x1C set to constant 6, and DWORD at offset 0x20 from parameter a3. Returns a2 sign-extended.

0x0040e880.name: StructFieldInitializer_e880
0x0040e880.label: StructFieldInitializer_e880
0x0040e880.summary: Sets three struct fields: WORD at offset 0x8 from a2, DWORD at offset 0x1C to constant 7, DWORD at offset 0x20 from a3; then calls ShortComputation_e770(this, a3, 0) and returns its result.

0x0040e8b0.name: StructSetupWithTwoCalls
0x0040e8b0.label: LightFrustumClosestPointSetup
0x0040e8b0.summary: Initializes light/shadow structure fields and computes closest point in light frustum via sub-call. Physics rendering system.

0x0040e8f0.name: StructInitWithFloatConstantsAndSubCalls
0x0040e8f0.label: PhysicsShapeInitType0
0x0040e8f0.summary: Initializes a physics collision shape structure with subtype=0, stores precomputed float constants via CollisionInvMassStore and F_6FieldBulkSetter. Physics collision system.

0x0040e990.name: StructInitWithFloatConstantsAndSubCalls_e990
0x0040e990.label: PhysicsShapeInitType1
0x0040e990.summary: Initializes a physics collision shape structure with subtype=1, stores precomputed float constants via CollisionInvMassStore and F_6FieldBulkSetter. Physics collision system.

0x0040ea30.name: sub_40EA30
0x0040ea30.label: PhysicsShapeInitType2WithBoundingBox
0x0040ea30.summary: Initializes physics collision shape with subtype=2, computes bounding box dimensions from collider data, stores scaled distance-squared values (factor 0.4166667 = 5/12) and writes shape constants to sub-struct. Physics collision system.

0x0040eb30.name: CameraProjectionMatrixInitWithFloatConstants
0x0040eb30.label: PhysicsShapeInitType3
0x0040eb30.summary: Initializes a physics collision shape structure with subtype=3, stores precomputed float constants via CollisionInvMassStore and F_6FieldBulkSetter. Physics collision system.

0x0040ebd0.name: UtilityFunction_ebd0
0x0040ebd0.label: PhysicsShapeInitType4
0x0040ebd0.summary: Initializes a physics collision shape structure with subtype=4, stores precomputed float constants via CollisionInvMassStore and F_6FieldBulkSetter. Physics collision system.

0x0040ec70.name: StructInitializerWithFloatConstants
0x0040ec70.label: PhysicsStructInitWithFloatConstants
0x0040ec70.summary: Initializes a physics/collision-related struct: writes two caller-supplied values and constant 5 to fields, builds a float-array of 2D offset vectors (Y-only non-zero), then stores collision mass data, bulk-sets 6 float constants, and conditionally runs a short computation if a4 non-zero.

0x0040ed10.name: sub_40ED10
0x0040ed10.label: PositionMagnitudeCompute
0x0040ed10.summary: Computes position vector and magnitude from sub-object data using mode-based dispatch (0-7). Uses bounding box center, max squared magnitude search, or direct field copy depending on mode and flags. Part of scene graph / physics state system.

0x0040eec0.name: SwitchBasedFloatProcessing
0x0040eec0.label: SwitchBasedFloatProcessing
0x0040eec0.summary: Processes 7-element float array through mode-based dispatch (0-5): stores collision inverse mass and bulk-sets 6 float fields. Part of collision/physics data pipeline.

0x0040ef70.name: PhysicsStateVectorConversion
0x0040ef70.label: PhysicsStateVectorConversion
0x0040ef70.summary: Converts physics state vector (13 floats) into sub-object fields: sets position + offset, copies components, applies rotation tensor matrix transform, and calls computation subroutine. Mode-based dispatch (0-5). Part of physics/vehicle state system.

0x0040f0d0.name: ShortComputation_f0d0
0x0040f0d0.label: ShortComputation_f0d0
0x0040f0d0.summary: Guarded chain: if ID field is not -1, inserts node into linked list, processes nested loop, and runs cleanup subroutine. Part of scene graph / widget management system.

0x0040f100.name: ConditionalCleanupChain
0x0040f100.label: ConditionalCleanupChain
0x0040f100.summary: Guarded cleanup chain: if ID field is not -1, runs helper subroutine, arithmetic comparison, and cleanup. Part of widget/scene object lifecycle system.

0x0040f130.name: StateDependentUpdateDispatch
0x0040f130.label: StateRangeCheckUpdateDispatch
0x0040f130.summary: Dispatches update processing on a UI/input object based on state range. Reads state field (offset 0x1C); only proceeds if state is 0-5. Inside, branches on sentinel check: if first DWORD is -1, calls NestedLoopCall; otherwise calls coordinate transform, sub_410AF0, and comparison. Always ends with sub_4BE010.

0x0040f1c0.name: SceneObjectLoaderStateMachine
0x0040f1c0.label: SceneObjectLoaderStateMachine
0x0040f1c0.summary: 7-mode state machine dispatching loading/unloading of scene objects: checks sub-object status, updates position from sub-object data, processes camera shake and vehicle physics. Part of scene/vehicle loading system.

0x0040f300.name: ModeDispatchedRenderPhysicsCall
0x0040f300.label: ModeDispatchedRenderPhysicsCall
0x0040f300.summary: Dispatches vehicle physics processing based on mode: angular velocity integration for modes 0-5, sub-call + wheel contact transform for mode 6. Part of vehicle physics / render sync system.

0x0040f380.name: SwitchBasedStateHandler
0x0040f380.label: SwitchBasedStateHandler
0x0040f380.summary: 8-mode state handler dispatching collision detection, wheel contact distance computation, UI focus changes, and scene node visibility toggles based on mode and vtable flags. Part of vehicle/collision/physics system.

0x0040f4b0.name: ModeDispatchWithSwitch
0x0040f4b0.label: ModeDispatchWithSwitch
0x0040f4b0.summary: Dispatches collision processing based on mode: runs computation + collision impulse for modes 0-5, or vehicle contact force accumulation for mode 6. Part of collision/physics response system.

0x0040f550.name: UICameraModeDispatchWithVehicleDataRead
0x0040f550.label: UICameraModeDispatchWithVehicleDataRead
0x0040f550.summary: Mode-based dispatch: integrates physics state and sets flag for modes 0-5, or reads vehicle telemetry position from sub-object for mode 6. Part of UI/camera/vehicle data integration system.

0x0040f600.name: CameraShakeRingBufferWrite
0x0040f600.label: Camera Shake Ring Buffer Write / Telemetry Encode
0x0040f600.summary: Writes camera shake / vehicle telemetry data into a ring buffer (432 bytes per entry, max 1023 entries). Encodes vehicle position, orientation (as atan2 angles), velocity, and angular velocity as quantized 16-bit integers. Dispatches progress-bar HUD events based on a case-switch over a mode field at this+0x1C (cases 0-5).

0x0040fb30.name: GraphicsResourceDestructor
0x0040fb30.label: Track Object Manager Destructor
0x0040fb30.summary: Destructor for the track object manager: frees all heap-allocated arrays (vehicle, dspoly, non-DSP, cone, post, sign, wheel, wing, part) created by the constructor at 0x40FE50, calling per-element destructors (ShortComputation_fd70 or EmptyStub_aa60) on large struct arrays before freeing.

0x0040fd70.name: ShortComputation_fd70
0x0040fd70.label: FileStreamSubobjectDestructor
0x0040fd70.summary: Destructor for an object with FileStream vtable. Replaces vtable pointer at this+0 with VTable_FileStream, then calls MultiFieldCleanupDestructor on a nested subobject at this+0xD4.

0x0040fdd0.name: ArrayOfObjectsDestructor
0x0040fdd0.label: MultiObjectArrayDestructor
0x0040fdd0.summary: Destructor for an array of 198-dword objects (or a single object) with FileStream vtable. If flag bit 2 set, iterates backward through an array (preceded by count dword at this-1), setting vtable and destructing each subobject. Always calls MultiFieldCleanupDestructor on subobject at +53 dwords. Optionally frees memory if flag bit 1 set.

0x0040fe50.name: sub_40FE50
0x0040fe50.label: Track Object Manager Constructor
0x0040fe50.summary: Initializes the dynamic track-object manager: allocates arrays for 104 vehicle data entries, then walks the scene graph (via collision geometry handle) to categorize linked-list nodes by type (dspoly, dsindicator, dscone, cone, post, sign, wheel, wing, part) into separate small-struct and large-struct arrays with vtable assignments.

0x00410890.name: BatchProcessWithFixedStartOffsets
0x00410890.label: BatchedObjectUpdateDispatcher
0x00410890.summary: Dispatches StateDependentUpdateDispatch across 6 batches of objects stored at fixed offsets within a struct. Each batch has a count field and a base pointer field; stride is 36 bytes per object. Batches 4-6 have minimum start indices (416, 208, 832) below which no objects exist. Resets counter at this+0x6C to 0.

0x00410980.name: LoopWithConditionalSkipFunction
0x00410980.label: LoopWithConditionalSkipFunction
0x00410980.summary: Iterates array of scene objects, runs state machine on each; if state machine returns false (fail/unload), removes element and runs conditional cleanup chain. Part of scene object lifecycle / main game tick update.

0x004109d0.name: PerVehicleCameraUpdateIterator
0x004109d0.label: PerVehicleCameraUpdateIterator
0x004109d0.summary: Iterates per-vehicle camera/physics update based on scoring gate mode: direct wheel contact (gate 2), mode-dispatched render physics + camera shake (gate 1 or other). Part of vehicle/camera/physics update tick.

0x00410ad0.name: LinkedListNodeInsert_0ad0
0x00410ad0.label: ArraySlotInsert
0x00410ad0.summary: Inserts a pointer into a growable pointer-array slot. Part of a dynamic array or handle table management system.

0x00410af0.name: sub_410AF0
0x00410af0.label: ArraySlotSwapRemove
0x00410af0.summary: Removes an element from an unordered pointer array by index using swap-with-last (O(1) removal). Complements ArraySlotInsert. Part of dynamic array / handle table system.

0x00410b60.name: DelegationWrapperToFUN0040ed10
0x00410b60.label: ArrayIndexedDelegationWrapper
0x00410b60.summary: Extracts an index from an input struct (offset 0x4), uses it to look up a 36-byte-stride array element from `this+0x10`, and delegates to sub_40ED10. Thin wrapper for indexed per-element processing.

0x00410b80.name: ArrayOfStructLinearSearchByID
0x00410b80.label: ArrayOfStructsLinearSearchByID
0x00410b80.summary: Linear search through array of structs comparing first DWORD (ID field) against `a2`. Returns pointer into parallel result array (36-byte stride per element) if found, 0 if not found. Used by collision detection system.

0x00410bc0.name: WheelControllerInputDecoder
0x00410bc0.label: WheelInputDataUnpackDispatcher
0x00410bc0.summary: Decodes packed wheel input data from a 36-byte input buffer into 13 scaled float values, then dispatches to the appropriate wheel group (6 groups total based on a 6-bit type field). Within each group, validates wheel index bounds, checks sentinel (-1) to optionally initialize via ShortComputation_e770, calls RepairServiceStateDispatcher with subgroup ID, and converts physics state vector via PhysicsStateVectorConversion. References VEH global arrays for repair state lookups.

0x00410f60.name: SceneNodeDecoder
0x00410f60.label: SceneNodeTransformDecoder
0x00410f60.summary: Decodes packed transform data from a 36-byte input buffer into 6 scaled float values, then dispatches to an indexed scene node object via sub_54B4D0. The 6-bit type field selects one of 6 node groups (offsets 0x24-0x68), validates the node index, looks up a target pointer (computed as base + 792/808*idx + 208), and if non-null, unpacks position/rotation floats.

0x00411120.name: SessionStructureCleanup
0x00411120.label: ConditionedPhysicsBatchCleanup
0x00411120.summary: Iterates 6 batches of 36-byte objects and conditionally calls ModeDispatchedRenderPhysicsCall with current session time (dbl_8AFEA0). First 3 batches are unconditional (count > 0). Batches 4-6 have VEH state conditions: skip call for objects whose associated VEH data indicates active/alive state (sentinel != -1, non-null state pointer, non-zero byte flag). Used during loading phase to clean up or reinitialize physics state.

0x00411330.name: ShortComputation_1330
0x00411330.label: PhysicsStateUpdateByType
0x00411330.summary: Dispatches a physics/computation update based on operation type (3/4/5). Indexes into different local arrays and global data tables, computes a float offset, then calls three downstream processing functions. Sets an activity flag at v7+0x0A. Part of collision effects/physics system.

0x00411570.name: StatusFieldCopy
0x00411570.label: VEHStatusFieldPropagator
0x00411570.summary: Copies 14 status fields from VEH global array (indexed by a2, 18624-byte stride) into three target groups (this[19], this[22], this[25]) via ShortComputation_e710. If a3 is non-zero, reads source values from VEH; if a3 is zero, writes zeros (reset). Copies 4 fields from VEH+324 (74-dword stride), 2 fields from VEH+377/394 (even/odd), and 8 fields from VEH+1644 (17-dword stride).

0x00411650.name: CircularBufferIndexIncrement
0x00411650.label: CircBufIndexIncrementWithWrap
0x00411650.summary: Classic circular buffer index increment. Reads capacity (this[0]) and current index (this[1]), increments index, wraps to 0 if index reaches capacity, returns old index value. No-op if capacity <= 1.

0x00411680.name: ShortArrayInit
0x00411680.label: ShortPairArrayInitializer
0x00411680.summary: Initializes an array of 537 word-pairs to (1, 0). Each iteration sets two consecutive words: first to 1 (enabled flag), second to 0 (counter/index). No guard conditions; always processes all 537 elements.

0x004117b0.name: AudioCommentaryChannelConfiguration
0x004117b0.label: CommentaryChannelParamLookup
0x004117b0.summary: Returns audio commentary channel configuration parameters based on channel index. Channel 0 returns default commentary values (2 DWORDs + 2 pointers). Channel 1 returns TV commentary values. Invalid index (>1) returns 1 (error). Used to configure commentary audio output settings.

0x00411840.name: FontRenderingPrep
0x00411840.label: FontAndEventRenderDispatcher
0x00411840.summary: Prepares font rendering and dispatch for a text overlay. Resolves generation and sub-indices via helper calls, initializes a track-load state block on first invocation (setting sentinels to -1), then dispatches in sequence: CharacterCodeMapper, RaceEventMessageDispatcher (decrements counter), FontCharacterRenderDispatcher, and SoundEventDispatcher. Returns count of successful dispatches (0-2). Called during text overlay display timer.

0x00411ab0.name: RandomRangeTableInitializer
0x00411ab0.label: DriverRandomRangeInitializer
0x00411ab0.summary: Two-phase initialization of 537 two-word entries. Phase 1: sets all pairs to (1, 0). Phase 2: overwrites pairs (except edge indices 0, 290-292, 536) with random values derived from driver data tables. Looks up range from word_5BEBB0 (indices 1-290) or word_5BF2F8 (indices 293-535), computes range size, generates random offset via RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator, and stores (range, random_offset) into each pair.

0x00411b50.name: CharacterCodeMapper
0x00411b50.label: FontCharCodeToEventIdMapper
0x00411b50.summary: Maps a character code (a1) to an event ID using either special-case handling or lookup tables. Special codes 9875 → 45/46 (based on a4=397/426) and 9876 → 42/43 (based on a4=1/2). Otherwise uses unk_5BEE08 (a2=0) or unk_5BF4C0 (a2=1) table for lookup. On success writes (code, mapped_id) to output buffer and returns 0; on failure returns 1.

0x00411bf0.name: RaceEventMessageDispatcher
0x00411bf0.label: EventIdToNamedLookupDispatcher
0x00411bf0.summary: Dispatches based on event ID (from state block offset +12) to one of several lookup/processing functions. Routes to SessionStringNameLookup (with optional random flag), sub_412490, sub_412E50, TextAttributeLookup, TextAttributeLookup_3710, or MapCollisionShapeToBoneIndex depending on event ID value. Returns handler result or 0 for unrecognized IDs.

0x00411db0.name: FontCharacterRenderDispatcher
0x00411db0.label: FontCharRenderDispatch
0x00411db0.summary: Dispatches font character rendering based on character code (state block offset +8). Special codes 9875 (with variant 397/426) and 9876 (variants 1-2) handled directly via sub_412490 or EnumValueTranslation plus counter decrement. General case uses GlobalFieldSelectorByIndex to resolve a field index, then copies string path and mapped values (code, field_index, zero flag) to output buffer, returning 1 on success or -1 on failure.

0x00411e90.name: SoundEventDispatcher
0x00411e90.label: SoundEventIdDispatch
0x00411e90.summary: Dispatches sound-related processing based on event ID (from state block offset +12). Large switch routing to handlers: SessionStringNameLookup, sub_412490, sub_412E50, TextAttributeLookup(_3600/_3710), EnumValueTranslation, SeasonSpecificTeamIDLookup, sub_413820, CollisionShapeSizeClassify, and MapCollisionShapeToBoneIndex. Uses two random generator calls for variant flag selection.

0x004122c0.name: SessionStringNameLookup
0x004122c0.label: SessionStringFieldLookup
0x004122c0.summary: Looks up a string and three metadata fields (offset 8, 12, 16) from a session linked-list node indexed by a3. Has two paths: (1) if camera flag off and championship mode, extracts vehicle data (v7+124); (2) otherwise reads one of 8 field offsets within the node selected by (a2, a4, a5). Copies string path and fields to output a1. If all outputs match default sentinel values, optionally does further processing via LinkedListIndexScannerWithValidation and TextAttributeLookup_34d0.

0x00412490.name: sub_412490
