0x00412490.label: EventIdToDriverModelIndexMapper
0x00412490.summary: Maps event parameter (a3, range 1-24) to a driver model/index value (236-387) based on dispatch mode (a2=0/1) and flag (a4=0/1, a5 variant). Uses four switch tables for (a2,a4) combinations. Also calls sub_414180(a2) to compute a secondary value. Writes both to output buffer (a1+8, a1+12). Returns 1 on success, -1 if a3 value unrecognized or a2 out of range.

0x00412c30.name: MapCollisionShapeToBoneIndex
0x00412c30.label: CollisionShapeToBoneIndexMapper
0x00412c30.summary: Maps collision shape IDs (1-12, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 50) to bone indices (153-189). Each shape maps to a base value minus boolean flag (a4 != 0). Writes mapped bone index to output a1+8 and secondary value from sub_414180(0) to a1+12. Returns 1 on success, -1 if a2 != 0 or shape ID unrecognized.

0x00412e50.name: sub_412E50
0x00412e50.label: EventParamToBucketIndexMapper
0x00412e50.summary: Maps event parameter a3 (1-24 or 1-26) to a bucket index (214-266) based on dispatch mode a2 (0/1) with a4 flag variant. Each case selects a base value adjusted by a4 boolean. Special cases for a3=23 (a2=1) and a3=26 (a2=0) use negative offset calculation. Writes result to a1+8 and sub_414180(a2) to a1+12. Returns 1 on success, -1 otherwise.

0x004133b0.name: TextAttributeLookup
0x004133b0.label: TextAttributeFieldLookup
0x004133b0.summary: Looks up text attribute string and metadata from a linked-list node indexed by a3. Selects one of 4 field offsets within the node based on a2 (0/1) and a4 (0/1). Copies string path and three metadata fields (offset 8, 12, 16) to output a1. Returns 1 if any output differs from default sentinel values, -1 if all match defaults (string==default path, metadata==-1,-1, byte==0).

0x00413820.name: sub_413820
0x00413820.label: FloatValueThresholdClassifier
0x00413820.summary: Classifies a float value a3 into 17 buckets (1-17) using cascading thresholds (1.0, 3.0, 4.0, 7.5, 12.5, 17.5, 22.5, 27.5, 32.5, 37.5, 42.5, 47.5, 52.5, 75, 110, 999). Only active when a2==0 and a4==0. Writes bucket index to a1+8 and sub_414180(0) to a1+12. Returns 1 on success, -1 when guard fails.

0x00413b60.name: SeasonSpecificTeamIDLookup
0x00413b60.label: SeasonDbTeamIdMapper
0x00413b60.summary: Maps team index a3 (1-17) to a team ID (333-400) based on which season database file matches the current season path (dword_7D0434). Four nested database filename checks (f11999 → f12000 → f12001 → f12002) select one of four team ID tables (base 334, 335, 336, or 333, each +4 per entry). Only active when a2==1 and a4==0. Writes team ID to a1+8 and sub_414180(1) to a1+12.

0x00414010.name: EnumValueTranslation
0x00414010.label: EnumValueToSoundIdMapper
0x00414010.summary: Maps an input enum value (1-22) to a translated literal value (113-134) and stores it with a sub-function result. Used in sound event dispatching.

0x00414210.name: GlobalListTripleCleanupWithTimerRemoval
0x00414210.label: GlobalListTripleCleanupWithTimerRemoval
0x00414210.summary: Cleans up three global linked lists (geometries/resources, multi-field pointers, text format entries) by iterating each, freeing valid (flag=1) entries via type-specific destructors, then zeroing all head pointers.

0x00414380.name: MultiFieldPointerFree
0x00414380.label: MultiFieldPointerFree
0x00414380.summary: Frees multiple pointer fields in a struct (main pointer at offset 0, and four groups of 2 pointers at stride 5) using FreeWrapper_7bcf, preceded by a TextFormatStructInitializer_4d70 reset call.

0x004144f0.name: DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion
0x004144f0.label: DriverDataLookupAndTimeCalc
0x004144f0.summary: Populates a struct with driver context IDs and computed time values. Uses sentinel-replacement logic (defaults from DriverDataTable globals) and performs time conversion via CRTFtol. Core lookup utility called by ~35 AI/commentary/display functions.

0x004145c0.name: StructCopy
0x004145c0.label: Struct32ByteCopy
0x004145c0.summary: Copies 8 DWORDs (32 bytes) from source struct (a2) to destination struct (this). Plain field-by-field copy with no transformation. Used as a helper for array entry insertion and compaction.

0x00414600.name: sub_414600
0x00414600.label: DriverFilePathBuilder
0x00414600.summary: Constructs file paths for driver assets (pws/tv variants with Fb/Fe/Sb/Se extensions), checks file existence via FilePathExtensionCheck, and registers found files via DriverNameIDLookup. Returns 1 on success after TextFormatStructInitializer, 0 on failure.

0x00414900.name: FilePathExtensionCheck
0x00414900.label: FileExistenceCheckWithExtension
0x00414900.summary: Appends a 5-byte extension (from global constants) to a file path and checks if the file exists via GetFileAttributes (FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL). Returns 0 if file exists (writes struct fields), 1 if missing.

0x004149a0.name: TextFormatStructInitializer
0x004149a0.label: TextFormatStructInitializer
0x004149a0.summary: Resets a text format struct by setting groups of fields (DWORD/DWORD/BYTE triples) to -1/-1/0 across 8 named slots plus 2 extra trailing slots, interleaved with global path string reinitialization via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.

0x00414a90.name: sub_414A90
0x00414a90.label: CommentaryPwsTvPathBuilder
0x00414a90.summary: Constructs and validates commentary file paths for pws (practice/weekend/season) and tv (television) subdirectories with TB/TE extensions, looking up driver IDs via ShortComputation_41a0/sub_417640 and sub_417AF0 for matching files.

0x00414d70.name: TextFormatStructInitializer_4d70
0x00414d70.label: TextFormatStructInitializer_4d70
0x00414d70.summary: Resets a text format struct variant by setting groups of fields (DWORD/DWORD/BYTE triples at varying offsets) to -1/-1/0 across 7 named slots plus 2 extra trailing slots, interleaved with global path string reinitialization via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.

0x00414e60.name: CommentaryTVPWSPathBuilder
0x00414e60.label: CommentaryTrackTvPathBuilder
0x00414e60.summary: Builds and validates commentary track file paths in "tv" subdirectory with Country/B/Circuit/E extensions, looking up track display IDs via TrackNameDisplayIDLookup for existing files.

0x00414fe0.name: TextFormatStructInitializer_4fe0
0x00414fe0.label: TextFormatStructInitializer_4fe0
0x00414fe0.summary: Resets a smaller text format struct variant by setting groups of fields (DWORD/DWORD/BYTE triples) to -1/-1/0 across 3 slots plus 2 extra trailing slots, interleaved with global path string reinitialization via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.

0x004150c0.name: DrawableResourceCleanup
0x004150c0.label: DrawableResourceCleanup
0x004150c0.summary: Cleans up three linked lists of drawable resources (text format entries, multi-field entries, text format 4fe0 entries) by iterating each, freeing active entries via type-specific destructors, then zeroing list heads and counters.

0x00415230.name: NamedEntryLookupInFormatList
0x00415230.label: NamedEntryLookupInFormatList
0x00415230.summary: Searches a linked list of named format entries for a matching string and index, creating and appending a new 176-byte entry if not found. The new entry is initialized with sub-structs, a text format reset, and driver file path setup via sub_414600; on failure the entry is freed.

0x00415520.name: SmallEntryStructInit
0x00415520.label: SmallEntryStructInit
0x00415520.summary: Initializes a 20-byte small entry struct: sets first DWORD to 0, second to -1, calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc to reinit the global path, sets next two DWORDS to -1/-1, and clears byte at offset 16 to 0.

0x00415550.name: LinkedListIndexScannerWithValidation
0x00415550.label: LinkedListIndexScannerWithValidation
0x00415550.summary: Scans a linked list (head at this[4], count at this[7]) to find the index of a node whose string matches a2. Returns matching index or -1 if not found.

0x004155d0.name: LinkedListEntrySearchByName
0x004155d0.label: LinkedListEntrySearchByName
0x004155d0.summary: Searches a linked list (head at this[8], count at this[11]) by comparing node strings with a2 using sub_588410. Returns matching index or -1 if not found.

0x00415650.name: LinkedListIndexedAccessor
0x00415650.label: LinkedListIndexedAccessor
0x00415650.summary: Returns the value (first DWORD) at a given index in a singly-linked list with head at *this and count at this[3]. Returns 0 if index out of bounds or node not found.

0x00415680.name: LinkedListIndexedAccessor_5680
0x00415680.label: LinkedListIndexedAccessor_5680
0x00415680.summary: Returns the value (first DWORD) at a given index in a singly-linked list with head at this[4] and count at this[7]. Returns 0 if index out of bounds or node not found.

0x004156c0.name: LinkedListIndexedAccessor_56c0
0x004156c0.label: LinkedListIndexedAccessor_56c0
0x004156c0.summary: Returns the value (first DWORD) at a given index in a singly-linked list with head at this[8] and count at this[11]. Returns 0 if index out of bounds or node not found.

0x00415700.name: sub_415700
0x00415700.label: LinkedListActiveFlagReset
0x00415700.summary: Iterates a linked list (head at this[0], stored at this[2]) and clears the active flag (byte at offset 0xC) to 0 for every reachable node, effectively resetting all entries to inactive.

0x00415730.name: ShortComputation_5730
0x00415730.label: DriverLookupAndFlagSetter
0x00415730.summary: Resets list flags, looks up a vehicle by name, resolves current vehicle from global buffer, finds or creates a format list entry for the vehicle's name, and sets the active flag (byte at offset 0xC) to 1 on the matching list node.

0x00415780.name: VehicleListBuilderFromGlobalArray
0x00415780.label: VehicleListBuilderFromGlobalArray
0x00415780.summary: Clears existing vehicle list, then builds a new linked list of 176-byte vehicle entries from the global vehicle array (stride 0x424). Each entry is initialized with sub-structs, text format reset, and driver file path setup via sub_414600.

0x004159b0.name: NameListBuilderFromVehicleArray
0x004159b0.label: NameListBuilderFromVehicleArray
0x004159b0.summary: Builds a deduplicated name list from the global vehicle array, then creates a secondary linked list of 172-byte commentary entries with TV/PWS path setup via sub_414A90, appending each to a doubly-linked list.

0x00415c30.name: NullSafePointerDereference
0x00415c30.label: NullSafePointerDereference
0x00415c30.summary: Returns the dereferenced string pointer from a char** argument, falling back to the default application directory path if null.

0x00415c40.name: SceneListBuilderFromGlobalArray
0x00415c40.label: SceneListBuilderFromGlobalArray
0x00415c40.summary: Clears existing scene list, then builds a new linked list of 92-byte scene entries from the global scene array (stride 0x18c). Each entry is initialized with sub-structs, text format reset, and track TV/PWS path setup via CommentaryTVPWSPathBuilder.

0x00415d90.name: DriverNameIDLookup
0x00415d90.label: DriverNameIDLookup
0x00415d90.summary: Looks up a driver name string from the vehicle data array and maps it to a numeric ID based on a category index and two boolean flags. Returns the ID and a computed secondary value in the output structure, or failure if no match is found.

0x00417640.name: sub_417640
0x00417640.label: TeamNameToCommentaryIdMapper
0x00417640.summary: Maps F1 team names (McLaren, Ferrari, Williams, etc.) to commentary audio file IDs based on extension type (a3=0/1) and language variant (a4=0/1). Returns the mapped ID via struct fields or 1 on failure.

0x00417f60.name: TrackNameDisplayIDLookup
0x00417f60.label: TrackNameToDisplayIDLookup
0x00417f60.summary: Maps track scene name strings to integer display IDs for commentary/UI. Called from CommentaryTVPWSPathBuilder to resolve display IDs per track and mode (a3=alternate layout, a4=dry/wet or event type).

0x004184b0.name: UtilityFunction_84b0
0x004184b0.label: StructureWithBuffersInit
0x004184b0.summary: Initializes a large structure: zeroes short array at start, initializes sub-struct at 0x864 with sentinel values, zeros two fields at 0xAF0/0xAF4, fills buffer region with 0x10F defaults via callee. Returns this pointer.

0x004184f0.name: LazyRendererAudioInitCheck
0x004184f0.label: LazyRendererAudioInit
0x004184f0.summary: Lazily initializes audio renderer on first call. Returns 0 on success (ready or already initialized), 1 on failure. Creates audio object via virtual dispatch on global InitStatus, stores handle at this+0xAF4.

0x00418560.name: InsertDriverTableEntry
0x00418560.label: SortedTableInsert
0x00418560.summary: Inserts an 8-DWORD entry into a 20-entry sorted table (at this+0x86C). Validates input, looks up driver data, computes score, finds insertion point by time/score ordering, shifts entries, and copies. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure. Used by AI/commentary subsystems.

0x004186f0.name: TextOverlayDisplayTimer
0x004186f0.label: TextOverlayTickUpdate
0x004186f0.summary: Per-tick update for timed text overlay display (commentary/subtitles). Checks race active, track condition, and init state; updates audio object, manages display cooldown timer and slot expiration; renders active overlay text via font subsystem; resets and compacts slots after display.

0x00418900.name: ShortComputation_8900
0x00418900.label: SoundAudioObjectCleanup
0x00418900.summary: Cleanup on sound exit: dispatches global vtable queries (0/1), frees drawable resources from cleanup list, and releases audio object at this+0xAF4 via vtable release call, then nulls the pointer.

0x00418940.name: StateFlagCheck
0x00418940.label: OverlayDisplayActiveQuery
0x00418940.summary: Returns bool: true if audio overlay object is busy processing (vfunc+8 returns non-zero) OR there is an active display slot (slot index != -1). Queries whether overlay display is currently active.

0x00418970.name: ThresholdGatedVirtualDispatch
0x00418970.label: AudioParamUpdateFromNormalized
0x00418970.summary: Updates audio object with normalized float parameter (0.0-1.0) via vfunc+28. Validates range before dispatch. Passes track condition state or loading percent to audio system.

0x004189b0.name: StateCheckedVirtualDispatch
0x004189b0.label: StateGatedVirtualAction
0x004189b0.summary: Checks that the current state ID (this+0xAEC) matches the requested state (a2), then validates through a vtable gate check before dispatching a virtual action method. Returns 1 if action executed, 0 if blocked. Part of state machine infrastructure.

0x004189f0.name: ArraySearchReturningIndex
0x004189f0.label: SearchAndResetByID
0x004189f0.summary: Linear search through 20-entry table (at this+0x864, 8-DWORD stride) for entries matching an ID. Each match resets entry via StructInitWithSentinelValues. Returns 1 if any entry matched, 0 otherwise. Used to clear/reset entries for specific driver/entity IDs.

0x00418ac0.name: ArraySlotCompactionWithGapFilling
0x00418ac0.label: OverlaySlotArrayCompact
0x00418ac0.summary: Iterates 20 overlay display slots (32 bytes each). Phase 1: resets expired slots (current time > stored expiry float with non-sentinel value). Phase 2: compacts array by shifting filled slots left to fill gaps. Maintains contiguous active slot list.

0x00418c10.name: MemoryAllocation_8c10
0x00418c10.label: TextStructDeepCleanup
0x00418c10.summary: Destructor for text display structure. Checks flag at this+0x8; if set, reinitializes data block via TextFormatStructInitializer_4d70, frees 9 allocated pointers within block at strides of 5 dwords, frees block itself, then optionally frees `this` container if a2 bit 0 is set.

0x00418d60.name: DestructorWithDoubleFreePattern
0x00418d60.label: SimplePointerListCleanup
0x00418d60.summary: Destructor for simple pointer container. If flag at this+0x8 is set and data block is non-null, frees first internal pointer then the block itself. Optionally frees container if a2 bit 0 is set.

0x00418db0.name: GlobalVariableZeroInit
0x00418db0.label: GlobalStateVarsReset
0x00418db0.summary: Zeros four consecutive global dword variables (dword_5EBB18 through dword_5EBB24). Unconditional global state reset.

0x00418df0.name: LinkedListDestructorWithConditionalCleanup
0x00418df0.label: LinkedListWithFlaggedDataCleanup
0x00418df0.summary: Destructor for linked list with per-node data cleanup flag. Calls pre-cleanup sub_4190C0, then iterates nodes: if node's byte flag at +8 is non-zero, frees attached data pointer before freeing node. Zeros all four list management fields (head/next/counts) after traversal.

0x00418e50.name: HUDDisplayDataReset
0x00418e50.label: AIDriverDisplayDataReset
0x00418e50.summary: Resets AI driver HUD display data for 104 driver entries conditioned on race active and track condition. Writes sentinel/zero values per driver slot for ID, flags, timers, and display state; calls AITargetDriverSelection for initial target assignment; then zeros three global tracking counters.

0x00418ee0.name: AITargetDriverSelection
0x00418ee0.label: AIDriverTargetClassification
0x00418ee0.summary: Classifies each driver slot relative to player: player self (1), teammate (2), scoring/overtake target (3), or retired/invalid (-1). Iterates vehicle entries (4656-byte stride), writes classification dword per slot. Called at race restart for driver targeting init.

0x004190c0.name: sub_4190C0
0x004190c0.label: LinkedListNodesCleanup
0x004190c0.summary: Iterates linked list nodes starting from head pointer at this+0x1A0. Frees node data if node's byte flag at +8 is non-zero, frees each node via FreeWrapper_7bcf, then zeros all four list management fields (head, tail, count, aux). Same node-cleanup logic as LinkedListDestructor but standalone.

0x00419120.name: AIDriverStateTransition
0x00419120.label: AIDriverStateTransitionHandler
0x00419120.summary: Handles AI driver state transitions (overtake/defend/pit/retire). Gated by race active, track condition, race phase, and valid state change. For session type 7, performs timed and randomized lookup into driver behavior tables (198/259/120 indices), inserts entry, updates driver's state field.

0x004193a0.name: AISessionModeTransition
0x004193a0.label: SessionModeTransitionHandler
0x004193a0.summary: Processes a session mode transition (0/1/2) for AI commentary/event system. Validates race active, track condition, and player vehicle match. Converts mode index via FloatRangeIndexLookup/ThreeWayEnumConverter, checks ScoringGateSelector, then fires BooleanOROfTwoChecks + DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion per mode, inserts table entry, and marks mode as transitioned. Part of AI session event pipeline.

0x00419500.name: AICornerSpeedComparison
0x00419500.label: AICornerSpeedComparisonHandler
0x00419500.summary: Compares AI's corner/sector speed against current vehicle's corner speed array at offset 0x4050. Selects driver behavior table index based on speed delta and corner index (1 or 2). Inserts overtake (13/14) or being-overtaken (19/20) behavior entry. On corner 2 while pitting, triggers vehicle damage event.

0x00419690.name: AIOvertakeDefendStateChange
0x00419690.label: AIOvertakeDefendStateHandler
0x00419690.summary: Manages AI overtake/defend/pit state changes. Writes state flag (1) at this[a3+108]. For session type 5 (race): selects lookup index based on overtake (3/10/16/33), defend (4), or pit (5) relative to player and target. For session type 7 (quali): outlap state indices (72/262). Inserts behavior entry into driver table.

0x004198b0.name: AIPositionChangeEvent
0x004198b0.label: PositionChangeEventHandler
0x004198b0.summary: Detects and processes position changes for AI race commentary. Compares stored vs current position per driver. On change, determines gain/loss event type, builds driver data, and inserts into session event table. Handles player and AI vehicles differently.

0x004199e0.name: AIRetirementVehicleFailureEvent
0x004199e0.label: AIRetirementVehicleFailureHandler
0x004199e0.summary: Handles AI retirement/vehicle failure events for player's team during race (session type 7). Inserts driver behavior entries: initial failure notification (41), opponent retirement gap (1), leading vehicle gap (2, gated by status != 2), and final-lap countdown alerts (272/273). Calculates lap time gaps between vehicles.

0x00419c50.name: PerDriverRaceCommentary
0x00419c50.label: Per-Driver Race Finish Commentary Trigger
0x00419c50.summary: Generates race commentary/event entries when a driver finishes. Maps the driver's finishing position and current track name to a commentary ID, then inserts playback entries into a driver-table. Handles player-specific finish commentary, close-race gap commentary, and championship-mode logic.

0x0041a0c0.name: AIOutOfTrackEvent
0x0041a0c0.label: AIOutOfTrackEventHandler
0x0041a0c0.summary: Handles AI out-of-track incidents for non-player vehicles. Checks race active and track condition, then inserts driver behavior entry with index 264 (off-track event) for the offending AI driver. Called from game state dispatch chain.

0x0041a170.name: AIVehicleDamageEvent
0x0041a170.label: AIVehicleDamageEventHandler
0x0041a170.summary: Handles AI vehicle damage events. Selects behavior entry index: 52 for non-race context (practice/quali), 196 for race (session type 7). Looks up driver's team ID from vehicle struct and inserts damage event entry into driver action table.

0x0041a200.name: AIPitStrategyState
0x0041a200.label: PitStrategyEventHandler
0x0041a200.summary: Handles AI pit strategy state transitions for commentary. When driver is pitting (pittingStatus==1), checks pit strategy type and inserts appropriate event (42 or 52) into session event table. When not pitting, fires a Boolean OR check (event 42). Restricted to player vehicle during active race.

0x0041a2b0.name: AISessionPhaseChange
0x0041a2b0.label: SessionPhaseChangeEventHandler
0x0041a2b0.summary: Processes session phase changes (race phase counter transitions) for AI commentary. For non-player vehicles during race sessions, inserts phase change event (21 or 22) or qualifying/practice event (178/179). Always calls AIPositionChangeEvent for race sessions regardless of player match.

0x0041a3a0.name: AIFormationLap
0x0041a3a0.label: FormationLapEventHandler
0x0041a3a0.summary: Handles formation lap commentary events for non-player vehicles. In race/practice sessions, uses generic event 6. In championship weekend (session type 7) with non-World-Championship mode, checks lap proximity and formation lap position status to emit specific events (180-182). Part of AI session event pipeline.

0x0041a4a0.name: DisplayMessage0x11c
0x0041a4a0.label: SessionEvent284Emitter
0x0041a4a0.summary: Inserts a fixed event (type 284) into the session event table when race is active and track condition is valid. No parameters — always uses same event ID and defaults.

0x0041a500.name: TimeBasedMessageChain
0x0041a500.label: TimeBasedMessageDispatcher
0x0041a500.summary: Dispatches race commentary/event messages at fixed elapsed-time thresholds (2700s, 1800s, 900s, 600s, 300s, 180s) by inserting driver table entries with specific message IDs; resets audio buffer when elapsed time reaches zero.

0x0041a6b0.name: DisplayMessage0x113
0x0041a6b0.label: FixedMessageDisplay_275
0x0041a6b0.summary: Displays fixed race message ID 275 by triggering audio reset, clearing the driver data buffer to defaults, then inserting a single driver table entry with the message ID.

0x0041a720.name: sub_41A720
0x0041a720.label: PenaltyIncidentEventHandler
0x0041a720.summary: Handles penalty/incident events for AI commentary. Maps penalty string IDs (SpeedingInPitL, CutTrack, JumpedStart, IgnoredBlueFlag) to event codes — different codes for player vehicle (151-155) vs AI vehicles (252-256). Inserts event into session event table. For player IgnoredBlueFlag, also fires three Boolean OR checks (123-125).

0x0041a8c0.name: AISessionEventAudio
0x0041a8c0.label: TeammateLapEventAudio
0x0041a8c0.summary: Fires audio event (message ID 55) when an AI entrant with the same team/constructor ID as the player completes a lap, confirmed by matching field at offset 0x4894; restricted to non-phase-8 race states.

0x0041a940.name: sub_41A940
0x0041a940.label: StopGoPenaltyIgnoredEventHandler
0x0041a940.summary: Handles "IgnoredStopGoPenalty" events for AI commentary. Maps to event 149 for player vehicle, event 243 for AI vehicles. Inserts event into session event table. Simpler variant of the general penalty handler (sub_41A720).

0x0041aa10.name: AISessionPhaseCounter
0x0041aa10.label: SessionPhaseCompletionTracker
0x0041aa10.summary: Tracks completion of up to 4 session phases per driver using flags at this+0xA44. Counts active flags; if fewer than 3 are set, emits an individual phase-event (95/97/99/101) based on phase index. If 3+ flags set, emits a combined event (105). Part of AI session event pipeline.

0x0041ab30.name: PitStateSlotActivation
0x0041ab30.label: PitStateSlotActivationTracker
0x0041ab30.summary: Tracks pit state slot activation for up to 4 slots (flags at this+0xA44). Sets flag to 2 for given slot index, counts activated slots. If fewer than 3 activated, emits individual slot events (94/96/98/100). If 3+ activated, emits combined event (104). Analogue of AISessionPhaseCounter but for pit state.

0x0041ac50.name: sub_41AC50
0x0041ac50.label: GearBasedEventDispatch
0x0041ac50.summary: Handles gear-related and retirement commentary events for AI vehicles during championship weekend (session type 7). Event type a2 determines category: 0=generic vehicle event (208), 2=gear-specific events (211-217 based on current gear), 3=retirement event (220). For non-player, non-finished vehicles only.

0x0041ad80.name: sub_41AD80
0x0041ad80.label: OvertakingEventTracker
0x0041ad80.summary: Tracks overtaking/passing events between two vehicles. Checks time since last event (2-second cooldown) and distance threshold (>1250.0). Updates per-driver timestamps, distances, and opponent references. Emits events: 114/115 for player-involved overtakes, 225 (with random weather noise gating) or 226 for AI-vs-AI overtakes.

0x0041afd0.name: sub_41AFD0
0x0041afd0.label: RepairServiceEventHandler
0x0041afd0.summary: Handles repair/service events for AI commentary. Maps event subtype (0-5) to different event codes for player vehicle (106-111) vs AI vehicles (221-223). Triggered from repair service state dispatcher. Part of AI session event pipeline.

0x0041b190.name: sub_41B190
0x0041b190.label: TeammateEventAudio_77
0x0041b190.summary: Fires audio event (message ID 77) when an AI entrant with the same team/constructor ID as the player triggers a session event, verified by matching field at offset 0x4894.

0x0041b250.name: sub_41B250
0x0041b250.label: RetirementFailureEventHandler
0x0041b250.summary: Handles retirement/vehicle failure commentary events during championship weekend (non-World Championship). Maps reason code to event IDs: player vehicle gets 117-119; AI vehicles get 235 (engine=1), 236 (fuel=9), 237 (other), 238 (brake=4). Uses FloatRangeIndexLookup for AI vehicle context. Guards against sentinel entries before insert.

0x0041b3c0.name: PitSelectionStateMachine
0x0041b3c0.label: PitSelectionStateMachine
0x0041b3c0.summary: Complex state machine managing pit selection commentary events. Handles multiple states (0/2/3/5): deactivation with zone-aware dispatch, activation with zone-comparison logic, generic event 131, and player pit entry sub-types (123-125). Uses FloatRangeIndexLookup for zone indexing and StateCheckedVirtualDispatch for gated transitions. Part of AI race commentary system.

0x0041b910.name: ClearPitSelectionFlags
0x0041b910.label: ClearPitSelectionFlags
0x0041b910.summary: Clears three pit-selection-related flags (offsets 123-125) on a pointer-table entry when race is active, track conditions exist, race phase is not 8, and action identifier equals 5. Called per-frame from AI pit logic.

0x0041b980.name: TeamNameDisplayIDLookup
0x0041b980.label: TeamNameToDisplayIDLookup
0x0041b980.summary: Matches a team name string (e.g. "1999 Arrows", "2002 Ferrari") read from a data struct at offset +252 against a hardcoded chain of team name constants spanning seasons 1999-2002, producing a numeric display ID (293-336). Inserts the resulting driver data entry into a UI table via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion and InsertDriverTableEntry. Part of the UI team display/rendering system.

0x0041be60.name: PitRaceStatusMessageDispatcher
0x0041be60.label: PitRaceStatusAnnouncer
0x0041be60.summary: Dispatches pit/race status audio messages (IDs 506-513) based on sector/phase classification from a pit condition structure, with additional temperature threshold and track-grip-average modifiers.

0x0041c0f0.name: PitExit
0x0041c0f0.label: PitExitMessageDispatcher
0x0041c0f0.summary: Dispatches position-dependent pit exit audio messages (IDs 397, 516-535) based on car relationship classification (player/rival/constructor rival), relative race position, and championship mode, using vehicle array iteration.

0x0041c440.name: sub_41C440
0x0041c440.label: StandingsMessageDispatcher
0x0041c440.summary: Dispatches a race standings/championship status audio message by querying standings sort buffer for position index and computing message ID via sub_420000; position data only provided in championship mode (4).

0x0041c4c0.name: PositionBasedMessageDisplay
0x0041c4c0.label: PositionBasedRaceMessage
0x0041c4c0.summary: Dispatches a position-based race status message using standings buffer position and a computed message ID; switches between live timing parameters and default sentinels based on a boolean flag.

0x0041d630.name: RaceCommentary
0x0041d630.label: Race commentary string dispatcher
0x0041d630.summary: Generates race-commentary audio/text strings based on current race state — identifies the active track, iterates over vehicle positions, detects retirements (DNF), player performance relative to position, and emits appropriate commentary IDs (track intro, position changes, retirements, fastest lap). Part of the in-race commentary/audio system.

0x0041daf0.name: SeasonDisplayIDResolver
0x0041daf0.label: SeasonResultsDisplayDispatcher
0x0041daf0.summary: Sends season/championship results display messages (IDs 478-503) by iterating standings to find top entries, resolving display IDs via NamedEntryLookupInFormatList keyed by track database version files, and comparing best-lap vs scoring data.

0x0041e320.name: ScoringClassificationDisplay
0x0041e320.label: ClassificationStandingsDisplay
0x0041e320.summary: Dispatches scoring classification display messages (IDs 427, 483-487) by resolving driver and constructor standings entries, comparing championship points differences between them, and handling race-session, season, and constructor-clinch scenarios.

0x0041e890.name: AIEntrantLookupByName
0x0041e890.label: EntrantNameToIDLookup
0x0041e890.summary: Searches the standings buffer for an entrant matching a given name string and returns the entrant's ID/index from offset 408 (0x198); returns 0 if not found within 103 entries.

0x0041e920.name: BestLapEntrantFinder
0x0041e920.label: BestLapEntrantFinder
0x0041e920.summary: Finds the standings entrant with the highest best-lap value at offset 408, optionally filtered by name; in strict mode (a2=0), rejects ties and returns 0 if the best value is not unique across entries.

0x0041eb30.name: ScoringSessionStatsAggregator
0x0041eb30.label: SessionBestPerformerFinder
0x0041eb30.summary: Aggregates scoring statistics across multiple categories (flags-1 iterations) for all standings entries using IndexedFieldGetter, finds the entry with the highest total, and returns its pointer; returns 0 on ties in strict mode.

0x0041ed30.name: CRTMathHelper
0x0041ed30.label: CompositeScoreComputer
0x0041ed30.summary: Computes a composite sum of all scoring category values for the best-matching standings entry of a named entrant, minus one; returns -1 if no entry found or insufficient categories.

0x0041eda0.name: ChampionshipScore
0x0041eda0.label: CategoryLeaderCheck
0x0041eda0.summary: Checks if a given standings entry leads or ties for the lead in any scoring category by comparing cumulative category totals against all other entries; returns 1 if the entry is not behind any other entry in a category, 0 otherwise.

0x0041ef40.name: ObjectComparisonWithTiebreak
0x0041ef40.label: StandingsEntryComparator
0x0041ef40.summary: Compares two standings entries by primary sort key at offset 412, then breaks ties by iterating positions and comparing CountMatchingSeasonEntries; returns the better-ranked entry or 0 if entries are perfectly equal.

0x0041f070.name: RelativePerformanceComparator
0x0041f070.label: PerformanceGapCheck
0x0041f070.summary: Checks if a standings entry's performance value at offset 408 exceeds the maximum value of all other active entries by at least 10, indicating a significant performance gap.

0x0041f190.name: ShortComputation_f190
0x0041f190.label: SessionDataValidationCheck
0x0041f190.summary: Validates a standings entry by checking a boolean from ShortComputation_f1e0 and verifying that a category-dependent field at derived offset (204 + v3*4) does not equal sentinel value 10 when more than 2 categories exist.

0x0041f220.name: ChampionshipPointsAccumulator
0x0041f220.label: PointsAccumulatorByName
0x0041f220.summary: Accumulates championship scoring values (IndexedFieldGetter) across a specified number of categories for a named entrant by iterating standings entries and summing values where the entry's scene name matches the input name.

0x0041f340.name: sub_41F340
0x0041f340.label: HighestScoringConstructorResolver
0x0041f340.summary: Iterates through 14 constructor team names (Arrows, BAR, Renault, Ferrari, Jaguar, Jordan, McLaren, Minardi, Prost, Sauber, Williams, Toyota, Benetton, Stewart), finds the one with the highest championship points total, and returns an allocated [name, score] object; returns 0 if multiple teams tie in strict mode.

0x0041f5d0.name: sub_41F5D0
0x0041f5d0.label: TopTeamByLimitedScore
0x0041f5d0.summary: Finds the constructor team with the highest championship points across a limited number of categories (FlagsGetter-1) by iterating 14 team names; returns an allocated [name, score] object on success, 0 on allocation failure or insufficient categories.

0x0041f8a0.name: ConstructorChampionshipClinchDetection
0x0041f8a0.label: ConstructorClinchVerifier
0x0041f8a0.summary: Verifies if a constructor team has mathematically clinched the championship by checking that the team leads all other 13 teams in cumulative points across every category prefix (0..v6 for v6 = 0 to FlagsGetter-2); returns 1 if clinched, 0 otherwise.

0x0041fb10.name: MemoryAllocation_fb10
0x0041fb10.label: DualStatusValidator
0x0041fb10.summary: Validates that a named entrant has both status values 10 and 6 in standings entries at a rank-derived offset (entry + 4*v3 + 212), indicating both completed/retired and active session states are present.

0x00420000.name: sub_420000
0x00420000.label: TrackNameToMessageIDMapper
0x00420000.summary: Maps the current track/scene name (at offset 260 in the scene array entry) to a track-specific message ID (338-354) by comparing against 17 known track name strings.

0x00420490.name: PositionChangeDetector
0x00420490.label: LeadingPositionChangeDispatcher
0x00420490.summary: Detects position changes for top-2 standings entries by scanning for entries with position values 1 and 2 at offset 412, checking for tied values at offset 408; dispatches message 397 with driver display info when `a1` is set and the position is uniquely held.

0x00420820.name: ConstructorStandingsParser
0x00420820.label: ParseConstructorStandings
0x00420820.summary: Parses constructor team standings: accumulates championship points for 14 F1 teams, determines top 3 with tie detection, inserts driver display table entries for podium teams.

0x00420cf0.name: GdbSeasonSelector
0x00420cf0.label: SeasonDatabaseTeamSelector
0x00420cf0.summary: Selects the F1 team with the most active drivers for the current season database, using tie-breaking logic; then loads the correct season's GDB file and inserts driver performance data into the global table.

0x004212e0.name: ShortComputation_12e0
0x004212e0.label: SumMatchingSceneField
0x004212e0.summary: Iterates active entities in RaceStandingsSortBuffer linked list, sums field at offset 416 for entities whose scene name matches the `this` parameter. Returns total sum.

0x00421470.name: FunctionCallWrapper_1470
0x00421470.label: InitSeasonParentPathArray
0x00421470.summary: Initializes SeasonParentPath array (dword_5EC3D0) with alternating 0/-1 values, calls ConfigDirectoryPathRegistration, returns pointer to array.

0x004216f0.name: ConfigDirectoryPathRegistration
0x004216f0.label: ConfigDirectoryPathRegistration
0x004216f0.summary: Registers all configuration directory paths by copying path string constants for audio, circuits, drivers, movies, options, replays, and other data directories, then initializes default config structure fields with preset values (including a count of 22 registered paths and a -1.0f sentinel).

0x00421b10.name: FileEnumerationByExtension
0x00421b10.label: EnumerateAndCopyFilesByExtension
0x00421b10.summary: Enumerates files matching scene extension from config directory, constructs source/destination paths, reads source file content and writes to destination. File copy operation based on extension enumeration.

0x00421cd0.name: ConfigIniParser
0x00421cd0.label: ConfigIniFileParser
0x00421cd0.summary: Parses the game's main .ini config file (config.ini): reads [Components], [Install], [Autolaunch], and [Version] sections, maps key-value pairs to struct fields (video settings, paths, ratings), and handles non-admin directory creation/copying on Windows XP/NT/2000.

0x00422be0.name: sub_422BE0
0x00422be0.label: ConfigFileWriter
0x00422be0.summary: Writes the game configuration file (settings/config) by opening a file in write-text mode, clearing its read-only attribute, then writing all config sections (video, audio, directories, rendering, etc.) via formatted string output. Returns 1 on success, 0 if file cannot be opened.

0x00422fd0.name: StringFormatReplaceOperation
0x00422fd0.label: PrependBasePathToString
0x00422fd0.summary: Prepends base path from this[32] (offset 0x80) to a2 string using format "%s%s". Returns 1 on success, 0 if a2 is null or base path equals default.

0x00423070.name: sub_423070
0x00423070.label: ReadConfigValueAndFormat
0x00423070.summary: Reads config value from given structure using "config" key, formats as "config=%s" string, returns pointer to copied result.

0x004230c0.name: sub_4230C0
0x004230c0.label: DetectWindowsVersionString
0x004230c0.summary: Detects Windows OS version via GetVersionExA, selects platform name string (Unknown/Win32s/95/98/Me/NT/2000/XP), copies to output buffer.

0x00423250.name: WindowsAdminCheck
0x00423250.label: WindowsAdminCheck
0x00423250.summary: Checks whether the current process runs with administrator privileges by impersonating the security context, building a LOCAL system SID ACL, and calling AccessCheck. Returns true if the token has the required access rights.

0x00423490.name: SingleFunctionCallWrapper_3490
0x00423490.label: ClearEmptyStringBuffer
0x00423490.summary: Zeroes EmptyStringBuffer (byte_5EC4C0, 13 bytes) and returns pointer to it.

0x00423530.name: SortedStringTableBuilder
0x00423530.label: InsertKeyValuePairWithAutoGrow
0x00423530.summary: Inserts a key-value string pair into a table structure. Auto-grows capacity by 128 slots when full, copies/reallocates existing entries, frees old buffer.

0x004236f0.name: StringHashTokenParsing
0x004236f0.label: ParseQuotedTokens
0x004236f0.summary: Parses quoted tokens from input string: removes delimiter characters, splits at period separator, extracts two quoted substrings into output buffers a2 and a3.

0x00423890.name: sub_423890
0x00423890.label: LoadGameDictionaryFile
0x00423890.summary: Opens and parses game dictionary file (game.dic), inserts key-value pairs into sorted string table, sorts table, then checks for OscLocaleString entry.

0x00423a00.name: BinarySearchInStringTable
0x00423a00.label: BinarySearchInStringTable
0x00423a00.summary: Binary search in a sorted string table (16-byte entries: key pointer at +0, value pointer at +8). On match copies value string to output buffer (returns 0); on miss copies input key to output buffer (returns -1). Null entry pointers fall back to a default directory path string.

0x00423b10.name: VehicleDynamics
0x00423b10.label: RelativeSpeedComputation
0x00423b10.summary: Computes relative speed between two vehicles for AI steering. Two branches controlled by flag a4: when true computes longitudinal (closing) speed via dot product (stores result in this[9] and this[12]); when false computes lateral speed via 2D cross product (stores only in this[9]). Called per-frame from AISteering.

0x00423ca0.name: ShortComputation_3ca0
0x00423ca0.label: ComputeRelativeVelocityComponents
0x00423ca0.summary: Decomposes target vehicle velocity into longitudinal and lateral components relative to a given direction (a2, a4). Computes signed projection magnitude (minus offset a5) into this[6] and signed perpendicular magnitude into this[4]. Used by AI steering for passing/overtaking decisions.

0x00423db0.name: ShortComputation_3db0
0x00423db0.label: ComputeRelativePositionComponents
0x00423db0.summary: Decomposes position difference between target vehicle and a reference point (a5, a7) into longitudinal and lateral components relative to direction (a2, a4). Stores signed longitudinal distance in this[3] and signed lateral distance in this[1]. Used by AI steering for spatial awareness.

0x00424010.name: VehicleSubsystemCleanup
0x00424010.label: CleanupVehicleSubsystem
0x00424010.summary: Frees dynamically allocated resource at this[4394] if non-null, calls stub, then cleans up vehicle subsystem at this+12.

0x00424040.name: LargeStructFieldSetterWithStoredReference
0x00424040.label: StoreReferenceAtTwoOffsets
0x00424040.summary: Stores input value a2 at this[0] and this[4109] (offset 0x4034), calls propagation function, returns result.

0x00424080.name: sub_424080
0x00424080.label: AI driver difficulty and scenario configuration loader
0x00424080.summary: Loads AI driver configuration from vehicle-specific data files: reads driver ability stats (starts dry/wet, qualifying ability, race ability, rain ability, track aggression, passing, cornering, crash probability, completed laps, script), applies difficulty scaling and track grip modifiers, and optionally injects mechanical failure events (engine, brakes, gearbox, suspension, stall) for season/career mode. Part of the AI driver setup system.

0x00424750.name: AIDifficultyScalar
0x00424750.label: AIDifficultyScalar
0x00424750.summary: Maps AI difficulty slider value (0-100 range) to a performance scalar between 0.75 and 1.0. Above 95 returns flat 1.0 (maximum AI ability); below 95 uses linear interpolation: ((slider - 70) * 0.01) + 0.75.

0x00424790.name: AIDriverStructInit
0x00424790.label: AI driver per-frame reset and reinitialization
0x00424790.summary: Per-frame reinitialization of AI driver state fields: resets timers, clears flags, re-seeds spatial search radius, optionally reloads waypoints/command queues, and applies difficulty-scaled traction control/track grip adjustments. Part of the AI driver update system.

0x00424ac0.name: AIDifficultyInterpolation
0x00424ac0.label: AIDifficultyInterpolation
0x00424ac0.summary: Maps AI difficulty slider to an interpolated ability value using three anchor constants (low/mid/high). Below 100 uses low-to-mid linear interpolation; above 100 uses mid-to-high extrapolation. Called once during AI driver struct init.

0x00424b20.name: CameraViewportFrustumInitialization
0x00424b20.label: AI Camera Frustum and Viewport Reset
0x00424b20.summary: Initializes AI driver camera viewport, frustum planes, and projection parameters each frame. Resets distance tracking, near/far clip planes, viewport dimensions, and driver status flags to default sentinel values before recomputation.

0x00424c80.name: AIRingBufferFieldInit
0x00424c80.label: AIRingBufferFieldInit
0x00424c80.summary: Computes an oscillating noise value from a trig lookup table indexed by a ring buffer counter, combined with baseline offset and difficulty slider scaling. Stores result in this[4370] (offset 0x4448) to add frame-to-frame variability to AI behavior.

0x00424cd0.name: AICommandMessageQueueDispatcher
0x00424cd0.label: AICommandMessageQueueDispatcher
0x00424cd0.summary: Dispatches AI commands via a switch-based message handler then manages a deduplicated command queue. Handles AI state transitions (cases 4, 5), timer setup (case 1), and race-phase-dependent cleanup (case 15). Deduplicates pending commands before enqueueing.

0x00424e30.name: PairArrayLinearSearch
0x00424e30.label: PairArrayLinearSearch
0x00424e30.summary: Linear search for a duplicate command ID in the AI command queue. Iterates 8-byte {cmd, param} pairs in the queue buffer. Returns 1 if command ID a2 already exists, 0 if not found. Called by CommandQueueResponseHandler for deduplication.

0x00424e70.name: AIMainUpdate
0x00424e70.label: AI Per-Frame State Machine Tick
0x00424e70.summary: Per-frame AI tick for a single vehicle: computes heading from yaw, runs state-machine (driverStatus switch 0-7), dispatches racing-line/steering/gearshift logic, handles pit scheduling and session-phase transitions.

0x00425660.name: FieldZeroSetter
0x00425660.label: DriverStatusClear
0x00425660.summary: Resets driver status field (this[4420] / offset 0x4510) to 0. Called from AIMainUpdate to clear AI driver state at the start of each frame tick.

0x00425670.name: SteeringAngleController
0x00425670.label: AI Steering Angle & State Machine
0x00425670.summary: Computes steering angle error (yaw delta to target) from vehicle position and optional target vehicle position, manages a driver-status state machine (states 0,1,6,7) for AI steering modes, and periodically snapshots position for trajectory recording.

0x004258c0.name: sub_4258C0
0x004258c0.label: AISteeringStateInit
0x004258c0.summary: Resets AI steering dynamics state: sets field at 0x4434 to 0 and field at 0x4438 to 1.0f. If speed < 4.0 or both threshold fields (0x37CC, 0x38C4) > 0.9, sets driverStatus to 2. Called from AIMainUpdate per frame.

0x00425920.name: AIRacingLine
0x00425920.label: AI Racing Line Update
0x00425920.summary: Per-frame AI racing line and speed-profile update — traverses waypoint chain, computes aerodynamic drag from lead car, builds speed profile with tire-force energy model, and determines throttle/brake targets based on overtaking feasibility and track position.

0x00426100.name: sub_426100
0x00426100.label: AISteeringCorrection
0x00426100.summary: Computes steering angle toward target waypoint using position difference, heading direction, and speed-dependent scaling. Applies rate limiting (max 0.1 change per frame) and clamps output to [-1, 1]. Inverts steering when driverStatus == 6 (reversing). Core AI path-following control.

0x00426330.name: PhysicsGearShiftLogicWithThresholds
0x00426330.label: PhysicsGearShiftLogic
0x00426330.summary: AI gear shift logic with multiple guard conditions. Handles upshifting (with traction check), downshifting, reverse gear (driverStatus 6), pit mode (carConditions 2), and a shift timer delay. Calls RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate to perform the actual gear change.

0x00426430.name: sub_426430
0x00426430.label: AIWaypointFollowingAndSteeringUpdate
0x00426430.summary: Per-frame AI driving update: finds nearest waypoint via spatial query, builds look-ahead waypoint chain, classifies speed zone (0–3), computes steering angle projections clamped to track bounds, and dispatches pit-lane entry commands when passing pit entry waypoints.

0x00426cc0.name: SpeedDeltaComputation
0x00426cc0.label: SpeedDeltaComputation
0x00426cc0.summary: Computes speed difference between AI's target vehicle (stored at this[0x4354]) and another vehicle (a2). Returns: 0.0 if a2 is null, speed difference if both exist, or -1.0 if AI has no target. Used by AI overtaking and nearest-vehicle logic.

0x00426cf0.name: AISteeringCorrection
0x00426cf0.label: AI Steering Correction and Grip-Degradation Blend
0x00426cf0.summary: Computes AI steering correction blend factor by combining racing line steering with suspension-ratio-based steering, applying tire grip degradation logic post race-start, and enforcing difficulty-scaled and track-specific limits. Part of AI driver per-frame update.

0x004270a0.name: AISteering
0x004270a0.label: AI Steering Target Computation
0x004270a0.summary: Per-frame AI steering logic: evaluates lateral track positions (5 lanes) via spatial nearest-neighbor queries, scores them, selects steering targets, and manages overtaking state transitions. Core of the AI driving system.

0x00429470.name: AIAbility
0x00429470.label: DriverAIAbilityTick
0x00429470.summary: Per-frame AI ability update for a driver — manages AI difficulty scaling, pit stop decisions, fuel checks, and corner-exit behavior based on session type and race phase.

0x00429960.name: sub_429960
0x00429960.label: AIPitstopStrategyInit
0x00429960.summary: Initializes AI pitstop strategy parameters — number of stops, tire compounds, fuel-adjusted lap targets per stop — based on session type (race vs non-race) and configuration string data. Part of the AI driver strategy/race-management system.

0x00429eb0.name: RacePhasePitEntryTrigger
0x00429eb0.label: RacePhasePitEntryTrigger
0x00429eb0.summary: Forces AI pit entry when fuel multiplier drops below 1, the pit-requested flag (this[0x4550]) is clear, and race phase is 5 (pit window). Calls FuelMultiplierValue and conditionally ForcePitExit.

0x00429ee0.name: CommandQueueResponseHandler
0x00429ee0.label: CommandQueueResponseHandler
0x00429ee0.summary: Processes dequeued AI commands by checking for each command type via PairArrayLinearSearch. Handles phase-3 cleanup, session-type-dependent parameter setting (cmd 0), parameter reset (cmd 5, 99999), state flag set (cmd 4, 14), and phase-4 speed delta reset. Updates driverStatus, reset flags, and calls parameter/wrapper functions.

0x00429fd0.name: RandomWeightedTierSelection
0x00429fd0.label: RandomWeightedTierSelection
0x00429fd0.summary: Selects tire compound tier based on track grip level (flt_8AFEE8). Uses tier thresholds with randomized boundaries for variety at mid ranges. Falls back to this[0x458C] (nextChosenTires) at very low grip. Maps chosen tier to a compound index via CompoundIndexLookup and TireCompoundNameIDMapping.

0x0042a110.name: ForcePitExit
0x0042a110.label: ForcePitExit
0x0042a110.summary: Forces AI driver to exit pits by setting a state flag. For race sessions, only acts when NOT on the last lap AND when teammate part lookup returns 0, 4, or driver has FinishState 1. For non-race sessions always forces exit. Calls StateConditionalAction and AIStateFlagSetter.

0x0042a180.name: AIPushLap
0x0042a180.label: AI Push-Lap Tire & Pit Strategy
0x0042a180.summary: Per-frame AI strategy for qualifying hot laps: adjusts target lap time based on remaining laps, selects optimal tire compound from track conditions, and forces a pit exit when tire wear or weather demands a change. Part of the AI race-strategy system.

0x0042a3d0.name: PitStopDecisionTireCompound
0x0042a3d0.label: AI Pit Stop Tire Compound Decision
0x0042a3d0.summary: Per-frame AI logic for selecting tire compounds during pit stops. Checks session type, race phase, remaining laps, and fuel level to schedule tire changes; also handles retired/active state flags and pit stop cleanup.

0x0042a6f0.name: PostPitCleanup
0x0042a6f0.label: PostPitCleanup
0x0042a6f0.summary: Post-pit-exit cleanup routine. Fills a sentinel slot, optionally increments tire change counter (if flag at 0x4584 is clear), clears timeOfNextExit for race sessions, and sets next pit window timestamp to session time + 4.0. Returns the tire-change flag byte.

0x0042a740.name: TrackParameterMinimumClamp
0x0042a740.label: TrackParameterMinimumClamp
0x0042a740.summary: Clamps a track/steering parameter at this[0x4484] into [5.0, a2] range. If current value exceeds a2, clamps down; if below 5.0, clamps up. Used by AI steering subsystems to limit track correction values.

0x0042a780.name: AIComputePassScore
0x0042a780.label: AIComputePassScore
0x0042a780.summary: Computes a weighted overtaking/passing score from AI ability factors and opponent vehicle data. Score = (input * a1[0x4504] + a1[0x4500]) * a1[0x4580] * a1[0x453C] * opponent[0x84]. Calls TireForceSolver on opponent tire data. Used by AIRacingLine for pass decision.

0x0042a7d0.name: OpponentProximityScanTeamRecognition
0x0042a7d0.label: AI Opponent Proximity Scan & Team Recognition
0x0042a7d0.summary: Scans all vehicles each frame to find the 5 nearest opponents, sorted by distance, then performs team/class recognition by matching team IDs; also applies overtake-direction heuristics. AI opponent awareness system.

0x0042ac70.name: AIStateFlagSetter
0x0042ac70.label: AIStateFlagSetter
0x0042ac70.summary: Sets callToBox flag (this[0x454C]) to 0 or 1. Guarded: only writes when a2 <= 1. Returns the input value unchanged.

0x0042ac90.name: WrapPlayerCallback
0x0042ac90.label: WrapPlayerCallback
0x0042ac90.summary: Wraps player session callback by computing callToBox flag = AiOvertakeDistanceThreshold + this[0x4], then writing it via AIStateFlagSetter. Used during phase-3 cleanup in CommandQueueResponseHandler.

0x0042aca0.name: AISpeedDeltaSetter
0x0042aca0.label: AISpeedDeltaSetter
0x0042aca0.summary: Sets AI speed delta flag (this[0x4550]) to a2 (0 or 1). When a2 == 1, additionally triggers AI state transition via sub_4A46F0(this, 1, 0) to enter speed-limited mode. Used by command queue and session state handlers.

0x0042acd0.name: ParameterValueSetter
0x0042acd0.label: ParameterToMaxSpeedSetter
0x0042acd0.summary: Sets vehicle maxSpeed field from input parameter. If parameter ID is 18, uses idle/reverse speed target constant; otherwise casts input directly to float.

0x0042ad00.name: LateralForceTorqueCalculation
0x0042ad00.label: LateralTorqueFromForce
0x0042ad00.summary: Computes lateral torque from input force value: multiplies input by lateral force coefficient and 0.01 scaling factor. Part of vehicle physics torque model.

0x0042ad20.name: FuelMultiplierValue
0x0042ad20.label: FuelMultiplierCalculator
0x0042ad20.summary: Computes fuel multiplier as integer. If FuelMult flag enabled, multiplies fuel rate factor by theoretical laps-per-litre minus 0.2 offset; otherwise returns default value 100.

0x0042ad50.name: FuelWeightLimitCheck
0x0042ad50.label: FuelSufficiencyCheck
0x0042ad50.summary: Checks if fuel is sufficient for remaining race distance. Returns FALSE (low fuel) when computed fuel consumption exceeds remaining laps adjusted by stint factor. If FuelMult flag is zero, always returns TRUE (fuel check disabled).

0x0042adb0.name: SessionCleanupFlagClear
0x0042adb0.label: SessionActiveFlagSetter
0x0042adb0.summary: If vehicle is not retired, clears cleanup/disqualification flag at 0x4424 and sets ActiveFlag to 1 to mark session as active. Returns vehicle's retired status.

0x0042add0.name: AIDelegateCall
0x0042add0.label: SpatialNearestNeighborQuery
0x0042add0.summary: Calls `SpatialTreeNearestNeighborSearch` with vehicle position and struct parameters to find nearest spatial neighbor. Returns handle to nearest entity or zero.

0x0042ae20.name: AIDriverRandomSelector
0x0042ae20.label: ResetRandomDriverSelection
0x0042ae20.summary: Resets AI driver random selection state: if a2 matches stored random targets at 0x45FC or 0x45F8, clears them and resets lateral force/torque field.

0x0042ae60.name: ServerSessionGateCheck
0x0042ae60.label: SessionTypeFiveGateCheck
0x0042ae60.summary: Gate for session type 5. Returns 0 if session type mismatch or if vehicle on lap 2 without pit call. Returns 1 to allow pass.

0x0042aee0.name: PitStopBlockingCondition
0x0042aee0.label: PitStopBlockedCheck
0x0042aee0.summary: Checks whether pit stop is blocked. Two code paths based on session type: for non-race sessions checks pit data bitmask; for race sessions (type 7) checks lap completion, race phase, and vehicle state flags.

0x0042af40.name: AIStateReset
0x0042af40.label: ResetAIStateToRetired
0x0042af40.summary: Resets AI driver state: calls state change notification, evaluates conditional gate, sets RetiredFlag (0x4410) to 1 and ActiveFlag (0x45F4) to 0.

0x0042af70.name: Overtaking
0x0042af70.label: AIOvertakeDecision
0x0042af70.summary: Evaluates and executes AI overtaking maneuver. Compares speed, lap position, and pit state between two vehicles across different session types. Records overtake target and sets lateral speed offset (3.0 or -3.0) when conditions permit.

0x0042b0e0.name: AISteeringRacingLineCorrection
0x0042b0e0.label: AI Steering Racing Line Correction
0x0042b0e0.summary: Computes steering angle corrections for AI vehicles based on distance to the racing line and position relative to other vehicles. Handles both race-phase (proximity to opponent) and qualifying-phase (waypoint-based) correction modes.

0x0042b8d0.name: AIShiftPattern
0x0042b8d0.label: AIShiftPatternDisplay
0x0042b8d0.summary: Renders AI shift pattern configuration UI text. If bitmask state passes, cycles through upshift/downshift/on/high string states and appends to base string with .HOT extension. Otherwise displays disallowed message.

0x0042bbd0.name: SetPlayerVehicleIndex
0x0042bbd0.label: SetPlayerVehicleByIndex
0x0042bbd0.summary: Sets current player vehicle pointer from index a1, searches VehiclePtrArray for matching vehicle, stores found array index as CurrentPlayerIndex.

0x0042bc40.name: SetPlayerVehicleIndex_bc40
0x0042bc40.label: SetPlayerVehiclePtrAndIndex
0x0042bc40.summary: Sets PlayerVehiclePtr from index a1, searches VehiclePtrArray for match, stores found index as CurrentVehicleIndex.

0x0042bc80.name: BuildActiveVehiclePointerArray
0x0042bc80.label: BuildActiveVehiclePointerArray
0x0042bc80.summary: Scans all vehicle structures, builds VehiclePtrArray of active vehicles (field at offset 13000 != -1), backfills missing entries, updates CurrentPlayerIndex and CurrentVehicleIndex.

0x0042bd60.name: SeasonScoringReset
0x0042bd60.label: ResetSeasonScoring
0x0042bd60.summary: Resets season scoring state: clears InitStateFlag, calls TeamIDSetter and SessionStateTransition for each vehicle up to CurrentVehicleIndex.

0x0042bda0.name: TimerConversionWithSin
0x0042bda0.label: TimerMultiplyAndStore
0x0042bda0.summary: Multiplies timer input a1 by 400.0, calls sin/computation helper, converts to integer, stores result in TimerOutputInt.

0x0042bdd0.name: sub_42BDD0
0x0042bdd0.label: FormatVehicleRaceTimeDisplay
0x0042bdd0.summary: Formats vehicle race time, gap to leader, laps down, or retirement status into display string based on session type and vehicle state.

0x0042c130.name: DynMan_Enter
0x0042c130.label: DynMan_Enter
0x0042c130.summary: Dynamic management enter handler: processes build path string via StringSplitLoop, logs "Entered DynMan Enter" message, then calls SeasonScoringReset.

0x0042c170.name: DynMan_Setup
0x0042c170.label: DynMan_Setup
0x0042c170.summary: Dynamic management setup handler: processes build path string via StringSplitLoop, logs "Entered DynMan Setup" message on success.

0x0042c1a0.name: DynMan_Init
0x0042c1a0.label: Dynamic Manager Initialization
0x0042c1a0.summary: Initializes the Dynamic Manager subsystem during game startup: selects the player vehicle index from the vehicle array, loads AI driver names and counts, handles formation lap state, loads vehicle graphics scenes for all vehicles, and sets up player name/identity.

0x0042c3b0.name: DynMan_Restart
0x0042c3b0.label: DynMan_Restart
0x0042c3b0.summary: Dynamic management restart handler: resets timer/session counters, reloads AI settings, renders all vehicles, syncs player vehicle index/pointer.

0x0042c440.name: sub_42C440
0x0042c440.label: DriverAssistInputHandler
0x0042c440.summary: Per-frame input processor for in-game driver assists — reads input device action codes and toggles steering assist, traction control, ABS, auto-shifting, brake bias, and other driving aids. Also handles session transitions, visual state changes, and suspension vibration triggers. Part of the gameplay input/control subsystem.

0x0042c690.name: MainGameTickUpdate
0x0042c690.label: Main Game Tick Update Loop
0x0042c690.summary: Drives the per-frame game update loop: converts session time to tick counter, dispatches AI updates, vehicle physics, particle effects, fuel consumption, tire force computation, and player controls at fixed sub-intervals. Coordinates all per-vehicle per-frame subsystems.

0x0042c9f0.name: DynMan_Post
0x0042c9f0.label: DynMan_Post
0x0042c9f0.summary: Dynamic management post-race handler: processes AI random selection for all vehicles, initializes wheel dynamics, resets season scoring, destroys graphics resources.

0x0042ca70.name: DynMan_Exit
0x0042ca70.label: DynManExitLog
0x0042ca70.summary: Logs a debug message indicating entry into DynMan (Dynamic Manager) exit routine. Used by game shutdown path.

0x0042caa0.name: AILateralForceComputation
0x0042caa0.label: VehicleLateralInteractionForce
0x0042caa0.summary: Computes lateral interaction forces between all vehicle pairs. Phase 1 calculates per-vehicle direction vectors and curvature radius from velocity. Phase 2 accumulates pairwise proximity-weighted forces and writes resultant vector (x,z components) to each vehicle struct at offset 14948.

0x0042ce30.name: SessionTypeNameLookup
0x0042ce30.label: SessionTypeNameToString
0x0042ce30.summary: Maps session type ID (0-7) to display string. Short names when a2=true, full names when a2=false. "Unknown" for out-of-range IDs.

0x0042cf10.name: MultiplayerVehiclePlacement
0x0042cf10.label: MultiplayerVehiclePlacementStateMachine
0x0042cf10.summary: Manages multiplayer session placement state transitions (0-7). Handles vehicle field copies, championship standings reordering, and debug logging at each state step. Clamps game state on exit.

0x0042d140.name: sub_42D140
0x0042d140.label: FormationLapDisplayState
0x0042d140.summary: Manages formation lap / pit timer display state for server session. Sets a state field; when state=3 and pit timer visible, formats "Begin Formation" message and renders it; calls per-vehicle initialization for states 0,2,3,4.

0x0042d210.name: sub_42D210
0x0042d210.label: PauseStateDisplayToggle
0x0042d210.summary: Sets pause state flag on object. When unpausing (a2=0), copies "Paused" string into message buffer and triggers screen update via ShortComputation_bde0.

0x0042d260.name: GameFileLoader
0x0042d260.label: GameFileLoader
0x0042d260.summary: Loads game assets (scene files, vehicle files, tire brands) and initializes random noise table. Returns 0 on success, 1 if scene or vehicle files are missing. Called during game enter sequence.

0x0042d350.name: SessionReset
0x0042d350.label: SessionReset
0x0042d350.summary: Destroys texture surfaces for state flag pair and frees/reinitializes season parent path resources. Called during game exit to reset session state.

0x0042d370.name: Game_Enter
0x0042d370.label: Game Subsystems Enter / Initialization
0x0042d370.summary: Game session initialization entry point — sequentially initializes all subsystems (OS manager, game files, video, special FX, dynamics, player data, audio configs, sound, input, on-screen display, game modules) and loads audio asset directories. Returns 1 on any init failure, 0 on success.

0x0042d5d0.name: Game_Setup
0x0042d5d0.label: GameSubsystemInitialization
0x0042d5d0.summary: Master game initialization: sets game state to "loading" (2), parses device path string, then sequentially initializes all game subsystems — input, scoring, options, special effects, physics steward, dynamics manager, sound, on-screen display, video manager, player file, and module manager.

0x0042d6b0.name: Game_Init
0x0042d6b0.label: Game Subsystem Initialization Orchestrator
0x0042d6b0.summary: Top-level game initialization function that sequentially starts all major subsystems (video, scene, AI, sound, rendering, input, physics, camera, special effects, UI, session manager). Sets game state to 3 (init phase) and returns 1 if video init fails.

0x0042d7a0.name: Game_Restart
0x0042d7a0.label: Game Subsystem Restart Orchestrator
0x0042d7a0.summary: Executes a full game restart sequence: sets game state to 4 (restarting), then calls restart/reset functions for all engine subsystems in dependency order — sound, special effects, input, dynamics, camera, rendering, HUD, video, player file, AI, and scoring. Part of the game state machine and session management system.

0x0042d8a0.name: GamePostMainLoop
0x0042d8a0.label: GamePostMainLoop
0x0042d8a0.summary: Main per-frame game processing loop: dispatches session state checks, runs the multi-phase physics/scoring/collision pipeline, updates camera, weather, rendering, HUD, and force feedback subsystems, then checks for loop exit conditions. Core game loop / main tick orchestrator.

0x0042da30.name: Game_Post
0x0042da30.label: Game Post-Frame Subsystem Dispatch
0x0042da30.summary: Main per-frame Post() dispatch: calls all engine subsystems in order — guarded dispatch, nested call loop, sound, special FX, steward, hardware input, dynamics, camera, render, on-screen display, video manager, player file, and session state — then sets multiplayer flags to 3. Called from GameMainEntry.

0x0042db20.name: GameExit
0x0042db20.label: GameExit
0x0042db20.summary: Orchestrates full game teardown: logs entry, shuts down subsystems (sound, special effects, input, display, DynMan, OnScreen, session), and closes main handle. Sets game state to 7 (exiting).

0x0042dc00.name: sub_42DC00
0x0042dc00.label: ScoreDatabaseDeallocator
0x0042dc00.summary: Deallocates score database structures: frees a score slot, then frees the base score DB pointer if non-null.

0x0042dc80.name: BoundedArrayAccessor
0x0042dc80.label: BoundedArrayAccessor
0x0042dc80.summary: Bounds-checked array lookup. Returns element from 8-byte stride array at given index, or 0 if index out of range.

0x0042dd00.name: RatioCalculator
0x0042dd00.label: Table2DRatioCalculator
0x0042dd00.summary: Computes weighted ratio from 2D lookup table. Takes row index (a2) and column index (a3), looks up base and weight values from two parallel arrays, and returns (scale * rowWeight * colWeight) / (rowBase * colBase * divisor). Returns 0 on any bounds or zero-value check.

0x0042dd80.name: WeightedDataLookup
0x0042dd80.label: Weighted1DRatioCalculator
0x0042dd80.summary: Computes weighted ratio from 1D lookup table. Looks up base and weight values by index a2, returns (scale * weightValue) / (baseValue * divisor). Returns 0 if index out of bounds or values non-positive.

0x0042ddd0.name: ScoreSlotDeallocator
0x0042ddd0.label: DoubleBufferDeallocator
0x0042ddd0.summary: Frees two dynamically allocated buffers stored at this[1] and this[3], then zeros all four pointer slots. Part of score/configuration slot teardown.

0x0042de10.name: GearRatioConfigFileReader
0x0042de10.label: GearRatioConfigReader
0x0042de10.summary: Parses gear ratio and final drive configuration from file. Opens file, reads "[GearRatios]" and "[FinalDrive]" sections, counts and extracts ratio values into allocated buffers, and stores pointer+count pairs in struct fields.

0x0042e1f0.name: CRTMathHelper_e1f0
0x0042e1f0.label: ScaledValueAndIndexParser
0x0042e1f0.summary: Parses configuration tokens: scales two doubles by a5 factor, converts a token to int via CRTFtol, and parses/clamps a final index within [0, storedCount-1]. Used for vehicle setup file values.

0x0042e290.name: PositionIndexClamp
0x0042e290.label: PositionIndexClamp
0x0042e290.summary: Maps a normalized double (0.0-1.0) to a clamped integer array index, with split at 0.5 for symmetrical (e.g., left/right) indexing. Used by pressure/force field mapping.

0x0042e469.name: sub_42E469
0x0042e469.label: DualByteSetter
0x0042e469.summary: Sets two consecutive byte fields (offsets 0x1D and 0x1E) to the same value. Likely a convenience setter for a pair of related flags/state bytes.

0x0042e470.name: EventTriggerOnStateChange
0x0042e470.label: StateChangeEventTrigger
0x0042e470.summary: Detects state change on tracked entity. Compares entity ID and state fields between reference (a2) and current (a3). When IDs match and state differs, copies new state and sets event trigger flags at this[0] and this[0x19A4] to 1.

0x0042e4a0.name: WeightedSumComparatorWithBinaryAdjustment
0x0042e4a0.label: WeightedBalanceAdjuster
0x0042e4a0.summary: Adjusts index values in two struct objects to satisfy weighted sum inequality. While a2's weighted sum exceeds a1's by 0.01% tolerance, decrements a2's index (if flag set and index > 0) or increments a1's index (if within bounds).

0x0042e530.name: TrackConfig
0x0042e530.label: TrackSetupPerFrameUpdate
0x0042e530.summary: Per-frame updates vehicle setup parameters (gear ratios, ride heights, spoiler angle, track-type adjustments) based on component/subcomponent indices a2/a3, clamping values, firing state-change events, and re-matching floating-point setup indices to nearest allowed steps.

0x0042eaa0.name: AIGearSelectionSet
0x0042eaa0.label: AIGearSelectionSet
0x0042eaa0.summary: Sets target gear for an AI driver's specific wheel in a multi-dimensional indexed structure. Clamps to valid gear range, triggers event on state change, and marks dirty flags when gear changes.

0x0042eb60.name: ListSelectionClamp
0x0042eb60.label: ListSelectionClamp
0x0042eb60.summary: Clamps a list selection index (e.g., gear ratio) for AI driver. Sets to clamped value or 0 if negative, marks dirty flags on change. Similar structure to AIGearSelectionSet.

0x0042ebc0.name: HistoryBufferShift
0x0042ebc0.label: HistoryBufferShift
0x0042ebc0.summary: Shifts a history buffer by one position (FIFO shift). Copies each element over the next, discarding the oldest entry. Operates on two separate buffer regions within the struct.

0x0042ec00.name: MessageStringFormatter
0x0042ec00.label: MessageStringFormatter
0x0042ec00.summary: Formats a UI message string by looking up format config (based on flag at this[4]), copying it to display buffer, then applying format arguments with overflow check.

0x0042ec60.name: AIStateBufferInitialize
0x0042ec60.label: AIStateBufferInitialize
0x0042ec60.summary: Initializes AI state history buffers by left-shifting all entries (discarding oldest), sets four float fields to 0.5f (default weights/confidence), and marks activation flag to 1.

0x0042ecc0.name: ReplayStateCopy
0x0042ecc0.label: GearConfigToReplayStateCopy
0x0042ecc0.summary: Reads gear ratio configuration from file via GearRatioConfigFileReader, then copies 8 consecutive DWORDs from config buffer (offset 0x1970) into replay state fields (starting at offset 0x1680) with stride 16 per field.

0x0042ed00.name: SessionStateIndexedLookup
0x0042ed00.label: IndexedRatioLookup
0x0042ed00.summary: Looks up weighted ratio from gear config table indexed by a2 via RatioCalculator. Uses gear ratio table at this+0x1970, row index from lookup array, and column index from this[0x1644]. Negates result when a2 equals 43.

0x0042ed50.name: NameStringCopy
0x0042ed50.label: BoundedStringCopy
0x0042ed50.summary: Copies up to 63 characters from source string a2 into struct buffer at this+0x70. Ensures null termination at this+0xAF.

0x0042ed70.name: sub_42ED70
0x0042ed70.label: FormatPathStringBuilder
0x0042ed70.summary: Constructs formatted resource path strings from template globals. Based on format selector at this+4, builds "%s/%s" and "%s/%s/%s" paths at this+56 and this+72, and a single string at this+88. Uses BinarySearchInStringTable to look up and copy string components.

0x0042f140.name: StringCopyWithReturn
0x0042f140.label: ValidatedStringCopy
0x0042f140.summary: Searches for source string a2 in string table; if found, copies a2 to this+0xC buffer (or clears buffer if a2 is null). Returns pointer to destination buffer.

0x0042f180.name: SetupValueFormatDS
0x0042f180.label: SetupValueFormatDS
0x0042f180.summary: Formats a vehicle setup value as degrees/seconds ("%d %s"). Computes scaled value from index×multiplier+base, converts with 0.001 factor, optionally applies degrees-to-something multiplier (~5.71) when format flag is 1.

0x0042f1e0.name: SetupValueFormat1fS
0x0042f1e0.label: SetupValueFormat1fS
0x0042f1e0.summary: Formats a vehicle setup value with one decimal float or integer ("%.1f %s" or "%d %s"). Selects float format with unit conversion (~0.0057) when format flag is non-zero, integer format otherwise.

0x0042f260.name: SetupValueFormatWithOffset
0x0042f260.label: SetupValueFormatWithOffset
0x0042f260.summary: Formats a vehicle setup value with optional offset term. Outputs "%.3f %s" (inches) when format flag is non-zero, "%.1f %s" (metric) otherwise. Adds an indexed offset from config fields when a3 != 0.

0x0042f2f0.name: SetupValueFormatDispatcher
0x0042f2f0.label: SetupValueFormatDispatcher
0x0042f2f0.summary: Dispatches vehicle setup value formatting by type (a3: 0=angle, 1=pressure, 2=length with offset, 3/9=length, 4=ds, 5-8=1f, 10=integer). Indexes into 64-byte stride array per group/slot.

0x0042f470.name: VehicleSetupValueFormatter
0x0042f470.label: VehicleSetupValueFormatter
0x0042f470.summary: Formats vehicle setup parameter values (suspension, aero, gearing, tires, etc.) into display strings for a garage/setup menu UI, dispatching on a 52+ case index to select the correct format specifier, unit conversion (metric/imperial), and optional label lookup. Writes formatted output to per-option destination buffers within the setup data structure.

0x0042fd00.name: VehicleSetupFileWriter
0x0042fd00.label: Vehicle Setup Configuration File Writer
0x0042fd00.summary: Serializes the complete vehicle setup configuration (suspension, aero, driveline, engine, tires, brakes, controls) into a formatted text file. Writes all setup parameters as labeled key-value pairs, validates gear settings against limits, and appends setup notes.

0x00430600.name: WheelForceAggregate
0x00430600.label: WheelForceAggregate
0x00430600.summary: Computes aggregate wheel forces from six indexed parameter triples using polynomial, quadratic, and linear physics models. Outputs summed lateral (a3) and longitudinal (a4) force components.

0x00430750.name: sub_430750
0x00430750.label: TireForceWithQuaternionTransform
0x00430750.summary: Computes per-wheel tire forces with suspension geometry. Guards on tire brand and compound lookup. Applies quaternion transforms for force distribution and returns normalized aggregate force.

0x00430a50.name: BrakeTemperatureFadeModel
0x00430a50.label: brake temperature fade force model (per-wheel thermal degradation computation)
0x00430a50.summary: Computes the brake fade force reduction due to thermal degradation across all active wheels, using tire compound lookup, axle-specific temperature interpolation, and a per-wheel temperature-vs-fade lookup curve. Returns the normalized fade force ratio.

0x00430f00.name: VehicleStatsEstimationDisplay
0x00430f00.label: VehicleStatsEstimationDisplay
0x00430f00.summary: Computes and formats vehicle performance estimates (acceleration, top speed, cornering G) for the setup display. Uses brake/fade model integration for acceleration, tire force model for cornering. Selects metric or imperial units based on UI encoding flag.

0x00431390.name: PhysicsStateInitIndexed
0x00431390.label: PhysicsStateInitIndexed
0x00431390.summary: Initializes an indexed physics state value (float array write at 4*a2+7336), clears change flag, sets activation flag, and triggers pressure/force field mapping.

0x004313c0.name: PressureForceFieldMapping
0x004313c0.label: TireContactPatchPressureMapper
0x004313c0.summary: Maps tire contact patch pressure forces to surface grid cells. Reads tire geometry parameters, computes blending factor from surface contact parameter, then finds best-matching pressure value for each session-state entry.

0x00431850.name: TireSuspensionForceComputation
0x00431850.label: TireSuspensionForceCalc
0x00431850.summary: Computes tire suspension force from compound properties, aero/suspension mode, and session state. Looks up compound index, selects force coefficient based on mode selector (aerodynamic vs suspension), applies scaling factors, and divides by session state value.

0x00431950.name: SetupIntegerFormatDS
0x00431950.label: TemperatureUnitFormatter
0x00431950.summary: Formats a Kelvin temperature value as integer with unit string for display. Converts to Celsius (or Fahrenheit if flag set), then formats as "%d %s" via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck.

0x004319da.name: TimeFormatStringForDebugDisplay
0x004319da.label: TimeValueDebugFormatter
0x004319da.summary: Formats a time value into a display string with unit suffix for debug HUD. Scales raw time by display multiplier, selects 2 or 3 decimal precision based on flag and value magnitude.

0x00431a50.name: SimpleSetterWithFlag
0x00431a50.label: FlaggedValueSetter
0x00431a50.summary: Sets a field at this+0x1CBC to input value a2 and sets a changed/dirty flag at this+0x1CB8 to 1. Always writes both fields.

0x00431aa0.name: SetupDateAngleDisplayFormat
0x00431aa0.label: TemperatureDateDisplayFormatter
0x00431aa0.summary: Formats three temperature values into a date-style display string (e.g., "85/90/88 °C") for telemetry HUD. Converts Kelvin inputs to Celsius or Fahrenheit based on unit flag, formats a triplet or single value via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck.

0x00431c00.name: PhysicsGlobalStateInit
0x00431c00.label: GlobalPhysicsStateReset
0x00431c00.summary: Resets global physics state variables to default values. Writes -1 to three sentinel/identity fields and 0 to all other state fields, then calls DualLinkedListCleanup on the global physics state block.

0x00431c70.name: PhysicsShutdown
0x00431c70.label: PhysicsSystemShutdown
0x00431c70.summary: Tears down the global physics system state. Walks and frees linked lists (input devices, collision geometry), deallocates flagged blocks (graphics state, device identity), and resets all heads to zero.

0x00431d40.name: PhysicsBufferAlloc
0x00431d40.label: PhysicsBufferAllocator
0x00431d40.summary: Allocates three physics system buffers (two of 80 bytes, one of 128 bytes) via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, stores pointers and sizes in the struct, and zeroes remaining fields.

0x00431db0.name: DirectoryFileEnumerator
0x00431db0.label: Directory File Enumerator
0x00431db0.summary: Enumerates files and subdirectories in a given path using Windows FindFirstFile/FindNextFile API. Builds two sorted linked lists — one for regular files and one for subdirectories — skipping "." and ".." entries, with automatic path separator normalization.

0x00432180.name: SettingsSetupFileRead
0x00432180.label: SettingsFilePathResolver
0x00432180.summary: Builds a settings file directory path by composing base path with a subdirectory component, then enumerates files in that directory. Used during settings/player name setup to locate configuration files.

0x00432220.name: SettingsCopySetupFileCopy
0x00432220.label: SetupFileSceneIteratorAndCopier
0x00432220.summary: Iterates scene entries, creates directory trees and copies settings/config files for each scene. When directory creation fails or config mismatch detected, builds a linked list of vehicle configuration entries (with .svm extension paths) and adds them via AddVehicleConfigEntryToLinkedList.

0x00432650.name: StringCapitalizer
