0x00432650.label: TitleCaseConverter
0x00432650.summary: Converts a string to title case in-place: capitalizes the first letter of each word (letters following non-letter characters) and lowercases all other letters.

0x004326a0.name: SettingsFolderResolver
0x004326a0.label: SettingsSectionResolver
0x004326a0.summary: Resolves a settings section by checking if it matches a season/race section, then looking up the corresponding vehicle data entry in a linked list. Returns the data entry handle or the original section pointer if no match found.

0x004326e0.name: PlayerNameSetup
0x004326e0.label: PlayerNameConfigSetup
0x004326e0.summary: Sets up player name configuration by reading settings files, resolving folder paths, searching string tables for player name, and enumerating matching files in the settings directory. Orchestrates multiple settings-file and path-resolution steps.

0x00432810.name: VehicleFieldAccessor
0x00432810.label: VehicleFieldAt2CAccessor
0x00432810.summary: Simple accessor that dereferences `this` as a pointer, then reads the DWORD at offset 0x2C from the target. Returns the vehicle identifier or configuration field at that offset.

0x00432820.name: IndexedListEntryAccessor
0x00432820.label: LinkedIndexEntryStringGetter
0x00432820.summary: Returns the first string from an indexed entry in a linked list. Validates index bounds, walks the list to the Nth node, and returns the entry's first string (or default application directory if null).

0x00432870.name: PathStringCombinator
0x00432870.label: PathStringArrayComposer
0x00432870.summary: Processes an array of three path strings: copies the first via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, processes the third via a path utility function, and returns the fifth entry (or default application directory if null). Defaults any null string to the application directory.

0x004328c0.name: PathAccessor
0x004328c0.label: PathFieldAt8Getter
0x004328c0.summary: Reads the path string pointer at offset 0x8 from a dereferenced object field. Returns the string or defaults to the application directory if null.

0x004328e0.name: PathAccessor_28e0
0x004328e0.label: FirstStringInArrayGetter
0x004328e0.summary: Returns the first string from the array pointed to by `this`. If the string pointer is null, returns the default application directory instead.

0x00432920.name: VirtualPropertyAccessor
0x00432920.label: VirtualPropertyAt3CAccessor
0x00432920.summary: Reads a DWORD value at offset 0x3C from a dereferenced object pointer. Returns the virtual property or identifier field.

0x00432930.name: IndexedEntryAccessor
0x00432930.label: IndexedListEntryStringGetterAlt
0x00432930.summary: Returns the first string from an indexed entry in a linked list, using different offsets (count at 0x3C, list head at 0x30). Validates index bounds, walks the list to the Nth node, and returns the entry's first string or default path.

0x00432980.name: PathNormalizerFileEnumeration
0x00432980.label: PathNormalizerAndFileEnumerator
0x00432980.summary: Normalizes a path string (ensuring it ends with a backslash) and then enumerates files in that directory. Reads the path from offset 0x8 of an array, defaults to application directory if null.

0x00432a60.name: VtableGetterAtOffset0x1c
0x00432a60.label: VtableFieldAt1cGetter
0x00432a60.summary: Reads a DWORD at offset 0x1C from a dereferenced object pointer. Likely retrieves a vtable-based method pointer or interface identifier.

0x00432a70.name: TrackSessionClassesReader
0x00432a70.label: TrackSessionClassListProcessor
0x00432a70.summary: Iterates through track session class entries, matching each against known vtable types (UI widget, message box, and two others). Stores matched UI widget handle at offset 0x10 and processes entries sequentially via loop.

0x00432bf0.name: AutoLoadEntryWriter
0x00432bf0.label: AutoLoadEntryStringWriter
0x00432bf0.summary: Writes a sequence of format strings (backup extension, format specifiers, and path components) into a buffer to compose an auto-load configuration entry. Used during config file parsing.

0x00432cc0.name: SessionConfigDefaultInit
0x00432cc0.label: SessionConfigDefaultInit
0x00432cc0.summary: Initializes a session configuration structure to defaults: copies the default application directory string three times via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and sets the field at offset 0x10 to the literal value 7.

0x00432df0.name: sub_432DF0
0x00432df0.label: PathDirectoryExtractorAndProcessor
0x00432df0.summary: Strips filename from a path string (removes everything after the last backslash) and processes the resulting directory path via sub_5665B0. Also performs a computation on the a2 parameter via ShortComputation_0b10.

0x00432e70.name: AutoLoadEntryListLoader
0x00432e70.label: AutoLoadEntryListLoader
0x00432e70.summary: Loads auto-load entry list from a config file (AutoLoadConfigFile). Parses physics file path, reads session track/class entries, appends unresolved entries to internal linked list, and sets completion flag.

0x00433090.name: PhysicsObjectDestructor
0x00433090.label: PhysicsObjectDestructor
0x00433090.summary: Destructor for a physics object struct. Calls session config default init, then frees three heap-allocated pointer fields at offsets 0x0, 0x8, 0x14 if non-null.

0x004330d0.name: ConfigFileParser
0x004330d0.label: ConfigFileParser
0x004330d0.summary: Writes auto-load entries from internal linked list to a config file. Builds physics file path, opens file, iterates linked list nodes writing each entry via AutoLoadEntryWriter, then closes file.

0x004331a0.name: DualLinkedListCleanup
0x004331a0.label: DualLinkedListFullCleanup
0x004331a0.summary: Frees all nodes and their contained data across two linked lists (session config items and secondary allocations), then zeroes all list structure fields. Physics session/configuration cleanup system.

0x00433290.name: PathDirectoryExtractionAndComparison
0x00433290.label: PathDirectoryExtractionAndComparison
0x00433290.summary: Extracts directory path from module callback table, copies it to output buffer. Strips file extension from input path string. If input becomes empty after stripping, concatenates with dot-extension string.

0x004333e0.name: AISettingsFileLoader
0x004333e0.label: AISettingsFileLoader
0x004333e0.summary: Loads AI settings (SVM) files per vehicle. Iterates all vehicles, builds paths from vehicle directory + settings folder + qual/race + .svm, tries multiple file variants, and stores found path into vehicle struct.

0x004336f0.name: LoadAIDriverNamesFromConfig
0x004336f0.label: LoadAIDriverNamesFromConfig
0x004336f0.summary: Loads AI driver names and settings for vehicles from config file. Iterates vehicle range, skips vehicles with existing AI settings, looks up remaining vehicles in auto-load config, and validates configuration.

0x00433890.name: AISettingsFileResolver
0x00433890.label: AISettingsFilePathResolver
0x00433890.summary: Resolves the full AI settings file path by combining base directory with settings entry from linked-list lookup tables, based on session type. AI settings/session configuration system.

0x004339e0.name: LookUpVehicleConfigEntry
0x004339e0.label: LookUpVehicleConfigEntry
0x004339e0.summary: Searches auto-load entry linked list for vehicle config matching settings folder and session type. Returns 0 with matching path string, or 1 with default path if no match found.

0x00433b60.name: AddVehicleConfigEntryToLinkedList
0x00433b60.label: AddVehicleConfigEntryToLinkedList
0x00433b60.summary: Searches linked list for existing matching vehicle config entry by settings folder and filter. If found and flag allows, copies strings. If not found, allocates new 28-byte entry and appends to linked list. Always writes config file via ConfigFileParser.

0x00433d60.name: LinkedListRemovalByName
0x00433d60.label: LinkedListRemovalByName
0x00433d60.summary: Removes linked list nodes whose entry name matches a given name string. Also clears stored name in object if it matches. Unlinks node, fixes head/tail/iterator pointers, decrements count, and frees node memory.

0x00433eb0.name: CleanupWrapper
0x00433eb0.label: CleanupWrapper
0x00433eb0.summary: Cleans up AI state buffer and resets a path string in the object to default directory. Thin wrapper around AIStateBufferInitialize and StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.

0x00433ed0.name: ValidateVehicleConfigurationFile
0x00433ed0.label: ValidateVehicleConfigurationFile
0x00433ed0.summary: Validates vehicle configuration by parsing two SVM/HDV files: first the vehicle's default file, then an override file. Returns 0 on success (both files parse), 1 on failure.

0x00434000.name: FileLoadWithFlagPreserve
0x00434000.label: FileLoadWithFlagPreserve
0x00434000.summary: Saves the SessionNameBuffer flag, loads a vehicle setup file via VehicleSetupFileWriter, then restores the flag. Preserves global state around the file load.

0x00434030.name: DoublyLinkedListAppend
0x00434030.label: DoublyLinkedListAppend
0x00434030.summary: Appends a new node to a singly-linked list with head/tail tracking. Allocates 12-byte node, sets data pointer and flag, updates head/tail/first/count.

0x00434090.name: LinkedListMergeSort
0x00434090.label: LinkedListMergeSortWideChar
0x00434090.summary: Sorts a doubly-linked list of string entries using merge sort with wide-character (2-byte) lexicographic comparison. Reconnects head/tail/prev pointers after sort. File directory enumeration system.

0x00434240.name: RecursiveNodeDeletion
0x00434240.label: RecursiveNodeDeletion
0x00434240.summary: Destroys a linked list node's data struct. If flag byte is set and data pointer is non-null, calls SessionConfigDefaultInit, frees three internal pointer fields (at offsets 0x0, 0x8, 0x14), then frees the data struct itself.

0x00434290.name: LinkedListMergeSort_4290
0x00434290.label: LinkedListMergeSortRecursive
0x00434290.summary: Recursive merge sort implementation for singly-linked list of string entries using ANSI strcmp comparison. Splits list in half, sorts each half recursively, then merges. File directory enumeration system.

0x00434460.name: CarSelectionStateMachine
0x00434460.label: Pre-Race Car Selection / Grid Camera State Machine
0x00434460.summary: State machine controlling pre-race car selection and grid-position camera: transitions through init → countdown → wait → vehicle-advance → end states, iterates over vehicle slots, validates against VehicleCount, triggers pit-exit/camera setup, and passes camera parameters to the rendering subsystem.

0x004347c0.name: EngineGuardedInitializer
0x004347c0.label: EngineGuardedInitializer
0x004347c0.summary: Guarded one-time engine initialization. Checks flag byte; if unset, initializes sound system, buffer, and session phase dispatch, then sets flag to 1. Returns immediately if already initialized.

0x00434820.name: ModuleInitializationWithFallback
0x00434820.label: ModuleInitializationWithFallback
0x00434820.summary: Initializes constraint solver parameters and dispatches initialization. Tries sub_4348B0 first; if it fails, falls back to GameActionStateMachine and sets flag.

0x004348b0.name: sub_4348B0
0x004348b0.label: CameraObjectInit
0x004348b0.summary: Allocates and initializes a 208-byte 3D camera/transform object with float parameters. Called by ModuleInitializationWithFallback as primary init path. Returns 0 on success, 1 on failure.

0x004349a0.name: TrackSplineExtrapolation
0x004349a0.label: TrackSplineExtrapolation
0x004349a0.summary: Computes track spline extrapolation data. Samples track spline points from SetupScenePtr, interpolates midpoints, performs extrapolation calculations with Catmull-Rom-like spline math, then calls sub_457F90 with result array.

0x00434d40.name: VtableMethodShutdown
0x00434d40.label: VtableMethodShutdown
0x00434d40.summary: Calls first vtable method (destructor/delete) on a vtable-based object and clears the pointer. Standard RAII-style cleanup for heap-allocated polymorphic object.

0x00434d60.name: SteeringInterpolationCameraFollow
0x00434d60.label: Interpolated Steering Camera Follow
0x00434d60.summary: Computes interpolated camera position and steering angle to smoothly follow a vehicle, handling both normal chase-cam and special fixed-camera (mode 5) paths. Part of the camera/rendering system.

0x004352c0.name: PlaneLineIntersectionRatio
0x004352c0.label: RayPlaneIntersectionRatio
0x004352c0.summary: Computes intersection ratio t along ray from a1 to a3 where it intersects plane defined by parameters a2 and a4 (x and z components). Returns FLT_MAX (3.4028235e38) for degenerate cases where denominator is zero.

0x004353f0.name: ConstructorStub
0x004353f0.label: ConstructorStub
0x004353f0.summary: Minimal constructor stub. Clears field at offset 0x9C to 0 and calls PhysicsBufferClear. Returns `this` pointer.

0x00435406.name: SetupArrayElementSetter
0x00435406.label: SetupArrayElementSetter
0x00435406.summary: Sets three consecutive DWORD fields (offsets 0x58, 0x5C, 0x60) in the struct to the same value passed via ECX. Returns this pointer.

0x00435410.name: SuspensionSetupSectionReader
0x00435410.label: SuspensionSetupSectionReader
0x00435410.summary: Reads suspension setup configuration from a file section: parses spring parameters (collision length, stiffness/damping, direction, head/body anchors), head mass/inertia, and min/max position/orientation limits into the vehicle suspension data structure.

0x004359a0.name: RigidBodyConstraintJointSolver
0x004359a0.label: Rigid body constraint joint solver loop
0x004359a0.summary: Iterates over joint constraints between two rigid bodies, computes position and angular error, and applies corrective impulses via angular momentum accumulation. Part of the physics constraint solver system.

0x00435e00.name: Matrix3x3VectorMultiply
0x00435e00.label: 3x3 matrix times 3-vector multiply
0x00435e00.summary: Computes matrix-vector product result = M * v for a 3x3 matrix stored as 9 doubles and a 3-element vector. Used for coordinate transformations in the physics engine.

0x00435e60.name: SuspensionSpringDamperForceComputationWithClampi
0x00435e60.label: Suspension spring-damper force with clamping
0x00435e60.summary: Computes suspension spring-damper force and torque for a wheel assembly, with min/max clamping on all axes. Transforms forces from suspension local frame to chassis frame and applies scaling/clamping. Part of vehicle suspension physics.

0x00436230.name: QuadraticForm6x6
0x00436230.label: 6x6 quadratic form evaluation
0x00436230.summary: Evaluates a quadratic form for 3-axis spring-damper force with sign-dependent stiffness selection and anti-symmetric damping. Produces 3-element force and 3-element moment output arrays. Part of the suspension force computation system.

0x004363f0.name: CollisionStructCopy
0x004363f0.label: Collision data struct copy with zeroing
0x004363f0.summary: Copies a collision result struct from a source to a destination, then zeroes output impulse/force fields. If source has zero type byte, skip copy and just return. Part of collision response pipeline.

0x00436470.name: QuadraticSpringEval
0x00436470.label: Quadratic spring function evaluation
0x00436470.summary: Evaluates two quadratic spring functions at a given input value: result0 = a*x^2 + b*x + c for a set of spring coefficients. Computes both force and its derivative (damping) as quadratic functions. Part of the suspension spring model.

0x004364a0.name: ConstraintComplianceMatrixBuild
0x004364a0.label: Constraint compliance matrix build
0x004364a0.summary: Builds a 3x5 constraint compliance matrix from constraint parameters (inverse mass, geometric dimensions, damping). Computes matrix elements as products of input scalars and vector components. Returns true if any non-zero compliance exists. Part of the constraint solver setup.

0x00436610.name: PiecewiseFunctionEval
0x00436610.label: Piecewise function evaluation with boundary correction
0x00436610.summary: Evaluates a 2-input piecewise function with multiple linear segments selected by sign and magnitude of inputs. Applies additional correction terms when the primary input exceeds defined range boundaries. Used for non-linear spring/damper characteristic curves in the constraint solver.

0x00436870.name: CollisionContactGenerationAndFrictionResponse
0x00436870.label: TireContactAndFrictionSolver
0x00436870.summary: Solves tire-ground contact and friction: generates 3 or 5 contact points from suspension geometry, queries terrain height via spatial grid, computes friction forces using Pacejka-like curves, and applies impulse with torque to the rigid body.

0x004380b0.name: ConstraintEnforce
0x004380b0.label: Constraint enforcement evaluation
0x004380b0.summary: Computes constraint displacement and velocity error, then evaluates the piecewise constraint response function. Stores the resulting constraint force. Part of the constraint solver feedback loop.

0x00438100.name: TorqueForceProductComputation
0x00438100.label: Torque-force product computation
0x00438100.summary: Computes torque-force product for tire/wheel force application: multiplies a force by a moment arm and adds a bias torque. Single-step arithmetic operation. Part of the vehicle dynamics force accumulation system.

0x00438130.name: VehicleDynamicsForceAccumulatorIntegration
0x00438130.label: Tire/Brake Thermal Integration and Wear Simulation
0x00438130.summary: Integrates brake and tire temperatures over time using force inputs, weighted blending, and ambient temperature offsets. Computes wear/fatigue accumulation with blowout threshold detection, and triggers pit-stop state transitions when wear exceeds critical levels. Part of the vehicle dynamics thermal and degradation simulation system.

0x00438690.name: PhysicsCollisionDamageDNFDetection
0x00438690.label: Collision Damage Accumulator with DNF Detection
0x00438690.summary: Per-frame collision damage computation: accumulates impact energy into a damage integrator (scaled by velocity and contact normal), computes temperature-based thermal damage component, checks if accumulated damage exceeds threshold, and when overflow/peak is detected marks the first non-DNF vehicle as DNF (sets state to 5).

0x00438930.name: ConstraintProjectGramSchmidt
0x00438930.label: Constraint direction Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization
0x00438930.summary: Performs Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization on constraint direction vectors. Computes the dot product between a reference direction and another vector, then subtracts the projected component to produce an orthogonal constraint basis. Part of the constraint solver setup.

0x004389b0.name: SuspensionDataCopyToPhysicsEngine
0x004389b0.label: Suspension data copy to physics engine bodies
0x004389b0.summary: Copies suspension geometry data (rotation matrix, inertia tensor) to physics engine body structs. Handles both active and inactive suspension paths. Part of vehicle physics initialization/data transfer.

0x00438c10.name: DynamicsObjectInitialization
0x00438c10.label: Vehicle dynamics state initializer
0x00438c10.summary: Initializes a vehicle dynamics object: zeroes 0x1F38-byte main struct, initializes 4 per-wheel substructures at 0x464-byte stride with alternating state values, calls sub-component initializers and wheel dynamics setup.

0x00438cc0.name: BrakeBiasSetup
0x00438cc0.label: Brake Bias and Vehicle Control Configuration Setup
0x00438cc0.summary: Initializes brake bias, differential, and vehicle control settings from global configuration data. Copies 11 configuration byte slots, applies bitmask filtering to disable unsupported settings, sets control mapping mode based on input device type, and computes a scaled driver data factor.

0x00438da0.name: VehiclePhysicsBodyNameMapping
0x00438da0.label: VehiclePhysicsBodyIndexInit
0x00438da0.summary: Initializes the vehicle physics body/joint name-to-index mapping by searching the joint system for named bodies (wheels, spindles, axles, steering arms, fuel tank, driver head, body) and storing their array indices for fast lookup during simulation. Part of the tire model initialization pipeline.

0x00438f00.name: sub_438F00
0x00438f00.label: Suspension geometry setup and body attachment
0x00438f00.summary: Reads suspension geometry offsets, transforms position by rotation matrix, attaches suspension to rigid body, and calls suspension setup section reader. Part of suspension initialization in vehicle physics.

0x004390a0.name: CollisionEnergy
0x004390a0.label: Collision energy computation with tire force evaluation
0x004390a0.summary: Computes total collision energy from weighted sums of damage parameters, then evaluates tire force and torque models across multiple polynomial/quadratic curve functions. Returns summed damage contributions. Part of vehicle collision damage system.

0x00439210.name: VehiclePhysicsInitializer
0x00439210.label: Vehicle Physics Suspension/Tire Setup Initializer
0x00439210.summary: Initializes vehicle physics parameters for suspension geometry, tire model, weight distribution, and collision energy. Computes ride height per corner, spring/damper rates from setup data, center of mass position, inertia tensor, and sets up per-corner force computation structures. Called each frame from TireModelInit to recalculate physics constants before the main physics update.

0x0043af50.name: SuspensionBarLookup
0x0043af50.label: Suspension anti-roll bar lookup by name
0x0043af50.summary: Searches for a suspension anti-roll bar entry by string name, then reads its rotation matrix and position offset to transform into world coordinates. If not found, zeros output and optionally logs debug error. Part of suspension setup.

0x0043b040.name: FrontSteeringGeometrySetup
0x0043b040.label: Front steering geometry setup
0x0043b040.summary: Sets up front steering geometry for left and right wheels. Searches suspension component arrays for matching pairs, computes steering transforms, finds closest geometry pairs, applies steering angle via tan formula, and updates rotation matrices. Part of vehicle steering initialization.

0x0043b590.name: SteeringGeometryComputation
0x0043b590.label: Steering Geometry / Ackermann Computation
0x0043b590.summary: Computes steering geometry for both front wheels: looks up suspension bar positions from named config strings, transforms them through the vehicle's rotation matrix, calculates steering offsets using trig (sin, sqrt, cross-product), and derives left/right Ackermann steering angles. Part of vehicle physics per-frame pipeline.

0x0043b930.name: SolverDispatch
0x0043b930.label: Solver type dispatcher
0x0043b930.summary: Dispatches to different solver functions based on an operation type ID. Routes to spring evaluation, constraint solving, force/torque computation, or delta tracking. Part of the physics constraint solver dispatch system.

0x0043ba20.name: ConstraintForceSolver
0x0043ba20.label: Constraint force solver with velocity computation
0x0043ba20.summary: Searches constraint element array for matching body pair, computes constraint force with velocity-dependent terms using matrix-vector transforms, then computes relative velocity. Part of the constraint force solving system.

0x0043bb00.name: DeltaUpdateTracking
0x0043bb00.label: Delta update tracking with smoothing
0x0043bb00.summary: Tracks a value's delta (change between frames), applies exponential smoothing, and accumulates the result. Used for smoothing physics parameters over time. Part of the physics update system.

0x0043bb30.name: QuadFunctionEval
0x0043bb30.label: Quadratic function evaluation
0x0043bb30.summary: Evaluates two quadratic functions at input value: result = a*x^2 + b*x + c, and stores both input and results. Used for non-linear spring curve evaluation in the physics solver.

0x0043bb80.name: QuadraticForceTorqueCalculator
0x0043bb80.label: Quadratic force-torque calculator
0x0043bb80.summary: Evaluates two quadratic functions at input value and stores results as force and torque components. Uses coefficients from the physics struct. Part of the vehicle dynamics force/torque computation system.

0x0043bbd0.name: SpringDamperCompute
0x0043bbd0.label: Spring-damper linear evaluation
0x0043bbd0.summary: Stores input value and evaluates three linear functions (result = a*x + b) for spring force, damper force, and combined output. Part of the spring-damper computation in the physics solver.

0x0043bc20.name: sub_43BC20
0x0043bc20.label: PhysicsStateFrameSnapshot
0x0043bc20.summary: Per-frame physics state copy: transfers collision geometry, spring-evaluated scalars, force/torque vectors, and damper parameters from a physics simulation object (a3) into a local snapshot struct, applying quadratic and spring-damper evaluations driven by vehicle parameters (a2).

0x0043c250.name: sub_43C250
0x0043c250.label: Vehicle Tire Model Full Initialization
0x0043c250.summary: Initializes the complete per-wheel tire physics model for a vehicle from configuration data. Sets up 4 wheel compliance matrices, suspension geometry, thermal/wear parameters, aerodynamics mappings, and interpolated lookup tables for tire force curves.

0x0043da10.name: TireCompoundPerWheelPhysicsApplication
0x0043da10.label: Per-Wheel TireCompoundParameterLoader
0x0043da10.summary: Loads tire compound parameters (camber curves, temperature coefficients, wear rates, grip curves) from compound data and applies them to a per-wheel physics structure. Includes debug logging for missing slip curve files. Part of tire physics initialization per wheel.

0x0043e050.name: TireModelInit
0x0043e050.label: Tire model initialization
0x0043e050.summary: Initializes tire physics model: sets up tire parameters, parses vehicle HDV file, maps body names, initializes vehicle physics, sets brake bias, and cleans up allocated resources. Part of vehicle physics initialization pipeline.

0x0043e230.name: WheelDynamicsInit
0x0043e230.label: Wheel dynamics initialization
0x0043e230.summary: Initializes wheel dynamics state: sets contact constraints, parameters, and grid values for 4 wheels. Initializes wheel struct entries with default bit patterns and cleans up resources. Part of wheel physics initialization.

0x0043e360.name: PhysicsStateZeroingResetForSuspension
0x0043e360.label: Suspension and wheel physics state reset
0x0043e360.summary: Resets suspension and wheel physics state by zeroing per-wheel block pairs (4 iterations at 0x464 stride), a variable-length buffer list via pointer+offset, and two contiguous DWORD ranges (0xEC-0x118, 0x1F04-0x1F30).

0x0043e4b0.name: RigidBodyConstraintSolve
0x0043e4b0.label: Rigid body constraint position solve
0x0043e4b0.summary: Computes position error between current and target pose using Euler-angle rotation matrix and body position, then applies constraint correction. Initializes wheel constraint state entries with default disabled values. Part of AI vehicle path tracking.

0x0043e5d0.name: AccumulateAngularImpulse
0x0043e5d0.label: ImpulseAndTorqueAccumulator
0x0043e5d0.summary: Accumulates linear impulse and computed torque (cross product of relative position × impulse) from a collision contact into the vehicle's accumulator buffers. Part of vehicle physics collision response.

0x0043e6a0.name: RigidBodyTransformUpdate
0x0043e6a0.label: RigidBodyPositionAndOrientationUpdate
0x0043e6a0.summary: Updates a rigid body's position by adding a delta vector, computes Euler angle extraction from its rotation matrix/quaternion (atan2-based), and calls the transform update function. Part of vehicle rigid-body physics integration.

0x0043e770.name: WheelCollisionContactFlagSetter
0x0043e770.label: WheelContactCollisionFlagUpdater
0x0043e770.summary: Sets collision contact flags on collision data entries based on wheel contact state. When a wheel has contact (v2 != 0), marks the matching body-pair contact as collided; otherwise marks wheel-body contacts with contact flags. Part of vehicle collision system.

0x0043e890.name: SuspensionDamperForceAccumulation
0x0043e890.label: SuspensionDamperForceAccumulator
0x0043e890.summary: Accumulates suspension damper forces with scaling and clamping, then evaluates the damper force curve via quadratic function. Scales input by damper-specific rates (0.23 and 0.18) and clamps accumulators to upper bounds from reference field plus offset. Part of vehicle suspension force computation.

0x0043e980.name: ClampedSpringIntegrator
0x0043e980.label: ClampedSpringIntegrator
0x0043e980.summary: Accumulates spring state with scaled input (0.23 and 0.18 rates), clamps accumulators against reference-plus-offset bounds, then computes spring-damper force via SpringDamperCompute. Part of vehicle suspension spring force system.

0x0043ea70.name: DoubleAccumulatorClamp
0x0043ea70.label: SingleAccumulatorClamp
0x0043ea70.summary: Accumulates a single value with 0.37 scaling factor and clamps against reference-plus-offset upper bound. Single-accumulator variant of the pattern seen in SuspensionDamperForceAccumulation and ClampedSpringIntegrator. Part of vehicle physics force scaling.

0x0043eae0.name: PhysicsAccumulatorIntegrate
0x0043eae0.label: PhysicsAccumulatorIntegrate
0x0043eae0.summary: Accumulates physics state with scaled input (0.23 and 0.18 rates), clamps accumulators against reference-plus-offset bounds, then evaluates quadratic force/torque via QuadraticForceTorqueCalculator. Structurally identical pattern to SuspensionDamperForceAccumulation and ClampedSpringIntegrator. Part of vehicle physics damping system.

0x0043ebd0.name: PhysicsForceScaleDispatch
0x0043ebd0.label: ForceScaleDispatchToDamperAndSpring
0x0043ebd0.summary: Dispatches a force input scaled by 0.25 to SuspensionDamperForceAccumulation and 0.75 to ClampedSpringIntegrator. Splits a single force value between damper and spring subsystems. Part of vehicle physics force distribution.

0x0043ec00.name: RandomWeightedAudioMix
0x0043ec00.label: RandomWeightedForceSplitter
0x0043ec00.summary: Reads a pseudo-random noise value from a trig lookup table using a ring buffer counter, then splits the input force between ClampedSpringIntegrator (weighted by noise) and DoubleAccumulatorClamp (weighted by 1.0-noise). Part of vehicle physics noise/variation system.

0x0043ec80.name: PhysicsForceVelocityClamping
0x0043ec80.label: Velocity clamp and hybrid force-torque evaluation
0x0043ec80.summary: Clamps two velocity state values (0x17A8, 0x17C0) against reference limits, evaluates quadratic force function, applies spring-damper computation with bias offsets, and computes quadratic torque. Part of vehicle wheel physics update.

0x0043ef20.name: EngineStressSimulation
0x0043ef20.label: Engine Stress, Thermal & Component Failure Simulation
0x0043ef20.summary: Simulates per-frame engine durability degradation from RPM, coolant/oil temperature dynamics with thermal stress accumulation, and random component failures (3 components) using weather-noise-driven probability. Engine physics / damage system.

0x0043f7f0.name: SuspensionWheelDynamicsSolver
0x0043f7f0.label: VehicleSuspensionConstraintSolver
0x0043f7f0.summary: Core per-frame vehicle suspension and wheel dynamics solver — computes constraint forces via an LCP (Linear Complementarity Problem) approach with Gram-Schmidt projection, evaluates suspension spring/damper curves from lookup tables, and integrates velocity states for 4 wheels across multiple suspension modes. Vehicle physics system.

0x004412f0.name: WheelStateHistoryShift
0x004412f0.label: WheelStateHistoryBufferShift
0x004412f0.summary: Shifts wheel state history buffers forward by one frame — copies current frame state to the "previous" slot for 4 wheels, then shifts per-wheel data blocks. Part of vehicle wheel state history management for physics integration.

0x00441360.name: StateAccumulateDelta
0x00441360.label: StateAccumulateDelta
0x00441360.summary: Shifts wheel state history, then for each wheel computes the delta between current and previous state (position and velocity vectors), accumulating the difference back into the previous state buffer. This stores the per-frame change for later interpolation. Part of vehicle wheel state management.

0x00441450.name: PhysicsSubObjectFree
0x00441450.label: PhysicsSubObjectDataCopy
0x00441450.summary: Copies suspension data between physics sub-object slots (front/rear left/right) using SuspensionDataCopyToPhysicsEngine. Branches based on whether a shared suspension ID is set — either copies 4 times using the shared ID, or uses individual wheel suspension IDs. Part of vehicle suspension data management.

0x004414d0.name: WheelDataCopy
0x004414d0.label: WheelStateCopyAndPhysicsDispatch
0x004414d0.summary: Copies wheel state history forward (current→previous), copies delta state buffers for each wheel from the previous-state buffer into the current-state buffer, then runs the suspension wheel dynamics solver, two batch iterators, a per-body update function, and the sub-object data copy. Main wheel physics dispatch function.

0x00441600.name: PhysicsStepFrame
0x00441600.label: PhysicsStepFrame
0x00441600.summary: Executes one physics step frame: shifts wheel state history, runs suspension wheel dynamics solver, processes two batch iteration helpers, finds minimum value via iteration function, and copies suspension data to physics sub-objects. Core per-frame physics step.

0x00441650.name: VehiclePhysicsIntegrationStep
0x00441650.label: VehiclePhysicsIntegrationStep
0x00441650.summary: Per-frame vehicle physics integration driver — runs sub-stepped RK2 (midpoint) integration loop, accumulates forces per wheel, detects collision damage, and transforms inertia tensors for physics sub-objects.

0x00441ad0.name: VelocityDampingFromSpeedError
0x00441ad0.label: VelocityDampingFromSpeedError
0x00441ad0.summary: Computes aerodynamic velocity damping based on speed error (deviation from reference speed 8.0). Computes body speed from velocity vector, calculates damping force proportional to the speed error, applies direction-dependent scaling, and accumulates the result into the body's force buffer. Part of vehicle aerodynamics/damping system.

0x00441bb0.name: RigidBodyTorqueAccumulation
0x00441bb0.label: RigidBodyTorqueForceAccumulator
0x00441bb0.summary: Transforms a local-space force vector to world-space via rotation matrix, computes torque from cross product of lever arm and force, applies damping/spring factors (stiffness and damping coefficient), and accumulates the result into the target body's force buffer. Part of vehicle rigid body dynamics.

0x00441d60.name: PhysicsIntegrationStep
0x00441d60.label: physics integration step (gravity, constraint solving, velocity accumulation)
0x00441d60.summary: Performs a physics integration substep: applies gravity to body array, computes damper/spring forces with anti-roll, solves rigid-body constraints, then accumulates linear and angular velocities into the current body state.

0x00441f00.name: ForceTorqueApplicationToRigidBodyWithInertiaTens
0x00441f00.label: Rigid body force-torque with inertia tensor transform
0x00441f00.summary: Applies force/torque inputs to a rigid body by transforming velocity through a 3x4 inertia tensor matrix, adding translational offsets and suspension damping, and writing computed force-torque to 4 per-wheel output slots (24 bytes each). Sets an active flag at 0x1724.

0x00442060.name: SteeringGeometryUpdate
0x00442060.label: SteeringGeometryUpdate
0x00442060.summary: Updates per-wheel steering geometry: computes steering angle from input, applies noise perturbation via trig table lookup, clamps to ±10 degrees, transforms wheel contact geometry through coordinate frames of matching contact bodies, and accumulates steering angle. If accumulated angle exceeds threshold, triggers a state change. Part of vehicle steering system.

0x004423b0.name: sub_4423B0
0x004423b0.summary: Per-frame physics tick: computes per-wheel track grip via position-projected lookup, queries spatial grid for ground plane, runs collision contact generation and friction response for 4 wheels, detects ground penetration to accumulate angular momentum impulses, and optionally applies spring-damper suspension forces.

0x00442c90.name: sub_442C90
0x00442c90.label: VehicleSuspensionPhysicsTick
0x00442c90.summary: Per-frame vehicle suspension and wheel physics update. Computes suspension arm geometry, constraint forces, anti-roll bar torques, and accumulates angular momentum for all four wheels.

0x00443150.name: WheelContactForceSolver
0x00443150.label: WheelContactNormalForceSolver
0x00443150.summary: Solves contact normal force for a wheel contact: transforms contact position to world space via body rotation matrix, computes slip-based force reduction using friction model (cubic falloff), and accumulates resulting angular momentum into the body. Part of wheel collision response system.

0x004432f0.name: DamperSpringForceComputationWithAntiRoll
0x004432f0.label: ComputeDamperSpringAndAntiRollForces
0x004432f0.summary: Computes per-corner damper/spring forces from suspension travel, helper-spring abutment forces, and anti-roll bar coupling torques; accumulates resulting angular momentum into the chassis rigid-body for the physics integration step.

0x00443af0.name: BoundingVolumeHierarchyTraversalFilter
0x00443af0.label: BvhTraversalFilter
0x00443af0.summary: Filters bounding volume hierarchy traversal by checking distance thresholds against an input parameter. Returns TRUE if any relevant bounding volume extends beyond the test distance, FALSE if all checked volumes are within it. Three mode-dependent filter paths based on BVH mode state. Part of collision detection pruning.

0x00443b70.name: Gearbox
0x00443b70.label: Gearbox RPM Matching and Shift Control Simulation
0x00443b70.summary: Computes engine RPM blending during gear changes, throttle control for auto/manual shift modes, RPM limiting, and shift-timing logic based on current gear ratio relative to target RPM. Also handles temperature-based RPM clamping, speed limiter engagement, and telemetry position updates. Part of the vehicle drivetrain/gearbox physics simulation.

0x004441f0.name: VehicleMainPhysicsUpdate
0x004441f0.label: Vehicle Main Physics Per-Frame Update
0x004441f0.summary: Main per-frame vehicle physics tick: computes steering input, throttle/brake blending, suspension forces, tire model, aerodynamics, collision avoidance, lap state transitions, and visual state updates. Coordinates all vehicle dynamics subsystems each frame.

0x00446fd0.name: CollisionPositionTransform
0x00446fd0.label: CollisionPositionTransform
0x00446fd0.summary: Transforms a collision contact position from body-local coordinates to world space using the body rotation matrix, subtracts the vehicle's world-space position, then applies two consecutive 3x3 matrix coordinate transformations. Part of collision detection geometry processing.

0x00447100.name: GetBodyMotionState
0x00447100.label: GetBodyForceAndTorqueState
0x00447100.summary: Computes suspension spring-damper force and torque for a body via SuspensionSpringDamperForceComputationWithClampi, then returns the results through two output float arrays (force and torque vectors). Part of vehicle suspension query interface.

0x00447160.name: VehicleActive
0x00447160.label: VehicleActiveStateCheck
0x00447160.summary: Returns boolean indicating whether the vehicle is in an active state. Checks multiple conditions: threshold values > 0, active flag set, optional override flag, and secondary state byte. Part of vehicle state management.

0x004471f0.name: SuspensionVibration
0x004471f0.label: SuspensionVibrationUpdate
0x004471f0.summary: Updates suspension vibration state based on a vibration trigger flag (a2). In one mode, copies vibration state from source to destination. In the other mode (no trigger), computes a noise-based vibration value from a weather noise table lookup when vibration threshold is exceeded. Part of vehicle suspension vibration/feedback system.

0x004472a8.name: SetByteOffset7257
0x004472a8.label: Byte flag clear at offset 0x1C59
0x004472a8.summary: Clears a single byte flag at this[7257] (offset 0x1C59) to zero. Minimal state reset within a larger physics/vehicle object.

0x004472b0.name: TireSlipForceCalculation
0x004472b0.label: Per-wheel tire slip force computation and collision effect dispatch
0x004472b0.summary: Computes per-wheel tire slip ratios, contact patch forces, and dispatches collision/particle effects for a 4-wheel vehicle each frame. Part of the vehicle physics simulation tick.

0x00447780.name: sub_447780
0x00447780.label: Suspension Physics Update and Sub-Object Integration
0x00447780.summary: Performs a suspension physics update step: copies input transform data to all sub-objects, computes suspension force from input vector and vehicle mode, applies tire multiplier and damper clamping, updates position/lap state, and propagates inertia-tensor transforms to each active physics sub-object. Part of the vehicle physics pipeline.

0x00447ab0.name: TrigTableLookup
0x00447ab0.label: TrigTableLinearInterpolator
0x00447ab0.summary: Performs a linear interpolated lookup into a 256-entry trig table using a scaled input value (x4.0 offset by -0.5). Uses integer truncation for table index and fractional part for interpolation between adjacent entries. Part of vehicle physics trig calculations.

0x00447b10.name: RandomPhysicsParameterGenerator
0x00447b10.label: RandomPhysicsParameterGenerator
0x00447b10.summary: Generates a randomized physics parameter in [0.0, 1.0] range by interpolating between a lower bound (value+0.1) and upper bound (value+1.6) using a trig-table-based pseudo-random value. Returns 0 if inactive flag not set, 1.0 if input parameter >= 0.9, 0.0 if <= 0.0. Part of vehicle physics parameter randomization.

0x00447bb0.name: TireFrictionCurveEval
0x00447bb0.label: Tire friction curve piecewise evaluation
0x00447bb0.summary: Evaluates tire friction force from slip input (double at this+0x19C). Returns saturated output (58.5) when input ≥ 4.4, zero when input ≤ 0.0, and interpolated value using TrigTableLookup in the range 0.0–4.0 with inflection at 0.4. Scales final result by 58.5.

0x00447c70.name: VisualStateChange
0x00447c70.label: HUD element visual state transition with noise
0x00447c70.summary: Updates byte at this+0x1C58 when incoming `a2` differs from current. If HUD element activation flag at this+0x1F00 is non-zero and `a3` is 0, indexes two noise/trig tables to compute modulated alpha and scale values, then calls HUDElementConfig(40, 2, ...) to configure a HUD element with weather-influenced transparency.

0x00447d00.name: BrakeBiasAdjustmentControl
0x00447d00.label: BrakeBiasAdjustmentControl
0x00447d00.summary: Adjusts brake bias index based on signed input delta, computes final bias value from index * step + base offset, formats as percentage string and renders OSD display. Belongs to vehicle setup/UI system.

0x00447e00.name: PositionLapStateUpdate
0x00447e00.label: PositionLapChangeHandler
0x00447e00.summary: Detects position change events (gained/lost positions) during a race, updates position tracking state, triggers appropriate positional change sound effects, and sets UI state machine values for position change display. Part of vehicle/race state system.

0x00447f30.name: sub_447F30
0x00447f30.label: Vehicle Physics Data Extraction to Float Array
0x00447f30.summary: Extracts vehicle physics state (position, orientation, velocity, wheel data) from the physics object into a flat float array for telemetry/external consumption. Transforms body-frame vectors using rotation matrix and computes derived values.

0x00448120.name: ObjectConstructor
0x00448120.label: Object constructor with D3D state initialization
0x00448120.summary: Constructs an object by zeroing field at offset 0x4 (initialization flag or reference counter) and initializing Direct3D rendering state. Called by Steward_Init.

0x00448140.name: sub_448140
0x00448140.label: HelicopterAudioAndSceneInit
0x00448140.summary: Initializes helicopter audio subsystem (loads helicopter.wav, sets engine RPM-based DSP parameters) and links scene graph entities for heli system. Called once from Steward_Init.

0x004482d0.name: D3DStateInit
0x004482d0.label: D3DRenderStateReset
0x004482d0.summary: Resets D3D render state structure: releases vtable-bound object at offset +4 via its destructor/release method (first vtable entry), zeroes most fields, and sets state mask at offset +0x18 to 0xFF7FFFFF. Called from both constructor and post-init.

0x00448300.name: RandomScaledValue
0x00448300.label: IndexedTrigScaledValue
0x00448300.summary: Generates a pseudo-random scaled value by indexing a 256-entry trig lookup table with an incrementing ring-buffer counter, multiplying the result by a stored scale factor at this+0x8. Called from Steward_Restart as part of audio/weather noise seeding.

0x00448330.name: AudioDSPStateUpdate
0x00448330.label: AudioDSPStateUpdate
0x00448330.summary: Per-frame audio DSP state update: accumulates time with stored offset, dispatches interrupt, iterates scene graph children with conditional dispatch, calls DSP parameter update on audio object, and manages scrolling/animation transition based on state comparison. Called from sub_4D4580.

0x00448480.name: WeightedAverageInterpolation
0x00448480.label: WeightedAverage
0x00448480.summary: Computes element-wise average (midpoint) of two input structures containing float + double + float fields, writing results into output structure. Used in collision and mesh subdivision code.

0x004484c0.name: Vec3Subtract
0x004484c0.label: Vec3Subtract
0x004484c0.summary: Element-wise subtraction of two structures (float + double + float) — result = a2 - a3. Used in triangle edge subdivision for collision geometry.

0x004484f0.name: EmptyFunction
0x004484f0.label: Squared magnitude / dot product of mixed-precision components
0x004484f0.summary: Computes sum of squares of three structure components: float² at offset 0 + double² at offset 4 + float² at offset 12. Returns squared magnitude (dot product with self). Used in collision mesh edge length calculation.

0x00448510.name: QuaternionRotationStructureInitialize
0x00448510.label: QuaternionRotationStructureInitialize
0x00448510.summary: Initializes a quaternion/rotation structure (0x60 bytes): copies first 4 dwords from input source, duplicates axes 2 and 3 into offsets +0x10 and +0x14, zeroes a 0x2C-byte block (offsets 0x1C-0x47), sets sentinel at +0x48 to -1, and zeroes remaining fields. Called from spatial tree and mesh adjacency builder.

0x00448570.name: PhysicsSubComponentDestroy
0x00448570.label: PhysicsSubComponentDestroy
0x00448570.summary: Destroys and frees 5 physics sub-component pointers: 4 sequential at offsets 0x4C-0x58 (indices 19-22), plus one at 0x5C (index 23). Each non-null pointer is destroyed via PhysicsSubComponentDestroy then freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Called from PhysicsBufferFree.

0x004485c5.name: DualFieldStore
0x004485c5.label: DualFieldStore
0x004485c5.summary: Stores the same 32-bit value into two adjacent fields at offsets 0x58 and 0x5C of the target structure. Fastcall convention: a1 in ECX, a2 in EDX (target pointer).

0x004485d0.name: SpatialTreeInsertion
0x004485d0.label: SpatialTreeInsertion
0x004485d0.summary: Inserts or locates a node in a 96-byte-node spatial tree data structure. Traverses using float/double key components (offsets 0, 4, 12): exact match returns existing node; float match without double match follows chain child at offset 0x5C; otherwise computes 4-way branch index from float-at-offset-12 comparison and descends into branch slot at offset 0x4C-0x58. Allocates new nodes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper when traversal hits a null slot. Called from TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder.

0x004486a0.name: DynamicsNodeCountRecursive
0x004486a0.label: Recursive tree node count
0x004486a0.summary: Recursively counts nodes in a spatial tree (BVH/kd-tree). Starts at 1 (self), then recurses into 4 child pointers (array at this+0x4C) if non-null, plus the equal-bucket child at this+0x5C. Returns total node count.

0x004486e0.name: BVHTreeLinearize
0x004486e0.label: BVH tree flatten/linearize
0x004486e0.summary: Recursively flattens a BVH tree into a contiguous array. Stores node pointer at `out[a3]`, writes current output index to `this[18]` (0x48), then recurses through up to 5 child pointers.

0x00448730.name: ShadowVolumeExtrusion
0x00448730.label: shadow volume extrusion computation
0x00448730.summary: Computes shadow volume extrusion offset for collision geometry. Reads triangle faces from an array at this+0x1C, detects silhouette edges relative to light, accumulates extrusion factor, writes clamped result to this+0x10.

0x00448da0.name: CollisionTreeTraversal
0x00448da0.label: Collision tree traversal with shadow extrusion and child recursion
0x00448da0.summary: Recursively traverses a collision tree node hierarchy. For each node, extrudes shadow volume geometry, then recurses into up to 4 child nodes and follows a sibling link to continue the traversal.

0x00448de0.name: PhysicsTreeMassPropagation
0x00448de0.label: Physics mass property propagation across collision tree
0x00448de0.summary: Propagates mass properties through a collision tree by blending a physics value (offset 0x10) toward a target value (offset 0x4) by half each step, then recursing into children and following the sibling chain.

0x00448e20.name: LinkedListNodeTraversal
0x00448e20.label: Advance linked-list pointers through collision node slots
0x00448e20.summary: Advances up to 11 linked-list pointers stored at consecutive slots (starting at this+0x1C). Each slot's pointer is replaced by following a "next" link at offset 0x1C within the pointed-to object, walking each list forward one step.

0x00448e90.name: AABBCollisionBodyInitializer
0x00448e90.label: AABB collision body structure initializer
0x00448e90.summary: Initializes a collision body structure: zeroes the header (first 24 bytes), then sets individual fields to default values (active flag=1, type=0, handle=INVALID, next pointer=null). Used to reset AABB proxy entries in the collision broad-phase.

0x00448ec0.name: SmallStructCopy
0x00448ec0.label: Copy 3-byte type+handle pair into collision body
0x00448ec0.summary: Copies a 1-byte type field and 2-byte handle word from a source structure into a collision body at offsets 0x19 and 0x1A. A small data field copy used during collision body initialization.

0x00448ee0.name: RGBColorPacking
0x00448ee0.label: Pack RGB color channels into DWORD
0x00448ee0.summary: Packs three color channels from a collision body (byte at offset 0x19, second byte of `this` value, word at offset 0x1A) into a single DWORD and writes it to the output pointer. Used during mesh/vertex color setup.

0x00449000.name: F_2DLineSegmentIntersection
0x00449000.label: 2D line segment intersection test with endpoint tolerance
0x00449000.summary: Tests whether two 2D line segments (defined by four points with 12-byte stride) intersect. Validates intersection parameters are strictly between 0 and 1 for both segments, and that contact is not at segment endpoints (within 0.001 skin thickness). Returns true on valid intersection.

0x004492b0.name: CollisionShapeInit
0x004492b0.label: Collision shape structure initializer
0x004492b0.summary: Zeroes three collision shape fields (offsets 0x8, 0xC, 0x10) and calls PhysicsBufferFree to initialize or reset the internal physics buffer. Prepares a collision shape for use.

0x004492d0.name: CollisionContactBufferAllocator
0x004492d0.label: Collision contact buffer allocator and AABB body array initializer
0x004492d0.summary: Allocates a heap buffer for `a2` AABB collision bodies (each 32 bytes). Stores count at offset 0x4, allocates memory via wrapper, initializes each body with AABBCollisionBodyInitializer, and stores the buffer pointer at offset 0x8. Precedes allocation with PhysicsBufferFree.

0x004493a0.name: TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder
0x004493a0.label: Triangle mesh adjacency builder with BVH spatial insertion
0x004493a0.summary: Builds adjacency data for a triangle mesh collision shape. Allocates/reallocates triangle body buffer, inserts vertices into spatial (BVH) trees, discovers shared edges between adjacent triangles, and stores edge adjacency pointers. Handles weighted edge midpoint interpolation and optionally copies edge flags.

0x00449700.name: CollisionContactResponse
0x00449700.label: Collision contact pair processing with mass blending
0x00449700.summary: Processes collision contact pairs after broad-phase detection. Traverses both collision trees (shadow volume extrusion), blends mass properties between contact pairs via weighted averaging, and propagates the blended mass through the physics tree. Calls weighted interpolation on each contact's vertex pairs.

0x004497e0.name: SweepAndPruneAABBOverlapDetection
0x004497e0.label: Sweep-and-prune AABB broad phase with SAT narrow phase
0x004497e0.summary: Broad-phase collision detection using sweep-and-prune on AABB projections. Computes min/max axis-aligned projections for each triangle, sorts them by left bound, sweeps for overlapping pairs, and validates each overlap with SATEdgeSeparationTest. Marks overlapping pairs at field offset 0x18.

0x00449a80.name: HATPolygonSurfaceFit
0x00449a80.label: QuadraticSurfaceFit
0x00449a80.summary: Solves a quadratic surface fit to a set of 6 input points using Gaussian elimination, storing 6 coefficients representing the fitted quadratic form. Part of the collision/physics geometry system, used by spatial hash, capsule shape, and Bezier tessellation pipelines.

0x0044a070.name: QuadraticSurfaceCollisionTest
0x0044a070.label: QuadraticSurfaceCollisionTest
0x0044a070.summary: Tests a ray/query against a quadratic surface defined by six double coefficients (conic equation). Performs 3-axis slab culling test, evaluates surface equation at intersection point, and updates query with nearest hit if closer than previous. Part of collision detection system.

0x0044a170.name: VisibilityFrustumTest
0x0044a170.label: View-space vertex coverage and overlap metric
0x0044a170.summary: Computes a 1D coverage/overlap metric between two vertex batches (stride 16 bytes). Tracks min/max extents of each batch, counts vertices that extend beyond the overlap region, and computes a normalized coverage score. Optionally links vertices into a chain when the update flag is set.

0x0044a2d0.name: sub_44A2D0
0x0044a2d0.label: Axis-projection visibility sort and coverage computation
0x0044a2d0.summary: Walks a linked list of vertex data nodes, projects each node's 3 vertex pairs onto a weighted axis (blend of two coordinates via a4/a5 factors), tracks min/max projection per node, sorts results, and computes coverage/overlap metric via VisibilityFrustumTest. Selects best coverage result from split-half comparison.

0x0044a450.name: CollisionMaterialLookup
0x0044a450.label: Collision material property lookup
0x0044a450.summary: Looks up material properties (friction, restitution) from global tables indexed by material ID. For basic materials (0-7), reads property from MaterialPropertyTable and restitution from CollisionRestitutionTable. For extended materials (8+), reads from ExtendedMaterialTable and negated CollisionResponseTable.

0x0044a4b0.name: sub_44A4B0
0x0044a4b0.label: Collision material selection and recursive spatial subdivision
0x0044a4b0.summary: Selects optimal collision material for a vertex-linked-list region by evaluating coverage scores across all material types (0-13). Walks linked list to count nodes, samples materials via sub_44A2D0, picks lowest-coverage material, stores dispatch flags and output buffer at this+0xC, then recurses into two child sub-regions.

0x0044a700.name: CollisionTreeNodeDeserializer
0x0044a700.label: Recursive collision tree node deserializer from stream
0x0044a700.summary: Deserializes a collision tree node from a file read stream. Reads node type byte: internal nodes (0-1) read a subtype byte and recurse into two children; leaf nodes (-1 = single, -2 = pair) allocate vertex storage and read indexed vertex data. Allocates output buffer space from arena pointers in v2.

0x0044a880.name: sub_44A880
0x0044a880.label: AABB tree point containment test with material transform
0x0044a880.summary: Tests a 2D point against an AABB collision tree. Transforms the point by material friction/restitution factors, then tests all four corners against child node bounds. Returns the leaf node on containment, null if fully outside. Recursively traverses internal nodes.

0x0044aa30.name: BVHTreeTraversal
0x0044aa30.label: BVHTreeTraversal
0x0044aa30.summary: Recursive BVH tree traversal for collision detection. Tests ray/query against BVH node: leaf nodes test against quadratic surface(s), interior nodes compute split-plane side and recurse into children. Part of collision detection system.

0x0044aae0.name: RecursiveTriangleEdgeSubdivisionForCollision
0x0044aae0.label: Recursive triangle edge subdivision for collision mesh
0x0044aae0.summary: Recursively subdivides a triangle whose edges exceed a squared-length threshold (22500.0). Identifies the longest edge, splits it at the midpoint via WeightedAverageInterpolation, and recurses on the two resulting triangles. Terminates when all edges are short enough, emitting the triangle via TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder.

0x0044acb0.name: AnimationPlaybackSequence
0x0044acb0.label: AnimationDrivenCollisionMeshUpdater
0x0044acb0.summary: Iterates audio network node hierarchy and scene graph to find animation-matched meshes, then generates collision geometry via recursive triangle edge subdivision for triangles passing normal and area checks.

0x0044af20.name: CollisionFaceVerticesGather
0x0044af20.label: CollisionFaceVertexDataGather
0x0044af20.summary: Reads 6 coordinate/component values from three vertex sources referenced by input index array and writes them into output buffer; used by collision and tessellation subsystems to extract face vertex data.

0x0044b110.name: sub_44B110
0x0044b110.label: CollisionFaceProximityAxisSelector
0x0044b110.summary: Tests proximity of triangle edges against a collision shape capsule, counts which edges are close, and selects the appropriate axis permutation index for collision response pipeline; returns 0 for ambiguous/dual-proximity, 4 for edge-fallback, or permutation index (2-3) for resolved axis.

0x0044b370.name: BezierPatchTessellation
0x0044b370.label: BezierPatchCollisionTessellator
0x0044b370.summary: Tessellates Bezier patch control points into collision triangle mesh adjacency; computes surface-fit coefficients, determines axis permutation from proximity tests, and builds final collision output with permuted/transformed vertex coordinates.

0x0044b910.name: BoundingBoxComputationFromTriangles
0x0044b910.label: TriangleBoundingBoxCompute
0x0044b910.summary: Scans triangle vertex data to compute 2D axis-aligned bounding box (XZ plane), then stores center coordinates and inverse-half-extent scale factors for use in collision spatial subdivision/indexing.

0x0044ba40.name: CollisionGridRaycast32x32
0x0044ba40.label: CollisionGrid32x32QueryBuilder
0x0044ba40.summary: Subdivides collision grid into 32×32 cells, computes each cell's world-space bounding box from grid center and scale parameters, queries collision data per cell via sub_44A880, and stores the returned pointers in a flat 1024-element output array.

0x0044bb60.name: CollisionGeometryOperationSelector
0x0044bb60.label: CollisionGeometryOperationRouter
0x0044bb60.summary: Dispatches collision geometry processing pipeline based on operation ID (0=animation-only, 1=animation+contact+sweep, 2=full pipeline with bezier tessellation); always returns result of sweep-and-prune AABB overlap detection.

0x0044bc50.name: sub_44BC50
0x0044bc50.label: CollisionSceneDataLoader
0x0044bc50.summary: Loads collision geometry from scene track file, allocates and initializes collision object and BVH node arrays, linearizes bounding volume hierarchy, processes contact pair linkages, and stores resulting pointers in output struct.

0x0044be70.name: HTreeTerrainFileFormatLoader
0x0044be70.label: TerrainHTreeFileLoader
0x0044be70.summary: Opens and validates a terrain H-tree file by checking version string and header fields, allocates and populates collision object arrays and tree node buffer, then deserializes collision tree structure from file data.

0x0044c0e0.name: SceneTrackFileLoader
0x0044c0e0.label: Scene Track File Loader with Collision Rebuild
0x0044c0e0.summary: Loads a scene/track terrain file (.scn/.hat format), validates freshness via registry timestamp queries, and conditionally rebuilds collision geometry including bounding boxes and directory structure. Handles weather-dependent path selection and creates required directory hierarchy.

0x0044c4c0.name: SpatialGridQuery
0x0044c4c0.label: SpatialGridQuery
0x0044c4c0.summary: Queries a 2D spatial grid (32x32 cells) for collision surfaces at a given position. Tests cached surface first, then maps world position to grid cell, looks up BVH tree for that cell, and traverses it. Part of collision detection system.

0x0044c620.name: CollisionStateInit
0x0044c620.label: CollisionStateDefaultsInit
0x0044c620.summary: Initializes four global collision state parameters to their default values: cell init count to 1, two float thresholds to 0.0, and cell scale to 1.0.

0x0044c680.name: SpatialNodeInit
0x0044c680.label: SpatialNodeDefaultsInit
0x0044c680.summary: Initializes four global spatial node parameters: element count to 2, radius sentinel to -1.0f, and two float thresholds to 0.0.

0x0044c6e0.name: GlobalStateInitializer
0x0044c6e0.label: GlobalStateDefaultsInit_c6e0
0x0044c6e0.summary: Initializes four global parameters: audio engine type to 3, two float thresholds to 0.0, and collision Z scale to 1.0.

0x0044c740.name: CollisionGridInit4
0x0044c740.label: CollisionGridSize4Init
0x0044c740.summary: Initializes four collision grid globals: grid size to 4, -1.0f sentinel, and two float fields to 0.0.

0x0044c7a0.name: CollisionStateInitAlpha
0x0044c7a0.label: CollisionStateAlphaInit
0x0044c7a0.summary: Initializes four globals for collision state: default collision type to 5, two float thresholds to 0.0, and a render/alpha field to 1.0.

0x0044c800.name: CollisionRegionInit5
0x0044c800.label: CollisionRegionType6Init
0x0044c800.summary: Initializes four collision region globals: region type to 6, -1.0f sentinel, and two float thresholds to 0.0.

0x0044c860.name: CollisionMaterialCoefficientsSet5
0x0044c860.label: CollisionMaterialDefaultsInit
0x0044c860.summary: Initializes four collision material coefficient globals: default material type to 7, two float thresholds to 0.0, and restitution coefficient to 1.0.

0x0044c8c0.name: CollisionFrictionInit8
0x0044c8c0.label: CollisionFrictionDefaultsInit
0x0044c8c0.summary: Initializes four collision friction globals: friction/state type to 8, -1.0f sentinel, and two float fields to 0.0.

0x0044c920.name: CollisionGlobalInit
0x0044c920.label: CollisionGlobalDefaultsInit_920
0x0044c920.summary: Initializes four collision global parameters: state type to 9, two float thresholds to 0.0, and a float init field to 1.0.

0x0044c980.name: CollisionGlobalInit_c980
0x0044c980.label: CollisionContactCountInit
0x0044c980.summary: Initializes four collision globals: maximum contact count to 10, -1.0f contact sentinel, and two float fields to 0.0.

0x0044ca40.name: CollisionStaticInit12
0x0044ca40.label: CollisionStaticType12Init
0x0044ca40.summary: Initializes four collision static globals: type ID to 12, -1.0f sentinel, and two float fields to 0.0.

0x0044d0a0.name: CollisionGlobalInit_d0a0
0x0044d0a0.label: CollisionGlobalDefaultsInit_d0a0
0x0044d0a0.summary: Initializes four collision globals: target/type field to 106, two float thresholds to 0.0, and a state field to 1.0.

0x0044d100.name: CollisionGlobalInit_d100
0x0044d100.label: CollisionGlobalCount107Init
0x0044d100.summary: Initializes four collision globals: count field to 107, -1.0f sentinel, and two float fields to 0.0.

0x0044d160.name: CollisionGlobalStructInit_d160
0x0044d160.label: CollisionConfigBlockInit
0x0044d160.summary: Initializes four collision configuration globals: config block type to 108, two float thresholds to 0.0, and config variable to 1.0.

0x0044d1c0.name: CollisionStaticInit6d
0x0044d1c0.label: CollisionStaticType109Init
0x0044d1c0.summary: Initializes four collision static globals: render state ID to 109, -1.0f sentinel, and two float fields to 0.0.

0x0044d220.name: InitMouseAbsAxisY
0x0044d220.label: MouseAxisInit_44d220
0x0044d220.summary: Initializes four global parameters: axis/steering value to 60, two zero-initialized fields, and a float field to 1.0.

0x0044d280.name: CollisionSubsystemInit_d280
0x0044d280.label: InitializeCollisionForceFeedbackAndBounds
0x0044d280.summary: Initializes four collision/force-feedback globals: sets ForceFeedbackGain to 61, CollisionBoundMax to -1.0f, and zeroes InitState2 and Flt_Unknown_Render.

0x0044d340.name: CollisionGlobalInitG
0x0044d340.label: InitializeCollisionWorldObjTypeAndSentinels
0x0044d340.summary: Initializes CollisionWorldObjType to 63, sets CameraInitFloat1 and FloatInit to 0, and writes -1.0f as a sentinel value (Sentinel_MinusOne).

0x0044d3a0.name: CollisionBroadphaseReset
0x0044d3a0.label: ResetCollisionBroadphaseGlobals
0x0044d3a0.summary: Initializes collision broadphase globals: sets bucket/cell index to 13 (0xd) and zeroes five collision bucket state/configuration fields. Returns 0.

0x0044d400.name: SpatialNodeInit_d400
0x0044d400.label: InitializeSpatialGridNodeGlobals
0x0044d400.summary: Initializes six spatial/grid globals: sets GridNodeElementCount to 14 and zeroes five other state fields (VideoMode_Index, CollisionZeroState, UnknownZeroedState, CollisionInitZeroed, CollisionInit6). Returns 0.

0x0044d460.name: GlobalStateInitializer_d460
0x0044d460.label: InitializeRainBrakeAndCollisionState
0x0044d460.summary: Initializes six globals: sets RainBrakeBiasGlobal to 15 and zeroes five collision/render state variables (CollisionStateCounter, CollisionState_7CCCF8, RenderState_Zero_05, ZeroedCollisionState, Unknown_Zeroed_CCD04). Returns 0.

0x0044d4c0.name: CollisionGridInit16x16
0x0044d4c0.label: InitializeCollisionGrid16x16
0x0044d4c0.summary: Sets collision grid size to 16 and zeroes five related state/parameter variables (SpatialGridState, CollisionGridParam, AudioState2Block, CollisionGridZeroBlock, CollisionGridState1). Returns 0.

0x0044d520.name: CollisionStateInit17
0x0044d520.label: InitializeCollisionStateBlock17
0x0044d520.summary: Sets collision state block type to 17 (0x11) and zeroes five related fields (CollisionCellOffsetY, Dword_Unknown_Render, CollisionGridInitZero, CollisionInitBlock, CollisionGridInitZero2). Returns 0.

0x0044d580.name: CollisionRegionInit1
0x0044d580.label: InitializeCollisionRegionType18
0x0044d580.summary: Sets collision region type to 18 and zeroes five region parameter/configuration fields (CollisionRegionParams, CollisionGridField, CollisionConfigField3, VideoMode_Index_2). Returns 0.

0x0044d5e0.name: CollisionMaterialCoefficientsSet1
0x0044d5e0.label: InitializeCollisionMaterialCoefficientsSet1
0x0044d5e0.summary: Sets first material ID to 19 and zeroes five adjacent material coefficient/parameter fields (CollisionMaterialCoeff_group, and four unnamed coefficient slots). Returns 0.

0x0044d640.name: CollisionTableInit14

0x0044ed10.name: sub_44ED10
0x0044ed10.label: CollisionDataSetupDispatch
0x0044ed10.summary: Dispatches incoming collision setup data (from a1) based on type field a2 (18/19/20). For type 19 copies data via CollisionStructCopy_efc0 to global byte_7CA594. For type 20 copies to unk_7CB318 or unk_7CB714 depending on device-create counter and increments it.

0x0044edd0.name: sub_44EDD0
0x0044edd0.label: CollectAudioSourceEntry
0x0044edd0.summary: If flag bit 0 at struct offset 0x1C (field at a1+28) is set, stores the value at offset 0x18 into audio source array dword_7CC9CC[dword_7CD07C] and increments counter. Returns whether counter < 8 (buffer not full).

0x0044ee10.name: D3DWindowSurfaceCreation
0x0044ee10.label: D3DWindowSurfaceCreate
0x0044ee10.summary: Creates a D3D window surface: initializes a 256-byte buffer with 1s/0s, sets surface constants (two DWORDs at offsets 0xC7C/0xC80), registers via ppvOut callback with sub_44ED10, creates vertex buffer through COM interface, and configures surface properties.

0x0044efc0.name: CollisionStructCopy_efc0
0x0044efc0.label: CollisionStructDataStore
0x0044efc0.summary: Stores a type ID (a2) at offset 0x278 of the target struct (a1 via ecx), then copies 0x244 bytes (580 bytes = 145 ints) from stack parameters a3..a63 into offset 0x8 of the struct.

0x0044efe0.name: CollisionCullCleanup
0x0044efe0.label: D3DSurfaceCleanup
0x0044efe0.summary: Cleans up D3D surface: zeros surface type field at this[158] (0x278), releases the DirectDrawSurface at this[1] (0x4) via vtable[32] (Release) and vtable[8] (ReleaseDC if applicable), then zeros the pointer.

0x0044f010.name: StoreNegatedAbsoluteValues
0x0044f010.label: StoreNegatedAbsValues
0x0044f010.summary: Computes absolute values of two floats (a2, a3), negates them, and stores results at this[799] (offset 0xC7C) and this[800] (offset 0xC80). Updates surface constants previously initialized as -0.5f and -0.1f.

0x0044f0a0.name: BVHTreeNodeArrayInit
0x0044f0a0.label: BVH tree node array initialization
0x0044f0a0.summary: Clears BVH tree node arrays: a 256-entry dword array at 0x87C, a 256-entry byte array at 0x37C, a count field at 0xC84, and 48 bytes at 0xC88. Called from HWInput_Restart to reset collision tree state.

0x0044f0e0.name: CollisionProxyUnregister
0x0044f0e0.label: Unregister collision proxy slot
0x0044f0e0.summary: Unregisters a collision proxy entry: clears one byte in the proxy active-flag array at 0x37C, removes proxy ID from the active list at 0xC88, and resets the proxy's axis float at 0x87C to either 0 or the dead zone threshold.

0x0044f150.name: sub_44F150
0x0044f150.label: Collision proxy input state update
0x0044f150.summary: Polls raw input device (keyboard or gamepad) for state changes, then updates BVH proxy slot states: tracks axis positions, manages proxy activation/deactivation based on input and dead zone, and conditionally registers active proxies. Called from collision update and input processing paths.

0x0044f4e0.name: sub_44F4E0
0x0044f4e0.label: Cursor initialization on input enter
0x0044f4e0.summary: Initializes cursor subsystem when input device enters: sets up frustum viewport to full screen, loads four cursor image files (00-03), and selects cursor index 0. Called from HWInput_Enter.

0x0044f540.name: CursorLoadImageALoaderWithHandleStorage
0x0044f540.label: Load cursor image and store handle
0x0044f540.summary: Loads a cursor image file from disk using LoadImageA and stores the resulting handle in a slot-indexed array. Constructs full path from application directory + cursor filename, then appends handle to the cursor array with associated metadata zeros.

0x0044f5f0.name: CursorResourceCleanup
0x0044f5f0.label: Destroy cursor handles and reset state
0x0044f5f0.summary: Destroys all loaded cursor handles via DestroyCursor, clears handle array entries, resets cursor count, and sets the active cursor to null. Called on input exit and cleanup paths.

0x0044f640.name: CursorSelectorFromArray
0x0044f640.label: Select and activate cursor by index
0x0044f640.summary: Selects a loaded cursor from the handle array by index, sets it as the active Windows cursor via SetCursor, and stores the selected index. Returns 1 on success, 0 if index is out of range or handle is null.

0x0044f680.name: FrustumViewportSetup
0x0044f680.label: Set viewport rectangle and projection factors
0x0044f680.summary: Configures a viewport rectangle from top, left, bottom, right coordinates: stores bounds, computes center point, and pre-calculates reciprocal half-width and half-height for projection transformations. Called during cursor initialization and input restart.

0x0044f73c.name: CursorScrollPositionTracker
0x0044f73c.label: Update scroll position with viewport clamping
0x0044f73c.summary: Tracks cursor scroll/drag position within viewport bounds: computes normalized delta from previous center, updates center to current position, clamps within viewport rectangle, and writes both normalized delta and clamped normalized position. No callers identified statically.

0x0044f7d0.name: ContactFlagReadClear
0x0044f7d0.label: Read and clear contact flag
0x0044f7d0.summary: Atomically reads the contact flag value at offset 0xBC (this[47]), then clears (zeroes) it. Returns the prior flag value. Called during viewport initialization.

0x0044f7f0.name: CollisionResponseCompute
0x0044f7f0.label: Compute collision force feedback response
0x0044f7f0.summary: Queries a device/force-feedback object at offset 0x80 for range data via vtable call, then computes collision response parameters: output range bounds, center value, inverse range values for mapping. Called from texture stage setup path.

0x0044f8f0.name: D3DTextureStage
0x0044f8f0.label: Configure D3D texture stage for force-feedback
0x0044f8f0.summary: Sets up Direct3D texture stage parameters for force-feedback collision rendering: polls device state, configures stage flags based on axis count, and calls CollisionResponseCompute for up to 8 axes when enabled. Called from device init and parameter clamp paths.

0x0044fa60.name: DirectXDeviceInitialization
0x0044fa60.label: Create and initialize Direct3D device
0x0044fa60.summary: Creates a Direct3D device, sets up vertex buffer, texture format, viewport parameters, and initializes force-feedback axis parameters. Stores device pointer at offset 0x80 and calls D3DTextureStage to finish setup. Called from HWInput_Setup.

0x0044fbb0.name: CollisionDataCopy
0x0044fbb0.label: Copy collision device caps data
0x0044fbb0.summary: Copies a block of device capability/configuration data (0x244 bytes starting at offset 0x84) from stack parameters to the object, and stores a version/count field at offset 0x2F4. Called from the device enumeration callback sub_44ED10.

0x0044fbe0.name: CollisionObjectDestructor
0x0044fbe0.label: Release and destroy Direct3D device
0x0044fbe0.summary: Releases the Direct3D device object: calls its stop/unacquire method (vtable+32), then Release (vtable+8), zeroes the device pointer at 0x80, and resets version field at 0x2F4. Called during setup, post-frame, and exit.

0x0044fcc0.name: D3DShaderConstantSetup
0x0044fcc0.label: Set up D3D shader constants for force feedback
0x0044fcc0.summary: Polls device state, converts raw state to float shader constants, applies dead zone, clamping, and smoothing for each of 8 force-feedback axes. Writes additional constant data (direction flags and sign bits) for shader use. Called per-frame from the collision update path.

0x0044fee0.name: CollisionImpulseAccumulator
0x0044fee0.label: CollisionImpulseAccumulator
0x0044fee0.summary: Accumulates collision impulse vectors into a contact impulse buffer. Adds three components each from two input vectors (a2, a3) to six consecutive double fields (linear + angular impulse accumulation). Part of collision response system.

0x0044ff50.name: sub_44FF50
0x0044ff50.label: AudioEngineInitAndVoiceRouting
0x0044ff50.summary: Initializes the audio engine's voice routing, device enumeration, and effect configuration. Sets up audio sources for different effect categories (engine, collision, UI, etc.), configures gain envelopes, and manages mute channel assignment based on quality level.

0x00451720.name: DriverInputController
0x00451720.label: DriverInputController_UpdateTick
0x00451720.summary: Per-frame tick that processes driver input state and vehicle physics data to update audio/visual effects across 10 channels (headlights, engine RPM, tire sounds, 3D positional audio). Reads wheel contact types and dispatches enable/disable to 4 audio sub-controllers.

0x004526c0.name: ArrayDestructorViaVirtualDispatch
0x004526c0.label: Destroy array of COM objects
0x004526c0.summary: Releases an array of 10 COM-style objects at stride 104 bytes starting at offset 0x64: calls vtable+44 (stop/release method), then vtable+8 (Release), zeroes the pointer. Also resets a count at offset 0x414. Called during HWInput_Post cleanup.

0x00452700.name: ConditionalFieldSetterWithState
0x00452700.label: Conditional value capture with one-shot state
0x00452700.summary: Manages a value capture with one-shot activation tracking: if override mode (offset 0x8) is set, always captures the input value; otherwise captures on first activation (0→1 transition) and ignores subsequent activations until deactivated (input 0 resets state). Called per-frame from collision update.

0x00452740.name: SwapAndReinit
0x00452740.label: Swap collision node values and reinitialize
0x00452740.summary: Calls CollisionNodePropertySetter with the old value, then replaces both stored properties (offset 0x0 and 0x4) with new values, and calls CollisionNodePropertySetter again with the new ones. Used during collision node property updates from various init paths.

0x004527c0.name: ConditionalCollisionDispatch
0x004527c0.label: Conditional collision property dispatch
0x004527c0.summary: If the guard field at offset 0x0 is zero, calls CollisionNodePropertySetter with the two property values at offsets 0x4 and 0x8. Otherwise returns 0 (no-op). Called from camera viewport configuration.

0x004527e0.name: StructInitWithSubCall
0x004527e0.label: Initialize collision property struct
0x004527e0.summary: Initializes a small collision property structure: zeros the first field at 0x0, swaps and reinitializes fields at 0x4/0x8 with new values via SwapAndReinit, then zeros fields at 0x1C and 0x20.

0x00452810.name: DeviceObjectSelector
0x00452810.label: Device/Object Config Selector & Registration
0x00452810.summary: Matches an input integer ID against a large set of pre-registered global config objects (collision, audio, rendering constants). Stores the matched global's address in this+0x20 (output), sets this+0x0=2 for success or 0 for no match, then reinitializes a sub-structure via SwapAndReinit. Part of the device initialization / config-binding system.

0x00452b10.name: sub_452B10
0x00452b10.label: CollisionConfigKeyLookupInitializer
0x00452b10.summary: Looks up a collision configuration key (passed as a2) against a table of ~60 known global collision/system config addresses. If matched, stores the address of the matching global in this+0x1C (field 7) and writes the a3 parameter to offset +8 of that global. Calls SwapAndReinit to reset remaining fields. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

0x00453100.name: CollisionResultProcessing
0x00453100.label: Process collision result and set output values
0x00453100.summary: Processes a collision result object based on its type field at offset 0x0: type 0 reads a packed flag from byte_7CA594, type 1 dereferences a pointer at 0x1C, type 2 evaluates an axis value from a pointer at 0x20. Sets output activation state (0x24) and magnitude (0x28) accordingly.

0x004531a0.name: MemoryAllocation_31a0
0x004531a0.label: Force-feedback device context initialization
0x004531a0.summary: Initializes a large force-feedback device context: zeroes multiple data regions, sets max-axis counts to 17 (three groups), creates 44 axis property structs via StructInitWithFixedValues, creates 44 {value, -1} sentinel pairs, and sets a self-reference pointer for circular list traversal.

0x004532d0.name: AudioSceneUpdateLoop
0x004532d0.label: Process audio scenes for collision parameters
