0x004532d0.summary: Iterates over audio/scene configurations (up to count at 0xD80), reading HUD state data from a global array (unk_7D1448) and calling CollisionParameterClampAndStore for 8 sub-elements per scene. Processes two data regions (at offsets 0xD88 and 0x1184) for each scene. Called during HWInput_Init.

0x004537b0.name: sub_4537B0
0x004537b0.label: Vehicle Telemetry / Control-State Global Broadcast
0x004537b0.summary: Reads vehicle physics and control state from a large struct and broadcasts clamped float values plus equality-comparison boolean flags to global telemetry variables (HUD, audio, render, collision subsystems). Part of the vehicle-state-to-globals update pipeline.

0x004541d0.name: PAUSEStringCopier
0x004541d0.label: Copy PAUSE menu key name string
0x004541d0.summary: Copies a PAUSE menu key name string from a lookup table based on an index byte at offset 0xC8C. Indexes ≤ 0x5A select from aPause_0 table; indexes > 128 select from aEmpty_0 table via offset. Requires count at 0xC88 > 0 to proceed.

0x00454350.name: sub_454350
0x00454350.label: Vehicle Setup Diagnostic State Classifier
0x00454350.summary: Classifies the current vehicle setup/damage state by evaluating constraint forces, swept-AABB overlaps, byte-flag arrays, and compound flag+value-match conditions, producing a numeric state ID (1-109) and copying a human-readable label from a string table into the output buffer. Used for telemetry, debug overlays, or diagnostic displays.

0x00454da0.name: sub_454DA0
0x00454da0.label: VehicleInputSmoothingAndGearSelect
0x00454da0.summary: Per-frame vehicle input processor that smooths throttle, brake, clutch, steering, handbrake, and gear selection with configurable decay rates. Each axis supports a direct-mode passthrough (field==2) bypassing the smoothing ramp.

0x00455260.name: sub_455260
0x00455260.label: StringTableLookupByType
0x00455260.summary: Looks up a string from one of two string tables (aEmpty or aPause_0) based on a discriminator field at offset 0x0. Returns pointer to formatted string or null for unknown type.

0x00455290.name: InputActionRegistration
0x00455290.label: RegisterInputActionStrings
0x00455290.summary: Registers all input action display-name strings by copying them through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc. Called during input system initialization to populate the internal string table for keybinding/control names. Part of the hardware input subsystem.

0x00455b30.name: TranslateVirtualKey
0x00455b30.label: VirtualKeyToCharTranslate
0x00455b30.summary: Translates a Windows virtual-key code to a character using ToAsciiEx/MapVirtualKeyExA. Initializes keyboard layout on first call, maps a special key (32825→57), returns translated result via sub_455580.

0x00455bf0.name: HWInput_Enter
0x00455bf0.label: HWInput_Enter
0x00455bf0.summary: Called on entering the HWInput game state. Logs entry, hides cursor, registers input actions, and optionally acquires dual-source input device when render flag 0x7D13A0 equals 1.

0x00455c60.name: HWInput_Setup
0x00455c60.label: HWInput_Setup
0x00455c60.summary: Sets up DirectInput8 device and initializes up to four sub-devices (keyboard, mouse, force-feedback) via DirectXDeviceInitialization and CollisionObjectDestructor. Logs entry unless session type is 5 (server).

0x00455d50.name: HWInput_Init
0x00455d50.label: HWInput_Init
0x00455d50.summary: Initializes HWInput state: logs entry (unless server session), calls audio scene update and global state initialization, then configures camera viewport.

0x00455da0.name: HWInput_Restart
0x00455da0.label: HWInput_Restart
0x00455da0.summary: Restarts HWInput state: sets up frustum viewport, initializes BVH tree node array, optionally reinitializes audio subsystem if audio quality is enabled, then scans device array at +0x1F98 for active entries to set active flag at +0x2428.

0x00455e70.name: HWInput_Post
0x00455e70.label: HWInput_Post
0x00455e70.summary: Tears down HWInput post-frame: fills collision data, destructs array and collision objects, cleans up collision culling, and releases the DirectInput device interface.

0x00455f00.name: HWInput_Exit
0x00455f00.label: HWInput_Exit
0x00455f00.summary: Exits HWInput state: destructs collision objects, cleans up cursor resource and collision culling, releases the DirectInput device, and optionally unloads input module module when render flag indicates.

0x00455f90.name: AngleWrap
0x00455f90.label: AngleNormalizeToPi
0x00455f90.summary: Normalizes a floating-point angle to the range [-PI, PI] by adding or subtracting 2*PI.

0x00456040.name: DoubleFieldGetterAt0x300x34
0x00456040.label: FieldGetter_0x30_0x34
0x00456040.summary: Copies struct fields at offsets 0x30 and 0x34 to output pointers if non-null.

0x00456060.name: DualFieldGetter
0x00456060.label: DualFieldGetter
0x00456060.summary: Reads two DWORD fields at offsets 0x38 and 0x3C from a struct and writes them to caller-supplied output pointers if non-null. Simple accessor / getter function.

0x00456080.name: ShortComputation_6080
0x00456080.label: FieldGetter_0x40_0x44
0x00456080.summary: Copies struct fields at offsets 0x40 and 0x44 to output pointers if non-null.

0x004560a0.name: DualFieldGetter_60a0
0x004560a0.label: FieldGetter_0x4C_0x50
0x004560a0.summary: Copies struct fields at offsets 0x4C and 0x50 to output pointers if non-null.

0x004560c0.name: RectViewportDimensionGetter
0x004560c0.label: FieldGetter_0x54_0x58
0x004560c0.summary: Copies struct fields at offsets 0x54 and 0x58 to output pointers if non-null.

0x004560e0.name: MultiFieldGetter
0x004560e0.label: FieldGetter_0x64_0x68_0x6C
0x004560e0.summary: Copies struct fields at offsets 0x64, 0x68, and 0x6C to three output pointers if non-null.

0x00456130.name: VectorCopy
0x00456130.label: Vector3Copy_0x18
0x00456130.summary: Copies three consecutive DWORDs from source to struct fields at offsets 0x18, 0x1C, 0x20 (elements [6], [7], [8]).

0x00456150.name: StructFieldCopy
0x00456150.label: Vector3Copy_0x24
0x00456150.summary: Copies three consecutive DWORDs from source to struct fields at offsets 0x24, 0x28, 0x2C (elements [9], [10], [11]).

0x00456170.name: F_3DSoundEmitter
0x00456170.label: F_3DSoundEmitter_Constructor
0x00456170.summary: Constructor/initializer for a 3D sound emitter object — sets the vtable, copies a default application directory path string, and initializes all spatial parameters (cone angles, distances, volumes, flags) to their default values.

0x00456280.name: TripleFieldSetter_6280
0x00456280.label: TripleFieldSetter_0x0_0x4_0x8
0x00456280.summary: Sets three consecutive DWORD fields at offsets 0x0, 0x4, and 0x8 from three input parameters.

0x004562a0.name: ShortComputation_62a0
0x004562a0.label: Destructor_VTableFree
0x004562a0.summary: Destructor: sets vtable pointer and frees a heap-allocated buffer at offset 0x4 if non-null.

0x004562f0.name: sub_4562F0
0x004562f0.label: CameraViewConfigParser
0x004562f0.summary: Parses camera view configuration data (clip planes, LOD bias, center, size, color, flags, radius, orientation/position offsets) from a config file section, storing float and integer values into the camera object. Applies defaults when no config sections exist.

0x00456670.name: sub_456670
0x00456670.label: ShaderParamsFormatToBuffer
0x00456670.summary: Reads multiple camera/shader struct fields via getter functions and writes them as formatted key-value strings into an output buffer using BufferWriteWithStringLengthCheck. Outputs a serialized shader parameter block.

0x004569b0.name: SteeringInputSmoothingWithSaturation
0x004569b0.label: SteeringInputSmoothAccumulate
0x004569b0.summary: Accumulates steering input with direction sign and multiplier (0.5 or 2.0) into two float state fields at offsets 0xA0 and 0xBC, with InterruptDispatch clamping after each update.

0x00456f60.name: sub_456F60
0x00456f60.label: ByteFlagSetter_0x7C
0x00456f60.summary: Sets byte at offset 0x7C to 1. Minimal flag-setter function.

0x00456f70.name: CollisionCoefficientApplication
0x00456f70.label: CollisionForceAccumulate
0x00456f70.summary: Computes collision force/response by applying a direction-signed coefficient (0.4 or 6.0) multiplied by input acceleration, added to an accumulator at this[43], then clamped via ClampedFloatSetter.

0x00456fb0.name: ClampedFloatSetter
0x00456fb0.label: FloatClampedSetter_0xAC
0x00456fb0.summary: Writes a float value to offset 0xAC, clamped between bounds at offsets 0x80 (min) and 0x84 (max).

0x00457000.name: sub_457000
0x00457000.label: StructDeepCopyFromSource
0x00457000.summary: Deep-copies a source struct into the destination `this` — copies a string via safe pointer dereference, two 3D vectors, and a sequence of float/dword/bool fields using multiple getter accessor helpers, then appends a tail of raw dword values.

0x004571e0.name: F_3DTransformObjectInit
0x004571e0.label: 3D transform object constructor/initializer
0x004571e0.summary: Constructor for a 3D transform/track object that sets up vtable pointer, copies a base directory path, and initializes ~40 fields to default values: FOV angles (60°/45°), zoom/speed scalars (1.0, 0.5), clip distances (500.0), and other transform parameters. Part of the 3D scene/camera object system.

0x004572b0.name: sub_4572B0
0x004572b0.label: StaticCameraConfigParser
0x004572b0.summary: Parses a static camera scene configuration file — reads position, orientation, LOD, clipping, color, and activation parameters from a key-value config and writes them into a camera descriptor struct. Part of the camera/scene loading subsystem.

0x00457670.name: sub_457670
0x00457670.label: static camera shader config string builder
0x00457670.summary: Reads camera/viewport fields from the `this` object, then writes a formatted static-camera shader configuration string to a buffer (`a2`) using format specifiers for position, orientation, FOV, clear color, clip planes, LOD, and activation parameters.

0x004579c0.name: EmptyStub
0x004579c0.label: VectorAddSquaredLength3D
0x004579c0.summary: Computes squared Euclidean distance between two 3D vectors (element-wise sum of this[31..33] and a2[0..2], then sum of squares).

0x00457a00.name: CollisionResponseWithRandomPerturbation
0x00457a00.label: CollisionResponseRandomPerturbation
0x00457a00.summary: Generates a random-perturbation collision response vector: reads current position (x,y,z) from offsets 0x90,0x94,0x98, applies random sign flips via UtilityFunction_6010, scales by input parameters, and writes perturbed result back via VectorCopy.

0x00457b00.name: StateActivatedPositionSaveRestore
0x00457b00.label: SaveOrRestorePositionByActivationState
0x00457b00.summary: Saves or restores a 3-DWORD position vector based on activation flag at offset 0x9C. When a2=1 and flag is clear, copies current position (0x18/0x1C/0x20) to saved slot (0x90/0x94/0x98) and sets flag to 1. When a2=0 and flag is set, restores saved position back to base offsets (0x00/0x04/0x08) via VectorCopy and clears flag.

0x00457b60.name: F_2DTransformStructCopy
0x00457b60.label: 2D Transform / Viewport Struct Copy
0x00457b60.summary: Copies a source 2D transform/viewport structure (position, scale, rotation, clip rectangle, string data) into a destination struct field-by-field using multiple getter subroutines. Handles null-safe string copy with buffer reallocation.

0x00457d00.name: CubicSplineInterpolation
0x00457d00.label: CatmullRomSplineInterpolate
0x00457d00.summary: Evaluates Catmull-Rom cubic spline at parameter `a2` over a keyframe array (28-byte stride: 3 position components + 4 tangent/control fields + time). Finds segment containing `a2`, normalizes position, computes 4 basis functions, and writes interpolated X/Y/Z plus time into output slots at offsets 0xC-0x18.

0x00457ee0.name: sub_457EE0
0x00457ee0.label: KeyframeArcLengthPrecompute
0x00457ee0.summary: Pre-computes cumulative arc length for each keyframe in a 3D position array. Sets first keyframe's accumulated time to 0, then for each subsequent keyframe computes 3D Euclidean distance from previous and accumulates. Stores total path length into this[2].

0x00457f90.name: sub_457F90
0x00457f90.label: KeyframeArrayAllocInit
0x00457f90.summary: Allocates and initializes a keyframe array from input 3D position data. Validates inputs (non-null array, count >= 4), allocates heap memory for a3 keyframes (28-byte stride each) plus 4-byte count header, copies 3-DWORD position triples into each keyframe element, then calls KeyframeArcLengthPrecompute to fill accumulated time fields. Returns 0 on success, 1 on invalid input.

0x00458050.name: sub_458050
0x00458050.label: TrackControlPointLoader
0x00458050.summary: Parses control point data from structured file stream. Iterates through records using dispatch/read loop, extracts "ControlPoint" entries (3 coordinate DWORDS each) into local buffer up to max 20 points. With 4+ points collected, calls KeyframeArrayAllocInit to build keyframe array. Returns 0 on success, 1 on parse failure or insufficient points.

0x00458190.name: sub_458190
0x00458190.label: MovementPathSerialize
0x00458190.summary: Serializes keyframe array (movement path) data to output text buffer using format strings. Validates keyframe array exists with >=4 entries, writes header strings, then writes one control point format entry per keyframe, followed by closing string. Returns 0 on success, 1 if data invalid.

0x004582c0.name: GuardedFunctionWithFlagSet
0x004582c0.label: GuardedSplineEvaluate
0x004582c0.summary: Wraps CubicSplineInterpolation with null-pointer guard and active flag. If keyframe array pointer (this[0]) is NULL, returns 0 immediately without side effects. Otherwise sets flag at offset 0x1C to 1, delegates to CubicSplineInterpolation(this, a2), and returns the interpolation result.

0x004582e0.name: BufferAllocCopy
0x004582e0.label: KeyframeArrayDeepCopy
0x004582e0.summary: Allocates new keyframe array and deep-copies all 7 fields (28 bytes) per element from source format accessed via StridedArrayElementPointer. Validates source count >= 4, allocates heap memory, copies each keyframe's data, then recomputes cumulative arc lengths via KeyframeArcLengthPrecompute. Returns pointer to `this`.

0x004583b0.name: F_3DTransformObjectInit_83b0
0x004583b0.label: Camera 3D Node Initialization
0x004583b0.summary: Initializes a 3D camera/transform node object — calls base transform init, zeroes sub-struct, sets vtable, copies a resource path string, and fills default camera parameters (FOV, near/far clip, scale, mode).

0x004584a0.name: VTableInitCallChain
0x004584a0.label: CameraNodeVTableInit
0x004584a0.summary: Initializes vtable pointer (this[0]) to CameraNode vtable (off_59F00C), then calls resource cleanup/zero-init function and a short computation. Returns computation result.

0x004584c0.name: CollisionResponseFilter
0x004584c0.label: AngularCollisionResponseFilter
0x004584c0.summary: Filters angular collision response by comparing total angular difference against a scaled threshold. Wraps and normalizes input Euler angles, sums absolute differences, and if total exceeds threshold * a5, performs quaternion slerp between source and target orientations. Otherwise passes source through unchanged.

0x004585e0.name: sub_4585E0
0x004585e0.label: Renderable Object / Environment Effect Configuration Parser
0x004585e0.summary: Parses a named configuration block for a renderable scene object or environmental effect: reads position, orientation, color, clip-planes, LOD/mipmap bias, size, center, flags, activation-zone (location + radius), tracking/movement rates, and movement path from a tokenised data source, then copies all values into the target struct with defaults applied when parsing is skipped.

0x00458a60.name: sub_458A60
0x00458a60.summary: Serializes tracking camera / shader configuration parameters into a formatted string buffer. Reads struct fields (position, orientation, FOV, clear color, clip planes, LOD, flags, activation zones, tracking rates) and writes them as key-value shader command strings to the output buffer.

0x00458df0.name: sub_458DF0
0x00458df0.label: PhysicsVelocityUpdateWithCollisionResponse
0x00458df0.summary: Processes velocity update and collision response for a physics object. Adds input velocity delta to current position, optionally triggers suspension force calculation (based on flag at 0xB0), computes normalized direction vector and yaw angle, optionally applies angular collision response filter (when threshold at 0xA4 > 0), and writes final velocity/orientation back. Handles state reset flag at 0xA0.

0x00459010.name: ComponentTransformInitializer
0x00459010.label: TransformComponentInit
0x00459010.summary: Initializes a transform/physics component to default state. Zeros position/transform fields via StructFieldCopy, sets counter/state fields (0xBC=0, 0xCC=0), sets scale factor (0xAC=1.0f), copies initial position to saved slot at 0x90 via VectorCopy, and sets active flag (0xA0=1).

0x00459070.name: SuspensionWheelForceCalculation
0x00459070.label: SuspensionWheelForceCalculation
0x00459070.summary: Computes suspension forces for wheel contact using spline-based force curve lookup. On first initialization (flag at 0xCC==0 with bit 1 of 0x74 set), determines suspension direction by evaluating two spline positions at different parameters and sets direction sign (0xAC) to ±1.0f. Normal path computes force from velocity magnitude, direction sign, time delta, and bias, evaluates suspension spline via GuardedFunctionWithFlagSet, then derives velocity from position change over time delta.

0x00459330.name: sub_459330
0x00459330.label: CameraViewConfigCopy
0x00459330.summary: Copies camera/viewport configuration from a source definition struct into the destination camera object, including view position, target, FOV parameters, clipping planes, and optional buffer data.

0x00459830.name: FloatDoubleCoordinateTransform
0x00459830.label: FloatToDoubleCoordTransform
0x00459830.summary: Converts float-precision position (offsets 4,8,12) and rotation (offsets 16,20,24) to double-precision. Stores position as 3 doubles at offset 0xD8, computes 3x3 rotation tensor matrix stored at offset 0x138, and saves position backup at offset 0xC0. If trigger flag at 0xD0 is set, calls external processing and clears buffer before conversion.

0x00459950.name: CollisionInvMassStore
0x00459950.label: CollisionInvMassStore
0x00459950.summary: Stores a mass value and its reciprocal (1/mass) into struct fields at offsets 0x180 and 0x188, then performs a reciprocal-division copy on a separate parameter. Part of collision/body initialization system.

0x00459990.name: F_6FieldBulkSetter
0x00459990.label: SixFieldBulkSetter
0x00459990.summary: Bulk-setter that writes six DWORD parameters (a2-a7) into six contiguous fields of a struct at offsets 0x28 through 0x3C (indices 10-15). Used for initializing grouped float/int configuration values.

0x004599c0.name: CollisionContactImpulse
0x004599c0.label: CollisionContactImpulse
0x004599c0.summary: Computes collision contact impulse by scaling a direction vector by a magnitude factor, computing a delta from contact body state, and performing cross-product rotation accumulation. Sets contact impulse magnitude at 0x20 and offset magnitude at 0x24. Part of collision response system.

0x00459a40.name: PhysicsStateIntegration
0x00459a40.label: PhysicsStateIntegration
0x00459a40.summary: Integrates body-state velocity (scaled by a factor) into position/displacement accumulator (three doubles at offsets 0xD8-0xE8). Outputs integrated displacement as floats and forwards to ThreeFieldSetterWithSubCall. Part of physics integration system.

0x00459ae0.name: VehiclePhysicsVelocityAngularVelocityIntegrator
0x00459ae0.label: Vehicle Physics Two-Pass Integrator
0x00459ae0.summary: Per-frame vehicle physics integration: computes drag forces from velocity, applies gravity and damping, rotates acceleration into local frame, handles network contact forces from other vehicles (when count > 1), integrates position/velocity via half-step then full-step, and reads remote vehicle state into local transform.

0x0045a8e0.name: sub_45A8E0
0x0045a8e0.label: VehicleSpeedLimiterAndPhysicsIntegrator
0x0045a8e0.summary: Clamps an input speed value against current limits, conditionally runs vehicle physics integration (velocity/angular velocity), computes attitude angles via atan2, and outputs the vehicle's 3D position. Part of the vehicle physics/dynamics system.

0x0045ae00.name: VehicleOrientationFromAngularVelocityIntegration
0x0045ae00.label: VehicleOrientationFromAngularVelocityIntegration
0x0045ae00.summary: Integrates angular velocity over time delta to update vehicle orientation. Reads angular velocity components, computes incremental rotation, extracts Euler angles from rotation matrix, and forwards result for body-state update. Part of vehicle physics integration system.

0x0045af50.name: CameraViewSetupFromVehiclePosition
0x0045af50.label: CameraFrustumSetupFromVehicle
0x0045af50.summary: Computes camera view frustum dimensions from vehicle bounding box. Calculates half-width and half-height from bounding box extents plus distance ratio offset, stores frustum size at offsets 0x318/0x320, computes diagonal distance at 0xCC, initializes 9 view-frustum structures with zeroed positions, then allocates vertex/particle render buffer.

0x0045b050.name: VehicleOrientationMatrixConstruction
0x0045b050.label: Vehicle Orientation Matrix & Network Packet Writer
0x0045b050.summary: Constructs a 4x4 vehicle orientation matrix from forward/up/right direction vectors (negated velocity components at offsets 264-280), then iterates 8 sub-blocks writing 12-byte rows via NetworkPacketDataWriter for network transmission.

0x0045b200.name: GameMainEntry
0x0045b200.label: WinMainEntry
0x0045b200.summary: Main game entry point (WinMain equivalent). Initializes session globals (state, session flags, instance handle), parses command line and config, sets up networking, then runs main game lifecycle: enters session setup → initialization → restart/render loop with post-processing cleanup → exit.

0x0045b360.name: ShortComputation_b360
0x0045b360.label: RenderUIObjectInit
0x0045b360.summary: Initializes a 3D UI/render object with 8 viewport sub-structures. Sets vtable to RenderUIObject table (off_59F080), initializes sub-object at offset 4, configures 8 viewport blocks (92 bytes each) with default values (-1, -1.0f, 3), calls per-index field resetter for each viewport, and clears remaining state fields (0x31C, 0x320, 0x324, 0x328).

0x0045b400.name: DestructorWithResourceCleanup
0x0045b400.label: RenderUIObjectDestructor
0x0045b400.summary: Destructor for RenderUIObject. Sets vtable to RenderUIObject table (off_59F080), cleans up sub-object at offset 4, frees heap allocation at offset 0x2C if non-null, then performs resource cleanup. Returns cleanup result.

0x0045b430.name: PerIndexStructFieldResetter
0x0045b430.label: PerIndexCircularBufferEntryResetter
0x0045b430.summary: Resets a specific entry (by index a2) in an 8-entry circular buffer: clears byte flag, sets sentinel values (-1, -1.0f, state=3). If the reset index matches the current write cursor (this[0x31C]), advances cursor modulo 8. Part of collision/event log system.

0x0045b500.name: RotatingIndexSearchWithThreshold
0x0045b500.label: RotatingIndexSearchWithThreshold
0x0045b500.summary: Searches an 8-entry circular buffer for an available slot: first tries rotating scan for entry with lifetime/damage field <= 0, then falls back to finding the entry with minimum comparison value. Returns -1 if the best candidate's threshold exceeds caller's limit a2. Part of event/damage buffer management.

0x0045b580.name: FindActivePhysicsChannelByIndex
0x0045b580.label: FindNthActivePhysicsChannel
0x0045b580.summary: Scans up to 8 physics channels (92-byte stride each) starting at offset 0x90, returns flat index (0-7) of the a2-th channel whose first float field is > 0.0 (active). Returns 0 if fewer than a2+1 active channels exist.

0x0045b5c0.name: sub_45B5C0
0x0045b5c0.label: MaxPhysicsChannelValueCompute
0x0045b5c0.summary: Computes maximum normalized coordinate value across active physics channels. Gets channel count via FloatArrayThresholdSearch, iterates active channels, computes normalized coordinate for each via NormalizedCoordinateCalculator, and returns highest value found.

0x0045b660.name: UICursorSelectionRectangleRenderWithInterpolatio
0x0045b660.label: SelectionRectangleRenderWithInterpolation
0x0045b660.summary: Renders UI cursor selection rectangle with smooth interpolation. Computes target size from active physics channel count and max coordinate, interpolates current rectangle bounds toward targets with 0.4 blend factor (clamped at 0.001 threshold), then renders 4 rectangle edges via DirectX device. Resets interpolation state when inactive.

0x0045b840.name: CollisionDamageDecayProcessor
0x0045b840.label: CollisionDamageDecayProcessor
0x0045b840.summary: Processes collision damage decay across physics channels. Iterates through up to 4 active damage channels per frame (rotated start index), applies cooling rate to each damage value, renders damage text at screen position, resets expired channels via PerIndexStructFieldResetter, and sets active damage flag. Calls UI selection rectangle render each frame.

0x0045b950.name: sub_45B950
0x0045b950.label: AudioCollisionSettingHelper
0x0045b950.summary: Configures audio collision parameters. Calls UtilityFunction_cfb0 with audio collision float and render parameters, sets two fields to value 1.25f (1060320051), returns UtilityFunction_cfb0 result.

0x0045bb90.name: ObjectAllocator
0x0045bb90.label: UIRenderObjectAllocator
0x0045bb90.summary: Allocates 812-byte UI render object from heap. On success, calls ShortComputation_bb40 to initialize allocated block and stores pointer in this[0]. On allocation failure, stores 0 in this[0]. Returns this.

0x0045bbe0.name: DoubleDelegateCall_bbe0
0x0045bbe0.label: UIRenderObjectPostInit
0x0045bbe0.summary: Post-initialization for UI render object. Calls audio collision helper, clears field at offset 0x31C in the object, then resets 8 per-index sub-structures. Returns result of last PerIndexStructFieldResetter call.

0x0045bd10.name: TextLineWrappingAndRendering
0x0045bd10.label: TextLineWrappingAndRendering
0x0045bd10.summary: Renders text with word-wrap: splits lines longer than 79 characters at space boundaries (>40 chars), renders each wrapped segment, then renders remaining text. Maps color ID if special flag (0x1020124 = 16909060) is passed. Part of UI/text rendering system.

0x0045bdf0.name: ShortComputation_bdf0
0x0045bdf0.label: CircularBufferFullReset
0x0045bdf0.summary: Resets the entire 8-entry circular buffer: initializes write cursor (obj[0x31C]) to 0, then resets all eight entries via PerIndexStructFieldResetter. Called for buffer initialization or full flush.

0x0045be00.name: CollisionPenaltyScaler
0x0045be00.label: PenaltyScaler
0x0045be00.summary: Clamps collision penetration depth to a minimum threshold from float array, then scales by 0.035f. Part of collision response system.

0x0045bea0.name: AVIStreamCleanup
0x0045bea0.label: AVIStreamCleanup
0x0045bea0.summary: Releases AVI file and stream handles, nullifies pointers, then delegates to AVIPlayerCleanup. Part of video playback teardown.

0x0045bed6.name: AVIPlayerCleanup
0x0045bed6.label: AVIPlayerCleanup
0x0045bed6.summary: Releases two resource pointers if not already set to sentinel, zeroes out the playback struct, then exits AVI file system. Final step of video playback teardown.

0x0045bf90.name: CollisionMutexInitialization
0x0045bf90.label: CollisionMutexInit
0x0045bf90.summary: Initializes global collision mutex: zeroes handle/flag, sets lock state to unlocked, creates unnamed mutex via CreateMutexA, and sets init flag on success. Part of collision system startup.

0x0045c0c0.name: sub_45C0C0
0x0045c0c0.label: FileScannerPopulate
0x0045c0c0.summary: Iterates directory entries, filters by type-dependent check function, appends matching results as linked list nodes to caller's struct. Part of file/directory enumeration system.

0x0045c240.name: FileScanner
0x0045c240.label: FileScanner
0x0045c240.summary: Clears previous scan results, frees linked list of file entries, then re-scans directory for .gdb, .hdv, and terrain.ini files using type-specific check functions. Initializes random seed bytes. Part of resource file enumeration for scene loading.

0x0045c320.name: SceneFileMatchByName
0x0045c320.label: SceneFileMatchByName
0x0045c320.summary: Searches linked list of file entries for a match against the filename portion of a path. Returns associated data value and updates iterator position. Part of terrain/scene file resolution.

0x0045c3c0.name: TwoByteFieldSetter
0x0045c3c0.label: TwoByteFieldSetter
0x0045c3c0.summary: Sets two consecutive byte fields on a struct from parameters and returns the first value. Part of particle/sound configuration initialization.

0x0045c3d0.name: ParserDispatchWrapper
0x0045c3d0.label: ParserDispatchWrapper
0x0045c3d0.summary: Dispatches to UtilityFunction_8a60 using byte at offset 1 as selector. Returns result or zeroes output on failure. Part of particle/sound parameter parsing.

0x0045c400.name: sub_45C400
0x0045c400.label: HdvVehicleFileParserWrapper
0x0045c400.summary: Parses an HDV vehicle file, accumulates parameter values into output via repeated UtilityFunction_8a60 calls, adds tire model data contribution, cleans up allocations. Returns success flag. Part of vehicle file loading system.

0x0045c650.name: DataFileCheckSizeQuery
0x0045c650.label: DataFileCheckSizeQuery
0x0045c650.summary: Strips extension from file path, looks up matching scene in scene array by name, and accumulates scene file size into output. Part of data file validation for scene loading.

0x0045c7e0.name: CollisionContactBufferTimestepUpdate
0x0045c7e0.label: ContactBufferTimestepUpdate
0x0045c7e0.summary: Accumulates timestep into contact time accumulator. On overflow, normalizes contact impulse values and resets accumulators. Updates 104 contact pair timers. Part of collision response system.

0x0045c8f0.name: CollisionContactSolver
0x0045c8f0.label: ContactSolver
0x0045c8f0.summary: Processes a single collision contact: accumulates time, records impact when threshold exceeded, clamps contact time, and updates global contact counters. Part of collision response pipeline.

0x0045ca20.name: TerrainSurfaceRoughnessHeightSampling
0x0045ca20.label: TerrainSurfaceRoughnessHeightSampling
0x0045ca20.summary: Samples terrain surface roughness/height at a given index: validates surface type, checks cached height, otherwise decodes packed height data, computes weighted average over sample window, caches result, and computes penetration compensation for surface type 16. Part of terrain/collision system.

0x0045cd70.name: sub_45CD70
0x0045cd70.label: Network auth decode and initialize
0x0045cd70.summary: Decodes a 6-byte XOR key from obfuscated source (byte_59F0C4 ^ 0x3E) into scratch globals dword_8D4680-8C, then calls sub_561BF0 with the decoded key, config pointer (off_5C5B68), and four callback function pointers. Sets initialized flag at this[0] on success. Only executes once.

0x0045cde0.name: DebugFloatFormatString
0x0045cde0.label: Format debug float value to string
0x0045cde0.summary: Formats hardcoded float value 1.026 as "%1.3f" into a local buffer via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, then processes the output buffer through ShortComputation_ce30 (backslash-to-underscore replacement) before and after formatting.

0x0045cf30.name: ShortComputation_cf30
0x0045cf30.label: Replace backslash with underscore in string
0x0045cf30.summary: Iterates through a null-terminated string, replacing every backslash character (0x5C = 92) with underscore (0x5F = 95) in-place. Returns the last character processed (or 0 for empty string).

0x0045cf50.name: SceneTextureApply
0x0045cf50.label: Format network session display string
0x0045cf50.summary: Builds formatted network session status display string: formats hostname, host port, map name, player count, max players, and game mode (open/closed) into output buffer using ShortComputation_ce30 key-value pairs. Checks network entrant validity before formatting.

0x0045d0d0.name: BooleanParameterFormatDispatch
0x0045d0d0.label: Format password boolean parameter
0x0045d0d0.summary: Checks whether a password is configured by reading string length via ConstantOffsetAccessor(0). Formats boolean result (1 if password length > 0, 0 if empty) as "%d" and writes "password" key-value pair into output buffer via ShortComputation_ce30.

0x0045d130.name: NetworkScorePingDisplay
0x0045d130.label: Format player score and ping display
0x0045d130.summary: Iterates over player count from StructFieldReadAt0x3e14, formats per-player key-value pairs (player_%d, score_%d, ping_%d) into output buffer via ShortComputation_ce30. Reads score and ping data via DataTableRowAccessor for each player row.

0x0045d260.name: NetworkReplayBufferInit
0x0045d260.label: NetworkReplayBufferInit
0x0045d260.summary: Initializes replay/network buffer structure: stores session port, clears flag byte, XOR-decodes obfuscation key data into global buffers, then allocates a memory object for network encoding.

0x0045d2d0.name: sub_45D2D0
0x0045d2d0.label: GameListStateUpdateHandler
0x0045d2d0.summary: Handles game-list state machine for network session browser. Sets scene refresh flag, updates display message based on current state (done/getting/searching/querying), and calls path registry wrapper. Called as MemoryObjectAllocator callback.

0x0045d490.name: GlobalFlagBasedStateSetter
0x0045d490.label: GlobalFlagBasedStateSetter
0x0045d490.summary: Checks game module state; if valid, updates object state by calling sub_45CD70 then sets byte flag at this+1 from global boolean byte_7D0F94.

0x0045d4e0.name: StringLengthCheckDispatch
0x0045d4e0.label: ByteFlagNetworkDispatch
0x0045d4e0.summary: Checks two byte flags on object; based on their values, conditionally calls inactivity timeout handler then dispatches network packet receive, or dispatches directly.

0x0045d530.name: AudioChannelInit
0x0045d530.label: AudioChannelConstructor
0x0045d530.summary: One-time constructor for an AudioChannel object (struct size ~112KB): initializes vtable, zeroes sub-structs (104×140-byte and 104×872-byte arrays), sets default volume/gain/frequency parameters, and stores the owner handle from parameter a2.

0x0045d730.name: sub_45D730
0x0045d730.label: StructTeardownCleanup
0x0045d730.summary: Tears down a large game session struct: destroys three linked lists, clears two arrays of sub-objects, resets vtable pointer, frees two dynamic buffers, and returns cleanup result. Acts as a destructor/cleanup routine.

0x0045d890.name: NetCommSessionMessageDispatcher
0x0045d890.label: NetSessionMessageDispatchSwitch
0x0045d890.summary: Central network session message dispatcher: decodes message type from header bits, then dispatches to sub-handlers for session transitions, player boot/join, terrain validation, track changes, and rendering state updates.

0x0045e570.name: UtilityFunction_e570
0x0045e570.label: PhysicsYGuardAnimationUpdate
0x0045e570.summary: Checks physics Y flag byte; if zero, triggers animation timing update with parameter set. Returns the flag value.

0x0045e5b0.name: ArraySearchFor1Sentinel
0x0045e5b0.label: ArraySentinelSearch
0x0045e5b0.summary: Searches a DWORD array starting at this+0x1D4 for the first element equal to -1 (sentinel). Returns index of match, or -1 if not found within 104 elements.

0x0045e620.name: PhysicsIntegrationStep_e620
0x0045e620.label: PhysicsIntegrationStep
0x0045e620.summary: Performs per-axle physics integration step: computes wheel velocity deltas from vehicle state, samples terrain roughness/height, integrates suspension velocity and displacement with semi-implicit Euler, applies velocity clamping, and stores updated wheel state. Part of vehicle physics simulation.

0x0045eb00.name: Vector3ScalarMultiply
0x0045eb00.label: Vector3ScalarMultiply
0x0045eb00.summary: Multiplies a 3-component vector by a scalar: computes this * a3 for each of three float components and stores result in output vector a2. Simple 3D vector scale operation.

0x0045eb50.name: NodeIDToPlayerNameLookup
0x0045eb50.label: NodeIDToPlayerNameLookup
0x0045eb50.summary: Looks up a player name string by node ID in a session player array. Returns pointer to name entry if found, or empty name string on failure with optional debug log.

0x0045ebd0.name: LinkedListPurgeByThreshold
0x0045ebd0.label: LinkedListPurgeByThreshold
0x0045ebd0.summary: Purges excess entries from a linked list when count exceeds 64. Walks from head, unlinks and frees excess nodes (including data if node flag is set). Keeps list size at or below threshold.

0x0045ecd0.name: sub_45ECD0
0x0045ecd0.label: AutoChatSpeechDataLoader
0x0045ecd0.summary: Loads auto-chat speech audio data from an audio stream file. Scans for labeled sections (autochat01 through autochat10), loads each matching section's name string, and builds a linked list of up to 10 autochat entries stored on the manager object.

0x0045f030.name: MouseInputHandler
0x0045f030.label: MouseInputTooltipRenderer
0x0045f030.summary: Processes mouse button inputs when hover timer exceeds threshold and HUD is enabled. Maps action codes to button indices, traverses button state list, formats and renders UI text labels, then resets hover timer.

0x0045f2a0.name: CollisionInvDistanceStore
0x0045f2a0.label: CollisionInvDistanceStore
0x0045f2a0.summary: Stores the inverse of a float parameter (1.0 / a2) into struct field at this+4. Used for collision inverse distance calculation.

0x0045f2b0.name: SessionUIElementRenderer
0x0045f2b0.label: NetworkUIElementEncodeSend
0x0045f2b0.summary: Encodes a UI element from session data (including variable-length payload for multiplayer), attaches it to a COM object, and dispatches it over the network. Called by UI update for session element rendering.

0x0045f390.name: RunCollisionDetectionLoop
0x0045f390.label: CollisionDetectionTimedLoop
0x0045f390.summary: Runs timed collision detection loop with animation timing and physics processing. Guarded by session phase check; loops until animation completes or 60-second timeout, then processes collision results.

0x0045f4a0.name: InputCommandDispatchToEntities
0x0045f4a0.label: InputCommandDispatchToEntities
0x0045f4a0.summary: Dispatches input commands from ring buffer to session entities. Processes each command through entity-specific logic: direct dispatch for global state handlers, or per-entity filtering with flag checks and texture creation. Final pass handles entity visibility grid updates.

0x0045f710.name: TeamRadioNetworkMessageProcessing
0x0045f710.label: TeamRadioMessageProcessor
0x0045f710.summary: Processes team radio network messages during active session phases (1-2). Handles resource cleanup, collision solving, message dispatching, and per-entity texture rendering. Ends with optional callback dispatch.

0x0045f950.name: SessionSynchronizer
0x0045f950.label: SessionSyncAndTimerUpdate
0x0045f950.summary: Per-frame session synchronization and timing update: in terrain-sampling mode (states 1/2) accumulates delta time and triggers per-player terrain-height samples; otherwise runs a countdown timer for network session-type polling, detects session changes, and displays "Synchronizing Game" with millisecond drift when the client clock diverges beyond 100 ms from the server.

0x0045fc50.name: NetCommPlayerSlotSync
0x0045fc50.label: Network Player Slot Synchronization
0x0045fc50.summary: Synchronizes multiplayer player slots: detects joining/leaving players, loads vehicle resources (VehGen scene, physics, cockpit HUD), updates the active vehicle pointer array, displays join/leave messages, and plays sound effects.

0x00460380.name: ClientGridDisplayTimer
0x00460380.label: ClientGridDisplayTimer
0x00460380.summary: Timer-driven client grid overlay controller. Decrements a 7.5-second timer each call; on expiry, evaluates scene state and toggles the grid display flag. Resets timer after evaluation.

0x00460470.name: SendServerOKRequest
0x00460470.label: SendServerOKRequest
0x00460470.summary: Sends server ready/OK signal based on session phase. During active phases (1-2), marks self as ready via NetComm. Otherwise encodes progress event and creates texture for OK indication.

0x00460520.name: NetComm_SetSelfAsReady
0x00460520.label: NetComm_SetSelfAsReady
0x00460520.summary: Sets network communication self as ready state. Handles slot assignment via array search, manages bitfield flags, and logs debug messages. Called during session phase transitions.

0x00460710.name: ConditionalRenderStateUpdate
0x00460710.label: ConditionalRenderStateUpdate
0x00460710.summary: Updates render state bitfield when session phase is not 1. Sets bit 4 of render state flag to 1 via state buffer initialization.

0x004607a0.name: ParticleSoundEffectSpawner
0x004607a0.label: AssetPathDataFileResolver
0x004607a0.summary: Resolves asset paths and data file sizes for particle/sound effects based on season and race index bytes. Computes hash checksums, builds season and track paths, queries data file sizes, and creates output texture.

0x00460a10.name: TerrainIniParser
0x00460a10.label: TerrainIniConfigValidator
0x00460a10.summary: Validates terrain INI configuration against scene data by checking 5 criteria: hash checksum, scene file name, terrain.ini match, season path, and full season directory. Returns true only if all 5 conditions match.

0x00460c60.name: ArrayInitWithSentinelInLoop
0x00460c60.label: ArraySentinelInitLoop
0x00460c60.summary: Initializes 104 entries of a DWORD array at this+0x3E18 with -1 sentinel value. Also reinitializes associated struct arrays via helper calls.

0x00460cb0.name: ClearPlayerSlots
0x00460cb0.label: ClearPlayerSlots
0x00460cb0.summary: Resets player slot arrays to default state: clears count to 0, initializes node ID and DWORD arrays with -1 sentinel, zeroes struct fields. Optionally validates slot entries against node ID array and logs debug for stale entries.

0x00460dd0.name: CollisionContactIteration
0x00460dd0.label: CollisionContactAIHandler
0x00460dd0.summary: Iterates through vehicles to resolve collision contact response. Checks vehicle AI state and penetration ratio, then sets AI control flag and driver visibility based on collision severity.

0x00460e90.name: ServerOpenTrackSignal
0x00460e90.label: ServerOpenTrackSignal
0x00460e90.summary: Sends server open-track signal with progress event and COM object dispatch. Optionally appends track info node to linked list when photo/free camera mode is active; otherwise frees the temporary allocation.

0x00461020.name: ServerCloseTrackSignal
0x00461020.label: TrackCloseSignalDispatch
0x00461020.summary: Sends "closing track" network signal, clears session open flag, and appends a log entry to the debug linked list under photo/free camera mode.

0x00461190.name: ServerOpenedClosedNotification
0x00461190.label: TrackOpenCloseNotify
0x00461190.summary: Notifies when a server track is opened or closed: formats message "*** The server {opened/closed} {trackname}", appends to debug log linked list, and renders text to UI resource.

0x004612e0.name: TrackOpeningProgressTimer
0x004612e0.label: TrackOpenProgressDecay
0x004612e0.summary: Decrements track opening progress timer each frame by a clamped delta; marks track as fully open when timer reaches zero.

0x004613e0.name: ShortComputation_13e0
0x004613e0.label: CollisionBroadcastLoop
0x004613e0.summary: Iterates over driver entries broadcasting collision events to network when flag bit test passes.

0x00461440.name: ReferencesGlobalState
0x00461440.label: SessionStateAndGlobalFlagCheck
0x00461440.summary: Returns true if session phase is 1 or 2 AND a global session flag byte_7D1074 is set.

0x004614f0.name: BitfieldSetClearAt0x88
0x004614f0.label: BitfieldSetOrClearAt0x88
0x004614f0.summary: Sets or clears specific bits in a byte field at this+0x88 based on a boolean control parameter.

0x004615c0.name: UtilityFunction_15c0
0x004615c0.label: BitFlagSetOrClearAt0x6E
0x004615c0.summary: Sets or clears a bit at a bit-indexed position within byte field this+0x6E based on boolean control.

0x00461610.name: SessionConfigBuilder
0x00461610.label: session configuration builder from global game state
0x00461610.summary: Constructs a session configuration packet by reading global game state variables (track path, season, flags, player counts, network state, weather, settings) and packing them into a compact binary struct. Also calls a utility to finalize the config with session option flags.

0x00461900.name: SessionConfigWriteback
0x00461900.label: SessionConfigWriteback
0x00461900.summary: Deserializes multiplayer session configuration from a received network struct and writes all values to global game-state variables. Parses scene data, AI config, track name, then maps byte/short/bitfield fields to clamped global settings (player count, weather, tire model, penalties, pit windows, damage, fuel, etc.), applying range clamping per field.

0x00461cd0.name: SessionStateCheck
0x00461cd0.label: SessionStateCheckAndTransition
0x00461cd0.summary: Returns current session state; transitions state from 4 to 3 if delegated call indicates ready (returns 3).

0x00461d20.name: YouHaveBeenBootedHandler
0x00461d20.label: BootMessageDisplayHandler
0x00461d20.summary: Decrements a boot timer each frame; when timer expires and not already shown, renders "You have been booted" message to screen UI.

0x00461de0.name: StartNetworkUpdate
0x00461de0.label: NetworkStartInit
0x00461de0.summary: Initializes network connection based on type (internet vs LAN): calls direct display mode init, then either InitWrapper (internet) or MultiStageInitializationChain (LAN) with port range.

0x00461ed0.name: DirectoryStringProcessingWithDecode
0x00461ed0.label: NetworkDirectoryLookupAndConnect
0x00461ed0.summary: Processes a directory string, decodes it via config lookup, resolves port from config, and establishes a network connection.

0x00461f70.name: ConditionalFunctionCall
0x00461f70.label: ConditionalNetworkSubCall
0x00461f70.summary: Calls sub_563410 on the network system pointer if non-null, otherwise returns the this pointer.

0x00461f90.name: ConditionalNetworkSystemDispatch
0x00461f90.label: ConditionalNetworkDispatch
0x00461f90.summary: Queries network capability and sets flag on network system pointer if capable and non-null.

0x00462160.name: NetworkFilterSort
0x00462160.label: ServerListSortAndFilter
0x00462160.summary: Sets the sort order for server browser from input parameter (clamped to valid range), updates display sort type, and triggers refresh.

0x00462250.name: TextureCreationWrapper
0x00462250.label: TextureCreateNetworkSend
0x00462250.summary: Creates a texture/data object via COM vtable, sets/overrides its type by argument, and sends it over the network.

0x00462300.name: SingleFunctionDispatch
0x00462300.label: COMDelegateDispatch
0x00462300.summary: Delegates to SingleFunctionCallWrapper_a810 with the COM interface pointer from the struct.

0x00462310.name: SingleFunctionForward
0x00462310.label: COMShortComputationForward
0x00462310.summary: Calls ShortComputation_a820 with the COM interface pointer and returns the result as a byte.

0x00462330.name: IDLookupInArray
0x00462330.label: DriverIDArrayIndexLookup
0x00462330.summary: Queries a COM interface for a target ID, then searches a 104-entry DWORD array at this+0x3E18 for a match, returning the index or -1.

0x00462370.name: StructFieldReadAt0x3e14
0x00462370.label: DriverCountRead
0x00462370.summary: Returns the DWORD value at obj+0x3E14 (the driver/entrant count field).

0x00462380.name: sub_462380
0x00462380.label: FlaggedDriverCount
0x00462380.summary: Counts how many driver entries have flag bit 2 set in their entry structure.

0x00462460.name: DriverDataCopyByID
0x00462460.label: DriverDataLookupByID
0x00462460.summary: Searches driver entries by ID byte, copies matching entry data (0x8C bytes) and a corresponding DWORD value from a parallel array.

0x004624e0.name: TerrainHeightComparison
0x004624e0.label: TerrainHeightThresholdCheck
0x004624e0.summary: Samples terrain height at a position and returns true if the sampled height exceeds the given threshold (or a default minimum penetration limit).

0x00462550.name: DriverEntrantSetupEntry
0x00462550.label: DriverEntrantSetupHandler
0x00462550.summary: Sets up a driver entrant by creating a COM query object, copying name and config data, dispatching a virtual function call; on failure, resets session state, clears the log linked list, appends a directory path node, and triggers file scanning.

0x00462760.name: BufferSendWithLocks
0x00462760.label: VTableBufferSend
0x00462760.summary: Queries COM temporary object, calls lock via vtable offset 0xc4, copies buffer data, unlocks, and releases the temporary object.

0x00462848.name: NetworkUIUpdate
0x00462848.label: NetworkUITickUpdate
0x00462848.summary: Updates UI state counters, optionally broadcasts collision events and renders all session UI elements.

0x004628a0.name: WeatherSurfaceUpdate
0x004628a0.label: Weather Surface Update (session UI progress)
0x004628a0.summary: Updates weather surface display during session: validates ID, dispatches state, builds session config, sends buffer, encodes progress bar event, creates textures, and calls OS API for session transition flag. Returns 1 on success, 0 if ID invalid.

0x00462940.name: CollisionEventNetworkBroadcast
0x00462940.label: Collision Event Network Broadcast
0x00462940.summary: Broadcasts a collision event over network. Checks object state (1 or 2), encodes progress bar event for collision, prepares COM object via vtable dispatch, sends data via NetworkSendDispatch, and cleans up. Returns true if send succeeded, false if state invalid or send failed.

0x00462a00.name: SingleFunctionCallWrapper_2a00
0x00462a00.label: Byte Accessor via Deep Pointer Chain
0x00462a00.summary: Reads a single byte at offset 0x5D from a sub-object reached through a multi-level pointer chain (this → vtable → intermediate pointer at +0x3FB8 → deref → +0x5D). Returns the byte value.

0x00462a10.name: ChampionshipStandingsReOrdering
0x00462a10.label: Championship Standings Re-Ordering After Race
0x00462a10.summary: Re-orders championship standings after a race result. Builds linked list of driver entries with their new positions based on flag state and stored values, merge-sorts them, writes position indices back to VEH array and struct field. Frees allocated memory.

0x00462c00.name: SendJoinRequest
0x00462c00.label: Send Join Request to Multiplayer Host
0x00462c00.summary: Sends a multiplayer join request to a remote host. Reads session entry by index, formats IP:port string, optionally logs "Sending join request", resets join retry flag at +0x378, and delegates to CollisionSpatialQuery. Returns 0 if session entry not found.

0x00462ce0.name: CollisionSpatialQuery
0x00462ce0.label: Collision/Spatial Query via VTable Dispatch
0x00462ce0.summary: Dispatches a network collision check via vtable call at offset 0x6c. On success (returns 0), sets state byte to 1, timeout float to 5.0, and state enum to 4. Returns 1 on success, 0 if vtable call failed.

0x00462d30.name: EnumToEnumTranslator
0x00462d30.label: Join Error Code Translator
0x00462d30.summary: Translates join-session error enum values: passes through a delegation guard check, calls sub_57A590 to convert input, then maps result 0→0, 1→3, 2→1, 3→2, 4→3, 5→4, default→3. Returns 0 on delegation failure or unknown input.

0x00462da0.name: sub_462DA0
0x00462da0.label: Join Failure Reason String Resolver
0x00462da0.summary: Maps join failure code to localized error string. Switch on input: 1→"Incompatible Game", 2→"The Game is Full", 3→"Game Closed", 4→"Bad Password", 5→"Join Timed Out", default→"No Join Failure".

0x00462e00.name: VehicleNameAccessor
0x00462e00.label: Vehicle Name String Accessor
0x00462e00.summary: Reads vehicle name/description string pointer at this+0xBC. Returns the pointer if non-null, otherwise returns fallback default directory path string as placeholder.

0x00462e20.name: sub_462E20
0x00462e20.label: Player Position Assignment in Multiplayer Standings
0x00462e20.summary: Assigns player grid/qualifying positions in multiplayer. Matches local player (via SingleFunctionDispatch) against server nodemap entries, sets position in VEH array, logs per-slot placement. Falls back to last position if self not found in standings.

0x00462ff0.name: ClampedPhysicsScaleWithThreshold
0x00462ff0.label: Physics Scale Clamp with Speed Threshold
0x00462ff0.summary: Computes clamped physics scale factor for a vehicle: picks input or default base scale, adjusts by speed-based multiplier (if under 25mph), conditionally scales by 4x if flag bit 2 not set, clamps result to [0.0, 0.5]. Used in tire temperature simulation.

0x004630d0.name: UniqueID
0x004630d0.label: Unique Identifier Validation via VTable Query
0x004630d0.summary: Validates a unique identifier: queries sub-object via vtable, checks COM result, copies 128-byte ID into output buffer, verifies copy consumed expected size. Returns true if copy size matches 128, false otherwise. Releases sub-object via vtable on exit.

0x00463140.name: ShortComputation_3140
0x00463140.label: Dual Virtual Dispatch and State Reset
0x00463140.summary: Dispatches via DualVirtualDispatchWrapper on sub-object at +0x3FB8, then resets state at +0x3FC4 to 0. Returns dispatch wrapper result.

0x00463160.name: NetCommParseCommandLine
0x00463160.label: NetCommCommandLineParser
0x00463160.summary: Parses command-line arguments (--host, --connect, --dedicated, --gamename, --password, --name, --maxplayers) and populates a NetComm configuration struct with host/client flags, address, port, game name, and player name. Part of the network communication initialization system.

0x004636a0.name: CollisionThresholdCheck
0x004636a0.label: Collision Threshold Comparison by State
0x004636a0.summary: Reads float value at +0x388 from this object, compares against threshold (20.0 or 1.25 depending on StateCheckWrapper result). Returns true if float exceeds threshold, false otherwise.

0x004636f0.name: FloatComparisonAgainstThreshold
0x004636f0.label: Positive Float Check
0x004636f0.summary: Returns whether float value at this+0x380 is greater than 0.0. Simple positive-threshold check.

0x00463710.name: StringCopyToStructField
0x00463710.label: String Copy to Fixed-Size Struct Field
0x00463710.summary: Copies a source string (max 31 chars) into struct buffer at +0x1B0 with null-termination at +0x1CF. If source is null, zeros first byte of buffer (empty string). Returns pointer to this.

0x00463760.name: ConditionalStateDispatch
0x00463760.label: Server Track Open/Close Signal Dispatch
0x00463760.summary: Dispatches server track signals based on state and a parameter. If state check fails, calls ServerOpenedClosedNotification. If state check passes and a2 is set, calls ServerOpenTrackSignal; otherwise calls ServerCloseTrackSignal.

0x004637a0.name: AutoJoinRetryLoop
0x004637a0.label: Multiplayer Auto-Join Retry Loop with Session State Machine
0x004637a0.summary: Implements the multiplayer auto-join retry loop: checks if auto-join is enabled (byte at *this+0xC6), determines championship mode (5=multiplayer), runs a retry loop with timeout (flt_7D0F28) that polls session state, attempts join via SessionStateTransition, resets vehicle arrays on success, and handles failure/logging paths.

0x00463bc0.name: sub_463BC0
0x00463bc0.label: Multiplayer/Championship Mode Entry Handler
0x00463bc0.summary: Enters multiplayer lobby or championship selection based on flag at +0xC5. Sets championship mode to 5 with timeout overrides, enables global boolean flag, calls dispatch wrapper, and shows "Select Circuit" or "Multiplayer Create" prompt depending on sub-routine result. Returns 0 if flag not set.

0x00463c80.name: VehicleDescriptionAccessor
0x00463c80.label: Vehicle Description String Accessor
0x00463c80.summary: Reads vehicle description string pointer at this+0xB4. Returns the pointer if non-null, otherwise returns fallback default directory path as placeholder.

0x00463ca0.name: sub_463CA0
0x00463ca0.label: Team Radio Network Message Processing by State
0x00463ca0.summary: Checks state at +0x3FC4 (via dereference chain); if non-zero, allocates buffer (size 256) and calls TeamRadioNetworkMessageProcessing. Returns char pointer (the this pointer or the result of radio processing).

0x00463cd0.name: CollisionResponseStatus
0x00463cd0.label: Collision Response and Session Sync with State Guard
0x00463cd0.summary: Dispatches input commands to entities and synchronizes session if state at +0x3FC4 is non-zero, using default scoring return value. Always resets flag at +0x374 to 0 on exit.

0x00463d50.name: UtilityFunction_3d50
0x00463d50.label: WheelCollisionAndIntegrationDispatcher
0x00463d50.summary: Performs collision test with threshold for a given wheel index; if collision detected, dispatches physics integration step and float state update. Reads per-wheel parameter from global array (unk_5F0708 indexed by a2*4656). Part of vehicle physics system.

0x00463e00.name: GuardedFunctionCallByState
0x00463e00.label: Particle/Sound Effect Spawner by State
0x00463e00.summary: Checks if state at +0x3FC4 equals 3; if so, calls ParticleSoundEffectSpawner on the object. Returns spawner result on match, undefined otherwise.

0x00463e20.name: sub_463E20
0x00463e20.label: Game Entry Initializer (Audio, Network Replay, Title)
0x00463e20.summary: Initializes audio stream struct with defaults and instance handle, formats game version string. If stack buffer copy predicate succeeds, sets flag at +0x1D0, stores this pointer at +0x3FC0, and queries sub-object result at +0x417C. Always initializes network replay buffer.

0x00463ef0.name: sub_463EF0
0x00463ef0.label: Game Setup Initializer (Mode-Dependent State Reset)
0x00463ef0.summary: Game setup initialization: if flag at +0x1D0 is not 1, resets state at +0x3FC4 to 0. If init guard not set and championship mode is 5, configures player count and vehicle count from globals; otherwise resets state to 0.

0x00463f70.name: SessionTypeSetter
0x00463f70.label: InitSessionTypeAndNetworkConfig
0x00463f70.summary: Initializes the game session type based on network state and stored config, sets multiplayer flags, copies network communication strings, and configures collision/session parameters for both online and offline modes.

0x00464290.name: SynchronizeWithServer
0x00464290.label: Server Synchronization State Machine
0x00464290.summary: Synchronizes multiplayer session with server. If state at +0x3FC4 is non-zero: initializes arrays, clears player slots, optionally runs collision detection loop. If sync flag not set, initializes structs in a loop. Based on state value (1/2 vs other), configures byte field or sets timeout/retry values. Always clears accumulated fields and runs array initialization. Returns state value.

0x004643c0.name: SessionScoringUpdate
0x004643c0.label: Per-frame session state manager and scoring update
0x004643c0.summary: Core per-frame update for race session state machine — advances timers, dispatches linked-list session-state messages, manages server communication (OK request, track-open signal), and triggers scoring/timing subsystems. Part of the session lifecycle management system.

0x00464600.name: SessionStateByte7CE25FSetter
0x00464600.label: Session flag setter based on object state
0x00464600.summary: Checks init guard byte_7CE260; if zero (not initialized), checks object bytes at +0xC5/+0xC6 and sets global byte_7CE25F=1 when either is nonzero. Also builds track config name and conditionally runs guarded init.

0x00464670.name: ConditionalObjectCleanup
0x00464670.label: Network object cleanup on game exit
0x00464670.summary: Conditionally cleans up two object pointers: VTableCall + pointer reset at +0x3FB8 if nonzero, then flag reset + NetworkCleanup + pointer reset at +0x1B79C if nonzero. Called on game exit.

0x004646c0.name: FloatClamp
0x004646c0.label: Float clamp to [lower, upper]
0x004646c0.summary: Clamps float value to range [a2, a3]. If value below a2, set to a2. If above a3, set to a3. Otherwise unchanged.

0x004646f0.name: ConditionalDestructor_46f0
0x004646f0.label: Conditional object destructor
0x004646f0.summary: Frees embedded pointer at +0x0 if flag at +0x8 is nonzero, then optionally frees self if a2 bit 0 is set. Destructor-like pattern.

0x00464740.name: LinkedListNodeRemoval
0x00464740.label: Linked list node removal with conditional free
0x00464740.summary: Traverses singly-linked list from head, removes node matching a2, updates head/tail/prev pointers, decrements count, conditionally frees node's embedded data and node itself based on flag at node+8.

0x004647d0.name: LinkedListMergeSort_47d0
0x004647d0.label: Linked list merge sort (recursive)
0x004647d0.summary: Recursive merge sort for singly-linked list. Counts nodes, splits at midpoint into two halves, recursively sorts each half, then merges based on comparison of sort key at (*node)[2] (offset 0x8 of node's pointed-to data).

0x00464990.name: ShortComputation_4990
0x00464990.label: Squared distance computation
0x00464990.summary: Computes squared Euclidean distance between entity position (offsets +0x75, +0x79, +0x7D) and reference point a2[3384..3386]. Stores result in this[1].

0x004649f0.name: BitFlagSetter
0x004649f0.label: Bit 7 flag setter/clearer
0x004649f0.summary: Sets or clears bit 7 (0x80) of byte at this, based on a2. If a2 nonzero, sets bit 7; if zero, clears bit 7. Returns a2.

0x00464a40.name: CollisionSensorInit
0x00464a40.label: Collision sensor initializer
0x00464a40.summary: Initializes collision sensor fields: sets sensor detection value to near -FLT_MAX, clears collision flag byte to 0, zeros contact count.

0x00464a60.name: FloatStoreWithConversion
0x00464a60.label: Speed-to-byte ratio converter
0x00464a60.summary: Stores input value to offset +0x220, maps it through cascading speed tiers (2975/7200/28800/62500) to select a conversion divisor (6/10/16/20/32), computes 1.0/divisor/0.005, converts to byte via CRTFtol, and stores to offset +0x22A.

0x00464b40.name: FloatComputation
0x00464b40.label: Collision response dispatch with flag clearing
0x00464b40.summary: Processes collision data from a2: if sensor value at this+0x71 < a2+4 or flag XOR mismatch, dispatches to VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles or ArithmeticComparison_3a90 based on a2's type field, then clears 104 bit flags via BitFlagSetter.

0x00464bb0.name: UtilityFunction_4bb0
0x00464bb0.label: Accumulator with threshold check
0x00464bb0.summary: Adds a2 to accumulator at this[26], stores result, returns true if accumulator >= a3.

0x00464bd0.name: FloatFieldDecrementWithClamp
0x00464bd0.label: Decrement with clamp to [0, max]
0x00464bd0.summary: Subtracts a2 from float field this[26], clamps result to range [0, a2]. If negative, set to 0; if above a2, set to a2.

0x00464c10.name: LargeStructInitialization
0x00464c10.label: CollisionSensorArrayInit
0x00464c10.summary: Initializes a large collision-sensor structure: zeroes sub-regions, creates 104 sensor entries each with an allocated tracking node and collision sensor init, sets sentinel and scale defaults, and initializes QPC timer.

0x00464d20.name: sub_464D20
0x00464d20.label: Byte zeroer
0x00464d20.summary: Sets byte at this to 0, returns pointer to this.

0x00464d30.name: sub_464D30
0x00464d30.label: Collision/Linked-List Reinitialization and Cleanup
0x00464d30.summary: Reinitializes a collision-sensor or physics-tracking data structure: stores a new input value, resets performance timer, walks and frees four linked lists of allocated nodes, clears all list-head pointers, and reinitializes collision sensor entries via CollisionSensorInit. Part of the collision detection / physics data management system.

0x00464ee0.name: ConditionalDelegateBasedOnCounter
0x00464ee0.label: Counter-based buffer size lookup
0x00464ee0.summary: Returns counter value at this[20] if positive; otherwise delegates to BufferSizeLookup with *this as argument.

0x00464ef0.name: FloatFractionFromInt
0x00464ef0.label: Accumulator fraction processing with iteration
0x00464ef0.summary: Adds a2 to accumulator at this[26], extracts integer part v4 via CRTFtol, iterates 104 items at this+35 stepping by 560 bytes calling sub_464B10 with v4, stores fractional remainder (v3 - v4*0.005) back to accumulator.

0x00465000.name: sub_465000
0x00465000.label: Comprehensive linked list cleanup
0x00465000.summary: Frees all nodes in four linked lists of a large object: walks linked lists at +0xE5B0 and +0xE5A0 (14704/14700), frees each node via ConditionalFreeByFlagCheck+FreeWrapper, clears list pointers/counts. Then frees a static array of 104 pointers, two flag-linked lists at offsets 0x7C/0x6C, and finally the object itself.

0x00465160.name: WheelSpeedConversionWithZeroGuard
0x00465160.label: Wheel speed conversion with zero guard
0x00465160.summary: Converts two speed inputs (a2, a3) to wheel speed units (1000*x/8) and stores to offsets +0x50 and +0x54, guarded against zero/negative values.

0x004651c0.name: ResourceManagerFrameCleanup
0x004651c0.label: Per-frame resource manager cleanup
0x004651c0.summary: Per-frame cleanup: computes timestep via HighResolutionTimerDelta (clamped to [0.001, 1.0]), calls FloatFractionFromInt, clears two linked lists (freeing nodes with flag check), zeroes 14560-byte array of bytes at +0x3E, resets accumulator at +0xE40C to 0.0.

0x004652d0.name: ShortComputation_52d0
0x004652d0.label: Resource slot activation counter
0x004652d0.summary: Checks activation byte at base + 560*a2 + 248. If zero (inactive), sets it to 1 and increments resource active count at +0xE40C.

0x00465300.name: sub_465300
0x00465300.label: Input command dispatch to collision/event lists
0x00465300.summary: Processes input command from a2. If it's a collision-type command (bits 29-30 == 1, subtype 0 or 7), routes to FloatComputation for direct collision processing. Otherwise allocates a new node, processes via ArithmeticComparison_3a90, and appends to one of two linked lists based on command type flags.

0x00465460.name: EntityVisibilityGridManager
0x00465460.label: Entity Visibility Grid & Priority Dispatch Manager
0x00465460.summary: Manages a grid-based entity visibility system: clears old allocation lists, classifies visible entities by distance threshold, sorts them by priority (via merge sort), and dispatches visibility/computation updates to each entity. Uses a budget system (v83 counter) to limit per-frame work. Part of the entity management / LOD system.

0x00465c30.name: LinkedListPopFront
0x00465c30.label: LinkedListPopFront
0x00465c30.summary: Pops front node from linked list at this+0xE5C8, returns its data via a2. Returns 1 on success, 0 if list empty or node data is zero.

0x00465c70.name: MergeSortOnLinkedList
0x00465c70.label: MergeSortAscendingOnLinkedList
0x00465c70.summary: Merge sort on singly linked list comparing float at (data+4). Ascending order by float key. Recursive split/merge pattern.

0x00465d70.name: sub_465D70
0x00465d70.label: MergeSortWithPriorityTable
0x00465d70.summary: Merge sort on linked list with custom comparator using a priority table (dword_7CD2AC+58384, 104 entries). Compares high bits, byte values, and table order to determine sort sequence. Used by entity visibility grid sorting.

0x00466090.name: sub_466090
0x00466090.label: UIObjectConstructorWithFloatDefaults
0x00466090.summary: UI object constructor. Calls UIStructInit, sets vtable to off_59F140, and initializes float fields (indices 60-73) with default values including 5.0, 10.0, 1.0, -1.0.

0x00466140.name: ShortComputation_6140
0x00466140.label: UIObjectDestructorWithStateReset
0x00466140.summary: Destructor/cleanup for UI object. Sets vtable to off_59F140, calls StateResetWithZero to reset state field, then calls Destructor_e670.

0x00466160.name: FunctionCallWrapper_6160
0x00466160.label: ComputeAngleRatioAndStore
0x00466160.summary: Computes sqrt(this[62]^2 - this[70]^2) → this[71] and this[70]/this[62] ratio → this[72]. Calls WrapperReturn0 and FloatConvertWrapper.

0x004661b0.name: GameObjectUpdateFrame
0x004661b0.label: GameObjectUpdateFrame
0x004661b0.summary: Per-frame update for game object. Optionally appends to doubly linked list, decrements a timer (field 0x124), calls position/physics subroutines (sub_466350, sub_466650) when flags set, and invokes virtual methods at vtable+44 and vtable+168.

0x00466250.name: FlagSetter
0x00466250.label: SetFlagByteF4
0x00466250.summary: Sets flag byte at this+0xF4 to 1 and calls FieldSetterCall with argument 3.

0x00466270.name: ShortComputation_6270
0x00466270.label: SetFlagByteF5
0x00466270.summary: Sets flag byte at this+0xF5 to 1 and calls FieldSetterCall with argument 3.

0x00466290.label: ClearFlagBytesF4F5
0x00466290.summary: Clears both flag bytes (0xF4 and 0xF5) to 0 and calls FieldSetterCall with argument 2.

0x004662e0.name: StateResetWithZero
0x004662e0.label: StateFieldResetAndCleanup
0x004662e0.summary: Calls ResourceCleanup, then zeros field at this+0xF0 (index 60). Returns 1.

0x00466300.name: StateInitializerWithFlagCheck
0x00466300.label: ScenePostInitWithFlagCheck
0x00466300.summary: Post-initialization after scene load. Sets field 0x124 to -1.0, calls CUBESceneLoaderEntry and FieldSetterCall(2), runs sub_466350 and sub_466650, then conditionally calls sub_541CA0(1) if flag at 0xEC is set.

0x00466350.name: sub_466350
0x00466350.label: PositionUpdateWithHeadingAndVelocity
0x00466350.summary: Position/heading update for camera or vehicle. Computes deltas from saved position, applies angle/velocity physics with clamping and flag-based branching (flags at 0xF4/0xF5). Uses sin/cos to compute velocity components and stores them at fields 0x118-0x120. Also uses global dword_7D0398 (photo/free camera mode) for alternate clamp logic.

0x00466650.name: sub_466650
0x00466650.label: SteeringOrRotationUpdate
0x00466650.summary: Secondary axis/rotation update for camera or vehicle. Accumulates elapsed time in this[67] (clamped to 3.0), reads position deltas, applies damping correction based on this[68] error term. Flag at 0xF4 selects brake-reset path vs smooth-damping path.

0x004668e0.name: InitVTableSet
0x004668e0.label: InitVTableSet_NetworkVTable
0x004668e0.summary: Constructor helper. Calls UIConstructorWithVTableParams(a2, a3) for base initialization, then sets vtable pointer to off_59F210 (NetworkVTable).

0x00466910.name: SetupValueDisplayFormatter
0x00466910.label: FormatValueAsPercentString
0x00466910.summary: Retrieves a float value via virtual call (vtable+180), converts to percentage (value*100+0.5) via CRTFtol, formats as "%d%%" string, and stores result via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.

0x00466980.name: VtableSetWithInitCall
