0x00466980.summary: Constructor helper. Calls UIConstructorWithVTableParams(this, a2, a3) for base initialization, then sets vtable pointer to off_59F2C8.

0x004669a0.name: SetupValueDisplayFormatter_69a0
0x004669a0.label: FormatNormalizedValueAsPercent
0x004669a0.summary: Retrieves a value via virtual call (vtable+180), normalizes by dividing by (this[62]-this[61]), converts to percentage, and formats as "%d%%" string. Checks flag at this+0xF0 to choose signed vs unsigned division.

0x00466a30.name: ConstructorWithVTableAndFloatInit
0x00466a30.label: ConstructorWithVTableFloatAndIndex
0x00466a30.summary: Constructor. Calls InitVTableSet(this, a3, a4), sets vtable to off_59F380, initializes field 0x104 to 0.5f, clears byte at 0x100, and stores a2 at 0x108.

0x00466a70.name: ConfigObjectDestructor
0x00466a70.label: ConfigObjectDestructor
0x00466a70.summary: Destructor for a config/command-binding object. Frees linked list of allocations at this+0x44 (each node: data ptr, next ptr, flag byte). Resets list head/tail fields to 0. Calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, VehicleStatsEstimationDisplay (conditional on byte_7C7064), and LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation.

0x00466c40.name: ShortComputation_6c40
0x00466c40.label: PhysicsInitAndDisplayForIndexedParam
0x00466c40.summary: Calls PhysicsStateInitIndexed with byte_7C56C0 and indexed float/int from this+0x104/0x108, then calls VehicleStatsEstimationDisplay. Clears byte at this+0x100 to 0.

0x00466d60.name: ShortComputation_6d60
0x00466d60.label: ObjectConstructorWithVTableAndZeroFields
0x00466d60.summary: Constructor. Calls sub_48C070(a2), zeros fields 0x31C-0x330, and sets vtable to off_59F438.

0x004670e0.name: SwitchOnActionIDVirtualCall
0x004670e0.label: DispatchByActionID
0x004670e0.summary: Dispatches based on action ID (this[205]-236, range 0-0xB1). Uses jump table byte_46713C. Case 0: calls virtual method +28 on dword_7CD8C0 with arg 14, then ObjectNameComparison. Case 1: same with arg 11. Case 2: immediate return 0.

0x00467260.name: ObjectConstructorWithParameterSetup
0x00467260.label: WindowManagerConstructor
0x00467260.summary: Constructor for window manager object. Calls sub_48C070(0), sets vtable to off_59F4F8 (VTable_WindowManager), stores a2 at this[201] as index, computes data table pointer from unk_7C6270 + 64*a2, and initializes fields with defaults (11, 4) and clears byte at 0x305.

0x004672c0.name: ObjectInitializerWithVtableIndex
0x004672c0.label: GridIndexedWindowManagerConstructor
0x004672c0.summary: Constructor for window manager with 2D grid indexing. Calls sub_48C070(this, 0), computes data table pointer from unk_7C5770 + 64*(a3+11*a2), sets vtable to off_59F4F8, stores row/column parameters (a2, a3) and additional param a4 at index 199.

0x00467340.name: IndexedCallWith1Increment
0x00467340.label: MenuOptionValueAdjust
0x00467340.summary: Adjusts a menu option value by ±1 based on direction (a2=1 increments, else decrements), then dispatches to the appropriate handler based on selection type. Belongs to menu option system.

0x004673b0.name: MenuOptionValueDisplay
0x004673b0.label: MenuOptionValueDisplay
0x004673b0.summary: Formats and displays the current value of a menu option by dispatching to the appropriate formatter (vehicle setup vs generic), then replaces the displayed string if it changed. Belongs to menu option system.

0x00467430.name: StringCompareAndConditionalReplace
0x00467430.label: StringCompareAndConditionalReplace
0x00467430.summary: Compares a new string against the current string buffer; if different, copies the new string (with size limit) and updates the position tracking, then calls a vtable method to signal the change. Belongs to menu option text display system.

0x004674e0.name: MenuCommandDispatcher
0x004674e0.label: MenuCommandDispatcher
0x004674e0.summary: Dispatches menu creation based on a command ID (this[93]) — formats and creates UI menu items for setup/date/angle display modes. Routes through different formatters depending on command range and UI bypass flag. Belongs to menu UI system.

0x00467720.name: sub_467720
0x00467720.label: ObjectInitAndLinkedListReset
0x00467720.summary: Initializes an object (vtable set, counters zeroed) then walks and frees all nodes in an embedded linked list, clearing head/tail pointers and counts. Acts as a combined constructor/cleanup for a linked-list-backed data structure.

0x004677e0.name: LinkedListNodeDestructor
0x004677e0.label: LinkedListNodeDestructor
0x004677e0.summary: Destructor that walks and frees all nodes in an embedded linked list, clears head/tail/count fields, calls vtable cleanup, and optionally frees the object itself based on a flag. Belongs to linked-list data structure cleanup system.

0x00467dc0.name: MenuLayoutCalculator
0x00467dc0.label: MenuLayoutCalculator
0x00467dc0.summary: Computes menu layout position (midpoint between two bounds) and processes credits text data and HTML output sections. Calls CreditsTxtParser and HTMLOutputSectionProcessor, then calculates center position and loads a resource via sub_497AD0. Belongs to menu layout system.

0x00467e40.name: CreditsTxtParser
0x00467e40.label: CreditsTxtParser
0x00467e40.summary: Opens and parses the "credits.txt" file from the application directory, reading lines into a linked list of string nodes. Each line is split at a delimiter, allocated as a node, and appended to the list. Belongs to credits/menu text loading system.

0x00467f90.name: HTMLOutputSectionProcessor
0x00467f90.label: HTMLOutputSectionProcessor
0x00467f90.summary: Processes parsed credits/HTML data: destroys a secondary linked list, then walks the primary list filtering strings for "Header" content. Non-"Header" strings cause traversal to the next node, whose content is inserted via LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation. Belongs to HTML/results output section processing system.

0x00468090.name: ShortComputation_8090
0x00468090.label: ObjectInitWithVTableAndDefault
0x00468090.summary: Initializes an object by calling sub_466090, setting a vtable pointer, and writing -1 to this[74]. Acts as a simple constructor. Belongs to object initialization system.

0x004681b0.name: VehicleSceneLoadAndPositionTires
0x004681b0.label: VehicleSceneLoadAndPositionTires
0x004681b0.summary: Loads a temporary vehicle visual scene file, locates the four tire nodes (LF, RF, LR, RR) in the scene graph, and repositions them relative to their computed center. Also handles cockpit and mirror node flag manipulation. Cleanup deletes the temporary scene file.

0x004685b0.name: FunctionCallWrapper_85b0
0x004685b0.label: ObjectConstructorWithVTableInit
0x004685b0.summary: Constructs an object by calling a base initializer, setting vtable pointer, zeroing a command/state field, and setting a field to -1 sentinel value. Belongs to object construction system (render/entity subsystem based on vtable).

0x00468610.name: DestructorWithFree
0x00468610.label: DestructorWithConditionalFree
0x00468610.summary: Destructor that sets the vtable pointer, conditionally frees a heap-allocated sub-object at this[93] if non-null, then delegates to another cleanup function. Belongs to object destruction system.

0x00468910.name: HTMLResultsStatsPageWorldChampionships
0x00468910.label: HTMLResultsStatsPageWorldChampionships
0x00468910.summary: Destroys the existing linked list of stat entries, then repopulates it with 10 career driver stat strings (experience laps, starts, avg positions, wins, points, etc.). Belongs to career mode results/stats HTML page generation system.

0x00468a00.name: CareerModeDriverStatsReset
0x00468a00.label: CareerModeDriverStatsReset
0x00468a00.summary: Resets career mode driver stats display by destroying the existing stat list, calling a vtable method, rebuilding the stat list with 13 stat keys (adding Circuit, BestLap, and an extra ExperienceLaps to the base 10), then calling state cleanup and sub_468BF0. Belongs to career mode results/stats system.

0x00468bf0.name: sub_468BF0
0x00468bf0.label: RaceResultsPageBuilder
0x00468bf0.summary: Builds HTML/results page content by iterating through a linked list of race results, formatting each entry (grand prix name, race number, lap time) into UI menu items. Compares and updates the current track name. Belongs to career mode results/stats HTML page generation system.

0x00468ee0.name: PlayerProfileScanner
0x00468ee0.label: PlayerProfileIconScanner
0x00468ee0.summary: Scans the settings directory for *.PLR player profile files, loads each profile's icon bitmap (falling back to default "ProfileIcon_DFT.bmp"), and builds a linked list of loaded icon bitmaps with associated path strings for UI selection.

0x004692b0.name: ProfileIconBmpLoader
0x004692b0.label: ProfileIconBmpLoader
0x004692b0.summary: Constructs a file path to "ProfileIcon.bmp" from the settings directory and a profile filename retrieved from a linked list, then removes the old linked list entry by that path and triggers profile scanner refresh. Belongs to profile/settings icon loading system.

0x004693e0.name: FilenameFromLinkedList
0x004693e0.label: FilenameFromLinkedList
0x004693e0.summary: Retrieves a filename string from a linked list by index, copies it to a buffer, then strips the file extension and path prefix to return just the bare filename. Belongs to profile/scene file management system.

0x00469550.name: PlayerNameNeverUsedProfileNameUniquenessCheck
0x00469550.label: PlayerNameUniquenessCheck
0x00469550.summary: Checks whether a given profile name is unique by scanning a linked list of existing profile filenames. Returns true if the name is unique (no matching entry found), with special handling for the "PlayerNameNever" string. Belongs to profile creation/validation system.

0x00469630.name: SetupFileLoadAndFinalize
0x00469630.label: SetupFileLoadAndFinalize
0x00469630.summary: Loads a setup file by retrieving a filename from a linked list, stripping its extension, copying season directory path, dispatching file copy check, loading an audio file, and processing sub-objects via vtable methods. Belongs to setup/configuration file loading system.

0x004698c0.name: DestructorWithSubObjectFree
0x004698c0.label: DestructorWithSubObjectFree
0x004698c0.summary: Destructor that conditionally frees a sub-object at this[96] if non-null, calls a cleanup wrapper, then optionally frees the containing object based on a destructor flag. Belongs to object destruction system.

0x00469900.name: sub_469900
0x00469900.label: PlayerStatsDisplayBuilder
0x00469900.summary: Builds player stats display page by iterating through race result linked list, formatting each entry (grand prix name, race number, lap time) into UI menu items with indexed labels (0, 1, 2). Similar to RaceResultsPageBuilder but processes the first entry differently before looping the rest. Belongs to career mode player stats display system.

0x00469d30.name: PlayerStatsDisplayCleanup
0x00469d30.label: PlayerStatsDisplayCleanup
0x00469d30.summary: Destroys the existing linked list of stat entries, repopulates it with 3 stat keys (Circuit, ExperienceLaps, BestLap), calls state cleanup, builds the stats display page via sub_469900, and resets a flag. Belongs to career mode player stats display system.

0x00469dd0.name: AnimationFrameTimer
0x00469dd0.label: AnimationFrameTimer
0x00469dd0.summary: Accumulates frame delta time and advances animation frames when a threshold (2.0) is exceeded. Increments a frame counter by 2, wraps at a limit, and calls a vtable callback for animation update. Belongs to animation timing system.

0x00469fb0.name: ResultsPageBuilder
0x00469fb0.label: ResultsPageBuilder
0x00469fb0.summary: Builds a results page by iterating through the race result linked list, filtering out entries matching the settings file path, formatting each remaining entry (grand prix name, race number, lap time) into UI menu items with indexed labels (1, 2). Belongs to career mode results/stats HTML page generation system.

0x0046a220.name: ObjectConstructorWithVTable
0x0046a220.label: ObjectConstructorWithVTableInit
0x0046a220.summary: Constructs an object by calling a base initializer, zeroing two fields, setting a field to -1 sentinel value, and assigning a vtable pointer. Belongs to object construction system (season database objects based on caller).

0x0046a270.name: VTableSetFreeCall
0x0046a270.label: DestructorWithVTableSetAndFree
0x0046a270.summary: Destructor function. Sets vtable pointer at offset 0, conditionally frees a sub-object at offset 0x348 via FreeWrapper_7bcf if non-null, then chains to LinkedListDestructor.

0x0046a2a0.name: sub_46A2A0
0x0046a2a0.label: SceneListRebuildFromArray
0x0046a2a0.summary: Rebuilds scene linked list. Clears existing list, iterates scene array (count from dword_8AC488, stride 0x18c), extracts scene name at offset +4, formats path/filename, loads/creates scene reference via sub_497AD0 (with fallback string), appends each to linked list.

0x0046a4e0.name: ConstructorWithVTableAndSubInit
0x0046a4e0.label: SeasonDatabaseObjectConstructor

0x0046bf10.label: RaceBroadcastUpdateTick

0x0046cb50.name: ProfileAlreadyExistsPageHandler
0x0046cb50.label: ProfileAlreadyExistsPageHandler

0x0046d060.name: SeasonDataFileSetupChain

0x0046d0d0.name: SessionCheckEndCondition

0x0048b9c0.name: TextInputRender

0x0048bbe0.name: UIActiveStateToggle

0x0048c070.name: sub_48C070

0x0048c070.summary: Constructor for HUD timer widget. Calls base initializer, sets vtable to VTable_HUDTimer, stores parameter a2 at this+0x308, and initializes flag/field defaults at offsets 0x304-0x318.

0x0048c0e0.name: WindowControlTypeDetection

0x0048c170.name: CollisionAnimationTimerUpdate
0x0048c170.label: CollisionAnimTimerUpdate
0x0048c170.summary: Updates collision/animation timer accumulator at this+0x318. Adds external float value (from this+0x40 pointer), applies damping toward 0.75, and dispatches vtable[46] callbacks if non-unit collision computed.

0x0048c940.name: StateQueryDispatch
0x0048c940.label: StateQueryDispatch

Otherwise checks ShortComputation_6720 result; if ==5, calls vtable[16](0). Always calls vtable[43] afterward. Used for state-based branching in collision/HUD system.

0x0048c9a0.name: SimpleVTableNullInit
0x0048c9a0.label: UIElementVTableInit
0x0048c9a0.summary: Initializes object with UIElementVTable at this+0x0 and zeroes field at this+0x4. Called during linked list node setup.

0x0048c9d0.name: ShortComputation_c9d0
0x0048c9d0.label: VTableSetterC9D0
0x0048c9d0.summary: Sets vtable at this+0x0 to UIElementVTable (off_5AC044). Minimal vtable initializer stub.

0x0048c9f0.name: ObjectConstructorWithZeroedFields
0x0048c9f0.label: ExtendedObjectConstructor

0x0048ca50.name: LinkedListDestructor
0x0048ca50.label: LinkedListNodeListDestructor
0x0048ca50.summary: Destroys linked list at this+0x31C. Walks nodes, calls vtable destructor on each non-terminal node, frees all nodes, zeros list fields, then restores HUDTimer vtable via VTableInit. Each node: offset 0x0=vtable, 0x4=next, 0xC=active flag.

0x0048cb00.name: CollisionPositionStepper
0x0048cb00.label: CollisionPositionStepper
0x0048cb00.summary: Steps collision/animation position toward target. Accumulates time delta, computes steps, advances position at rate proportional to distance (0.444 scaling), wraps within range (step * multiplier), and calls vtable[11] update each step.

0x0048cc20.name: LinkedListSizeCalcWithMaxTracking
0x0048cc20.label: LinkedListMaxSizeCalc
0x0048cc20.summary: Walks linked list at this+0x31C, computes maximum dimensions from each node's sub-object child struct (offsets 28 and 32 plus padding). Initializes default maxes to 5, tracks running max in this+0x32C and this+0x330.

0x0048ccb0.name: sub_48CCB0
0x0048ccb0.label: SpriteTileBatchRenderer
0x0048ccb0.summary: Renders a batch of sprite/tile objects by iterating a linked list, computing screen-space rects from object bounds and camera clip region, and issuing draw calls via F_10ParamForwarder. Handles clipping, wrapping, and sub-region rendering. Render system.

0x0048d0a0.name: sub_48D0A0
0x0048d0a0.label: CollisionStepperAndVTable43
0x0048d0a0.summary: Reads float input from this+0x40 pointer, passes to CollisionPositionStepper for position update, then calls vtable[43]. Simple tick/dispatch wrapper for collision animation system.

0x0048d0d0.name: sub_48D0D0
0x0048d0d0.label: ListScrollCentering
0x0048d0d0.summary: Computes which list item index should be centered in visible area based on scroll position (this+0x334) and offset. Steps one-by-one toward target index via vtable[46] callback. Used for list/gallery scrolling with centering.

0x0048d1a0.name: UtilityFunction_d1a0
0x0048d1a0.label: ListIndexStep

0x0048d230.name: LinkedListDestructionWithVTableCall
0x0048d230.label: LinkedListFullDestroyAndReset
0x0048d230.summary: Destroys linked list at this+0x31C, frees all nodes (with vtable destructor call on non-terminal nodes), then resets all collision/scroll fields (0x31C-0x340) to zero except direction byte at 0x33C set to 1.

0x0048d2b0.name: LinkedListNodeAppend
0x0048d2b0.label: LinkedListNodeAppend
0x0048d2b0.summary: Appends a new value node to a doubly-linked UI list/collection. Allocates a data node (8 bytes) with vtable and stores the input value, then allocates a list node (16 bytes) to link it, updating tail pointer and count.

0x0048d360.name: GuardedAccessor
0x0048d360.label: GuardedSelectedIndexGetter
0x0048d360.summary: Returns the currently selected index (stored at this+0x338) if the list count (this+0x328) is greater than 0, otherwise returns -1. A guarded accessor for a UI list/collection.

0x0048d380.name: BoundsCheckedIndexSetter
0x0048d380.label: BoundsCheckedSelectedIndexSetter
0x0048d380.summary: Sets the selected index (at this+0x338) with bounds checking against the list count (at this+0x328). The new index is only written if 0 <= a2 < count.

0x0048d3a0.name: UIConstructorWithVTableParams
0x0048d3a0.label: UIObjectConstructorWithStoredParams
0x0048d3a0.summary: Initializes a UI widget object by calling base init (ShortComputation_5e30) and field init (F_5FieldInit), then stores the vtable pointer and two integer parameters (a2 at +0xF4, a3 at +0xF8). Two byte flags at +0xF0 and +0xF1 are zeroed.

0x0048d3e0.name: ObjectInitWithVTableCleanup
0x0048d3e0.label: VTableResetAndCleanup
0x0048d3e0.summary: Resets the vtable pointer to off_5AC1D0 (UIWidgetVTable), then calls sub_485EB0 for further cleanup/teardown. Appears in destructor sequences.

0x0048d3f0.name: sub_48D3F0
0x0048d3f0.label: DestructorWithConditionalFree
0x0048d3f0.summary: Destructor that resets vtable to off_5AC1D0, calls sub_485EB0 for cleanup, then conditionally frees the object via FreeWrapper_7bcf if the low bit of parameter a2 is set.

0x0048d4b0.name: ScrollProgressHandler
0x0048d4b0.label: ScrollProgressHandler
0x0048d4b0.summary: Calculates and updates scroll bar thumb position for a UI scroll area. Computes progress ratio from current scroll value vs range, converts to pixel position, and triggers redraw if the thumb position changed.

0x0048d590.name: InputDispatch
0x0048d590.label: ListNavigationInputDispatch
0x0048d590.summary: Processes a set of input codes (short array) for UI list navigation. Handles code 203 (scroll up/previous) and code 205 (scroll down/next) by incrementing or decrementing the selected index, clamping via a virtual bounds check, and signaling a change.

0x0048d660.name: ConstructorDualSubInit
0x0048d660.label: MenuItemConstructor
0x0048d660.summary: Constructs a menu item by calling ConstructorInitVTable with params (1, -1), setting vtable to VTable_MenuItem_5AC280, and calling SimpleSetter_8bc0 with value 2.

0x0048d6a0.name: ShortComputation_d6a0
0x0048d6a0.label: MenuItemVTableInit
0x0048d6a0.summary: Sets vtable to off_5AC280 (VTable_MenuItem_5AC280) and delegates to ConstructorWithVTableSet for the remainder of initialization. A minimal constructor stub.

0x0048d6b0.name: UIScreenSelectionHandler
0x0048d6b0.label: UIScreenSelectionHandler
0x0048d6b0.summary: Handles UI screen selection by retrieving a screen object from this+0x40, getting its path string (via FieldGetterAt0x1570, field at +0xC0 from the screen object), and comparing it to a stored path via UIStringComparison. If a valid screen object exists, triggers a content-changed signal.

0x0048d6f0.name: ConditionalRenderingCall
0x0048d6f0.label: ConditionalRenderDispatch
0x0048d6f0.summary: Conditionally dispatches UI rendering. If the screen pointer at this+0xEC is non-null, retrieves a UI string and passes it to sub_498560 for resource lookup, then delegates to UILargeRenderDispatcher for the actual render.

0x0048d740.name: LargeZeroInitConstructor
0x0048d740.label: ScrollAreaConstructor
0x0048d740.summary: Constructs a scroll area UI object. Calls ConstructorWithByteParams for base init, zeros 16 consecutive fields (this[58] through this[73], offsets 0xE8-0x124), and sets the vtable to off_5AC328.

0x0048d850.name: UIScrollAreaAutoScrollManager
0x0048d850.label: ScrollAutoScrollManager
0x0048d850.summary: Manages auto-scroll behavior for a UI scroll area based on input state. Reads mouse/touch position and scroll state via ShortComputation_6720 and DualFieldRead, then dispatches scroll commands (0=none, 6=scroll up, 7=scroll up fast, 8=scroll down, 9=scroll down fast, 3=stop) via virtual call at vtable+64 depending on which region the cursor is in.

0x0048d9d0.name: MediaBufferPlaybackManager
0x0048d9d0.label: Playback Item Render Loop
0x0048d9d0.summary: Renders a linked list of media buffer items with string lookup, message dispatch, and surface fill operations. Handles playback index clamping, item navigation, state-dependent multi-item rendering, and virtual-method cleanup.

0x0048df40.name: UIWidgetDragHandler
0x0048df40.label: ScrollDragHandler
0x0048df40.summary: Handles mouse/touch drag input for a scroll area. Reads cursor position via DualFieldRead and current scroll state via ShortComputation_6720, then changes scroll state (3=start drag, 0=stop drag) based on which region the cursor occupies.

0x0048dff0.name: StateMachineWithVirtualDispatch
0x0048dff0.label: ScrollStateDispatch
0x0048dff0.summary: Dispatches scroll behavior based on state from ShortComputation_6720. States 1→scroll up (cmd 6), 2→scroll down (cmd 7), 4→scroll left (cmd 8), 5→scroll right (cmd 9). Each state sets a scroll command via vtable+64 and calls refresh via vtable+156.

0x0048e070.name: Constructor_e070
0x0048e070.label: BinkVideoPlayerConstructor
0x0048e070.summary: Constructs a Bink video player object. Calls ShortComputation_5e30 for base init, zeros fields at 0xE0 and 0xE4 (this[56], this[57]), sets field at 0xEC to -1 (this[59]), sets field at 0xE8 to 0 (this[58]), sets vtable to off_5AC3E0, and calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc with null (string reset).

0x0048e0d0.name: sub_48E0D0
0x0048e0d0.label: BinkVideoPlayerDestructor
0x0048e0d0.summary: Destructor for a Bink video player object. Resets vtable to off_5AC3E0, conditionally frees a Bink video resource at this+0xE0 via ConditionalFreeWithBinkClose, frees a secondary allocation at this+0xE8 via FreeWrapper_7bcf, then calls sub_485EB0 for base teardown.

0x0048e110.name: UIScreenSoundResourceLoader
0x0048e110.label: SoundResourceLoader
0x0048e110.summary: Loads a sound resource for a UI screen. Frees any existing Bink sound resource at this+0xE0, constructs a sound object via ObjectCreationWithRollbackOnFailure using the path from this+0xB0 (or default directory), then creates a second resource by concatenating a subdirectory path (dword_5EC3F0) with the screen path, and calls sub_551EB0 to set a DSP transform parameter on success.

0x0048e250.name: UIStringComparison_e250
0x0048e250.label: BinkVideoRenderOrReload
0x0048e250.summary: Compares two stored path strings (this+0xB0 and this+0xE8). If they match and resources are loaded, renders a Bink video frame (via BinkVideoFrameRender) and signals update. If paths differ, calls vtable+160 to reload/reinitialize the video.

0x0048e300.name: ShortComputation_e300
0x0048e300.label: FontResourceConstructor
0x0048e300.summary: Constructs a font resource object. Calls ConstructorWithByteParams for base init, zeros fields at 0xE4 (this[57]) and 0xFC (this[63]), sets field at 0x100 to -1 (this[64]), sets vtable to off_5AC490, and calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc with null to reset string.

0x0048e360.name: UtilityFunction_e360
0x0048e360.label: FontResourceDestructor
0x0048e360.summary: Destructor for a font resource object. Resets vtable to off_5AC490, conditionally frees a Bink video resource at this+0xE4 via ConditionalFreeWithBinkClose, frees a secondary allocation at this+0xFC via FreeWrapper_7bcf, then calls InitWithVTableCleanup for base teardown.

0x0048e3a0.name: FontResourceLoader
0x0048e3a0.label: FontResourceLoader
0x0048e3a0.summary: Loads a font resource for the UI. Frees any existing resource at this+0xE4, constructs a font object path from a base directory (dword_5EC3F0 or default), allocates a 128-byte path buffer, creates the resource via ObjectCreationWithRollbackOnFailure, and extracts font metrics (width/height from offsets +0xC and +0x10 of the created object) if successful. Calls sub_551EB0 to configure a DSP parameter on success.

0x0048e4b0.name: sub_48E4B0
0x0048e4b0.label: BinkVideoFrameRenderOrReload
0x0048e4b0.summary: Compares two path strings (this+0xB0 and this+0xFC). If they differ, calls vtable+160 to reload. If they match and resources are loaded (this+0xE4 non-null, flag at this+0xF8 set), renders a Bink video frame via BinkVideoFrameRender, then copies the rendered surface via Accessor/RenderSurfaceFillCopy, signals update and repaints.

0x0048e5c0.name: ConditionalGeometryDisplayUpdate
0x0048e5c0.label: ConditionalGeometryDisplayUpdate
0x0048e5c0.summary: Calls a virtual method at vtable+160 (0xA0) to check if a video resource needs reloading. If reload is not needed (returns 0), copies the source rectangle (this[58]-this[61]) from the render surface via Accessor/RenderSurfaceFillCopy to update the display.

0x0048e600.name: UIStructInit
0x0048e600.label: UIBaseStructInit
0x0048e600.summary: Initializes base UI struct: calls ShortComputation_5e30 for base init, sets vtable to off_5AC540, zeroes fields at 0xE0/0xE8/0xEC, sets sentinel -1 at 0xE4, copies default directory string. Part of UI object construction.

0x0048e670.name: Destructor_e670
0x0048e670.label: UIObjectStructDestroy
0x0048e670.summary: Destructor for UI struct: restores vtable to off_5AC540 for safe virtual dispatch during destruction, calls ResourceCleanup to release resources, conditionally frees handle at offset 0xE0 if non-null, then chains to base destructor sub_485EB0.

0x0048e6b0.name: DirectoryChangeHandler
0x0048e6b0.label: DirectoryPathChangeComparer
0x0048e6b0.summary: Compares current directory path at offset 0xB8 against stored path at offset 0xE0. If they differ, updates the path buffer and fires a virtual change notification callback at vtable+172. Always invokes refresh virtual method at vtable+44 with argument 1. Appends to a linked list on entry.

0x0048e750.name: ViewportRectangleRenderSetup
0x0048e750.label: ViewportBoundsProjectionSetup
0x0048e750.summary: Reads rectangle bounds from struct fields, optionally computes scaled viewport offsets for HUD/shading using screen scale globals, updates camera projection, and writes computed rectangle to output parameters. Guarded by a child state field check.

0x0048e860.name: UIConditionalVirtualDispatch
0x0048e860.label: ConditionalLinkedListTraversalDispatch
0x0048e860.summary: Guarded dispatch: if field at offset 0xE8 (this[58]) is zero, traverses child linked list via LinkedListTraversalWithVirtualCall and invokes virtual method at vtable+160; otherwise returns the field value as-is (blocking dispatch).

0x0048e890.name: ResourceCleanup
0x0048e890.label: SemaphoreHandleCleanup
0x0048e890.summary: Cleans up a mutex/semaphore resource: if handle at offset 0xE8 is non-zero, calls MutexSemaphoreCleanup and zeroes the handle; also zeroes field at offset 0xEC. Returns 1.

0x0048e8d0.name: CUBESceneLoaderEntry
0x0048e8d0.label: CUBESceneDataLoadEntry
0x0048e8d0.summary: Entry point for loading CUBE scene data: validates directory path matches default, traverses child linked list, attempts audio engine initialization; on failure stores result handle and optionally dispatches fallback utility calls; on success relocates strings and logs debug message on split error.

0x0048e9e0.name: UIStructInit_e9e0
0x0048e9e0.label: UIBaseControlStructInit
0x0048e9e0.summary: Initializes a base UI control struct: sets vtable to off_5A443C, zeroes fields at offsets 0x4/0xC/0x10/0x14/0x18/0x1C/0x20/0x24/0x28, sets sentinel -1 at offset 0x8, copies default directory string. Called by UI object constructors.

0x0048ea60.label: PointInRectHitTest
0x0048ea60.summary: Hit-test: checks if point (a2, a3) lies within the axis-aligned rectangle defined by left (offset 0x14), top (offset 0x18), width (offset 0xC), and height (offset 0x10). Returns 1 if inside, 0 otherwise.

0x0048eaa0.name: LargeConstructor
0x0048eaa0.label: UI Slider Widget Constructor
0x0048eaa0.summary: Constructs a UI slider widget: calls base-class initializer (ShortComputation_5e30) then sets slider-specific fields — zeroes a large float/int region, assigns default slider range (min=1, max=4, current=0.5), marks an invalid/unset ID (-1), and sets a step count (10).

0x0048ebd0.name: UIDimensionCapture
0x0048ebd0.label: UI Element Dimension Measurement & Layout
0x0048ebd0.summary: Captures and computes UI element dimensions (position/size) by querying child widgets via indexed accessors and applying fallback defaults. Part of the UI layout system.

0x0048f0b0.name: ShortComputation_f0b0
0x0048f0b0.label: ClippedRenderBoundsForwarder
0x0048f0b0.summary: Computes clipped viewport rendering bounds: clips source rectangle against offset/scroll position, computes visible x/y dimensions and offsets, retrieves a global rendering value, and forwards all calculated parameters to F_10ParamForwarder for rendering.

0x0048f1a0.name: sub_48F1A0
0x0048f1a0.label: UI Tile Grid Cursor Input Handler
0x0048f1a0.summary: Processes cursor/touch position within a UI tile grid widget: reads two-axis coordinate from a sub-object via DualFieldRead, checks if the position falls inside predefined rectangular regions (tiles), transitions between interaction states (hover, select, activate), and dispatches virtual-method callbacks for rendering and state updates.

0x0048f300.name: StateResetConditionalVirtualCall
0x0048f300.label: StateFlagResetWithVirtualDispatch
0x0048f300.summary: Resets byte flags at offsets 0x17D and 0x17E to zero. If state field at offset 0x104 is NOT equal to 4, resets it to 0 and invokes virtual method at vtable+64 with argument 0.

0x0048f330.name: FieldSetterWithVTableDispatch
0x0048f330.label: StateSentinelResetDispatch
0x0048f330.summary: Zeroes byte flag at offset 0x17F, sets dword at offset 0x170 to -1 (sentinel), and invokes virtual method at vtable+44 with argument 1.

0x0048f590.name: LinkedListIndexedAccessor_f590
0x0048f590.label: LinkedListElementByIndex
0x0048f590.summary: Accesses the Nth element in a linked list by index: validates index against list count, traverses list nodes starting from head pointer (offset 0xF0) using next pointers (offset +4), returns data pointer of matched node or 0 if out of bounds or not found.

0x0048f5d0.name: DoublyLinkedListAppend_f5d0
0x0048f5d0.label: DoublyLinkedListNodeAppend
0x0048f5d0.summary: Appends a new node containing data pointer and byte flag to a doubly linked list. Allocates 16-byte node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, initializes node fields (data, next=0, prev=0, flag), updates head/tail/cursor pointers, and increments element count.

0x0048f640.name: UIViewportLayoutCalculator
0x0048f640.label: TileGridLayoutCalculator
0x0048f640.summary: Computes tile grid layout dimensions for a viewport: reads available width/height, iterates child linked list to find max tile dimensions, calculates row and column counts based on layout mode (0=vertical, 1=horizontal), and handles overflow by invoking state reset virtual method. Calls UITileGrid to update tile positions.

0x0048f870.name: UITileGrid
0x0048f870.label: tile grid layout calculator
0x0048f870.summary: Computes screen positions for tiles in a grid-based UI layout. Iterates over row/column counts, walks a linked list of tile nodes to find valid tiles, calculates X/Y positions accounting for alignment (left/center/right), and calls sub_48EA20 to place each tile.

0x0048f9f0.name: UIWindowTextSetup
0x0048f9f0.label: UITextWindowConfigLoader
0x0048f9f0.summary: Loads and configures UI text window properties from configuration files: builds file path from directory, searches for .HOT extension files, loads two resources via SingleFunctionCallWrapper_7f59 into fields at 0x154 and 0x150, and determines layout mode (offset 0xE0) by comparing loaded file extension against known tokens (.c=1, .R=2, else 0).

0x0048faf0.name: DecrementCounterWithClamp
0x0048faf0.label: ScrollOffsetDecrementClamp
0x0048faf0.summary: Decrements the scroll offset counter (offset 0x168) by the given amount (or by the value at offset 0x178 if negative), clamps result to minimum 0, then calls UITileGrid to recalculate tile positions.

0x0048fb30.name: sub_48FB30
0x0048fb30.label: ScrollOffsetIncrementClamp
0x0048fb30.summary: Increments the scroll offset counter (offset 0x168) by the given amount (or by default value from offset 0x178 if negative), clamps result to maximum at offset 0x16C, then calls UITileGrid to recalculate tile positions.

0x0048fb70.name: ShortComputation_fb70
0x0048fb70.label: UIObjectVariantStructInit
0x0048fb70.summary: Initializes a UI struct variant: calls ShortComputation_5e30 for base init, sets vtable to off_5AC5F0, zeroes field at 0xE0, sets sentinel -1 at 0xE4. A simpler init variant compared to UIStructInit_0048e600 (fewer fields initialized).

0x0048fc10.name: UtilityFunction_fc10
0x0048fc10.label: CachedValueSyncDispatch
0x0048fc10.summary: Reads a value from a referenced object at offset 0x254 (this[56]+372) and compares it with cached field at 0xE4 (this[57]). If they differ, updates the cache and invokes virtual method at vtable+44 with argument 1 to signal change. Always calls virtual method at vtable+168 for final dispatch.

0x0048fc50.name: UIObjectConstructor_fc50
0x0048fc50.label: HUDTextNodeConstructor
0x0048fc50.summary: Constructor for a UI object: calls UIStructInit_e9e0 to initialize base struct, then zeroes field at offset 0x30, sets sentinel -1 at offset 0x34, zeroes field at offset 0x38, and sets vtable to off_5A4450 (VTable_HUDTextNode).

0x0048fc80.name: StructFieldCopy_fc80
0x0048fc80.label: ExternalBoundsFieldCopy
0x0048fc80.summary: Copies rectangle dimensions from an external source struct into local fields: stores source pointer at offset 0x38, reads rectangle width from *(src+12)+28 into offset 0xC, and reads rectangle height from *(src+12)+32 into offset 0x10. Returns the source structure pointer.

0x0048fca0.name: BitmapBlitWithClipping
0x0048fca0.label: BlitClipped
0x0048fca0.summary: Performs bitmap blit with source/destination rectangle clipping for a UI rendering system. Reads source bitmap data and destination bounds from this-context, clips source offset and dimensions against destination boundaries, then dispatches to final blit function.

0x0048fd60.name: Constructor_fd60
0x0048fd60.label: UIStructConstructor
0x0048fd60.summary: Constructor for a UI structure. Calls base init, sets vtable pointer, and zero-initializes a field.

0x0048fd80.name: DestructorWithConditionalFree_fd80
0x0048fd80.label: ConditionalDestructorFree
0x0048fd80.summary: Destructor that conditionally frees a child pointer and optionally frees self based on a flag. Part of a UI control object lifecycle.

0x0048fdb0.name: ViewportRectSizeCalc
0x0048fdb0.label: ViewportRectSizeCalc
0x0048fdb0.summary: Calculates viewport rectangle dimensions from a bounding box and stores them into the this-struct. Part of a UI layout system.

0x0048fdf0.name: ConditionalDispatchWithCleanup
0x0048fdf0.label: ConditionalDispatchCleanup
0x0048fdf0.summary: Conditionally dispatches a cleanup/delegation operation on a sub-object. Loads a pointer from this context, calls a delegation function with offset data, accumulates position offset, and invokes a vtable method.

0x0048fe30.name: sub_48FE30
0x0048fe30.label: VTableDoubleDispatchConditional
0x0048fe30.summary: Dispatches two vtable calls on a sub-object: first a method at vtable+60, then coerces its result based on whether input `a2` is zero, and passes that to a second method at vtable+56. Used for conditional UI state propagation.

0x0048fe60.name: UIComponentInit5
0x0048fe60.label: UICompInit5
0x0048fe60.summary: Initialization function for a UI component. Calls base initializer, sets vtable pointer, and initializes two fields to default values (1 and 0).

0x0048feb0.name: VTableSubInit
0x0048feb0.label: VTableSubInit
0x0048feb0.summary: Sets vtable pointer on this object and delegates rest of initialization to a sub-initializer. Part of a UI component construction chain.

0x0048fec0.name: ShortComputation_fec0
0x0048fec0.label: ShortComputation
0x0048fec0.summary: Dispatches a vtable method with a state flag, then runs window type detection. Part of a UI component update cycle.

0x0048fee0.name: UIFullRenderWithDimensions
0x0048fee0.label: UIFullRenderWithDimensions
0x0048fee0.summary: Full UI render function that positions and draws text/bitmap content with clipping against viewport bounds. Reads rendering dimensions, string resource, and mode flag to select between different draw paths. Updates output position pointers.

0x004900a0.name: sub_4900A0
0x004900a0.label: UIStateToggleOnHitTest
0x004900a0.summary: Tests if a cursor/input position falls within a computed bounding region; if so, toggles a state flag (0→1, 1→0, 2 stays 2). Then dispatches vtable methods with updated state. Part of UI interactive element handling.

0x00490160.name: BooleanFlagSetterVirtualCall
0x00490160.label: BoolFlagSetVirtualCall
0x00490160.summary: Sets a boolean state flag (0 or 1) based on input parameter, then dispatches a vtable method. Used for UI toggle/hover state management.

0x00490190.name: ZeroCheckGetter
0x00490190.label: ZeroCheckGetter
0x00490190.summary: Returns whether a state flag at offset 0xE0 is zero. Simple boolean getter for UI component state.

0x004901a0.name: UIWindowTypeDetection
0x004901a0.label: UIWindowTypeDetection
0x004901a0.summary: Classifies a UI window by matching its name/path string against known patterns ("UI_Load", ".c", ".r") and sets a type field accordingly. Used to determine render/behavior mode.

0x00490250.name: ObjectInitWithFieldZeroing_0250
0x00490250.label: WidgetListInit
0x00490250.summary: Initializes a UI widget list object: calls base init, zeroes five state fields, and sets vtable pointer.

0x004902c0.name: LinkedListDestructorWithVTableNotification
0x004902c0.label: LinkedListDtorNotify
0x004902c0.summary: Destructor for a linked list of widget nodes. Iterates the list, conditionally dispatches vtable notification on each node before freeing it, then zeroes list fields and calls base destructor.

0x00490330.name: sub_490330
0x00490330.label: StateDispatchGroupsA
0x00490330.summary: State-based dispatch using ShortComputation_6720 result: groups 0-2 select param 2, groups 3-5 select param 5 for vtable method at offset 64. Then calls vtable method at offset 152 and iterates child dispatch list.

0x00490390.name: sub_490390
0x00490390.label: StateDispatchGroupsB
0x00490390.summary: State-based dispatch using ShortComputation_6720 result: groups 0-2 select param 4, groups 3-5 select param 1 for vtable method at offset 64. Then calls vtable method at offset 156 and iterates child dispatch list.

0x004903f0.name: UtilityFunction_03f0
0x004903f0.label: StateDispatchGroupsC
0x004903f0.summary: State-based dispatch using ShortComputation_6720 result: groups 0-2 select arg 1, groups 3-5 select arg 4 for vtable method at offset 64. Then iterates child dispatch list.

0x00490450.name: UIWidgetProcessChildren
0x00490450.label: UIWidgetProcessChildren
0x00490450.summary: Processes child widgets by reading input position and checking bounds intersection. For state groups 3-5, iterates the child linked list and dispatches a hit notification when a child rectangle contains the input position.

0x00490550.name: PanelMouseInteractionHandler
0x00490550.label: PanelMouseInteraction
0x00490550.summary: Handles mouse/input interaction for a panel: for state groups 3-5, reads input position, tests against a custom hit-test vtable method, then iterates child widgets and dispatches hit notification on bounds match. Always iterates child dispatch list.

0x00490640.name: VTableDispatchInit
0x00490640.label: VTableDispatchInit
0x00490640.summary: Dispatches vtable method at offset 64 with arg 0, then iterates the child dispatch list. Entry point for initializing or resetting widget dispatch state.

0x00490660.name: VTableDispatchListIteration
0x00490660.label: VTableDispatchListIteration
0x00490660.summary: Iterates a linked list of child widgets and dispatches a vtable method at offset 16 on each, passing a boolean flag derived from state computation. Used for broadcasting state/flag changes to children.

0x004906e0.name: CustomMemoryPoolAllocatorInit
0x004906e0.label: CustomPoolAllocInit
0x004906e0.summary: Initializes a custom memory pool allocator system: allocates pool struct, creates 32-entry memory pool with thunk-initialized entries, builds free list, and stores pool descriptor and allocator handle in globals. Registers teardown callback.

0x00490850.name: ResourceLinkedListTeardown
0x00490850.label: PoolAllocTeardown
0x00490850.summary: Tears down the custom memory pool allocator system. Frees allocator handle, walks used and free linked lists to release resources with conditional cleanup routines, zeroes list fields, then frees the pool descriptor itself.

0x00490940.name: ResourcePoolNodeAllocDealloc
0x00490940.label: PoolNodePopOrAlloc
0x00490940.summary: Pool node allocator: tries to pop a node from global pool's free list; if empty, allocates + initializes new node and appends to pool. Runs secondary dealloc-walk to remove a matching value node. Ends with ShortComputation_16e0 on inputs.

0x00490b00.name: sub_490B00
0x00490b00.label: FixedBucketArrayInit
0x00490b00.summary: Constructor/initializer for a fixed-capacity bucket array struct. Zeros 12 DWORD state fields, stores element count in `this[0]`, allocates and zeros a 16-byte-per-element array, stores pointer in `this[2]`.

0x00490b90.name: MultiListDestruction
0x00490b90.label: MultiLinkedListDestructor
0x00490b90.summary: Destructor for a struct containing 3 embedded linked lists and an array of list elements. Destroys all list iterators, frees each list's nodes (with conditional ShortComputation_1e60 for active entries), frees the array, zeroes the struct.

0x00490d00.name: sub_490D00
0x00490d00.label: BroadphasePairPartition
0x00490d00.summary: Iterates two collision-proxy lists (outer a2, inner a1) testing AABB overlap between each pair. Non-overlapping pairs are refined via RectangleClipping; overlapping pairs are removed from pending list. Partitioning step in broadphase collision pipeline.

0x00490ee0.name: CollisionBroadphaseBuilder
0x00490ee0.label: BroadphaseListBuilder
0x00490ee0.summary: Builds/updates broadphase collision list: takes input list a1 and new AABB (a2-a5), filters existing entries via sub_491680, clips overlapping entries into subdivisions, calls BroadphasePairPartition (sub_490D00) to finalize partitioning. Core broadphase update step.

0x004910d0.name: ListIteratorFullDestruction
0x004910d0.label: ListDetachAndFreeAll
0x004910d0.summary: Full destruction of a doubly-linked list sentinel struct: first reparents each node's value elsewhere via LinkedListNodePrepend, then frees all node memory (calling EmptyStub_0170 on values if flags indicate active). Zeros the 4-DWORD struct.

0x00491170.name: CollisionBroadphaseTraversal
0x00491170.label: BroadphaseRecursiveTraversal
0x00491170.summary: Recursive broadphase AABB traversal: walks list testing overlap via AABBOverlapTest; if no direct hit but sub_491680 filter passes, clips rectangle and recurses on subdivisions. Returns 1 on any overlap, 0 if list exhausted.

0x00491280.name: sub_491280
0x00491280.label: BroadphaseFindByFilter
0x00491280.summary: Walks broadphase list applying sub_491680 filter on each node's AABB. Returns 1 on first match, 0 if list exhausted with no match. Simpler than the recursive traversal — no clipping or overlap test.

0x00491300.name: MultiShortStructWriter
0x00491300.label: RectOrAABBInitializer
0x00491300.summary: Initializes a struct with 4 shorts (AABB/rect coordinates) at offsets 0x0-0x6 and zeros a DWORD at offset 0xC. Simple struct constructor.

0x00491350.name: RectangleClipping
0x00491350.label: RectDifferenceClipping
0x00491350.summary: Clips one rectangle (subject, from this[0..3]) against a boundary rectangle (a2..a5). Returns a linked list of rectangles representing the area of the subject that lies outside the boundary. Uses 3×3 spatial subdivision.

0x004915a0.name: AABBOverlapTest
0x004915a0.label: AABBContainmentCheck
0x004915a0.summary: Tests if the `this` AABB (x1, y1, width, height) is fully contained within boundary AABB (a2, a3, a4, a5). Requires top-left corner inside boundary AND bottom-right corner not exceeding boundary edges.

0x00491600.name: RectangleClampConstraint
0x00491600.label: RectClampToBounds
0x00491600.summary: Clamps a short[4] rect (x1, y1, width, height) in-place to fit within boundary (a2, a3, a2+a4, a3+a5). Adjusts width/height when position shifts. Used for render/viewport clipping.

0x00491770.name: sub_491770
0x00491770.label: ArrayAndIteratorDestructor
0x00491770.summary: Destructor for a struct containing an array of list iterators plus two embedded iterators. Destroys each array element (16-byte stride) via ListIteratorFullDestruction, then destroys the embedded iterators at offsets 0xC and 0x1C.

0x004917c0.name: CircularBufferRingAdvance
0x004917c0.label: CircularBufferAgeAndEvict
0x004917c0.summary: Advances circular buffer index (conditional on race phase timer), destroys two embedded list iterators, then processes the ring slot at current index: increments age counter on each node (up to 3), evicts and frees aged-out nodes, prepends their values elsewhere.

0x004918d0.name: RenderSurfaceFillCopy
0x004918d0.label: UpdateBroadphaseRegion
0x004918d0.summary: Dispatches broadphase collision update for screen region (a2-a5). If race phase timer allows, updates all stored broadphase structures; otherwise updates only current ring-bucket slot. Called from many render paths.

0x004919c0.name: sub_4919C0
0x004919c0.label: PoolNodeAppendToList
0x004919c0.summary: Gets a pool node for AABB (a2-a5), wraps it in a 12-byte list node, and appends to a linked list embedded at offset 12 in `*this`. Returns 1 on success, 0 if pool node unavailable.

0x00491a40.name: LinkedListNodeUnlinkByContent
0x00491a40.label: UnlinkNodeByContentReparent
0x00491a40.summary: Reads reference node at struct offset 16, prepends its content to another list, then walks the list at offset 12 to find and unlink a matching node. Frees the unlinked node (and its value if flagged). Returns 1 on success.

0x00491ad0.name: CollisionProxyListBuilder
0x00491ad0.label: RebuildCollisionProxyList
0x00491ad0.summary: Rebuilds collision proxy working list at header offset 28: clears it, then iterates two source lists (ring buffer slot + embedded list at offset 44), copies each node's AABB into a pool node and appends to working list. Then calls BroadphasePairPartition between working list and list at offset 12.

0x00491bd0.name: SubListWalkDestruction
0x00491bd0.label: EmbeddedListWalkDestroy
0x00491bd0.summary: Destroys an embedded linked list at `*this + 12`: prepends each node's value to another list (reparent), then frees all node memory (with conditional value free). Zeros the 4-DWORD list sentinel.

0x00491cf0.name: LinkedListFollow0x1cPointer
0x00491cf0.label: FollowPointerAndStore
0x00491cf0.summary: Reads pointer at struct offset 0x1C, copies it to offset 0x24, then dereferences it and returns the first DWORD. Simple linked-list node follower.

0x00491d10.name: LinkedListFieldReader
0x00491d10.label: LinkedListAdvanceAndRead
0x00491d10.summary: Advances linked list iterator stored at struct offset 0x24: if current node pointer is non-null, follows its next pointer (+4) to advance. Returns first DWORD of new current node, or 0 if end of list.

0x00491d30.name: LinkedListNodeRemovalByValue
0x00491d30.label: Remove linked list node by value match
0x00491d30.summary: Removes first node from singly-linked list whose first DWORD matches the value parameter. Updates head/tail/cached-end pointers, decrements count, optionally frees node data payload.

0x00491db0.name: LinkedListDestructor_1db0
0x00491db0.label: Destroy linked list and free all nodes
0x00491db0.summary: Iterates linked list, frees each node's data payload (if ownership flag at node+0x8 is set), frees each node, then zeros list header fields (head, tail, iterator, count).

0x00491ee0.name: FileOpenWrapperWithModeCheck
0x00491ee0.label: Open audio file read/write streams
0x00491ee0.summary: Opens file read stream ("rb" mode) and optionally write stream ("wt" mode) for audio buffering. If write mode flag at this+410 is set but write stream creation fails, clears the flag.

0x00491f60.name: TripleFieldCleanup
0x00491f60.label: Close streams and zero three resource handles
0x00491f60.summary: Closes/dispatches three stream/resource handles (audio file read, file write streams), then zeros their slots. Called during audio resource cleanup.

0x00491fb0.name: sub_491FB0
0x00491fb0.label: Read line and count tokens in text parser
0x00491fb0.summary: Reads a line of input text via LineInputReader, increments line counter at this[99], and increments special-token counter at this[100] when the parsed token type is 1, 3, or 4. Used by the UI/text parser system.

0x00492030.name: TokenMatchingLoop
0x00492030.label: Match brace/bracket pairs and count nesting
0x00492030.summary: Parses tokenized input tracking brace/bracket nesting depth using a counter. Skips past delimiters, then matches open/close tokens to find matching pairs. Decrements this[101] (nesting counter).

0x004920b0.name: sub_4920B0
0x004920b0.label: Load MAS resource files with error reporting
0x004920b0.summary: Reads up to 32 lines of text, attempts to load each as a MAS (bitmap) file via BitmapLoader. Reports errors to UI buffer on failure. Resets audio buffer before and after.

0x00492160.name: sub_492160
0x00492160.label: ParseOptionsScreenConfigFile
0x00492160.summary: Parses an options screen configuration (.OSC) file line-by-line, reading named sections (Attributeset, Layer, Gizmo, Dopage, Loadingscreenp, Systemfont, Tooltipfont, TooltipColor, SetSymbol, DisableGizmo) and dispatching to type-specific handlers to build and configure UI elements.

0x00492460.name: sub_492460
0x00492460.label: UILayerDefinitionParser
0x00492460.summary: Parses a UI layer definition string and dispatches to type-specific handlers (normal, modal, name, sound focus/lost-focus, gizmo, page) — constructing layer objects, loading textures, and building the UI layer tree.

0x00492710.name: sub_492710
0x00492710.label: UIElementConfigParser
0x00492710.summary: Parses a stream of UI element configuration tokens and processes them into a tree structure. Handles tokens for name, location, position/size, surface, gizmo, enter-target, and escape-target, building up a UI element node in a tree.

0x00492a40.name: sub_492A40
0x00492a40.label: GizmoDefinitionParser
0x00492a40.summary: Parses a gizmo/widget definition string (type name, position, size, attributes, actions, children, friend gizmos) token-by-token, constructing a gizmo object tree with linked properties. Supports recursive child gizmo parsing. Part of the UI gizmo/layout definition system.

0x00493060.name: sub_493060
0x00493060.label: UI widget property parser
0x00493060.summary: Parses key-value property definitions for a UI widget — reads string-keyed properties (fonts, sounds, sizes, offsets, frames) from the `this` object, dispatches each to the appropriate handler to configure widget attributes (font paths, sound effects, dimension/offset values, frame settings). Part of the UI layout/definition system.

0x00493480.name: sub_493480
0x00493480.label: UIActionCommandParser
0x00493480.summary: Parses UI action commands from a token stream, allocating typed action nodes (1-12) and appending them to an event-linked list based on trigger type (click, release, focus, lostfocus). Handles DoPage, DoPageTransition, DoLayer, SetSymbol, DropPopups, ExitGame, SimulateClick, and TransitionAttr commands.

0x00493990.name: sub_493990
0x00493990.label: Parse UI surface block with animation properties
0x00493990.summary: Parses a UI surface definition block from text input: reads location, position/size, surface name, animation delta/rule/subframe tokens. Creates surface objects via sub_499F70, sets animation properties. Uses nesting counter at this[101] for recursive sub-element parsing.

0x00493c80.name: sub_493C80
0x00493c80.label: Display OSC script error/warning message
0x00493c80.summary: Formats and displays error/warning messages from OSC script parser with severity levels (Undefined/Warning/Error/CriticalError). Opens log file stream if not already open, writes formatted message. Shows MessageBox for Error/CriticalError severity if callback mode not active.

0x00493e20.name: ResourcePathBuilder
0x00493e20.label: Build resource file path with directory prefix
0x00493e20.summary: Constructs a resource file path by prepending directory traversal prefix ("..\\" or ".HOT\\") based on parser nesting depth, then appends the filename. Outputs to write stream if write mode is enabled.

0x00493f50.name: sub_493F50
0x00493f50.label: Initialize OSC parser state structure
0x00493f50.summary: Zero-initializes the OSC script parser state structure: clears counters, flags, and pointers at the beginning of the struct, and sets default log file paths ("Log\\osc.information" and "Log\\osc.err") in the string buffer region.

0x00493fc0.name: sub_493FC0
0x00493fc0.label: UIWidgetFactoryByName
0x00493fc0.summary: Creates or retrieves a UI widget by name lookup: first searches the child widget container (this+0x1A4) for an existing instance, then falls back to instantiating one of 23 known widget types by matching the name against a keyword table (off_5CC270). After creation, optionally decorates the widget with a "Prelinked Gizmo - <name>" label via sub_493C80. Part of the UI widget instantiation/factory system.

0x00494470.name: UIDestructorWithSelfFree
0x00494470.label: UI object destructor with self-free
0x00494470.summary: Sets vtable pointer, calls base destructor sub_485EB0, and optionally frees the object allocation if the flag parameter has bit 0 set.

0x004944a0.name: sub_4944A0
0x004944a0.label: Initialize and run OSC script parser
0x004944a0.summary: Initializes the OSC script engine: stores parser parameters, opens file streams, loads MAS resources, optionally loads intro/bik videos and legal screen, runs script parser sub_492160, then closes streams.

0x00494600.name: CollisionGlobalZeroing
0x00494600.label: Zero collision system globals
0x00494600.summary: Zeros four collision system global counters/state variables at 0x7CDDF0-0x7CDDFC. Called during collision system reset or shutdown.

0x00494630.name: LinkedListCleanupDestroy
0x00494630.label: Destroy collision system linked list
0x00494630.summary: Destroys collision system linked list anchored at dword_7CDDF0: iterates nodes, calls EmptyStub_7470 and frees data payload if ownership flag at node+0x8 is set, frees each node, then zeroes all four collision global counters.

0x00494690.name: sub_494690
0x00494690.label: Initialize rendering surfaces and texture coordinates
0x00494690.summary: Allocates and initializes three rendering surface objects (A-buffer 512x512, B-buffer 1024x1024, S-buffer 256x256) for the video/renderer system. Configures texture coordinate UV mappings for screen quad rendering.

0x00494900.name: CollisionSystemShutdownCleanup
0x00494900.label: Shut down rendering surface system
0x00494900.summary: Cleans up all rendering surface allocations and collision sound handles during system shutdown. Destructs A/B/S buffers and collision sound objects via ResourceCascadeCleanup/DestructorWithConditionalFreeFlagClear, then frees memory and zeros globals.

0x00494a70.name: F_2DScreenQuadRender
0x00494a70.label: Render 2D textured screen quad
0x00494a70.summary: Renders a clipped 2D textured quad on screen. Clamps width/height to [0,256], sets up rendering region, configures four-corner texture UV coordinates with 1/256 scale, and draws via sub_553700.

0x00494c80.name: F_2DLineRectClipping
0x00494c80.label: Clip line segment against axis-aligned rectangle
0x00494c80.summary: Clips a 2D line segment against a rectangle (width/height taken from a struct). Returns true if the clipped line has non-zero length and is visible.

0x00494de0.name: CollisionNodeAllocator
0x00494de0.label: Allocate and append collision node
0x00494de0.summary: Allocates a 12-byte collision linked list node (data ptr + next ptr + flag byte), sets its data pointer from parameter, and appends it to the global collision list at dword_7CDDF0. Updates tail pointer and increments counter.

0x00494e60.name: CollisionGeometryFreeList
0x00494e60.label: Free collision geometry string list
0x00494e60.summary: Processes collision geometry linked list: walks nodes calling StringCompareLinkedListSearch on each data payload, then frees all nodes and their data, and zeroes the four collision global counters.

0x00494f10.name: UIMessageDispatch
0x00494f10.label: Dispatch UI message with optional string table lookup
0x00494f10.summary: Dispatches a UI message via sub_53D2E0. When a6 flag is set, looks up the message string in a binary string table (byte_5EC4C0) and copies the translated/buffered version to byte_5EC4CC before dispatch.

0x00495020.name: MultiStepInitSequence
0x00495020.label: Render frame with state flag computation
0x00495020.summary: Performs a render frame operation: initializes timing, draws via render device (sub_553700), computes state flags (StateFlagComputation), and resets timing. Used in file loading retry loop.

0x00495080.name: sub_495080
0x00495080.label: Render frame with state flag computation (duplicate)
0x00495080.summary: Performs a render frame operation: initializes timing, draws via render device (sub_553700), computes state flags (StateFlagComputation), and resets timing. Functionally identical to MultiStepInitSequence (00495020).

0x004950e0.name: RenderFrameWrapper
0x004950e0.label: Simple render frame wrapper
0x004950e0.summary: Performs a minimal render frame operation: initializes timing, draws via render device (sub_553700), and resets timing. Lacks StateFlagComputation call compared to similar frame functions (00495020, 00495080).

0x00495120.name: GlobalFieldReader
0x00495120.label: ReadRenderDeviceFields
0x00495120.summary: Reads two DWORD fields at offsets 0x1C and 0x20 from the render device struct (dword_8B8DC8) into caller-supplied output pointers. Provides viewport or render-surface dimension retrieval for the UI/render system.

0x00495190.name: LargeStructZeroInit
0x00495190.label: Screen UI Structure Initialization
0x00495190.summary: Initializes a large screen/UI data structure (0x18EC+ bytes): zeros most fields, sets sentinel values (-1 for unsigned max), initializes sub-objects via helper constructors, and assigns a vtable pointer. Part of the screen-data initialization system called during game setup.

0x00495300.name: sub_495300
0x00495300.label: Track Database Object Destructor
0x00495300.summary: Destructor for the track database object: cleans up linked lists of track segments and curve data, frees heap-allocated memory arrays, invokes virtual destructors on child objects with vtable checks, and zeros all internal pointer fields to prevent dangling references.

0x00495440.name: FPSOverlayDraw
0x00495440.label: DrawFPSOverlay
0x00495440.summary: Calculates and renders FPS overlay text on screen. Checks config array for FPS-display toggle (value 0x1021), accumulates frame delta time, computes integer FPS, formats as string, and draws via surface/bitmap operations.

0x00495580.name: UIComboListRender
0x00495580.label: ComboBoxItemRender
0x00495580.summary: Renders a combo box / dropdown list item with text label and background fill. Reads driver/device name string, renders it to a surface, computes centered position clamped to 800x600, and draws a background rect (animated scale or full size). Part of the UI widget rendering system.

0x004957a0.name: UIClickEventDispatch
0x004957a0.label: UIClickEventDispatch
0x004957a0.summary: Dispatches click/input events (type 1 = left click, type 28 = right click/context) by reading handler strings from nested pointer chain and forwarding to sub_4988D0. After processing events, calls virtual method (vtable slot 8) for default event forwarding. Part of the UI widget event system.

0x00495810.name: StringNormalizeLookup
0x00495810.label: StringNormalizeHashLookup
0x00495810.summary: Normalizes an input string (via sub_589901), looks it up in a hash table (dword_5CC79C). If not found, constructs a compound key by appending the hash bucket head value and a file-extension byte, then allocates a collision node via CollisionNodeAllocator. Part of the collision/asset name resolution system.

0x00495890.name: HashTableIDResolution
0x00495890.label: StringHashIDResolve
0x00495890.summary: Formats an input string into a global format buffer (unk_7CDE38), then resolves it via ShortComputation_4fb0 to verify it exists in a hash/ID table. Returns the original string on success (resolved) or NULL on failure. Part of the asset/hash-table name resolution system.

0x00495930.name: TreeWalkerVirtualCallRecurse
0x00495930.label: TreeWalkRecurseVirtual
0x00495930.summary: Recursively walks a tree structure invoking a virtual callback (vtable slot 40) on each node, then recursing into the child subtree (offset 0x90), and iterating to the sibling node (offset 0x118). Returns 0 on successful full traversal, -1 on NULL input. Part of a UI or scene-graph tree walker.

0x00495980.name: ObjectSearchWithDoubleIteration
0x00495980.label: ObjectSearchTwoPass
0x00495980.summary: Two-pass object search: iterates a primary list (from SimpleFieldGetter), calling a virtual match function (vtable slot 12) against criteria at offsets 0x5C and 0x60. If no match found, falls back to a secondary list (from sub_498E40 + offset 68). Returns first matching object or NULL. Part of the UI/widget object lookup system.

0x00495a20.name: DoublyLinkedListNodeUnlink
0x00495a20.label: DoublyLinkedListUnlink
0x00495a20.summary: Unlinks a node from a doubly-linked list. Walks the list from head (offset 0x14) following next pointers (offset 0x64) to locate the target node, then splices it out by updating adjacent nodes' prev/next pointers and adjusting list head/tail (offsets 0x14, 0x18) if needed. Part of the generic doubly-linked list management system.

0x00495a80.name: DoublyLinkedListAppend_5a80
0x00495a80.label: DoublyLinkedListAppend
0x00495a80.summary: Appends a node to the tail of a doubly-linked list. First unlinks the node from its current list (via DoublyLinkedListNodeUnlink), zeroes its next/prev pointers, then walks to the list tail and splices the node in. If list is empty, sets head and tail to the new node. Part of generic doubly-linked list management.

0x00495ae0.name: sub_495AE0
0x00495ae0.label: ListTailPopAndRenderDispatch
0x00495ae0.summary: Pops the tail node from a doubly-linked list (when list has ≥2 nodes), reads 4 rectangle parameters from the node (offsets 4, 8, 12, 16), dispatches a sub-rectangle render via GuardedSubRectangleRenderDispatch, then zeroes the popped node's prev/next pointers. Part of a UI sub-rectangle render queue.

0x00495b30.name: ShortComputation_5b30
0x00495b30.label: RenderQueueDrainLoop
0x00495b30.summary: Drains a render-queue list by repeatedly popping the tail node (via sub_495AE0) while the list has elements (tail at 0x18 is non-null) and a condition check (ShortComputation_8f70 returns 1) permits processing. Part of the UI sub-rectangle render dispatch system.

0x00495b60.name: sub_495B60
0x00495b60.label: AnimationSlotCompactAndProcess
0x00495b60.summary: Processes a fixed array of 4 animation/effect slots (each 12 bytes, starting at offset 0x15FC). Decrements a float timer at 0xC0, checks each slot against a threshold, and compacts valid entries by copying data forward and initializing empty slots. Part of the UI/animation effect lifecycle system.

0x00495bd0.name: UITextDialogRendering
0x00495bd0.label: TextDialogRender
0x00495bd0.summary: Renders a multi-option text dialog from 4 active-entry slots (each 12 bytes, starting at offset 0x15FC). Iterates slots, measures text dimensions via TextRenderToSurface, computes layout clamped to 800x600, draws background/shadow for the first entry, renders each entry's text, dispatches UI messages, and fills the final render surface. Part of the UI text dialog system.

0x00495dc0.name: sub_495DC0
0x00495dc0.label: CarDamageImpactRender
0x00495dc0.summary: Renders car crash damage impact rectangles. Two modes: state==0 draws a single static damage rectangle at computed position; state==1 draws 80 stepping damage rectangles as an animated crack-spread effect over 800x600 screen space. Uses CollisionNoiseGenerator for per-frame noise and F_10ParamForwarder for rectangle rendering. Part of the car crash damage display system.

0x00496030.name: CarCrashDamageProcessing
0x00496030.label: CarCrashDamageProcess
0x00496030.summary: Processes car crash damage animation over its lifecycle. On initial frame (timer == 0.01f), randomly selects impact origin from 8 screen-edge directions. Each frame decrements the damage timer, renders impact damage rectangles via sub_495DC0, and cleans up when timer expires. Part of the vehicle crash damage display system.

0x00496280.name: FloatArrayInitWithRandom
0x00496280.label: FloatArrayInitUniform
0x00496280.summary: Initializes 16 consecutive floats at offset 0x162C with values from 0.0 to 0.9375 in steps of 0.0625 (i/16). Calls sub_5881F0 for each value as a seed/transform step. Part of a lookup table or noise initialization system.

0x004962c0.name: CollisionNoiseGenerator
0x004962c0.label: LookupTableNoiseInterp
0x004962c0.summary: Generates a noise value from a 16-entry float lookup table (at float[1419] = offset 0x162C) using linear interpolation between adjacent entries. Applies an optional per-sample transform (sub_5881F0) when the blend parameter a3 >= 0. Used by the collision damage system for impact visual variation.

0x00496380.name: sub_496380
0x00496380.label: TitleSplashResourceLoad
0x00496380.summary: Loads a title screen bitmap resource — either the default game title (aGametitleBmp) or a magazine/promotional splash (aPmbeltiteMag) depending on the PhotoFreeCameraFlag. Falls back to the default title if the magazine load fails. Part of the boot/title screen resource loading system.

0x004963c0.name: FieldSetter_63c0
0x004963c0.label: FlagSetter_0x28_Enable
0x004963c0.summary: Sets the DWORD at offset 0x28 to 1 and returns 0. A simple boolean flag enable/setter function for an object state.

0x004963d0.name: sub_4963D0
0x004963d0.label: GlobalResourceManagerShutdown
0x004963d0.summary: Iterates through all internal linked lists of managed resources (generic objects, collision geometry, cursor textures, MAS audio handles), calls each resource's destructor via vtable dispatch, and frees memory. Part of the global manager shutdown sequence executed on game exit.

0x00496560.name: sub_496560
0x00496560.label: LargeStructDefaultValueInitializer
0x00496560.summary: Initializes a large data structure (vehicle or pit-crew state) with default float values, zeroes byte flags, sets scalar constants, and seeds random values. One-time constructor-style initialization with no branches.

0x004966e0.name: LinkedListNodeInsert_66e0
0x004966e0.label: DoublyLinkedListNodeAppend
0x004966e0.summary: Appends a node containing value a2 to a doubly-linked list. Allocates a 16-byte node (value + 4/8/12: next, prev, byte), initializes it, links it after the tail, updates tail pointer, and increments the count. If list is empty, initializes head, tail, and a secondary pointer to the new node. Part of a generic doubly-linked list with counted nodes.

0x00496750.name: DoublyLinkedListAppend_6750
0x00496750.label: DoublyLinkedListAppendWithFlag
0x00496750.summary: Appends a node with value a2 to a doubly-linked list, allocating a 16-byte node (value + next + prev + byte). If a3 is non-zero, sets a flag byte at offset 0x24 to 1. Otherwise identical to the standard append pattern: links after tail, increments count, initializes head/secondary on first insertion. Returns a3. Part of a flagged doubly-linked list system.

0x004967d0.name: DoublyLinkedListAppend_67d0
0x004967d0.label: DoublyLinkedListAppend_18CC
0x004967d0.summary: Appends a node containing value a2 to a doubly-linked list (offsets 0x18CC-0x18D8). Allocates a 16-byte node, initializes it, links after tail, updates tail pointer, increments count. On empty list, initializes head and secondary pointer. Third variant of the doubly-linked list append pattern, differing only in base offsets from the list head struct.

0x00496840.name: LinkedListSummationWithIterator
0x00496840.label: LinkedListSummationWithIterator
0x00496840.summary: Iterates a linked list starting from head (offset 0x4) using a cursor (offset 0xC), calling ShortComputation_58d0 on each node's value (first DWORD of node) and summing results. Stops when cursor is NULL or node value is zero. Returns accumulated sum. Part of a list-processing summation utility.

0x00496880.name: sub_496880
0x00496880.label: UIPageLayerRenderAndStringCopy
0x00496880.summary: Iterates child objects (linked list at offset 0x1C) calling virtual render method (vtable+164) on each. Processes the current active object (offset 0x18) with virtual position update (vtable+56), then copies its page/layer names into string tables (StringReverseCopyLookup with "current page" / "current layer" keys). Calls final virtual method (vtable+64) on the current object. Part of the UI page/layer rendering system.

0x00496930.name: UILargeRender
0x00496930.label: Main UI render/dispatch frame handler
0x00496930.summary: Per-frame UI rendering and input dispatch handler: resolves active UI element via collision classification, manages element lifecycle (creation/destruction), dispatches per-type rendering (string accessors, alpha blend, FPS overlay), processes input action map, and handles click events. Part of the UI system.

0x00496e20.name: sub_496E20
0x00496e20.label: FloatFieldPositiveCheck
0x00496e20.summary: Checks if float field at offset 0xDC in the structure is positive (> 0.0f). Returns BOOL indicating result. Called by UILargeRender.

0x00496e40.name: LinkedListTraversalWithVirtualCall
0x00496e40.label: TraverseLinkedListAndProcessNodes
0x00496e40.summary: Traverses a singly-linked list starting from head pointer at this+0x18DC. For each node, reads item pointer at node+0x0 and calls its virtual method at vtable offset 0x6C. Advances via next pointer at node+0x4.

0x00496e90.name: sub_496E90
0x00496e90.label: Car Crash Damage / UI Render State Machine
0x00496e90.summary: Orchestrates car crash damage processing and UI rendering for the damage/repair screen. First calls CarCrashDamageProcessing; if it returns true, returns 0 immediately. Otherwise iterates a linked list of crash damage nodes (8 primary + chained via field 26), calling virtual dispatch per-node to get screen coordinates, then renders damage overlays, combo lists, and text dialogs. Manages a timer at this+0x44 (float, decremented by FloatFieldAccessor) for timed UI transitions.

0x004970e0.name: FieldSetterWithGuardedCall
0x004970e0.label: SetFieldAndConditionallyDispatchRender
0x004970e0.summary: Stores parameter to field at 0x1918. If guard field at 0x30 is non-zero, calls RenderDispatchWithIteration. Returns either the stored parameter or the render dispatch result.

0x00497100.name: SceneEntityCleanup
0x00497100.label: CleanupSceneEntityLists
0x00497100.summary: Performs cleanup of two scene-entity linked lists when parameter a2 is non-zero. Traverses each list twice: first calls virtual method (vtable+0x44) on each item, then frees nodes with active flag (byte at node+12). Zeroes all list pointers. Always calls Accessor and CircularBufferRingAdvance.

0x00497250.name: ShortComputation_7250
0x00497250.label: ByteFieldSetter_0x25
0x00497250.summary: Stores incoming byte parameter `a2` to field at offset 0x25. Returns the stored value. Simple setter called by many callers.

0x004972b0.name: RectangleDrawingWithPattern
0x004972b0.label: DrawConcentricRectanglesWithBorder
0x004972b0.summary: Draws concentric rectangles inward from given bounds (a4-top, a5-bottom, a6-left, a7-right), repeated `a3` times. Each iteration draws four edges with alternating colors (v18/v19) for 3D bevel effect, then shrinks rectangle by 1px per side.

0x004973d0.name: sub_4973D0
0x004973d0.label: ConditionalSurfaceRenderFromResource
0x004973d0.summary: Renders and copies a surface fill contingent on a float threshold (> 0.2 at 0xC4) and a valid resource pointer (at 0x1568). Searches for a named resource via ObjectSearchWithDoubleIteration; if not found or name mismatch, falls back to sub_497AD0 with aNoDropIcon string. Renders via F_10ParamForwarder and RenderSurfaceFillCopy.

0x004974a0.name: LinkedListSearchWithAction
0x004974a0.label: SearchLinkedListAndDispatchAction
0x004974a0.summary: Traverses a singly-linked list starting from head pointer at this+0x4, searching for a node whose data matches parameter `a2`. On match, calls SimpleSetter_fc40(1), FieldGetter_8e30, and SetterVirtualCall. Always sets byte field at this+0x25 to 1 via ShortComputation_7250 before returning 0.

0x00497510.name: DoublyLinkedListNodeInsert
0x00497510.label: InsertNodeAtDoublyLinkedListTail
0x00497510.summary: Allocates a 16-byte doubly-linked list node initialized with data `a2` and flag=1 (byte at +12). If list empty, sets head/tail to new node; otherwise appends to tail. Increments counter at 0x2C and node count at 0x10 on each call.

0x004975d0.name: sub_4975D0
0x004975d0.label: InitializeAndAppendChildToList
0x004975d0.summary: Initializes a child element `a2`: sets backlink to `this` at a2+0x40, clears fields at 0x98/0x9C/0x8C. If string `a3` non-null, calls sub_49AD50. Appends `a2` to singly-linked list rooted at this+0x1C using next pointer at offset 0x8C. Returns a2, or 0 if a2 is null.

0x00497650.name: UIListItemSearchByName
0x00497650.label: SearchUIListItemByName
0x00497650.summary: Traverses a linked list rooted at this+0x4. For each node, reads name string pointer at offset 0x34 (defaulting to byte_5EA438 if null), compares with parameter `a2` via sub_588410 (likely string compare). Returns matching node pointer or 0 if not found.

0x004976c0.name: UIListSearchByName_76c0
0x004976c0.label: SearchTwoLevelNestedListByName
0x004976c0.summary: Traverses a two-level nested linked list. Outer list rooted at this+0x4. For each outer node, retrieves inner list head via FieldGetter_8e30, then walks inner list using next pointer at offset 0x48, comparing name string at offset 0x34 against `a2`. Returns last matching inner item pointer, or 0.

0x00497750.name: RenderingContextSetup
0x00497750.label: SearchRenderingContextByName
0x00497750.summary: Initializes a stack-based rendering context via PassthroughWrapper, processes `this` via sub_4998E0, then searches for an item whose name string (at offset 0x34) matches `a2`. Uses FieldAccessor/sub_499910 to iterate. Returns matching item pointer or 0.

0x004977e0.name: sub_4977E0
0x004977e0.label: ConfigureStateWithMode
0x004977e0.summary: Stores parameter `a2` to field at 0x157C, calls sub_496E90 twice, then sets state field at 0x1578 to mode value (0-3) and float field at 0xDC to 0.01f based on switch on `a3`. Cases 0-3 set both fields; case 4 sets only float. Default does nothing.

0x00497890.name: UtilityFunction_7890
0x00497890.label: SearchNestedListAndProcessMatch
0x00497890.summary: Searches outer-linked-list (head at this+0x4) with inner lists via FieldGetter_8e30. For each inner item matching `a2`: conditionally calls sub_4977E0 (if byte at 0x1574 set), appends outer node via DoublyLinkedListAppend_5a80, calls virtual method (vtable+0x2C), and calls SetterVirtualCall. Guards: field at 0x18 triggers ListIterationWithVTableDispatch before and LinkedListIterationVirtualCall after.

0x00497980.name: BitmapSpriteAccessor
0x00497980.label: GetSpriteBitmapName
0x00497980.summary: Retrieves name string from a bitmap/sprite descriptor structure. Reads sprite base pointer from this+0x18, validates fields at offsets 0x48 and 0x50, then reads name string at offset 0x34 from the sub-descriptor. Returns name string or default byte_5EA438 if null.

0x004979c0.name: Setter
0x004979c0.label: SetFieldAtOffset20
0x004979c0.summary: Stores parameter `a2` to field at offset 0x20 (this[8]) and returns the same value. Simple setter called by many callers.

0x004979e0.name: SimpleSetter_79e0
0x004979e0.label: ClearFieldAtOffset20
0x004979e0.summary: Sets field at offset 0x20 (this[8]) to 0. Simple reset/clear function for the same field that Setter_004979c0 writes to.

0x004979f0.name: BitmapLoader
0x004979f0.label: RegisterBitmapPathInList
0x004979f0.summary: Builds full path from base directory (dword_5EC408 or byte_5EA438) and filename `a2` via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck. On validation success (ConditionalFieldClear returns 0), allocates PathRegistry entry and inserts 12-byte node into singly-linked list (head at 0xF0, next at +4, flag at +8). Increments counter at 0xFC.

0x00497ad0.name: sub_497AD0
0x00497ad0.label: LoadAndRegisterSurfaceResource
0x00497ad0.summary: Loads a surface/texture resource by name `a2`. Checks cache via sub_497BA0; returns existing if found. Otherwise resolves ID via HashTableIDResolution (logs error via sub_4986D0 if a3 is set and ID not found). Allocates 20-byte node (flag=1 at +0, next=0 at +16, data=v10 at +12) and appends to singly-linked list rooted at this+0x104. Increments counter at this+0x108.

0x00497ba0.name: sub_497BA0
0x00497ba0.label: FindSurfaceNodeByNameAndResolve
0x00497ba0.summary: Searches the loaded-surface linked list (head at this+0x104) for a node whose name string (at node offset 0x4) matches `a2`. If the node's data field (at node offset 0xC) is null, lazily resolves via HashTableIDResolution and logs error on failure. Returns matching node pointer or 0.

0x00497c40.name: LinkedListNodeRemovalByStringKey
0x00497c40.label: RemoveSurfaceNodeByName
0x00497c40.summary: Removes a node from the loaded-surface linked list (head at this+0x104) by matching name string `a2` against node name at offset 0x4. Unlinks, processes data via ThunkToFUN0053cb90, clears data field, frees name string and node. Returns 1 on successful removal, 0 if not found.

0x00497d00.name: TwoFieldSetter
0x00497d00.label: SetDwordAndFlag
