0x00497d00.summary: Stores parameter `a2` to DWORD field at offset 0x18A8 and sets byte flag at offset 0x18EC to 1. Returns a2. Simple two-field setter.

0x00497d20.name: TextureSurfaceLoader
0x00497d20.label: LoadTextureSurfaceAndRegister
0x00497d20.summary: Loads a texture/surface by name `a2`. Validates init status via dword_8AC4C4, calls surface creation method (vtable+0x5C). On success: allocates 88-byte node (name via strcpy at +0, surface handle at +0x50, next at +0x54), appends to linked list (head at this+0x10C), increments counter at this+0x110.

0x00497e80.name: sub_497E80
0x00497e80.label: FindSurfaceHandleByName
0x00497e80.summary: Searches the loaded-surface linked list (head at this+0x10C) for a node whose name matches `a2`. Each node is checked via sub_588410 (string compare, 0=match). Returns surface handle at node offset 0x50, or 0 if not found.

0x00497ec0.name: DriverNameStringHandler
0x00497ec0.label: Driver Name String Parser/Storer
0x00497ec0.summary: Parses a driver name string from a path-like string: normalizes it, checks against a blacklist, and if it is not a known registered key, extracts the component up to a path separator and stores it in an internal array. Returns the lookup index or -1 on failure/blacklist match.

0x00497f90.name: StringArrayMatchSearch
0x00497f90.label: Driver Name Array Search
0x00497f90.summary: Searches a stored array of driver name strings for a match against the input string (after truncating at a separator character). Returns 1 if found, 0 if not found or empty/null input.

0x00498030.name: RendererAlphaBlendSetter
0x00498030.label: Alpha Blend State Configuration
0x00498030.summary: Computes a clamped alpha/color-intensity value from a DSP transform parameter (flt_7CF2CC) and calls a virtual method (vtable offset 4) on a renderer object to apply the alpha blend state along with an identity transform.

0x004980c0.name: ConditionalSetter0x30
0x004980c0.label: Conditional Field Setter (offset 0x30)
0x004980c0.summary: Conditionally stores a non-zero value into `this[12]` (offset 0x30) and returns the value. Skipped entirely when the input is zero/NULL.

0x004980d0.name: BitmapDraw
0x004980d0.label: Centered Bitmap/UI Element Render
0x004980d0.summary: Renders a bitmap or UI element centered within a bounding rectangle if a text string is present. Optionally resolves the input string through a message display buffer. Computes centered horizontal/vertical position, dispatches UI display, then fills a background surface behind the rendered element.

0x004981f0.name: BitmapDraw_81f0
0x004981f0.label: UI Message Element Render (Text Only)
0x004981f0.summary: Renders a text or UI element at a specified vertical position with horizontal centering within bounding rectangle. Optionally resolves input string through a message display buffer. Similar to BitmapDraw_004980d0 but without the background surface fill step.

0x004983b0.name: TextRenderToSurface
0x004983b0.label: Text Dimensions Computer
0x004983b0.summary: Computes rendered width and height of a text string. Optionally resolves the string through a message display buffer. Returns dimensions via output parameters a3 (width) and a4 (height). Called by many UI rendering functions to size text elements.

0x00498440.name: sub_498440
0x00498440.label: Font Name Validation and Selection
0x00498440.summary: Validates a requested font name against the registered system font list. If the font is found, selects it by copying the name to a buffer. On failure, shows an error MessageBox and falls back to the first registered font.

0x00498650.name: StringLengthGuardedFieldSetter
0x00498650.label: Guarded String Copy With Field Set
0x00498650.summary: Copies a non-empty string to an internal buffer and stores three associated integer values in adjacent fields. If the input is NULL or empty, returns 0 without modification.

0x004986a0.name: RenderStateReset
0x004986a0.label: Render State Fields Reset
0x004986a0.summary: Clears three integer state fields to 0 and resets a global string buffer to a default/empty value. Used to reinitialize rendering state.

0x004986d0.name: sub_4986D0
0x004986d0.label: Error Code To MessageBox Display
0x004986d0.summary: Converts a numeric error code to a text string and displays it in a "Options Error" message box. Then calls a utility function with argument 1. No-op when error code is 0.

0x00498720.name: CollisionSpeedSetter
0x00498720.label: Physics/Collision Parameter Setter
0x00498720.summary: Stores a global double value (dbl_8AFE90) into the float field at offset 0xC0, updating a collision or physics parameter.

0x00498740.name: InitViewportDimensions
0x00498740.label: Viewport/Dimensions Initializer
0x00498740.summary: Initializes six render-state/viewport fields: computed integer width and height from font-scale factors multiplied by 400/300, screen width, scroll acceleration, a constant, and a contact flag value.

0x00498880.name: DualFieldRead
0x00498880.label: Dual Dimension Field Read Accessor
0x00498880.summary: Reads two adjacent integer fields at offsets 0x5C and 0x60 (the computed width and height dimensions initialized by InitViewportDimensions_00498740) and returns them via output parameters. Also returns the second value as the function result.

0x004988a0.name: FieldSetterCall
0x004988a0.label: Field Setter With Cursor Select
0x004988a0.summary: Writes a value to the field at offset 0x58 and calls CursorSelectorFromArray with a rendering state value and the same argument, returning the selection result.

0x004988c0.name: sub_4988C0
0x004988c0.label: Byte Flag Setter at offset 0x18F5
0x004988c0.summary: Writes a byte value to the field at offset 0x18F5 and returns the same value. Serves as a simple flag/toggle setter.

0x004988d0.name: sub_4988D0
0x004988d0.label: Contextual Rendering Setup With Virtual Calls
0x004988d0.summary: Creates a rendering context from a string parameter, invokes four virtual methods on it (init, setter, two-field copy, and teardown/finalize), guarded by non-null/non-empty string and a validity check on a sub-object.

0x00498950.name: SpriteTextureEnumeration
0x00498950.label: Sprite/Texture Entry Selector
0x00498950.summary: Iterates through up to 4 sprite/texture entries, comparing the input against each entry's string. If a match is found, returns immediately. Has special-case handling when exactly 3 entries are valid and the 4th is inactive.

0x004989e0.name: sub_4989E0
0x004989e0.label: Replay/Save Animation Renderer
0x004989e0.summary: Renders "saving replay" UI with two code paths: a static display when a replay-related structure is active, or a timed animation loop with progress-based alpha/color blending when replay save is in progress.

0x00498d00.name: PathRegisterFieldSet
0x00498d00.label: Path Register Field Setter
0x00498d00.summary: Copies a path string into an internal buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and stores an associated integer value in the adjacent field at offset 0x44.

0x00498d20.name: InitWithVTableParam
0x00498d20.label: Object Initializer With VTable and Param
0x00498d20.summary: Initializes an object by calling parent constructor, setting the vtable pointer to off_5AC9E8, running multi-field struct initialization, and storing a parameter value at offset 0x44.

0x00498d90.name: DualListDestruction
0x00498d90.label: Dual Linked List Destruction
0x00498d90.summary: Iterates two linked lists and calls the virtual destructor (vtable[0] with arg 1) on each node, then returns the result of a final cleanup computation. Restores the vtable pointer at start.

0x00498e50.name: NodeInsertionIntoTree
0x00498e50.label: Linked List Node Insertion
0x00498e50.summary: Inserts a node (a2) into a linked list maintained within the object. Handles both empty list (initializes head and tail) and existing list (traverses with FieldGetter_8e30 then walks the 0x48 chain to append). Increments node counter and stores a back-link.

0x00498eb0.name: LinkedListAppend_8eb0
0x00498eb0.label: Linked List Append With Child Linking
0x00498eb0.summary: Appends a node a2 to the linked list rooted at this+0x4C. Also iterates a2's child list (at a2+0x90 linked via offset 0x8C) and sets parent back-links. Increments node counter and calls a multi-region accumulation function.

0x00498f40.name: SetterVirtualCall
0x00498f40.label: Conditional Setter With Virtual Call
0x00498f40.summary: Conditionally stores a value into field at offset 0x50, then unconditionally calls virtual method at vtable offset 44 with argument 1.

0x00498f80.name: LinkedListIterationVirtualCall
0x00498f80.label: Dual-list virtual method dispatch
0x00498f80.summary: Iterates two linked lists of polymorphic objects, calling virtual method at vtable offset 0x70 (render/draw) on each node. Part of a render dispatch system.

0x00498fb0.name: ListIterationWithVTableDispatch
0x00498fb0.label: Dual-list virtual method dispatch at 0x74
0x00498fb0.summary: Iterates two linked lists, calling virtual method at vtable offset 0x74 on each node. Paired with LinkedListIterationVirtualCall_00498f80 (identical structure, different vtable slot). Part of render dispatch system.

0x00498fe0.name: GuardedDrawRenderDispatch
0x00498fe0.label: Guarded rectangle fill & render list dispatch
0x00498fe0.summary: Conditionally fills a rectangular region on a render surface, then iterates two render lists calling draw methods. Guarded by enable flag at this+0x60 and a virtual method check at vtable[0x28]. Part of render subsystem.

0x00499050.name: GuardedSubRectangleRenderDispatch
0x00499050.label: Guarded sub-rectangle fill dispatch
0x00499050.summary: Conditionally fills a sub-rectangle on the render surface when mode field equals 2. Part of render surface update system.

0x00499140.name: ConstructorWithVTableAndSubInit_9140
0x00499140.label: Constructor with vtable assignment
0x00499140.summary: Constructor: calls base initialization via InitWithVTableParam, then sets vtable pointer to off_5ACA30. Part of object construction chain.

0x00499180.name: ShortComputation_9180
0x00499180.label: Vtable setup with destruction call
0x00499180.summary: Sets vtable pointer to off_5ACA30 then calls DualListDestruction. Part of object teardown/transition sequence.

0x004991e0.name: FunctionCallWrapper_91e0
0x004991e0.label: UI element constructor / registrar
0x004991e0.summary: Constructor for a UI element: zeroes sentinel/index fields, sets vtable to off_5ACA74 (UIElementVTable), and registers with system via sub_4992E0. Part of UI element creation pipeline.

0x00499280.name: DestructorWithListWalk
0x00499280.label: Destructor with linked-list cleanup
0x00499280.summary: Destructor: walks a linked list at this+0x44 calling virtual destructor on each node, frees two optional buffers at this+0x58/0x60, then chains to base destructor. Part of UI element destruction.

0x004992e0.name: sub_4992E0
0x004992e0.label: Object registration with centered scroll-offset calculation
0x004992e0.summary: Registers an object pointer at this+0x4C, then conditionally computes centered scroll offsets and dispatches via ScrollOffsetUpdateWithConditionalDispatch. Part of UI element initialization/parenting.

0x00499360.name: ObjectRegistration
0x00499360.label: Object registration into parent linked list
0x00499360.summary: Appends an object (a2) to a linked list at this+0x44, updates a counter at this+0x54, and calls dispatch with coordinates. Part of UI/object hierarchy management.

0x004993d0.name: RenderDispatchWithIteration
0x004993d0.label: Render dispatch with rect clamping and child iteration
0x004993d0.summary: Renders clamped sub-rectangles from a linked list onto a drawing surface, then iterates child linked list calling draw method. Core render dispatch function in UI render system.

0x00499520.name: LinkedListVirtualDispatch
0x00499520.label: Linked-list virtual dispatch at offset 0xA4
0x00499520.summary: Iterates linked list starting at this+0x44, calling virtual method at vtable offset 0xA4 on each node. Advances via next pointer at node offset 0x8C. Part of render/update dispatch chain.

0x00499580.name: LinkedListDestroy
0x00499580.label: Linked-list node destruction with conditional vtable call
0x00499580.summary: Walks a linked list freeing each node; conditionally calls virtual destructor (vtable[0]) on nodes with flag at offset 0xC set and valid vtable pointer. Zeros list fields after loop. Part of list/container teardown.

0x00499620.name: ShortComputation_9620
0x00499620.label: Conditional double-free wrapper
0x00499620.summary: Conditionally frees inner pointer at this+0 then optionally frees this itself. Part of object/container teardown.

0x00499690.name: sub_499690
0x00499690.label: Recursive scene file deletion
0x00499690.summary: Recursively deletes files matching a scene extension pattern (from dword_5C2AB8) under a given directory path. Skips "." and ".." entries. Removes read-only attribute before deletion. Calls itself for subdirectory contents. Part of save/scene file cleanup.

0x00499870.name: LinkedListIteratorAdvance
0x00499870.label: Iterator advance to next linked-list node
0x00499870.summary: Advances linked-list iterator: loads next node from current, updates iterator state, returns success. If current node is NULL, returns false (end of list). Part of linked-list iteration utility.

0x004998c0.name: LinkedListNodeTraversal_98c0
0x004998c0.label: Iterator advance via node offset 0x48
0x004998c0.summary: Advances linked-list iterator: reads next node pointer at offset 0x48 from current node, updates iterator position. Returns true if more nodes remain. Part of linked-list iteration utility.

0x00499910.name: sub_499910
0x00499910.label: Tree traversal state machine (sibling/child iteration)
0x00499910.summary: State-machine iterator for traversing a tree hierarchy. Manages three states (init/sibling-descend/child-iterate) to walk nodes depth-first. Stops when done flag sets. Part of rendering tree traversal.

0x004999e0.name: sub_4999E0
0x004999e0.label: Two-field init with sub-initializer
0x004999e0.summary: Initializes first two fields (0 and -1), then calls SmallStructInit_9a00 sub-initializer. Part of struct/object construction.

0x00499a00.name: SmallStructInit_9a00
0x00499a00.label: String copy init with field zero
0x00499a00.summary: Copies global path string (byte_5EA438) via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, then zeroes field at this+0x8. Part of struct initialization with path/default directory.

0x00499a30.name: StringFieldSetter
0x00499a30.label: String copy and field setter
0x00499a30.summary: Copies string from parameter a2 via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, then sets field at this+0x8 to a3. Part of string/resource field assignment.

0x00499a50.name: FloatThresholdCheck
0x00499a50.label: Float field positive check
0x00499a50.summary: Checks if float value at this+0x8 is greater than 0.0. Returns BOOL result. Used as guard/predicate in caller logic.

0x00499a70.name: DataEntryCopy
0x00499a70.label: Data entry copy with self-assignment guard
0x00499a70.summary: Copies string pointer and field at this+0x8 from source a2 to destination this. Falls back to default directory (byte_5EA438) when source string is NULL. Part of data entry assignment.

0x00499ab0.name: StructInitPathRegistry
0x00499ab0.label: Three-field init with string copy
0x00499ab0.summary: Constructor/init: zeroes field at this+0x0, sets sentinel at this+0x4 to -1, copies string from a2, sets this+0x8 to a3. Part of path/texture registry initialization.

0x00499af0.name: ObjectResetWithVTableDispatch
0x00499af0.label: Object reset with sub-object destruction
0x00499af0.summary: Destroys sub-object at this+0x50 (virtual destructor call) if non-null, then zeroes entire structure via memset(0x50 bytes). Part of object reset/recycle.

0x00499b10.name: sub_499B10
0x00499b10.label: ObjectConstructorInit (13-field zero + 0.1f)
0x00499b10.summary: Initializes all 13 DWORD fields of the object to 0, except field at offset 0x18 which is set to 0.1f (1036831949). Acts as a common constructor called by UI object constructors.

0x00499b50.name: ConditionalDualCleanup
0x00499b50.label: DualConditionalResourceCleanup
0x00499b50.summary: Conditionally cleans up two resources held by the object. If field at offset 0x30 (pointer) is non-NULL, frees it via ResourceCascadeCleanup and clears the field to 0. If field at offset 0x2C is non-zero, invokes DestructorWithConditionalFreeFlagClear. Returns the original value of field 0x30.

0x00499b80.name: ObjectFieldInitWithIndirectLookup
0x00499b80.label: ConstructorWithIndirectOffsetLookup
0x00499b80.summary: Initializes several object fields, zeroing offsets 0x00 and 0x08, storing the `a2` parameter at offset 0x20, and conditionally reading two values through two-level pointer indirection (a2->[12]->[28] and a2->[12]->[32]) into offsets 0x04 and 0x0C. When a2 is NULL, those fields are zeroed instead.

0x00499bb0.name: StructEquality
0x00499bb0.label: StructFieldEqualityComparison
0x00499bb0.summary: Compares two object instances by checking equality of six DWORD fields (offsets 0x00, 0x04, 0x08, 0x0C, 0x1C, 0x20) in order. Returns TRUE if all match, FALSE on first mismatch. Fields at offsets 0x10-0x18 and 0x24-0x30 are not compared.

0x00499c10.name: ShortComputation_9c10
0x00499c10.label: StructUpdateAndSnapshot
0x00499c10.summary: Copies six selected DWORD fields (offsets 0x00-0x0C, 0x1C, 0x20) from source struct `a3` into `this`, then copies the entire 52-byte (0x34) content of `this` into buffer `a2` via qmemcpy. Returns the buffer pointer `a2`.

0x00499c50.name: ConstructorInitWith1Sentinels
0x00499c50.label: Constructor with Sentinel-Initialized Slot Array
0x00499c50.summary: Constructor that initializes a vtable pointer, stores a context parameter, and initializes an array of 10 slots each as (activeFlag=0, id=-1 sentinel) followed by trailing zero fields. Object lifecycle / initialization system.

0x00499ce0.name: DestructorWithMultipleConditionalFrees
0x00499ce0.label: DestructorWithMultipleConditionalFrees
0x00499ce0.summary: Destructor that sets the vtable pointer (offset 0x00), recursively destroys a tree node via TreeNodeRecursiveDestructor, frees a linked list at offset 0x6C via LinkedListFree, then conditionally frees up to 10 pointer fields (offsets 0x10 through 0x58, step 0x08) via FreeWrapper_7bcf if non-NULL.

0x00499da0.name: TreeNodeRecursiveDestructor
0x00499da0.label: TreeNodeRecursiveDestructor
0x00499da0.summary: Destructs a tree node by recursively processing children and freeing the node. If `a2` is NULL, reads the node pointer from `this+2` (offset 0x08). If the node pointer is non-NULL, recursively destructs its children at offsets 0x24 and 0x28, calls ConditionalDualCleanup on the node, then frees it. Finally clears the node pointer slot and sets `this[3]` to 0.

0x00499e20.name: StringPointerAccessor
0x00499e20.label: StringPointerAccessor
0x00499e20.summary: Returns a string pointer from struct field at offset 0x10, or a default path string (byte_5EA438) if the field is null. Simple accessor for resource path or filename.

0x00499eb0.name: AbsValueFieldSetter
0x00499eb0.label: ClampToNonNegativeFieldSetter
0x00499eb0.summary: Sets two fields at offsets 0x60 and 0x64 to the input values, clamping negative inputs to 0 (taking the absolute/non-negative value). Returns the original a3 value.

0x00499ee0.name: TwinFieldGetter
0x00499ee0.label: TwinFieldGetter
0x00499ee0.summary: Reads the two fields at offsets 0x60 and 0x64 and stores them into output pointers `a2` and `a3` respectively. Returns the value of field 0x64.

0x00499f70.name: sub_499F70
0x00499f70.label: ResourceNodeLookupOrCreateAndLink
0x00499f70.summary: Looks up a resource by name via sub_497AD0. If found, allocates and initializes a new 52-byte node (via sub_499B10 constructor), populates it with parameters a2-a5 and the lookup result, conditionally overrides fields from indirect data when a7 is set, then links the node into either a named sub-list (if a9 matches an existing node) or the main linked list anchored at this+8. If lookup fails and a8 is set, shows an error MessageBox.

0x0049a110.name: ShortComputation_a110
0x0049a110.label: LinkedSkipAndCountChildren
0x0049a110.summary: Walks a linked list anchored at this+0x08, skipping up to `a2` nodes by following next-sibling pointers (offset 0x24), then switches to child pointers (offset 0x28) and counts remaining nodes. Returns count of nodes reachable via child links after the skip.

0x0049a1c0.name: ConditionalSingleStoreWithIteration
0x0049a1c0.label: LazyInitListHeadOrIterateAndSet
0x0049a1c0.summary: If `a2` is zero, returns -1. If the list head at offset 0x00 is NULL, stores `a2` as the head (lazy initialization) and returns 0. If the head already exists, iterates through the list via sub_499E00 (walking a node chain) and calls FieldSetterAt0x68 on the traversed node.

0x0049a270.name: sub_49A270
0x0049a270.label: TripleConditionalFree
0x0049a270.summary: Conditionally frees three pointer fields at offsets 0x00, 0x08, and 0x10 via FreeWrapper_7bcf if non-NULL. Each is checked independently. Returns the result of the last free call or NULL if none fired.

0x0049a2d0.name: StringPointerAccessor_a2d0
0x0049a2d0.label: StringPointerWithDefaultFallback
0x0049a2d0.summary: Returns the string pointer stored at offset 0x08. If that pointer is NULL, returns a default directory path string (byte_5EA438) as fallback.

0x0049a3b0.name: ResourceLookupOrCreate
0x0049a3b0.label: IndexedResourceLookupOrCreate
0x0049a3b0.summary: Normalizes a string, validates it, converts to an index via CharToIndexConversion, allocates a 28-byte node, initializes it, and inserts it into an indexed array at `this[result]`. If the slot already holds a list, appends the node to the tail (following offset 0x18 next pointer). Returns the index, or -1 on failure.

0x0049a5a0.name: DualConditionalFree
0x0049a5a0.label: DualConditionalFree
0x0049a5a0.summary: Conditionally frees two pointer fields at offsets 0x04 and 0x0C via FreeWrapper_7bcf if non-NULL. Returns the result of the last free call or 0 if none fired.

0x0049a5d0.name: sub_49A5D0
0x0049a5d0.label: UICommandDispatch
0x0049a5d0.summary: Dispatches UI actions based on a command ID at offset 0x00. Cases 1-6 perform list navigation (search by name, utility action with varying parameter, set current page string). Case 7 searches list items and performs linked list search. Case 9 copies string parameters. Case 0xA triggers polling loop. Case 0xB sets global multiplayer active flag to -1 (shutdown). Case 0xC sets up a rendering context and calls vtable methods. Cases 3-6 optionally use offset 0x14 as a TwoFieldSetter parameter.

0x0049a930.name: ConstructorWith1Sentinels
0x0049a930.label: ConstructorWithSentinelInit
0x0049a930.summary: Constructor that sets the vtable pointer (off_5ACAB0) at offset 0x00, initializes a sub-object at offset 0x24 via ThunkToFUN00491330, zeroes fields 0x04-0x10, sets fields 0x14-0x20 and 0x38 to -1 (sentinel/empty markers), and clears byte at 0x3C and DWORD at 0x34 to 0.

0x0049a990.name: ShortComputation_a990
0x0049a990.label: DestructorWithVTableSetAndFree
0x0049a990.summary: Sets the vtable pointer at offset 0x00 to off_5ACAB0, conditionally frees a pointer at offset 0x34 if non-NULL via FreeWrapper_7bcf, then calls EmptyStub_0170 on sub-object at offset 0x24 for further cleanup.

0x0049a9c0.name: ShortComputation_a9c0
0x0049a9c0.label: QuadFieldSetter
0x0049a9c0.summary: Stores four parameters into fields at offsets 0x04, 0x08, 0x0C, and 0x10. Returns the third parameter (a4).

0x0049a9e0.name: RectangleEdgeOffsetCalculator
0x0049a9e0.label: RectangleRelativeOffsetCalculator
0x0049a9e0.summary: Computes the offset of a rectangle (a2,a3)-(a4,a5) relative to a reference point stored at offsets 0x04 (y) and 0x0C (x). Stores the four relative edge values at offsets 0x14-0x20. Returns the relative bottom edge.

0x0049aa10.name: MultiFieldStructWriter
0x0049aa10.label: StructFourFieldWriter
0x0049aa10.summary: Writes four caller-supplied integer parameters into consecutive dword fields at offsets 0x14-0x20 of a struct. Returns the fourth parameter as result.

0x0049aa70.name: PositionUpdate
0x0049aa70.label: PositionalOffsetAccumulator
0x0049aa70.summary: Adds each caller parameter to a corresponding baseline struct field and stores the result in an adjacent output field. Returns the computed X offset.

0x0049aad0.name: WidgetRectBounds
0x0049aad0.label: WidgetBoundsCalculator
0x0049aad0.summary: Computes output bounding rectangle for a widget. If widget dimensions are zero/negative, outputs raw dword rect stored at 0x4-0x10; otherwise computes pixel-accurate bounds from 16-bit position and size fields.

0x0049ab60.name: UIRectangleClipping
0x0049ab60.label: RectangleClipAndDispatch
0x0049ab60.summary: Clips an input rectangle against widget scroll/child bounds then delegates to ShortComputation_16e0. If widget has zero or negative dimensions, skips clipping entirely.

0x0049ac20.name: TextureSurfaceDimensionValidityCheck
0x0049ac20.label: TextureDimensionIsValid
0x0049ac20.summary: Returns true only if both texture surface dimensions (height at 0x28, width at 0x2A) are positive. Used as a validity check before rendering or allocation.

0x0049acc0.name: ScrollOffsetUpdateWithConditionalDispatch
0x0049acc0.label: ScrollOffsetUpdateWithConditionalRenderDispatch
0x0049acc0.summary: Applies scroll offsets (a2, a3) to four scroll/position fields with overflow-aware clamping, conditionally dispatches a render surface fill copy if the scroll flag at 0x40 is set, then unconditionally accumulates raw offsets into the fields.

0x0049adc0.name: ObjectConstructor_adc0
0x0049adc0.label: LinkedIntPairNodeConstructor
0x0049adc0.summary: Allocates and initializes a linked list node storing a pair of 16-bit values. Allocates a word pair buffer for a2/a3, then a 12-byte node linking to it. Appends to tail of existing list or starts new list. Returns 1 on success, 0 on allocation failure.

0x0049aec0.name: LinkedListIndexedFieldReader
0x0049aec0.label: LinkedListIndexedFieldReader
0x0049aec0.summary: Reads a pair of 16-bit values from a linked list node at a given index. Walks the list from head following next pointers at offset +4. If the index is out of range or the node/data is null, zeros the output parameters and returns 0.

0x0049afe0.name: MultiCallSequence
0x0049afe0.label: GlobalStateResetSequence
0x0049afe0.summary: Calls sub_49E8F0 on five consecutive global data structures for initialization/reset, then zeroes a 96-byte block of global state (0x7CE058 through 0x7CE0B4). Returns 0.

0x0049b0a0.name: sub_49B0A0
0x0049b0a0.label: WidgetResourceArrayInit
0x0049b0a0.summary: Initializes a four-element widget array for UI overlay buttons (vehicle display, network problem, next track, next session). Builds path from SeasonDir or default directory, loads a resource container, then creates four button widgets stored in global dword_7CE23C[0..3]. Cleans up on surface creation failure.

0x0049b1c0.name: StaticArrayCleanup
0x0049b1c0.label: UIRenderWidgetArrayCleanup
0x0049b1c0.summary: Iterates the four-element dword_7CE23C widget pointer array, destructing and freeing each non-null entry, then zeroing the slot. Called during UI shutdown/teardown.

0x0049b200.name: RandomColorGenerator
0x0049b200.label: TimeBasedTriangularWaveColor
0x0049b200.summary: Computes a packed RGB color value from a time-based triangular wave oscillation. Uses session time (dbl_8AFEA0 + a3) to generate a value in [0,1] via triangle wave, clamps, then converts to a 24-bit integer via three CRTFtol conversions.

0x0049b370.name: F_2DTextRenderingWithScissorRectangle
0x0049b370.label: ScissoredTextRenderWithColorHighlight
0x0049b370.summary: Renders 2D text within a scissored rectangle region. Computes scaled text position from input dimensions, calls a chain of FloatToIntConversionChain calls, renders a background widget if UI flag is set, renders text via FieldSetter calls, and conditionally draws a time-based color highlight bar if feature flags are enabled.

0x0049b670.name: CollisionGridCellDecoder
0x0049b670.label: AngleTimeToGridCellDecoder
0x0049b670.summary: Converts a float value (angle in degrees or time in seconds) to integer hours via multiplication by 1/3600, computes the remainder after removing whole-hour chunks, then delegates to SpatialGridCell for grid cell lookup.

0x0049b6d0.name: LapTimeGapCalculation
0x0049b6d0.label: VehicleLapTimeGapCalculator
0x0049b6d0.summary: Computes the time gap between two vehicles based on lap count and sector times. If vehicles are on the same lap, returns signed gap. Handles lap-wrap scenarios (one lap ahead with smaller time, or multi-lap gaps). Returns 1 if first vehicle is behind by lap count, 0 if gap was computed.

0x0049b7a0.name: sub_49B7A0
0x0049b7a0.label: VehicleAssistSteeringBitmaskSelector
0x0049b7a0.summary: Returns a steering assist strength bitmask (values 0-15) based on vehicle velocity threshold, team mate proximity, or a performance ratio. Uses session time parity for random-like selection when on same team, or thresholds a ratio of two vehicle dynamics parameters otherwise.

0x0049b9a0.name: sub_49B9A0
0x0049b9a0.label: EngineWearDriverNotification
0x0049b9a0.summary: Checks if current player and current vehicle are on the same team, if an engine wear parameter exceeds a threshold, and if engine wear mode is active. On first detection, calls sub_41B190 to notify the driver. Updates and returns the driver present flag.

0x0049bad0.name: ShortComputation_bad0
0x0049bad0.label: distance-projection threshold check
0x0049bad0.summary: Computes a distance projection from postProcessInput, then checks if either a ring buffer access or indexed float array lookup at that distance equals 2. Returns true if either matches.

0x0049bb40.name: sub_49BB40
0x0049bb40.label: string-table lookup and copy to message buffer
0x0049bb40.summary: Binary-searches a string table; on match, copies the found string into the MessageDisplayBuffer, then copies it into a caller-supplied output buffer with null-termination.

0x0049bbb0.name: sub_49BBB0
0x0049bbb0.label: elapsed-time string formatter with fallback
0x0049bbb0.summary: Computes elapsed session time from postProcessInput, formats it as " MM:SS.FFF" into the output buffer, or writes a default string if conditions (grid cell, negative time, flag) are not met.

0x0049bcd0.name: sub_49BCD0
0x0049bcd0.label: secondary string-table lookup and copy
0x0049bcd0.summary: Binary-searches a secondary string table; on match, copies the found string into the MessageDisplayBuffer and then into the caller-supplied output buffer with null-termination.

0x0049bd40.name: sub_49BD40
0x0049bd40.label: conditional time-format with text-render-flag path select
0x0049bd40.summary: Writes default string to output; if TextRenderFlag bit 0 is set, retrieves a time value from an indexed float table (via sub_4D1B50), otherwise reads it directly from postProcessInput. Formats as " MM:SS.FFF" if the value is positive.

0x0049bde0.name: sub_49BDE0
0x0049bde0.label: third string-table lookup and copy
0x0049bde0.summary: Binary-searches a third string table (off_5CCBE4); on match, copies the found string into MessageDisplayBuffer and then into the caller-supplied output buffer with null-termination.

0x0049be50.name: sub_49BE50
0x0049be50.label: Sector time difference format
0x0049be50.summary: Computes difference between finish and start time values, formats as "+/-MM:SS.mmm" string in output buffer. Part of lap timing HUD display with ghost/replay comparison support.

0x0049bff0.name: sub_49BFF0
0x0049bff0.label: Next lap time format
0x0049bff0.summary: Reads time value for next lap index (current+1, wraps at 2→0), formats as " MM:SS.mmm" string in output buffer. Part of lap timing HUD display with ghost/replay comparison support.

0x0049c0b0.name: sub_49C0B0
0x0049c0b0.label: conditional debug-string formatter from vehicle struct
0x0049c0b0.summary: Copies default string to output; depending on TextRenderFlag, selects either a vehicle struct (via sub_4D1B50 lookup) or postProcessInput; if a time field in the struct is positive, formats a debug string from offset 0x46F8 and outputs it.

0x0049c140.name: sub_49C140
0x0049c140.label: multi-table string lookup by circular index
0x0049c140.summary: Uses the circular index (0-2) from postProcessInput to select among three string tables (off_5CCBF0, off_5CCBE8, off_5CCBEC), binary-searches the chosen table, and copies the result to the output buffer.

0x0049c280.name: sub_49C280
0x0049c280.label: simple circular-index time formatter
0x0049c280.summary: Reads a time value from postProcessInput's indexed time array using a circular index (0-2); if positive, formats as " MM:SS.FFF" into the output buffer.

0x0049c310.name: sub_49C310
0x0049c310.label: debug-label formatter from struct name field
0x0049c310.summary: If the debug-suppression flag at postProcessInput+0x405C is clear, reads a name string (at offset 0x46F8) from a pointer at postProcessInput+0x40D0, formats it with "%s:" suffix, and outputs the result.

0x0049c370.name: sub_49C370
0x0049c370.label: lap-time gap formatter with lap-count fallback
0x0049c370.summary: Computes time gap (or lap count gap) between current vehicle and a target via LapTimeGapCalculation; formats as "-MM:SS.FFF" for behind, or "-N lâps" for ahead (with localized plural via string table).

0x0049c490.name: sub_49C490
0x0049c490.label: secondary debug-label formatter
0x0049c490.summary: If debug-suppression flag is clear, reads a name string (at offset 0x46F8) from a pointer at postProcessInput+0x40D4, formats it with "%s:" suffix, and writes to output.

0x0049c4e0.name: sub_49C4E0
0x0049c4e0.label: inverse lap-time gap formatter (current-to-other)
0x0049c4e0.summary: Computes time gap from current vehicle to a target (swapped LapTimeGapCalculation order); formats as "+MM:SS.FFF" if ahead, or "+N lâps" if behind by laps (localized via string table).

0x0049c600.name: SeasonNameLookup
0x0049c600.label: season-name string-table lookup and copy
0x0049c600.summary: Binary-searches a season-name string table; on match, copies the found season name into the MessageDisplayBuffer and then into the caller-supplied output buffer with null-termination.

0x0049c670.name: sub_49C670
0x0049c670.label: lap counter formatter
0x0049c670.summary: Formats current lap number (incremented from postProcessInput lap index) and total race laps as " %d/%d" or " %d/--" for unlimited-lap races.

0x0049c6d0.name: sub_49C6D0
0x0049c6d0.label: position/count formatter
0x0049c6d0.summary: Formats current race position and total vehicle count as " %d/%d" into the output buffer.

0x0049c700.name: sub_49C700
0x0049c700.label: string-table lookup and copy (off_5CCBD8)
0x0049c700.summary: Binary-searches a string table via off_5CCBD8; on match, copies the found string into MessageDisplayBuffer and then into the caller-supplied output buffer with null-termination.

0x0049c770.name: sub_49C770
0x0049c770.label: fuel-quantity formatter with unit and metric/imperial switch
0x0049c770.summary: Reads a fuel quantity and multiplier from postProcessInput; selects unit string (literal or computed); formats value as integer or gallons (converted, one decimal) based on CostDisplayMode flag.

0x0049c830.name: EventRoundNameLookup
0x0049c830.label: event/round name string-table lookup and copy
0x0049c830.summary: Binary-searches an event/round name string table; on match, copies the found name into MessageDisplayBuffer and then into the caller-supplied output buffer with null-termination.

0x0049c8a0.name: ShortComputation_c8a0
0x0049c8a0.label: championship score threshold formatter
0x0049c8a0.summary: Looks up a championship score threshold via ChampionshipScoreThresholdSearch; displays as integer if positive, otherwise displays a placeholder string (e.g. "---").

0x0049c8f0.name: sub_49C8F0
0x0049c8f0.label: string-table lookup and copy (off_5CCBF8)
0x0049c8f0.summary: Binary-searches a string table via off_5CCBF8; on match, copies the found string into MessageDisplayBuffer and then into the caller-supplied output buffer with null-termination.

0x0049c960.name: sub_49C960
0x0049c960.label: countdown-timer formatter
0x0049c960.summary: Computes remaining session time (threshold minus elapsed); displays as " MM:SS.FFF" countdown. Suppressed in qualifying session type and championship mode.

0x0049ca00.name: CockpitDashboardLEDGaugeSetup
0x0049ca00.label: Cockpit Dashboard LED Gauge Initialization
0x0049ca00.summary: One-shot initialization of the cockpit dashboard LED gauge HUD widget: creates sub-elements, loads BMP texture resources, allocates animation control memory, and resolves UI manager handles. Returns success/failure.

0x0049cd80.name: sub_49CD80
0x0049cd80.label: VehicleNodeCreateWithAudioVisual
0x0049cd80.summary: Loads vehicle definition from game data path, creates vehicle node with 2D rectangle rendering and audio sound handle. Part of vehicle/cockpit graphics loading system.

0x0049d070.name: SteeringWheelAnimation
0x0049d070.label: Steering wheel animation update/render
0x0049d070.summary: Renders steering wheel animation HUD element. Conditionally selects audio trigger path or sub-function chain based on engine input mode state, then updates five animation parameters via clamped lerp.

0x0049d150.name: MultiStageCleanupWithRepeatedCallCycle
0x0049d150.label: Multi-Stage Resource Cleanup & Struct Zeroing
0x0049d150.summary: Iterates over pointer fields (indices 1-7), calls release/cleanup on non-null linked-list and resource pointers, then runs 5 cycles of 4-phase cleanup (ShortComputation, SoundResourceCleanup, SingleFieldFree, ConditionalFree) on sub-blocks at offsets +24, +43, +62, +81, +100. Finally zeroes all 24 DWORD fields (0x00-0x5C).

0x0049d280.name: WheelRotationAnimation
0x0049d280.label: Wheel rotation audio animation
0x0049d280.summary: Triggers up to four wheel rotation audio effects based on driver appearance bitmask. Each wheel's audio source is stored in struct fields at offsets 0x20-0x2C.

0x0049d320.name: TrackPositionNameFormatter
0x0049d320.label: Gear indicator formatting and display
0x0049d320.summary: Formats the current gear position (numeric, neutral "N", or error text) into a display buffer and renders it to the HUD. Called from steering wheel animation chain.

0x0049d3f0.name: GlobalStateBranchFormat
0x0049d3f0.label: Speed value formatting and display
0x0049d3f0.summary: Reads speed magnitude via one of two accessor functions (selected by encoding flag), formats as zero-padded 3-digit number, and renders to HUD.

0x0049d440.name: FormatRegisterDispatch
0x0049d440.label: Register value text dispatch
0x0049d440.summary: Fetches a formatted register/state value via sub_49C6D0 into a 16-byte buffer and renders it to HUD at position (4, 0).

0x0049d4c0.name: sub_49D4C0
0x0049d4c0.label: Vehicle state audio effects dispatch
0x0049d4c0.summary: Evaluates multiple vehicle state checks (collision, fuel, pit, disqualification, flags) and triggers corresponding audio effects or collision events through audio source handles stored at this[12]-this[18].

0x0049d5d0.name: sub_49D5D0
0x0049d5d0.label: Race state HUD dispatch
0x0049d5d0.summary: Dispatches to HUD rendering sub-systems based on RaceSessionState and SessionType. Renders clipped rect backdrop, then conditionally branches into formatting functions for timing, position, brake/water temp, or session-specific displays.

0x0049d700.name: sub_49D700
0x0049d700.label: Multi-line session HUD display
0x0049d700.summary: Renders a multi-line HUD display with alternating label/value pairs for session-specific data (standings, gaps, laps). Uses pre-formatted text buffers from batch source and renders at stepped Y positions.

0x0049da60.name: TimestampedRenderStringUpdate
0x0049da60.label: Timestamped HUD string update
0x0049da60.summary: Renders a single timestamped data row (label + value) for HUD display. Formats value via sub_49C8F0 and label via sub_49C960, then renders as label/value pair.

0x0049db00.name: sub_49DB00
0x0049db00.label: Temperature value formatter
0x0049db00.summary: Formats a temperature value as integer with unit suffix. Optionally converts Celsius to Fahrenheit based on CostDisplayMode flag.

0x0049db80.name: BrakeWaterTemperatureHUDDisplay
0x0049db80.label: Temperature display HUD
0x0049db80.summary: Renders water, oil, and brake temperatures to HUD with labels. Converts Kelvin to Celsius, formats via temperature formatter, and renders label/value pairs at stepped Y positions.

0x0049de40.name: sub_49DE40
0x0049de40.label: Session state 2 HUD display
0x0049de40.summary: Renders session-state-2 HUD overlay: clipped backdrop, colored status indicators, suspension corner position bars, and formatted text (round/event info). Used for race standings or car status view.

0x0049e170.name: FormatStringBatchDisplay
0x0049e170.label: Batch format character display
0x0049e170.summary: Renders a 2-row batch of single-character values at fixed grid positions. Characters are read from indexed control/config mapping globals, formatted as "%c", and displayed via sub_553070.

0x0049e3e0.name: ConditionalDispatch
0x0049e3e0.label: Conditional rendering dispatch
0x0049e3e0.summary: Guarded dispatch to sub_49F1C0 drawing function. Passes render surface and display context after null checks.

0x0049e410.name: DualTextDisplay
0x0049e410.label: Dual text label/value display
0x0049e410.summary: Formats and renders a label/value pair at the same Y position. Label uses sub_49BB40 and renders at first X, value uses sub_49BBB0 and renders at second X.

0x0049e520.name: RandomCollisionEvent
0x0049e520.label: Collision audio event dispatch
0x0049e520.summary: Triggers collision audio effect based on session time threshold. Calls InterruptDispatch with session time, then enables/disables audio source handle depending on time > 0.5s.

0x0049e5b0.name: FloatToColorEncoding
0x0049e5b0.label: Float to color gradient encoding
0x0049e5b0.summary: Maps a float value (range 30-150) to a 32-bit ARGB color gradient. Low values map to blue, mid values to green, high values to red with clamped endpoints.

0x0049e7b0.name: sub_49E7B0
0x0049e7b0.label: Colored suspension load indicator bar
0x0049e7b0.summary: Renders a colored horizontal bar representing suspension load for a wheel corner. Bar fill level and color (red/yellow/green) indicate normalized load value from vehicle physics data.

0x0049e930.name: VehicleNodeCreation
0x0049e930.label: Vehicle node/D3D texture creation
0x0049e930.summary: Allocates and initializes a 96-byte vehicle node struct with D3D texture creation attempt. On successful texture creation, frees the struct and clears pointer; on failure, retains struct for retry state.

0x0049e9a0.name: AudioSoundCreateWithHandle
0x0049e9a0.label: Audio node/D3D texture creation
0x0049e9a0.summary: Allocates and initializes a 96-byte audio node struct with D3D texture creation attempt (same pattern as VehicleNodeCreation but stores at this[3] instead of this[2]). On success frees struct, on failure retains for retry.

0x0049ea10.name: F_2DRectangleRender
0x0049ea10.label: 2D textured quad render
0x0049ea10.summary: Renders a 2D textured rectangle (quad) with computed UV coordinates. Stores rectangle parameters as floats, computes UV scale from texture dimensions, and renders 4 vertices with sub_553650.

0x0049eb40.name: FloatComputation_eb40
0x0049eb40.label: Float computation / secondary quad render
0x0049eb40.summary: Renders a second 2D textured quad using audio node (this+0xC) as resource. Calls SingleFieldFreeWrapper then renders 4 vertices with UV coordinates. Mirror of F_2DRectangleRender but stores at this+0xC and this+0x3C-0x48.

0x0049ec40.name: ShortComputation_ec40
0x0049ec40.label: Resource handle cleanup at offset 0
0x0049ec40.summary: Releases a resource handle stored at this[0] via ResourceCascadeCleanup and clears it to 0. Called before re-render to clean up stale resources.

0x0049ec60.name: SoundResourceCleanup
0x0049ec60.label: Sound/vehicle node resource cleanup
0x0049ec60.summary: Releases and frees the resource pointer stored at this[2] (offset 0x8). Calls destructor, stub cleanup, and free wrapper, then clears pointer to 0.

0x0049eca0.name: SingleFieldFreeWrapper
0x0049eca0.label: Single field resource cleanup (this[1])
0x0049eca0.summary: Releases resource handle at this[1] (offset 0x4) via ResourceCascadeCleanup and clears to 0. Same pattern as ShortComputation_ec40 but operates on offset 0x4 instead of 0x0.

0x0049ecc0.name: ConditionalFreeSubCall
0x0049ecc0.label: ConditionalFreeSubObject
0x0049ecc0.summary: Conditionally frees a sub-object at this+0xC if non-null. Calls destructor, empty stub helper, and heap free wrapper, then nulls the pointer.

0x0049ed00.name: FieldSetterTrigger
0x0049ed00.label: FieldSetterTrigger
0x0049ed00.summary: Stores parameter a2 into this+0x1C then triggers UISparkleEffect. Simple field setter with side-effect call.

0x0049ed30.name: UISparkleEffect
0x0049ed30.label: UISparkleEffectRender
0x0049ed30.summary: Renders a 4-point sparkle/star graphic around a center position using angular interpolation and color-coded vertices. Reads rotation mode, angle, speed/duration ratios, and center coordinates from the struct.

0x0049ef40.name: OnScreen_Enter
0x0049ef40.label: OnScreen_Enter
0x0049ef40.summary: OnScreen debug-log entry point called during Game_Enter. Runs StringSplitLoop as assertion check, logs "entered onscreen" message on success.

0x0049ef70.name: OnScreen_Setup
0x0049ef70.label: OnScreen_Setup
0x0049ef70.summary: OnScreen debug-log entry point called during Game_Setup. Runs StringSplitLoop assertion check, logs "entered onscreen" message if assertion passes.

0x0049efa0.name: OnScreen_Init
0x0049efa0.label: OnScreen_Init
0x0049efa0.summary: OnScreen initialization called during Game_Init. Runs assertion log, initializes race session with constants, conditionally sets up cockpit LED gauge based on vehicle count, dispatches resource delegate, and calls sub-initializer.

0x0049f000.name: OnScreen_Restart
0x0049f000.label: OnScreen_Restart
0x0049f000.summary: OnScreen restart handler called during Game_Restart. Runs assertion log, dispatches resource calls, resets two state fields (0x4=1, 0x8=0), then walks table at 8AD2A8 clearing 25 entries via VTableDispatchWithFieldClear.

0x0049f070.name: ShortComputation_f070
0x0049f070.label: PostFrameUpdateDispatch
0x0049f070.summary: Main per-frame update dispatcher called from GamePostMainLoop. Runs mode dispatch, clamps camera shake, checks boot/kick status, updates steering wheel animation, conditionally dispatches resource thunk, then evaluates session state to conditionally render position/speed UI overlay.

0x0049f0d0.name: OnScreen_Post
0x0049f0d0.label: OnScreen_Post
0x0049f0d0.summary: OnScreen post-frame cleanup called from Game_Post. Runs assertion log, calls session utility function, triggers multi-stage cleanup on UI singleton, then cleans up static array.

0x0049f120.name: OnScreen_Exit
0x0049f120.label: OnScreen_Exit
0x0049f120.summary: OnScreen exit logging called from GameExit. Runs StringSplitLoop assertion check, logs "entered onscreen" message on success.

0x0049f150.name: FunctionCallWrapper_f150
0x0049f150.label: SessionInitFlagSetter
0x0049f150.summary: Stores argument a2 into this+0x0 and sets global byte_8AD384 flag to 1 when a2==1 (session init complete). Returns bool indicating whether a2 equals 1.

0x0049f170.name: sub_49F170
0x0049f170.label: CyclicIndexAdvanceUntilValid
0x0049f170.summary: Advances or decrements a cyclic index (this+0x4, range 0-4) in direction determined by a2, looping until the indexed entry in the player vehicle struct (at offset 40 + index*64) has value > 1. Used to find next valid slot.

0x0049f1c0.name: sub_49F1C0
0x0049f1c0.label: PitStatusHUDRender
0x0049f1c0.summary: Renders pit-status HUD text overlay for each of 5 vehicle slots. Shows driver names, highlights the active slot with colored selection box, and formats position/speed text. Called with render surface dimensions and texture handles.

0x0049f530.name: ParamRangeClampedLerp
0x0049f530.label: ParamClampedLerpDispatch
0x0049f530.summary: Reads a parameter value (speed, temperature, pressure, friction) based on mode index (0-4), applies unit conversion and range clamping, then stores the normalized range and offset into struct a2 and calls field setter/guarded call chain.

0x0049f790.name: ModeBasedDispatch
0x0049f790.label: ModeBasedDispatch
0x0049f790.summary: Dispatches UI mode updates based on this+0x0 value and global feature flags. When in mode 1, checks audio/input/UI flags to advance selected index via sub_49F170 or decrement via IndexDecrementWithBoundsWrap.

0x0049f870.name: sub_49F870
0x0049f870.label: VehicleLabel2DRenderer
0x0049f870.summary: Renders 2D text labels (driver names, timings) above vehicles in the 3D world projected to screen space. Part of the HUD/overlay rendering system — collects visible vehicles via view-frustum test, sorts by distance, and draws scissored text labels.

0x004a0030.name: sub_4A0030
0x004a0030.label: ChampionshipSessionInit
0x004a0030.summary: Initializes session state based on championship/race mode (dword_7D0410). For modes 1-4 sets global state and dispatches monitor page; for modes 5-6 just sets state. Always calls global vtable dispatch and penalty struct init.

0x004a00a0.name: sub_4A00A0
0x004a00a0.label: session/scene initialization orchestrator (post-loading setup dispatch)
0x004a00a0.summary: Orchestrates post-loading initialization of a race session: hides cursor, conditionally loads a FIA short BIK video in championship mode, then chains through camera setup, vehicle assignment, collision/scoring gating, telemetry, and scene rendering subsystems.

0x004a0250.name: sub_4A0250
0x004a0250.label: Post-Race Session State Transition Handler
0x004a0250.summary: Handles post-race session state transitions: cleans up D3D collision resources, shows cursor, dispatches post-race monitor commands, tears down scoring gates, and updates vehicle state per session type. Conditionally activates post-race monitoring when session type is race (7) and championship mode is not 6.

0x004a03f0.name: SystemOSAPICall
0x004a03f0.label: SystemOSAPICall
0x004a03f0.summary: Shows OS cursor (busy-waits until ShowCursor > 0), resets global state to 0, runs a short computation, and initializes audio mixer device. Called during main menu and session transitions.

0x004a0430.name: sub_4A0430
0x004a0430.label: SessionModeUIPageDispatch
0x004a0430.summary: Dispatches UI page lookup based on championship/race mode. For modes 1-4 opens monitor page. For mode 5 opens either mp host grid or mp client grid depending on session state check.

0x004a0490.name: sub_4A0490
0x004a0490.label: SessionScoringCleanupAndReset
0x004a0490.summary: Session-level scoring and state cleanup. Sets session init state for server mode, dispatches per-mode handler (profile icon loading, tire wear computation, mode fallback), resets sound system, buffer, and season scoring, then dispatches main menu.

0x004a0590.name: sub_4A0590
0x004a0590.label: SessionPhaseAdvance
0x004a0590.summary: Advances session phase (1→2→...→7) by calling MultiplayerVehiclePlacement with the next phase number. For race mode 4, additionally dereferences standings buffer and either advances pit stop phase or checks session active state when phase 7.

0x004a0630.name: SessionSceneInitChain
0x004a0630.label: SessionSceneInitChain
0x004a0630.summary: Initializes session scene: places multiplayer vehicles (phase 1), allocates node list, checks array init, loads track scene via settings path (with fallback to default directory), resets sound system, initializes buffer defaults, and calls sub-initializer.

0x004a0690.name: SceneClearReset
0x004a0690.label: SceneClearReset
0x004a0690.summary: Resets/clears scene state: initializes array check, loads track scene from settings path (with fallback to default directory), resets sound system, initializes buffer defaults, and calls sub-initializer.

0x004a06e0.name: SessionInit
0x004a06e0.label: SessionInit
0x004a06e0.summary: Initializes session state: resets sound system and buffer, calls sub-init with parameter 4, sets session init flag to 1, stores scoring gate flag, initializes array and init state flag, then conditionally places multiplayer vehicles based on tire wear data.

0x004a0760.name: sub_4A0760
0x004a0760.label: Race Session Phase Initialization / Video Playback Orchestrator
0x004a0760.summary: Initializes a race session phase by checking scoring/race state, playing intro/outro Bink videos (windrivers/winners), updating standings, dispatching UI commands, and setting the multiplayer session state to active (3). Part of the race flow/game-mode state machine.

0x004a08e0.name: sub_4A08E0
0x004a08e0.label: ClassificationScreenFileLoad
0x004a08e0.summary: Conditionally loads and displays classification/scoring screen data. When standings delegation returns 3, linked list has data, and scene file count is 1 with race timer flag set, constructs path string and loads file. Always displays scoring classification.

0x004a09a0.name: SessionActiveCheck
0x004a09a0.label: SessionActiveCheck
0x004a09a0.summary: Checks if session is active by dereferencing the standings buffer. If active, delegates to get vehicle setup path, loads track scene, and calls session sub-initializer. Returns 1 if inactive, 0 if active.

0x004a09f0.name: sub_4A09F0
0x004a09f0.label: BinkVideoLoader
0x004a09f0.summary: Loads a .bik (Bink video) file for the current scene. Constructs path from scene directory and base path, then loads the file with retry logic.

0x004a0a80.name: sub_4A0A80
0x004a0a80.label: MenuStateTransitionTo2
0x004a0a80.summary: Transitions game menu state to 2 and dispatches via global vtable. Conditionally handles championship race-completion state when session type is 7 (multiplayer lobby).

0x004a0af0.name: sub_4A0AF0
0x004a0af0.label: GameFilterDispatch
0x004a0af0.summary: Checks game command dispatch interface for feature availability (vtable+28, param 23). If available, dispatches game filter. Used during multiplayer session joining.

0x004a0b20.name: sub_4A0B20
0x004a0b20.label: LapModuloEventDispatcher
0x004a0b20.summary: Dispatches milestone driving events based on lap number modulo 5 and driver position. Triggers event IDs 13 and 19 at specific lap intervals for the leading driver.

0x004a0ba0.name: RaceFinishHandler
0x004a0ba0.label: RaceFinishHandler
0x004a0ba0.summary: Handles race completion per driver. Triggers per-driver commentary, transitions game state machine to post-race mode, and conditionally switches to menu mode based on vehicle state and timing. Dispatches event 19 for race winner.

0x004a0c60.name: SessionMenuModeSwitch
0x004a0c60.label: PostRaceMenuModeSwitch
0x004a0c60.summary: Switches session to menu mode after race completion. Two paths: if setup directory suffix flag is set, transitions directly to main menu with SessionType5=6; otherwise initializes post-race state (reciprocal computation and one-time init) if qualifying DSQ is not enabled.

0x004a0cb0.name: sub_4A0CB0
0x004a0cb0.label: RestartMenuModeGuard
0x004a0cb0.summary: Conditionally invokes SessionMenuModeSwitch after session restart. Guards require qualifying DSQ disabled, HUD enabled, session mode identifier at -1 (unset), and player vehicle state field == 1.

0x004a0cf0.name: ConditionalInitGuard
0x004a0cf0.label: ConditionalInitGuard
0x004a0cf0.summary: Guards initialization logic against the HUD-disable flag. Only runs sub_4A0250 and resets InitZeroFieldSet when DisableHUDFlag is 0. Returns the DisableHUDFlag value.

0x004a0d50.name: sub_4A0D50
0x004a0d50.label: CommandLineOptionParser
0x004a0d50.summary: Parses command-line or config string for known option keywords. Sets flags for "altosc" (alternate OS/controller config) and "skipoptions" (skip options screen) to configure session behavior.

0x004a0df0.name: SessionStateDispatch
0x004a0df0.label: UIStateDispatchForSession
0x004a0df0.summary: Dispatches UI handling based on current session state. For session state 3, queries dispatch interface with param 36; for state 2, with param 35. When valid result is returned, processes text input, list selection, and plays UI sound effect.

0x004a0e70.name: SessionTypeGuard
0x004a0e70.label: SessionTypeGuardDispatch
0x004a0e70.summary: Guards a dispatch call against session type and HUD-disable flag. Only dispatches when GameCommandDispatchInterface exists and session type is 2 (race) or 6 (menu), or HUD is disabled. Used for forwarding network/session messages.

0x004a0eb0.name: Options_Setup
0x004a0eb0.label: OptionsSetupHandler
0x004a0eb0.summary: Handles options/setup screen initialization and main processing loop. Manages state transitions between initial setup, options screen entry, and session initialization. Logs entry detection, checks guard flags, and runs setup loop until exit condition.

0x004a0fb0.name: GlobalZeroInit
0x004a0fb0.label: SessionStateFlagsClear
0x004a0fb0.summary: Resets five session-state global flags/values to zero during game restart. Part of session/game state initialization system.

0x004a0fd0.name: RestartGate
0x004a0fd0.label: Session Restart and Menu Transition Gate
0x004a0fd0.summary: Central gatekeeper for session restart and main-menu transitions. Evaluates global flags (mini-restart, full-restart, init-guard), a countdown timer, scoring state, and input-device actions to decide whether to return 4 (mini-restart with cleanup), return 6 (full restart), transition to main menu, or continue normal execution.

0x004a1200.name: sub_4A1200
0x004a1200.label: CreateGameWindow
0x004a1200.summary: Creates the main game window (and optionally a child message window) via Win32 API — registers window classes, creates windows with appropriate styles, clips the cursor, and shows the window. Part of the video manager / windowing system.

0x004a14e0.name: sub_4A14E0
0x004a14e0.label: WindowCleanupDestroy
0x004a14e0.summary: Cleans up and destroys game windows during shutdown. Destroys the main window and a secondary window (if different), unregisters their window classes, and releases cursor clip. Called from VidMan_Exit.

0x004a1830.name: sub_4A1830
0x004a1830.label: WindowsMessagePump
0x004a1830.summary: Processes Windows message queue (message pump). Peeks for and dispatches all pending messages. If no messages pending, sleeps for a computed duration unless sleep is suppressed.

0x004a18d0.name: OSMan_Enter
0x004a18d0.label: SingleInstanceGuard
0x004a18d0.summary: Ensures only one instance of the application runs by creating a named mutex. Logs OS manager entry. Returns TRUE if another instance is already running (mutex already exists) or creation fails.

0x004a1b90.name: FileSettingsScanner
0x004a1b90.label: FileSettingsScanner
0x004a1b90.summary: Scans a settings file buffer for configuration key-value pairs. Parses tokens delimited by separators, extracts the key portion by removing substrings, compares the key against a reference path, and calls a virtual callback to process matches.

0x004a1d10.name: LinkedListWalker
0x004a1d10.label: LinkedListWalker
0x004a1d10.summary: Walks a singly-linked list and invokes FileSettingsScanner on each node. Tracks current position in iterator field (this+0x8). Used during player file initialization to process settings entries.

0x004a1d50.name: LinkedListDispatchWithVTableCalls
0x004a1d50.label: LinkedListDispatchWithVTableCalls
0x004a1d50.summary: Walks a linked list and calls each node's first vtable function (vtable[0]) with a parameter. Optionally performs resource lookup with dual path before traversal. Tracks current position in iterator field (this+0x8).

0x004a1da0.name: FlagSetterWithGlobalUpdate
0x004a1da0.label: FlagSetterWithGlobalUpdate
0x004a1da0.summary: Sets a byte flag at offset 0x10 of an object and synchronizes a global pointer. When flag is non-zero, stores object address in SessionCatchupFlag; when zero, clears the global.

0x004a1dc0.name: LinkedListAppend_1dc0
0x004a1dc0.label: LinkedListAppend
0x004a1dc0.summary: Appends a new node containing data to a linked list. Allocates a 12-byte node, populates it with data pointer and zeroed next/flag fields, then inserts at the tail. Updates head (if first node), tail, and element count.

0x004a1ec0.name: SettingsPathBuilder
0x004a1ec0.label: SettingsPathBuilder
0x004a1ec0.summary: Constructs a settings file path by concatenating the application directory, a base file path, a player-specific identifier, and a file suffix, then passes the built path to ShortComputation_1b70 for processing.

0x004a1f10.name: FileStreamCleanup
0x004a1f10.label: DualPathResourceCleanup
0x004a1f10.summary: Performs resource cleanup by calling ResourceLookupWithDualPath on three paths. Uses this+0x4 as a custom path if non-null, otherwise falls back to default application directory. Always returns 1.

0x004a1f60.name: sub_4A1F60
0x004a1f60.label: QuadWordZeroInit
0x004a1f60.summary: Initializes 4 consecutive DWORD fields at the object pointer to zero. Returns the object pointer. Simple struct constructor/initializer.

0x004a1fd0.name: RangeProportionInitializer
0x004a1fd0.label: RangeProportionInitializer
0x004a1fd0.summary: Initializes a float range min/max pair and precomputes inverse range for proportion calculation. Sets field 0/2/4 to min, max, and (if range positive) 1/(max-min) for fast linear interpolation lookups.

0x004a2010.name: PitCrewMeshLoader
0x004a2010.label: PitCrewMeshLoader
0x004a2010.summary: Loads pit crew member meshes into the scene graph. Guards on detail level threshold, allocates mesh resources, walks sub-mesh linked list, appends nodes to actor node list, and builds child index table. Falls back to error logging on allocation failure.

0x004a2220.name: sub_4A2220
0x004a2220.label: PitCrewAnimStructInitAndCleanup
0x004a2220.summary: Initializes a pit crew animation structure with default values and releases any previously allocated resources (3D sound source, buffer, array of 28-byte animation elements). Reinit/destructor hybrid called during cleanup and loader reentry.

0x004a22d0.name: sub_4A22D0
0x004a22d0.label: PitCrewAnimFrameAdd
0x004a22d0.summary: Adds one animation frame entry to the pit crew animation element array. Grows the array by one, copies existing data, allocates per-element scratch buffer, populates it by walking a wide-string linked list and mapping animation name strings to IDs.

0x004a24d0.name: PitCrewAnimationStringMapper
0x004a24d0.label: PitCrewAnimationStringMapper
0x004a24d0.summary: Maps a pit crew animation name string to an integer enum ID (0-24). Called during animation frame loading to identify which pit crew animation type a named entry corresponds to.

0x004a2770.name: ModeDependentSubsystemCall
0x004a2770.label: PitCrewMeshLoadWithMode
0x004a2770.summary: Sets mode byte and parameter, loads a pit crew mesh via PitCrewMeshLoader, then conditionally adjusts runtime flags based on the stored mode. Only manipulates flags when the 3D sound source handle at 0x64 is non-null.

0x004a27d0.name: ConditionalDispatch_27d0
0x004a27d0.label: ConditionalTransformUpdate
0x004a27d0.summary: Conditionally dispatches 6 transform/position parameters (3 DWORDS + 3 floats at offsets 0x4C-0x60) to sub_54B4D0 when the sound source handle at offset 0x64 is non-null. Otherwise returns the struct pointer unchanged.

0x004a2800.name: Vec3CopyToStruct
0x004a2800.label: Vec3CopyToStruct
0x004a2800.summary: Copies two 3-element DWORD arrays from source pointers into struct fields at offsets 0x4C-0x60 (first source to 0x4C-0x54, second source to 0x58-0x60), then dispatches a conditional transform update via ConditionalDispatch_27d0.

0x004a2840.name: sub_4A2840
0x004a2840.label: KeyframeAnimationUpdater
0x004a2840.summary: Updates keyframe-driven animation state: iterates through keyframe segments (7 floats each), interpolates output value based on input parameter a2, calls listener callbacks when value changes. Tracks last value for change detection. Part of animation/UI system (pit crew/animation).

0x004a2980.name: StructInitCall
0x004a2980.label: StructInitCall
0x004a2980.summary: Zeros three consecutive DWORD fields (offsets 0xC, 0x10, 0x14) then calls ArrayResourceCleanup. Simple struct field reinitialization stub.

0x004a29a0.name: ArrayResourceCleanup
0x004a29a0.label: ArrayResourceCleanup
0x004a29a0.summary: Cleans up an array of 120-byte pit crew animation sub-structs and releases associated resources (3D sound source). Zeros 3 header DWORDs, iterates over elements calling sub_4A2220 destructor on each, frees the array block, then destroys the sound source.

0x004a2a90.name: PitCrewAnimationLoader
0x004a2a90.label: PitCrewAnimationFileParser
0x004a2a90.summary: Parses pit crew animation definition files (.ANM): reads ACTOR/MESH/POSITION/MOVE/ROTATE directives, allocates actor entry array (120 bytes per actor, 30 dwords), maps wheel-on/off MTS meshes to mode-dependent subsystem calls, and initializes rendering resources.

0x004a3220.name: PITANIMSMASAnimationFileLoader
0x004a3220.label: PITANIMSMASAnimationFileLoader
0x004a3220.summary: Loads pit crew animation data from the "PITANIMS.MAS" archive file. Cleans up existing resources, resolves the base directory path, opens the MAS file via sub_53CBC0, calls PitCrewAnimationLoader to parse animation data, then closes the file and cleans up string resources.

0x004a3320.name: sub_4A3320
0x004a3320.label: PitCrewOrientationSetup
0x004a3320.summary: Sets up pit crew member orientation: computes Euler rotation matrix from parameter a3, applies 180-degree Y-axis rotation, sets state flag (this[0x8] = 2), and forwards transform data. Part of pit crew animation system.

0x004a3390.name: sub_4A3390
0x004a3390.label: PitCrewAnimationStateProcessor
0x004a3390.summary: Processes pit crew animation state: iterates through child animation entries (stride 120 bytes), updates keyframe animations via sub_4A2840, manages visibility/flag bits based on active state, and triggers UI widget update when detail level >= 2. Part of pit crew rendering system.

0x004a3440.name: FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall
0x004a3440.label: PitCrewFlaggedArrayProcessor
0x004a3440.summary: Processes an array of pit-crew-related objects when the pending flag (bit 0) is set. Iterates through objects at base `this[4]` (each 120 bytes), calls Bit12FlagSet on non-null entries. Optionally updates UI widgets if detail level ≥ 2 and `this[5]` is non-zero. Clears flag bits 0-1 at end.

0x004a34a0.name: PerElementConditionalActionDispatcher
0x004a34a0.label: PitPartFlagStateMachine
0x004a34a0.summary: Manages per-part flag state in a pitstop operation. In normal mode (a2=0), conditionally sets or clears Bit12 on each non-null part object based on completion state (float == 99999.0) and a pending-interaction byte flag. In clear-all mode (a2≠0), clears Bit12 on every part unconditionally.

0x004a3560.name: FlagSetterWithOR
0x004a3560.label: PitOpValueStoreAndDirtyFlag
0x004a3560.summary: Stores a caller-supplied value into `this[4]` and sets the dirty/change flag (bit 1 on `this[0]`) to signal that the stored value was updated. Called by PitStopOperationTimer to record a pit operation parameter change.

0x004a3570.name: sub_4A3570
0x004a3570.label: PitOpCountdownAndDeltaUpdater
0x004a3570.summary: Dual-mode pit operation element updater. When flag bit 0 is set, decrements a countdown timer and resets each array element's float at offset +68 to -1.0f and calls sub_4A2840 with 0.0. When flag bit 1 is set, computes delta `a2 - this[1]` and calls sub_4A2840 on each element with the delta. Both modes are independent and can execute in the same tick.

0x004a35f0.name: sub_4A35F0
0x004a35f0.label: AnimationTargetPropagator
0x004a35f0.summary: Computes desired float values from the input parameter struct `a2` (reading flags and float offsets for two animation phases), then propagates those values into each array element's sub-element structures by calling RangeProportionInitializer. Called by PitStopOperationTimer to drive part animation targets.

0x004a3820.name: PhysicsChannelProcessingWithLocals
0x004a3820.label: AnimationPhaseDistributor
0x004a3820.summary: Computes time-phase subdivisions (0.0, 0.25×, 0.5×, 0.75×, and offset-3.6) from an input float value (elapsed time / phase), then distributes them to each array element's sub-element structures via RangeProportionInitializer. Used by PitStopOperationTimer for multi-channel animation timing.

0x004a3910.name: PitCrewAnimationMASSetup
0x004a3910.label: PitCrewAnimationMASFileLoader
0x004a3910.summary: Loads pit-crew animation MAS files from season/track-specific directories, builds file paths with left/normal hand variants, and sets up animation range parameters for pit crew members. Part of pit stop animation system.

0x004a3b30.name: sub_4A3B30
0x004a3b30.label: PitCrewExtStructInit
0x004a3b30.summary: Zeros 4 extended DWORD fields (offsets 0x78-0x84) then calls sub_4A2220 (PitCrewAnimStructInitAndCleanup) to perform base struct initialization and resource cleanup.

0x004a3b50.name: Camera
0x004a3b50.label: CameraUpdate
0x004a3b50.summary: Computes updated camera position and yaw rotation for a 3D object (pit crew member or vehicle camera). Reads current camera state via RenderCallWithGuard, computes view direction with optional weather noise perturbation, handles two code paths based on a mode flag (+0x12C in scene struct), and performs spatial grid collision query when sound source handle (0x64) is active.

0x004a3fe0.name: ShortComputation_3fe0
0x004a3fe0.label: FieldResetAndFlagUpdate
0x004a3fe0.summary: Zeros two extended DWORD fields (offsets 0x78, 0x84) and conditionally adjusts flag bits via FlagFieldBitManipulation when the sound source handle at 0x64 is non-null.

0x004a4000.name: UtilityFunction_4000
0x004a4000.label: FieldSetOneAndFlagUpdate
0x004a4000.summary: Sets DWORD field at offset 0x78 to 1, zeros DWORD at offset 0x84, and conditionally adjusts flag bits via FlagFieldBitManipulation(1,1,1,0) when the sound source handle at offset 0x64 is non-null.

0x004a4050.name: AccumulatorWithStateSwitch
0x004a4050.label: ModeSwitchAccumulator
0x004a4050.summary: Accumulates `a2` into an internal float value (offset 0x84) and forwards it to sub_4A2840. Behavior depends on state at offset 0x78: 0 = disabled (no action), 1 = reset accumulator to 0 then forward, other = accumulate and forward.

0x004a40f0.name: ArrayZeroInit
0x004a40f0.label: StructZeroInit
0x004a40f0.summary: Zero-initializes the entire struct: memset first 0x1A0 bytes to 0, then writes DWORD 0 at offset 0x1A0 (extends memset range). Called during game restart to reset state.

0x004a4110.name: sub_4A4110
0x004a4110.label: AIIncidentCooldownCheck
0x004a4110.summary: Per-frame AI incident trigger check — zeros out inactive vehicle slots, blocks incidents for vehicles in special states with moderate deceleration, then computes a race-progress-weighted probability for an AI crash/spin event with a cooldown timer at this+0x1A0.

0x004a4710.name: FindNearestVehicle
0x004a4710.label: NearestVehicleFinder
0x004a4710.summary: Iterates through the global vehicle pointer array (dword_7C54F0) to find the vehicle closest (by positive SpeedDeltaComputation) to a target vehicle identified by index a2. Uses two different distance-computation paths depending on whether the candidate pointer is null (fallback to base vehicle data). Returns the closest vehicle pointer.

0x004a47e0.name: sub_4A47E0
0x004a47e0.label: PitMenuStringByTypeId
0x004a47e0.summary: Maps an integer enum value (0-4) to a pit/garage menu string literal (StopGo, Fuel, Tyres, Wing, Damage). Part of pit strategy/HUD menu system.

0x004a4830.name: TireCompoundNameIDMapping
0x004a4830.label: TireCompoundNameToId
0x004a4830.summary: Maps a tire compound name string to an integer ID: Hard→2, Soft→3, Intermediate→4, Wet→5, Monsoon→6, unknown→1. Uses sub_588410 for string comparison (returns 0 on match).

0x004a48c0.name: F_5LoopInitCall
0x004a48c0.label: FiveSubStructInit
0x004a48c0.summary: Initializes 5 consecutive sub-structures (each 0x40 bytes, at offsets 0x18, 0x58, 0x98, 0xD8, 0x118) via StructInitializer, zeros 3 DWORD fields at offsets 0xC-0x14, then calls UIComponentCleanup. Part of physics tire system construction.

0x004a4900.name: sub_4A4900
0x004a4900.label: PitCrewAnimationLoadSetup
0x004a4900.summary: Loads pit crew animation MAS files (10sec, normal, and optionally pit-director) for the current vehicle/track context. Runs only when ScoringGate != 2 and either the target vehicle is the player vehicle or detail level >= 3.

0x004a4ed0.name: TireWheelGraphicsMeshLoader
0x004a4ed0.label: TireWheelGraphicsMeshLoader
0x004a4ed0.summary: Loads tire/wheel graphics mesh reference (.MTS file) for a specific wheel position (LF/RF/LR/RR). Parses instance name, meshfile path, and LOD distance bounds from a data stream, allocates a 72-byte mesh info struct, and links it into the per-tire linked list. Recursively handles nested instance loading.

0x004a51c0.name: sub_4A51C0
0x004a51c0.label: TireWheelMeshLoadLoop
0x004a51c0.summary: Loads tire and wheel graphics meshes by looping through file entries, with detail level controlling LOD scaling factor. Part of vehicle tire/wheel graphics loading system.

0x004a5330.name: PitPartStateCopy
0x004a5330.label: PitPartStateCopy
0x004a5330.summary: Copies pit-stop part state from a source vehicle object into a destination pit-stop state structure, including tire brand lookup, compound index search, scoring interval computation, and callback chain processing. Part of the pit-stop state management system.

0x004a55a0.name: ConditionalDispatch_55a0
0x004a55a0.label: ThreeTargetAnimationDispatcher
0x004a55a0.summary: Dispatches to up to three sub-objects for per-frame update: calls sub_4A3570 (AnimationTargetPropagator) on `this[4]` and `this[3]`, and AccumulatorWithStateSwitch on `this[5]`, passing the caller's float parameters through. Each call is guarded by null-pointer check.

0x004a55e0.name: ConditionalDispatch_55e0
0x004a55e0.label: PitstopTransitionSelector
0x004a55e0.summary: Selects between two pitstop state transition targets using a boolean flag at offset 0x2C. If flag is non-zero, calls PitstopStateTransition on `this[4]`; otherwise calls it on `this[3]`.

0x004a5600.name: PitstopStateTransition
0x004a5600.label: PitstopActiveObjectSwitcher
0x004a5600.summary: Transitions pitstop state machine from the current active sub-object to a new one (`a2`). Conditionally runs cleanup on the old sub-object (FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall) or skips cleanup based on operation state flags (offsets 0x184/0x190). Then either reinitializes the new sub-object (sub_4A3390) or directly activates it based on the old object's pending flag.

0x004a5660.name: ArithmeticComparison_5660
0x004a5660.label: PitstopModeSelector
0x004a5660.summary: Sets the pitstop operation mode and selector flags based on input `a2`. When a2=0, sets mode to 1 with flags cleared. When a2≠0 and mode is not already 2, transitions to mode 2 with flags set. Always dispatches through ConditionalDispatch_55e0 after updating state.

0x004a56b0.name: StateTransition
0x004a56b0.label: GenericModeSwitchWithReturnCode
0x004a56b0.summary: Sets operation mode and flags. When a2=0, mode=1 with flags cleared. When a2≠0 and mode is not already 2, transitions to mode 2 with flags set. Returns 0 (reset), 1 (activated), or 2 (already active). Unlike ArithmeticComparison_5660, does not dispatch further.

0x004a5700.name: ChampionshipScoreThresholdSearch
0x004a5700.label: ScoreThresholdSearch
0x004a5700.summary: Searches an array of up to 3 championship score thresholds (stride-2, starting at offset 0x164). Returns the first threshold whose value falls between the player's current championship score (at *this + 0x403C) and total race laps (dword_8ACF8C). Returns -1 if no threshold matches.

0x004a57f0.name: FindZeroResultIndex
0x004a57f0.label: ValidPartCountFinder
0x004a57f0.summary: Iterates through valid part indices by calling NthValidPartLookup(i) until it returns 0 (no part at that index). Stores the count (first index returning 0) in `this[42]`. Requires at least one valid part to complete (i > 0 guard prevents premature exit on initial index 0).

0x004a5820.name: NthValidPartLookup
0x004a5820.label: NthAvailablePartFinder
0x004a5820.summary: Finds the Nth (1-indexed) available part by iterating through a part list. Filters out parts whose byte at +20 is set (occupied/busy) during a valid race session, unless the out-of-session flag is active. Optionally filters by compound type via `this[87]`. Returns the matching part pointer or 0 if not found.

0x004a58b0.name: PitRepairStatusDisplay
0x004a58b0.label: FormatPitRepairStatusWidget
0x004a58b0.summary: Formats and refreshes a pit-repair HUD widget by computing fuel/lap-time display strings, looking up part names, formatting repair progress counters, and selecting "Repair"/"Do Not Repair" status labels based on internal mode flags.

0x004a5bd0.name: ClampedIndexAssignment
0x004a5bd0.label: FloatToClampedIndex
0x004a5bd0.summary: Converts a float value `a2` into a zero-based integer index using parameters (base, step, upper bound). Computes `round((a2 - base) / step)`, then clamps to [0, max-1]. Stores the clamped result at offset 0x6C. Used by PitStopDecisionTireCompound for array indexing.

0x004a5c40.name: TeammatePartValueLookup
0x004a5c40.label: TeammatePartValueReader
0x004a5c40.summary: Scans the global vehicle array for a teammate (same team ID, different vehicle) and returns a part-related value (offset 0x3450) from the matching vehicle. Used by ForcePitExit to read teammate pit status.

0x004a5c80.name: StateChangeNotify
0x004a5c80.label: StateChangeRecorderWithRingBuffer
0x004a5c80.summary: Records a state change event into a ring buffer for replay/progress bar. On state transitions to 1 or 2 (with specific conditions), saves the session timestamp. Increments a ring buffer counter (max 1023 entries, each 432 bytes), encodes a progress bar event (type 6), and dispatches AI state machine processing on the new entry.

0x004a5d10.name: AIStateMachineWithModeDispatch
0x004a5d10.label: AIStateMachineDispatch
0x004a5d10.summary: Main AI state machine dispatcher. Reads state from ring buffer entry `a2` (byte at +8 = mode, float at +4 = value). Updates internal mode (offset 0x184), calls AIPitStrategyState on mode change. Based on vehicle sub-state (offset 0x32C8 == 2/3) and mode, dispatches to sub_4A5EA0 (mode 2, pits-under-red) or sub_4A5F20 (mode 0). Then dispatches steering/physics via ConditionalDelegateDispatch + sub_4A3320 for modes 1/2, or FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall for mode 0.

0x004a5e10.name: SessionTransitionDispatch
0x004a5e10.label: AIModeTransitionSwitch
0x004a5e10.summary: Drives AI mode transitions: state 0→1 (activate), state 1→0 (deactivate), state 4→1 (reactivate). Routes each transition through StateChangeNotify for ring-buffer recording and dispatch. Other states produce no transition.

0x004a5e60.name: StatePhaseSetter
0x004a5e60.label: AIStatePhase4Initializer
0x004a5e60.summary: Sets AI state to phase 4 (offset 0x184) and flag to 1 (offset 0x180). If a sub-object pointer at offset 0x14 is non-null, calls ShortComputation_3fe0 on it.

0x004a5e80.name: ObjectStateClear
0x004a5e80.label: AIStateClearToZero
