0x004a5e80.summary: Resets AI state to 0 (offset 0x184) and flag to 0 (offset 0x180). If a sub-object pointer at offset 0x14 is non-null, calls ShortComputation_3fe0 on it. Inverse of StatePhaseSetter (which sets state to 4, flag to 1).

0x004a5ea0.name: sub_4A5EA0
0x004a5ea0.label: PitsUnderRedHandler
0x004a5ea0.summary: Handles the "entering pits under red flag" scenario. Fires once (guarded by flag at offset 0x180). Records state change to 2, updates session phase, processes vehicle pit state (offset +0x4034). If race start gate flag is 2 and penalties are enabled, either disqualifies (session type 7) or applies time penalty (sub_4BBA90 with 1000.0).

0x004a5f20.name: sub_4A5F20
0x004a5f20.label: ExitPitsUnderRedHandler
0x004a5f20.summary: Handles the "exiting pits under red flag" scenario. Fires once when flag at offset 0x180 is set. Records state change to 0, increments pit exit counter (offset +0x406C+56), calls AIFormationLap. If race config gate flag is 2 and penalties enabled, either disqualifies (session type 7) or applies time penalty (sub_4BBA90 with 1000.0). Always calls ShortComputation_3fe0 on sub-object at offset 0x14.

0x004a5fa0.name: VehicleProximityCollisionDetection
0x004a5fa0.label: Proximity collision detection and response
0x004a5fa0.summary: Checks if vehicle is within proximity collision range of another object, evaluates direction/velocity for collision response, and triggers collision state notification. Part of vehicle physics/tick system.

0x004a6200.name: PitStopReadyCheck
0x004a6200.label: Pit stop readiness evaluation
0x004a6200.summary: Determines if vehicle is ready for pit stop by checking wheel speed, race session state, and tire compound decision. Sets pit stop timer and triggers pit lane entry logic. Part of pit state machine.

0x004a6340.name: PitStopOperationTimer
0x004a6340.label: Pit Stop Operation Timer & Sequence Coordinator
0x004a6340.summary: Manages pit stop operation timing per frame — computes max duration of all pending operations (tire change, jack, wheel gun, refueling), tracks progress, dispatches audio/visual effects, and handles crew condition checks. Pit stop system.

0x004a68b0.name: PitStopProgress
0x004a68b0.label: Pit Stop Progress Timer and State Machine
0x004a68b0.summary: Manages pit stop progress each tick: applies wheel damage repair forces on a timed schedule, controls pit speed limiter, triggers pit exit state transitions, handles post-pit cleanup and camera mode changes.

0x004a6b80.name: CollisionAvoidanceCheck
0x004a6b80.label: Collision avoidance state machine
0x004a6b80.summary: Checks vehicle's movement direction against all other vehicles' projected trajectories to detect imminent collisions. Transitions collision avoidance state between checking and clear. Part of vehicle physics/tick.

0x004a6d50.name: sub_4A6D50
0x004a6d50.label: ChampionshipThresholdCrossingNotify
0x004a6d50.summary: In championship sessions (SessionType==7), checks if the player's score+1 matches any threshold in the stride-2 array at offsets 0x164+. If match found, calls StateChangeNotify to trigger a championship state transition.

0x004a6db0.name: VehicleControlEnabled
0x004a6db0.label: Vehicle control enable check
0x004a6db0.summary: Evaluates whether vehicle controls should be enabled by checking session type, damage/health status fields, car control mode, and force feedback state. Returns false if car is non-operational.

0x004a6e50.name: PitStateUpdateMachine
0x004a6e50.label: Pit state machine dispatcher
0x004a6e50.summary: Main pit state machine that dispatches to collision detection, pit stop readiness, pit progress, and collision avoidance based on current pit state (entering/in-pit/exiting). Coordinates vehicle control enable checks and state transitions.

0x004a7010.name: FunctionCallWrapper_7010
0x004a7010.label: ParameterStoreAndCall
0x004a7010.summary: Stores two integer parameters as duplicated pairs at offsets 0xC/0x14 and 0x10/0x18, copies an input string via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, then delegates to ShortComputation_1b70. Part of player options initialization.

0x004a7040.name: DebugCoordinateFormat
0x004a7040.label: DebugCoordinateFormat
0x004a7040.summary: Writes two constant debug strings ("%s %d %d" format and a config substring token) to a buffer via BufferWriteWithStringLengthCheck. Likely formats debug coordinate or position output for logging.

0x004a70e0.name: UIControlWindowInitialization
0x004a70e0.label: UIControlWindowConstructor
0x004a70e0.summary: Constructor that fully initializes a UI control window object by zeroing its core fields and setting up hundreds of sub-control slots with sentinel values (-1 = no target) and vtable pointers. Forms part of the game's UI system.

0x004a8af0.name: VTableInitWithDefaults
0x004a8af0.label: VTableInitWithDefaults
0x004a8af0.summary: Initializes struct vtable pointer from global off_5ACBF0 and fills 6 DWORD fields with alternating 0/-1 default pairs (offsets 0x4-0x18). Three (state/counter=0, handle/index=-1) pairs. Part of UI control window initialization.

0x004a8b10.name: InitWithSentinelValues
0x004a8b10.label: InitWithSentinelValues
0x004a8b10.summary: Initializes struct vtable pointer from global off_5ACC08 and sets one DWORD pair at offsets 0x4/0x8 (0 = state/counter, -1 = handle/index). Part of UI control window initialization.

0x004a8b30.name: ShortConstructor
0x004a8b30.label: UIWidgetConstructor
0x004a8b30.summary: Initializes struct vtable pointer from global off_5ACBFC and sets one DWORD pair at offsets 0x4/0x8 (counter=0, handle=-1). UI widget base constructor called from UIControlWindowInitialization.

0x004a8b50.name: sub_4A8B50
0x004a8b50.label: ObjectConstructor_4A8B50
0x004a8b50.summary: Constructor/initializer for a 7-field DWORD object. Sets vtable pointer at offset 0x0 to off_5ACC14 and initializes all fields to defaults (0, -1 sentinel, 0, 89, 0, 89).

0x004a8b80.name: StaticInitBulk
0x004a8b80.label: BulkDestructorCleanup
0x004a8b80.summary: Bulk destructor/cleanup for a large object (~4680 DWORDs). Calls DoubleListCleanup, frees arrays of two-pointer structs in loops (36-byte stride), calls ShortComputation_4370 on many short fields, frees multi-pointer structs, then walks a linked list at the head freeing each node and its payload, finally zeroing the first 4 DWORDs.

0x004aa170.name: MultiPointerFree_a170
0x004aa170.label: TriplePointerFree
0x004aa170.summary: Frees up to three pointers stored at object offsets 0x14, 0xC, and 0x4. Each pointer is null-checked before calling FreeWrapper_7bcf.

0x004aa1e0.name: sub_4AA1E0
0x004aa1e0.label: GameModeToPathFormatter
0x004aa1e0.summary: Maps a game mode index (0-6) to a mode string prefix, then formats "%s%s" (mode prefix + name) into output buffer via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck. Returns 1 for valid modes, 0 for invalid.

0x004aa270.name: PlayerOptionsInitializer
0x004aa270.label: player options / game settings profile initializer
0x004aa270.summary: Initializes a comprehensive player options and game settings structure with default values for driving aids, race conditions, sound, graphics, controls, network, force feedback, and HMD settings. Builds the full options tree by calling setters and string formatters for each category.

0x004add50.name: sub_4ADD50
0x004add50.label: SaveFileCopyWithMetadata
0x004add50.summary: Copies a save/settings file from source path to destination path, then overwrites the destination filename portion with metadata bytes from global renderer/UI state variables. Uses CopyFileA with overwrite enabled.

0x004ade20.name: TrackEnvironmentSelect
0x004ade20.label: TrackEnvironmentAndPhysicsSetup
0x004ade20.summary: Selects environment type (wet/dry/mixed) based on flags when parameter a2 is set, clamps camera index to valid range, loads track scene, then initializes physics parameters, driving mode, car part visibility, and tire compound.

0x004adf10.name: DrivingModeParameterSetup
0x004adf10.label: DrivingModeParameterSetup
0x004adf10.summary: Applies driving mode specific parameter values to a vehicle physics/tuning struct. Based on the mode selector at offset 0x1CC0 (switch on 6 modes), writes clamped integer and float values into multiple parameter slots with their min/max range bounds.

0x004ae490.name: CarPartVisibilityController
0x004ae490.label: UpdateCarPartVisibilityTargets
0x004ae490.summary: Updates car-part visibility slider targets across multiple part groups based on a mode selector at offset 0x1AC8. Mode 1 slides targets toward hidden (0 or 0.5f), mode 2 slides toward visible (1 or 0.5f), and any nonzero mode triggers additional visible-target processing for secondary part groups plus arithmetic comparison calls keyed by season-derived indices.

0x004ae750.name: sub_4AE750
0x004ae750.label: Vehicle Damage/Part State Initializer
0x004ae750.summary: Initializes vehicle damage/part-state arrays based on an input mode selector. Clamps the input value within valid range, then sets paired flag+value fields (enabled/disabled booleans + part type IDs) for different damage configurations across front, rear, side, and wheel components.

0x004ae9f0.name: sub_4AE9F0
0x004ae9f0.label: AIDifficultyParameterInit
0x004ae9f0.summary: Initializes AI/track-environment clamped parameters based on a difficulty level switch (1-4) read from this+0x1B10, with per-difficulty value sets and an additional AI-difficulty-dependent dispatch via dword_5EC4AC.

0x004af220.name: TireCompoundClamp
0x004af220.label: TireCompoundClamp
0x004af220.summary: Clamps tire compound selection to valid range. Selects compound value (12/14/16) and index (0/1/2/3) based on compound mode (1-4), then clamps both against per-object min/max bounds.

0x004af3a0.name: PhysicsParameterInitialization
0x004af3a0.label: TrackPhysicsParameterInit
0x004af3a0.summary: Selects and initializes a full set of physics/track-environment parameters (grip, wear, temperature, etc.) based on a track-type selector at this+0x3B40. Four profiles (cases 0-3) each clamp defaults between min/max bounds and populate nested per-wheel arrays. No guard condition; default case returns immediately.

0x004b0180.name: sub_4B0180
0x004b0180.label: DirectoryPathFormatBuilder
0x004b0180.summary: Formats a directory path string as "%s%s\\" using settings directory (or default application directory) concatenated with the input name. Returns 0.

0x004b02b0.name: NamePathFormatterWithLengthCheck
0x004b02b0.label: NamePathFormatterWithLengthCheck
0x004b02b0.summary: Formats a file path with ".bch" extension. Validates buffer size, prepends directory path from object field (or default), strips existing extension (before '.'), then appends ".bch". Returns 0 on success, -1 if buffer too small or inputs invalid.

0x004b0390.name: NameComparisonAt0x1b4
0x004b0390.label: PathLastBackslashExtractor
0x004b0390.summary: Extracts the portion of a path string after the last backslash from object field at offset 0x1B4 (this[109]), or from default directory, and copies it to output buffer via sub_587DD0. Returns 1.

0x004b03f0.name: PlayerNameNeverUsedProfileFileCreateRead
0x004b03f0.label: PlayerNameNeverUsedProfileFileCreateRead
0x004b03f0.summary: Attempts to find player profile files via directory iteration. If a profile file exists, copies it to the settings directory. If no profile files exist, reads default "PlayerNameNever..." text file, calls itself recursively, and sets two flag bytes at this+0x49A8 and this+0x49A9 to 1.

0x004b04e0.name: StringCopyFileCheckDispatch
0x004b04e0.label: StringCopyFileCheckDispatch
0x004b04e0.summary: Copies input filename string to internal buffer at this+20, determines target directory (settings dir or default), checks if path matches settings directory, builds full path if needed, then calls PlayerFileInit to initialize player file.

0x004b0540.name: PlayerFileInit
0x004b0540.label: PlayerFileLoadAndInit
0x004b0540.summary: Loads a player file by opening an audio stream on the file path, then initializes game subsystems: parses scene data, computes vehicle count from scoring, builds vehicle arrays, loads auto-load entries, and runs 5-step init — all conditioned on environment flags (wet/dry) and internal state flags.

0x004b0770.name: sub_4B0770
0x004b0770.label: SettingsFileReadWriteWithBackup
0x004b0770.summary: Manages settings file backup/restore: strips extension from default directory, appends "tmp" suffix, toggles read-only attributes, loads file list, dispatches callbacks, parses config file, then deletes old file and renames new temp file to original name. Includes debug logging via StringSplitLoop checks.

0x004b0930.name: SettingsFileInit
0x004b0930.label: SettingsFileInit
0x004b0930.summary: Updates vehicle data fields, builds a ".bch" settings file path from object's name field via NamePathFormatterWithLengthCheck, toggles read-only attribute, then reads career section data from the file via CareerSectionReader.

0x004b09a0.name: TextFileReader
0x004b09a0.label: TextFileReaderAndEnvironmentSetup
0x004b09a0.summary: Reads text file path, creates directory tree for the path, sets environment type (wet/dry), loads AIW data if scene files exist, loads vehicle data if vehicle files exist, then runs file copy, track environment selection, cleanup, and settings file read/write.

0x004b0b20.name: sub_4B0B20
0x004b0b20.label: PlayerNameOrModulePathExtractor
0x004b0b20.summary: Extracts a player/plr filename to output buffer. First tries to get a string from game module manager via NullTerminatedStringLengthAt0x11c. If not available, extracts the portion of object's name string after the last backslash and truncates at ".plr" suffix match.

0x004b0c00.name: sub_4B0C00
0x004b0c00.label: Vehicle setup parameter range-clamping batch operation
0x004b0c00.summary: Copies raw vehicle setup parameter values from an input table (offsets 0x496C-0x49A4) to working slots and clamps each to its valid min/max range. Part of the vehicle setup/config validation system.

0x004b0e30.name: VehicleDataFieldCopy
0x004b0e30.label: VehicleState_SnapshotFields
0x004b0e30.summary: Copies 15 vehicle state fields (12 ints, 1 byte, 1 float, plus one float read separately) from scattered source offsets into a contiguous destination block at this+0x496C (offset 18796). Used for network sync or save-state snapshot of vehicle data.

0x004b0ef0.name: sub_4B0EF0
0x004b0ef0.label: SessionConfigSlotActivate
0x004b0ef0.summary: Activates one of six configuration slots (indexed 1-6) by copying per-slot parameter values into the active/current fields, clamping each against stored min/max bounds; special-cases slot 1 and 2 for an additional control field, then calls sub_4B1190 to apply the configuration globally.

0x004b1190.name: sub_4B1190
0x004b1190.label: RaceSessionParameterLoader
0x004b1190.summary: Initializes race session parameters (qualifying laps, race laps, race time) with bounds clamping. Reads data from season section file using string-keyed lookups for "QualifyLaps", "RaceLaps", "RaceTime", "ReconPitOpen", "ReconPitClosed" keys. Applies time multiplier (a2) to scale values.

0x004b1410.name: NameCompareAndFormat
0x004b1410.label: NameCompareAndFormat
0x004b1410.summary: Compares input name against stored name at this[2023]. If matching, builds season directory path + name, performs object ID lookup, loads audio file for the name, then initializes settings file and runs 5-step initialization. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

0x004b1520.name: sub_4B1520
0x004b1520.label: IndexedNameExtractorWithGameFilterAppend
0x004b1520.summary: Extracts a string from an indexed array (this[7*index + 2609]), copies it to output buffer with length limit. If a game filter string is available from conditional dispatch and buffer has space, appends ".HOT" extension + game filter string.

0x004b15d0.name: BitmaskStateTest
0x004b15d0.label: Bitmask state test
0x004b15d0.summary: Tests whether a given bit index is set in a bitmask field, with an early-exit guard based on a state field value. Returns true if state field is not 5, or if the specific bit is set in the bitmask.

0x004b1600.name: PathPathRegistryWriter
0x004b1600.label: PathRegistryBulkCopy
0x004b1600.summary: Copies six path string pointers from object fields (offsets 0x1F8C, 0x1F94, 0x1F9C, 0x1A4, 0x1AC, 0x1B4) into reallocated string buffers. Each null pointer falls back to default directory. Returns result of last copy.

0x004b16b0.name: TrackConfigurationNameBuilder
0x004b16b0.label: TrackConfigurationNameBuilder
0x004b16b0.summary: If track name at this+0x2D50 is non-empty, calls NameCompareAndFormat to load season data/audio for the track, then copies default directory. If config name at this+0x2D6C is non-empty, copies three additional path strings from object fields at offsets 0x2D5C, 0x2D64, 0x2D6C and default directory into reallocated buffers.

0x004b1780.name: InputClamp
0x004b1780.label: InputValueClamp
0x004b1780.summary: Clamps an input value (at this+0x2988) to the range [-1, 1]. If StateCheckWrapper fails (game not in correct state), returns the raw value unclamped.

0x004b17b0.name: sub_4B17B0
0x004b17b0.label: SeasonDataFreeAtHalfDistance
0x004b17b0.summary: During race or qualifying session (type 5 or 7), checks if a session phase field (this+0x1F78) equals 4 and half-distance flag is set. If so, frees season data via ConditionalSeasonDataFree.

0x004b17f0.name: sub_4B17F0
0x004b17f0.label: NoPlayerStringFlagSetter
0x004b17f0.summary: Checks if input string a2 contains the substring "noplayer". If found, sets flag at this+0x49AC to 1. Returns result of substring search.

0x004b1820.name: PlayerFile_Enter
0x004b1820.label: PlayerFileEnter
0x004b1820.summary: Logs debug message when entering player file handler. Sets player data pointer (this+0x49B0) to global vehicle data structure (unk_5EC6D8), then calls PlayerNameNeverUsedProfileFileCreateRead to initialize profile.

0x004b1870.name: PlayerFile_Setup
0x004b1870.label: Player file setup on game start
0x004b1870.summary: Called from Game_Setup to initialize player file subsystem. Logs debug "entered playerf" message on path-split success, then runs two-phase init through sub_4B0770 and PlayerFileInit.

0x004b18d0.name: PlayerFile_Restart
0x004b18d0.label: Player file restart handler
0x004b18d0.summary: Called from Game_Restart. Logs "entered playerf" debug message after successful debug path parse. No struct fields accessed — pure logging stub.

0x004b1900.name: PlayerFile_Post
0x004b1900.label: Player file post-processing
0x004b1900.summary: Called from Game_Post to handle player file post-update. Logs debug message, runs player data init (sub_4B0770), then conditionally calls additional setup based on a state field at this+0x1F78.

0x004b1950.name: SmallStructConstructor
0x004b1950.label: Small struct constructor with vtable
0x004b1950.summary: Constructor for small 5-dword object called from UIControlWindowInitialization. Sets vtable pointer from off_5ACBE4 at +0x00, initializes two range-bound pairs: first pair (0x4=0, 0x8=-1), second pair (0xC=0, 0x10=-1).

0x004b1970.name: SmallStructInitWithVtable
0x004b1970.label: Small struct init with UITexture vtable
0x004b1970.summary: Constructor for small 5-dword object called from UIControlWindowInitialization. Sets UITextureVTable pointer from off_5ACBD8 at +0x00, initializes two range-bound pairs: first pair (0x4=0, 0x8=-1), second pair (0xC=0, 0x10=-1). Same layout as SmallStructConstructor_004b1950 but with different vtable.

0x004b1990.name: VTableFieldsInit
0x004b1990.label: Small struct constructor with UIElement vtable
0x004b1990.summary: Constructor for small 5-dword object called from UIControlWindowInitialization. Sets VTable_UIElement_ACBCC pointer at +0x00, initializes two range-bound pairs: first pair (0x4=0, 0x8=-1), second pair (0xC=0, 0x10=-1).

0x004b19b0.name: VTablePatternedFieldInit
0x004b19b0.label: Small struct constructor with VTablePtr_5ACC20
0x004b19b0.summary: Constructor for small 5-dword object called from UIControlWindowInitialization. Sets vtable pointer from off_5ACC20 at +0x00, initializes two range-bound pairs: first pair (0x4=0, 0x8=-1), second pair (0xC=0, 0x10=-1).

0x004b19d0.name: sub_4B19D0
0x004b19d0.label: Small struct constructor with VtablePtr_5ACC2C
0x004b19d0.summary: Constructor for small 5-dword object called from UIControlWindowInitialization. Sets vtable pointer from off_5ACC2C at +0x00, initializes two range-bound pairs: first pair (0x4=0, 0x8=-1), second pair (0xC=0, 0x10=-1).

0x004b19f0.name: ShortComputation_19f0
0x004b19f0.label: Small struct constructor with Input vtable
0x004b19f0.summary: Constructor for small 5-dword object called from UIControlWindowInitialization. Sets Ptr_VTable_Input pointer from off_5ACC38 at +0x00, initializes two range-bound pairs: first pair (0x4=0, 0x8=-1), second pair (0xC=0, 0x10=-1).

0x004b1a10.name: FunctionCallWrapper_1a10
0x004b1a10.label: Small struct constructor with PTR_VTABLE_5ACC44
0x004b1a10.summary: Constructor for small 5-dword object called from UIControlWindowInitialization. Sets vtable pointer from off_5ACC44 at +0x00, initializes two range-bound pairs: first pair (0x4=0, 0x8=-1), second pair (0xC=0, 0x10=-1).

0x004b1a30.name: VTableInitWithDefaults_1a30
0x004b1a30.label: Small struct constructor with InputObjectVTable
0x004b1a30.summary: Constructor for small 5-dword object called from UIControlWindowInitialization. Sets InputObjectVTable pointer from off_5ACC50 at +0x00, initializes two range-bound pairs: first pair (0x4=0, 0x8=-1), second pair (0xC=0, 0x10=-1).

0x004b1a50.name: InitWithSentinelPattern
0x004b1a50.label: Small struct constructor with VTablePtr4
0x004b1a50.summary: Constructor for small 5-dword object called from UIControlWindowInitialization. Sets vtable pointer from off_5ACC5C at +0x00, initializes two range-bound pairs: first pair (0x4=0, 0x8=-1), second pair (0xC=0, 0x10=-1).

0x004b1a70.name: ShortConstructor_1a70
0x004b1a70.label: Small struct constructor with RenderObject vtable
0x004b1a70.summary: Constructor for small 5-dword object called from UIControlWindowInitialization. Sets VTable_RenderObject pointer from off_5ACC68 at +0x00, initializes two range-bound pairs: first pair (0x4=0, 0x8=-1), second pair (0xC=0, 0x10=-1).

0x004b1a90.name: StructInitWithVTableSentinels
0x004b1a90.label: Small struct constructor with VtablePtr_5ACC74
0x004b1a90.summary: Constructor for small 5-dword object called from UIControlWindowInitialization. Sets vtable pointer from off_5ACC74 at +0x00, initializes two range-bound pairs: first pair (0x4=0, 0x8=-1), second pair (0xC=0, 0x10=-1).

0x004b1ac0.name: MultiFieldSetterWithStrings
0x004b1ac0.label: Multi-field setter with optional string copy
0x004b1ac0.summary: Called from PlayerOptionsInitializer. Copies string from a2, sets three integer fields at +0x14/+0x18/+0x1C, conditionally copies string from a6, and conditionally reassigns field +0x14. Ends with ShortComputation_1b70 to finalize.

0x004b1b10.name: DebugLogFormat
0x004b1b10.label: Debug log entry formatter
0x004b1b10.summary: Writes a formatted debug log entry to output buffer. Copies a labeled string from this+0x14 into temp buffer, writes key-value separator, appends optional comment string (from this+0x0C or default path), then writes a config-substring token suffix.

0x004b1bb0.name: SliderClampStringToIntControl
0x004b1bb0.label: String-to-int slider with clamping
0x004b1bb0.summary: Parses a string value to integer via ObjectHandleReader, clamps between lower bound (this+0x1C) and upper bound (this+0x20), stores result at this+0x14. Returns 0 if input is NULL/empty.

0x004b1c20.name: sub_4B1C20
0x004b1c20.label: Byte-field setter with optional string copy
0x004b1c20.summary: Called from PlayerOptionsInitializer. Copies string from a2, sets three byte fields at +0x15/+0x16/+0x17, optionally copies string from a6, and conditionally copies a3 to +0x14. Ends with ShortComputation_1b70.

0x004b1c70.name: sub_4B1C70
0x004b1c70.label: Byte copy from +0x15 to +0x14
0x004b1c70.summary: Simple byte copy: reads byte from this+0x15, writes it to this+0x14, returns the byte value. No branches or guards.

0x004b1de0.name: ClampedFloatSetter_1de0
0x004b1de0.label: Clamped float value setter
0x004b1de0.summary: Stores a float value (passed as int a2) at this+0x14, then clamps it between lower bound (this+0x1C as float) and upper bound (this+0x20 as float). If value < lower bound, snaps to lower bound. If value > upper bound, snaps to upper bound.

0x004b1f50.name: ShortFieldSetter
0x004b1f50.label: Short-field setter with optional string copy
0x004b1f50.summary: Called from PlayerOptionsInitializer. Copies string from a2, sets three short fields at +0x16/+0x18/+0x1A, optionally copies string from a6, and conditionally copies a3 to +0x14. Ends with ShortComputation_1b70.

0x004b1fb0.name: ShortGetterCopy
0x004b1fb0.label: Short copy from +0x16 to +0x14
0x004b1fb0.summary: Simple short copy: reads short from this+0x16, writes it to this+0x14, returns the short value. No branches or guards.

0x004b21f0.name: FloatToRGBColorConversion
0x004b21f0.label: Float to packed RGB color conversion
0x004b21f0.summary: Converts 3 float color channel values (R, G, B) to a packed 40-bit color format by clamping to [-65536, 65536] range, scaling by 32768, and packing into 3 output dword/byte fields. Part of rendering/color pipeline.

0x004b2310.name: sub_4B2310
0x004b2310.label: Float vector to compact int16+dword pack
0x004b2310.summary: Copies 3 source dword values to output, and converts 3 float values to int16 by clamping to [-16, 16] range and scaling by 2048. Packs vertex position or similar vector data into compact format (3×32-bit + 3×16-bit).

0x004b2420.name: ArithmeticComparison_2420
0x004b2420.label: Compact vector unpack (int16 to float)
0x004b2420.summary: Inverse companion to sub_4B2310 — copies 3 dword values and converts 3 int16 values to float by multiplying by 1/2048 (0.00048828125). Unpacks compact vertex/vector data back to floating point.

0x004b2480.name: UtilityFunction_2480
0x004b2480.label: Float vector to int16 pack (scale 50)
0x004b2480.summary: Converts 3 float values to int16 by clamping to [-655.34, 655.34] range and scaling by 50.0. Packs vertex/vector data into compact int16 format. Inverse of ShortVectorToFloatWithScale.

0x004b2580.name: ShortVectorToFloatWithScale
0x004b2580.label: Int16 vector to float unpack (scale 0.02)
0x004b2580.summary: Converts 3 int16 values to float by multiplying by 0.02 (1/50). Unpacks compact vertex/vector data back to floating point. Inverse of UtilityFunction_2480.

0x004b25d0.name: FloatToFixedConversionWithClamp
0x004b25d0.label: Float to fixed-point conversion with clamping
0x004b25d0.summary: Converts three floats from a2 array into fixed-point representation: a2[0] clamped ±6.35 ×20 → byte at +0x24; a2[1] clamped ±65.534 ×500 → short at +0x26; a2[2] clamped ±6.35 ×20 → byte at +0x25. All clamped to signed min/max sentinel values on overflow.

0x004b26d0.name: FloatTruncation
0x004b26d0.label: Byte/int16 to float unpack with truncation
0x004b26d0.summary: Converts 2 signed bytes and 1 signed int16 to float by scaling (0.05, 0.002) and applying truncation via CRTFtol. Unpacks compact packed data to floating point for physics calculations.

0x004b2750.name: FloatToShortClampedConversion
0x004b2750.label: Float to short conversion with clamping
0x004b2750.summary: Converts two floats from a2 array (a2[0] and a2[2]) to signed short fixed-point: multiply by 512 after clamping input to ±64. Stores at this+0x28 and this+0x2A. Clamps to ±32767 on overflow.

0x004b2800.name: ShortToFloatVectorUnpack
0x004b2800.label: Int16 vector 2-component unpack (scale 1/512)
0x004b2800.summary: Converts 2 int16 values to float by multiplying by 0.001953125 (1/512) and writes to X/Z float output with Y set to 0. Unpacks compact 2D vector data.

0x004b2840.name: FloatToByteShortEncoding
0x004b2840.label: Indexed float-to-byte/short encoding
0x004b2840.summary: Converts two floats to packed fixed-point at indexed offsets: a3 clamped ±0.496 ×256 → byte at this[0x12 + a2]; a4 clamped ±327.67 ×100 → short at this[0x16 + 2*a2]. Used by SetupCarLightingAndRender for indexed parameter packing.

0x004b2930.name: FloatToBitfieldPack
0x004b2930.label: Float to bitfield pack (15-bit, shifted 17)
0x004b2930.summary: Multiplies float by 10.0, clamps to [0, 32767], shifts left 17 bits, and inserts into bitfield at offset 0x2C preserving low 17 bits. Packs unsigned value into high 15 bits of dword.

0x004b2980.name: BitfieldExtractScale
0x004b2980.label: Bitfield extract and scale (inverse of pack)
0x004b2980.summary: Extracts bits 17-31 from bitfield dword at offset 0x2C, shifts right 17, and multiplies by 0.1 (1/10). Inverse of FloatToBitfieldPack. Returns double.

0x004b29b0.name: BitfieldInsert
0x004b29b0.label: Bitfield 5-bit insert (bits 12-16)
0x004b29b0.summary: Multiplies float by 31.0 and inserts 5-bit value into bits 12-16 of bitfield at offset 0x2C via XOR merge. Packs color channel or similar small-range data.

0x004b29f0.name: ShortComputation_29f0
0x004b29f0.label: Bitfield 5-bit extract and scale (inverse of insert)
0x004b29f0.summary: Extracts bits 12-16 from bitfield dword at offset 0x2C, shifts right 12, masks to 5 bits, and scales by 0.032258064 (1/31). Inverse of BitfieldInsert. Returns double.

0x004b2a40.name: FloatToBitfieldEncoder
0x004b2a40.label: Bitfield 7-bit biased insert (bits 0-6)
0x004b2a40.summary: Multiplies float by 63.0, subtracts 64 bias, and inserts 7-bit signed value into low 7 bits (0-6) of bitfield at offset 0x2C. Packs signed color/audio channel data as biased offset.

0x004b2a80.name: BitfieldToFloatConversion
0x004b2a80.label: Bitfield 7-bit biased extract and scale
0x004b2a80.summary: Extracts low 7 bits from bitfield at offset 0x2C, subtracts bias 64, and multiplies by 0.015873 (1/63). Inverse of FloatToBitfieldEncoder. Converts biased 7-bit signed value back to float.

0x004b2b10.name: FunctionCallWrapper_2b10
0x004b2b10.label: FloatToBitfield10BitsPacker
0x004b2b10.summary: Multiplies a float by 3.0, truncates to integer, and packs the result into bits 22-31 (10 bits) of the dword at offset 0x30, preserving the lower 22 bits. Returns the updated dword value.

0x004b2b40.name: BitfieldExtractionWithScale
0x004b2b40.label: Bitfield 2-bit extract (bits 22-23)
0x004b2b40.summary: Extracts 2-bit field from bits 22-23 of dword at offset 0x30 and multiplies by 0.333333 (1/3). Decodes small-range state/flag value.

0x004b2b90.name: FloatThresholdClassification
0x004b2b90.label: FloatToTwoBitClassifier
0x004b2b90.summary: Classifies a float value into one of four 2-bit categories stored in bits [1:0] of byte at offset 0xF. Thresholds: <= 0.75 = 0, 0.75-0.85 = 1, 0.85-0.95 = 2, >= 0.95 = 3.

0x004b2bf0.name: TernarySelectByBitfield
0x004b2bf0.label: TwoBitFieldToDoubleSelector
0x004b2bf0.summary: Reads a 2-bit field at offset 0xF and returns one of four double constants: 0 (00) = 0.7, 1 (01) = 0.8, 2 (10) = 0.9, 3 (11) = 1.0. Companion decoder for FloatThresholdClassification.

0x004b2c20.name: BitfieldUpdateFromFloat
0x004b2c20.label: FloatToSixBitFieldEncoder
0x004b2c20.summary: Encodes a float value into a 6-bit field at bits [7:2] of byte at offset 0xF. Float is multiplied by ~0.018 (1/55.55), truncated to int, masked to 6 bits, then inserted via XOR merge.

0x004b2c50.name: sub_4B2C50
0x004b2c50.label: SixBitFieldToFloatDecoder
0x004b2c50.summary: Decodes a 6-bit field from bits [7:2] of byte at offset 0xF and multiplies by 55.55 to recover an approximate float value. Inverse of BitfieldUpdateFromFloat.

0x004b2c80.name: VectorToShort3Conversion
0x004b2c80.label: FloatVectorToInt16SaturationPackWithClassification
0x004b2c80.summary: Converts a 3D float vector to packed int16 values with ±511.98001 saturation and 64.0 scale factor, storing results at offsets 0x9, 0xB, 0xD. Also runs RGB color conversion, float rescaling, threshold classification, and bitfield update on the same data.

0x004b2dd0.name: VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles
0x004b2dd0.label: VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles
0x004b2dd0.summary: Converts packed 16-bit Euler angle data (offsets 0x0-0xD) into a full 3D orientation matrix with cross-product axes, extracts Euler angles, packs results into output structure. Uses TernarySelectByBitfield and SixBitFieldToFloatDecoder values for additional rotation parameters.

0x004b31a0.name: FloatToInt16SaturationPack
0x004b31a0.label: Float3ToInt16SaturationPack
0x004b31a0.summary: Converts three float values to int16 with saturation at ±15.999512 and 2048.0 scale factor. Stores results at offsets 0xC, 0xE, 0x10 of the struct. Returns the third converted value.

0x004b32a0.name: sub_4B32A0
0x004b32a0.label: CollisionVertexPackTransform
0x004b32a0.summary: Packs collision vertex/transform data from fixed-point struct `this` into float vector v12-v14, then processes through bitfield packing pipeline. Called by CollisionStateUpdate during collision geometry setup.

0x004b33b0.name: ProgressBarEventEncode
0x004b33b0.label: Progress bar event encode
0x004b33b0.summary: Packs multiple parameters (event ID, sub-type, session type, etc.) into a bitfield word at offset 0x0 for progress bar UI event dispatch. Stores secondary data at offset 0x4 and resets flag at offset 0x1AC to -1.

0x004b3400.name: sub_4B3400
0x004b3400.label: Network / Replay Event Packet Dispatch
0x004b3400.summary: Decodes a 32-bit message header into major type (bits 29-31), sub-type (bits 18-23), and vehicle index (bits 0-7), then dispatches to the appropriate handler: vehicle input/control (type 1), vehicle state/position (type 2), UI/sound (type 3), session/race control (type 4), or AI/motion (type 6). Used for network packet and replay event processing.

0x004b3a90.name: ArithmeticComparison_3a90
0x004b3a90.label: Size-prefixed data copy
0x004b3a90.summary: Copies variable-length data from source to destination using a 10-bit size field extracted from bits 8-17 of the source's first dword, plus 8 bytes minimum. Also copies field at offset 0x1AC between structures.

0x004b3af0.name: AdvanceRingBuffer
0x004b3af0.label: AdvanceRingBuffer
0x004b3af0.summary: Advances ring buffer read pointer by one entry (432 bytes). If pointer reaches end, wraps to start and returns 0; otherwise calls ArithmeticComparison_3a90 on current entry and returns 1. Used by input, radio, and timing subsystems.

0x004b3b30.name: SessionDataCopy
0x004b3b30.label: RingBufferResetToStart
0x004b3b30.summary: Resets ring buffer read pointer (0x6C00C) to start address (0x6C008). Companion to AdvanceRingBuffer — rewinds buffer to beginning for replay or re-initialization.

0x004b3b40.name: BufferReset
0x004b3b40.label: RingBufferFullReset
0x004b3b40.summary: Drains all remaining ring buffer entries by calling sub_4B3400 on each, decrements pending counter for each entry, then resets all three buffer pointers (start, current, end) to base+4. Called at shutdown/reset from GamePostMainLoop.

0x004b3bd0.name: RandomNoiseTableInitialization
0x004b3bd0.label: RandomNoiseTableInit
0x004b3bd0.summary: Initializes 514-float noise table: index 0 set to 0.0, indices 1-256 filled with uniform random values [0,1), indices 257-512 filled with uniform random values [-1,1), index 513 seeded with RDTSC timestamp. Called from GameFileLoader during startup.

0x004b3c60.name: DeterministicHashPseudoRandomGenerator
0x004b3c60.label: Deterministic hash-based PRNG
0x004b3c60.summary: Generates pseudo-random DWORD by combining RDTSC timestamp, GetTickCount, LCG random, and internal state counters (0x0, 0x804). Reads from a float noise table indexed by auto-incrementing counter. Part of random number generation system.

0x004b3ce0.name: RandomNoiseValueGenerator
0x004b3ce0.label: Gaussian noise value generator
0x004b3ce0.summary: Generates noise value approximating normal distribution by computing popcount of hash-based PRNG result (binomial approximation), combining with noise table float and scaling by 0.35355338 (1/sqrt(8)). Part of random/audio/noise system.

0x004b3dc0.name: VehicleVisibilityCulling
0x004b3dc0.label: VehicleVisibilityCulling
0x004b3dc0.summary: Culls non-visible vehicles by sorting them by camera-space distance and marking only the nearest N (up to VisibleVehicleIndex). When vehicle visibility state changes, triggers audio (engine sound enable) for newly visible vehicles and disables flags/UI for newly hidden ones. Called from RenderScreenSave during frame render.

0x004b4030.name: Render_Init
0x004b4030.label: RenderInit
0x004b4030.summary: Initializes render subsystem by calling StringSplitLoop for path validation, then logs "Entered Render Init" on success. Called from Game_Init during startup.

0x004b4060.name: Render_Restart
0x004b4060.label: RenderRestart
0x004b4060.summary: Resets render state by filling 168-byte struct `this` with 0x01 byte pattern, logs "Entered Render Restart". Called from Game_Restart during session restart.

0x004b40a0.name: RenderScreenSave
0x004b40a0.label: RenderScreenSave
0x004b40a0.summary: Captures screenshot when 'X' key is pressed: saves screen to season or default directory path, displays "Screen Saved" message. Always runs CameraViewportRenderSetup, VehicleVisibilityCulling, and final render call. Called each frame from GamePostMainLoop.

0x004b4170.name: Render_Post
0x004b4170.label: RenderPost
0x004b4170.summary: Post-render lifecycle marker — validates source path via StringSplitLoop, logs "Entered Render Post". Called from Game_Post during shutdown/cleanup sequence.

0x004b41e0.name: FileStreamWriter
0x004b41e0.label: FilePathStreamWriter
0x004b41e0.summary: Writes a file path string through conditional dispatch system: dispatches this struct header (4 bytes), then string length (1 byte), then string content. Falls back to default application directory path if no custom path set. Called from VehicleForceAerodynamicsComputation for aerodynamics debug logging.

0x004b42e0.name: FAILWRONGDESCRIPTION_42e0
0x004b42e0.label: CollisionDataDispatchWithTypeCheck
0x004b42e0.summary: Dispatches collision data block through conditional dispatch system. Checks header type bits (must be 0x2 in high 3-bit field with specific subfield clear), conditionally computes and dispatches a transformed float value as byte, then dispatches data payload. Called from CollisionObjectListManagement.

0x004b4460.name: SmallStructZeroInit
0x004b4460.label: SmallStructZeroInit
0x004b4460.summary: Zero-initializes a 10-byte struct (two dwords + one word). Simple utility called by wrapper and buffer transfer functions.

0x004b4470.name: FileHandleCloseRegistration
0x004b4470.label: ResourceHandleDispatchRegistration
0x004b4470.summary: Looks up a resource handle via ResourceLookupDispatcher, stores it at offset 0x4, then dispatches 4-byte header and 2-byte sub-field through conditional dispatch. Called from CollisionObjectListManagement during object registration.

0x004b44e0.name: sub_4B44E0
0x004b44e0.label: PoolAllocatorInitWithLinkedLists
0x004b44e0.summary: Initializes a fixed-block memory pool: allocates 13824-byte buffer (32 entries × 432 bytes), builds an active list header node and 32 free list nodes. Wires global list heads (AudioBucketListHead, FreeListHead) and tail pointers. Called once at startup.

0x004b45f0.name: sub_4B45F0
0x004b45f0.label: PoolAllocatorTeardown
0x004b45f0.summary: Tears down the fixed-block memory pool: walks free list and active list, frees all buffers and nodes, resets all global list pointers to zero. Guarded by cleanup flag byte_8AB6E0 bit 0 to prevent double-free.

0x004b46f0.name: QuadrupleListCleanup
0x004b46f0.label: QuadrupleListCleanup
0x004b46f0.summary: Walks and frees 4 linked lists of physics/collision nodes at offsets 0x70-0xAC (16 dwords of head/tail/next pointers). Frees type-1 nodes' associated buffers, frees all node structs, zeroes all pointers. Also zeroes 4 fields at offsets 0xB0-0xBC. Called from SpriteOverlayListCleanup.

0x004b48e0.name: CollisionObjectInsertion
0x004b48e0.label: CollisionObjectTypeDispatchInsert
0x004b48e0.summary: Inserts a collision object into one of 4 type-specific sub-lists based on its 3-bit type tag (extracted from header bits [31:29]). Allocates or reuses a free node from the pool, creates a 12-byte linked list entry, links into sub-list at offset 112 + index*64. Called from PitStallProximityCheck for pit collision zone management.

0x004b4a30.name: sub_4B4A30
0x004b4a30.label: CollisionObjectRemoveAndRecycle
0x004b4a30.summary: Removes a collision object node from its type-specific sub-list (indexed by tag bits [31:29]), frees the node's buffer and struct, then allocates a new node pointing to `a2` and prepends it to the global free list. Called from sub_4B6190 during collision object lifecycle management.

0x004b4b50.name: CollisionObjectListManagement
0x004b4b50.label: CollisionObjectListFilterProcess
0x004b4b50.summary: Manages 4 collision object sub-lists: rebuilds/sorts lists, finds global minimum float threshold, removes entries within ±0.02 tolerance of minimum, processes removed entries through collision dispatch pipeline, returns count processed. Called from sub_4B7860 for per-frame collision management.

0x004b4e10.name: PhysicsObjectListManager
0x004b4e10.label: PhysicsObjectListDrainToFreePool
0x004b4e10.summary: Drains all 4 collision object sub-lists: removes each node, frees type-1 buffers, reallocates node as free list entry and prepends to global free pool. Stores session time at offset 0x6C, resets sub-list metadata, sets enable flag to 1. Called from QuadrupleListCleanup and PitstopActionSet.

0x004b4f70.name: StructInitWithGlobalData
0x004b4f70.label: StructInitWithGlobalData
0x004b4f70.summary: Initializes a struct by calling ThunkWithStructInitSubCalls on sub-struct at offset 0x90, zeroing 4 byte fields (offsets 0, 1, 0x41, 0x61), and setting 3 sentinel dwords at offsets 0x84/0x88/0x8C to -190986834 (0xF49C952E).

0x004b50c0.name: UtilityFunction_50c0
0x004b50c0.label: Bounds check with sentinel values
0x004b50c0.summary: Checks if float parameter is within range [lower, upper] where -1.0e32 sentinel value means the respective bound is inactive (unbounded). Supports open-ended or fully bounded range checks.

0x004b51e0.name: DriverNameTeamCopy
0x004b51e0.label: DriverNameTeamPathCopy
0x004b51e0.summary: Copies driver/team name string (63 bytes) and two file path strings (31 bytes each) from source struct a2 into this, extracting filename portions after last backslash. Copies a flag byte from a2+18580 to this[0]. Called from VehicleInstanceListBuilder during vehicle instance setup.

0x004b52a0.name: ListRebuildWithNodeTransfer
0x004b52a0.label: ListRebuildWithNodeTransfer
0x004b52a0.summary: Transfers all nodes from source list (this+0x20) to target list (this+0x10): searches for each source node by data pointer, unlinks it, frees type-1 buffers and node structs, allocates new node with same data pointer, prepends to target list. Sets sentinel at offset 0x30. Called during widget destroy and buffer pool init.

0x004b5380.name: FloatComparisonListIteration
0x004b5380.label: FloatThresholdListIterate
0x004b5380.summary: Walks a linked list, comparing each node's float fields at offsets +12 and +444 against threshold a2. Dispatches to different processing paths based on which field exceeds the threshold, or a default handler when both are within range. Called from sub_4B9000 for threshold-based list processing.

0x004b5460.name: ListWalkWithUserCancelCheck
0x004b5460.label: List Walk With Cancel Check
0x004b5460.summary: Walks a linked list, testing each node's first field via FieldCompareConstant. Returns 0 if a node fails the comparison (user cancel detected), 1 if list is empty or all nodes pass.

0x004b54e0.name: NetworkMessageDispatch
0x004b54e0.label: Network Message Dispatch
0x004b54e0.summary: Dispatches a network message (a2) by finding or allocating a matching node, then enqueues it with state data and calls threshold comparison. Manages a free list and an active singly-linked list.

0x004b5630.name: CollisionFilterAABBCull
0x004b5630.label: AABB Cull Filter
0x004b5630.summary: Walks an active collision linked list, filtering nodes by field comparison and Z-distance threshold. Nodes that fail the check are removed from the active list and appended to a separate output list (culled). Allocates new entries for culled nodes.

0x004b5760.name: LinkedListIteratorWithStateUpdate
0x004b5760.label: List Walk With Audio State Update
0x004b5760.summary: Walks a linked list, testing each node against field/float/audio playback conditions. On match, updates node Z-position (offset 0x370) and decodes scene node via SceneNodeDecoder. Advances via next link.

0x004b57f0.name: CarPhysicsStateInitializer
0x004b57f0.label: Car Physics State Initializer / Constructor
0x004b57f0.summary: Initializes a car physics state object by zeroing most fields and setting default sentinels, timer state, and configuration constants. Called once per car physics object creation during game setup.

0x004b5a30.name: DestroyUIWidgetHierarchy
0x004b5a30.label: DestroyUIWidgetHierarchy
0x004b5a30.summary: Destroys the entire UI widget hierarchy by cleaning up sprite overlays, freeing linked lists of widget nodes, releasing heap-allocated buffers, and zeroing all list-head pointers across multiple sub-hierarchy levels. Part of the UI teardown/cleanup system.

0x004b5c50.name: VehicleInstanceListBuilder
0x004b5c50.label: Vehicle Instance List Builder
0x004b5c50.summary: Iterates 104 vehicle entries from a2 (each 18624 bytes stride), building per-slot linked lists of tracked vehicle instances. Compares vehicle identity strings, sets initial timestamps for new entries, and manages free list allocation.

0x004b5da0.name: PitStallProximityCheck
0x004b5da0.label: Pit Stall Proximity Check
0x004b5da0.summary: Iterates a circular buffer of pit stall indices, checking vehicle Z-distance to each stall. If within 1.5 units, creates a collision object to register the stall contact.

0x004b5e50.name: sub_4B5E50
0x004b5e50.label: Per-Slot List Reinitialization
0x004b5e50.summary: Iterates 104 slots (stride 16 bytes), each containing a linked list head/tail/count. For each non-empty slot, destroys all existing nodes (freeing data payloads), reinitializes the underlying data via StructInitWithGlobalData, and relinks nodes into a new list at this+0x10.

0x004b5f60.name: LinkedBufferTransfer
0x004b5f60.label: Doubly-Linked Buffer Transfer
0x004b5f60.summary: Iterates a doubly-linked source list at this+0x714, removing each node and its data pointer, then reinitializing the data via SmallStructZeroInit and relinking into a singly-linked output list at this+0x30. Frees source node wrappers and creates new 12-byte wrappers for the output.

0x004b6130.name: SpriteOverlayListCleanup
0x004b6130.label: Overlay/Sprite List Cleanup
0x004b6130.summary: Frees an array of overlay/sprite entries at this+0x9B0. Reads entry count from a header at offset -4, iterates backward with 44-byte stride calling QuadrupleListCleanup per entry, then frees the allocation and zeroes the pointer and count fields.

0x004b6190.name: sub_4B6190
0x004b6190.label: Pit Crew Worker Allocator
0x004b6190.summary: Iterates 4 worker slots, scanning a circular buffer of pit stall entries (176 bytes each) via HashTableLookup. Collects up to 12 matching entries per slot; if 9+ found, sorts by distance and assigns workers to stalls via bitfield and data operations.

0x004b6360.name: sub_4B6360
0x004b6360.label: Multi-Stage Alignment Comparator
0x004b6360.summary: Compares two sets of vector/angle data (from a2 and a4) through arithmetic and angular tolerance checks. Uses difficulty level (this[0x9AC]) to select thresholds; returns 1 if aligned, 0 if misaligned.

0x004b66e0.name: LapSpeedComparisonWithSwitchSelectableThresholds
0x004b66e0.label: Speed Difference Threshold Check
0x004b66e0.summary: Compares two float values (a2, a3) against difficulty-scaled thresholds selected by this[0x9AC]. Used to determine if speed/velocity differences between two states are within acceptable bounds.

0x004b67d0.name: SteeringAlignmentToleranceCheck
0x004b67d0.label: Steering Angle Tolerance Check
0x004b67d0.summary: Checks if an angular difference (a2) is within tolerance, scaled by difficulty level (this[0x9AC]) and an additional factor (a3). Returns true if the angle difference is small enough for alignment.

0x004b68c0.name: CircularBufferCheck
0x004b68c0.label: Circular Buffer Active Count
0x004b68c0.summary: Computes the number of active entries in a circular buffer of pit stall data (176-byte entries). Returns count based on read/write index positions; returns 0 if buffer is in invalid state or the single entry is empty.

0x004b6940.name: PitstopActionSet
0x004b6940.label: Pit Stop Action Set
0x004b6940.summary: Adds a new entry to the pit stop circular buffer, writing a float value (Z-position/speed) into the current slot. Resets buffer if indices are invalid; otherwise advances to next slot.

0x004b69a0.name: CircularCounterIncrement
0x004b69a0.label: Circular Buffer Write Advance
0x004b69a0.summary: Increments the circular buffer write index (this[0x9B8]) by 1 with modulo wrap. Returns the PhysicsObjectListManager result for the newly pointed entry.

0x004b69d0.name: RingBufferCounterWithWrap
0x004b69d0.label: Ring Buffer Read Advance
0x004b69d0.summary: Advances the circular buffer read index (this[0x9BC]) by 1 with modulo wrap, consuming one entry. Returns the old read index value (with division overflow flag).

0x004b69f0.name: CoordinateBoundCheck
0x004b69f0.label: Buffer Index Validity Check
0x004b69f0.summary: Returns TRUE if either circular buffer index (write or read) is negative, indicating the buffer is in an uninitialized or invalid state.

0x004b6a10.name: VehicleForceAerodynamicsComputation
0x004b6a10.label: State Serialization Export
0x004b6a10.summary: Serializes vehicle/race state to a conditional dispatch stream: writes path strings, byte flags, 104 slot lists (via sub_4B4FB0), a linked list (via FileStreamWriter), and a range-filtered list of entries. Returns success if processed count matches expected.

0x004b6c90.name: ModelSceneFileLoader
0x004b6c90.label: Model/Scene Binary File Deserializer
0x004b6c90.summary: Deserializes a binary model/scene file: reads string tables and byte flags from the stream, allocates and links scene-object nodes into two managed linked lists (at this+0x6C0 and this+0x714), processes per-node format headers, and computes bounding extent values. Part of the game-data file I/O system.

0x004b70b0.name: LoadVehicleEntries
0x004b70b0.label: Vehicle Entry Loader
0x004b70b0.summary: Iterates 104 vehicle slots (18624 byte stride), looking up each via LinkedListTraversalWithFilter. Initializes driver names and state for found entries; sets absence flag for missing ones. Finalizes by building vehicle pointer arrays, parsing scene data, and initializing AI.

0x004b71e0.name: BufferPoolAllocatorInitialization
0x004b71e0.label: Buffer Pool Allocator Init
0x004b71e0.summary: Full reinitialization of buffer pool lists and circular buffer. Transfers linked lists, frees file-stream list nodes, clears list pointers, allocates pit stall circular buffer (size selected by enum at this+0x9A4), and initializes all 44-byte sub-entries.

0x004b7300.name: GameDataFileIO
0x004b7300.label: GameDataFileLoader
0x004b7300.summary: Loads or resets game data files (3D scene models, audio streams) for a track/vehicle. In cleanup mode (a3 true) it frees existing node data and reinitializes paths; in load mode (a3 false) it opens an audio stream and loads a model/scene file. Part of the game data I/O system.

0x004b7500.name: sub_4B7500
0x004b7500.label: ReplayDataFileWriter
0x004b7500.summary: Writes replay/game-state data to file — either as a full replay recording (iterating 104 physics steps and streaming vehicle dynamics data when save state flag is set) or as a secondary file dump triggered by a byte flag — closing file handles and performing cleanup afterward.

0x004b7860.name: sub_4B7860
0x004b7860.label: Circular Buffer Processor With List Output
0x004b7860.summary: Processes entries from the circular buffer via CollisionObjectListManagement, collecting results into a doubly-linked list at this+0x714. Advances the buffer read index via RingBufferCounterWithWrap. Returns 1 if processing occurred, 0 if buffer not ready.

0x004b7a00.name: QueuePop
0x004b7a00.label: Queue Pop Processor
0x004b7a00.summary: Drains the circular buffer via sub_4B7860 until empty, then extracts first and last data values from the result linked list into accumulators at 0xF30/0xF34. Returns 0.

0x004b7a90.name: PitTimingUpdate
0x004b7a90.label: Pit Timing Update
0x004b7a90.summary: Main pit timing tick function: updates per-vehicle pit timers, triggers pit stall proximity checks, dispatches pit crew allocation across 104 vehicle slots (round-robin 12 per frame), processes session data messages, and manages pit stop actions based on timing thresholds.

0x004b7c80.name: NetworkBufferRead
0x004b7c80.label: Network Buffer Range Read
0x004b7c80.summary: Walks a linked list of data entries, selects those with float key in [a4, a5] range, and dispatches their payload data (deltas) via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch and ConditionalDispatch_6bd0. Returns total bytes dispatched.

0x004b7de0.name: sub_4B7DE0
0x004b7de0.label: SaveHotlapData
0x004b7de0.summary: Saves hotlap (qualifying lap) telemetry/replay data to a .HOT file on disk. Part of session/telemetry persistence system.

0x004b8010.name: FileSettingExistenceCheck
0x004b8010.label: FileSettingExistenceCleanup
0x004b8010.summary: Checks if a settings file exists by attempting to open it; if found, removes read-only attribute and deletes it. Part of file/settings cleanup system.

0x004b8090.name: BinaryFloatComparison
0x004b8090.label: SerializationMagicCheck
0x004b8090.summary: Writes sentinel values ("xxxx" and -1.0f) to the serialization backend, then reads them back to verify they match expected constants. Used for serialization format version detection.

0x004b8150.name: LinkedListFloatAccessor
0x004b8150.label: LinkedListFloatIndexAccessor
0x004b8150.summary: Returns the float value at a given index from a linked list, traversing nodes by walking next pointers. Returns -1.0f for out-of-bounds or null node.

0x004b81a0.name: SortedLinkedListInsert
0x004b81a0.label: SortedLinkedListInsertByFloatKey
0x004b81a0.summary: Allocates a new linked-list node with a float key from this+0xF38, appends it to the list, then performs a mergesort on the entire list by float value. Marks the list as sorted (dirty flag=1). Part of a display/overlay list system.

0x004b8360.name: SpriteOverlayDisplayListCleanup
0x004b8360.label: DisplayListNodeRemoveByFloatKey
0x004b8360.summary: Walks a sorted doubly-linked overlay display list and removes the first node whose float value matches a reference key within epsilon (2.0). Frees both the node frame and its inner data if the byte flag is set. Part of overlay/sprite display list management.

0x004b8480.name: LinkedListDestructor_8480
0x004b8480.label: LinkedListFullDestructor
0x004b8480.summary: Frees all nodes in the linked list (including inner data if the byte flag is set), then zeros head, tail, cursor, and count. Full teardown of the overlay display list.

0x004b84f0.name: SortedListSeekByValue
0x004b84f0.label: SortedListSeekForwardFromHead
0x004b84f0.summary: Walks the sorted linked list forward from head, advancing past nodes whose float value <= threshold (this+0xF38). Sets the cursor (this+0x6C8) to the first node exceeding the threshold, and copies its float value back to this+0xF38. Part of sorted list navigation.

0x004b85d0.name: LinkedListPrioritySearchByFloatThreshold
0x004b85d0.label: SortedListSeekBackwardFromTail
0x004b85d0.summary: Walks the sorted linked list backward from the tail, seeking the last node whose float value is within a threshold window (reference - 2.0). Sets cursor to that node and reads its float back to the threshold field. Part of priority-based sorted list navigation.

0x004b86e0.name: AngleClampWrap
0x004b86e0.label: AngleClampWrap
0x004b86e0.summary: Clamps or wraps an angle value to a configurable range [this+0xF30, this+0xF34]. In wrapping mode (byte at this+0xF81 == 0), value exceeding range wraps around. In clamp mode (byte non-zero), value is hard-clamped to bounds. Saves previous angle to this+0xF3C. Part of physics/steering animation system.

0x004b87a0.name: QueuePeek
0x004b87a0.label: QueuePeekTwoValues
0x004b87a0.summary: Copies two values from this+0xF30 and this+0xF34 to output pointers without modifying the source. Non-destructive queue/position peek.

0x004b87c0.name: LoadingPhase1
0x004b87c0.label: LoadingPhase1SessionInit
0x004b87c0.summary: First phase of session loading: pops queue, validates range width, loads resources, initialises vehicle effect tables and state visibility, sets angle clamp mode to hard clamp, and runs state trigger checks. Part of session/loading state machine.

0x004b8940.name: LoadingPhase2
0x004b8940.label: LoadingPhase2SessionFinalise
0x004b8940.summary: Second phase of session loading: runs state trigger checks, sets angle clamp to wrap mode, finalises per-vehicle state (visibility, audio effects, UI), cleans up session structure, and releases the loaded resource handle. Part of session/loading state machine.

0x004b8ae0.name: StateTriggerCheck
0x004b8ae0.label: StateTriggerCheck
0x004b8ae0.summary: Tests whether a game state/loading transition trigger condition is met — first checks that the target threshold exceeds the current value, then ticks all major game subsystems (physics, rendering, camera, weather, collision, session state), and returns 1 only if the loading progress has reached or exceeded the target threshold; returns 0 if blocked by any early-exit guard.

0x004b8c40.name: sub_4B8C40
0x004b8c40.label: AnimationPhaseUpdateDispatcher
0x004b8c40.summary: Dispatches animation/simulation phase updates based on a mode parameter (0-4). Each mode adjusts the angle by a cooling-rate-derived offset, applies angle clamping, sets a phase identifier (4-7), and invokes a guarded virtual call with a scale factor. Part of steering/animation system.

0x004b8da0.name: ProcessDriverEntries
0x004b8da0.label: ProcessDriverEntriesLoadConfig
0x004b8da0.summary: Iterates through driver entry array (stride 4656), copies driver name strings from linked-list nodes matching a float key, resolves file paths, loads vehicle configurations, and adjusts vehicle count. Part of vehicle/driver loading system.

0x004b9000.name: sub_4B9000
0x004b9000.label: ZoneCollisionProcessingPass
0x004b9000.summary: Processes a frame update for zone/collision objects by traversing a BST keyed on float thresholds, dispatching network messages, and running two-pass collision filter iteration with AABB culling.

0x004b9510.name: TimedAudioEventPlayback
0x004b9510.label: TimedAudioEventRangePlayback
0x004b9510.summary: Plays timed audio events within a time window [a2, a3] by walking a sorted linked list of event nodes. Each event triggers stream read, ring buffer write, and audio control operations. Part of audio/event playback system.

0x004b97e0.name: RenderToggleRefresh
0x004b97e0.label: RenderToggleRefresh
0x004b97e0.summary: Calls sub_4B7500 with the first DWORD of `this` and a boolean indicating whether a global scoring/cut-scene flag is active. Part of render toggle / scene refresh system.

0x004b9820.name: WheelForceAccessor
0x004b9820.label: WheelForceAccessor
0x004b9820.summary: Dereferences `this` to get an object pointer, then reads an int value at offset 0xF1C from that object. Part of wheel/force feedback data access.

0x004b9830.name: sub_4B9830
0x004b9830.label: PathBuildWithVcrExtension
0x004b9830.summary: Builds a file path using the global directory pointer or default path, then appends ".vcr" extension via sub_5665B0. Part of file/settings path construction.

0x004b9860.name: SingleFunctionCallWrapper_9860
0x004b9860.label: StateTimestepFactorSetter
0x004b9860.summary: Writes a2 to obj+0x9AC and sets obj+0xF7C to a float constant corresponding to the timestep/index value (0-4 maps to ~0.04-0.16f). Part of simulation timestep/update rate configuration.

0x004b9890.name: sub_4B9890
0x004b9890.label: LoadingPhaseOrchestrator
0x004b9890.summary: Orchestrates the full session loading sequence: calls LoadingPhase1, clamps time offset to [10, 180], sets up game state machine, runs key-priority/state-trigger loop, sets player vehicle index, calls LoadingPhase2. Part of session/loading state machine.

0x004b9a00.name: PackedFlagRead_9a00
0x004b9a00.label: AngleClampModeRead
0x004b9a00.summary: Reads the angle clamp/wrap mode byte at offset 0xF81 from a dereferenced object pointer. Returns non-zero for hard-clamp mode, zero for wrap mode.

0x004b9a10.name: sub_4B9A10
0x004b9a10.label: NormalisedProgressRatioCompute
0x004b9a10.summary: Computes a normalised progress ratio within a range [lower, upper], using either wrap mode (range width) or clamp mode (session time minus offset). Returns (delegation_result - lower) / range, or 0 if range <= 0. Part of steering/animation interpolation.

0x004b9ac0.name: sub_4B9AC0
0x004b9ac0.label: AudioSampleLookupAndPlay
0x004b9ac0.summary: Looks up an audio sample entry from a linked list using a float position/distance parameter, then selects and plays the appropriate sample with pitch modulation and stereo positioning based on field comparisons at +36 and +146.

0x004b9b80.name: sub_4B9B80
0x004b9b80.label: TimedAudioWithVehicleUpdateDispatch
0x004b9b80.summary: Processes timed audio events between two time points (ordering them ascending), resets the ring buffer, and if the event range spans an integer boundary at 1/40th scale, triggers per-vehicle sub_4EE2D0 and MultiObjectRemove calls. Part of audio/vehicle update system.

0x004b9cb0.name: VehicleLifetimeAverageAccessor
0x004b9cb0.label: VehicleLifetimeAverageAccessor
0x004b9cb0.summary: Reads a float at offset 0xF30 from a dereferenced object. Returns the lower bound of the angle/range. Part of vehicle lifetime or telemetry data access.

0x004b9cc0.name: VehicleSpeedAccessor
0x004b9cc0.label: Speed read accessor
0x004b9cc0.summary: Reads a float speed value from a nested pointer chain (this->ptr->field at offset 0xF34). Returns as double.

0x004b9da0.name: MenuActionDispatch
0x004b9da0.label: Menu action dispatch by ID
0x004b9da0.summary: Dispatches menu UI actions based on switch value. Stores action ID 0-8 at menu state field (0xF8C), or delegates to list/display cleanup routines for actions 9-13.

0x004b9e30.name: VehicleDataAccessor
0x004b9e30.label: VehicleDataAccessor
0x004b9e30.summary: Reads a DWORD at offset 0xF8C from a vehicle object pointer obtained via double indirection through `this`, returning an integer vehicle data field.

0x004b9e40.name: PitServiceSteeringAnimationStep
0x004b9e40.label: Pit service steering animation state machine
0x004b9e40.summary: Advances the pit service steering animation by one step. State machine at offset 0xF8C drives direction/speed of steering wheel rotation using queue peek events and FloatAccumulator.

0x004b9fb0.name: ArithmeticComparison_9fb0
0x004b9fb0.label: VehicleTypeRangeValidator
0x004b9fb0.summary: Checks if vehicle type identifier is 2; if so, validates that the vehicle data value at offset 0xF8C is within range 6-8, returning false if outside.

0x004b9fd0.name: sub_4B9FD0
0x004b9fd0.label: Replay activation message display
0x004b9fd0.summary: Builds and displays a replay activation status message once. Checks session state, formats path+string, and renders via TextLineWrappingAndRendering. Sets completion flag to prevent re-display.

0x004ba140.name: ArithmeticComparison_a140
0x004ba140.label: Byte field setter via pointer chain
0x004ba140.summary: Stores a byte argument into a nested struct field at offset 0xF80, accessed through pointer at this+0x8. Returns the intermediate pointer.

0x004ba150.name: ConditionalStateUpdate
0x004ba150.label: Session flag-gated update
0x004ba150.summary: Conditionally triggers a session update when the session is active (this[0]==1) and a packed flag at offset 8 is not yet set. Passes session time and message count to CallWrapper_9870.

0x004ba180.name: ConditionalMultiPathDispatcher
0x004ba180.label: Key-priority multi-path dispatcher
0x004ba180.summary: Dispatches between steering animation and alternative handler based on KeyPriorityChain result. Then conditionally processes driver entries if float field mismatch or flag is set. Resets flag after processing.

0x004ba1f0.name: sub_4BA1F0
0x004ba1f0.label: Replay File Load State Machine
0x004ba1f0.summary: Implements a state machine for loading replay/vcr files. State 2: opens a replay file via AudioStreamOpen, reads it in 1024-byte chunks using FileWriteWithBackendDispatch/ConditionalDispatch_6bd0, processes via ThunkToFUN004b7300, then sets up player vehicle and menu action. State transitions: on failure sets *this=0; on success keeps *this=2; else sets *this based on ConditionalFlagReturn and session flags (dword_7D0038, dword_7D005C).

0x004ba460.name: sub_4BA460
0x004ba460.label: ReplayRecordingController
0x004ba460.summary: Controls replay recording state: checks session conditions and championship mode, starts replay file recording (creates directory, reads track name, initializes recorder) or displays recording status message to player.

0x004ba6c0.name: TwoPathDispatch
0x004ba6c0.label: Type-sentinel two-path dispatcher
0x004ba6c0.summary: Dispatches between session/ring-buffer update (type 1) and weather particle update (type 2) based on sentinel at this[0]. Path 1 also gates on byte_7C56AC enable flag and session state.

0x004ba740.name: GuardedDispatchWithStateCheck
0x004ba740.label: Session-cleanup-gated render refresh
0x004ba740.summary: Conditionally calls cleanup sub when SessionCleanupFlag is set and this[0]==1. Always runs RenderToggleRefresh and clears byte flag at this+4.

0x004ba780.name: ShortComputation_a780
0x004ba780.label: Pointer dereference guard
0x004ba780.summary: If this[0] is non-null, dereferences it as a pointer and returns the pointed DWORD. Always copies this[0] to this[2]. Returns 0 if this[0] is null.

0x004ba7a0.name: DoublyLinkedListNodeRemoval
0x004ba7a0.label: Value-match linked list node removal
0x004ba7a0.summary: Finds a node by value in a singly-linked list with head/tail/count tracking, unlinks it, decrements count, and conditionally frees attached data. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

0x004ba900.name: LinkedListNodeDestructor_a900
0x004ba900.label: Node destructor with conditional data free
0x004ba900.summary: Frees a linked list node's attached data (both primary and secondary pointers) if the free-flag at this+0xC is set. Optionally frees the node itself if a2 bit 0 is set.

0x004ba9f0.name: LinkedListDestruction
0x004ba9f0.label: Full linked list destructor
0x004ba9f0.summary: Walks a singly-linked list freeing each node and optionally freeing its attached data. Zeroes all list bookkeeping fields (head, tail, current, count) to empty state.

0x004bac20.name: ShortComputation_ac20
0x004bac20.label: ListNode triple-field initializer
0x004bac20.summary: Initializes a 3-field node struct: sets data value (a2), zeroes next pointer, sets byte flag (a3). Returns this.

0x004bac40.name: LinkedListNodeInsertion_ac40
0x004bac40.label: Dual-list spatial structure builder
0x004bac40.summary: Inserts a value into a linked list, then builds a second linked list of 8 or 32 nodes with 432-byte stride offsets from the base value. Used in collision object insertion.

0x004bacf0.name: LinkedListNodeRemoval_acf0
0x004bacf0.label: Head node pop and return
0x004bacf0.summary: Removes the head node from a singly-linked list, returns its data pointer, and frees the node but not its attached data. Updates head/tail/current/count bookkeeping.

0x004bae20.name: LinkedListRemoveByValue
0x004bae20.label: Head node pop with data return
0x004bae20.summary: Removes head node from a singly-linked list, returns its data pointer. Clears the free-flag before check (data never freed). Frees node itself. Updates head/tail/current/count.

0x004bafc0.name: MemoryAllocation_afc0
0x004bafc0.label: Dual-list allocation with 1016-byte block init
0x004bafc0.summary: Allocates a 4-byte pointer block and a 2036-byte initialized block with two 1016-byte sub-chunks. Creates a list node referencing the block and inserts it into the first list. Creates two stride-offset nodes in the second list.

0x004bb2e0.name: MergeSort_b2e0
0x004bb2e0.label: Recursive merge sort on singly-linked list
0x004bb2e0.summary: Classic merge sort for singly-linked list sorted by float key value (descending). Splits list at midpoint, recursively sorts halves, then merges by comparing data[0] as float. Modifies next pointers in place.

0x004bb400.name: LinkedListDestructor_b400
0x004bb400.label: List destructor (flag at offset 0xC)
0x004bb400.summary: Walks a linked list freeing each node and optionally freeing attached data if the flag at node+0xC is set. Zeroes all list bookkeeping fields after destruction.

0x004bb460.name: DestructorWithConditionalFree_b460
0x004bb460.label: Secondary data destructor with self-free
0x004bb460.summary: Frees secondary allocation at this+0x4 if non-null. Optionally frees this itself if a2 bit 0 is set. Returns this.

0x004bb4f0.name: LinkedListDestructionWithRefCountLoop
0x004bb4f0.label: List destructor with refcount element cleanup
0x004bb4f0.summary: Walks linked list freeing nodes. For flagged nodes with data, iterates over refcounted 884-byte elements (calling EmptyStub per element), then frees the refcounted block, data pointer, and node. Zeroes all list fields.

0x004bb650.name: ListFullDestruction
0x004bb650.label: List destructor with two-level data free
0x004bb650.summary: Walks linked list freeing nodes. For flagged nodes with data, frees both the inner allocation (data[0]) and the outer data block. Zeroes all list fields.

0x004bb730.name: FailureCategoryNameLookup
0x004bb730.label: Failure category name lookup
0x004bb730.summary: Maps integer failure category ID (1-9) to a component name string: Engine, Gearbox, Clutch, Suspension, Brakes, Accident, Electronics, Fuel. Returns default block for unknown IDs.

0x004bb800.name: ZeroTwoFields
0x004bb800.label: Two-field zero initializer
0x004bb800.summary: Zeroes two DWORD fields at offsets 0x30 and 0xA4 (this[12] and this[41]). Returns 0.

0x004bb810.name: sub_4BB810
0x004bb810.label: SessionLapDataAllocator
0x004bb810.summary: Allocates three arrays (two float, one byte) sized by total race laps (capped at 128) for storing per-lap session data (times, results); initializes all entries to -1.0f (0xBF800000) and 0.

0x004bb8e0.name: sub_4BB8E0
0x004bb8e0.label: SessionStateReset
0x004bb8e0.summary: For non-qualifying sessions (SessionType <= 6), resets AI racing line path and clears float/flag fields if object condition is met; always zeroes status flag bytes at the end.

0x004bba90.name: sub_4BBA90
0x004bba90.label: PenaltyFinesMessageDisplay
0x004bba90.summary: Displays a "Fined US" or "Penalty" message with driver name and optional fine amount to the HUD, accumulating the fine total in this[41]; guarded by penalty state flags.

0x004bbc60.name: WarningHandler
0x004bbc60.label: WarningMessageDisplay
0x004bbc60.summary: Formats and displays a "Warning <message>" text to the HUD using string table lookup and text rendering, guarded by penalty state flags.

0x004bbd60.name: StopGoPenaltyHandler
0x004bbd60.label: StopGoPenaltyHandler
0x004bbd60.summary: Displays a "Stop/Go Penalty" message with driver name to HUD and logs the penalty event (type 4, ID 23) to the ring buffer with driver identifier and session time.

0x004bbed0.name: AccumulatorWithFixedArray
0x004bbed0.label: AccumulateByteValueWithFixedArray
0x004bbed0.summary: Accumulates byte values from input object into fixed-size 4-slot array; when fewer than 4 entries exist stores new entry (type=3, value=byte), when 4+ entries adds byte to existing slot's value field. Called by sub_4B3400 for pit/event accumulation.

0x004bbf20.name: ProgressBarIncrement
0x004bbf20.label: ProgressBarLapStageWriter
0x004bbf20.summary: Writes a progress bar stage event (type 4, ID 24) with current session time to the ring buffer for the given driver, returning the current lap/stage value at offset 0x44.

0x004bbf70.name: ArrayShiftConditionalDispatch
0x004bbf70.label: FixedArrayDequeueShift
0x004bbf70.summary: Decrements entry count of the fixed-size accumulator array, shifts remaining entries left by one slot (each slot = 2 DWORDs), then reports emptiness status through ArithmeticComparison_5660. Used by sub_4B3400 as the dequeue counterpart to AccumulatorWithFixedArray.

0x004bbfc0.name: PitCrewStateMachine
0x004bbfc0.label: PitStopStateMachine
0x004bbfc0.summary: Manages pit entry/exit state transitions with audio feedback. On pit-entry trigger (object matches expected type), sets state=2, stores car index, disables pit sound flag, plays audio, resets AI state. On exit (non-pit object), resets state to 0, restores pit sound flag to 1, plays audio.

0x004bc060.name: sub_4BC060
0x004bc060.label: QualifyingTireUsageEncoder
0x004bc060.summary: During qualifying session (SessionType == 7), writes tire compound usage event (type 4, ID 26/27) to the ring buffer indicating whether a tire set is currently in use or discarded, with compound identifier.

0x004bc0e0.name: DisqualificationHandler
0x004bc0e0.label: DisqualificationHandler
0x004bc0e0.summary: Displays a "Disqualified:" message with driver name to HUD and logs disqualification event (type 4, ID 28) to ring buffer, guarded by this[12] != 3 to prevent double-disqualification.

0x004bc240.name: sub_4BC240
0x004bc240.label: RacingLineResetGuard
0x004bc240.summary: In non-qualifying sessions, checks if an object flag at offset 13388 is set; if so, resets the racing line mode flag at this[24] from 2 to 1.

0x004bc270.name: sub_4BC270
0x004bc270.label: BoundedFloatArrayLookup
0x004bc270.summary: Reads a float from an indexed array with bounds checking; returns -1.0 if index out of bounds or array pointer null. Accesses array via pointer at this+0x8C, bounded by capacity fields at this+0x8 and this+0x88.

0x004bc2a0.name: ArithmeticComparison_c2a0
0x004bc2a0.label: BoundedFloatArrayLookupAlt
0x004bc2a0.summary: Bounds-checked float array read using a different pointer field (this+0x90) compared to sub_4BC270; returns -1.0 if index is negative or >= either capacity bound. Uses two capacity fields at this+0x8 and this+0x88 as upper limits.

0x004bc2d0.name: sub_4BC2D0
0x004bc2d0.label: PitTrackerStateInit
0x004bc2d0.summary: Initializes three state fields for pit timer/tracker: zeroes counter at offset 0xC, sets state/mode to 2 at offset 0x60, stores driver/vehicle index at offset 0x64. Called by PitTimerStateInit.

0x004bc2e8.name: StateFlagSetter_c2e8
0x004bc2e8.label: SetStateToOne
0x004bc2e8.summary: Sets single state field at this+0x60 to value 1. Unconditional setter with no parameters beyond this pointer.

0x004bc2f0.name: ConditionalFieldSetter
0x004bc2f0.label: AIDriverStateChange
0x004bc2f0.summary: Conditionally updates AI driver state at this+0x2C with transition notification. If new state differs from current, calls AIDriverStateTransition with old/new values on global state array, then updates field.

0x004bc320.name: FieldCopy
0x004bc320.label: FieldCopyStateToPrev
0x004bc320.summary: Copies AI driver state (offset 0x2C) to previous-state field (offset 0x24), copies float from offset 0x68 to offset 0x28, preserving current state snapshot before update.

0x004bc330.name: FieldCopy_c330
0x004bc330.label: CopyField24To2C
0x004bc330.summary: Copies int value from offset 0x24 to offset 0x2C and returns the copied value. Simple inverse-direction field copy compared to FieldCopy_004bc320.

0x004bc340.name: sub_4BC340
0x004bc340.label: PenaltyEligibilityCheck
0x004bc340.summary: Returns true when session is server mode (dword_7C569C == 5), penalty state permits it, and race phase is one of {5, 6, 8}; used as a conditional guard for penalty logic.

0x004bc390.name: LapSplitTimeEvent
0x004bc390.label: LapSplitTimeEvent
0x004bc390.summary: Processes lap/split timing events with state-dependent routing. Early-returns if a ride-height threshold exceeded; validates current state against expected state for event type (0→expect state 2, 1→expect state 0, 2→expect state 1); computes intersection time delta; encodes event data into ring buffer; records lap completion.

0x004bc4e0.name: LapCompletion
0x004bc4e0.label: LapCompletionHandler
0x004bc4e0.summary: Processes vehicle lap/sector completion events — records lap and sector times, detects fastest laps, manages race finish and retirement states, handles penalties (stop-go, disqualification), and triggers session transitions. Part of the race timing and session management system.

0x004bc9b0.name: sub_4BC9B0
0x004bc9b0.label: GridAlignmentAndJumpStartValidator
0x004bc9b0.summary: Validates grid position alignment and detects jump-start violations — computes velocity magnitude, transforms vehicle orientation vectors, and checks distance/angle thresholds to determine if the car is properly lined up; triggers stop-go penalty or disqualification for jump starts when penalties are enabled.

0x004bccc0.name: sub_4BCCC0
0x004bccc0.label: AI Race Penalty and Track Position Update
0x004bccc0.summary: Per-frame AI race driving logic: updates track distance projection, enforces pit lane speed limits with stop-go penalties, detects corner cutting and wrong-way driving violations, manages blue flag penalty timers, and handles pit entry selection based on nearby vehicle proximity.

0x004bd760.name: SentinelSlotFill
0x004bd760.label: SentinelSlotFill
0x004bd760.summary: Searches a fixed-size array of 10 slots (starting at this+56) for a sentinel value -1, fills the first empty slot with this[2], and returns the slot index; if no slot is free, returns 10.

0x004bd7d0.name: F_3FieldInitCall
0x004bd7d0.label: ThreeFieldZeroInit
0x004bd7d0.summary: Zeros three struct fields (offsets 0x8, 0x14, 0x20) then calls StructCleanup for additional teardown. Called by AudioMixerChannelInit.

0x004bd860.name: DynamicArrayPush
0x004bd860.label: DynamicArrayPush
0x004bd860.summary: Appends a value to a dynamic integer array (capacity at this[0], count at this[1], data at this[2]); grows capacity by 8 when full by allocating a new buffer, copying existing elements, and freeing the old buffer.

0x004bd8c0.name: ArithmeticComparison_d8c0
0x004bd8c0.label: ArrayRemoveByValue
0x004bd8c0.summary: Searches an integer array (count at this[1], data pointer at this[2]) for a matching value; if found, replaces it with the last element and decrements count. Returns the index of the removed element or count if not found.

0x004bd900.name: MemoryAllocation_d900
0x004bd900.label: DynamicArrayPushAlt
0x004bd900.summary: Appends a value to a dynamic integer array (capacity at this+0xC, count at this+0x10, data at this+0x14); grows capacity by 8 when full — same logic as DynamicArrayPush_004bd860 but uses different field offsets.

0x004bd970.name: ArrayRemoveByValue
0x004bd970.label: ArrayRemoveByValue
0x004bd970.summary: Searches an integer array (count at this[4], data pointer at this[5]) for a matching value; if found, replaces it with the last element and decrements count. Returns index of removed element or count if not found.

0x004bd9b0.name: DynamicArrayAppendWithRealloc
0x004bd9b0.label: DynamicArrayAppendWithRealloc
