0x004bd9b0.summary: Appends integer to a dynamic array; when capacity is exhausted, grows by +8 slots (reallocates, copies old elements, frees old buffer), then stores new element and increments count.

0x004bda20.name: ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate
0x004bda20.label: ProximityTagUpdater
0x004bda20.summary: Iterates two dynamic arrays of objects (first by this[1]/this[2], second by this[4]/this[5]), updates tag identifier on objects whose tag doesn't match a2, and calls SwitchBasedStateHandler on each updated object.

0x004bdb10.name: SphereProximityTag
0x004bdb10.label: SphereProximityTagUpdater
0x004bdb10.summary: Iterates an array of objects (count at this[7], data at this[8]); for each object whose tag doesn't match a2, updates the tag and triggers UI focus change on the associated UI element.

0x004bdc10.name: SceneExtentComputation
0x004bdc10.label: SceneExtentComputation
0x004bdc10.summary: Computes bounding box of all scene collision objects by iterating the collision geometry tree, tracking min/max X and Z coordinates. Stores normalized extents (min X, min Z, scale X = 8.0/rangeX, scale Z = 8.0/rangeZ) for rendering. Logs error string if no valid extent found.

0x004bde20.name: sub_4BDE20
0x004bde20.label: GridCellAssignment
0x004bde20.summary: Computes 2D grid cell coordinates (0-7 range) from an object's bounding box using grid origin/scale fields at offsets 0x924-0x930, then assigns the object to all overlapping cells in the 8x8 grid.

0x004bdfe0.name: MatrixClear
0x004bdfe0.label: GridMatrixClear
0x004bdfe0.summary: Zeroes an 8x8 grid matrix with stride 9 (clearing 64 elements at offsets 1, 10, 19, ...) and resets the cell count at this[577] to 0.

0x004be340.name: GridCellIterate
0x004be340.label: GridCellIterate
0x004be340.summary: Computes 2D grid cell coordinates (0-7 range) from a position and radius using grid origin/scale fields, then calls ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate on all overlapping cells and the overflow list.

0x004be700.name: PerformanceSetupStructInitializer
0x004be700.label: PerformanceSetupStructInit
0x004be700.summary: Initializes AI performance/setup struct fields with defaults: enables two boolean flags (1,1), sets zero flag, configures float parameters (1.0, 1.0, 600.0, 10.0), zeros accumulators, sets countdown (10) and session type (5). Called by Delegation_e6f0.

0x004be760.name: sub_4BE760
0x004be760.label: AIPerformanceSpeedCalc
0x004be760.summary: Computes AI performance target speed based on closest and second-closest vehicle distances ahead. Iterates all vehicles, finds nearest leader (state==1, speed/distance>1.0) and next vehicle within 115% of that distance. Uses session type at this+0x360 to select qualifying vs race physics offsets. Falls back to season config data when no valid distances found.

0x004be9e0.name: AnimationStateSetter
0x004be9e0.label: AnimationStateSetter
0x004be9e0.summary: Copies four animation/behavior parameters into struct: two byte flags (offsets 0x340, 0x341), a DWORD at offset 0x344, and a DWORD at offset 0x350. Returns the third parameter (a4).

0x004bea10.name: RandomVariationScaler
0x004bea10.label: RandomVariationScaler
0x004bea10.summary: Computes random performance variation scaler for AI vehicle using two LCG random numbers. Selects qualifying (17604) vs race (17600) vehicle physics offset based on session type at this+0x360==7. Clamps result to [0,1] and applies as percentage scaling to input a4.

0x004beb10.name: AIOvertake
0x004beb10.label: AIOvertakeLogic
0x004beb10.summary: Manages AI overtaking/behavioral state: checks accumulated overtake time against threshold, sets session type and total laps to struct fields, detects human-controlled vehicles in qualifying mode, and dispatches AIBehaviorInitialization if activation flag (0x342) is clear. Accumulates time step at offset 0x354.

0x004bec55.name: EngineFailureCheck
0x004bec55.label: EngineFailureCheck
0x004bec55.summary: Main AI driver update loop that checks engine failure conditions, manages collision response, pit state, and AI sorting across all vehicles. For each vehicle: checks engine state flags, applies random variation scaling on negative speed, triggers collision response with probabilistic severity selection, updates AI driver state, accumulates damage counters, and records progress bar events.

0x004bef60.name: AICollision
0x004bef60.label: AICollision
0x004bef60.summary: Checks AI collision state: returns 0 (no collision) if not qualifying session; checks wheel contact/brake flags for all 4 wheels (returns 1 if any missing or braking); checks vehicle state for collision severity (returns 2 for state==2); performs probabilistic collision response based on wear flags and random thresholds. Uses two boolean flags (0x340, 0x341) and multiplier (0x344) from behavior config.

0x004bf0a0.name: AIBehaviorInitialization
0x004bf0a0.label: AI performance initialization per vehicle
0x004bf0a0.summary: Initializes AI opponent timing/performance offsets per vehicle for a race session. Sets per-vehicle speed bias and start delay based on AI difficulty slider, track reference speed, and engine wear mode.

0x004bf390.name: AIDriverSorting
0x004bf390.label: AI driver position sorting
0x004bf390.summary: Compares an AI driver's race progress against other drivers and swaps position values when the driver should overtake. Handles race session (lap+time comparison) vs other sessions (best-lap comparison).

0x004bf4f0.name: AITickUpdate
0x004bf4f0.label: AI tick update per vehicle
0x004bf4f0.summary: Per-frame AI timing update: advances lap counters and race times for vehicles whose elapsed segment time exceeds zero. Resets scoring ring-buffer globals at end of tick.

0x004bf6a0.name: sub_4BF6A0
0x004bf6a0.label: Season audio parameter lookup
0x004bf6a0.summary: Looks up a season-specific audio parameter (volume/pitch) by audio channel key string. Computes a float value from season data entry with randomized noise, returns 1.0 on failure.

0x004bf790.name: AIOpponentSelection
0x004bf790.label: AI opponent list builder
0x004bf790.summary: Builds a sorted linked list of AI opponent candidates by randomly selecting vehicles, computing audio/skill parameters for each, and merge-sorting by float value. Used to select opponents for AI path/difficulty assignment.

0x004bfa00.name: AIPathPerformanceFunction
0x004bfa00.label: AI performance-sorted opponent list builder
0x004bfa00.summary: Builds a merge-sorted linked list of AI opponents from the vehicle pool by excluding already-selected vehicles and lookup up audio/skill parameters. Used to generate a performance-ranked opponent list for path assignment.

0x004bfcd0.name: VehicleArrayIndexAccessor
0x004bfcd0.label: Indexed vehicle file pointer lookup
0x004bfcd0.summary: Walks a linked list to find the Nth node, then uses its data pointer to index into the global vehicle file array. Returns pointer to the vehicle file entry or 0 if index out of range.

0x004bfd40.name: IndexedListLookup
0x004bfd40.label: Linked list index accessor
0x004bfd40.summary: Walks a linked list to the Nth node and returns the first DWORD of the node's data. Generic list accessor returning stored integer value at index.

0x004bfd90.name: AIDriverCountSetup
0x004bfd90.label: AI driver count and team setup
0x004bfd90.summary: Configures AI opponent count and assigns team/nationality data per driver based on game mode (championship vs other). Handles single-player override, random AI count generation, and per-driver team assignment.

0x004bff70.name: sub_4BFF70
0x004bff70.label: Grid position assignment
0x004bff70.summary: Assigns starting grid positions to all vehicles based on qualifying performance or randomized order. Handles both qualifying-session grid ordering and non-qualifying random placement.

0x004c01a0.name: sub_4C01A0
0x004c01a0.label: Score-sorted grid position assignment
0x004c01a0.summary: Assigns grid positions to vehicles sorted by a performance score field. Uses selection-sort on a 104-slot array to order vehicles by their stored score value.

0x004c0260.name: sub_4C0260
0x004c0260.label: Qualifying position lookup by driver name
0x004c0260.summary: Looks up a driver name in the season's qualifying section and returns the 1-based grid position index. Returns 104 (max vehicles) if not found.

0x004c02d0.name: sub_4C02D0
0x004c02d0.label: Qualifying time lookup by driver name
0x004c02d0.summary: Looks up a driver name in the season's qualifying section and returns the qualifying time/score value. Returns -1.0 if not found or value below 10.0 threshold.

0x004c03f0.name: CareerStandingsStateLoader
0x004c03f0.label: Career standings state loader
0x004c03f0.summary: Loads career season standings from an ini-file buffer into the standings object. Reads finish positions, points, season totals, grid positions, and active flag for each indexed entry.

0x004c0690.name: SettingsIniFileWriter
0x004c0690.label: Career standings ini writer
0x004c0690.summary: Writes career season standings data to an ini-style text buffer. Outputs per-driver finish positions/points (up to 48 entries) and season totals including grid positions and control type.

0x004c0850.name: sub_4C0850
0x004c0850.label: Vehicle state restore from career data
0x004c0850.summary: Restores a vehicle's runtime state (name, position, session state) from loaded career standings data. Copies vehicle name and file path strings to the season scoring database entry and sets grid position.

0x004c0910.name: SeasonScoring
0x004c0910.label: Season scoring computation
0x004c0910.summary: Computes season championship points for a vehicle based on race position and game state. Handles both idle scoring (GameState==5) and post-race scoring (GameState==7) with points lookup from scoring data.

0x004c0a20.name: SceneNameLookupBySeason
0x004c0a20.label: Scene name copy to buffer
0x004c0a20.summary: Looks up the current vehicle's scene name and copies it into an output buffer with length limit. Gets vehicle name from object field, resolves it via vehicle lookup, and returns the scene-name string.

0x004c0a80.name: SceneNamePointer
0x004c0a80.label: Scene name pointer accessor
0x004c0a80.summary: Returns a pointer to the current vehicle's scene name string (offset +124) by looking up the vehicle name stored in the object. Returns 0 if vehicle not found.

0x004c0ab0.name: AudioSubsystemInitializer
0x004c0ab0.label: Career standings sub-block initializer
0x004c0ab0.summary: Initializes a large career standings structure containing 103 per-driver sub-blocks and session state fields. Sets default values for season status, race session, and current race index.

0x004c0b10.name: PitStopMemoryCleanup
0x004c0b10.label: Career standings memory cleanup
0x004c0b10.summary: Frees dynamically allocated pointers and runs cleanup on 103 per-driver sub-blocks in the career standings structure. Releases pit stop and driver data allocations before structure destruction.

0x004c0b70.name: CareerSeasonStateFileReader
0x004c0b70.label: Career season state file reader
0x004c0b70.summary: Parses career season state from an ini-style buffer, loading opponent standings, player standings, season status, race session, race-over flag, and current race index.

0x004c0cc0.name: PlayerOpponentStateWriter
0x004c0cc0.label: Player/opponent state ini writer
0x004c0cc0.summary: Writes career season state for player and active opponents to an ini-format text buffer. Outputs season status, race session, race-over flag, current race, and per-driver standings via SettingsIniFileWriter.

0x004c0db0.name: GameFilterDataLoader
0x004c0db0.label: Game filter data and career state loader
0x004c0db0.summary: Loads game filter configuration, initializes career standings structure for player and up to 103 opponents, and populates per-driver data from the vehicle file pool. Sets default session vehicle counts and active flags.

0x004c0f60.name: RaceStandingsRankingsComputation
0x004c0f60.label: Post-race ranking computation
0x004c0f60.summary: Computes driver rankings after race by scoring season points for player and opponents, then ranking active drivers by position. Sets race-over flag when complete.

0x004c1050.name: sub_4C1050
0x004c1050.label: SessionInitAndTrackLoad
0x004c1050.summary: Initializes a race session: loads track scene from session config, resets 103 driver/entity entries (setting field at 0x1AC to 1), transitions session states for empty slots, copies path strings, and clamps game state. Called once at session start.

0x004c11e0.name: SessionConfigReader
0x004c11e0.label: SessionConfigParser
0x004c11e0.summary: Parses session configuration from a scene-order data file. Validates scene order via AudioChannelStop, opens the season races section, loads track scene, copies scene path strings into session object, and reads QualifyLaps/QualifyTime/RaceLaps/RaceTime values (defaulting to -1 if keys missing). Returns pointer to session string buffer at offset 0xB130.

0x004c15a0.name: PitStopPhaseAdvance
0x004c15a0.label: SessionPhaseAdvance
0x004c15a0.summary: Advances a session phase counter (0xB14C) from 1 through 7. At phase 7, triggers race standings/rankings computation and timer countdown with state transition. Each step zeros a flag byte at 0xB150.

0x004c1670.name: TimerCountdownWithStateTransition
0x004c1670.label: TimerCountdownHandler
0x004c1670.summary: Handles countdown timer for session state transitions. When timer flag at 0xB150 is active, increments counter at 0xB148, checks it against SceneOrderReader threshold — if exceeded, sets phase to 3 at 0xB144. Resets phase counter to 1 and clears timer flag.

0x004c1700.name: DoubleListCleanup
0x004c1700.label: DualLinkedListDestructor
0x004c1700.summary: Destructor for a structure containing two singly-linked lists. Walks each list, frees nodes and optionally their data payloads when the ownership flag (node+8) is set. Performs three passes: first list cleanup with PitStopMemoryCleanup, second list cleanup with ShortComputation_4370, then a final verification pass on the first list. Zeros all pointers afterward.

0x004c1820.name: LinkedListNodeRemovalWithCleanup
0x004c1820.label: LinkedListNodeRemoveWithCleanup
0x004c1820.summary: Removes a node from a singly-linked list by matching its data pointer against LinkedListDereference result. Updates head/tail/count metadata, optionally frees the node's data payload if ownership flag is set, then deallocates the node. Returns 1 on success, 0 if target not found.

0x004c18b0.name: PlayerCareerStatsGameOptionsLoader
0x004c18b0.label: PlayerCareerStatsGameOptionsLoader
0x004c18b0.summary: Loads player career statistics and game options from save data — reads season state files, track stats, and game configuration parameters, building internal linked lists of career data records; validates track/directory existence before committing results.

0x004c1e80.name: GameOptionsWriter
0x004c1e80.label: Game options / career stats file parser and loader
0x004c1e80.summary: Parses game options and career statistics from config files: reads career season state, player track stats, and race condition settings (qualifying, race length, opponent strength, fuel/tire multipliers, speed compensation, mechanical failure rate, weather, flags, format). Populates an options struct for use in race setup. Part of the game options / career system.

0x004c2300.name: DualListDestructionWithDeepCleanup
0x004c2300.label: PitStop State Teardown with Dual LinkedList Cleanup
0x004c2300.summary: Destroys two linked lists of pit-stop memory allocations: the first list has simple node-cleanup, the second has deep nested cleanup (freeing sub-objects within each node). Resets all pit-stop state fields and restores a UI option value. Part of the pit-stop memory management system.

0x004c2420.name: CareerStatsWriter
0x004c2420.label: CareerStatsFileWriter
0x004c2420.summary: Writes career statistics (player/opponent states, track records, race conditions, game options) to an output buffer using format strings. Iterates two linked lists: player-opponent state nodes and per-track stat records. Returns 0.

0x004c2700.name: CareerSectionReader
0x004c2700.label: CareerSectionFileReader
0x004c2700.summary: Opens a file handle, reads the "Career" section from it using a structured reader, and writes career stats via CareerStatsWriter. Returns success/failure flag.

0x004c2780.name: NodeAllocListInsert
0x004c2780.label: AudioNodeAllocAndListInsert
0x004c2780.summary: Allocates and initializes an audio subsystem block (45396 bytes), loads game filter data into it, then wraps it in a 12-byte list node appended to this object's linked list. Optionally removes an existing node first if DelegatedFieldGetter returns 2.

0x004c2850.name: LinkedListDereference
0x004c2850.label: LinkedListCursorRead
0x004c2850.summary: Returns the data pointer at the current list cursor position by dereferencing the node at this+0x4. Saves the cursor node pointer to this+0x8 for later use. Returns 0 if cursor is null.

0x004c2860.name: LinkedListSearchByName
0x004c2860.label: LinkedListSearchByName
0x004c2860.summary: Walks a linked list starting from this+0x10, comparing each node's name string (at node+8) against a target string a2 using string comparison. Returns the first matching node's address, or 0 if not found. Falls back to default path for null names.

0x004c28d0.name: TrackSceneNodeAdd
0x004c28d0.label: TrackSceneNodeAdder
0x004c28d0.summary: Adds a new track scene node to the scene list. Checks for duplicates by name via LinkedListSearchByName, parses scene data, allocates and initializes a scene node block (24 bytes), wraps it in a list node (12 bytes), and appends to the linked list at this+0x10. Returns the existing or newly inserted node.

0x004c29f0.name: sub_4C29F0
0x004c29f0.label: RaceSessionScoringUpdate
0x004c29f0.summary: Processes scoring data during a race session (type 7). Checks scoring gate, computes running averages with AI difficulty and race setup scaling, and conditionally increments a session counter at this+0x3C when championship mode is 3 or 4 and player vehicle is in a specific state.

0x004c2a80.name: SeasonScoringInfoUpdater
0x004c2a80.label: SeasonScoringProcessor
0x004c2a80.summary: Updates season scoring statistics during a race session. Accumulates player vehicle laps/minimum speed into track scene nodes, applies running average filters, and evaluates race completion scoring criteria (90% race distance, vehicle state, championship mode). Integrates with file-based season scoring data.

0x004c2be0.name: Accumulator
0x004c2be0.label: FieldAccumulator
0x004c2be0.summary: Adds the input value a2 to a running total stored at this+0x24. Returns the input value unchanged. Used to accumulate laps, points, or other session counters.

0x004c2c40.name: RunningAverageFilter
0x004c2c40.label: RunningAverageFilter
0x004c2c40.summary: Computes an incremental running average of input values. Uses sample count at this+0x28 to weight the running average at this+0x44 via formula: new_avg = ((n-1)*old_avg + new_val)/n. Clamps result to [1.0, 22.0] range. First sample initializes the average directly.

0x004c2cb0.name: MovingAverageFilterWithClamp
0x004c2cb0.label: MovingAverageWithClamp
0x004c2cb0.summary: Computes an incremental moving average of input values, storing result at this+0x48. Uses sample count at this+0x28 for weighting. Similar to RunningAverageFilter but writes to a different field (0x48 vs 0x44). Clamps result to [1.0, 22.0] range.

0x004c2d30.name: sub_4C2D30
0x004c2d30.label: ScaledMovingAverageFilter
0x004c2d30.summary: Computes a moving average of input values scaled by 100, storing result at this+0x4C. Uses sample count at this+0x28 for weighting. Clamps result to [5.0, 100.0] range. Called with RaceSetupScaling to smooth performance metrics.

0x004c2dc0.name: ArithmeticComparison_2dc0
0x004c2dc0.label: IncrementalRunningAverage
0x004c2dc0.summary: Computes an incremental running average of AI difficulty slider values. Maintains a counter at this+0x2C (incremented each call) and a running average at this+0x50 (init 120.0f). Uses standard incremental formula: new_avg = (old_count * old_avg + input) / (old_count + 1). Clamps result to [~60.0, 120.0] range.

0x004c3130.name: MultiFieldCleanup
0x004c3130.label: StructPointerFieldCleanup
0x004c3130.summary: Destructor that frees multiple pointer fields in a structure: walks and frees a linked list at this+0x3D4, then individually frees pointer fields at offsets 0x0, 0x8, 0x10, 0x18, 0x20, 0x3CC, and 0x3D8. Each pointer is null-checked before freeing.

0x004c3200.name: VehFileParser
0x004c3200.label: Vehicle R-File Parser and File Resolver
0x004c3200.summary: Parses a vehicle `.R` definition file (read via fopen), extracting all team/driver/livery/eyepoint/camera data into the vehicle struct, then resolves companion file paths (HDV, INI, GEN, SFX) via FileFinder. Returns 0 on success, -1 if the file cannot be opened.

0x004c38d0.name: FileINILoader
0x004c38d0.label: TextureFilenameProcessor
0x004c38d0.summary: Extracts the filename from a file path, strips the extension, appends ".tga", and scans for matching TGA texture files via TGATextureFileScanner. Stores the scanner result at this+0x420. Cleans up scanner's linked list output. Handles null paths with default directory fallback.

0x004c3a00.name: TGATextureFileScanner
0x004c3a00.label: TGATextureDirectoryScanner
0x004c3a00.summary: Scans a directory for TGA texture files matching a given filename. Iterates directory entries, compares base filenames (stripping directory paths and extensions), and builds a linked list of matching results with path match priority (exact path matches appended, others prepended). Returns a list destructor result.

0x004c3d80.name: VehicleFileLoader
0x004c3d80.label: VehicleFileLoader
0x004c3d80.summary: Bulk-loads .veh vehicle files from the season directory. Scans directory for matching files, allocates/reallocates a vehicle data array (1060 bytes per entry), parses each file via VehFileParser, and updates the global vehicle count. Cleans up existing array before reload.

0x004c3f80.name: VehicleLookupByName
0x004c3f80.label: VehicleNameLookup
0x004c3f80.summary: Searches the global vehicle array for a vehicle matching a given name string. Iterates entries (stride 1060), compares the name field (first string pointer in each entry) via string comparison. Stores matching index in dword_8AC38C if found; no return value.

0x004c40d0.name: FileFinder
0x004c40d0.label: FileFinder
0x004c40d0.summary: Searches for a file across multiple paths (custom path, season directory, common directory), opens it if found and copies the path; logs a debug message if not found in any location.

0x004c4240.name: VehicleDataLoader
0x004c4240.label: VehicleDataSorter
0x004c4240.summary: Selection-sorts the global vehicle array by composite string key. For each position, finds the best-matching remaining entry via CompositeStringCompare, swaps it into place using a local temporary buffer. Copies strings, integer fields, and raw byte blocks (16B to 256B chunks) during each swap. Called after vehicle files are loaded.

0x004c45d0.name: VehicleDataCopy
0x004c45d0.label: VehicleDataCopy
0x004c45d0.summary: Performs a deep copy of vehicle configuration data from a source template struct (a2) into the destination vehicle instance (this). Copies 7 string fields (with null-fallback to default directory path), multiple byte-range blocks of varying sizes (8 to 256 bytes), a 15-DWORD contiguous block, and a final trailing DWORD. Called once during vehicle loading to instantiate a vehicle from its template.

0x004c4930.name: ArithmeticComparison_4930
0x004c4930.label: SceneListAndDataCleanup
0x004c4930.summary: Destructor that cleans up scene list and associated data. Calls SceneListCleanup on primary pointer, then walks a linked list at this+0x8 freeing nodes and their data payloads (guarded by ownership flag at node+8). Zeros all list pointers at offsets 0x8 through 0x14 and frees the primary pointer at offset 0x0.

0x004c4990.name: VehicleFilteringSelection
0x004c4990.label: Filter vehicles by criteria, build result list
0x004c4990.summary: Filters vehicles from global vehicle array by matching all specified criteria, excluding vehicles already present in a keyed exclusion list, and builds a linked list of matching vehicle indices in the output structure.

0x004c4bb0.name: LinkedListSearchRemoval
0x004c4bb0.label: Remove list nodes failing filter criteria
0x004c4bb0.summary: Iterates a linked list of vehicle index nodes; removes nodes whose vehicle field at offset 0x1BC does not match ALL specified filter criteria. Returns remaining count.

0x004c4cb0.name: LinkedListKeySearch
0x004c4cb0.label: Search linked list for matching key value
0x004c4cb0.summary: Traverses a linked list where each node holds a pointer to an int; returns 1 if any node's value equals the search key `a2`, 0 otherwise. Updates iterator field during traversal.

0x004c4cf0.name: SceneListCleanup
0x004c4cf0.label: SceneLinkedListFree
0x004c4cf0.summary: Frees a linked list of scene/layer nodes, conditionally freeing each node's embedded data buffer based on a flag byte, then zeros the head pointers. Part of scene/layer management system.

0x004c4d50.name: sub_4C4D50
0x004c4d50.label: Three-stage vehicle list filter with token parsing
0x004c4d50.summary: Parses a filter string into three token groups (default AND-matches, explicit AND: group, NOT: exclusion group), then applies them sequentially: builds list of vehicles matching default tokens, intersects with AND-group matches, removes NOT-group matches. Falls back to full vehicle list when no filter or special game mode active.

0x004c4ff0.name: SeasonSceneMatchByIndex
0x004c4ff0.label: Find vehicle in list matching a name string
0x004c4ff0.summary: Searches the linked list of vehicle indices for a vehicle whose name (from global vehicle array) matches the search string `a2`. Returns pointer to vehicle entry if found, storing match index in field 0x18; returns 0 if not found.

0x004c5070.name: RandomVehicleSelector
0x004c5070.label: Get random vehicle entry from filtered list
0x004c5070.summary: Generates a random index from an internal 64-bit state, bounds-checks it against the linked list count, walks the list to the indexed node, and returns the corresponding vehicle entry pointer from the global vehicle array. Used for AI opponent vehicle selection.

0x004c5130.name: ListIndexedAccessor
0x004c5130.label: Access linked list element by stored index
0x004c5130.summary: Reads an index from field 0x18, validates it against list count, walks the linked list to that position, and returns the data value (int pointer dereferenced from node). Falls back to first element if index is out of bounds.

0x004c51a0.name: TrackFilePathBuilder
0x004c51a0.label: Register scene file and build scene file path
0x004c51a0.summary: Strips extension and path from a scene file path, extracts the base filename, searches/creates an entry in the scene file registry array, stores the full path, calls section writer, and computes a formatted scene file path result.

0x004c52c0.name: SceneFileLoader
0x004c52c0.label: BuildSceneFileArrayFromDirectory
0x004c52c0.summary: Scans a directory for scene (.SCN) files for the current track/season combination, allocates an array of 396-byte scene entries, and loads each .SCN file via TrackFilePathBuilder. Sorts the resulting scene array by season/race using SeasonRacesSceneSorter and returns the total scene count.

0x004c54f0.name: AIW
0x004c54f0.label: Build SCN and AIW file paths from current scene entry
0x004c54f0.summary: Reads the current scene entry (indexed by `dword_8AC48C`) from the scene array, copies the scene name to a track name buffer, formats `.SCN` and `.AIW` file path strings from the scene's base name, and copies the buffers to persistent storage.

0x004c55b0.name: TrackSceneLoader
0x004c55b0.label: Find and set current scene by name
0x004c55b0.summary: Normalizes an input scene name and searches the scene registry array for a matching entry by name comparison. If found, sets `dword_8AC48C` to the matching index. Returns scene count if no match.

0x004c5690.name: SceneDataParser
0x004c5690.label: Match scene file path to registry entry
0x004c5690.summary: Strips directory path and extension from an input scene file path, then iterates the scene registry comparing the base filename against each entry's path (also stripped). On match, sets `dword_8AC48C` to the matching index. Returns scene count on failure.

0x004c5840.name: SeasonRacesSectionFinder
0x004c5840.label: SeasonRacesSectionFinder
0x004c5840.summary: Returns a string-keyed linked list search result for the "SeasonRaces" section using either a provided key or the current scene's data offset; guarded by a name lookup check.

0x004c5940.name: SeasonRacesSceneSorter
0x004c5940.label: Sort scene array by season races order
0x004c5940.summary: Reads the current "season races" linked list, maps each scene entry to its position in that list, then selection-sorts the scene array entries by that mapping order. Frees the temporary index array.

0x004c5ae0.name: SeasonRacesSectionWriter
0x004c5ae0.label: Build season races file path, load section data
0x004c5ae0.summary: Constructs a file path by taking the default directory prefix, appending the input path, stripping the extension, and adding a suffix from global constants. Then loads/creates the season races audio channel data for that file.

0x004c5bb0.name: SceneFilePathFormatter
0x004c5bb0.label: Build formatted scene file path and compute result
0x004c5bb0.summary: Constructs a file path from the default directory, input path, and global suffix constants, then calls `UtilityFunction_8a60` with parameter `a3` to compute a result value. Returns the computed result or -1 on failure.

0x004c5c80.name: sub_4C5C80
0x004c5c80.label: Initialize filter property structure and find scene order slot
0x004c5c80.summary: Initializes a 16-byte filter property structure: stores scene index, resets order position and slot state to defaults, copies a filter name string, then calls `SceneOrderSlotFinder` to look up the scene's position in the SceneOrder list.

0x004c5cb0.name: SceneOrderSlotFinder
0x004c5cb0.label: Find scene position in SceneOrder list
0x004c5cb0.summary: Initializes order slot to INT_MAX (0x7FFFFFFF), loads the SceneOrder linked list, then iterates through it comparing scene names against the scene entry name at global offset. Stores the matching list index in field 0xC.

0x004c5d30.name: SceneSortComparator
0x004c5d30.label: Compare two filter properties for sorting
0x004c5d30.summary: Comparison function for sorting filter property nodes. Primary key is the SceneOrder position (field 0xC); ties broken by scene name comparison (offset 0x104 in scene array), falling back to filter property name strings (field 0x4). Returns true if first argument sorts before second.

0x004c5de0.name: sub_4C5DE0
0x004c5de0.label: Full filter properties structure cleanup
0x004c5de0.summary: Calls resource list cleanup, then walks the linked list of filter property nodes freeing each node's data (with secondary pointer cleanup if flag set) and the node itself. Zeroes all list fields, then frees the base structure pointer.

0x004c5e50.name: FilterPropertiesListBuilder
0x004c5e50.label: Build filter property list matching criteria
0x004c5e50.summary: Iterates scene registry entries, skips those in exclusion list, builds a filter property name from scene name, checks against filter criteria. For matching entries, allocates and initializes a filter property struct (via sub_4C5C80), appends to result linked list.

0x004c6150.name: FilterPropertiesListNodeRemover
0x004c6150.label: Remove filter property nodes matching criteria
0x004c6150.summary: Iterates filter property linked list, builds filter name from each node's scene entry, checks against filter criteria. Nodes whose filter name matches ALL criteria are preserved; non-matching nodes are unlinked and freed (with extra cleanup for the filter property structure).

0x004c62c0.name: ResourceListCleanup_62c0
0x004c62c0.label: Free resource list nodes and reset structure
0x004c62c0.summary: Copies default directory path string, then walks a linked list of resource nodes freeing each node's data (including any secondary allocation within the data struct) and the node itself. Zeroes all list-management fields.

0x004c6330.name: SceneFileFilterBuilder
0x004c6330.label: SceneFileFilteredListBuilder
0x004c6330.summary: Builds a filtered, sorted linked list of scene files — either the full unfiltered set (when no filter string or in photo/free-camera mode), or a parsed filter string supporting AND:/NOT: logic with tokenized include/exclude buckets and merge-sorted output.

0x004c6760.name: BoundsCheckedIndexSetter_6760
0x004c6760.label: Set list index with bounds check
0x004c6760.summary: Sets an index field (0x18) in the structure if the provided value is within valid range [0, count-1]. Returns the input value unchanged regardless of whether the set succeeds.

0x004c6780.name: LinkedListRandomAccess
0x004c6780.label: Get random scene entry from filtered list
0x004c6780.summary: Generates a random index from internal 64-bit state, bounds-checks it against the linked list count, walks the list to the indexed node, and returns the corresponding scene entry pointer from the global scene array.

0x004c6810.name: MergeSortLinkedList
0x004c6810.label: Recursive merge sort for linked lists
0x004c6810.summary: Standard top-down merge sort for a singly-linked list. Counts nodes, splits at midpoint, recursively sorts both halves, then merges using `SceneSortComparator` for ordering. Returns pointer to sorted list head.

0x004c6920.name: VehicleObjectConstructor
0x004c6920.label: Vehicle object constructor
0x004c6920.summary: Initialises a vehicle object struct: calls RaceStructInit to zero-init fields, sets field at +0x4894 to -1 (invalid/unset), clears driver info, and stores a self-reference via LargeStructFieldSetterWithStoredReference.

0x004c6960.name: TeamIDSetter
0x004c6960.label: Team ID setter across multiple struct fields
0x004c6960.summary: Writes the same team ID value (a2) to five different offsets in the vehicle struct: +0x4, +0x10, +0x32D0, +0x4038, +0x4894. Propagates the team identifier to multiple substructures that all need to agree on team identity.

0x004c6980.name: SetDriverName
0x004c6980.label: Set driver full name and derive abbreviation
0x004c6980.summary: Copies a driver name string (max 63 chars) into the driver name field at this+17952 (offset 0x4620), null-terminates it, then calls DriverAbbreviationNameFormatter to generate and store the abbreviated name.

0x004c69b0.name: ShortStringSet
0x004c69b0.label: Set short string value with hash
0x004c69b0.summary: Copies a short string (max 7 chars) to this+4546 (offset 0x4708), null-terminates it, then hashes/processes it via sub_587ECE and stores the resulting hash at this[4548] (offset 0x4710).

0x004c6a10.name: DriverAbbreviationNameFormatter
0x004c6a10.label: FormatDriverAbbreviationName
0x004c6a10.summary: Formats a driver name into abbreviated display string (e.g., initial-dot + truncated name) using "Abbreviation" section lookup or fallback extension-strip. Part of driver name/HUD display system.

0x004c6b60.name: sub_4C6B60
0x004c6b60.label: VehicleFrameUpdate
0x004c6b60.summary: Per-vehicle per-frame update: runs AI path tracking, suspension simulation, state transition, and camera/frustum setup. Called each tick for every vehicle.

0x004c6c40.name: VehgenScnFileLoader
0x004c6c40.label: Vehicle generation scene file loader
0x004c6c40.summary: Loads the "vehgen.scn" scene configuration, sets up vehicle graphics and physics scene, initialises driver name and nationality path from config, sets driver number, and cleans up allocated memory. Called during vehicle setup/initialisation.

0x004c6d90.name: SceneRenderUpdate
0x004c6d90.label: VehicleSceneRenderUpdate
0x004c6d90.summary: Per-vehicle scene render update each frame. Coordinates vehicle physics prep, AI driver state, render dispatch (grid position / path data), force feedback update, and optional collision check.

0x004c6e80.name: sub_4C6E80
0x004c6e80.label: Vehicle reset/cleanup (disqualify/remove)
0x004c6e80.summary: Resets a vehicle struct for reinitialisation: clears physics, UI components, driver info, and double buffer state; reassigns AI drivers via random selector; sets two fields at +0x48A4/+0x48A8 to -1 (invalid). Forces simulation reset.

0x004c6f10.name: sub_4C6F10
0x004c6f10.label: GridPositionAllocation
0x004c6f10.summary: Allocate this vehicle to a free grid slot on the starting grid. Scans 52 slots, skips occupied ones, assigns slot index (0x48A4) and team column (0x48A8). Called per frame when position is unset.

0x004c71c0.name: SetupCarLightingAndRender
0x004c71c0.label: Vehicle Telemetry Packet Encoder
0x004c71c0.summary: Encodes per-vehicle physics state (throttle, brake, RPM, gear, steering, suspension positions, temperatures, flags) into a bitfield-packed telemetry packet for rendering/network transmission. Reads car state fields and packs them via a series of encoding subroutines into a DWORD array output buffer.

0x004c73f0.name: VehiclePhysicsTimeStep
0x004c73f0.label: Vehicle Physics Per-Frame Timestep
0x004c73f0.summary: Per-frame vehicle physics update: computes position/velocity from input data, applies suspension parameters, runs subsystem state machines (mode 2/3), and updates audio/vibration/braking effects based on bitfield flags.

0x004c77d0.name: TireTemperatureSimStep
0x004c77d0.label: Tire temperature simulation step
0x004c77d0.summary: Simulates tire temperature for a vehicle each frame: clamps temperature to [0, 5.0], subtracts cooling rate, applies recovery when temperature drops to zero, and updates car lighting render. Only runs for vehicle types 0 or 1 (human/primary).

0x004c78f0.name: NationalityDriverInfoLoader
0x004c78f0.label: Nationality/career driver info loader
0x004c78f0.summary: Loads driver nationality info, name, short/long descriptions, and abbreviation from a data array (indexed by a2). Sets the driver's full name, nationality display string, short description, long description, abbreviation code, and nationality flag path. Stores driver index at +0x4898.

0x004c7a70.name: VehicleAIControlFlag
0x004c7a70.label: Vehicle AI control flag set/clear
0x004c7a70.summary: Sets or clears bit 0 of the AI control flag at offset +0x48BC (this[4655]). When a2 is non-zero, sets the AI-controlled flag (bit 0 = 1); when zero, clears it (bit 0 = 0). Used during collision contact iteration to toggle AI override.

0x004c7aa0.name: SetDriverVisibility
0x004c7aa0.label: Set driver visibility (show/hide)
0x004c7aa0.summary: Sets visibility flags (bits 1-2) at offset +0x48BC to show (a2 non-zero) or hide (a2 zero) the driver. When showing and the vehicle matches the current player's team, plays engine sound; when hiding, plays stop sound. Manages 3D audio for the player's own vehicle vs others.

0x004c7b20.name: TwoCallDelegation
0x004c7b20.label: Vehicle name enumeration then nationality loader
0x004c7b20.summary: Delegates to VehicleNameEnumeration with the config path, then loads nationality/career driver info using the enumerated vehicle index. Two-step setup: enumerate available vehicle names, then populate driver data from the first match.

0x004c7b50.name: VehicleSetupDriverNumber
0x004c7b50.label: Lookup and store driver number from config
0x004c7b50.summary: Looks up the driver number from a named entry list using the driver's full name and nationality path. Falls back to vehicle array name lookup if the initial search fails. Also scans a linked list for a long description match and stores the result as a secondary ID. Writes results to +0x489C (driver number) and +0x48A0 (secondary ID).

0x004c7bd0.name: sub_4C7BD0
0x004c7bd0.label: IsPlayerVehicle
0x004c7bd0.summary: Returns true if this vehicle's grid slot index (offset 0x4894) matches the current player vehicle's starting grid position. Used as an "is this the player's car" check.

0x004c7bf0.name: PropertySetter
0x004c7bf0.label: VehiclePropertySetter
0x004c7bf0.summary: Simple setter: stores a2 into the vehicle field at offset 0x48AC (this[4651]). Returns the value that was set.

0x004c7ca0.name: NetworkMessageReceiveAndDispatch
0x004c7ca0.label: Network message receive and dispatch to list
0x004c7ca0.summary: Receives and dispatches network messages from audio network nodes. Iterates over connected nodes, checks render flags, allocates message entries, and builds a linked list of pending messages on this object's list head at +0xC. Uses vtable dispatch for message processing.

0x004c7dd0.name: FieldZero4
0x004c7dd0.label: Zero field at offset +0x4
0x004c7dd0.summary: Sets the DWORD at offset +0x4 of the struct to 0. Simple field zeroing function.

0x004c7de0.name: sub_4C7DE0
0x004c7de0.label: Render tick update with camera FOV and list iteration
0x004c7de0.summary: Render tick processing: decrements a timer at +0x4 by a default return value; when timer goes below zero, calls UpdateCameraFOV (0.4 increment) and clamps timer to 0. If InitStatus is set, dispatches vtable call and iterates a linked list, calling sub_4C8FC0 on each entry.

0x004c7e80.name: sub_4C7E80
0x004c7e80.label: Linked list destructor (free all entries and head)
0x004c7e80.summary: Destroys a linked list: iterates all entries, calls vtable destructor (param 1) on entries with byte at +8 non-zero, frees each entry, zeroes the list header fields (head/tail/cursor/count), then frees the list header itself. Sets the list pointer at this+0xC to NULL.

0x004c7f30.name: UpdateCameraFOV
0x004c7f30.label: UpdateCameraFOV
0x004c7f30.summary: Updates camera FOV (this[2]) based on session type, race phase, elapsed race time, and lap progress. Smoothly interpolates current FOV toward computed target using frame-time delta.

0x004c81a0.name: ListSearchWithGlobalMatch
0x004c81a0.label: Search linked list for matching global value
0x004c81a0.summary: Searches a linked list at this+0xC for an entry whose second DWORD (+4) matches the global dword_8ACFCC. Iterates from current cursor position; when a match is found, sets entry's field at +0x18 to 0. If no match, returns without modification. Advances cursor after each non-matching entry.

0x004c8350.name: ArithmeticComparison_8350
0x004c8350.label: Singleton manager shutdown/cleanup
0x004c8350.summary: Destructor dispatch for four global singleton managers: AudioMixerPtr (dword_8AC4C8), SceneManagerPtr (dword_8AC4CC), SingletonMgrPtr_3 (dword_8AC4D0), and InitStatus (dword_8AC4C4). Calls each object's destructor (vtable offset 4 for first three, offset 12 for InitStatus) and zeroes the pointers.

0x004c83b0.name: sub_4C83B0
0x004c83b0.label: Audio scene reinitialisation with playlist shuffle
0x004c83b0.summary: Destroys existing audio playlist linked list (frees all entries), then scans the track directory to build new .wav and .mp3 playlists. If tracks exist, selects a random starting track. If no tracks are found and InitStatus exists, triggers scene index loading via vtable dispatch.

0x004c84a0.name: sub_4C84A0
0x004c84a0.label: Directory scan and playlist builder
0x004c84a0.summary: Scans a directory for files matching a given extension (.wav/.mp3). For each file found, allocates a linked list node with file path data and appends it to this object's playlist list (head at *this, tail this[1], cursor this[2], count this[3]).

0x004c85d0.name: AudioMixerDeviceInit
0x004c85d0.label: Audio mixer device initialisation
0x004c85d0.summary: Initialises audio mixer device: creates AudioMixerPtr via InitStatus vtable dispatch (offset 96), sets initial volume from global flt_7CF380, and marks the sound device as active (this[16]=1) with no fade state (this[20]=0).

0x004c8630.name: VirtualDispatchStateReset
0x004c8630.label: Audio mixer state reset
0x004c8630.summary: Resets audio mixer state: calls vtable offset 12 on AudioMixerPtr to stop/clear audio, and clears the active flag at this[16] to 0 (deactivate sound device).

0x004c8650.name: SoundAudioPlayback
0x004c8650.label: Sound audio playback manager (fade/advance)
0x004c8650.summary: Manages audio playback each frame: handles volume fade-in (state 1) and fade-out (state 2+), advances to next track in the playlist linked list, or picks a new track from scene index when the list is exhausted. Communicates with AudioMixerPtr for actual playback control.

0x004c8830.name: sub_4C8830
0x004c8830.label: ConditionalSoundRenderFadeUpdate
0x004c8830.summary: Checks enable flag and audio mixer ptr; if conditions met, computes fade value from global flt_7CF380 divided by a2 (or direct if a2 <= 0). Part of audio/visual fade synchronization.

0x004c88a0.name: ConditionalRatioCompute
0x004c88a0.label: ConditionalAudioMixerRatioUpdate
0x004c88a0.summary: Same enable-flag guard pattern as fade update; computes ratio using audio mixer value as numerator divided by a2. Sets state flag to 2. Part of audio/visual synchronization system.

0x004c8920.name: sub_4C8920
0x004c8920.label: SoundSceneDSPConfigUpdate
0x004c8920.summary: Builds audio file path from directory base and "PitPitsoundsMp" suffix; configures scene manager with DSP wetness value (product of two global factors). Called from render tick to initialize/update audio scene.

0x004c8a20.name: Sound_Enter
0x004c8a20.label: SoundSystemEnter
0x004c8a20.summary: Sound system entry/init called from Game_Enter. Lazily initializes audio resources, dispatches global guard, queries scene graph nodes, and logs sound environment entry.

0x004c8ab0.name: Sound_Setup
0x004c8ab0.label: SoundSetupLog
0x004c8ab0.summary: Calls string split parser on default scene path with token count 683; conditionally logs "Entered sound setup" message. Called from Game_Setup.

0x004c8ae0.name: Sound_Init
0x004c8ae0.label: SoundInitLog
0x004c8ae0.summary: Logs "Entered sound init" conditionally after string parsing; unconditionally dispatches network message with scene camera parameter. Called from Game_Init.

0x004c8b20.name: Sound_Restart
0x004c8b20.label: SoundRestartStateReset
0x004c8b20.summary: Resets virtual dispatch state on sound context, zeros scene camera parameter global, and reinitializes sound buffer. Called from Game_Restart.

0x004c8b70.name: RenderTickUpdate
0x004c8b70.label: RenderTickUpdate
0x004c8b70.summary: Main render tick handler: performs guarded render calls, iterates vehicles for suspension computation, updates render state flag, and dispatches either global virtual dispatch or sound setup depending on state flags.

0x004c8ca0.name: Sound_Post
0x004c8ca0.label: SoundPostCleanup
0x004c8ca0.summary: Post-cleanup for sound system: resets init status, clears scene camera parameter, dispatches guarded virtual call, and validates/resets entries in sound pointer table. Called from Game_Post.

0x004c8d00.name: Sound_Exit
0x004c8d00.label: SoundExitCleanup
0x004c8d00.summary: Sound system exit: dispatches global vtable calls, resets virtual dispatch state on context, and performs cleanup computation. Called from GameExit.

0x004c8de0.name: SoundEffectLoadPlay
0x004c8de0.label: SoundEffectLoadPlay
0x004c8de0.summary: Loads and plays a sound effect by index (a1 < 8) with parameter a2. Lazily initializes singleton manager from InitStatus. Builds file path from base directory + sound name table entry.

0x004c8f10.name: ParticleEmitterInit
0x004c8f10.label: ParticleEmitterInit
0x004c8f10.summary: Initializes particle emitter struct: sets vtable pointer, zeroes state fields, configures duration (default 1.0), and computes randomized end offset from trig lookup table.

0x004c8f80.name: VTableDispatchWithNegation
0x004c8f80.label: VTableDispatchWithNegation
0x004c8f80.summary: Stores parameter handle, retrieves scene node position, negates Y coordinate, then dispatches vtable method at offset 4. Returns 1 if a2 is null.

0x004c8fc0.name: sub_4C8FC0
0x004c8fc0.label: TimedVTableDispatchDecrement
0x004c8fc0.summary: Decrements counter by global delta; when counter <= 0 and secondary condition passes, resets counter from initial value and dispatches vtable callback at offset 12. Timer/countdown pattern.

0x004c9000.name: ArithmeticComparison_9000
0x004c9000.label: SessionStateGuardCheck
0x004c9000.summary: Three-stage validation: checks this+4 field non-zero, session manager short computation non-zero, and sub_54C0E0 result non-zero. Returns 1 only if all pass; 0 otherwise.

0x004c9060.name: sub_4C9060
0x004c9060.label: SoundObjectDestructor
0x004c9060.summary: Destructor for sound object: switches vtable to destructor variant, calls triple vtable release, restores original vtable, optionally frees memory if a2 & 1.

0x004c91d0.name: TripleVTableDestructorRelease
0x004c91d0.label: TripleVTableDestructorRelease
0x004c91d0.summary: Releases three vtable-based objects stored at offsets 0x20, 0x24, 0x28 by calling their vtable[0] (Release) with final flag (1), then nulls each pointer.

0x004c9260.name: StateIndexedFieldGetter
0x004c9260.label: StateIndexedFieldGetter
0x004c9260.summary: Indexed field selector: reads selector at this+0x1C (0/1/2) and returns the corresponding value at this+0x20/0x24/0x28. Returns 0 for out-of-range index.

0x004c9280.name: EqualityStateCheck
0x004c9280.label: EqualityStateCheck
0x004c9280.summary: Compares a2 against state index (this+0x1C); if match, retrieves indexed field value and checks vtable+28 result != 2. Returns 1 only if all conditions pass.

0x004c9310.name: ResourceReleaseTripleDispatch
0x004c9310.label: ResourceReleaseTripleDispatch
0x004c9310.summary: Dispatches vtable+8 method on up to three sub-objects stored at offsets 0x20, 0x24, 0x28. Does NOT null or free pointers. Returns result from last successful dispatch.

0x004c9360.name: ObjectVTableSwitchDestructor
0x004c9360.label: ObjectVTableSwitchDestructor
0x004c9360.summary: Destructor for object with vtable switching: sets vtable to destructor variant (off_5ACE4C), calls destructor body (sub_4C94D0), restores original vtable (off_5ACE2C), optionally frees memory.

0x004c94d0.name: sub_4C94D0
0x004c94d0.label: ReleaseTripleSubObjects
0x004c94d0.summary: Releases up to three sub-objects (offsets 0x1C-0x24) by calling vtable[0] (Release) with final flag (1), then nulls each pointer. Destructor body called from ObjectVTableSwitchDestructor.

0x004c9600.name: VTableSwitchDtor
0x004c9600.label: VTableSwitchDtor
0x004c9600.summary: Destructor with vtable switching: sets to destructor vtable (off_5ACE5C), calls VtableDestructorNull body, restores original vtable (off_5ACE2C), optionally frees memory.

0x004c9790.name: VtableDestructorNull
0x004c9790.label: VtableDestructorNull
0x004c9790.summary: Releases single sub-object at this+0x20 by calling vtable[0] (Release) with final flag (1), then nulls the pointer. Minimal destructor body.

0x004c97b0.name: RendererSceneNodeUpdate
0x004c97b0.label: RendererSceneNodeUpdate
0x004c97b0.summary: Scene node render update: resets field at this+0x1C, then dispatches vtable+4 on sub-object (this+0x20) with DSP transform parameter. Gated by virtual state check and race phase.

0x004c9840.name: AmbientSoundPlayback
0x004c9840.label: AmbientSoundLoadAndPlay
0x004c9840.summary: Loads an ambient sound file ("pithorn.wav" from "ambient" subdirectory) and initializes playback with volume, pan, and fade settings. Called once to start ambient audio.

0x004c9960.name: ShortComputation_9960
0x004c9960.label: StopAndReleaseOwnedObject
0x004c9960.summary: Calls the "stop" method (vtable[0] with arg=1) on an owned object at this+0x1C, then clears the handle to 0. Object cleanup/release helper.

0x004c9980.name: RenderObjectAtPosition
0x004c9980.label: RenderObjectSetTransform
0x004c9980.summary: Sets the world transform/position on a render object by calling its vtable method (offset 4) with position data from this+0x8 and a DSP transform parameter.

0x004c99d0.name: RenderObjectUpdateDispatch
0x004c99d0.label: RenderDeviceStatePollAndTrigger
0x004c99d0.summary: Polls render device state via method call (vtable offset 36) on the InitStatus object. If status flags indicate a pending update, triggers render operation (vtable offset 40) with parameters (1, 1.0f, ~0.33f).

0x004c9a50.name: MemoryAllocation_9a50
0x004c9a50.label: ParticleEmitterFactoryByType
0x004c9a50.summary: Factory that allocates and initializes particle emitter objects of different types (1,2,5,6,7), each with distinct allocation size, lifetime parameter, and vtable pointer. Called from network message dispatch.

0x004c9ba0.name: SortComparatorSpeedSum
0x004c9ba0.label: SortComparatorSpeedSum
0x004c9ba0.summary: qsort/qsort-style comparator function. Sums two float speed fields (offsets 0x738 and 0x740) from each object and returns -1/0/1 for sorting by total speed.

0x004c9c00.name: SortDriversByDistance
0x004c9c00.label: SortVehiclesBySpeedSum
0x004c9c00.summary: Copies vehicle pointers from global array (with offset +0xC), sorts them by combined speed sum using SortComparatorSpeedSum, and writes the speed sums into a results buffer at this+103. Used by weather particle system to prioritize effects.

0x004c9d10.name: TwoFieldSetter_9d10
0x004c9d10.label: SpecialFxFieldInit
0x004c9d10.summary: Initializes two fields of a special FX object: offset 0x20 set to -1.0f (sentinel/inactive) and offset 0x24 set to 0. Called during SpecialFX_Init.

0x004c9d30.name: RecursiveTreeFree
0x004c9d30.label: RecursiveTreeFree
0x004c9d30.summary: Recursively frees a tree of nodes by following the child pointer at this+0x24. Each node is freed with FreeWrapper_7bcf after its subtree is freed. Called during SpecialFX_Init cleanup.

0x004c9d50.name: SentinelFieldInit
0x004c9d50.label: SentinelFieldInit
0x004c9d50.summary: Initializes three fields (at offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x44) to -1 (0xFFFFFFFF) sentinel value, indicating invalid/empty state. Called from sub_4CB120.

0x004c9d60.name: ParticlePositionSetup
0x004c9d60.label: ParticlePositionInitNoise
0x004c9d60.summary: Initializes a particle's position, direction, color, and attributes using noise-perturbed values from the weather noise table. Computes position from input parameters a2-a5 with noise scaling, normalizes direction vector, packs ARGB color, and generates random index.

0x004c9fb0.name: ParticleCollisionSpawn
0x004c9fb0.label: ParticleCollisionSpawnHandler
0x004c9fb0.summary: Handles particle collision events by spawning secondary particles — computes bounding-box center and half-extent at the collision point, randomizes spread direction/magnitude using a weather noise table, filters nearby packed-array elements, and allocates a collision result buffer with distance-squared data.

0x004ca2d0.name: ParticleEmitterChildUpdateWithRotationAndScaling
0x004ca2d0.label: ParticleChildRotateAndScale
0x004ca2d0.summary: Updates child particle positions by applying a 2D rotation (sin/cos from time-varying angle) and scaling to offset components. Loops over children, writing transformed X/Z positions. Clears a visibility flag on the linked list display object afterward.

0x004ca410.name: sub_4CA410
0x004ca410.label: SpecialFXFreeChild
0x004ca410.summary: Frees a dynamically-allocated child object stored at this+0x50 if non-null. Called during SpecialFX_Post cleanup phase.

0x004ca480.name: MaterialShaderReactionEffectParser
0x004ca480.label: ReactionEffectConfigParser
0x004ca480.summary: Parses a reaction effect configuration block from a data stream, determining the effect type (dust, smoke, flames, skid, spray, etc.) and associated material shader properties including texture paths, vertex/pixel shader flags, blend modes, chromakey, and particle settings. Builds a renderer sub-object with all parsed parameters.

0x004cada0.name: sub_4CADA0
0x004cada0.label: BlendModeStringToEnum
0x004cada0.summary: Converts a blend mode string to a D3DBLEND enum value (1=ZERO, 2=ONE, 3=SRCCOLOR, etc.). Logs unknown blend mode warning via DebugLogWrite if unmatched. Called from material/reaction effect parser.

0x004caed0.name: sub_4CAED0
0x004caed0.label: SpecialFXEqualityMergeCheck
0x004caed0.summary: Compares two special FX objects for structural equality across all float fields, IDs, and sub-object material properties (including texture name strings). If equal and incoming object has a larger "priority/version" field at this+0x58, updates the field. Used for deduplication during SpecialFX_Init.

0x004cb120.name: sub_4CB120
0x004cb120.label: Reaction Particle System Initialization
0x004cb120.summary: Initializes a reaction/particle-effects system: sets up collision restitution and physics constants from globals, handles render-throttle frame count, allocates particle arrays with sentinel init and position setup, and for type-13 (weather) generates noise tables and random particle direction vectors. Called during special effects initialization.

0x004cb4f0.name: MultiFieldFree
0x004cb4f0.label: SpecialFXMultiFieldCleanup
0x004cb4f0.summary: Frees two heap-allocated buffers (at this+0x5C and this+0x68), removes a doubly-linked list node (at this+0x54), and clears intermediate fields (0x58, 0x64). Called during SpecialFX_Post cleanup.

0x004cb540.name: CircularBufferSlotAlloc
0x004cb540.label: ParticleSlotAllocator
0x004cb540.summary: Allocate next free slot from a circular particle buffer. Increments write index, wraps at capacity, returns pointer to slot. If slot is free (refcount < 0), bookkeeps it.

0x004cb5a0.name: ArrayElementRemoval
0x004cb5a0.label: ArraySwapRemoveByIndex
0x004cb5a0.summary: Removes an element from a flat pointer array by swapping with the last element (swap-remove pattern). Decrements count, copies last element into the removed slot, updates the moved element's index, and marks removed element as invalid (-1).

0x004cb5e0.name: sub_4CB5E0
0x004cb5e0.label: ArrayClearAll
0x004cb5e0.summary: Clears all elements from a flat pointer array by popping the last element in a loop, marking each as invalid (-1), and releasing its resource handle via sub_558B30. Decrements count to 0.

0x004cb620.name: ParticleCollisionSpark
0x004cb620.label: CollisionSparkParticleSpawn
0x004cb620.summary: Spawn a spark particle at a collision contact point. Allocates slot, sets position, velocity, size from collision data, computes spark color/intensity, flags texture layer. Called by collision dispatch when surface generates sparks.

0x004cb860.name: WheelRenderObjectPerFrameUpdate
0x004cb860.label: WheelRenderObjectLifetimeAndVisibilityUpdater
0x004cb860.summary: Updates per-frame wheel render object positions, removes expired objects, checks ray-sphere intersections with player/AI vehicles for visibility, and applies texture/color flags. Part of the wheel render object management system.

0x004cbc50.name: ParticleTrailEmitter
0x004cbc50.label: CollisionTrailParticleSpawn
0x004cbc50.summary: Spawn a trail particle at a collision point. Allocates slot, sets position/velocity from collision data, applies noise, computes normal. Optionally adjusts Y position when a7 flag is set (surface offset mode).

0x004cbdd0.name: RaySphereIntersection
0x004cbdd0.label: RaySphereIntersectionSliding
0x004cbdd0.summary: Performs a 3D ray-sphere intersection test with sliding collision response. Adjusts sphere position by restitution coefficient, checks distance threshold, and if intersection found, slides the ray origin (a1) to the contact point. Used by wheel and particle collision systems.

0x004cbf50.name: F_3DAABBOverlapTestWithSlidingResponse
0x004cbf50.label: OBBOverlapSlidingResponse
0x004cbf50.summary: Tests line segment (a1→a2) against an oriented bounding box (a3) for overlap. Transforms both endpoints into the box's local coordinate frame using its orientation matrix, checks AABB interval overlap on all three axes, and slides the target point (a2) to the box surface on collision. Used by particle physics collision.

0x004cc1d0.name: ParticleInstanceUpdate
0x004cc1d0.label: ParticleInstanceUpdate
0x004cc1d0.summary: Core particle instance update function: iterates all active particles, checks lifetime (removes expired ones via swap-remove), interpolates position from velocity, handles vehicle collision detection (ray-sphere), updates texture layer position, computes alpha fade (early-life boost, mid-life sustain, late-life fade), and writes ARGB color. Flags check for scoring gate mode.

0x004cc500.name: ParticleEffectBillboardQuadSetup
0x004cc500.label: BillboardQuadVertexWriter
0x004cc500.summary: Compute and write 4 billboard quad vertices for a particle sprite. Computes perpendicular vectors relative to camera direction, scales by particle size, writes each vertex position to texture buffer via PixelWriteToTextureBuffer.

0x004cc700.name: F_3DBoundingBoxRender
0x004cc700.label: Render 3D bounding box corners
0x004cc700.summary: Computes 4 corner points of a 3D bounding box centered at a1[11..13] with offset vectors a2/a3 and writes each corner as a pixel to texture buffer via PixelWriteToTextureBuffer. Debug/visualization rendering helper.

0x004cc840.name: sub_4CC840
0x004cc840.label: ParticleMatrixRotationUpdate
0x004cc840.summary: Updates rotation matrix axes for each particle entry in a strided array (10 floats per entry). Computes cross product of scaled direction vectors and normalizes them using magnitude from this[4]. Called to prepare particle orientation before rendering.

0x004cc970.name: sub_4CC970
0x004cc970.label: ParticleSpawnAndPositionInit
0x004cc970.summary: Spawns and initializes particle positions with wind noise. Adds noise to input position, allocates circular buffer slots, offsets particle positions by noise table values, and renders bounding boxes for each spawned particle.

0x004ccb30.name: ParticleEffectPhysics
0x004ccb30.label: ParticleEffectPhysicsUpdate
0x004ccb30.summary: Updates particle physics each frame — removes particles outside lifetime window, applies acceleration to velocity, runs AABB collision detection with sliding response against player vehicle or nearby drivers, and renders bounding boxes for remaining particles.

0x004ccdc0.name: ParticlePositionAdd
0x004ccdc0.label: ParticlePositionAddWithWind
0x004ccdc0.summary: Computes wind direction from (a3-a2) vector, adds noise from weather noise table, then applies the resulting offset to each particle's position in the array. Finally calls ParticleEffectPhysics for physics update.

0x004cce90.name: ParticleSpawnFunction
0x004cce90.label: ParticleGroupSpawner
0x004cce90.summary: Spawn multiple particles in a burst. Reads particle count from parameter (shifted by emitter detail level), allocates slots, applies random noise to position and velocity from weather noise table, computes collision normal, sets up billboard quad for each particle.

0x004cd220.name: ParticleSystemUpdateWithWindAndDamping
0x004cd220.label: ParticleSystemFullUpdate
0x004cd220.summary: Full particle system update — removes expired particles, integrates velocity with damping and gravity, clamps position to ground with normal reflection/damping, detects AABB collisions with sliding response against player or nearby vehicles, and renders billboard quads for each active particle.

0x004cd6c0.name: WheelContactParticle
0x004cd6c0.label: WheelContactParticleSpawn
0x004cd6c0.summary: Spawn a wheel contact particle (tire spray / smoke / dust). Allocates slot, sets particle lifetime and alpha based on surface type. Writes 4 quad vertices to texture buffer. Surface type 8 gets wet/smoke-specific color and alpha blending.

0x004cd8d0.name: sub_4CD8D0
0x004cd8d0.label: ParticleColorFadeRenderer
0x004cd8d0.summary: Renders particles with computed color fade based on input parameter a2. When a2 > 0, computes a color value and writes pixel attributes to texture for each particle. When a2 == 0, falls back to sub_4CB5E0. Optionally triggers AI waypoint path checker rendering when particles are absent.

0x004cd980.name: TelemetryBarIndicatorRenderer
0x004cd980.label: TelemetryBarIndicatorRender
0x004cd980.summary: Renders bar indicator particles with dual fade values computed from lifetime progress. Checks particle lifetime window and writes pixel attributes if within range; removes particles outside the window via ArrayElementRemoval.

0x004cdad0.name: ScoringGateTimeoutCheck
0x004cdad0.label: ScoringGateTimeoutCheck
0x004cdad0.summary: Removes particles that timeout (current time before their birth time) when scoring system is active (dword_8AB6E4 == 2). Delegates to scoring system then iterates particle array removing entries whose birth time exceeds current time.

0x004cdb20.name: sub_4CDB20
0x004cdb20.label: ObjectTypeDispatchUpdate
0x004cdb20.summary: Dispatches per-frame update to a type-specific handler based on object type ID at this+4. Routes to particle instance update, wheel render update, scoring timeout check, telemetry bar render, particle system physics, or full wind/damping update depending on type value.

0x004cdbf0.name: StringTableLookup
0x004cdbf0.label: StringTableLookup
0x004cdbf0.summary: Searches a key=value formatted INI-style string table for a matching key string. Copies base path, then iterates through lines parsed by sub_5897CA, comparing each key against the target using sub_587C20.

0x004cdc70.name: sub_4CDC70
0x004cdc70.label: TrackSurfaceTokenToFloat
0x004cdc70.summary: Parses a track surface material token string and converts to a float value. If the token is numeric (digit or '.'), parses directly as float. Otherwise, searches a linked list of named entries for a matching string and returns its associated float value. Logs a debug message on lookup failure.

0x004cdd80.name: TrackSurfaceMaterialLoader
0x004cdd80.label: TrackSurfaceMaterialParser
0x004cdd80.summary: Parses track surface material properties (friction, wet modifier, bump amplitude/wavelength, spring, damper, collision friction, sound type IDs, scraping flag, sink depth, materials string) from config entries and populates a surface material definition struct. Part of the track special-effects / physics surface system.

0x004ce110.name: WheelSurfaceContactFriction
0x004ce110.label: WheelContactFrictionParticle
0x004ce110.summary: Compute wheel contact friction and spawn surface particles. Compares velocity difference against threshold, computes perpendicular friction vectors, iterates contact surface types (6=grass/dirt, 7=?, 8=wet) to determine particle color and size, then spawns WheelContactParticle.

0x004ce380.name: FloatComparisonWithConstantsTable
0x004ce380.label: ParticleTypeFloatCheck
0x004ce380.summary: Check if a non-zero float value exists for a given particle type entry in a constant table. Iterates entries; type 1 reads field at offset 0x28 (a2[10]), type 5 reads field at offset 0x30 (a2[12]), default reads offset 0x2C (a2[11]). Returns 1 if the field is non-zero.

0x004ce3e0.name: CollisionEffectDispatch
0x004ce3e0.label: CollisionEffectParticleDispatch
0x004ce3e0.summary: Dispatch collision effects (spark and trail particles) based on collision type. Iterates collision effect slots: type 1 spawns collision spark particles, type 2 spawns trail particles with throttle gating (every 20 ticks), type 0 spawns trail particles from velocity field. Incorporates weather flags for render throttling.

0x004ce860.name: StringListLookup
0x004ce860.label: StringListLookup
0x004ce860.summary: Searches a strided string table array (108 bytes per entry) for a given normalized string. Calls StringTableLookup for each entry and returns the matching entry's index, or -1 if not found.

0x004ce8f0.name: sub_4CE8F0
0x004ce8f0.label: VectorFieldNonZeroCheck
0x004ce8f0.summary: Returns TRUE if any of three float fields (at offsets 0x00, 0x14, 0x28) in the input struct are non-zero. Simple presence check for velocity/magnitude channels.

0x004ce930.name: ParticleCollisionEffect
0x004ce930.label: ParticleCollisionEffectEmitter
0x004ce930.summary: Spawn trail particles from three collision effect slots (index 8, 9, 10) when the collision point has moved sufficiently. Each slot tracks previous position; on significant movement (>0.15 or >0.06 distance), spawns a trail particle with noise and velocity scaling. Third slot also spawns a secondary offset trail at higher throttle.

0x004cee90.name: SpecialFX_Enter
0x004cee90.label: SpecialFX_Enter
0x004cee90.summary: Debug trace function called when entering the special effects system. Logs "entered special" message via conditional debug write.

0x004ceec0.name: SpecialFX_Setup
0x004ceec0.label: SpecialFX_Setup
0x004ceec0.summary: Debug trace function called when setting up the special effects system. Logs "entered special" setup message via conditional debug write.

0x004ceef0.name: sub_4CEEF0
0x004ceef0.label: BuildTerrainIniPath
0x004ceef0.summary: Constructs the file path to terrain.ini by formatting season and track directory paths into a string buffer. Falls back to default application directory if either directory global is null.

0x004cefa0.name: sub_4CEFA0
0x004cefa0.label: ArraySearchAndWheelContactParticle
0x004cefa0.summary: Searches a strided array (108 bytes per entry) for an element whose slot at +4 matches a3. On match, calls WheelContactParticle to spawn a contact particle effect at that entry's position. Returns the entry index or array count if not found.

0x004cefe0.name: StridedArraySearchAndCall
0x004cefe0.label: StridedArraySearchAndCall
0x004cefe0.summary: Searches a strided array (108 bytes per entry) for an element whose second DWORD (offset +4) matches a2, then calls sub_4CD8D0 (ParticleColorFadeRenderer) on the matched entry. Returns entry index or array count if not found.

0x004cf040.name: RepeatedCallLoop_f040
0x004cf040.label: RepeatedArrayProcessLoop
0x004cf040.summary: Iterates through a strided array (108 bytes per entry) and calls sub_4CB5E0 on each element in sequence. Processes all entries when array count is positive.

0x004cf070.name: SpecialFX_Init
0x004cf070.label: Special effects system initialization and config parser
0x004cf070.summary: Initializes the special effects (particle collision, material reaction, track surface) subsystem: parses track `.mas` config files, loads feedback/reaction effect definitions, sets up per-track material effect arrays, allocates particle collision structures, and configures spatial grid queries for effect placement. Part of the special effects / physics reaction system.

0x004cfc90.name: SpecialFX_Restart
0x004cfc90.label: SpecialFX_Restart
0x004cfc90.summary: Debug trace function called when restarting the special effects system. Logs "entered special" message via conditional debug write.

0x004cfcc0.name: WeatherParticleUpdate
0x004cfcc0.label: WeatherParticleUpdate
0x004cfcc0.summary: Main weather particle system update — sorts drivers by distance, spawns weather particles with wind noise, updates all particle subsystems via type dispatch, and updates emitter children with rotation/scaling based on camera direction and visibility distance.

0x004cfed0.name: SpecialFX_Post
0x004cfed0.label: SpecialFX_Post
0x004cfed0.summary: Tears down special effects system — frees all allocated particle/emitter arrays with type-specific cleanup, cleans collision tree nodes, zeroes all struct fields. Called when leaving the game session.

0x004cfff0.name: SpecialFX_Exit
0x004cfff0.label: SpecialFX_Exit
0x004cfff0.summary: Debug trace function called when exiting the special effects system. Logs "entered special" message via conditional debug write.

0x004d0080.name: sub_4D0080
0x004d0080.label: SoundSourceArrayDestructor
0x004d0080.summary: Destructor for an array of 3D sound sources (132-byte stride). Iterates through array calling F_3DSoundSourceDestructor on each, then cleans up internal fields via sub_4A2220, frees the allocation, and zeroes both count and pointer fields.

0x004d0110.name: sub_4D0110
0x004d0110.label: Grid girl / track-side model placement and animation initializer
0x004d0110.summary: Allocates and initializes per-vehicle track-side decoration structures (grid girls, sign models): assigns random models/textures, positions them using weather noise tables and spatial grid queries, loads meshes and animations, and sets up rendering resources. Part of the track decoration / scene dressing system.

0x004d0b00.name: F_3FieldInitCall_0b00
0x004d0b00.label: ThreeFieldZeroInit
0x004d0b00.summary: Zeros three specific fields at offsets 0x64, 0x6C, and 0x74, then calls sub_4A2220 to perform full zero-initialization of the remaining struct. Returns the struct pointer.

0x004d0b20.name: F_3DDistanceCheckAccumulate
0x004d0b20.label: 3D distance check and accumulate
0x004d0b20.summary: Iterates a list of objects, computes squared 3D distance from a reference position (obtained via SessionManager virtual dispatch), and accumulates parameter `a2` into objects within 32-unit radius. Calls sub_4A2840 on each updated element.

0x004d0c20.name: DriverStandingComparator
0x004d0c20.label: Driver standing comparator
0x004d0c20.summary: qsort-style comparator for two drivers by race standing. Status=3 (retired) drivers sort after active drivers; then compares integer rank at vehicle offset 44, float time/gap at offset 104, then pointer address as tiebreaker.

0x004d0cf0.name: DriverSortComparator
0x004d0cf0.label: Driver race position comparator
0x004d0cf0.summary: qsort-style comparator for two drivers by race position. Status 3 (retired) sorts after active drivers; status 1 (racing) compares lap time at offset 132; other statuses compare secondary rank at offset 12 and time at offset 16. Tiebreaker at offset 44, then pointer address.

0x004d0e20.name: StewardLightGlowNodeFinder
0x004d0e20.label: Find scene glow and line nodes
0x004d0e20.summary: Evaluates scene node properties for two node identifiers (a2, a3), storing resulting handles at this+0x4 (line node) and this+0x8 (glow node). Logs "could not find" errors if either property evaluates to zero.

0x004d0ec0.name: ArithmeticComparison_0ec0
0x004d0ec0.label: Value setter with conditional dispatch
0x004d0ec0.summary: Stores value `a2` at this+0x0, then conditionally calls sub_5506A0(a2, 0, 0) if the flag at this+0x4 or this+0x8 is non-zero. Acts as a setter with notification gate.

0x004d1030.name: LoopOverTwoParallelArrays
0x004d1030.label: Parallel vehicle arrays update loop
0x004d1030.summary: Iterates two per-vehicle data arrays in parallel: first computes DistanceComparison results and resets sentinels in AI/path data (stride 4656), then processes RenderCallWithGuard and AIVehiclePathPositionTracking on main vehicle array (stride 18624). Calls sub_4D1670 at end.

0x004d10e0.name: SingleFunctionDispatch_10e0
0x004d10e0.label: SingleGridPositionDataRead
0x004d10e0.summary: Read a single grid position data element from the setup scene. Index is (this[0x4058] - 1), corresponding to the vehicle's allocated grid slot. Calls sub_403CD0 to copy position data to output arrays.

0x004d1100.name: ConditionalDelegateDispatch
0x004d1100.label: GridPositionConditionalCopy
0x004d1100.summary: If grid position index (this[0x48A4]) is unset (< 0), recalculate via sub_4C6F10. Then copy grid position data from setup scene via ArrayOfStructIndexedFieldCopy.

0x004d1140.name: RenderCallWithGuard
0x004d1140.label: RenderIndexedStructDataWithGuard
0x004d1140.summary: If grid position index (this[0x48A4]) is unset (< 0), recalculate via sub_4C6F10. Then read indexed struct data from setup scene using grid position index and column index via IndexedStructDataRead.

0x004d1180.name: sub_4D1180
0x004d1180.label: RenderDispatchWithSessionGuard
0x004d1180.summary: Dispatch either SingleFunctionDispatch_10e0 or RenderCallWithGuard based on session type and phase. If session type == 7 (race) and phase is 2, 3, or 4 (racing), uses SingleFunctionDispatch_10e0 and returns 1. Otherwise uses RenderCallWithGuard and returns 0.

0x004d11d0.name: sub_4D11D0
0x004d11d0.label: Format and render timer string
0x004d11d0.summary: Formats a float time value (seconds) into MM:SS string with optional path prefix, renders the text via ShortComputation_bde0 and TextLineWrappingAndRendering. Called by PitTimer for on-screen time display.

0x004d12c0.name: PitStopOrderLoader
0x004d12c0.label: PitStopOrderDataLoader
0x004d12c0.summary: Load and parse pit stop order data for teams. Queries team list from string-keyed linked list, allocates array for team entries, checks if reverse pit order is enabled. If reverse, iterates teams in reverse order; otherwise forward.

0x004d1410.name: IndexedArrayAccessor
0x004d1410.label: PitStopOrderIndexedAccessor
0x004d1410.summary: Indexed accessor into a pit stop order array. If the array pointer (this[107]) is null, lazily loads pit stop order data via PitStopOrderLoader, then returns pointer at 8-byte stride for given index.

0x004d1450.name: sub_4D1450
0x004d1450.label: Load logo textures for 52 slots
0x004d1450.summary: Loads team/driver logo textures for up to 52 slots. Constructs base path from season and track directories, iterates indexed strings to build BMP filenames (Logo*.bmp, PBOX*.bmp), and loads textures via TextureAdjuster.

0x004d15f0.name: sub_4D15F0
0x004d15f0.label: Init pit door and tent scene nodes
0x004d15f0.summary: Loads logo textures (sub_4D1450), then if collision geometry is present, evaluates scene node properties for 52 pit door (PDOOR%02d) and pit tent (PTENT%02d) objects, storing handles in this array at offsets 0x1B0 and 0x280.

0x004d1670.name: sub_4D1670
0x004d1670.label: VehicleOccupiedFlagBuilder
0x004d1670.summary: Builds a 52-element occupancy bitmask from all vehicles by reading each vehicle's type field at offset 18596, then iterates 52 paired flag fields on `this`, calling FlagFieldBitManipulation to set/clear bit flags depending on occupancy.

0x004d1730.name: sub_4D1730
0x004d1730.label: Pit proximity detection and notification
0x004d1730.summary: Detects vehicles near pit area using per-vehicle distance/speed threshold, updates state array, notifies PitSelectionStateMachine on transitions, and logs encoded progress bar events to ring buffer.

0x004d1a50.name: ParseMidiBitstream
0x004d1a50.label: Parse packed parameter update stream
0x004d1a50.summary: Decodes a packed bitstream: if header DWORD indicates reset command (bits 22-17 = 0x28), clears all state entries to 0; then processes (index, value) pairs from packed WORDS following header, updating state array via ShortComputation_0f00.

0x004d1ad0.name: ScoringGateSelector
0x004d1ad0.label: PenaltyGatePrioritySelector
0x004d1ad0.summary: Scans a scoring/penalty gate list at this[68] with given range, selecting the highest-priority gate type (3 > 8 > 2 > 0). Returns 3 for invalid/out-of-range, or the best match.

0x004d1bc0.name: PitStopOrderRank
0x004d1bc0.label: Compute driver race rank
0x004d1bc0.summary: Computes a driver's race position by counting how many other drivers rank ahead according to DriverStandingComparator. For session type 7, returns direct position value from VEH array instead.

0x004d1c40.name: sub_4D1C40
0x004d1c40.label: Slot best-time keeper with position change notification
0x004d1c40.summary: Tracks which driver holds the best lap time in a given slot. When a new driver posts a better or equal time, notifies AIOvertakeDefendStateChange of the position change and updates the slot owner.

0x004d1cf0.name: RingBufferAccessWithWrap
0x004d1cf0.label: FloatIndexedRingBufferAccessor
0x004d1cf0.summary: Converts a float index to an integer ring-buffer index by truncating `a2 * this[264] - 1`, wraps using modulo this[268] (buffer size), clamps to [0, size-1], and reads a 8-byte element from the buffer at this[272].

0x004d1d80.name: sub_4D1D80
