0x004d1d80.label: Scoring and position tracking update
0x004d1d80.summary: Periodic scoring update (0.25s interval) that computes per-vehicle position deltas, detects active/inactive transitions, sorts drivers by standing, logs order changes and data to progress bar ring buffer, and calls pit proximity detection (sub_4D1730).

0x004d2170.name: sub_4D2170
0x004d2170.label: Delayed vehicle condition check
0x004d2170.summary: Returns 1 if at least 30 seconds have elapsed since last trigger time (this+0xB4) and all vehicles pass sub_4BC9B0 check; otherwise returns 0. Used as a readiness/confirmation gate.

0x004d2260.name: ProgressBarDataStore
0x004d2260.label: Store two values to progress bar ring buffer
0x004d2260.summary: Encodes a progress bar event (type 21, subtype 8) with two custom data values (a1, a2) plus current session time to the ring buffer. Used for logging paired integer data to the replay/progress system.

0x004d22c0.name: FieldSetterWithInit
0x004d22c0.label: Field setter with init and dispatch
0x004d22c0.summary: Initializes struct fields: zeroes byte flag at 0xC1, stores current session time at 0xB0, copies value from source at 0xB4, then dispatches via sub_42D140 using session type and source data.

0x004d23d0.name: PitTimerStateInit
0x004d23d0.label: Pit timer state initialization
0x004d23d0.summary: Initializes pit timer struct from source: copies timestamp and computed offset value, zeroes two flag bytes, dispatches registration (sub_42D140), and broadcasts the timestamp to all vehicles via sub_4BC2D0.

0x004d24d0.name: sub_4D24D0
0x004d24d0.label: Race results file writer
0x004d24d0.summary: Generates and writes a comprehensive race-results text file to disk — creates the output directory, builds a timestamped filename, then writes header metadata (game info, session params), per-driver results (qualifying/race times, positions, lap times, status), and optional multiplayer drive-aids settings. Part of the post-race/steward results system.

0x004d2dd0.name: sub_4D2DD0
0x004d2dd0.label: Lazy allocation of 8-byte sub-structure
0x004d2dd0.summary: Lazily allocates an 8-byte zero-initialized structure on first call, stores pointer at this+0xA4, and passes it to sub_4D0110 init. Returns existing pointer on subsequent calls (singleton pattern).

0x004d2e50.name: PitTimer
0x004d2e50.label: PitStopTimerStateMachine
0x004d2e50.summary: Tick-driven pit stop timer state machine that handles countdown display, pit lane open/close transitions, time-remaining messages, and session phase advancement. Part of the race UI / session management system.

0x004d36d0.name: Steward_Setup
0x004d36d0.label: Steward subsystem setup and registration
0x004d36d0.summary: Registers Steward subsystems: Vehicle (via sub_5599D0), Timing and Pitstop (via sub_559A00) with TimerFrameRateThrottle and TrackTemperatureDisplay as handler callbacks. Logs debug entry message.

0x004d3740.name: TimerFrameRateThrottle
0x004d3740.label: Timing event dispatch with flag-based indexing
0x004d3740.summary: Dispatches LapSplitTimeEvent and AICommandMessageQueueDispatcher for the vehicle identified by flag property index 2048. Clears buffer entry at this+0x14.

0x004d37b0.name: TrackTemperatureDisplay
0x004d37b0.label: Session state handler with telemetry logging
0x004d37b0.summary: Handles session state transitions for current vehicle: dispatches AI commands (command 5 for active state, command 4 for pit/transition state), updates vehicle telemetry substate, and periodically (every 3s) logs progress bar telemetry events for the player vehicle.

0x004d38f0.name: Steward_Init
0x004d38f0.label: StewardTrackInit
0x004d38f0.summary: Initializes the steward system for a track: locates light/glow scene nodes, computes steering waypoints from track reference speed, discovers pit-in/pit-out/finish/sector polygon nodes, places multiplayer vehicles, and optionally spawns a helicopter object. Called during game initialization.

0x004d3cf0.name: Steward_Restart
0x004d3cf0.label: Steward_Restart
0x004d3cf0.summary: Initializes/resets the race steward/session state machine at game restart, setting session-specific parameters (laps, time limits, speed scaling, display labels) based on the session type (practice/qualifying/race/pre-race presentation). Reads configuration overrides from vehicle/track data files and resets internal arrays and state flags. Part of the race session management system.

0x004d4580.name: sub_4D4580
0x004d4580.label: Main race system dispatch and state machine
0x004d4580.summary: Main dispatch for race subsystem: runs 3D distance checks, audio DSP update, pit timer; handles race phase state machine (session type 7) with collision proxy, progress bar logging, and delegated scoring.

0x004d4600.name: Steward_Post
0x004d4600.label: Steward post-race cleanup and teardown
0x004d4600.summary: Post-race cleanup: frees D3D audio state at 0xA8, resets comparison and camera director, frees state arrays at 0x110 and 0x114, frees counted array at 0x1AC, zeros 52 pairs of entries at 0x1B0/0x280, resets all vehicle substates.

0x004d4840.name: ObjectInit_4840
0x004d4840.label: Object constructor with vtable init
0x004d4840.summary: C++ object constructor: sets vtable pointer at this+0x0 to off_5ACF08 and zero-initializes three DWORD fields at offsets 0x4, 0x8, 0xC.

0x004d4860.name: sub_4D4860
0x004d4860.label: RefCountedContainerRelease
0x004d4860.summary: Decrements reference count on a container object; when count reaches zero, calls destructor callback on inner pointer and frees associated resource via FreeWrapper. Part of ref-counted COM-like object system.

0x004d4a58.name: StructFieldInitializer_4a58
0x004d4a58.label: StructFieldInit_4
0x004d4a58.summary: Initializes two fields at offsets 4 and 8 of a struct to literal values 4 and 0. Constructor helper for a small struct.

0x004d4a80.name: TelemetryDataDump
0x004d4a80.label: Telemetry Session Initialization & Header Write
0x004d4a80.summary: Initializes a telemetry output session — destroys previous telemetry state, checks scoring gate, finds active player vehicle, opens output file, computes sampling rate (1-40 Hz), writes CSV-style header with all telemetry channel names, embeds XML scene config, and writes integrity checksums (CRC, vehicle hash, scene hash, session seed) into the file.

0x004d5840.name: ResourceDestroy
0x004d5840.label: FileResourceHandleDestroy
0x004d5840.summary: If *this (a file handle) is non-zero, performs cleanup: writes 8 zero bytes to state, reads 4 bytes back, closes the file handle, and sets *this to 0. File handle destroy/close sequence.

0x004d5885.name: ExternalProcessLauncher
0x004d5885.label: ExternalProcessLauncher
0x004d5885.summary: Launches an external process via CreateProcessA. Builds command line as `"<exe_path>" <args>`, using dword_7CEA18 as override exe path or default byte_5EA438 directory. Part of process-launch utility layer.

0x004d5900.name: EncodedDataWriterWithXOR
0x004d5900.label: XOREncodedDataWriter
0x004d5900.summary: Writes encoded data to a byte stream: maps a type selector (0→3, 1→1, 2→2, else→0xFF), writes as 1-byte tag, then XORs a payload value with key at this+0x8 and writes 4 bytes. Used by LapSplitTimeEvent for encoding split event data.

0x004d5960.name: DebugLogInit
0x004d5960.label: DebugLogOutputInitializer
0x004d5960.summary: Initializes the debug logging subsystem. Writes a null byte via sub_4D5BE0, conditionally sets global debug mode constants based on dword_5C753C(), processes a double constant via sub_447F30, stores a float result in this[2], then writes 228 bytes of data via sub_4D5BE0.

0x004d59b0.name: sub_4D59B0
0x004d59b0.label: TelemetryOptionFlagsPacker
0x004d59b0.summary: Packs 11 option/settings flags into a bitfield (2 bits each) plus multiplayer option flag, tire model mode, player vehicle mode flag, and input mode flag. Writes the packed bitfield and several physics globals (rain fade, track grip, temperature offsets, brake balance) through sub_4D5BE0 debug data writer.

0x004d5af0.name: FileReadWithXORDecode
0x004d5af0.label: FileReadXORDecodeTripleKey
0x004d5af0.summary: Opens a binary file, counts its size, writes 4-byte size header to output stream, then reads file contents decoding each byte with a 3-key cycling XOR scheme (keys 0x5C, 0xB4, 0x12). Used by TelemetryDataDump to load XOR-encoded telemetry data.

0x004d5be0.name: sub_4D5BE0
0x004d5be0.label: FeedbackShiftRegisterDataProcessor
0x004d5be0.summary: Processes each byte of input buffer through a 4-word feedback shift register (FSR) state machine using multiplication and addition, updating state fields at this[3..6]. After processing all bytes, calls FileReadWrapperWithLock to write processed data to the file descriptor at *this.

0x004d5c70.name: QuaternionTransformComputation
0x004d5c70.label: QuaternionCubicInterpolationTransform
0x004d5c70.summary: Computes a quaternion/rotation transform using cubic interpolation parameterized by a2 (negated if positive), a3 (clamped [0,1]), and a4. Builds four 4x4 transform matrices from these parameters, calls sub_5677B0 to combine them, then stores result as 8 doubles in `this`. On failure, zeros the output and sets the last element to identity (1.0).

0x004d5ea0.name: DivisionWithThreshold
0x004d5ea0.label: SafeDivisorWithThreshold
0x004d5ea0.summary: Performs a guarded division: if divisor a3 <= 0, uses FLT_MAX (3.4028235e38) instead. Stores the (possibly clamped) divisor in this[1], and the result of (a2 - 1.0) / divisor in this[0].

0x004d5ee0.name: TireLoadFactorSetter
0x004d5ee0.label: TireLoadFactorComputer
0x004d5ee0.summary: Computes tire load factor values: average load (a2+a3)/2, half-difference (a2-a3)/2, stores a4 as the tire load, and its reciprocal 1.0/a4. If a4 <= 0 and session is not server (5), conditionally logs "tire load factor" debug message.

0x004d5f70.name: TireSlipCurveBuilder
0x004d5f70.label: tire slip-angle curve builder (spline fit from parsed slip/force data points)
0x004d5f70.summary: Parses a tire slip-curve definition file (name, step size, and data points), builds a cubic Hermite spline through the data points, finds the peak grip slip angle, and normalizes all spline coefficients by the peak force value.

0x004d6800.name: StructEntryCleanup
0x004d6800.label: StructEntryCleanup
0x004d6800.summary: Cleans up a struct entry: zeros three fields (offsets 0x8, 0xC, 0x10) and conditionally frees a heap-allocated buffer at offset 0x14 via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Also calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc on a global string buffer. Called by ArrayBlockCleanup for per-entry teardown.

0x004d6830.name: CubicHermiteInterpolation
0x004d6830.label: TableCubicHermiteInterpolator
0x004d6830.summary: Performs 1D cubic Hermite interpolation from a coefficient table. Computes normalized parameter t = a3/a2 * this[8], clamps index to table bounds, then evaluates cubic polynomial: ((c3*t + c2)*t + c1)*t + c0, where coefficients are read from 32-byte stride entries in this[20].

0x004d6ae0.name: VehicleSuspensionForceHelper
0x004d6ae0.label: SuspensionForceTemperatureScaler
0x004d6ae0.summary: Computes suspension force scaled by temperature: ((this[35] + 273.16) * a2 * 0.002778858444950814 * this[8]) + this[7]. Converts temperature from Celsius to Kelvin, multiplies by input factor, a position scaling constant, and an offset.

0x004d6b00.name: sub_4D6B00
0x004d6b00.label: TireBrandFileParser
0x004d6b00.summary: Parses a tire brand definition file (.tbc) by reading key-value pairs for front and rear tire properties (grip curves, radius, spring, damper, wear, heating, etc.), storing them into a structured tire data block. Also computes averaged grip multipliers and a wear-rating integer clamped to [7,15]. Part of the vehicle physics/tire subsystem.

0x004d7050.name: ArrayBlockCleanup
0x004d7050.label: ArrayBlockCleanup
0x004d7050.summary: Cleans up a two-part dynamic array block structure. Iterates first array (24-byte entries at this+0xC), calling StructEntryCleanup and freeing sub-pointers; iterates second array (680-byte entries at this+0x14), calling ShortComputation_4370 on fields. Frees both array headers, zeros counters, sets sentinel at 0x20 to -1. Called by multiple teardown paths.

0x004d7150.name: TireBrandFileParser
0x004d7150.label: Tire Physics File Parser (SlipCurve + Compound)
0x004d7150.summary: Parses a tire physics data file containing "SlipCurve" and "Compound" sections. Makes two passes: first counts entries and allocates typed arrays (24-byte slip curves, 680-byte compounds), second fills them via TireSlipCurveBuilder and compound initializer. Validates counts match and reports errors on overflow or mismatch.

0x004d7570.name: CompoundIndexLookup
0x004d7570.label: TireCompoundIndexValidator
0x004d7570.summary: Validates tire compound index a2 against range [0, this[4]) and returns pointer to compound data at this[5] + 680*a2. If index out of range, conditionally logs "tire brand doesn't" error and returns 0.

0x004d75d0.name: TireSlipCurveNameLookup
0x004d75d0.label: TireSlipCurveNameSearcher
0x004d75d0.summary: Searches a tire slip curve name table for a matching string. Iterates up to this[2] entries at this[3] with 24-byte stride, comparing each name via sub_588410. Returns pointer to matching entry, or 0 if not found (with optional debug log).

0x004d7660.name: TireBrandLoader
0x004d7660.label: TireBrandLoader
0x004d7660.summary: Loads tire brand configuration (.tbc) files from season directory. Searches for .tbc files using sub_565F80, allocates entry array (36 bytes each), parses each file via TireBrandFileParser, logs warning if no brands found. Called by GameFileLoader.

0x004d7800.name: TextureSurfaceDestroyer
0x004d7800.label: TextureSurfaceDestroyer
0x004d7800.summary: Destroys a texture surface container: iterates active entries calling ArrayBlockCleanup per entry, then walks the full allocated block freeing sub-pointers at offsets 0 and 0x18 via FreeWrapper_7bcf, frees the block header, zeros both fields. Called by SessionReset and TireBrandLoader during teardown.

0x004d7880.name: TireBrandLookup
0x004d7880.label: TireBrandNameSearcher
0x004d7880.summary: Searches a tire brand name table for a matching string. Iterates up to *this entries at this[1] with 36-byte stride, comparing each brand name via sub_588410. Returns pointer to matching entry, or 0 if not found (with optional debug log, gated by session type).

0x004d7960.name: TraceLogInit
0x004d7960.label: TraceLogInit
0x004d7960.summary: Initializes trace logging to "trace.txt" in weather/season directory. Clamps trace level (this+0x0) to max 2, opens file for writing, writes header line with level. If file already open, just writes header. Called by sub_4D7A00.

0x004d7a00.name: sub_4D7A00
0x004d7a00.label: TraceLogSetup
0x004d7a00.summary: Checks for "notrace" command-line flag via sub_587C20; if absent, sets trace buffer to 3000 and calls TraceLogInit to initialize trace file. Called by GameMainEntry at startup.

0x004d7a50.name: StringSplitLoop
0x004d7a50.label: DebugLogPathValidator
0x004d7a50.summary: Checks if this[0] >= a2 (minimum level threshold), then iterates through a path string via sub_587C20 splitting on backslashes. After iteration, writes a formatted debug log entry. Returns 1 if validation passes, 0 if level too low.

0x004d7aa0.name: DebugLogWrite
0x004d7aa0.label: DebugLogMessageWriter
0x004d7aa0.summary: Writes a formatted message to the debug log file handle at this[4]. Calls FileWriteWrapperWithLock to write the buffer, then LockCallUnlockWrapper to flush/sync the file handle.

0x004d7ad0.name: SlotArrayInit
0x004d7ad0.label: SlotArrayInit_3x4
0x004d7ad0.summary: Initializes an interleaved 3-slot array (12 DWORDs total). For each slot, sets two fields to -1 (sentinel) and two to 0. Total struct spans offsets 0x0 through 0x2C.

0x004d7b00.name: sub_4D7B00
0x004d7b00.label: TrackReferenceFinder
0x004d7b00.summary: For each of 3 slots, initializes min/max indices (-1), sets lower/upper value bounds from track reference globals, then searches track data array (dword_8ACFF0, count in dword_8ACFEC) to find entries within bounds. Updates slot min/max indices to point to bracketing track entries. Called by Game_Restart.

0x004d7c10.name: FloatRangeIndexLookup
0x004d7c10.label: WrappedFloatRangeIndexer
0x004d7c10.summary: Wraps float a2 into range [0, this[9]) by repeatedly adding/subtracting this[9]. If result is <= flt_5EA404 (small threshold), returns 0. Otherwise scans 3 predefined range thresholds (at flt_5EA404, flt_5EA404-4, flt_5EA404-8) to find which segment the value falls into, returning index 0, 1, or 2 (or -1 if none match).

0x004d7cf0.name: FloatWrapTableInterpolation
0x004d7cf0.label: WrappedFloatLerpFactorComputer
0x004d7cf0.summary: Wraps float a2 into range [0, this[9]), calls FloatRangeIndexLookup to get the segment index, then computes linear interpolation factor: (a2 - this[v6+6]) / (this[v6+9] - this[v6+6]). Optionally writes index to *a3.

0x004d7e00.name: VTableDispatchChain_7e00
0x004d7e00.label: VTableDispatchChain
0x004d7e00.summary: Two-stage vtable dispatch: calls check method (vtable[6] at offset +0x18), conditionally invokes sub_4D7FE0 and PhaseBasedAudioParticleEnvelope, then dispatches to final method (vtable[1] at offset +0x4) and returns result. Called by sub_4D8450.

0x004d7e30.name: VTableDispatchWithFieldClear
0x004d7e30.label: VTableDispatchWithStateClear
0x004d7e30.summary: Clears this[3] to 0, then dispatches through the vtable at offset 0x10 (4th vtable entry). Standard virtual call wrapper with state reset.

0x004d7e40.name: UITextRenderWithScale
0x004d7e40.label: UITextRenderWithScale
0x004d7e40.summary: Renders UI text with horizontal/vertical scaling. Looks up render context via SwitchBasedGlobalLookup, applies scale factors (a7, a8), computes scaled position with alignment (left or center), renders via sub_553070 to D3D device, restores original context scale. Heavily called across UI rendering.

0x004d7fa0.name: SwitchBasedGlobalLookup
0x004d7fa0.label: SwitchBasedGlobalLookup
0x004d7fa0.summary: Simple selector-to-pointer lookup: returns one of 4 global resource/context pointers indexed by input (1→dword_8AD38C, 2→dword_8AD390, 3→dword_8AD394, default→dword_8AD388). Used by UI text rendering to select render context.

0x004d7fe0.name: sub_4D7FE0
0x004d7fe0.label: DelegateWithField4
0x004d7fe0.summary: Delegates to sub_4D8A30 passing the value at offset 0x4 of the struct as argument. Called by VTableDispatchChain_7e00 as part of the dispatch chain.

0x004d7ff0.name: PhaseBasedAudioParticleEnvelope
0x004d7ff0.label: Audio particle envelope tick
0x004d7ff0.summary: Advances a phase accumulator (this+0xC) by a fixed delta (dbl_8AFE98), then computes a multi-segment amplitude envelope (attack-sustain-release) across a 4.0-unit cycle, gated at a 0.2 threshold. Calls TimerClockFormat to apply the resulting amplitude.

0x004d8130.name: TimerClockFormat
0x004d8130.label: HUD text render with alpha
0x004d8130.summary: Renders a text string (directory path prefix + generated character suffix sequence) at fixed screen position (640, 974) with configurable alpha (`a1`) modulated by audio envelope. String suffix base character is selected by flag `a2`.

0x004d8220.name: RaceInitWithConstants
0x004d8220.label: Race state init with screen constants
0x004d8220.summary: Initializes a race-related struct: computes normalized screen dimensions from pixel values, then calls a sequence of init subroutines (struct setup, per-channel batch init 1-5, audio/timer init, and finalization).

0x004d82d0.name: HUDFlagRendererMain
0x004d82d0.label: HUD flag render main
0x004d82d0.summary: Collects race flag bytes (yellow=62, blue=65, black=63, pit=102, checkered=66, plus fuel/penalty flags) into a buffer based on various game-state checks, then renders them via sub_553070 with a white color override. Skips if input display mode is 0, a conditional flag is set, scoring gate is at state 2, or participant slot is invalid.

0x004d8450.name: sub_4D8450
0x004d8450.label: HUD Message Display Manager & Input Toggle Handler
0x004d8450.summary: Manages HUD message display lifecycle (timed messages, broadcast toggles, HUD on/off), processes input device actions for toggling display modes, and handles audio device state. Heads-up display system.

0x004d8760.name: sub_4D8760
0x004d8760.label: GuardedStateTransitionWithDispatch
0x004d8760.summary: Performs a guarded state transition: checks that the new state object exists (this[a2+4] != 0), authorization/validation passes, transition is forward or same-state, and a conditional flag is clear. If all guards pass, updates this[55] to 0 or 0.5f based on a3 flag, sets *this = a2 (new state), and dispatches via vtable. Returns 0 on success, 1 on rejection.

0x004d8860.name: ConditionalBranchByFlag
0x004d8860.label: FlagBranchWithIndexReset
0x004d8860.summary: If flag a2 is non-zero, calls IndexValidationSetter(0) and returns 0. If a2 is zero, sets this[2] = -1 (reset index) and returns 0.

0x004d8880.name: IndexValidationSetter
0x004d8880.label: Validated index setter
0x004d8880.summary: Validates and stores an index into `this[2]` (offset 0x8). If index is -1, clears the selection. Otherwise sets it only if the corresponding entry at `this[index+3]` is non-zero and an enable flag is set.

0x004d88b0.name: IteratorCheck
0x004d88b0.label: Iterator advance check
0x004d88b0.summary: Advances a sequential iterator: reads current index from `this[0]`, calls a vtable method (offset 20) on the associated entry object, and resets index to -1 when iteration completes (method returns 1). Acts as a "step and check done" for an entry list walk.

0x004d88d0.name: sub_4D88D0
0x004d88d0.label: Race render resource allocator
0x004d88d0.summary: Allocates per-index Direct3D objects (25 slots, gated by permission matrix for current race mode), allocates 3 sub-objects, conditionally creates one more object based on range check, and stores a fixed-node allocator. Called once during race init.

0x004d8950.name: BatchVTableDispatchAndCleanup
0x004d8950.label: Batch release and cleanup
0x004d8950.summary: Releases all Direct3D/render objects (25 + 3 + 2) by dispatching vtable method at offset 0 with parameter 1 (release/free), then nulls each pointer. Counterpart to sub_4D88D0 allocation. Called during cleanup/shutdown.

0x004d89d0.name: sub_4D89D0
0x004d89d0.label: Race render struct default init
0x004d89d0.summary: Initializes a race render struct to default values: set three ID/index fields to -1, clear all object pointer arrays (25 D3D slots + 3 sub-object slots + 2 singletons) to null via memset and direct assignment, and store default float/byte configuration (0.5f scale, 1.0f scale, 1-byte flag).

0x004d8a30.name: sub_4D8A30
0x004d8a30.label: Indexed render dispatch
0x004d8a30.summary: Dispatches a render operation based on index a1 (0-5). For indices 1-5 reads a handle from a global 5-element array; index 5 additionally renders a colored quad first. Calls sub_553700 on the render device if both the handle and render device exist. Returns 0 on success, 1 on invalid index.

0x004d8ab0.name: sub_4D8AB0
0x004d8ab0.label: Audio/render resource loader with screen dimensions
0x004d8ab0.summary: Loads 4 audio/render resources (dword_8AD388–8AD394) from path-constructed filenames using base directory (override or default) plus vtable-derived suffixes. Configures each loaded resource with normalized screen dimensions (this[57]/this[58]) at offset 92/96. Cleans up existing resources before reloading.

0x004d8cf0.name: sub_4D8CF0
0x004d8cf0.label: HUD texture/quad resource initializer
0x004d8cf0.summary: Initializes HUD render resources (texture quads) for types 1-5: releases existing resource, then creates a new render object with 4 textured quad vertices positioned at screen-scaled coordinates using normalized dimensions (this[57]/this[58]). Type 3 additionally loads a D3D texture from file and allocates a 96-byte zero-filled struct.

0x004d8fb0.name: sub_4D8FB0
0x004d8fb0.label: Release 4 audio/render handles
0x004d8fb0.summary: Releases four global resource handles (dword_8AD388 through dword_8AD394) by calling a release/destructor function on each non-null handle, then nulling the handle. Called to clean up existing resources before reloading.

0x004d9030.name: AudioResourceReleaseByType
0x004d9030.label: Release resource by type
0x004d9030.summary: Releases a render/audio resource identified by type index (1-5) from the global handle array (dword_8AD398–8AD3A8). Type 3 additionally releases an associated extra struct (dword_8AD3AC) via destructor and memory free. Nulls handles after release.

0x004d90d0.name: QuadRenderWithColor
0x004d90d0.label: HUD quad render with position offset
0x004d90d0.summary: Renders a full-screen-width textured quad (1280×50 scaled) at a vertical position determined by participant slot (this[8]==-1 → y=0, else y=140). Uses sub_553650 to set 4 vertices with UV coordinates. Skips render when color/alpha parameter a2 is zero.

0x004d9290.name: IDTypePermissionMatrix
0x004d9290.label: Permitted index lookup by mode
0x004d9290.summary: Returns 1 (permitted) or 0 (denied) for an index (a1, 0-24) given a race mode (a2, 1-5). Modes 3-5 permit all indices; modes 1-2 permit only specific subsets. Out-of-range modes always return 0.

0x004d9420.name: StartingGridUIDraw
0x004d9420.label: Starting grid UI render
0x004d9420.summary: Renders the starting grid HUD. When participant count (this[5]) is non-zero, draws grid car positions in two columns via sub_4D95D0. When zero, renders "Starting Grid" title text and 4 position marker labels at computed Y positions.

0x004d95d0.name: sub_4D95D0
0x004d95d0.label: Starting grid car position drawer
0x004d95d0.summary: Draws up to two grid cars at screen positions for a starting grid. Searches vehicle array for IDs matching a1 (primary) and a2 (secondary); draws primary at (a3, a4+160) and secondary offset at (a3+64, a4-32). Returns when both are found or all vehicles scanned.

0x004d9690.name: sub_4D9690
0x004d9690.label: Grid car info render
0x004d9690.summary: Renders a starting grid car's information at screen position: position number, driver name, team name, and qualifying time. Time is formatted as "mm:ss.fff" via SpatialGridCell if valid (>= 0), else shows a placeholder string. Handles position indices 1-25.

0x004d98a0.name: TimerCountdown
0x004d98a0.label: Countdown phase handler with driver info
0x004d98a0.summary: Decrements a countdown timer (this[4]) by delta time each call. While timer is active (>= 0), renders current player's grid position, driver name, and team/car name at fixed HUD positions. Returns 1 when timer expires.

0x004d99e0.name: HUDVenue
0x004d99e0.label: Venue/track name HUD display
0x004d99e0.summary: Renders venue name, decorative separator bar, and additional race info at fixed HUD positions. Timer-gated (this[4] decrements each frame; hides when expired). Looks up venue name and secondary string from race data tables via linked-list searches.

0x004d9dd0.name: TimerDisplayRender
0x004d9dd0.label: Timer HUD display with separators
0x004d9dd0.summary: Renders the timer HUD area: delegates countdown logic to TimerCountdown, then renders two colored separator characters (red left, green right) and a centered track/venue path label in yellow. Only draws when countdown timer is active.

0x004d9f80.name: sub_4D9F80
0x004d9f80.label: Gated state update dispatch
0x004d9f80.summary: Timer-gated state update function: decrements state timer (this[4]), triggers VehicleStateUpdate when vehicle state flag (this[5]) is negative, checks TimerValueComparison, then calls sub_4DA0D0 for further processing if all conditions pass.

0x004d9fe0.name: VehicleStateUpdate
0x004d9fe0.label: Vehicle lap gap state update
0x004d9fe0.summary: Compares player vehicle's lap/segment times (from offsets 16592/16596) to compute a gap value via LapTimeGapCalculation. Sets comparison type flag (this[6]=0/1) and stores the reference time. Triggers VTableDispatchWithFieldClear on gap success or zero-gap threshold.

0x004da080.name: TimerValueComparison
0x004da080.label: Reference time validation check
0x004da080.summary: Validates that the stored reference time (this[7]) still matches the current player vehicle's comparison slot, selected by type flag (this[6]). Returns 1 if match confirmed, 0 if gap is invalid, reference is zero, or vehicle state has changed.

0x004da0d0.name: sub_4DA0D0
0x004da0d0.label: HUDVehicleInfoRenderer
0x004da0d0.summary: Renders debug/vehicle info overlay (gear/position, name, indexed extra chars, speed) for two entities (left/right columns) on screen. Part of HUD/debug UI system.

0x004da840.name: sub_4DA840
0x004da840.label: RaceFinishStateHandler
0x004da840.summary: Manages post-race completion state machine: init, timer hold after finish detection, finish state validation, and session transition to results/summary. Part of race management system.

0x004da990.name: sub_4DA990
0x004da990.label: CountVehiclesAtOrBeyondLap
0x004da990.summary: Iterates all vehicles and counts those whose lap progress (offset 0x406C) meets or exceeds a threshold value from this+0x24. Used for position/finish ranking calculation.

0x004da9e0.name: sub_4DA9E0
0x004da9e0.label: HUDLapTimePositionRender
0x004da9e0.summary: Renders lap count or elapsed time text on HUD. If session has 1 lap total, shows "N LAPS" using string table lookup; otherwise computes formatted race time (MM:SS.mmm or SS.mmm) and renders with position suffix character.

0x004dad30.name: SingleFunctionCallWrapper_ad30
0x004dad30.label: LapCountToVehicleWriter
0x004dad30.summary: Writes lap/threshold value from this+0x24 into vehicle struct at offset 0x4034 via sub_4BC270. Synchronizes lap counter into vehicle data for time gap calculation.

0x004dad50.name: ArithmeticComparison_ad50
0x004dad50.label: WriteLapToCurrentVehicle
0x004dad50.summary: Gets current vehicle index via sub_4D1B50, then writes lap/threshold from this+0x24 into that vehicle's offset 0x4034. Part of standings/time-gap calculation pipeline.

0x004dad80.name: sub_4DAD80
0x004dad80.label: CheckAllVehiclesFinished
0x004dad80.summary: Checks whether all vehicles have finished the race by comparing position counts against vehicle tally and verifying trailing vehicles' finish states. Returns 1 when race completion is confirmed. Part of race management system.

0x004dae00.name: sub_4DAE00
0x004dae00.label: RaceEndProgressionGate
0x004dae00.summary: Gate function controlling race-end flow progression. Returns 1 when timers have expired and player position relative to finished vehicles allows proceeding. Part of race management system.

0x004daea0.name: Direct3DObjectFactory
0x004daea0.label: UIWidgetFactory
0x004daea0.summary: Factory function allocating and initializing UI widget objects of various types (0,1,2,6,7,8,0xD,0x11,0x13) based on type ID. Sets vtable pointer and common fields. Returns new object pointer or NULL on allocation failure. Part of UI/widget system.

0x004db070.name: ConstructorVTable3Fields
0x004db070.label: ThreeFieldStructConstructor
0x004db070.summary: Initializes a 4-field structure: sets vtable pointer to off_5AD06C, stores two caller-provided parameters (a2 at +4, a3 at +8), and zeros field at +0xC. Simple inline constructor. Part of widget/object initialization.

0x004db090.name: UIClassConstructor
0x004db090.label: AudioFilterDestructor
0x004db090.summary: Destructor/disposer for audio filter objects. Sets vtable pointer to off_5AD06C and optionally frees object memory when `a2 & 1` flag is set. Part of object lifecycle management.

0x004db0b0.name: InitTwoFieldsToZero
0x004db0b0.label: TwoFieldZeroInitializer
0x004db0b0.summary: Zeros two integer fields at offsets 0x10 and 0x14 of the object. Likely a sub-object initializer or reset function.

0x004db0e0.name: SmallStructConstructor_b0e0
0x004db0e0.label: UIWidgetSubtypeConstructor
0x004db0e0.summary: Initializes a UI widget object: sets vtable to off_5AD034, type field to 1, active flag to 1, and reserved field to 0. Small inline constructor used by the widget factory.

0x004db100.name: ConstantReturnSetter
0x004db100.label: FloatFourInitializer
0x004db100.summary: Sets float field at offset 0x10 to 4.0f and returns the raw bit pattern. Simple constant-field initializer.

0x004db120.name: FloatConstantSetter
0x004db120.label: FloatTenInitializer
0x004db120.summary: Sets float field at offset 0x10 to constant 10.0f. Simple field initializer.

0x004db170.name: SteeringAckermannComputation
0x004db170.label: DebugTelemetryBarRenderer
0x004db170.summary: Renders debug telemetry overlay: a path/name label string and a 40-segment color-coded bar indicator (white vs red based on threshold). Gated by global flag flt_5EA4E8. Part of HUD/debug system.

0x004db420.name: sub_4DB420
0x004db420.label: InstantReplayObjectFactory
0x004db420.summary: Factory creating 24-byte objects with different vtables based on type ID (0/1/2). Type 0 initializes with "Instant Replay" label string. Returns NULL on allocation failure or invalid type. Part of replay system.

0x004db4e0.name: DualVtableDestructor
0x004db4e0.label: DualVtableDestructor
0x004db4e0.summary: Two-stage destructor: switches vtable to off_5AD0DC, frees child object pointer at offset 0x10 if non-null, switches vtable to off_5AD06C, then optionally frees self if a2&1. Part of object lifecycle management.

0x004db520.name: TripleVirtualCall
0x004db520.label: UIInitializationSequence
0x004db520.summary: Calls two virtual methods (vtable+0x1C with arg 0, vtable+0x20 with arg 1000) followed by UILayoutDispatchWithDataPrep(640). Resets and initializes UI layout at 640px width.

0x004db550.name: UILayoutDispatchWithDataPrep
0x004db550.label: HUDLayoutDispatcher
0x004db550.summary: Prepares game data (speed, engine RPM) and dispatches to multiple HUD element renderers at specific Y-positions (20, 68, 10). Part of HUD layout system.

0x004db6f0.name: PositionOrderNameDisplay
0x004db6f0.label: PositionGearTextRenderer
0x004db6f0.summary: Renders position or gear indicator text at screen coordinates. Shows localized "Error" for -1, "N" for 0, or numeric value for positive numbers. Colors change to red when driver appearance flags indicate failure state. Part of HUD system.

0x004db7f0.name: sub_4DB7F0
0x004db7f0.label: SymmetricalGhostCharacterRenderer
0x004db7f0.summary: Renders a single character (from byte_5D4AE9) at 8 symmetrical positions around center X, with 4 color variants selected by bitmask in a1. Creates ghost/shadow HUD effect.

0x004db9a0.name: UtilityFunction_b9a0
0x004db9a0.label: SpeedValueRenderer
0x004db9a0.summary: Converts float speed value to integer, formats as decimal string ("%d"), and renders at screen coordinates in yellow (16776960) with center alignment. Part of HUD speed display.

0x004dba00.name: UIMessageCompose
0x004dba00.label: WarningIconComposer
0x004dba00.summary: Composes a HUD warning string by checking multiple warning conditions (general, fuel, and two state icons) and appending corresponding icon bytes. Renders at screen position if any warnings active. Part of HUD warning system.

0x004dbac3.name: HUDFlagRendererSecondary
0x004dbac3.label: FlagIndicatorComposer
0x004dbac3.summary: Composes and renders HUD flag/status indicator string by checking multiple conditions (vehicle flag, pit state, disqualification, race phase). Renders text overlay at screen position. Part of HUD flag/status system.

0x004dbb60.name: DrawDebugTextOverlay
0x004dbb60.label: Render multi-line debug text overlay
0x004dbb60.summary: Renders debug information overlay by formatting multiple data fields into a 64-byte buffer via sub_49C* formatters and displaying them as colored text lines at screen-relative positions (a1 offset); also renders a secondary overlay element via DoubleRenderPass.

0x004dbde0.name: TextRenderWithShadow
0x004dbde0.label: Render text with shadow outline
0x004dbde0.summary: Renders text with a drop-shadow effect by performing two render passes at the same position: first a shadow pass (mode 1/alignment 2) and then a foreground pass (mode 0/alignment 1), using sub_49C8F0 and sub_49C960 to format the text buffer.

0x004dbe60.name: MultiLayerTextRendering
0x004dbe60.label: Render lap/time info with conditional layout
0x004dbe60.summary: Renders multi-layer race information overlay; branches on TotalRaceLaps (dword_8ACF8C): if 0x7FFFFFFF (infinite), renders text with shadow at top position; otherwise renders lap counter in yellow at a larger offset. Always renders secondary text fields with shadow below.

0x004dbf90.name: MultiColorTextRender
0x004dbf90.label: Render multi-color lap/time overlay
0x004dbf90.summary: Renders race information overlay using two color passes per text line: lap info in yellow at right offset, then position/status text pairs (white foreground + yellow overlay) at two rows on the left side of the screen.

0x004dc250.name: DrawYellowTextAtFixedScreenPosition
0x004dc250.label: Render yellow text at fixed screen position
0x004dc250.summary: Renders a yellow-colored text string at fixed screen coordinates (880, 140) by setting the color field at offset +72 of a context object to yellow (16776960), then calling sub_49F1C0 with the race session state and render device.

0x004dc446.name: sub_4DC446
0x004dc446.label: Vtable initializer (constructor stub)
0x004dc446.summary: Sets the vtable pointer of an object to `off_5AD11C` (function pointer table) and returns the object pointer — a standard constructor initialization pattern.

0x004dc450.name: StringCompareCopy
0x004dc450.label: Compare and conditionally copy file path with extension handling
0x004dc450.summary: Compares a source file path against a global path buffer (byte_5EA438) by extracting filename portions, checks extension match via sub_546AA0; optionally copies the filename with extension stripping if a4 flag is set, then registers and matches the result.

0x004dc660.name: ScaledTextureRender
0x004dc660.label: Render texture with scale adjustment and alignment
0x004dc660.summary: Renders a scaled texture by looking up the texture object via WideStringLinkedListSearch, temporarily multiplying its scale factors (offsets +92, +96) by the requested scales, computing aligned screen position, rendering via sub_553070, then restoring original scale and color values.

0x004dc770.name: TextureAdjuster
0x004dc770.label: Adjust texture material assignment by matching alternatives
0x004dc770.summary: Resolves a material name to a texture ID via sub_548890, then tries to match up to three alternative texture paths (a3-a5) against it using StringCompareCopy; returns 0, 1, or 2 indicating which alternative matched, or -1 on failure. Logs a debug message when no match found.

0x004dc960.name: RaySphereIntersectionTest
0x004dc960.label: 3D ray-sphere intersection test
0x004dc960.summary: Performs a ray-sphere intersection test: computes squared distance between a point (a2) and a retrieved 3D vector, compares against radius squared (a5), applies viewport clamping via D3D device wrapper, and returns whether the intersection is valid and in front of the camera.

0x004dca80.name: sub_4DCA80
0x004dca80.label: Four-corner rectangle render from struct fields
0x004dca80.summary: Renders a four-corner rectangle by computing corner positions from struct fields (base X/Y, width/height offsets, corner deltas) and calling sub_553650 four times with mode 0-3 to draw each corner/segment.

0x004dcba0.name: sub_4DCBA0
0x004dcba0.label: Texture/object initialization with fallback construction
0x004dcba0.summary: Attempts to initialize a texture/rendering object: first tries D3D texture creation, then falls back to generic object construction with sub-init; stores configuration fields (a2, a7, a8) and computes alignment when both paths fail. Cleans up on error.

0x004dcc90.name: FloatToIntConversionDelegation
0x004dcc90.label: Convert proportional float coordinates to screen-space integers
0x004dcc90.summary: Converts relative/proportional float parameters (a4-a8) to integer screen-space coordinates using screen dimensions (dword_5D6D60, dword_5D6D64) and delegates to sub_4DCBA0 for texture/object initialization.

0x004dcd10.name: ResourceCleanup_cd10
0x004dcd10.label: Dual-resource cleanup/destructor
0x004dcd10.summary: Frees two resource pointers stored in the object: calls destructor then frees memory for pointer at offset +4, and calls cascade cleanup on pointer at offset +0 if non-null. Returns result of ShortComputation_cb70.

0x004dcd60.name: ConditionalCall
0x004dcd60.label: Guarded dispatch with device fallback
0x004dcd60.summary: If the object's first field (*this) is non-null, dispatches to a render/setup function using the provided device pointer (or dword_8B8DC8 fallback if null).

0x004dcd80.name: TwoFieldSetterUpdate
0x004dcd80.label: Update two position fields and re-render
0x004dcd80.summary: Sets two object fields at offsets +0x14 and +0x18 with provided parameters (a2, a3), then triggers a re-render via sub_4DCA80 (four-corner rectangle render).

0x004dcdd0.name: PositionComputationWithAlignment
0x004dcdd0.label: Compute position with 9-point alignment
0x004dcdd0.summary: Sets object Z/size field at +0x10, then computes X/Y position fields at +0x08 and +0x0C using one of 9 alignment modes (0-8) relative to anchor point (a2, a3) and object dimensions (width at +0x14, height at +0x18), then renders via sub_4DCA80.

0x004dcf30.name: TwinFieldGetter_cf30
0x004dcf30.label: Two-field getter (width and height)
0x004dcf30.summary: Returns two object fields at offsets +0x14 (this[5]) and +0x18 (this[6]) via output pointers a2 and a3 if non-null; returns a3 as the function result.

0x004dcf50.name: TripleFieldGetter
0x004dcf50.label: Three-field getter (X, Y, Z/size)
0x004dcf50.summary: Returns three object fields at offsets +0x08 (X), +0x0C (Y), and +0x10 (Z/size) via output pointers a2, a3, a4 if non-null; returns a4 as the function result.

0x004dcf80.name: sub_4DCF80
0x004dcf80.label: Initialize object with default scale and path buffer
0x004dcf80.summary: Initializes two scale factor fields at offsets +0x30 and +0x34 to 1.0f, copies the global path buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, and returns ShortComputation_cb70 result.

0x004dd010.name: TwoFieldSetters
0x004dd010.label: Two-field setter (scale X and scale Y)
0x004dd010.summary: Sets two object fields at offsets +0x30 (this[12]) and +0x34 (this[13]) with provided parameters a2 and a3; returns a2 as the function result.

0x004dd030.name: TextRenderDispatcher
0x004dd030.label: Dispatch text rendering with bounds clipping and truncation
0x004dd030.summary: Renders a text string with scale, alignment, and bounds-aware clipping; queries text surface size, computes aligned position against object bounds, truncates overflowing text (left or right) using "AbCd" measurement heuristic, then delegates to ScaledTextureRender.

0x004dd3a0.name: TwoOutputPassthrough
0x004dd3a0.label: Query text surface dimensions with font fallback
0x004dd3a0.summary: Queries rendered text surface dimensions (width, height) for a given string and scale via SurfaceSizeQuery; uses font from this+0x28 or global fallback byte_5EA438 if a7 is null; returns width/height via output pointers.

0x004dd470.name: ArrayCleanupWithDestructorLoop
0x004dd470.label: Cleanup array of objects with destructor loop
0x004dd470.summary: Frees a single resource pointer at offset +0x8, then processes an array at offset +0x10 by reading its element count from the preceding length header, iterating backward through 24-byte elements calling ShortComputation_d4d0 on each (destructor), and finally freeing the array allocation.

0x004dd4d0.name: ShortComputation_d4d0
0x004dd4d0.label: Element destructor (free single resource)
0x004dd4d0.summary: Frees the resource pointer stored at offset +0x14 (this[5]) via FreeWrapper_7bcf if non-null; returns the pointer value.

0x004dd550.name: BoundingBoxComputation
0x004dd550.label: SceneGraphBoundingBoxComputer
0x004dd550.summary: Computes 3D axis-aligned bounding box (min/max X,Y,Z) of a scene graph node. Initializes min to +FLT_MAX and max to -FLT_MAX, iterates scene graph children, filters by LOD level, extracts vertex data via PackedArray, and records extents. Returns child count.

0x004dd6a0.name: BoundingBoxUpdate
0x004dd6a0.label: MergeBoxIntoMinMaxBounds
0x004dd6a0.summary: Computes bounding box from object via BoundingBoxComputation and position offset via TripleFieldQuery, then merges result into existing min (a2) and max (a3) extents. Scene bounding volume update for graphics.

0x004dd7c0.name: sub_4DD7C0
0x004dd7c0.label: SceneGraphMaxDotProductFinder
0x004dd7c0.summary: Computes the vertex in a scene graph with maximum dot product against direction vector a2. Iterates children, filters by LOD level, extracts vertices via PackedArray, evaluates dot product of each vertex with the direction, and returns the coordinates of the extreme point in a3.

0x004dd8f0.name: MaxSquaredMagnitudeSearch
0x004dd8f0.label: FindMaxSquaredMagnitude
0x004dd8f0.summary: Iterates scene graph children, computes squared magnitude of 3D vectors from packed array, returns maximum value found. Part of LOD/geometry culling system.

0x004dd9f0.name: TriangleNormalComputation
0x004dd9f0.label: ComputeTriangleNormal
0x004dd9f0.summary: Computes normalized face normal from three triangle vertices via cross product. Returns 0 on success, -1 for degenerate (zero-area) triangle. Used in collision/geometry processing.

0x004ddad0.name: PitCrewInstanceSetup
0x004ddad0.label: PitCrewTexturePathsBuilder
0x004ddad0.summary: Builds full file paths for 9 pit-crew/vehicle texture types (car body, driver, arms, wing, helmet, pit body, pit helmet, lollipop, refueler) by combining base directory, team/track config strings, and fallback paths, then calls TextureAdjuster for each.

0x004ddf90.name: SceneFileTEAMDIRVEHDIRNOTSPINWriter
0x004ddf90.label: VehicleSceneFileTemplateWriter
0x004ddf90.summary: Processes a vehicle scene file template by reading the source file, replacing directive tags (teamdir, vehdir, spin, notspin, high/med/low detail, dashhigh/dashlow) with runtime values, and writing the result to an output file. Also handles merging backup override files for physics detail levels.

0x004de5f0.name: F_2FieldInitCall
0x004de5f0.label: TwoFieldZeroAndDualArrayDestruct
0x004de5f0.summary: Zeroes two DWORD fields at offsets 0xC and 0x14, then calls DualArrayDestructor to clean up internal array structures. Object teardown or reinitialization helper.

0x004de610.name: sub_4DE610
0x004de610.label: GeometrySceneGraphSetup
0x004de610.summary: Initializes geometry/scene-graph data structures from child nodes. Allocates and populates per-child vertex arrays with position/normal data, builds triangle-adjacency links, then allocates output transform arrays and processes position offsets. Graphics pipeline initialization.

0x004dedb0.name: SortedArrayInsertWithLRUEviction
0x004dedb0.label: SortedLRUArrayInsert
0x004dedb0.summary: Inserts 9-float entry into sorted array with LRU eviction when full (max 20 entries). Checks for duplicates first, then finds eviction candidate if full, shifts entries to fill slot, then inserts in sorted position by a2[1] key. Returns insertion result via sub_4DF110. Part of spatial/scene cache system.

0x004def70.name: sub_4DEF70
0x004def70.label: PositionOffsetAndLRUInsert
0x004def70.summary: Builds 9-float entry with position-offset vector from a3 relative to object's stored position (subtracted if flag at offset 0x42 set), computes magnitude of a4 as LOD/distance value, then inserts into sorted LRU array via SortedArrayInsertWithLRUEviction when magnitude positive. Spatial cache population.

0x004df030.name: sub_4DF030
0x004df030.label: TypedLRUArrayInsert
0x004df030.summary: Creates 9-float entry with type=1 and given float value (a2), zeroing remaining fields, then inserts into sorted LRU array via SortedArrayInsertWithLRUEviction if type field at offset 0x18 is nonzero. Scene element registration for spatial cache.

0x004df110.name: sub_4DF110
0x004df110.label: ContactConstraintSolverUpdate
0x004df110.summary: Updates wheel contact constraint data — finds insertion slot by depth threshold, processes soft deformation and hard limits on contact vertex positions, computes face normals. Core of tire-ground contact solver.

0x004dfa60.name: ConditionalAudioParamSetup
0x004dfa60.label: ConditionalAudioTransformSetup
0x004dfa60.summary: Stores audio parameter byte at offset 0x42, then conditionally configures audio-physics transforms. If object pointer at offset 0x0 is valid: optionally mixes audio via AudioPhysicsMixWithLerp, computes dual-matrix transforms, sets flag bytes. Otherwise zeroes six DWORD fields and clears flags. Always computes Euler rotation matrix at end. Vehicle audio setup.

0x004dfca0.name: DualArrayDestructorLoopFree
0x004dfca0.label: LoopDualArrayDestructAndFree
0x004dfca0.summary: Walks backward through array of 11 structures (each 748 bytes), calling DualArrayDestructor on each, then conditionally frees a pointer at offset 0x90 if non-null. Cleanup/destructor for array of sub-systems.

0x004dfce0.name: VehicleGraphicsSceneLoader
0x004dfce0.label: Vehicle graphics scene node tree loader and initializer
0x004dfce0.summary: Loads and initializes the full vehicle graphics scene graph — wheel nodes, wings, cockpit, debris, lights, and all visual sub-nodes — from a scene file and populates bounding boxes, audio parameters, and tread/sound effect handles. Part of the vehicle rendering/graphics scene management system.

0x004e0800.name: VehicleRespawnReset
0x004e0800.label: VehicleRespawnAndStateReset
0x004e0800.summary: Resets vehicle state on respawn or race restart: clears collision/contact data, computes random respawn delay from noise table, reinitializes vehicle sub-structs, resets gear-change animation timer, zeroes force accumulators, and dispatches per-contact-zone state reset via ConditionalDispatchByFlag.

0x004e09e0.name: VehicleResetClear
0x004e09e0.label: VehicleStateResetAndReinit
0x004e09e0.summary: Resets and reinitializes a vehicle state structure — zeroes large blocks of fields (timers, counters, flags, collision state, audio handles), calls destructor loops on embedded array objects, and conditionally runs multi-system init + 3D sound cleanup when collision geometry is loaded. Returns void pointer from freed memory.

0x004e0c90.name: UITimerTweenUpdate
0x004e0c90.label: UITimerTweenValueUpdate
0x004e0c90.summary: Updates UI timer/tween countdown value by dt * 0.2 speed factor and applies result to UI element state. Part of UI animation/tween system.

0x004e0d00.name: LazyInitCallback
0x004e0d00.label: LazyInitUISoundEffect
0x004e0d00.summary: Performs one-time lazy initialization of a UI element — moves doubly-linked list node, applies position/color values, triggers sound effect, and registers in global lookup arrays. Part of UI lazy-init system.

0x004e0d70.name: ConditionalResourceRelease
0x004e0d70.label: ConditionalResourceRelease
0x004e0d70.summary: Conditionally releases a UI resource — transplants node from doubly-linked list, clears init flag, and calls flag field update. Reverse counterpart of LazyInitCallback.

0x004e0ed0.name: AudioSoundEffectController
0x004e0ed0.label: Audio UI Widget State Controller
0x004e0ed0.summary: Per-frame audio/UI widget visibility controller that manages which HUD widgets are shown/hidden based on the current game mode (view=0, replay=1, driving=2, default=3). Handles session phase transitions for audio state changes and pit-control widget toggling.

0x004e16c0.name: FieldReadDelegate
0x004e16c0.label: FieldReadDelegate
0x004e16c0.summary: Reads three DWORDs and three floats from struct offsets 8-28 and forwards them to sub_54B4D0. Simple data-binding delegate for UI state update.

0x004e16f0.name: ParticleEffectWorldTransform
0x004e16f0.label: ParticleEffectWorldTransform
0x004e16f0.summary: Transforms 17 particle emitter positions from local space to world space using a 3x3 rotation matrix and translation vector, then spawns particles. Part of particle effect rendering system.

0x004e17c0.name: SubsystemStateMachine
0x004e17c0.label: SubsystemStateMachine
0x004e17c0.summary: Dispatch function for subsystem slot lifecycle management — routes to lazy init or conditional release based on slot ID and activation intent. Manages 14 slot types (indices 0-13).

0x004e18c0.name: SubsystemReadyQuery
0x004e18c0.label: SubsystemReadyCheck
0x004e18c0.summary: Queries readiness of subsystem indexed by a2 (0-13). Subsystems 0-3 checked via stride-296 array at offset 0x144, subsystems 4-5 via dedicated fields, subsystems 6-13 via stride-68 array at offset 0x4D4. Returns 1 if ready (pointer allocated AND ready byte zero), 0 otherwise. Initialization status query.

0x004e1970.name: EffectDataTableInitialization
0x004e1970.label: SubsystemReadyTableInit
0x004e1970.summary: Queries readiness for all 14 subsystems (indices 0-13) via SubsystemReadyQuery and stores results in an array at offset 0xB70. Called during loading/initialization phase to populate subsystem status table.

0x004e19d0.name: VehicleStateUpdate_19d0
0x004e19d0.label: Vehicle Dashboard & HUD State Update
0x004e19d0.summary: Per-frame vehicle dashboard/HUD update — propagates position/rotation transforms to wheel sub-objects and active components, detects state changes (low-grip warning, gear changes, byte flags), and dispatches sound/visual cues via sub_5506A0.

0x004e1fd0.name: F_3DTransformPointByMatrixAndTranslation
0x004e1fd0.label: PointTransformByMatrixWithTranslation
0x004e1fd0.summary: Transforms 3D point by rotation matrix (rotation at this+0x14, component scale at this[572]) and adds translation (at this+0x8E8). Outputs transformed point to a2 and copies rotation quaternion to a3. Camera/view space coordinate transform.

0x004e2070.name: LocalToWorldCoordinateTransform
0x004e2070.label: LocalToWorldCoordinateTransform
0x004e2070.summary: Transforms local 3D coordinates to world space. Adds camera-relative offsets (this[573]+this[576] etc.), multiplies by rotation matrix (this[8..16] = offset 0x20-0x40), adds base position (this[2..4] = offset 0x8-0x10), copies 3x3 matrix, and calls sub_567120 with position vector. Camera world-space transform.

0x004e2130.name: ChassisWorldTransform
0x004e2130.label: ChassisWorldTransform
0x004e2130.summary: Transforms 3D point by chassis rotation matrix (this+0x14, component scale at this[584]) and adds chassis position offset (this+0x918). Outputs transformed point to a2 and copies rotation quaternion to a3. Camera tracking transform for vehicle chassis.

0x004e21d0.name: ColorAlphaUpdateFlagSet
0x004e21d0.label: ColorAlphaUpdateFlagSet
0x004e21d0.summary: Computes ARGB color value from alpha parameter (a2 * 254), writes it to all packed array elements' color field (offset 24), and sets dirty flag bit 0x10000000 at offset 0x14. Part of color/visibility update system.

0x004e2230.name: VibrationStateMachine
0x004e2230.label: VibrationStateMachine
0x004e2230.summary: State machine for vibration/force feedback — transitions between off (0), low (1), and high (2) states based on |a3| thresholds (16.0 and 64.0). Updates hardware slots and audio slots on state change. Part of input/haptic feedback system.

0x004e2370.name: MultiplayerSessionType
0x004e2370.label: MultiplayerSessionType
0x004e2370.summary: Configures multiplayer session mode — maps session type enum (a2) to mode value at offset 0xB6C, then initializes 4 session slots at 0x1EC (74-DWORD stride) to -1. Part of multiplayer/session management system.

0x004e23d0.name: F_3x3MatrixTransform
0x004e23d0.label: Transform3x3WithTranslation
0x004e23d0.summary: Applies 3x3 rotation matrix and translation to a 3D vector. Stores rotation angles, rotation matrix, input vector, and transformed result in output struct. Part of physics/transform system.

0x004e24a0.name: SuspensionParamUpdate
0x004e24a0.label: SuspensionParamUpdate
0x004e24a0.summary: Updates wheel suspension parameters — ride height offset, damper angle, and steering angle for a given wheel index. Rebuilds rotation matrix on angle change. Part of vehicle suspension system.

0x004e2540.name: WheelSuspensionTireStateInit
0x004e2540.label: WheelSuspensionTireStateInit
0x004e2540.summary: Initializes wheel suspension and tire state for a given wheel index — computes wheel offset from chassis origin, stores camber/toe/caster parameters, and builds rotation matrix from Euler angles. Part of vehicle suspension system.

0x004e2610.name: SuspensionGeometryInitializer
0x004e2610.label: SuspensionGeometryInitializer
0x004e2610.summary: Initializes suspension geometry for a wheel — computes wheel offset from chassis origin, copies two rotation matrices (suspension orientation + upright orientation), and extracts Euler angles from both. Part of vehicle suspension initialization.

0x004e2760.name: ForceFeedback
0x004e2760.label: ForceFeedbackPacketBuild
0x004e2760.summary: Builds force feedback output packet. Iterates 4 wheels packing type and force data into bit fields, packs steering/vibration values into output bytes/words. If FFB enable flag at offset 0x98C is set, iterates 17 channels scaling forces to ±32767 range and packs into output structure; otherwise zeros FFB fields. Returns pointer to output packet at this+0x938.

0x004e2a60.name: sub_4E2A60
0x004e2a60.label: PitCrewInstanceSetupWithPath
0x004e2a60.summary: Resolves vehicle index from skin/path data, determines skin override path (player-specific or default), then calls PitCrewInstanceSetup to instantiate pit crew. Part of vehicle graphics scene loading.

0x004e2ad0.name: PhysicsAudioVectorUpdate
0x004e2ad0.label: PhysicsAudioCenterUpdate
0x004e2ad0.summary: Centers physics/audio vertex data around bounding box midpoint. Computes bounding box for objects a1 and a2, derives center, adjusts all child vertex positions by subtracting center offset, recalculates bounding boxes, and updates audio position references. Audio-physics geometry integration.

0x004e2c70.name: ScoringGateValueSelect
0x004e2c70.label: ScoringGateTimeSelect
0x004e2c70.summary: Selects timestamp value for scoring field at offset 0x984 based on gate type. If scoring gate type is 2, delegates to Delegation function for gate-specific time and stores result; otherwise stores global session time. Scoring/timing system.

0x004e2ca0.name: ScalePropagate
0x004e2ca0.label: ScalePropagate
0x004e2ca0.summary: Propagates a new scale value to scene graph children when scale changes. Computes scale ratio and updates velocity scaling on child nodes. Part of vehicle transform/scale system.

0x004e2d00.name: VertexClusteringLODGrouping
0x004e2d00.label: VertexLODClusteringUpdate
0x004e2d00.summary: Groups scene-graph vertices into 4 LOD clusters by spatial proximity to 4 reference positions. Finds nearest cluster center per vertex, allocates per-cluster arrays, stores vertex positions with normals and LOD distance weights. Scene LOD/culling preparation.

0x004e3050.name: ArrayCleanup
0x004e3050.label: QuadArrayPointerCleanup
0x004e3050.summary: Iterates 4 array pointers at stride 296 bytes (starting from offset 0x1F4), zeroes each count field and frees non-null allocations, then zeroes pointers. Destructor/cleanup for cluster storage arrays.

0x004e3090.name: sub_4E3090
0x004e3090.label: SkinningVertexDeform
0x004e3090.summary: Deforms skinned vertex positions using a bone rotation frame (tangent/binormal/normal) for a single bone. Computes transformed positions with vertex weight interpolation and clears dirty flag. Part of mesh skinning system.

0x004e3360.name: sub_4E3360
0x004e3360.label: VehicleAudioConfigLoader
0x004e3360.summary: Parses vehicle audio/sound configuration file, extracts restriction-sphere and force-field-sphere parameters, and initializes per-vehicle audio playback sub-slots for engine, tire, and environmental sounds. Part of the vehicle audio initialization system.

0x004e3890.name: StateArrayReset
0x004e3890.label: StateArrayReset
0x004e3890.summary: Resets an array of contact/state entries by calling sub_4DF110 with zero on each entry and clearing the sixth float field to 0.0. Part of vehicle state/reset system.

0x004e38d0.name: TimerClampAndProcess
0x004e38d0.label: TimerCountClampAndArrayDestroy
0x004e38d0.summary: Clamps timer counter at offset 0xBA8 to valid range [0, 11], then iterates up to count calling DualArrayDestructor on each array entry (stride 748 bytes). Resets counter to 0 at end. Timer/array cleanup during vehicle reset.

0x004e3940.name: RepeatedPositionOffsetTransform
0x004e3940.label: RepeatedPositionOffsetTransform
0x004e3940.summary: Computes position offset vector from reference point (offsets 0x48/0x4C/0x50), then dispatches to sub_4DEF70 for each entry in array at stride 748 bytes starting from offset 0xBAC. Count controlled by field at offset 0xBA8. Repeated spatial transform for sub-elements.

0x004e39d0.name: UIElementMultiDispatch
0x004e39d0.label: UIElementMultiDispatch
0x004e39d0.summary: Iterates array of sub-elements at stride 748 bytes (starting from offset 0xBAC), dispatching float value a2 to each via sub_4DF030. Count from field at offset 0xBA8. UI/scene element update dispatch.

0x004e3aa0.name: TireContactForceComputation
0x004e3aa0.label: TireContactForceComputation
0x004e3aa0.summary: Computes tire contact forces — queries collision normal from track surface, calculates contact penetration depth, spring/damper force, and lateral/longitudinal friction forces. Core of tire-ground interaction model.

0x004e3d00.name: WheelSpringDamperForceAndSteering
0x004e3d00.label: Wheel Spring-Damper Force and Steering Torque Computation
0x004e3d00.summary: Computes per-frame spring/damper forces and steering torques for a single wheel using suspension geometry. Applies a suspension model with bump/rebound damping, contact patch displacement tracking, and outputs force components along the wheel's local axes.

0x004e43d0.name: sub_4E43D0
0x004e43d0.label: WheelAngularVelocityIntegrator
0x004e43d0.summary: Integrates wheel angular velocity with friction/braking torque. Computes accumulated rotation from directional inputs, applies friction convergence, and clamps speed. Calls interrupt dispatch if speed exceeds threshold. Part of wheel rotation dynamics.

0x004e4500.name: PhysicsTireSystemConstructor
0x004e4500.label: PhysicsTireSystemConstructor
0x004e4500.summary: Constructor for physics tire system. Calls sub-initializers for forces, arrays, 4 tire structures, and engine RPM. Sets default field at offset 0x32BC to -1 and EngineMaxRPM at offset 0x39A4 to 0. Physics vehicle setup.

0x004e4590.name: F_4FieldPropagation
0x004e4590.label: FourFieldPropagate
0x004e4590.summary: Propagates integer value a2 across four fields at offsets 0x0, 0x8, 0x6E4, and 0x32C0. Synchronization/initialization of sub-structures within the physics tire system.

0x004e45b0.name: LargeConfigFunctionWithPhysicsConstants
0x004e45b0.label: VehiclePhysicsConfigAndStep
0x004e45b0.summary: Initializes and runs one physics time step — initializes tire model, parses vehicle HDV file, computes integration sub-step parameters, executes suspension and tire force solvers, and frees temporary allocations. Part of vehicle physics update.

0x004e4790.name: sub_4E4790
0x004e4790.label: VehiclePhysicsPerFrameReset
0x004e4790.summary: Resets per-frame vehicle physics state each tick — zeros accumulated wheel dynamics buffers, reinitializes per-tire constants (puncture=1.0, etc.), and conditionally calls WheelDynamicsInit on first frame. Core physics system.

0x004e4930.name: VehiclePhysicsModeDispatcher
0x004e4930.label: VehiclePhysicsModeDispatcher
0x004e4930.summary: Dispatches vehicle physics integration based on mode flag at offset 0x32BC — full init+step (mode 0), sub-step integration (mode 1), or pit/team-color update (mode 2). Central physics mode router.

0x004e49b0.name: VehicleSetupInitialization
0x004e49b0.label: VehiclePhysicsStateSnapshotUpdate
0x004e49b0.summary: Per-frame tick copies vehicle dynamics state (orientation matrix, position, steering geometry, suspension deflection, camera projection) from global physics globals into a local snapshot struct for the vehicle setup/rendering system.

0x004e4e60.name: PhysicsIntegrationStateMachine
0x004e4e60.label: PhysicsIntegrationStateMachine
0x004e4e60.summary: Selects integration sub-step size based on wheel speed squared vs threshold, then runs v4 iterations of suspension/tire physics (spring-damper reset, force computation, torque integration). Stores step value in 4 wheel slots (62-DWORD stride). Part of vehicle physics time integration.

0x004e4f40.name: SuspensionSpringDampingRateReset
0x004e4f40.label: SuspensionSpringDampingRateReset
0x004e4f40.summary: Resets spring/damper forces to zero for all wheels, applies brake cooling post-treatment, and recomputes damping rates based on suspension type (0=push-rod, 1=double-wishbone, 2=third-spring). Core of per-frame suspension force initialization.

0x004e5080.name: BrakeCoolingPostTreatment
0x004e5080.label: brake cooling effectiveness factor computation
0x004e5080.summary: Computes brake cooling effectiveness factor from temperature delta and cooling mode selector, clamped to [0,1]. Part of brake thermal/suspension system.

0x004e51a0.name: sub_4E51A0
0x004e51a0.label: AntiRollBarForceDistribution
0x004e51a0.summary: Computes and distributes anti-roll bar forces to the four wheels based on suspension travel, damper velocities interpolated from a lookup table, and a configurable distribution mode (front-only, rear-only, or all-four). Part of the vehicle physics integration pipeline.

0x004e5470.name: WheelForceCalculationSpringDamperTorque
0x004e5470.label: Per-Wheel Spring/Damper Force and Torque Computation
0x004e5470.summary: Computes per-wheel spring/damper forces, tire contact forces, and resulting suspension torques for all 4 wheels using wheel-space coordinate transforms. Core physics tick for suspension force integration.

0x004e58d0.name: sub_4E58D0
0x004e58d0.label: suspension spring-damper force accumulation
0x004e58d0.summary: Computes spring/damper forces from suspension displacement in local frame with gravity compensation, accumulating results per-axis. Part of suspension dynamics system.

0x004e5ae0.name: sub_4E5AE0
0x004e5ae0.label: VehicleAngularDynamicsAndSuspensionUpdate
0x004e5ae0.summary: Integrates vehicle angular velocity and torque from engine contribution and per-wheel forces, then computes suspension/damper response based on a mode selector. Part of the physics simulation system.

0x004e5f60.name: SuspensionAndWheelPhysics
0x004e5f60.label: Vehicle Physics Per-Frame Update (Suspension/Wheel/Tire/Engine)
0x004e5f60.summary: Computes full vehicle dynamics each frame: wheel contact positions, suspension forces, tire compound behavior, anti-roll bar forces, aerodynamic loads, engine/drivetrain parameters, and particle effects. Reads configuration from parameter structs (a2=car setup, a3=session/track data), writes results back into the vehicle state struct.

0x004e8010.name: TireBrushModelForceSolver
0x004e8010.label: Compute tire forces via brush/slip model
0x004e8010.summary: Solves tire longitudinal and lateral forces using the brush model across 4 wheels and 15 slip-ratio samples per frame. Applies load transfer, wet/dry grip scaling, and suspension geometry normalization.

0x004e8780.name: SuspensionRatioClamp
0x004e8780.label: suspension compression ratio clamp
0x004e8780.summary: Computes negated ratio of two suspension travel values and clamps to [0,1]. Yields normalized compression ratio for suspension dynamics.

0x004e87e0.name: BrakeThermalModel
0x004e87e0.label: brake thermal factor computation
0x004e87e0.summary: Computes normalized brake thermal factor from squared suspension displacement divided by heat capacity, clamped to [0,1]. Part of brake thermal simulation.

0x004e88b0.name: TireGripCoefficient
0x004e88b0.label: tire grip coefficient with anti-roll cross-coupling
0x004e88b0.summary: Computes per-corner tire grip coefficients with anti-roll bar cross-coupling term, selects min/max across axles based on mode selector, and clamps result to [0,1]. Part of tire dynamics system.

0x004e8b80.name: AerodynamicForceCalc
0x004e8b80.label: aerodynamic downforce/drag computation
0x004e8b80.summary: Computes aerodynamic force from speed-squared with weight compensation, table lookup with linear interpolation, and quadratic drag formula. Part of aerodynamic dynamics system.

0x004e8ce0.name: TireForceSolver
0x004e8ce0.label: tire force bisection solver with table lookups
0x004e8ce0.summary: Bisection-method root solver for tire contact force using table lookups with linear interpolation. Narrows bracket [lo,hi] until force function changes sign, returns interpolated root. Part of tire dynamics system.

0x004e9100.name: TireForce
0x004e9100.label: tire force friction-circle computation with table lookups
0x004e9100.summary: Computes tire force using friction-circle model with sign-selected lookup tables, linear interpolation, and aerodynamic drag term. Part of tire dynamics system.

0x004e9300.name: TireGripLateralForceCalculation
0x004e9300.label: lateral tire grip force with multi-contact iteration
0x004e9300.summary: Computes lateral tire grip force using friction-circle model, iterates over wheel contact patches to accumulate individual slip forces, limits by friction circle and contact capacity. Part of tire dynamics system.

0x004e9630.name: PositionChangeMonitor
0x004e9630.label: position change tracking with history save
0x004e9630.summary: Monitors position changes by storing current position to history and calling an external tracking function. Returns a tracking handle. Part of position/telemetry tracking system.

0x004e96c0.name: sub_4E96C0
0x004e96c0.label: vehicle proximity detection with position change tracking
0x004e96c0.summary: Determines vehicle proximity by tracking position changes, checking rotation alignment, and testing threshold distance against nearby entities. Part of collision/proximity detection system.

0x004e9980.name: ComputeSlipVelocityNorm
0x004e9980.label: slip velocity vector norm with local-frame transform
0x004e9980.summary: Transforms position delta (reference minus current) into local frame via rotation matrix, computes Euclidean norm, adds constant bias 3.2, and clamps to minimum threshold. Part of tire slip velocity computation.

0x004e9a40.name: VehicleBodyToWheelContactDistanceComputation
0x004e9a40.label: body-to-wheel contact distance with network write
0x004e9a40.summary: Computes local-frame distance from predicted vehicle body position to wheel contact reference, writes 13 contact elements to network packet, returns clamped norm. Part of vehicle dynamics/netcode system.

0x004e9bd0.name: F_3x3MatrixTransformWithTranslation
0x004e9bd0.label: 3x3 rotation + translation transform
0x004e9bd0.summary: Transforms local offset vector by 3x3 rotation matrix, adds body world position, stores world-space result. Standard rigid-body point transform for suspension/contact system.

0x004e9ca0.name: AIRacingLinePathFollowing
0x004e9ca0.label: AI Racing Line Path Node Traversal
0x004e9ca0.summary: Traverses the racing line's doubly-linked path nodes for an AI vehicle: looks up the current and target nodes via position queries, iterates node-by-node applying position/orientation to vehicle state, updates suspension and wheel contact distances, and toggles scene-node visibility for track-follow display. Part of the AI path-following and racing-line visualization system.

0x004ea040.name: F_3DCollisionDetectionWithAABBTestAndContactResp
0x004ea040.label: VehicleCollisionDetectionAABBAndContactResponse
0x004ea040.summary: Per-vehicle 3D collision detection: transforms contact point to vehicle-local space, performs AABB overlap test against vehicle bounds, iterates collision geometry vertices to find closest penetrating point, computes contact normal and penetration depth, and outputs collision response data (contact point, normal, force direction).

0x004ea970.name: CollisionDetectionSystem
0x004ea970.label: VehicleCollisionDetectionSystem
0x004ea970.summary: Per-frame collision detection system for a vehicle: iterates 13 contact-point slots, reads collision events from network packets, transforms contact points to world space, identifies colliding vehicle pairs, computes collision response (penetration depth, contact normal, impulse force), and dispatches force application to both vehicles.

0x004eb430.name: ParticleEffectUpdateDispatch
0x004eb430.label: Vehicle Surface Effect & Particle Update Dispatch
0x004eb430.summary: Per-frame vehicle surface-effect dispatcher — clears/queues particle effect slots, computes slip velocity and wheel contact, runs collision detection, then iterates vehicle components dispatching surface-type-specific effects (sparks, dust, smoke) with force-dependent intensity, and accumulates telemetry positions for camera tracking.

0x004ebc60.name: VehicleContactForceAccumulation
0x004ebc60.label: Vehicle Collision Response Accumulator
0x004ebc60.summary: Per-frame accumulation of contact forces from vehicle collisions: transforms local contact impulses through a rotation matrix into world-space linear and angular impulse accumulators, then dispatches to physics, particle effects, or pointer-computation subsystems based on a mode selector.

0x004ec080.name: VehicleTelemetryPositionAccumulator
0x004ec080.label: position accumulator with velocity integration
0x004ec080.summary: Accumulates velocity-scaled deltas into position, transforms by rotation matrix, dispatches to rigid-body or pointer-based update depending on mode selector. Part of vehicle telemetry/positioning system.

0x004ec1a0.name: CollisionSparkParticleEffects
0x004ec1a0.label: CollisionSparkAndDamageParticleEffects
0x004ec1a0.summary: Per-frame collision response visual/audio effects: computes collision damage from force magnitude and direction, dispatches spark particle effects at contact points (8 body + 4 wheel zones), triggers repair/damage service events, applies steering geometry deformation, and resets tire scrub on severe impacts.

0x004ed030.name: ActorMotionPostProcessingUpdate
0x004ed030.label: ActorMotionPostProcessingUpdate
0x004ed030.summary: Post-processing update for actor motion. Runs lazy initialization on two subsystems, transitions state, resets one-shot flag, interpolates mismatched damping values, selects force feedback source based on contact state, solves tire-brush forces, and optionally clamps velocity via global time. Physics/timing update.

0x004ed0f0.name: AccumulatorClamp
0x004ed0f0.label: accumulator with hysteresis threshold clamping
0x004ed0f0.summary: Accumulates input scaled by 0.225, applies upper bound clamp, checks hysteresis thresholds to update output value and flag. Part of accumulator/clamping system for physics.

0x004ed1c0.name: FloatParameterForwarder
0x004ed1c0.label: float parameter accumulator dispatcher
0x004ed1c0.summary: Forwards float input to AccumulatorClamp, conditionally dispatches to PhysicsForceScaleDispatch when mode flag is zero. Part of physics parameter routing system.

0x004ed250.name: RepairServiceStateDispatcher
0x004ed250.label: repair/pit service state switch dispatcher
0x004ed250.summary: Dispatches repair service state transitions (0-13) with subslot cleanup, wheel collision flagging, resource release, and brush-model force solver calls. Part of repair/pit service system.

0x004ed380.name: AnisoVectorTripleProduct
0x004ed380.label: anisotropic scalar triple product
0x004ed380.summary: Computes anisotropic triple product (cross product scaled by per-axis factors, then dotted with second vector) with bias. Part of anisotropic force/spring computation.

0x004ed420.name: VehicleGeometryProximityTest
0x004ed420.label: vehicle geometry proximity test with collision response
0x004ed420.summary: Tests proximity of a point to vehicle geometry by transforming to local frame, checking distance against per-corner thresholds, and computing contact force with anisotropic triple product. Part of collision detection system.

0x004ed7b0.name: F_33MatrixVectorMultiply
0x004ed7b0.label: 3x3 matrix * vector multiply
0x004ed7b0.summary: Multiplies a 3x3 matrix (9 floats at `this`) by input vector `a2`, stores result in `a3`. Pure math utility for rigid-body transforms.

0x004ed810.name: WheelTireForceUpdate
0x004ed810.label: wheel tire temperature update with thermal model
0x004ed810.summary: Updates per-corner tire temperatures using convection and friction heating model, normalizes to [0,1] range. Part of tire thermal dynamics system.

0x004ed960.name: FuelConsumptionAndWear
0x004ed960.label: Fuel Consumption and Component Wear Update
0x004ed960.summary: Per-frame update of fuel consumption, tire wear, and random mechanical failures (engine, gearbox, puncture). Decrements fuel based on throttle and engine power, applies tire wear using track grip interpolation, and triggers random failure events at cooldown intervals.

0x004ee150.name: EngineWearFailureSimulation
0x004ee150.label: engine wear/failure simulation
0x004ee150.summary: Initializes 4 engine wear values to FLT_MAX, optionally computes wear using noise generator and session parameters when engine wear mode is active (1 or 2). Part of engine damage/wear system.

0x004ee230.name: ThrottleBrakeOverride
0x004ee230.label: throttle/brake override with sentinel detection
0x004ee230.summary: Computes override value from brake ratio and cooling factor (v1³ * factor * 0.5), replaces throttle/brake channel values when reference equals sentinel -789.0. Part of throttle/brake control system.

0x004ee2d0.name: sub_4EE2D0
0x004ee2d0.label: Vehicle Physics Collision & Tire Contact Update
0x004ee2d0.summary: Per-frame vehicle physics update handling tire-ground contact, collision detection via spatial grid, and particle/spark effects. Dispatches to tire slip force solver, throttle/brake overrides, and collision effect systems based on physics mode (0-3).

0x004ef180.name: WheelContactTransform
0x004ef180.label: wheel contact transform with collision feature query
0x004ef180.summary: Transforms per-corner vectors by 3x3 rotation matrix, adds offset, queries collision normal from feature, and updates surface friction for each of 4 wheel contacts. Part of wheel contact/collision system.

0x004ef2e0.name: sub_4EF2E0
0x004ef2e0.label: ForceFeedbackEventLogger
0x004ef2e0.summary: Monitors force feedback state changes and logs events to ring buffer via ProgressBarEventEncode. Throttled to ~8Hz (0.125s debounce) with forced-flush path when delta > 4.0s.

0x004ef4f0.name: PositionUpdateWithTelemetryRecording
0x004ef4f0.label: TelemetryRecordingTick
0x004ef4f0.summary: Records position telemetry data to ring buffer when session time exceeds last recording time by 4.5s threshold. Part of telemetry/event recording system.

0x004ef5a0.name: SessionStateTransition
0x004ef5a0.label: SessionStateTransitionHandler
0x004ef5a0.summary: Updates session state pointer and handles entry/exit side-effects. On state exit (non-NULL → NULL), records vehicle position and race time. On entry to state 1, triggers position change monitor, cleanup flags, and AI speed adjustment.

0x004ef680.name: RideHeightDelta
0x004ef680.label: RideHeightDeltaCompute
0x004ef680.summary: Computes average ride height delta (pitch component) from four corner ride heights and packs into a 3-vector with track Y position. Part of vehicle physics/suspension system.

0x004ef6c0.name: CoordinateTransformWithOffset
0x004ef6c0.label: CoordinateTransformWithOffset
