0x004ef6c0.summary: Transforms a coordinate vector from one space to another using Euler angle rotation matrix, ride height delta, and position offsets. Part of vehicle physics coordinate transformation system.

0x004ef7c0.name: AIVehiclePathPositionTracking
0x004ef7c0.label: AIVehiclePathPositionTracking
0x004ef7c0.summary: Tracks AI vehicle position error against target path position, accumulates correction offsets, and ensures rigid body constraint is solved. Part of AI vehicle path following system.

0x004ef930.name: RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate
0x004ef930.label: RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate
0x004ef930.summary: Manages race start countdown sequence — advances countdown steps, triggers sound effects, records telemetry on green light, and manages timer state. Part of race start system.

0x004efa40.name: VehicleClimbAdjust
0x004efa40.label: VehicleClimbAdjust
0x004efa40.summary: Adjusts vehicle climb/throttle value with optional vibration noise from weather table when rigid body constraint is present. Part of vehicle suspension/climb control system.

0x004efac0.name: ConditionalGate
0x004efac0.label: ConditionalGate
0x004efac0.summary: Conditional gate that resets a per-instance field or a global flag based on rigid body constraint. Part of vehicle state management system.

0x004efae0.name: TireScrubReset
0x004efae0.label: TireScrubReset
0x004efae0.summary: Resets tire scrub value to zero when wear mode is active and vehicle has rigid body. Part of tire wear/physics system.

0x004efbd0.name: RayTriangleIntersectionWithBarycentricCoordinate
0x004efbd0.label: RayTriangleIntersectionWithBarycentric
0x004efbd0.summary: Computes ray-triangle intersection distance using barycentric coordinates. Returns minimum ride height delta clamped at 0.025, or `this[3371]` (rest height) if no valid intersection found.

0x004eff00.name: ForceDirectionProjection
0x004eff00.label: ForceDirectionProjection
0x004eff00.summary: Normalizes a force direction vector and computes negated scalar projection of another vector onto it. Returns zero if direction vector is zero. Part of physics force system.

0x004effd0.name: DistanceComparison
0x004effd0.label: DistanceComparison
0x004effd0.summary: Performs 3D transform and render call, returning boolean comparison result. Part of rendering/distance culling system.

0x004f0050.name: DistanceProjectionCalc
0x004f0050.label: DistanceProjectionCalc
0x004f0050.summary: Computes projected signed distance along a direction vector between two monitored positions, clamped to TrackRefSpeed range. Part of position tracking system.

0x004f01b0.name: sub_4F01B0
0x004f01b0.label: ProjectedDistanceWithLapWrap
0x004f01b0.summary: Computes interpolated projected distance along a track segment between two waypoints, with lap-count wraparound correction based on session state flag. Part of position/lap tracking system.

0x004f03e0.name: TeamColorLoader
0x004f03e0.label: TeamColorLoader
0x004f03e0.summary: Loads team color data via utility function and applies it to vehicle physics time step. Part of vehicle appearance/team customization system.

0x004f0430.name: sub_4F0430
0x004f0430.label: VehiclePhysicsTick
0x004f0430.summary: Per-frame vehicle physics update that integrates position/orientation from velocity, computes 4-wheel suspension geometry and collision transforms, and triggers vehicle sound/HUD based on a physics-mode selector (cases 0-3). Part of the vehicle dynamics/physics tick system.

0x004f0d20.name: sub_4F0D20
0x004f0d20.label: TeamColorScaleApply
0x004f0d20.summary: Applies team color scale to object after conditional render transform, comparing vehicle team color against current player. Part of rendering/appearance system.

0x004f0dd0.name: SteeringForceWithRandom
0x004f0dd0.label: SteeringForceWithRandomNoise
0x004f0dd0.summary: Computes steering force with random sign noise and speed-squared factor, clamped to [-0.3, 0.3], then updates UI timer. Part of steering/force feedback system.

0x004f0f40.name: WheelContactForceAggregation
0x004f0f40.label: WheelContactForceAggregation
0x004f0f40.summary: Aggregates contact forces across all 4 wheels by surface type, computing weighted average direction and sending to PerIndexStructFieldSetter. Part of wheel contact/tire physics system.

0x004f1120.name: WheelForceAggregation
0x004f1120.label: WheelForceAggregation
0x004f1120.summary: Aggregates wheel forces across all 4 wheels by surface type with speed-clamped weighting, computing normalized direction for PerIndexStructFieldSetter. Part of wheel force/tire physics system.

0x004f12e0.name: VehicleSoundTrigger
0x004f12e0.label: VehicleSoundTrigger
0x004f12e0.summary: Triggers vehicle sound/HUD events based on wheel contact/force surface types, velocity change, timer state, and rigid body status. Part of vehicle audio/HUD system.

0x004f1510.name: ScaleAudioPitch
0x004f1510.label: ScaleAudioPitch
0x004f1510.summary: Scales audio pitch and wheel RPM values by speed ratio based on physics random flags, then solves tire brush model. Part of audio/pitch scaling system.

0x004f1630.name: TireNameAccessor
0x004f1630.label: TireNameAccessor
0x004f1630.summary: Looks up tire name string from compound index; returns default path if not found. Part of tire/vehicle configuration system.

0x004f1650.name: VehicleSetupDataCopy
0x004f1650.label: Vehicle Setup Data Copy & Render Transform
0x004f1650.summary: Copies vehicle setup data (position, velocity, orientation matrix) from multiple source buffers into this object, then performs 3x3 matrix-vector multiplications to compute transformed render coordinates. Vehicle physics / rendering system.

0x004f17a0.name: EffectParameterSetter
0x004f17a0.label: EffectParameterSetter
0x004f17a0.summary: Sets three effect parameters: throttle/climb value, a scaled parameter using tire choice multiplier, and another parameter. Part of vehicle effect/parameter system.

0x004f17d0.name: MatrixVectorSetup
0x004f17d0.label: MatrixVectorSetup
0x004f17d0.summary: Copies a 3x3 rotation matrix and input vector, computes their product, stores result. Part of vehicle physics/matrix transformation system.

0x004f1860.name: ConditionalMathDispatch
0x004f1860.label: ConditionalSolverDispatch
0x004f1860.summary: Dispatches solver call when rigid body constraint is absent. Part of physics solver dispatch system.

0x004f1890.name: SpeedValueSetterWithGlobalMirror
0x004f1890.label: SpeedValueSetterWithGlobalMirror
0x004f1890.summary: Sets per-instance speed value and conditionally mirrors to global when rigid body constraint is absent. Part of speed/value management system.

0x004f18c0.name: sub_4F18C0
0x004f18c0.label: TireCompoundSetupWheel
0x004f18c0.summary: Sets up tire compound parameters for a specific wheel index: looks up compound data, computes spring/damping/force values, and optionally solves tire brush model. Part of tire/compound configuration system.

0x004f1aa0.name: VelocityThresholdCheck
0x004f1aa0.label: velocity / contact threshold gate
0x004f1aa0.summary: Checks vehicle velocity against range [2,4] with an additional distance comparison guard. Part of collision/contact detection system.

0x004f1b10.name: RatioComputationWithClamping
0x004f1b10.label: normalized absolute ratio clamp
0x004f1b10.summary: Computes absolute ratio of two float fields, clamps result to [0.0, 1.0]. Used by sound effect triggering for normalized intensity calculation.

0x004f1b50.name: CameraModeSetter
0x004f1b50.label: camera view mode / render offset reset
0x004f1b50.summary: Sets camera view mode global and resets render offset fields based on input flag and internal state. Called during pit stop camera transitions.

0x004f1ba0.name: WheelForceParameterSet
0x004f1ba0.label: wheel force parameter storage / direct apply
0x004f1ba0.summary: Stores four wheel force/torque parameters into struct fields or applies them directly to rigid body based on enable flag. Called during pit stop wheel operations.

0x004f1c20.name: ReplayAIStateCheck
0x004f1c20.label: replay / AI state active check
0x004f1c20.summary: Reads a pointer to an AI/replay state object and checks if its state flag equals 1. Used by overtaking system to determine if AI or replay is active.

0x004f1c40.name: VehicleYawRotationRecoveryController
0x004f1c40.label: Vehicle Yaw Rotation Recovery Controller
0x004f1c40.summary: Detects excessive vehicle yaw rotation (spinning/flipping) and triggers recovery by resetting vehicle dynamics state, recomputing orientation from atan2 of direction components, and snapping position to the racing line. Monitors wheel contact states and applies corrective contact forces for partial loss of ground contact.

0x004f1fe0.name: sub_4F1FE0
0x004f1fe0.label: VehicleYawRecoveryStateMachine
0x004f1fe0.summary: Manages yaw recovery state for a vehicle: accumulates time since last check, monitors postProcessInput state, validates qualifying/disqualifying conditions, computes vehicle position relative to track, and triggers recovery (position reset + audio + AI path tracking) when vehicle is off-track beyond timeout. Vehicle physics/recovery system.

0x004f2320.name: VehicleDynamicsStateReset
0x004f2320.label: vehicle dynamics state zero reset
0x004f2320.summary: Zeroes rendering state fields (RenderX/Y/Z and related) and per-wheel data blocks. Optionally triggers additional suspension physics reset based on enable flag.

0x004f23c0.name: sub_4F23C0
0x004f23c0.label: TireModelConstantsFree
0x004f23c0.summary: Frees all six tire model constant pointer allocations (0x8ADB00-0x8ADB2C) by calling FreeWrapper_7bcf on each non-null pointer. Cleanup/shutdown function.

0x004f24f0.name: VehicleDamageModel
0x004f24f0.label: ParseVehicleDamageConfig
0x004f24f0.summary: Parses a vehicle damage configuration file/stream, extracting physics parameters (collision, mass, inertia, detach thresholds, aero coefficients, random damage factors) for engine, front/rear wings, 4 wheels, and 8 detachable body parts into a struct.

0x004f2c60.name: PerWheelBrakeSuspensionDataLoader
0x004f2c60.label: PerWheelBrakeSuspensionDataLoader
0x004f2c60.summary: Parses per-wheel brake and suspension configuration data from a vehicle setup file line, populating a double array with spring rates, damper settings, camber, tire pressure, brake temperature/wear/torque parameters, and ride heights; converts brake optimum temperature from Celsius to Kelvin (+273.16).

0x004f3090.name: FenderAeroSetupSectionReader
0x004f3090.label: fender aero setup section parser
0x004f3090.summary: Reads the fender aerodynamics setup section from a vehicle file, parsing center, drag, lift, and sideways parameter fields. Sets a flag when center data is loaded.

0x004f3190.name: QuadraticCubicPolynomialEvaluator
0x004f3190.label: dual quadratic polynomial evaluator
0x004f3190.summary: Evaluates two quadratic polynomials (a2²*C2 + a2*C1 + C0) using double-precision coefficients stored in the struct. Outputs zero if the enable flag is clear.

0x004f3240.name: VehicleDampingDirectionValidation
0x004f3240.label: damping direction sign validation
0x004f3240.summary: Parses 3 damping values per direction index (0-5 corresponding to X+/X-/Y+/Y-/Z+/Z-), validates that damping sign opposes motion, and logs warnings for wrong-signed damping. Suppresses logging on server sessions.

0x004f3490.name: ArithmeticComparison_3490
0x004f3490.label: triple absolute-value normalizer
0x004f3490.summary: Reads three long double values via string parser, then enforces non-negativity by applying fabs to each. Used during vehicle file parsing to normalize parameter tuples.

0x004f34e0.name: TireModelDataInit
0x004f34e0.label: Tire Model Data Structure Initializer
0x004f34e0.summary: Initializes the per-vehicle tire model data structure with default values: zeroes out runtime accumulators, sets sentinel handles (-1), populates tire friction/camber/slip-angle coefficient arrays, and loads a configuration file path.

0x004f3c10.name: EngineMapSetupFieldDefinitions
0x004f3c10.label: engine map range/setting field definitions
0x004f3c10.summary: Registers three engine parameter range/setting pairs (rev limit, engine map, engine braking multiplier) with CRTMathHelper for vehicle file parsing. Applies scale factor for RPM conversion.

0x004f3c80.name: EngineSectionParser
0x004f3c80.label: Engine HDV Section Parser
0x004f3c80.summary: Parses the [ENGINE] section of a vehicle HDV/SVM file, reading RPM-torque curves, idle/launch/rev-limit logic, thermal properties (oil/water/radiator), lifetime averages, starter timing, and fuel consumption. Converts RPM fields from RPM to rad/s and validates curve ordering.

0x004f4270.name: TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser
0x004f4270.label: ParseSVM_HDV_VehicleConfigFile
0x004f4270.summary: Parses .SVM and .HDV vehicle configuration files line-by-line, dispatching to section-specific parsers for general vehicle data, aero surfaces, suspension, engine, driveline, and per-wheel brake settings. Writes parsed values into both the internal vehicle setup struct and the output vehicle state struct.

0x004f6720.name: ParameterizedCurveInterpolation
0x004f6720.label: piecewise-linear curve interpolator (dual output)
0x004f6720.summary: Interpolates along a piecewise-linear curve defined by (x, y1, y2) triple points. Returns two interpolated values; if y2 < y1, averages both to midpoint. Handles edge extrapolation and single-point case.

0x004f6850.name: RandomOffsetCalculator
0x004f6850.label: randomized offset computation
0x004f6850.summary: Computes a2 * scale + bias, optionally randomizing a2 first via sub_5881F0 based on an enable flag. Used for stochastic variation in physics parameters.

0x004f6880.name: BiasValueComputation
0x004f6880.label: bias-offset randomized value (variant 2)
0x004f6880.summary: Computes a2 * scale + bias with optional randomization of a2, using different parameter offsets than RandomOffsetCalculator. Variant of the same stochastic physics parameter computation.

0x004f68b0.name: TireForceTorqueComputation
0x004f68b0.label: tire force/torque computation with quadratic model
0x004f68b0.summary: Computes tire force (3 components) and torque outputs using quadratic polynomials and absolute values. Force component a4[2] and torque a5 use quadratic functions of a2 with additional bias/scale terms on a3.

0x004f6950.name: QuadraticForceModel
0x004f6950.label: simplified quadratic force model (no bias term)
0x004f6950.summary: Computes one torque (a4) and three force components (a3[0-2]) using quadratic polynomials and absolute values. Variation of tire force model without the bias/scale term on torque output.

0x004f69e0.name: LinearVehicleParameterEvaluation
0x004f69e0.label: linear force/torque parameter evaluation
0x004f69e0.summary: Evaluates linear combinations of input parameters (a2, a3, a4) with stored coefficients plus bias terms. Outputs force components (absolute values) and a combined torque-like quantity. No enable flag — always active.

0x004f6a50.name: QuadraticForceTorqueCurveEvaluation
0x004f6a50.label: quadratic curve evaluation with split linear term
0x004f6a50.summary: Evaluates a quadratic curve: a2²*C2 + a2*C1 + a2*C3 + C0. The linear contribution is split across two coefficients (C1 and C3). Disabled by flag at 0x4D4.

0x004f6bc0.name: StructZeroInit_6bc0
0x004f6bc0.label: StructZeroInit_6bc0
0x004f6bc0.summary: Zeros 17 consecutive dwords (offsets 0x0 through 0x40) of a struct, including listed fields at 0x0, 0x8, 0xC, and 0x40. Initialization helper.

0x004f6bf0.name: RPMRangeLoader
0x004f6bf0.label: RPMRangeLoader
0x004f6bf0.summary: Parses MinRPM, MaxRPM, and NatRPM string key-value pairs for a given gear index (0-4), converts RPM to rad/s (multiply by pi/30), and stores result in `this[3*a3 + {1,2,3}]`. Natural RPM stores the inverse (1/value).

0x004f6d60.name: ArrayNonZeroCounter
0x004f6d60.label: ArrayNonZeroCounter
0x004f6d60.summary: Counts consecutive non-zero entries (max 5) from an array pointed to by `this[16]` (offset 0x40). Stores count in `*this` (offset 0x0). Returns when a zero entry is encountered or limit reached.

0x004f6d90.name: ParametricInterpolationBlending
0x004f6d90.label: ParametricInterpolationBlending
0x004f6d90.summary: Finds which range segment a parameter `a2` falls into, then computes sqrt-based blending weights between adjacent segments and invokes virtual callbacks with scaled values. Used for suspension force blending.

0x004f7010.name: StateHandlerDispatch
0x004f7010.label: dual-table state handler dispatch
0x004f7010.summary: Selects one of two handler tables based on a flag byte, iterates up to 45 handler objects calling each via vtable method at offset 8. Updates the flag byte after dispatch.

0x004f70c0.name: sub_4F70C0
0x004f70c0.label: TireConfig_LoadAndInit
0x004f70c0.summary: Initializes tire configuration data by loading tire property tables, sound-file paths, and visual parameters from global config arrays into two 180-byte per-tire buffers (45 slots each). Performs wildcard string matching and color-palette/setup-parameter resolution for each tire slot.

0x004f7440.name: TireSlotStructInit
0x004f7440.label: TireSlotStructInit
0x004f7440.summary: Initializes a tire-slot struct: copies default directory path via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, sets slot IDs at offsets 8 and 12 to -1 (invalid/unused), and clears active flag at offset 16 to 0.

0x004f7460.name: sub_4F7460
0x004f7460.label: Vehicle Engine Sound Configuration Loader
0x004f7460.summary: Parses a vehicle audio configuration file, loading engine RPM sound profiles, road noise samples, shift/hit/skid sounds, and engine volume/shape/range parameters into global state. Part of the audio/sound engine initialization system.

0x004f81d0.name: StringMatchWithWildcard
0x004f81d0.label: ObjectFindByString
0x004f81d0.summary: Looks up an object by string identifier through the InitStatus (dword_8AC4C4) virtual method table. Returns handle in `*a1`. Uses default directory path if string is empty (sets output to 0).

0x004f8250.name: ObjectDestructor
0x004f8250.label: ObjectDestructor
0x004f8250.summary: Calls vtable destruction chain (release at +8, cleanup at +24, delete at +0 with arg 1) on a COM-like object pointer, then nulls it. Used for safe object disposal.

0x004f8280.name: ColorPaletteLookupByIndex
0x004f8280.label: ColorPaletteLookupByIndex
0x004f8280.summary: Returns RGB color triple from palette by index. Two color groups: bright/light (indices 0-4, 43) and dark/helm (indices 12-20, 38-41, 44). Defaults to MaterialColorR/TrackFrictionParam/ModuleInterfaceVal if index not in either group.

0x004f8330.name: ArithmeticComparison_8330
0x004f8330.label: inverse difference with zero floor
0x004f8330.summary: Computes 1.0 / (value_at_0x80 - value_at_0x84) if the difference is positive, otherwise writes 0. Used for computing a reciprocal distance or stiffness factor.

0x004f8370.name: ArithmeticComparison_8370
0x004f8370.label: StructReinitHelper
0x004f8370.summary: Resets struct state: frees double buffers, reinitializes tire slots, resets two array counters, clears field at 0x94, and sets active flag at offset 4 to 1.

0x004f83b0.name: DoubleBufferFree
0x004f83b0.label: DoubleBufferFree
0x004f83b0.summary: Frees two double-buffered arrays of 45 objects each (offset 0x694 and 0x6D8). Destroys each object via ObjectDestructor, frees the buffer memory, nulls pointers, and clears active flag at offset 4.

0x004f8440.name: SuspensionForceComputationWithPerCornerVirtualDi
0x004f8440.label: Suspension Force Per-Corner Virtual Dispatch
0x004f8440.summary: Computes suspension forces for each corner of the vehicle by transforming body-space positions through a 3x3 rotation matrix, applying parametric interpolation blending for brake/steering force feedback, and dispatching to per-corner virtual function handlers. Iterates over 40 corner slots (i=5..44) calling setup-specific force computation.

0x004f87c0.name: HUDElementConfig
0x004f87c0.label: indexed HUD element force feedback configuration
0x004f87c0.summary: Configures an indexed HUD element with force feedback gain and magnitude values. Selects gain source based on a flag in a sub-struct and clamps output index to [0,3].

0x004f88a0.name: SoundEffectTrigger
0x004f88a0.label: randomized sound/HUD intensity trigger
0x004f88a0.summary: Computes a clamped ratio of two sub-struct floats, combines with noise table values and random number to produce two intensity parameters, then configures an indexed HUD element. Used for randomized sound/feedback effects.

0x004f89a0.name: SoundEffectTrigger_89a0
0x004f89a0.label: randomized sound/HUD trigger (variant 2, higher indices)
0x004f89a0.summary: Variant of SoundEffectTrigger that computes intensity via ratio and noise, then configures HUD element with base indices 15-17 (vs 12-14 in the other variant). Same noise/random jitter pattern.

0x004f8b00.name: sub_4F8B00
0x004f8b00.label: OffsetAdjustByHalfRange
0x004f8b00.summary: Calls ArithmeticComparison_8c00 on array at this+3. If it returns 0 (failure/mismatch), subtracts 0x8000 from three short values at offsets 4, 8, 12 (converting unsigned 16-bit range to signed).

0x004f8b50.name: sub_4F8B50
0x004f8b50.label: VfxModuleLoader
0x004f8b50.summary: Loads VFX dynamic library via LoadLibraryA, resolves five function entry points (Open, Close, ZeroSet, SetVideoMode, GetTracking) via GetProcAddress, and calls VFXOpen to initialize. Returns 0 on success, 1 on load failure, 4 on missing exports.

0x004f8d70.name: sub_4F8D70
0x004f8d70.label: Frame-Rate HUD Counter Widget Initializer
0x004f8d70.summary: Initializes a HUD frame-rate counter display widget: allocates a backing sub-object (76 bytes), sets screen position from resolution constants, loads the "Mas" font and "FTFrameRate" bitmap surface, and registers the string for display. Part of the HUD/debug overlay system.

0x004f8ea0.name: FrameRateCounterInitReset
0x004f8ea0.label: FrameRateCounterInitReset
0x004f8ea0.summary: Resets frame rate counter struct: frees object at offset 0x18, searches for "FTFrameRate" string entry in linked list, and zeros all 13 counter/timer fields (offsets 0x0-0x2C and 0x6C).

0x004f8f10.name: ConditionalInitBranch
0x004f8f10.label: FrameRateTimerReinit
0x004f8f10.summary: Resets high-resolution timer and updates counter parameter. On parameter a2==0, also cleans up frame rate string list entry. Gated on struct being initialized.

0x004f8f50.name: sub_4F8F50
0x004f8f50.label: FrameRateMonitorAndOverlayRenderer
0x004f8f50.summary: Tracks frame rate/performance statistics (min, max, instantaneous FPS, frame counter, override value) across four display modes, formats the result into a string buffer, and renders it as a text overlay via the rendering subsystem. Debug/performance monitoring HUD system.

0x004f9160.name: UtilityFunction_9160
0x004f9160.label: ParticleIndexSetter
0x004f9160.summary: Sets the current particle array index (dword_8AFE6C) and stores the corresponding value (dword_8AFE68) when the requested index is within valid range retrieved from dword_8AFE64.

0x004f9240.name: MultiTableCoordinateSearch
0x004f9240.label: MultiTableCoordinateSearch
0x004f9240.summary: Searches multiple coordinate tables for a matching 4-tuple (4 coordinate values). Iterates tables by index, calling UtilityFunction_9160 to track current table, then searches entries within each table via GlobalGuardedFieldReader. Returns matching entry index or -1.

0x004f9310.name: sub_4F9310
0x004f9310.label: ArraySlotCheckWithFlagConfig
0x004f9310.summary: Computes configuration flags from mode/display state, stores network packet buffer index, and calls ArraySlotCheckConditionalCall. On failure, logs "CUBE error" message with directory path. Early exit if ParticleLifeValue is zero.

0x004f9420.name: sub_4F9420
0x004f9420.label: CoordinateSearchResultStore
0x004f9420.summary: Searches coordinate tables via MultiTableCoordinateSearch, stores the result and input parameters into globals on success. Returns 0 on match, 1 if no match found.

0x004f9480.name: sub_4F9480
0x004f9480.label: Loading Screen Progress Bar and Track Intro Renderer
0x004f9480.summary: Renders the loading/transition screen: extracts the current track name, loads and displays LOD bitmaps (track preview, logo), draws a horizontal progress bar that fills proportionally to the loading progress value `a2` against a computed threshold (`VehicleCount*1.5+113.0`), displays the track name and sub-title in two font sizes, and when loading completes, cleans up resources and dispatches to the next game state.

0x004f9ad0.name: ArithmeticComparison_9ad0
0x004f9ad0.label: GlobalTimeAccumulatorUpdate
0x004f9ad0.summary: Advances multiple time accumulator globals (SessionTime, InputAxisDeadZone, EngineCoolingRate, ScoringDefaultReturn) by the same delta value obtained from sub_556730.

0x004f9b30.name: StateFlagComputation
0x004f9b30.label: StateFlagComputation
0x004f9b30.summary: Computes state flags from sub_4F9B20 result, optionally sets HUD-disable bit. Dispatches via CallWrapper_c060; if result is -2, sets audio init success flag.

0x004f9b70.name: FileLoadWithRetryLoop
0x004f9b70.label: FileLoadWithRetryLoop
0x004f9b70.summary: Loads a file via ObjectCreationWithRollbackOnFailure with path fallback retry. Displays Bink video loading sequence with retry loop until input device detected or video completes. Cleans up resources on exit.

0x004f9d60.name: ResourceFileLoader
0x004f9d60.label: LoadResourceWithTimedLoadingScreen
0x004f9d60.summary: Loads a resource from either direct path or default directory + override path; if resource not immediately available, displays a timed loading animation with optional input polling that breaks early on user input.

0x004f9fc0.name: sub_4F9FC0
0x004f9fc0.label: SessionTimeAndTimerReset
0x004f9fc0.summary: Initializes session time from parameter, resets performance-counter timer, performs two bounds/index checks against a data table, and reads input axis dead zone.

0x004fa000.name: VidMan_Enter
0x004fa000.label: VidMan_Enter
0x004fa000.summary: Video manager entry point — initializes the rendering subsystem by creating the game window, configuring graphics state, and initializing sub-modules. If the current working directory does not match the configured game directory, it relaunches the game executable via CreateProcessA in the correct directory. Part of the startup/initialization system.

0x004fa2f0.name: VidMan_Setup
0x004fa2f0.label: VidmanSetupLogInit
0x004fa2f0.summary: Initializes a debug message buffer with a path prefix and logs an "entered VidMan" message on success.

0x004fa320.name: VidMan_Init
0x004fa320.label: VidManInitialize
0x004fa320.summary: Initializes the video/visual manager subsystem: sets rendering flags, loads the track scene file, initializes the audio engine with collision geometry, and configures force feedback. Returns 0 on success, 1 if audio engine initialization fails.

0x004fa640.name: VidMan_Restart
0x004fa640.label: VidManRestartStateInit
0x004fa640.summary: Reinitializes video manager state on game restart — writes debug log, resets rendering mode flags per session type, resets session timer, axis dead zone, and render display list pointers.

0x004fa7e0.name: sub_4FA7E0
0x004fa7e0.label: MainGameFrameTick
0x004fa7e0.summary: Main per-frame game tick: handles scene rendering setup, session-state-dependent global-float selection, one-time display initialization, weather-based rendering configuration, per-vehicle UI widget updates, audio subsystem dispatch, pause-text overlay rendering, and frame-delta-time accumulation (clamped to 0.5s) with optional audio-init retry on byte_8AFE72.

0x004fac00.name: VidMan_Post
0x004fac00.label: VidManPostCleanupAndScenePathRegister
0x004fac00.summary: Post-race video manager cleanup — resets frame rate counter, releases collision geometry handle, clears global state, extracts directory path from current scene struct (strips filename) and registers it via string matching.

0x004fad00.name: VidMan_Exit
0x004fad00.label: VidManExitCleanup
0x004fad00.summary: Video manager exit handler — logs exit, shuts down collision system, dispatches race time delta handle, runs cleanup subroutines, and frees race time delta memory if allocated.

0x004faec0.name: F_3DPositionDeltaComputation
0x004faec0.label: Compute3DPositionDelta
0x004faec0.summary: Computes 3D position delta between current-position pointer and stored reference, or between stored position and reference pointer. Falls back to (0, 0, -1.0f) when neither pointer is available.

0x004faf60.name: sub_4FAF60
0x004faf60.label: SuspensionContactGeometryChainPropagation
0x004faf60.summary: Computes suspension contact geometry for a vehicle physics node: calculates distance vectors from reference position to linked neighbor objects, normalizes the direction, computes approach angles via atan2, and propagates cosine similarity values through a chain of up to 4 linked physics nodes. Vehicle suspension/physics system.

0x004fb260.name: sub_4FB260
0x004fb260.label: lerp-based physics state propagation
0x004fb260.summary: Computes four output fields using a lerp-interpolated base value multiplied by per-field coefficients plus bias terms. Used for physics state propagation with distance/time falloff.

0x004fb2e0.name: VehicleProximity
0x004fb2e0.label: ComputeVehicleProximityDistances
0x004fb2e0.summary: Computes closest-approach proximity distances between this vehicle and two other entities by projecting position+direction lines. Stores results to output fields, with FLT_MAX sentinels for parallel or non-intersecting cases.

0x004fb5d0.name: FAILNODOCENTRY
0x004fb5d0.label: InitLinkedDampingCoefficients
0x004fb5d0.summary: Initializes two float[8] arrays with values derived from a linked-list traversal. If seed >= 500 fills all entries with 500.0; otherwise walks chain accumulating per-node value, filling array entries whose index exceeds per-node thresholds.

0x004fb6d0.name: sub_4FB6D0
0x004fb6d0.label: signed-distance collision/penalty metric
0x004fb6d0.summary: Computes a signed distance metric between a target position and the owning object, considering direction bias, two reference points (sub-structs A and B), and Y-axis displacement. Returns the maximum of several distance-based penalties.

0x004fb910.name: sub_4FB910
0x004fb910.label: ComputeSessionDurationSeconds
0x004fb910.summary: Returns session duration in seconds based on event configuration index (days + hours). For certain session types, checks if track is Monaco and subtracts one day.

0x004fba10.name: sub_4FBA10
0x004fba10.label: Cloud / Skybox Scene Graph Initializer
0x004fba10.summary: Initializes cloud and skybox rendering state: resolves scene graph nodes for skybox and three cloud layers (normal, snowy, rainy), builds arrays of cloud node handles from the audio network graph, computes cloud opacity and noise-driven animation speeds, and calculates bounding boxes. Called during weather setup from sub_4FCAA0.

0x004fbd70.name: CameraViewportRenderSetup
0x004fbd70.label: CameraViewportRenderSetup
0x004fbd70.summary: Sets up camera viewports for rendering: detects session type changes, adjusts camera position per viewport, manages render-state fade transitions, computes per-object alpha blending from gradient ranges, and updates pit-crew animation offsets for both primary and secondary viewport layers.

0x004fc170.name: RenderColorUpdate
0x004fc170.label: UpdateRenderEntryColors
0x004fc170.summary: Updates color value across all render entries in a scene graph. Converts float alpha to 24-bit grayscale color, collects up to 16 node pointers, then patches color field (offset 24) in each node's packed array while preserving existing alpha channel.

0x004fc2f0.name: CloudSceneObjectRandomSelector
0x004fc2f0.label: SelectRandomCloudSceneObjects
0x004fc2f0.summary: Iterates cloud scene objects, separates into two groups by name pattern, randomly selects one from each group using LCG, and copies their data (31 bytes) to output slots.

0x004fc400.name: sub_4FC400
0x004fc400.label: TextureVariantPathBuilder
0x004fc400.summary: Builds texture variant paths with letter suffixes (A-D). Splits filename at extension, strips trailing letter, then calls TextureAdjuster for each of 4 letter variants.

0x004fc550.name: sub_4FC550
0x004fc550.label: LoadCommonLogoMapAndSetupCloudTextures
0x004fc550.summary: Constructs path from season+track+"common/logomap.mas", loads the resource, selects random cloud scene objects, registers wcclouds/wccloudr texture variants, and cleans up physics linked list.

0x004fc700.name: StringNameMatching
0x004fc700.label: MatchAndUpdateCloudSceneNames
0x004fc700.summary: Matches cloud scene object names against stored buffers; when names differ, copies new name data and triggers cloud texture setup or stores session type config. Used for switching cloud scene variants.

0x004fc870.name: sub_4FC870
0x004fc870.label: FloatColorTo16BitConversion
0x004fc870.summary: Converts 6 float values to 16-bit integer output — first 4 (RGBA color channels) scaled by 65535, last 2 (intensity) scaled by 128.

0x004fc901.name: ObjectFieldInitializer
0x004fc901.label: InitThreeFloatFields
0x004fc901.summary: Initializes three fields of an object: first (offset 0xC) set from ECX parameter, next two (offsets 0x10, 0x14) set to 20.0f.

0x004fc910.name: sub_4FC910
0x004fc910.label: UnpackPacked16BitToFloats
0x004fc910.summary: Unpacks 6 packed 16-bit integers into floats: first 4 unsigned (color channels, scale 1/65536), last 2 signed (position/normal components, scale 1/128).

0x004fc9a0.name: FloatArrayInitializer
0x004fc9a0.label: InitFourFloatDefaults
0x004fc9a0.summary: Sets four float fields to default values: 0.0, 20.0, 0.3, 0.0.

0x004fca50.name: sub_4FCA50
0x004fca50.label: LinkedPointerListRelease
0x004fca50.summary: Walks a linked list starting at this+0x54, freeing each node's internal pointer (if flag at node+8 is non-zero) and the node itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Clears all four tracking fields at offsets 0x54-0x60 after cleanup.

0x004fcaa0.name: sub_4FCAA0
0x004fcaa0.label: Weather Parameter Block Initializer
0x004fcaa0.summary: Initializes weather parameters: reads or writes weather.txt file, sets up weather mode constants (0.75/0.5 scaling factors, 175/675 range limits, 150.0 default, 0.01 threshold), computes derived values from orientation angles and field lookups, and delegates to sub_4FBA10 for cloud/skybox scene graph setup. Called from Game_Init.

0x004fcc30.name: sub_4FCC30
0x004fcc30.label: Weather/Environment State Initializer
0x004fcc30.summary: Initializes weather and environment state on game restart: selects weather mode, builds weather parameter tables from file or built-in data, processes audio ring buffer for weather events, seeds noise values, and configures per-race weather flags. Called from Game_Restart.

0x004fcee0.name: sub_4FCEE0
0x004fcee0.label: HUD Scoring Progress Bar Animation Update
0x004fcee0.summary: Updates a HUD scoring/progress bar element each frame: decrements a timer, encodes ring-buffer events when expired, interpolates alpha/color/position based on time-of-day and value thresholds, and updates audio panning and UI properties. Part of the HUD/scoring display system.

0x004fd6f0.name: RangeInterpolationTable
0x004fd6f0.label: Range-to-Interpolation-Table Bucket Fill
0x004fd6f0.summary: Populates a 16-entry interpolation lookup table (offsets 0x64–0xA0) from a [min, max] range at fixed interpolation fractions (0.0, 0.01, 0.03, 0.05, 0.06, 0.14, 0.25, 0.37, 0.5, 0.63, 0.75, 0.86, 0.94, 0.99, 1.0). Used to precompute parameter curves for physics and audio subsystems.

0x004fd7e0.name: F_1DTableLookupWithLerp
0x004fd7e0.label: 1D table lookup with linear interpolation
0x004fd7e0.summary: Looks up a value from a 1D float table (starting at `this+0x64`) indexed by `a2`, clamping at 3.75 and performing linear interpolation between adjacent entries. Physics/vehicle subsystem.

0x004fd840.name: DualLinkedListDestruction
0x004fd840.label: DualLinkedListDestruction
0x004fd840.summary: Destroys two linked lists: first list iterated from this+0x3C (node next at +0xC), second from this+0x54 (each node: pointer at +0, next at +4, flag at +8). Frees all nodes and conditionally frees sub-pointers if flag is non-zero. Clears tracking fields at offsets 0x38-0x3C and 0x54-0x60.

0x004fd8b0.name: sub_4FD8B0
0x004fd8b0.label: CameraOscillationGenerator
0x004fd8b0.summary: Generates a linked list of oscillation samples for camera sway/vehicle shake, using random noise values with multi-stage clamping, sinusoidal motion computation, and physics-constant-driven amplitude limits.

0x004fde00.name: sub_4FDE00
0x004fde00.label: FloatRangeEnvelopeCompute
0x004fde00.summary: Computes two scalar outputs at offsets 0x20 and 0x24 from input float a2 using threshold-based envelope logic. Below 0.6: both zero. 0.6-0.7: first ramps linearly 0→1. 0.7-1.0: first saturates at 1, second ramps 0→1. Above 1.0: both saturate at 1. Used in audio/physics signal envelope context.

0x004fdeb0.name: AudioADSREnvelope
0x004fdeb0.label: AudioADSREnvelope
0x004fdeb0.summary: Computes ADSR audio envelope: walks interpolated envelope table (linked list of keyframes from this+0x38), interpolates values based on phase a3, applies decay to two internal state variables (offsets 0x28, 0x2C), calls RangeInterpolationTable, computes final output at offset 0x34 with sample-rate-dependent smoothing. Core audio envelope DSP function.

0x004fe060.name: CarPositionTargetCheck
0x004fe060.label: CarPositionTargetCheck
0x004fe060.summary: Checks car position (this+0x8) against computed target via sub_4FC910. Sets match flag (this+0x4) to 2.0f if within 0.5 threshold, else 0.0f. Blocked in multiplayer when scoring gate is active. Calls RangeInterpolationTable after evaluation.

0x004fe0d0.name: WeatherNameWetnessMultiplier
0x004fe0d0.label: WeatherNameWetnessMultiplier
0x004fe0d0.summary: Returns wetness multiplier (0.03–1.0) by comparing weather name string against known categories (Best→0.03, Nice→0.30, Clear→0.60, Overcast→0.65, Drizzle→0.73, Rain→0.85, Monsoon→0.97). Unknown names compute multiplier via sub_58850F * 0.01 clamped to [0.0, 1.0]. Used by physics/wetness system.

0x004fe1e0.name: WeatherSeverityGripMultiplier
0x004fe1e0.label: WeatherSeverityGripMultiplier
0x004fe1e0.summary: Returns grip/severity multiplier (0.0–1.0) by matching weather severity name against known categories. Cascading comparison via sub_588410 returns discrete values; fallback computes via sub_58850F clamped to [0,1]. Used by physics/grip system.

0x004fe2b0.name: sub_4FE2B0
0x004fe2b0.label: TireTemperatureLookup
0x004fe2b0.summary: Returns tire temperature/pressure value (7.5–32.5) by matching temperature name string against categories. off_5D6FD4 → 32.5, Warm→26.25, Medium→20.0, Cool→13.75, Cold→computed via sub_58850F, unknown→7.5. Used by tire physics system.

0x004fe350.name: sub_4FE350
0x004fe350.label: SessionWeatherDataInitializer
0x004fe350.summary: Initializes weather, track temperature, and wetness data for a race session by searching linked-list data entries for the best-matching session type and minute markers. Builds a time-keyed linked list of weather condition snapshots used during gameplay. Session/weather system.

0x004fe7c0.name: sub_4FE7C0
0x004fe7c0.label: WeatherAudioLoadAndChannelStop
0x004fe7c0.summary: Loads an audio file by resource ID, stops the weather audio channel, and processes the stopped channel data into the caller's float buffer. Returns 0 on success or -1 if the channel stop fails.

0x004fe820.name: WeatherConditionsFileWriter
0x004fe820.label: WeatherConditionsFileWriter
0x004fe820.summary: Writes per-session weather conditions (on-path wetness, off-path wetness, ambient/track temperature, minute-by-minute data) to a formatted output file. Iterates 8 sessions, simulates weather transitions via AudioADSREnvelope, and logs errors on file-open failure. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

0x004feaf0.name: AudioEventRingBufferProcessing
0x004feaf0.label: Audio Event Ring Buffer Processor
0x004feaf0.summary: Processes a ring buffer of timed audio events, computing ADSR envelopes across 720 time slots, detecting peaks above noise thresholds, and spawning sorted linked-list nodes for audio events to be played. Uses weather noise and track conditions to randomize event timing and intensity.

0x004fefc0.name: ClampedReciprocalWithGuard
0x004fefc0.label: CrossfadeCoefficientCompute
0x004fefc0.summary: Clamps an input blend factor to [0.01, 1.0], then computes reciprocal (1.0/factor) and reciprocal of complement (1.0/(1.0-factor)) for audio crossfade or parameter interpolation.

0x004ff040.name: ValueClampRange
0x004ff040.label: AudioParamRangeClamp
0x004ff040.summary: Computes a clamped range [low, high] from two audio parameter inputs. Low = 1-a2 clamped to [0,1], high = 1-a3 forced >= low and clamped to <= 1.0.

0x004ff130.name: sub_4FF130
0x004ff130.label: ParameterCurveEvaluate
0x004ff130.summary: Evaluates a time-based parameter curve from a linked list of (time, value) keyframes. Returns interpolated or extrapolated float value via ThresholdBasedReturn. Falls back to status codes 2-5 when no curve is set.

0x004ff1d0.name: AudioFilterParameterCalculation
0x004ff1d0.label: FilterParameterAverageCalculate
0x004ff1d0.summary: Averages min/max values across a linked list of keyframes up to a future time (session time + 3000 or +5400 for session type 7), applies offset from this+0x104, clamps to [0,1], and returns via ThresholdBasedReturn. Falls back to status codes 2-5 if no curve is set.

0x004ff3a0.name: F_3DHermiteSplineInterpolation
0x004ff3a0.label: 3D Hermite/Catmull-Rom spline interpolation
0x004ff3a0.summary: Performs Hermite (Catmull-Rom) spline interpolation between two 3D points `a1`/`a3` with tangents `a2`/`a4` at parameter `a5` (0..1), writing result to `a6`. Audio/sample interpolation system: normalizes tangents, computes Hermite basis functions, blends position.

0x004ff680.name: AudioParameterInterpolation
0x004ff680.label: Audio parameter state interpolation
0x004ff680.summary: Interpolates audio/physics parameter state between frames: clamps delta, unpacks short vectors and bitfields, applies rotation via Euler angles, copies interpolated packed state to output. Audio/parameter blending system.

0x004ff8f0.name: AudioSampleCrossFadeInterpolation
0x004ff8f0.label: Audio sample cross-fade with position/rotation/blend
0x004ff8f0.summary: Cross-fades between two audio sample states `a3`/`a4`: computes blend factor from time, interpolates position via Hermite spline, rotation via quaternion slerp, and packed bitfields. Audio sample playback system.

0x004fffb0.name: ZoneThresholdComparisonWithConditionalAction
0x004fffb0.label: ZoneBasedThresholdAction
0x004fffb0.summary: Compares an incoming value against two thresholds (upper at this+0xC, lower at this+0x1BC) and triggers different actions via ArithmeticComparison_3a90 depending on which zone the value falls into. For zone/region state management in networking.

0x00500010.name: CollisionStateUpdate
0x00500010.label: CollisionSurfaceStateUpdate
0x00500010.summary: Updates collision surface contact state with new value and 3-bit type. Skips redundant updates when new value is within tolerance of current state and type matches. Depending on flag bits, either converts Euler angles to vehicle orientation or performs arithmetic comparison.

0x005000e0.name: PhysicsFloatUpdateWithCompare
0x005000e0.label: Physics float update with spatial grid compare
0x005000e0.summary: Updates `a1[3]` (offset 0xC) by adding `a2` only if a spatial grid query succeeds and the new value exceeds the current value. Physics/collision system.

0x00500190.name: VehicleDataBufferClear
0x00500190.label: VehicleDataBufferClear
0x00500190.summary: Clears a collision/vehicle data buffer region (0x1B0 bytes at offset 0x1B8) and sets a sentinel at offset 0x1BC to -FLT_MAX. Called during list iteration reset.

0x005001b0.name: sub_5001B0
0x005001b0.label: DataBufferClearPositiveSentinel
0x005001b0.summary: Clears a data buffer region (0x1B0 bytes at offset 0x8) and sets a sentinel at offset 0xC to +FLT_MAX. Symmetrical to VehicleDataBufferClear (uses positive FLT_MAX sentinel instead of negative). Called during list iteration reset.

0x005001d0.name: FieldCompareConstant
0x005001d0.label: Field sentinel comparison (not equal to FLT_MIN-like value)
0x005001d0.summary: Returns TRUE if `this[111]` (offset 0x1BC) is NOT equal to `-9.9999997e37` (a very large negative sentinel). Used to check whether a struct field has been initialized/set. Shared utility across many callers.

0x005001f0.name: FloatComparisonCheck
0x005001f0.label: Float sentinel comparison (not equal to FLT_MAX-like value)
0x005001f0.summary: Returns TRUE if `this[3]` (offset 0xC) is NOT equal to `9.9999997e37` (FLT_MAX-like sentinel). Checks whether a float field has been initialized. Shared utility used by many collision/iteration functions.

0x00500210.name: AudioSamplePlaybackWithPitchModulationAndStereoP
0x00500210.label: Audio sample playback with pitch modulation and stereo panning
0x00500210.summary: Interpolates audio sample playback state: encodes progress event, blends color (RGB) and orientation data between current and target frame, clamping Euler angles to ±15.999 before quantized output. Audio sample playback system.

0x00500560.name: CollisionTestWithThreshold
0x00500560.label: Collision test with threshold and parameter interpolation
0x00500560.summary: Tests collision state with threshold: if field is initialized and time delta is valid, interpolates audio parameters and cross-fades collision sample; otherwise performs basic parameter interpolation. Physics/collision system.

0x0050099c.name: SurfaceBlitOperation
0x0050099c.label: SurfaceBlitOperation
0x0050099c.summary: Performs D3D surface blit between source and destination surfaces. Attempts direct hardware blit when surfaces are compatible (same pixel format/size), falls back to CPU-side lock-copy via D3DTextureSurfaceLockCopy and NetworkPacketSendReceive. Cleans up render resources on exit.

0x00500bc8.name: D3DSurfaceCopyBlit
0x00500bc8.label: D3DSurfaceCopyBlit
0x00500bc8.summary: Copies D3D texture surface data across mip levels and cubemap faces. Validates surface type (3=2D texture, 4=3D volume, 5=cubemap), auto-selects mip format flags, iterates per-face/mip calling SurfaceBlitOperation or Direct3DTextureVertexBufferInit. Manages surface lock/unlock lifecycle.

0x00500eac.name: sub_500EAC
0x00500eac.label: DebugSetMuteLazyInit
0x00500eac.summary: Lazily loads the D3D8 DebugSetMute function from d3d8.dll or d3d8d.dll and calls it to suppress/enable D3D debug output during surface operations. Caches function pointer for subsequent calls.

0x00500f55.name: ArithmeticComparison_0f55
0x00500f55.label: RecursiveTreeDestructor
0x00500f55.summary: Recursively destructs and frees a tree/list structure. Conditionally frees data pointers at this+4/this+8 (guarded by flags at this+56/this+60), then recursively destructs and frees child nodes at this+76 and this+80.

0x00500fca.name: DDSTextureFormatValidationDecoding
0x00500fca.label: DDSTextureFormatDecode
0x00500fca.summary: Validates DDS header and pixel format, maps DDS pixel formats to internal format IDs, allocates output buffer, and decodes pixel data to 32-bit BGRA. Handles palette expansion (8-bit indexed), RLE decompression (type 2), and uncompressed formats (1/4/8/16/24/32-bit).

0x005016e0.name: VTableDispatchWithLongjmp
0x005016e0.label: ExceptionSafeVtableDispatch
0x005016e0.summary: Calls a vtable function at offset 8, then performs a longjmp to a recovery/jump buffer at offset 132 in the vtable data area. If longjmp returns, restores context state by copying offset 28→0 and 32→4 of a secondary context struct. A fiber/yield or SEH recovery pattern.

0x00501711.name: BufferPointerAdjust
0x00501711.label: BufferReadPointerAdvance
0x00501711.summary: Advances a buffer read pointer by `a2` bytes and decreases the remaining byte count by `a2`. Classic buffer read tracking structure update.

0x00501722.name: ImageTextureDecompressor
0x00501722.label: ImageTextureDecompressor
0x00501722.summary: State-machine-driven image texture decompressor. Decodes streaming texture data via setjmp/longjmp error recovery. Handles format 50 (raw RGBA copy) and format 22 (24-bit RGB unpacked from 16-bit RGB565 source). Allocates output pixel buffer on decode.

0x00501e39.name: PPMP6ImageDecoder
0x00501e39.label: PPMP6ImageDecoder
0x00501e39.summary: Decodes PPM P3 (ASCII) or P6 (binary) image data into 32-bit BGRA pixel buffer. Parses header (magic, width, height, max value), allocates output buffer, and converts RGB samples with max-value normalization to 4-byte BGRA pixels.

0x005020bf.name: StreamBinaryRead
0x005020bf.label: StreamBinaryRead
0x005020bf.summary: Reads `a3` bytes from a tracked buffer into `a2`, advances read pointer, decrements remaining count. If insufficient bytes remain, triggers error via GuardedCallWithLongjmp.

0x0050210e.name: sub_50210E
0x0050210e.label: Media Surface / Codec Format Initialisation
0x0050210e.summary: Initialises a media-surface / video-codec context from a binary stream: validates input, creates a versioned subsystem ("1.0.5"), parses format metadata (dimensions, pixel format, FOURCC), allocates pixel-data and palette buffers, negotiates stride, and builds a 256-entry RGBA colour-conversion table with optional gamma correction.

0x005026a4.name: DDSTextureSurfaceCreation
0x005026a4.label: DDSTextureSurfaceHierarchyBuild
0x005026a4.summary: Parses DDS data and builds a linked-list surface hierarchy for mip-mapped/cubemap textures. Creates one surface sub-object per mip level per face, each with format, dimensions, stride, data pointer, and mip chain linking. Validates DDS magic, format table lookup, and buffer size.

0x00502a15.name: DirectXSurfaceFormatNegotiation
0x00502a15.label: Texture Format Auto-Detection and Decoding Dispatcher
0x00502a15.summary: Attempts to decode raw image data by trying format decoders in priority order (BMP, TGA, DDS-header, generic, DDS-surface, PPM, DDS-validate). On success, populates an output descriptor struct with format info; on failure, cleans up allocations and tries the next decoder.

0x00502bea.name: ZeroPairInit
0x00502bea.label: ZeroTwoFields
0x00502bea.summary: Zeros two consecutive DWORD fields at offsets 0 and 4 in the struct.

0x00502bf4.name: DualVTableDestructor
0x00502bf4.label: DualVTableDestructor
0x00502bf4.summary: Calls destructor (vtable entry 0) on two sub-objects with flag=1. Second sub-object pointer stored at this+4, first at this+0. Only calls destructor if the pointer is non-NULL.

0x00502c28.name: ComplexMemoryAllocationWithFloatComputation
0x00502c28.label: AudioResampleFilterTableBuild
0x00502c28.summary: Allocates and builds a polyphase resampling filter position table for audio sample rate conversion. For each of a1 output positions, computes fractional input sample positions and generates a list of (source_index, fractional_weight) pairs. Handles wrap/no-wrap modes via a3 flag.

0x00502ee5.name: ConditionalFree_2ee5
0x00502ee5.label: ConditionalFreeWithFlag
0x00502ee5.summary: Conditionally frees memory based on flag bits in a2. Bit 2 selects mode: loop-free via NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH or direct free. Bit 1 controls secondary free.

0x00502f31.name: sub_502F31
0x00502f31.label: AudioMixerInit
0x00502f31.summary: Initializes audio mixer/convolution engine with 2D filter position tables. Creates three filter tables via ComplexMemoryAllocationWithFloatComputation, allocates intermediate working arrays, builds cross-mapping between two filter dimensions, performs convolution accumulation setup, and handles cleanup on failure.

0x005033a5.name: DXTCompressedTextureBlockCopy
0x005033a5.label: DXT block blit with alignment and format validation
0x005033a5.summary: Copies DXT-compressed texture blocks from source to destination surface, validating 4-byte alignment and DXT1/2/3/4/5 pixel format, then iterating over rows and columns of blocks with qmemcpy.

0x00503888.name: FunctionPointerSwitch
0x00503888.label: Render path function pointer selector
0x00503888.summary: Selects between compositing function pointers based on sub_50FC7D() condition: on true, sets both slots to sub_503772; on false, sets to ImageBlendingCompositing and F_2DImageBoxFilter. Then calls the selected function via off_5D76C0.

0x00503920.name: sub_503920
0x00503920.label: 2x2 bilinear pixel averaging filter (16-bit 565)
0x00503920.summary: Downsampling helper that averages 2x2 blocks of 16-bit RGB565 pixels into one output pixel per block, iterating over source surface rows and columns with stride-based addressing.

0x00503e36.name: PixelBlenderCompositor
0x00503e36.label: 8-bit 2x2 pixel averaging blend
0x00503e36.summary: Performs 2x2 block pixel averaging for 8-bit RGB surfaces, reading 4 source pixels per block and blending channels (masks 0xE3 and 0x1C for RGB 332 format) into one output byte per block. Iterates over source rows with double-stride advancement.

0x00504508.name: SurfacePixelCopy
0x00504508.label: Surface-to-surface pixel row copy
0x00504508.summary: Copies pixel data between two validated compatible surfaces, checking format, dimensions, and palette match. Routes compressed formats to DXTCompressedTextureBlockCopy; for uncompressed formats, performs row-by-row qmemcpy with configurable strides.

0x00504640.name: MemoryAllocationWithVectorConstructor
0x00504640.label: Staging buffer alloc, fill via surface methods, free
0x00504640.summary: Allocates a staging buffer (16 bytes × width), initialises it via vector constructor, fills it by calling source and destination surface vtable methods per block coordinate, then frees the buffer. Validates surface dimensions match before processing.

0x00504731.name: sub_504731
0x00504731.label: Dual staging buffer surface transfer with overlap handling
0x00504731.summary: Allocates two staging buffers, fills first from source and dest surfaces for overlapping region, fills second from dest-only for non-overlapping region, then frees both. Handles partial depth/row overlap between surfaces of different sizes.

0x00504933.name: Direct3DTextureResampling
0x00504933.label: 3D texture resampling with fixed-point scaling
0x00504933.summary: Resamples a 3D texture from source to destination dimensions using fixed-point coordinate scaling ((val<<16)/dim). Allocates two staging buffers, samples source via vtable method, copies 16-byte blocks, and writes to destination via vtable method.

0x00504b37.name: COMInterfaceVectorProcessingMethod
0x00504b37.label: Texture resize/compositing dispatch with format-specific handlers
0x00504b37.summary: Dispatches texture compositing/resizing based on pixel format ID (21–43): calls format-specific handlers (PhysicsStateDispatch, VehicleDataForwardingCall, sub_503920, sub_503A70, F_16BitTextureBlending, BitplaneBlendingCompositing, PixelBlenderCompositor, F_2xBoxDownscale, ImageBlendCombine, sub_50415C, sub_50427D, sub_5043C9). Falls through to generic float-vector 2x2 averaging path with staging buffers when format doesn't match or handler fails.

0x00504f5a.name: MultiLevelBufferAllocationWithVectorOps
0x00504f5a.label: 3D texture downscale with 8-sample trilinear averaging
0x00504f5a.summary: Downscales a 3D texture by 2× in each dimension using 8-sample trilinear float averaging (×0.125). Validates dimensions match half-size, ensures even alignment, allocates up to 4 staging buffers, reads 8 source texels per output via vtable method, averages floats, writes result to destination.

0x005053ec.name: MemoryAllocation_53ec
0x005053ec.label: Interpolation coordinate table allocator
0x005053ec.summary: Allocates and fills an interpolation coordinate table (16 bytes × count) for texture resampling. Computes fractional source coordinates from dest coordinate with sub_5895A2, storing adjacent source indices and blend weights for bilinear interpolation. Handles edge clamp/wrap modes.

0x005054ec.name: sub_5054EC
0x005054ec.label: Bilinear texture resample with weighted float averaging
0x005054ec.summary: Performs full bilinear texture resampling using coordinate tables from MemoryAllocation_53ec. Allocates two staging buffers, reads 4 source texels per output, applies weighted float interpolation using coordinate blend factors, writes result to destination via vtable method. Frees 4 buffers on completion.

0x005058d2.name: VertexBufferAllocationAndStageTransformation
0x005058d2.label: 3D trilinear texture resample with X/Y/Z coord tables
0x005058d2.summary: Performs full 3D trilinear texture resampling using coordinate tables from MemoryAllocation_53ec for all three dimensions. Allocates two staging buffers, reads 8 source texels per output, applies weighted float interpolation with 3-layer weighting, writes to destination. Frees 5 buffers on completion.

0x00506003.name: sub_506003
0x00506003.label: Vertex weighted-blend transform with freelist management
0x00506003.summary: Transforms vertex data from source to destination using weighted float accumulation. Creates coordinate remap tables via ComplexMemoryAllocationWithFloatComputation, builds vertex buffer with per-slot ref counting and freelist recycling, accumulates source contributions into destination vertices via vtable methods. Decrements ref count per vertex and releases when zero.

0x005063a5.name: D3DContextInit
0x005063a5.label: D3D surface pair creation and transfer attempt chain
0x005063a5.summary: Initialises a D3D texture copy context: validates parameters, creates source and destination surfaces via DirectXTextureSurfaceFactoryDispatchingFourCCCod, then attempts a chain of surface copy/resampling methods (SurfacePixelCopy, MemoryAllocationWithVectorConstructor, sub_504731, Direct3DTextureResampling, COMInterfaceVectorProcessingMethod, MultiLevelBufferAllocationWithVectorOps, sub_5054EC, VertexBufferAllocationAndStageTransformation, sub_506003, sub_502F31). First success wins; otherwise returns failure. Releases surfaces on exit.

0x005064cf.name: RenderResourceTeardown
0x005064cf.label: Release D3D surface/device resources and clear pointers
0x005064cf.summary: Tears down render resources by releasing COM interfaces stored in this[1]/this[2]/this[3] via vtable calls. Optionally performs a copy-before-release if this[1]/[2]/[3] are all valid and flag bit 0 not set. Sets released pointers to 0.

0x0050653e.name: VTableReleaseClear
0x0050653e.label: Release single COM interface pointer and null
0x0050653e.summary: If the stored interface pointer (*this) is non-null, calls its vtable+40 method (likely Unlock or Release), then sets the pointer to 0.

0x00506559.name: D3DTextureSurfaceLockCopy
0x00506559.label: Lock D3D surface rectangle and copy pixel data
0x00506559.summary: Tears down existing resources, then locks a rectangular region of a D3D surface, creates a compatible child surface, copies pixel data between surfaces handling compressed (DXT) format alignment, and fills a descriptor structure with surface info (pitch, format, dimensions). Supports partial rect copies and various copy flags.

0x00506971.name: sub_506971
0x00506971.label: Volume/texture 3D region lock and copy
0x00506971.summary: Releases existing interface, then locks a 3D sub-region of a volume texture surface. Validates 3D rect bounds (x/y/z), handles DXT format alignment, calls vtable+36 (LockBox) with flags, fills descriptor with surface info (pitch, format, dimensions, depth), and stores the surface pointer.

0x00506ccc.name: VtableSetFreeChild
0x00506ccc.label: Set vtable to static table and free child pointer
0x00506ccc.summary: Retrieves child pointer from this[1043], sets this vtable pointer to off_5ADB80 (static vtable), and frees the old child pointer via FreeWrapper_7bcf.

0x00506ce2.name: DirectXVertexBufferFormatConversion
0x00506ce2.label: Vertex float format conversion (normalized ↔ signed)
0x00506ce2.summary: Converts vertex float data between normalized [0..1] and signed [-1..1] coordinate ranges based on format codes in this[2] (dest) and this[1042] (source). Processes each vertex element with 16-byte stride. Returns output pointer this[1043]. Formats: 1=map to (val+1)*0.5, 2=map from val*2-1, 3=direct/passthrough.

0x00506fd9.name: ComplexDestructorWithLoop
0x00506fd9.label: Destructor with 2D child pointer array cleanup
0x00506fd9.summary: Sets vtable to off_5ADB90, then iterates over a 2D slab of child pointer entries (rows v1[1063]..v1[1064], columns v1[1060]..v1[1062]), freeing each via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Frees child array and metadata pointers, then delegates to VtableSetFreeChild for final cleanup.

0x00507079.name: sub_507079
0x00507079.label: 2x2 pixel quad accumulation buffer with flush
0x00507079.summary: Accumulates vertex/texel data into 2×2 quad buffer slots. On first write to a slot, allocates staging buffer; fills sub-pixel data from source surface via stride-based addressing. When all 4 sub-pixels filled (bits 0-3), flushes the completed 2x2 block via processing callbacks and recycles or frees the slot buffer.

0x00507496.name: DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain
0x00507496.label: DirectXTextureSurfaceConstructor
0x00507496.summary: Constructs a DirectX texture/surface object from a source descriptor — copies format metadata, converts packed color to float RGBA, loads 256-entry palettes for indexed formats (types 40/41), and initializes the mipmap chain with a sub-object constructor. Render system.

0x005076fe.name: TextureCopyRealloc
0x005076fe.label: Reallocate staging buffer on format mismatch
0x005076fe.summary: Compares destination format vs source format (offset 8 in both objects). If they differ, reallocates a staging buffer (16 bytes × width) via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper with vector construction, stores result at this[1043] and the new format at this[1042].

0x00507779.name: TemporaryStateWrapper
0x00507779.label: Save state, process with temporary params, restore
0x00507779.summary: Saves object state fields (width, stride, data pointers, flags), replaces them with temporary values (including a stack-local buffer and constant data pointer), optionally runs DirectXVertexBufferFormatConversion if format != 1, then calls vtable+8 and vtable+4 processing methods. Restores all saved fields and returns saved flag value.

0x00507845.name: ContactManifoldCleanup
0x00507845.label: ContactZMatchZero
0x00507845.summary: Iterates contact manifold array, zeros out any contact whose position matches a reference contact position stored in the owning struct.

0x005078b5.name: VertexColorFloatToByte
0x005078b5.label: FloatVertexColorToByte
0x005078b5.summary: Converts floating-point vertex colors to 8-bit byte values by multiplying by 255.0 and writing consecutive RGB bytes.

0x00507bc5.name: ColorVertexTransform
0x00507bc5.label: FloatVertexColorToRGB565
0x00507bc5.summary: Converts floating-point vertex colors to packed 16-bit RGB565 format (R=5 bits, G=6 bits, B=5 bits) with scale factors 31/63/31.

0x00507cc6.name: ConvertFloatColorTo16Bit
0x00507cc6.label: FloatVertexColorToRGB555
0x00507cc6.summary: Converts floating-point vertex colors to packed 16-bit RGB555 format (R=5 bits, G=5 bits, B=5 bits, 1 unused bit) using scale factor 31.0 per channel.

0x00507ee4.name: TextureEncoderRGBA4444
0x00507ee4.label: FloatVertexColorToARGB4444
0x00507ee4.summary: Converts floating-point vertex colors to packed 16-bit ARGB4444 format (A=4 bits, R=4 bits, G=4 bits, B=4 bits) using scale factor 15.0 per channel.

0x00508007.name: TextureEncode8BitDXTS3TCQuantization
0x00508007.label: FloatVertexColorToRGB332
0x00508007.summary: Converts floating-point vertex colors to packed 8-bit RGB332 format (R=3 bits, G=3 bits, B=2 bits) using scale factors 7.0 for R/G and 3.0 for B.

0x005081ae.name: F_15BitTo16BitTextureDithering
0x005081ae.label: FloatVertexColorToARGB8332
0x005081ae.summary: Converts floating-point vertex colors to packed 16-bit ARGB8332 format (A=8 bits, R=3 bits, G=3 bits, B=2 bits) with scale factors 7.0/7.0/3.0/255.0.

0x005083d2.name: TextureColorConvert10
0x005083d2.label: FloatVertexColorToRGB10A2
0x005083d2.summary: Converts floating-point vertex colors to packed 32-bit RGB10A2 format (R/G/B=10 bits each, A=2 bits) using scale factors 1023.0 for color channels and 3.0 for alpha.

0x005084f5.name: Color565Transform
0x005084f5.label: FloatVertexColorToRG16
0x005084f5.summary: Converts floating-point vertex colors to packed 32-bit format with 16-bit R and 16-bit G channels (scale factor 65535.0 per channel). Only two color components are processed.

0x005085c5.name: VertexColorTransform
0x005085c5.label: VertexWeightNearestSearch
0x005085c5.summary: Searches 256-entry weight table for nearest matching weight index per vertex, packs result as 16-bit value with alpha*255 in upper byte.

0x005086dd.name: FindNearestVertexWeight
0x005086dd.label: NearestNeighborWeightSearch
0x005086dd.summary: For each input vertex, searches a 256-entry 4-component weight table (squared Euclidean distance) and writes the nearest match index as a byte.

0x005087a2.name: DXTColorEncoder_87a2
0x005087a2.label: RGBToLuminanceByte
0x005087a2.summary: Converts float RGB to a single luminance byte using standard BT.709 coefficients (0.2125 R + 0.7154 G + 0.0721 B), scaled by 255, for DXT/S3TC compression encoding.

0x0050895d.name: DXTColorEncoder_895d
0x0050895d.label: LuminanceAlphaToByte
0x0050895d.summary: Converts float RGB to 4-bit luminance (BT.709 coefficients) and 4-bit alpha, packed as one byte (luminance | alpha<<4) for DXT compression encoding.

0x00508a48.name: TextureFloatTo16bitPack
0x00508a48.label: FloatVertexColorToRG88
0x00508a48.summary: Converts two float color channels to packed 16-bit RG88 format (R=8 bits, G=8 bits) using scale factor 128.0 per channel.

0x00508b1d.name: VertexColorTransform_8b1d
0x00508b1d.label: FloatVertexColorToRGA565
0x00508b1d.summary: Converts floating-point vertex colors to packed 16-bit format: R=5 bits (scale 16), G=5 bits (scale 16), A=6 bits (scale 63).

0x00508c22.name: FloatToByteColorConverter
0x00508c22.label: FloatVertexColorToRGA24
0x00508c22.summary: Converts floating-point vertex colors to packed 32-bit format: R=8 bits (scale 128), G=8 bits (scale 128), A=8 bits (scale 255). B channel is skipped.

0x00508e67.name: TextureEncode16BitPair
0x00508e67.label: FloatVertexColorToRG16Pair
0x00508e67.summary: Converts two float color channels to packed 32-bit format: each channel scaled by 32768.0, stored as 16-bit unsigned values (R low 16 bits, G high 16 bits).

0x00508f3d.name: TextureEncoderRGB565
0x00508f3d.label: FloatVertexColorToRGB32HighPrecision
0x00508f3d.summary: Converts floating-point vertex colors to packed 32-bit format: R=10 bits (scale 512), G=11 bits (scale 1024), B=11 bits (scale 1024).

0x00509047.name: TextureEncode32BitRGB10A2
0x00509047.label: FloatVertexColorToRGB10A2
0x00509047.summary: Converts floating-point vertex colors to packed 32-bit RGB10A2 format: R/G/B=10 bits each (scale 512), A=2 bits (alpha doubled).

0x0050917d.name: TextureColorSpaceTransform
0x0050917d.label: RGBToLuminance16
0x0050917d.summary: Converts float RGB to 16-bit luminance using BT.709 coefficients (0.2125 R + 0.7154 G + 0.0721 B), scaled by 65535.0, writing single 16-bit value per pixel.

0x005094e8.name: TextureEncoderRGBA8888Packed
0x005094e8.label: FloatVertexColorToRGBA64Packed
0x005094e8.summary: Converts floating-point vertex colors to packed 64-bit format: all 4 channels scaled by 65535.0 (16-bit each), interleaved into a 64-bit quad word.

0x00509644.name: TextureByteToFloatConverter
0x00509644.label: ByteRGBToFloatRGBAConverter
0x00509644.summary: Converts packed 24-bit RGB byte texture data (3 bytes/pixel) to 32-bit float RGBA format with alpha=1.0, under DirectX texture system.

0x005096d0.name: TextureRGBAByteToFloatConversion
0x005096d0.label: ByteRGBAToFloatRGBAConverter
0x005096d0.summary: Converts packed 32-bit RGBA byte texture data (4 bytes/pixel) to 32-bit float RGBA format, under DirectX texture system.

0x00509812.name: VertexTextureDecoderRGB565
0x00509812.label: RGB565ToFloatRGBAVertexDecoder
0x00509812.summary: Decodes 16-bit RGB565 packed texture data to 32-bit float RGBA format (alpha=1.0), using 5-6-5 bit channel extraction with per-channel scale factors, under DirectX texture system.

0x005098b7.name: TextureDecode16BitRGB565Format
0x005098b7.label: RGB555ToFloatRGBAConverter
0x005098b7.summary: Decodes 16-bit packed RGB (5-5-5 bit layout, top bit unused) texture data to 32-bit float RGBA format (alpha=1.0), under DirectX texture system.

0x00509a09.name: TextureDecodeRGBA4
0x00509a09.label: TextureDecodeRGBA4
0x00509a09.summary: Decodes 16-bit packed RGBA4 texture data (two bytes per pixel, 4 bits per channel) to 32-bit float RGBA format, using 1/15 scale factor, under DirectX texture system.

0x00509ab8.name: VertexTextureDecoderRGBA1010102
0x00509ab8.label: RGB10A2ToFloatRGBAVertexDecoder
0x00509ab8.summary: Decodes 32-bit packed RGBA10/10/10/2 texture data to 32-bit float RGBA format, extracting 10-bit RGB and 2-bit alpha channels with per-component scale, under DirectX texture system.

0x00509b8e.name: TextureDecode32BitRGLuminanceAlphaFormat
0x00509b8e.label: LuminanceAlpha16ToFloatRGBAConverter
0x00509b8e.summary: Decodes 32-bit packed luminance+alpha texture data (two 16-bit half-words per pixel) to 32-bit float RGBA format (R=luminance, G=luminance, B=1.0), under DirectX texture system.

0x00509c20.name: RGB332ToFloatTextureDecompress
0x00509c20.label: RGB332ToFloatRGBAConverter
0x00509c20.summary: Decodes 8-bit packed RGB332 texture data (3-3-2 bit layout) to 32-bit float RGBA format (alpha=1.0), under DirectX texture system.

0x00509cc2.name: TextureDecode8BitAlphaOnlyFormat

0x00509f0c.name: TexturePixelPaletteLookup

0x0050a0f0.name: F_8BitVertexPositionDecompression

0x0050a172.name: RGB565TextureDecompression
0x0050a172.label: RGB565ToFloatRGBAWithAlphaDecoder
0x0050a172.summary: Decodes 16-bit packed RGB565 texture data to 32-bit float RGBA format, extracting 5-6-5 bit color channels and alpha from the upper 5 bits, with signed-channel expansion via sign-extension of 5/3 bit values, under DirectX texture system.

0x0050a223.name: VertexUnpackRGBA

0x0050a223.summary: Decompresses 32-bit vertex data (four signed 8-bit integers per vertex) to 32-bit float RGBA format (XY positions with signed scaling, alpha from byte), under DirectX vertex/texture system.

0x0050a34b.name: VertexBufferGeneration

0x0050a34b.summary: Decompresses signed 16-bit vertex position data (two int16 values packed in 4 bytes per vertex) to 32-bit float RGBA format (XY positions, Z=0.0, alpha=1.0), under DirectX vertex/texture system.

0x0050a3ce.name: VertexTextureDecoder1010102
0x0050a3ce.label: RGB10A2SignedToFloatRGBAVertexDecoder
0x0050a3ce.summary: Decodes 32-bit packed RGB10A2 signed texture data to 32-bit float RGBA format, extracting 10-bit sign-extended color channels and setting alpha=1.0, under DirectX texture system.

0x0050a488.name: TextureDecode32BitRGB10A2Format
0x0050a488.label: RGB10A2SignedToFloatRGBAConverter
0x0050a488.summary: Decodes 32-bit packed RGB10A2 signed texture data to 32-bit float RGBA format, extracting 10-bit sign-extended color channels and 2-bit alpha with scale, under DirectX texture system.

0x0050a55b.name: F_16BitGrayscaleToRGBATextureConverter

0x0050a55b.summary: Converts 16-bit grayscale texture data (one uint16 per pixel) to 32-bit float RGBA format where R=G=B=luminance and alpha=1.0, under DirectX texture system.

0x0050a659.name: F_16BitVertexPositionDecompression
0x0050a659.label: Uint16_3DToFloatRGBAVertexDecoder
0x0050a659.summary: Decompresses 48-bit vertex position data (three uint16 values packed in 6 bytes per vertex) to 32-bit float RGBA format (XYZ positions, alpha=1.0), under DirectX vertex/texture system.

0x0050a6e5.name: TextureDecodeRGB16
0x0050a6e5.label: RGBA16PackedToFloatRGBAConverter
0x0050a6e5.summary: Decodes 128-bit packed RGBA texture data (four uint16 values per pixel in 8 bytes) to 32-bit float RGBA format using sub_58A870 for channel decoding, under DirectX texture system.

0x0050a7c5.name: ObjectConstructorWithSizeCountInit
0x0050a7c5.label: TextureObject24ByteConstructor
0x0050a7c5.summary: Constructor that initializes a DirectX texture surface object with 0x18-byte (24-byte) allocation via DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain and sets vtable to off_5ADBA8, under DirectX texture system.

0x0050a7e1.name: RenderBufferVertexAllocator
0x0050a7e1.label: RenderBufferAndVertexArrayAllocator
0x0050a7e1.summary: Allocates and initializes a render buffer with vertex array: computes vertex count rounded up to even, allocates 16-byte stride array via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, initializes elements with sub_5008C2, and conditionally configures for FourCC 'GEQY' format, under DirectX render system.

0x0050a8d9.name: RenderFormatConstructor

0x0050a92d.summary: Iterates vertex color float data, performs RGB-to-YCbCr-like color conversion, clamps channels to 8-bit range, and packs results into 16-bit values per pixel. Part of rendering pipeline for vertex color encoding to texture format.

0x0050b27c.summary: Reads a texture format identifier to determine per-channel bit depth, then quantizes float RGBA channel values to match the target format (R5G6B5 for color, 4-bit or 8-bit alpha). Writes back quantized values and stores the max channel value and its reciprocal.

0x0050b813.summary: DirectX surface sub-constructor variant. Calls DirectXTextureSurfaceFormatInitialization to set up format data, then installs vtable off_5ADE0C.

0x0050b830.name: DestructorWithResourceCleanup_b830
0x0050b830.label: Video Decoder Destructor
0x0050b830.summary: Destructor for a video decoder object. Sets vtable, calls VertexColorPackRGBto16 (color-space cleanup), frees a heap-allocated resource at offset 0x105C, then calls VtableSetFreeChild to release child objects.

0x0050b879.name: ObjectConstructorWithSingleInit
0x0050b879.label: Pixel Shader Constructor

0x0050b891.name: RenderObjectConstructor_b891
0x0050b891.label: Shader Object Constructor
0x0050b891.summary: DirectX shader sub-constructor. Calls RenderBufferVertexAllocator to allocate render buffer/vertex data, then installs shader vtable (off_5ADE2C).

0x0050b8a9.name: DirectXTextureSurfaceFactoryDispatchingFourCCCod
0x0050b8a9.label: FourCC-based texture/surface format factory dispatcher
0x0050b8a9.summary: Reads a FourCC format code from input data and dispatches to the appropriate Direct3D texture/surface object constructor via a large switch/if-else chain, allocating memory and invoking post-construction virtual init. Part of the D3D rendering pipeline initialization.

0x0050c0a6.name: sub_50C0A6
0x0050c0a6.label: Cubic Hermite Spline Interpolation (2D)
0x0050c0a6.summary: Evaluates cubic Hermite spline interpolation for a 2-component vector. Computes result = h00*p0 + h10*m0 + h01*p1 + h11*m1 with standard Hermite basis functions and parameter t=a6.

0x0050c15e.name: HermiteCubicSplineInterpolation
0x0050c15e.label: Catmull-Rom Spline Interpolation (2D)
0x0050c15e.summary: Evaluates Catmull-Rom spline interpolation for a 2-component vector. Uses Catmull-Rom basis with 0.5 scaling factor. Result = 0.5 * (c0*p0 + c1*p1 + c2*p2 + c3*p3) with parameter t=a6.

0x0050c2e3.name: CubicBezierInterpolation
0x0050c2e3.label: Cubic Hermite Spline Interpolation (3D)
0x0050c2e3.summary: Evaluates cubic Hermite/Bezier interpolation for a 3-component vector. Uses standard Hermite basis functions (2t^3-3t^2+1, t^3-2t^2+t, -2t^3+3t^2, t^3-t^2) with parameter t=a6.

0x0050c3bb.name: sub_50C3BB
0x0050c3bb.label: Catmull-Rom Spline Interpolation (3D)
0x0050c3bb.summary: Evaluates Catmull-Rom spline interpolation for a 3-component vector. Uses Catmull-Rom basis with 0.5 scaling factor. Result = 0.5 * (c0*p0 + c1*p1 + c2*p2 + c3*p3) with parameter t=a6.

0x0050c525.name: F_4DAffineTransform
0x0050c525.label: 4D Affine Transform (Vector-Matrix Multiply)
0x0050c525.summary: Applies a 4x4 affine transformation matrix to a 3-component input vector, producing a 4-component homogeneous output vector. result = input_vec * transpose(matrix), where matrix is column-major.

0x0050c78c.name: sub_50C78C
0x0050c78c.label: Cubic Hermite Spline Interpolation (4D)
0x0050c78c.summary: Evaluates cubic Hermite/Bezier interpolation for a 4-component vector. Uses standard Hermite basis functions (2t^3-3t^2+1, t^3-2t^2+t, -2t^3+3t^2, t^3-t^2) with parameter t=a6.

0x0050c887.name: CatmullRomSplineInterpolation
0x0050c887.label: Catmull-Rom Spline Interpolation (4D)
0x0050c887.summary: Evaluates Catmull-Rom spline interpolation for a 4-component vector. Uses Catmull-Rom basis with 0.5 scaling factor. Result = 0.5 * (c0*p0 + c1*p1 + c2*p2 + c3*p3) with parameter t=a6.

0x0050cad9.name: Mat4x4Determinant
0x0050cad9.label: 4x4 Matrix Determinant
0x0050cad9.summary: Computes determinant of a 4x4 matrix using cofactor (Laplace) expansion. Returns double-precision determinant value from column-major float matrix.

0x0050cbb6.name: F_4x4MatrixMultiply
0x0050cbb6.label: 4x4 Matrix Multiply
0x0050cbb6.summary: Multiplies two 4x4 matrices (a2 * a3) and stores result in a1. Handles aliasing (when a1 overlaps a2 or a3) by computing into a stack temporary then copying result.

0x0050d0c2.name: F_4x4MatrixInverse
0x0050d0c2.label: 4x4 Matrix Inverse
0x0050d0c2.summary: Computes inverse of 4x4 matrix using cofactor/adjugate method. Computes determinant via 3x3 sub-determinants; if non-zero (checked via ArithmeticComparison_a88f), writes inverse to a1 and returns a1. Otherwise returns 0.

0x0050d85d.name: QuaternionToRotationMatrix
0x0050d85d.label: Quaternion to Rotation Matrix
0x0050d85d.summary: Converts a unit quaternion (a2) to a 4x4 rotation matrix (a1). Implements standard formula: R[i][j] = ... using products qx^2, qy^2, qz^2, qx*qy, qx*qz, qx*qw, qy*qz, qy*qw, qz*qw. Output is column-major with translation row/column zeroed and bottom-right element = 1.0.

0x0050d9a5.name: TransformOffsetSetup
0x0050d9a5.label: Transform offset setup — build 4×4 affine matrix with optional offset handling
0x0050d9a5.summary: Builds a 4×4 transformation matrix with scale `a2` on diagonal and identity-like off-diagonal zeros. Optionally applies offset vector `a3` (subtract before transform, add back after) and/or additive offset `a5` to the translation row.

0x0050dab2.name: QuaternionNormalizeAndDecompose
0x0050dab2.label: Quaternion normalize-and-decompose — normalized vector part and scaled scalar
0x0050dab2.summary: Normalizes a quaternion (x,y,z,w) and decomposes it: writes normalized vector part (x,y,z) into `a2` and twice the scalar part (2*w) into `a3`. Falls back to identity on degenerate (near-zero) quaternion.

0x0050db5c.name: RotationMatrixToQuaternion
0x0050db5c.label: 3×3 rotation matrix to quaternion conversion
0x0050db5c.summary: Converts a 3×3 rotation sub-matrix (from a 4×4 column-major matrix `a2`) into a unit quaternion (x,y,z,w in `a1`). Uses the standard trace-based algorithm with two branches to avoid numerical instability near 180° rotations.

0x0050dcb0.name: RotationMatrixFromAxisAndAngle
0x0050dcb0.label: Axis-angle to quaternion conversion
0x0050dcb0.summary: Builds a quaternion (x,y,z,w) from a rotation axis (derived from `a2` via a thunk call) and an angle `a3` (in degrees). Computes half-angle trig and scales the axis by `sin(halfAngle)` for the vector part.

0x0050dd40.name: EulerAnglesToQuaternion
0x0050dd40.label: Euler angles to quaternion conversion
