0x0050dd40.summary: Converts three Euler angles (`a2`, `a3`, `a4`) into a quaternion (x,y,z,w). Computes half-angle sines/cosines and combines them via trigonometric products for the final quaternion components.

0x0050decf.name: QuatNormalize
0x0050decf.label: Quaternion normalization (unit-length)
0x0050decf.summary: Normalizes a quaternion `a2` to unit length and writes result to `a1`. Skips computation if already unit-length (within FloatRangeCheck), zeroes output if norm is below FLT_MIN.

0x0050df9b.name: QuaternionConjugateAndNormalize
0x0050df9b.label: Quaternion conjugate and normalize
0x0050df9b.summary: Computes conjugate (negate vector part x,y,z) of input quaternion `a2`, then normalizes to unit length. Writes result to `a1`. Skips normalization if already unit-length within tolerance; zeroes output if norm is below ultra-small threshold.

0x0050e055.name: RotationVectorToQuaternion
0x0050e055.label: Rotation vector to quaternion (w=0 output)
0x0050e055.summary: Converts a rotation-axis/angle vector `a2` (axis x,y,z + angle in a2[3]) to a quaternion with scalar part w always set to 0. Vector part is scaled by `angle/sin(angle)` for non-degenerate angles; copied verbatim when angle >= 1 or sin(angle) ≈ 0.

0x0050e19e.name: QuaternionSlerp
0x0050e19e.label: Spherical linear interpolation between two quaternions
0x0050e19e.summary: SLERPs between quaternions `a2` and `a3` with factor `a4` (0-1). Uses standard formula with dot-product sign flip for shortest path, trig-based interpolation except near 1-dot ~ FLT_EPSILON where linear interpolation avoids instability.

0x0050e342.name: sub_50E342
0x0050e342.label: Blend weighted transforms between two parameters
0x0050e342.summary: Blends two transforms computed from `a2` with parameters `a3` and `a4` using weights `a5` and `a6`. If total weight `a5+a6` is near zero, copies `a2` verbatim to output `a1`. Otherwise delegates to a transform-construction thunk for intermediate blending.

0x0050e491.name: RayPlaneIntersect
0x0050e491.label: Ray-plane intersection test
0x0050e491.summary: Computes intersection point between a ray (defined by origin `a3` and target point `a4`) and plane `a2` (normal + negated distance). Returns output point in `a1` if intersection is valid, or NULL if ray is parallel or t-value fails validation.

0x0050e6d3.name: F_2DVectorNormalizeWithFallback
0x0050e6d3.label: 2D vector normalization with degenerate fallback
0x0050e6d3.summary: Normalizes a 2D vector `a2` to unit length, writing result to `a1`. Skips normalization if already unit-length; zeroes output if squared length is below FLT_MIN.

0x0050e7cb.name: sub_50E7CB
0x0050e7cb.label: 2D point transform by 4×4 matrix with perspective divide
0x0050e7cb.summary: Transforms 2D point `a2` by 4×4 column-major matrix `a3` to produce output point `a1`. Computes homogeneous (x,y,w), then optionally perspective-divides by w if w is not approximately 1.0.

0x0050e887.name: VectorNormalization
0x0050e887.label: 3D vector normalization with degenerate fallback
0x0050e887.summary: Normalizes a 3D vector `a2` to unit length, writing result to `a1`. Skips normalization if already unit-length; zeroes output if squared length is below FLT_MIN.

0x0050e927.name: F_44MatrixTransform
0x0050e927.label: 3D point transform by 4×4 matrix with perspective divide
0x0050e927.summary: Transforms 3D point `a2` by 4×4 column-major matrix `a3` to produce output point `a1`. Computes homogeneous (x,y,z,w), then optionally perspective-divides by w if w is not approximately 1.0.

0x0050e9e6.name: ColorMatrixTransformWithBlend
0x0050e9e6.label: Color component transform with conditional blending
0x0050e9e6.summary: Processes three color components `a1` through a matrix-like transform, calling thunks conditionally based on flags `a4`/`a5`/`a6`. Optionally blends result with values from a palette/blend structure `a3` (per-channel offset and scale).

0x0050eb73.name: sub_50EB73
0x0050eb73.label: Color component normalization and conversion with flag dispatch
0x0050eb73.summary: Normalizes three color/vector components from `a2` into `a1` using per-channel offset and scale from palette structure `a3`. Uses flag-based (`a4`/`a5`/`a6`) switch to dispatch conditional thunk calls before normalization.

0x0050ee0b.name: SkeletonBoneTransformConstruction
0x0050ee0b.label: Skeleton bone 4×4 transform matrix construction
0x0050ee0b.summary: Builds a 4×4 transformation matrix for a skeleton bone, with support for root/child bone modes (via `a3`), offset vector (`a2`), parent transform (`a4`), and additive translation offsets (`a5`/`a7`). Handles identity initialization, diagonal scale from parent, and negative offset for child bones.

0x0050f199.name: sub_50F199
0x0050f199.label: 4×4 transformation matrix construction from decomposed parameters
0x0050f199.summary: Constructs a 4×4 transformation matrix `a1` using parameters set by a preliminary thunk call (likely quaternion or axis-angle components). Rotation part uses quadratic products of three parameters; translation part scales a fourth parameter. Bottom row is [0,0,0,1].

0x0050f258.name: QuaternionSlERP
0x0050f258.label: Quaternion SLERP with derivative/interpolation output
0x0050f258.summary: Performs spherical interpolation involving quaternion `a6`, writing interpolated components and/or derivatives to `a1`, `a2`, `a3`. Includes shortest-path negation check, angular offset adjustments from `a7`, and multiple indirect thunk computations for trigonometric weighting.

0x0050f632.name: sub_50F632
0x0050f632.label: Render/camera object initialization with parameter dispatch
0x0050f632.summary: Initializes a render/camera object `a1` with parameters `a2` and `a3`. Dispatches through vtable for non-default values, zeroes the 0x1A8-byte structure (preserving vtable), sets up render init via `RenderVTableObjectInit` and camera setup via `DirectorCameraObjectSetup`, then stores field values including count=200.

0x0050f6f7.name: sub_50F6F7
0x0050f6f7.label: JpegSOFHandler_InitDecoder
0x0050f6f7.summary: Handles JPEG Start-of-Frame (SOF) marker initialization — validates component count and color space, then configures decoder state (quant scale, restart interval, MCU counters). Part of the JPEG/image decoding subsystem.

0x0050f86a.name: StateMachineDispatch
0x0050f86a.label: State machine dispatch for buffer/resource processing
0x0050f86a.summary: Drives a state machine using `this+0x10` as state variable. Handles states 200 (init), 201 (process), 202 (done), 203-208/210 (processing via function pointer), and unknown states (dispatched through vtable with opcode 18). Transitions to terminal state 202 on success.

0x0050f904.name: StateMachineDispatcher
0x0050f904.label: State machine dispatcher with processing loop and polling
0x0050f904.summary: State machine using `this+0x10` as state (205/206, 207, 210, other). Handles state transitions to 210, then enters a do-while loop polling a processing function pointer at `this+0x18C` until completion flag at offset 0x11 is set, triggering a final dispatch.

0x0050f9ab.name: StateMachineDispatch_f9ab
0x0050f9ab.label: State machine dispatch wrapper with extended result handling
0x0050f9ab.summary: Wraps `StateMachineDispatch` (sub_50F86A) with additional handling for result code 2: optionally dispatches vtable opcode 50 based on `a2` flag, then calls `VirtualDispatchConditionalValue`. Also vtable-dispatches opcode 18 for states other than 200/201 before delegating to inner state machine.

0x0050fa0e.name: BufferProcessingStateMachine
0x0050fa0e.label: Buffer processing state machine with batch dispatch
0x0050fa0e.summary: Processes data buffers in state 204, tracking progress via counter (offset 0x78) against a limit (offset 0x60). For each chunk, calls a callback object (at this+0x8) and a processing function (at this+0x180+4). When batch completes, flushes via this+0x17C functions and resets counter. When processing flag clears, transitions to state 205 or 206.

0x0050fab7.name: StreamBufferReadStateMachine
0x0050fab7.label: Stream buffer read state dispatcher
0x0050fab7.summary: State machine for reading from a stream buffer. Dispatches data chunks to a callback and advances read position until buffer exhausted, then signals completion with state 119.

0x0050fb3b.name: StateMachineWithDispatch
0x0050fb3b.label: State machine with dispatch loop
0x0050fb3b.summary: Multi-state processing function for image/texture decompression. Handles state 202 (initialize → constructor, early-exit check, transition to 203/207), state 203 (dispatch loop with callback and counter management), and fallback states (unknown → buffer processing).

0x0050fbfc.name: sub_50FBFC
0x0050fbfc.label: Direct3D registry value query
0x0050fbfc.summary: Queries a registry value from HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Direct3D. Returns TRUE only if the key opens, the value is read successfully, and the registry value type matches the expected type parameter.

0x0050fc7d.name: sub_50FC7D
0x0050fc7d.label: MMX support detection with registry override
0x0050fc7d.summary: Detects MMX instruction support for rendering. Checks registry "DisableMMX" for forced disable; if uninitialized (dword_5D7994 negative), runs CPU feature detection and emits EMMS if MMX is available. Returns MMX enable state (0=disabled, 1=enabled).

0x0050fd4e.name: sub_50FD4E
0x0050fd4e.label: CPU SSE/SSE2 feature detection via CPUID
0x0050fd4e.summary: Detects SSE and SSE2 instruction set support using CPUID leaf 1. Returns a bitmask: bit 2 (0x4) for SSE, bit 3 (0x8) for SSE2. Uses SEH to guard against CPUID faults on pre-Pentium CPUs.

0x0050fdf3.name: OSVersionDetection
0x0050fdf3.label: OS version and CPU feature detection
0x0050fdf3.summary: Detects OS platform (Win9x vs NT) and queries CPU instruction set support (SSE, SSE2, 3DNow!) based on a ProcessorFeature ID. Uses IsProcessorFeaturePresent API on NT; falls back to direct CPUID detection on Win9x or when the API fails.

0x0050fea7.name: sub_50FEA7
0x0050fea7.label: D3D PSGP function table init by CPU feature
0x0050fea7.summary: Initializes the D3D PSGP (parallel shader graphics pipeline) function pointer table by detecting CPU features (3DNow!, SSE2, SSE). Copies a template table, then patches entries based on the best available CPU feature, with registry override "DisableD3DXPSGP". Tracks state in dword_5D7998.

0x0050ff84.name: sub_50FF84
0x0050ff84.label: Command context state initialization
0x0050ff84.summary: Initializes/resets state fields in a command dispatch context object. Sets state code to 101 (or 60 if a re-entry flag is set), clears and configures arrays of byte/word fields, and sets the re-entry guard byte to 1.

0x0051030d.name: sub_51030D
0x0051030d.label: Stream command parser with slot table lookup
0x0051030d.summary: Parses a command structure from a byte stream. Reads a 3-byte header (size + slot count), validates size=2*count+6, looks up each slot ID in a 21-dword entry table, stores nibble-flag parameters, reads a 4-byte trailer, and dispatches state throughout parsing.

0x005105bf.name: JPEGMarkerParsing
0x005105bf.label: JFIF marker header parser
0x005105bf.summary: Parses a JFIF (JPEG File Interchange Format) APP0 marker segment from a byte stream. Validates the "JFIF\0" signature, extracts version, aspect ratio/density units, X/Y density, and thumbnail dimensions, dispatching state transitions throughout.

0x005107fb.name: AdobePSDHeaderParser
0x005107fb.label: Adobe APP14 JPEG marker parser
0x005107fb.summary: Parses an Adobe APP14 JPEG marker segment from a byte stream. Validates the "Adobe" signature and extracts DCT encoder version, flags, and color transform value, dispatching parsing states.

0x00510975.name: sub_510975
0x00510975.label: Byte pair parser with nibble store
0x00510975.summary: Parses pairs of bytes (ID + value) from a stream. For IDs 0-15, stores the value as separate low/high nibbles in two arrays (this+0xCA, this+0xDA). For IDs 16+, stores the full byte at this+0xDA+ID. Dispatches state for each pair and for commands with ID >= 32.

0x00510acc.name: sub_510ACC
0x00510acc.label: JPEG Huffman table parser
0x00510acc.summary: Parses JPEG Huffman table definitions (DHT marker) from a byte stream. Reads a 16-byte symbol-count header, validates sizes, reads symbol values, and stores the complete table (17-byte header + up to 256 symbol bytes) in dynamically allocated slots indexed by table ID (0-3 or 16-19).

0x00510d60.name: MP3HuffmanDecoder
0x00510d60.label: Decompression table builder
0x00510d60.summary: Parses Huffman/decompression table entries from a byte stream. Each entry specifies a table index (0-3) and value format; reads values from stream according to global position table dword_5AF778, stores them as WORD arrays in allocated buffers, and optionally outputs 64-WORD batches to the state dispatcher.

0x00510f89.name: StreamRead2ByteTokenParser
0x00510f89.label: Fixed-size 2-byte token reader
0x00510f89.summary: Reads a 4-byte token from a byte stream: a 2-byte big-endian size that must equal exactly 4, followed by a 2-byte big-endian value. Stores the extracted value at this+0xFC and dispatches state 81.

0x00511060.name: StreamingDataReader
0x00511060.label: Segment size reader with skip
0x00511060.summary: Reads a 2-byte big-endian segment size from a byte stream. Dispatches state 90 with a stored field value (this+0x178) and the size, then skips the remaining segment bytes.

0x005110fc.name: BitstreamTokenReader
0x005110fc.label: Byte-stuffing aware marker reader
0x005110fc.summary: Reads a byte stream handling 0xFF byte-stuffing (0xFF 0x00 = data byte 0xFF). Counts data and stuffing bytes until a JPEG marker (0xFF followed by a non-zero, non-0xFF byte) is found. Reports the byte count and marker value via state 112 dispatch.

0x005111d3.name: JPEGMarkerReader
0x005111d3.label: JPEG SOI marker validator
0x005111d3.summary: Reads 2 bytes from a byte stream and validates them as the JPEG SOI (Start of Image) marker 0xFF 0xD8. Reports error state 52 with the unexpected bytes if the marker doesn't match. Stores the second byte at this+0x178.

0x0051126a.name: CommandDispatchStateMachine
0x0051126a.label: JPEG marker dispatch state machine
0x0051126a.summary: Main JPEG marker parsing dispatcher. Reads the next marker from the stream using byte-stuffing-aware (BitstreamTokenReader) or raw (JPEGMarkerReader) mode based on a flag. Dispatches to specialized parsers based on the marker value (192-255 = standard JPEG markers; 1, 208-215 = special; 224-239 = APP via function table; 254 = COM handler).

0x00511457.name: StateCounterWithDispatch
0x00511457.label: JPEG restart marker counter
0x00511457.summary: JPEG RST marker (208-215) handler that tracks the expected restart interval counter. Compares the current marker against the expected value (this+0x1E4 + 208), dispatches state 97 on match, and increments the counter modulo 8. Falls back to an alternative handler on mismatch.

0x005114d5.name: AudioVideoDecodeSubbandLoop
0x005114d5.label: JPEG restart marker scanner
0x005114d5.summary: Scans JPEG markers to find the expected restart (RST) marker relative to a reference counter. Classifies markers into three categories: v5=1 (expected RST found, break), v5=2 (unexpected or <192, skip and read next), v5=3 (acceptable non-RST marker, return). Dispatches states 117 and 96 per iteration.

0x005115c4.name: StateReset
0x005115c4.label: JPEG decoder state reset
0x005115c4.summary: Resets all JPEG decoder state fields to zero: slot table pointer, command counter, current marker, byte-stuffing flag, control flag, and byte counter. Prepares the context for a fresh decode session.

0x005115ee.name: sub_5115EE
0x005115ee.label: JPEG APP marker dispatch table initializer
0x005115ee.summary: Allocates and populates a function dispatch table (92 bytes) for JPEG APP marker handling. Fills slots with StreamingDataReader as default, then overrides key entries: +0=StateReset, +4=CommandDispatchStateMachine, +8=StateCounterWithDispatch, +12=StreamingDataReader, +16=JPEGMarkerParsing, +72=AdobePSDHeaderParser. Stores table at this+0x190 and calls StateReset.

0x0051166b.name: ArithmeticComparison_166b
0x0051166b.label: Dispatch chain caller
0x0051166b.summary: Calls a chain of functions: vfunc 2 on the object (third vtable entry), then sub_516959, UtilityFunction_9ca4, and VtableDispatchThunk. Returns the thunk result.

0x00511686.name: VtableDispatchThunk
0x00511686.label: Vtable thunk with stack buffer
0x00511686.summary: Allocates a 200-byte stack buffer and dispatches through vtable entry +0xC (fourth vfunc). The buffer is passed as a parameter, likely for output data. Returns the vfunc result.

0x005116a3.name: ReferenceCountedResourceAccessRelease
0x005116a3.label: Reference-counted resource release
0x005116a3.summary: Releases a reference to a tracked resource via callback; validates access against resource limit and tracks concurrent reference count.

0x005116d4.name: FormatStringWithArgs
0x005116d4.label: Select format string and call vsnprintf equivalent
0x005116d4.summary: Selects a format string from a table (primary or alternate range) by index; resolves default string on out-of-range; detects "%s" format to switch between varargs and va_list calling convention; delegates to string formatting function.

0x0051176b.name: ResettableStateClear
0x0051176b.label: Reset two state fields to zero
0x0051176b.summary: Clears two fields (offsets 0x14 and 0x6C) in a struct pointed to by `*this` back to zero, performing a partial state reset.

0x0051177c.name: sub_51177C
0x0051177c.label: Vtable-and-resource initializer (format string manager)
0x0051177c.summary: Initializes a vtable-like structure with method pointers (ArithmeticComparison, ResourceRelease, VtableDispatch, FormatStringWithArgs, ResettableStateClear) and populates format string table fields — primary table pointer, element count (119), and zeroed alternate table. Clears five state fields.

0x0051184f.name: TripleFieldSetter_184f
0x0051184f.label: Set three object fields from parameters
0x0051184f.summary: Writes three consecutive DWORD fields at offsets 0x40, 0x44, 0x48 from three parameters, with parameter-to-offset remapping (a2→0x48, a3→0x40, a4→0x44).

0x005118e6.name: sub_5118E6
0x005118e6.label: PNG/zlib decompression context initializer
0x005118e6.summary: Allocates and initializes a PNG/zlib decompression context block: stores parameters, validates libpng version string (must start with '1'), sets up error-recovery via setjmp/longjmp, initialises zlib stream (version 1.1.3), handles zlib error codes with specific messages, and registers sub_513C80 as read callback.

0x005119e9.name: sub_5119E9
0x005119e9.label: PNGFile_ParseChunks
0x005119e9.summary: PNG file chunk parser that validates the 8-byte PNG signature, then iteratively reads and dispatches chunks (IHDR, PLTE, IEND, IDAT, gAMA, sRGB, tRNS) to specialized sub-handlers. Uses longjmp-based error handling with descriptive error messages for corrupted/missing chunks.

0x00511b5c.name: ConditionalDispatchWithGuard
0x00511b5c.label: Conditional audio buffer recalc before packet encoding
0x00511b5c.summary: Conditionally recalculates audio buffer size when flag bit 0x40 is clear, then always dispatches to packet field encoding.

0x00511b7c.name: sub_511B7C
0x00511b7c.label: PNG image row decoder with Adam7 interlace and Huffman decompression
0x00511b7c.summary: Decodes one or more rows from a PNG image (IDAT chunks) using zlib/Huffman decompression. Supports Adam7 interlacing (7-pass) with row filter processing, horizontal stretching, and optional post-processing callbacks.

0x00511f23.name: sub_511F23
0x00511f23.label: Iterate session modes and process fields
0x00511f23.summary: Copies session field count from offset 0xBC to 0xC0, then iterates a number of times (from FlagBasedSessionModeSelector) calling sub_511B7C on each element of an input array for each field.

0x00511f70.name: LargeStructPartialReset
0x00511f70.label: Partial structure reset preserving vtable header and three fields
0x00511f70.summary: Releases multiple sub-resources via conditional callbacks, then zeroes most of the struct (0x19C bytes) while preserving the first 0x40 bytes (vtable header) and DWORDs at offsets 0x40, 0x44, 0x48.

0x00512319.name: BitFlagSetter_2319
0x00512319.label: Set bit 0 on flags DWORD
0x00512319.summary: Sets the lowest bit (0x1) on a flags DWORD at offset 0x60 unconditionally.

0x00512322.name: AnimationStateFlagSet
0x00512322.label: Set animation flag when state equals 16
0x00512322.summary: Conditionally sets bit 0x10 on flags DWORD at offset 0x60 when the animation-state byte at offset 0x117 equals 16.

0x00512334.name: DriverStateFlagSet
0x00512334.label: Set driver flag and state byte when state below 8
0x00512334.summary: When the state byte at offset 0x117 is less than 8, sets bit 4 on flags DWORD at offset 0x60 and writes 8 to the driver-state byte at offset 0x118.

0x0051234d.name: FlagBasedSessionModeSelector
0x0051234d.label: Select single or multi session mode by flag
0x0051234d.summary: Returns 1 (single session mode) when the selector byte at offset 0x113 is zero; otherwise sets bit 2 on flags DWORD and returns 7 (multi-session mode count).

0x00512366.name: StateFlagSetter_2366
0x00512366.label: Set flag byte and output state based on two state values
0x00512366.summary: Sets high bit on byte at offset 0x61, stores a WORD parameter at offset 0x11E, toggles bit 7 on flags byte at 0x5C based on boolean a3, and writes output state (2 or 4) at offset 0x11B depending on state bytes at offsets 0x116 and 0x117.

0x005123b3.name: sub_5123B3
0x005123b3.label: Conditional byte-swap on buffer pairs
0x005123b3.summary: When enable byte at offset 0x9 equals 16 and element count * stride is non-zero, swaps each adjacent byte pair in the output buffer (endianness conversion) for count * stride iterations.

0x005123e0.name: sub_5123E0
0x005123e0.label: Conditional pixel format byte-swap conversion
0x005123e0.summary: Conditionally converts pixel byte order in-place based on format flags (bit depth 8 or 16, swap mode 2 or 6) by swapping specific byte positions within each pixel; skips entirely when bit 1 of flag byte is clear.

0x0051249f.name: CameraRotationStateSetter
0x0051249f.label: Store camera rotation values with validation flag
0x0051249f.summary: Stores two double-precision rotation parameters as floats at offsets 0x130/0x134; sets flag bit 5 on byte at offset 0x61 when the product of the two values deviates from 1.0 by more than 0.05.

0x005124d5.name: sub_5124D5
0x005124d5.label: Set bit 4 on flags byte
0x005124d5.summary: Unconditionally sets bit 4 (0x10) on the flags byte at offset 0x61.

0x005124de.name: PacketFieldEncoding
0x005124de.label: Encode packet format fields from state flags
0x005124de.summary: Reads session state flags (bits at offsets 0x60/0x61) and configures an output packet header's encoding type, bit depth, channel count, and total size; copies camera rotation data when video flag is set.

0x005125c9.name: BitPackingUnpacking
0x005125c9.label: Unpack bit-packed data into byte fields
0x005125c9.summary: Reads bit-packed elements from a buffer and unpacks them into separate byte fields based on bit depth (1, 2, or 4 bits per element); writes result size metadata back to the tracking struct.

0x005126d9.name: sub_5126D9
0x005126d9.label: Bit-depth down-conversion with per-channel shifts
0x005126d9.summary: Converts pixel data from higher bit depth (2/4/8/16 bpp) to lower depth using per-channel shift amounts from a lookup table; supports planar and interleaved channel layouts; skips when mode byte equals 3.

0x00512850.name: BitExpandDecompress
0x00512850.label: BitExpandDecompressByTwo
0x00512850.summary: Decompression step: if state==16, deinterleave input buffer by factor 2 (take every other byte), pack contiguously, then update state to 8 and compute output stride/count.

0x00512894.name: PixelFormatExpansion
0x00512894.label: PixelFormatExpansionInPlace
0x00512894.summary: Expand packed pixel buffer in-place from lower to higher bit depth based on format state fields. Handles 1→2, 1→4, and 1→8 byte-per-pixel expansion with configurable color/alpha fill patterns.

0x00512e1a.name: sub_512E1A
0x00512e1a.label: BitpackedIndexedToRgbaDecompressor
0x00512e1a.summary: Decompress bit-packed indexed texture: phase 1 unpacks 1/2/4-bit fields to bytes, phase 2 looks up each index in a 3-byte RGB palette, optionally inserting alpha from a secondary table. Output is RGB (24-bit) or RGBA (32-bit).

0x00513022.name: BitmapDecompression
0x00513022.label: BitmapDecompressWithChromaKey
0x00513022.summary: Multi-phase bitmap decompression: phase 1 unpacks 1/2/4-bit packed pixels to bytes; phase 2 applies chroma-key transparency using a key-color table (a3). Handles both indexed and direct-color formats, outputting 2 or 4 bytes per pixel.

0x00513374.name: PixelFormatConverter
0x00513374.label: PixelFormatTo8BitIndexed
0x00513374.summary: Convert 4-byte or 5-byte RGBA pixels to 8-bit indexed via 15-bit color LUT (a3), or remap existing 8-bit indices via secondary table (a4). Updates format state fields on completion.

0x00513482.name: EngineSoundWaveTableGenerator
0x00513482.label: EngineSoundWaveTableGenerator
0x00513482.summary: Generate PCM wave tables for engine sound synthesis. Two paths: mono 256-entry linear ramp table, or multi-channel 16-bit wave table array with configurable quantization based on input amplitude profile.

0x0051378b.name: TextureImageColorTransform
0x0051378b.label: TextureColorTransformAndWaveTableGen
0x0051378b.summary: Two-pass texture/audio processing on shared state: generate engine sound wave tables and remap texture RGB pixels via lookup table (if format==3), then apply per-channel bit-shift color reduction (if flag bit 3 set and format==3).

0x0051389e.name: sub_51389E
0x0051389e.label: PNGRowTransformPipeline
0x0051389e.summary: Applies the PNG row transform pipeline to a decoded image row — checks transform flags in the PNG info struct and sequentially invokes the appropriate decompression/expansion/conversion/dithering subroutines, with fatal longjmp-guarded errors for NULL row buffer or zero rowbytes after dithering.

0x00513bd1.name: CallbackDispatchWithNullGuard
0x00513bd1.label: CallbackDispatchWithNullGuard
0x00513bd1.summary: Dispatch to callback function pointer at this+0x50 with null guard. If non-null, invoke callback(a1,a2,a3); if null, call GuardedCallWithLongjmp with error string.

0x00513bf9.name: sub_513BF9
0x00513bf9.label: SetReadCallbackWithConflictGuard
0x00513bf9.summary: Set read data callback (a3) and user data (a2) on struct. If write callback (0x4C) is already set, clear it and emit error about dual read/write conflict. Clears flag at 0x120, returns the callback pointer.

0x00513cd8.name: AnimationHandleAlloc
0x00513cd8.label: AnimationHandleHashInit
0x00513cd8.summary: Generate CRC32 hash via CRC32Computation(0,0,0) and store at this+0x100. Returns hash value. Initializes animation handle identifier.

0x00513d63.name: F_16BitColorToFloat4Decoder
0x00513d63.label: Decode16BitColorToFloat4
0x00513d63.summary: Decode 16-bit RGB 5:6:5 packed color to 4 floats (R, G, B, A=1.0). Output written to result pointer. Used in texture filtering and keyframe interpolation.

0x00513daf.name: BatchClampToMax
0x00513daf.label: BatchUnpremultiplyAlphaClamp
0x00513daf.summary: Batch process 16 float4 RGBA pixels: if alpha==0, zero RGB; if 0<alpha<1, scale RGB by 1/alpha clamped to max 1.0 (un-premultiply with clamp). If alpha>=1, leave unchanged.

0x00513e2d.name: MatrixScaleByW
0x00513e2d.label: BatchScaleXYZByW
0x00513e2d.summary: Batch-process 16 float4 vectors: multiply X, Y, Z by W (homogeneous weight). Output W unchanged. Used for 3D perspective/pre-transform vertex weighting.

0x00513e80.name: sub_513E80
0x00513e80.label: Float3RgbTo16Bit565
0x00513e80.summary: Clamp float RGB [0,1] to range and quantize to 16-bit 5:6:5 packed format. R:5 bits, G:6 bits, B:5 bits. Uses FPUControlWordMerger for rounding mode control.

0x00513f7a.name: ColorQuantization
0x00513f7a.label: QuantizeColorBounds
0x00513f7a.summary: Find optimal min/max bounds for quantizing 16 float samples to N levels (6 or 8). Uses Lloyd-Max style iterative refinement with coefficient tables; outputs clamped [0,1] bounds.

0x0051427f.name: OBBFittingAndProjection
0x0051427f.label: OBBFittingAndQuantization
0x0051427f.summary: Compute oriented bounding box of 16 float4 vertices, then iteratively refine projection bounds for quantization to N levels. Outputs min and max float3 bounds. Used for spline/texture coordinate bound fitting.

0x005147ea.name: TextureFilterAndLayerCompositing
0x005147ea.label: DxtBlockCompressor
0x005147ea.summary: Compress 4×4 float4 pixel block to DXT/BC format: compute two endpoint colors via OBB projection, quantize to 16-bit 5:6:5, build 2-bit selector bitmask per pixel. Early exit if all pixels transparent (alpha<0.5).

0x00514fee.name: KeyframeQuadInterpolationWithBitPackedSelector
0x00514fee.label: DxtBlockDecompressor
0x00514fee.summary: Decompress 4×4 DXT/BC block to 16 float4 colors. Decode two 16-bit 5:6:5 endpoint colors, interpolate 2 or 4 color palette based on endpoint ordering, then expand 32-bit selector bitmask to select output color per pixel.

0x0051512c.name: sub_51512C
0x0051512c.label: Bc3Dxt5BlockDecompressor
0x0051512c.summary: Decompress BC3/DXT5 block: call color decompressor on a2+4, then unpack 16 alpha values (two 32-bit words, 4-bit nibbles each) into float4 alpha slots with 1/15 scaling.

0x005151af.name: sub_5151AF
0x005151af.label: Bc4Bc5AlphaBlockDecompressor
0x005151af.summary: Decompress alpha channel with 3-bit selector encoding: call color decompressor on a2+4, generate interpolated alpha palette from two reference bytes, then unpack 3-bit alpha indices (two sets of 8) into float4 alpha slots.

0x00515303.name: QuantizationColorSpaceConversion
0x00515303.label: Bc3Dxt5BlockEncoder
0x00515303.summary: Encode 4×4 float4 block to BC3/DXT5: quantize alpha to 4-bit nibbles with error diffusion, pack 16 nibbles into two DWORDs (MSB-first), then delegate color block compression to TextureFilterAndLayerCompositing.

0x00515417.name: sub_515417
0x00515417.label: AlphaBlockEncoderWithColorCompression
0x00515417.summary: Encode 4×4 pixel block alpha channel with error diffusion: quantize 16 float alphas to 8-bit, find optimal bounds via ColorQuantization, generate 5 or 7-step interpolation palette, pack 3-bit selectors per pixel. Delegates color compression to TextureFilterAndLayerCompositing.

0x005159f5.name: TextureSurfaceValidator
0x005159f5.label: Texture Surface Format Validator
0x005159f5.summary: Validates texture surface dimensions and format parameters against allowed limits, then computes pixel-aligned layout descriptors (stride, dimensions) for each sub-surface. Sets up surface descriptor fields with aligned dimensions for rendering.

0x00515bb0.name: AudioVoiceChannelAllocation
0x00515bb0.label: Audio Voice Channel Allocator
0x00515bb0.summary: Allocates voice channels for PCM audio streams: computes per-stream voice counts, buffer alignments, and sample counts using ceiling division for format negotiation. Handles single-stream (direct copy) and multi-stream (iterative allocation) cases with a hard cap of 10 total voice slots. Part of the audio/voice management system.

0x00515d26.name: ObjectBufferCopyWithValidation
0x00515d26.label: ObjectBufferAllocAndCopy
0x00515d26.summary: Iterate array of object descriptors, allocate 130-byte buffers for unallocated entries, copy data from source pool. Updates parent object fields with type ID and fires vtable callback on new allocations.

0x00515db8.name: VtableDelegateDispatch
0x00515db8.label: VtableDelegateDispatch
0x00515db8.summary: Sequence three operations: audio channel allocation, buffer copy/validation, then two vtable dispatches (a1+0x194, a1+0x184). Copies field at offset 4 from second dispatch result to pointer at a1+0x18C.

0x00515df2.name: UIScreenStateMachine
0x00515df2.label: UIScreenStateTick
0x00515df2.summary: Ticks UI screen state machine. Reads state from vtable dispatch; handles transition logic for states 1 (active/idle) and 2 (exiting/completed). Manages screen change requests by writing new screen IDs and invoking screen methods through vtable.

0x00515e85.name: ArithmeticComparison_5e85
0x00515e85.label: ArithCompareSetup
0x00515e85.summary: Initializes arithmetic comparison sub-object accessed via main object (a1). Stores UIScreenStateMachine pointer, clears two byte flags, sets active flag to 1, dispatches virtual init calls, then clears result state field.

0x00515ebc.name: VtableFunctionPointerWrite
0x00515ebc.label: UIScreenStateMachineStore
0x00515ebc.summary: Stores the global UIScreenStateMachine pointer into the first dword of the sub-object at this+0x18C, then returns the sub-object pointer.

0x00515ecd.name: DirectorCameraObjectSetup
0x00515ecd.label: SetupInternalDispatchObject
0x00515ecd.summary: Allocates a 24-byte dispatch sub-object via virtual allocator at *(this+4), stores result at this+0x18C. Populates it with UIScreenStateMachine pointer, three function pointers (ArithmeticComparison_5e85, VtableDelegateDispatch, VtableFunctionPointerWrite), clears two byte flags, and sets enable byte to 1.

0x00515f0e.name: ShortComputation_5f0e
0x00515f0e.label: InitObjWithConstantAndParam
0x00515f0e.summary: Writes constant 53 to obj+0x14 and parameter a2 to obj+0x18 via pointer read from this's first field, then dispatches virtual function 0 on this and returns its result.

0x00515f23.name: MemoryAllocator
0x00515f23.label: AllocFromFreeList
0x00515f23.summary: Custom heap allocator using per-category free lists with 8-byte aligned allocation. Traverses free list for best-fit block, creates new blocks via MallocWrapper when necessary, tracks total allocated bytes at this+0x4C. Calls ShortComputation_5f0e error handler on oversized allocation or out-of-memory.

0x0051601f.name: MemoryAllocatorWithAlignment
0x0051601f.label: AlignedAllocFromMalloc
0x0051601f.summary: Allocates 8-byte aligned memory via MallocWrapper, links each new block into a per-category singly-linked free list at this+0x3C+4*a2. Always allocates fresh from system heap (no block splitting). Tracks total allocation size at this+0x4C.

0x005160ad.name: MemoryAllocatorWithChunking
0x005160ad.label: ChunkedElementAllocator
0x005160ad.summary: Allocates elements in bulk chunks via MemoryAllocatorWithAlignment and builds a pointer-index array via MemoryAllocator. Stores computed chunk size at this+0x50. Returns pointer to the array of element pointers.

0x005161dd.name: LinkedListNodeAllocAndInsert
0x005161dd.label: AllocLinkedListNodeInsertHead
0x005161dd.summary: Allocates a 120-byte node via MemoryAllocator, populates it with caller-supplied data (a4, a5, a6, a3) and metadata, then inserts at head of singly-linked list at this+0x44. Returns new node pointer.

0x0051623e.name: sub_51623E
0x0051623e.label: AllocLinkedListNodeInsertHead2
0x0051623e.summary: Same pattern as LinkedListNodeAllocAndInsert but inserts into a separate linked list anchored at this+0x48. Allocates 120-byte node via MemoryAllocator, populates with caller data, prepends to list.

0x0051629f.name: DirectXTextureSurfaceAllocation
0x0051629f.label: D3DTextureSurfaceAllocator
0x0051629f.summary: Allocates Direct3D texture surfaces by walking two linked lists of surface descriptors, computing total pixel area, determining a memory-budget scale factor, and allocating/clamping each surface's dimensions accordingly. Part of the DirectX texture/resource management system.

0x0051641e.name: sub_51641E
0x0051641e.label: IterateProcessWithBounds
0x0051641e.summary: Iterates over indexed elements from array at *(this) with boundary-clamped chunk sizes, dispatching each chunk to one of two callbacks (this+0x28 or this+0x2C selected by flag a3). Each callback receives destination, state pointer, element pointer, base offset, and byte count.

0x00516531.name: RingBufferWriteWithBoundsCheck
0x00516531.label: RingBufferWriteValidate
0x00516531.summary: Validates write parameters against ring buffer state at a2: checks capacity (a2+4), max write size (a2+12), and buffer existence. Updates write position (a2+24) and written-position bound (a2+28). Optionally zero-fills new elements or dispatches via sub_51641E. Returns pointer into buffer array at computed offset.

0x0051664f.name: OffsetValidationWithBufferUpdate
0x0051664f.label: BufferWriteValidateOffset
0x0051664f.summary: Validates write parameters against buffer state at a2, similar to RingBufferWriteValidate but with alternative reposition logic (sets position to a3 on else) and different zero-fill stride (element_size * 128). Dispatches out-of-bounds regions via sub_5164A6.

0x00516772.name: sub_516772
0x00516772.label: FreeListCleanupByCategory
0x00516772.summary: Frees all nodes in two free list chains for a given category, decrementing the allocation counter at this+0x4C. For category a2==1, processes two active node lists first: invokes cleanup callbacks on nodes with flag set, then clears list heads.

0x00516853.name: TwoIterationCleanup
0x00516853.label: TwoPassCleanup
0x00516853.summary: Runs sub_516772 cleanup for categories 1 and 0 in two iterations, then frees the base pointer at this+0x4 and clears it to 0. Delegates final return value to EmptyStub_7b96.

0x00516883.name: RenderVTableObjectInit
0x00516883.label: AllocatorVTableInit
0x00516883.summary: Allocates a 80-byte function dispatch table via MallocWrapper, populates it with 11 function pointers composing the allocator interface (MemoryAllocator, MemoryAllocatorWithAlignment, etc.), zeroes internal state fields, and stores the table at this+0x4. On allocation failure writes constant 53 to obj and dispatches error via vtable.

0x00516937.name: VirtualDispatchConditionalValue
0x00516937.label: SetDispatchPriorityValue
0x00516937.summary: Dispatches a virtual call to *(this+4)+0x24 with argument 1, then reads byte flag at this+0xC to determine result value (200 if non-zero, 100 if zero). Stores result at this+0x10 and returns it.

0x00516959.name: sub_516959
0x00516959.label: CleanupAndResetState
0x00516959.summary: If pointer at this+0x4 is non-null, invokes its cleanup callback at offset 0x28 with this as argument. Then clears both this+0x4 and this+0x10 to 0. Returns the old value of this+0x4.

0x00516974.name: VTableAllocNullTerminate
0x00516974.label: AllocAndNullTerminateBuffer
0x00516974.summary: Allocates a 130-byte buffer via vtable function at *(this+4) (first entry, called as allocator), writes a zero byte at offset 128 (null terminator), and returns the buffer pointer.

0x005169ac.name: ComplexStateValidator
0x005169ac.label: ValidateObjectState
0x005169ac.summary: Validates an object's state by checking multiple fields against expected values. Returns 1 if all checks pass (byte flags clear, enum-type fields match expected constants, sub-object fields consistent), 0 on any mismatch.

0x00516a1d.name: sub_516A1D
0x00516a1d.label: VideoTextureFormatSetup
0x00516a1d.summary: Sets up video texture/format allocation parameters: computes power-of-two scale factors and mipmap-level dimensions from width/height ratios, iterates over entries to assign optimal texture sizes, and validates format support via ComplexStateValidator.

0x00516c0c.name: BufferInitWithIdentityPattern
0x00516c0c.label: InitIdentityLookupTables
0x00516c0c.summary: Allocates a 1408-byte buffer via vtable allocator at *(this+4), stores pointer at this+0x11C. Fills first 256 bytes with identity pattern (each byte = its index), then populates three sequential tables: 0xFF fill, zero fill, and a copy of the identity table.

0x00516c7b.name: sub_516C7B
0x00516c7b.label: MediaStreamPlaybackObjectConstructor
0x00516c7b.summary: Initializes a media stream/playback object: validates state, allocates buffers (Huffman tree/context, UI combo box, media decode, playback), configures input bindings or stream decoder based on flags, and wires up sub-objects for audio/video playback. Media/UI initialization system.

0x00516e28.name: UIControlStateMachine
0x00516e28.label: UIControlStateMachine
0x00516e28.summary: UI control state machine per-tick update: manages control activation state, state transitions, virtual-function dispatch for rendering/input handling, and child-control position updates. Implements a state machine with flag-based branching for button press, hold, and release logic.

0x00516f55.name: PhysicsStepCounterIncrement
0x00516f55.label: PhysicsStepIncrementCounter
0x00516f55.summary: Checks flag byte at this+0x4A; if set, dispatches virtual call via function table at this+0x1A4 (entry +8). Always increments step counter at sub-object offset 0xC (accessed via this+0x17C). Returns either virtual call result or this pointer.

0x00516f76.name: ObjectConstructor_6f76
0x00516f76.label: ConstructSubObject
0x00516f76.summary: Allocates a 28-byte sub-object via vtable allocator at this+0x4, stores at this+0x17C. Initializes byte flag at +8 to 0, stores UIControlStateMachine pointer and PhysicsStepCounterIncrement function pointer. Delegates remaining init to sub_516C7B.

0x00516fb0.name: UnidentifiedLogicFunctionTable
0x00516fb0.label: MathFunctionTableInitializer
0x00516fb0.summary: Populates a pre-allocated function pointer table (vtable-like dispatch table) with pointers to SIMD/SSE math library functions — vector normalization, spline interpolation, matrix multiplication, axis-angle conversion, and related utilities. Initialization/startup system.

0x005170c0.name: sub_5170C0
0x005170c0.label: SSE Math Interpolation VTable Initializer
0x005170c0.summary: Initializes a vtable/function-pointer table for an SSE-accelerated math library, wiring up ~32 entries covering vector operations, cubic/hermite/bezier spline interpolation, bilinear interpolation, matrix math, triangle geometry, and Newton-Raphson refinement. Called once during setup.

0x005172a5.name: sub_5172A5
0x005172a5.label: SIMD Math Function Table Initialization (3DNow/MMX Dispatch)
0x005172a5.summary: Detects CPU SIMD feature flags via sub_5171D0 and populates a 57-entry function-pointer table with 3DNow/MMX-optimized math routines (quaternion, matrix, vector, interpolation). If SSE/SSE2 bits are also available, overrides selected entries with alternative optimized implementations.

0x00517927.name: FunctionTableInit
0x00517927.label: FillMathFunctionTable
0x00517927.summary: Populates an 8-entry function pointer table with math/geometry transform functions: Vec2AffineTransform, sub_517569, sub_517653, two 4x4 matrix multiply variants, Mat2x2Mul, sub_5175F4, and VectorNormalize.

0x00517963.name: ResourceResetWithCounter
0x00517963.label: ResetResourceWithStateCheck
0x00517963.summary: Validates non-null pointers (this and sub-object at this+0x1C), resets state counters to 0 (this+0x8, this+0x14, this+0x18), sets sub-object first dword to 7 or 0 based on condition flag at sub-object+0xC, then calls sub_52765A with data pointer from sub-object+0x14.

0x005179a2.name: sub_5179A2
0x005179a2.label: CleanupResourceWithCallback
0x005179a2.summary: Validates non-null pointers for this, sub-object at this+0x1C, and callback at this+0x24. Optionally calls cleanup function sub_527EED if pointer at sub-object+0x14 is non-null. Invokes callback from this+0x24 with data from this+0x28 and sub-object pointer. Clears sub-object pointer at this+0x1C to 0.

0x005179e0.name: sub_5179E0
0x005179e0.label: StreamResourceInit
0x005179e0.summary: Initializes a stream/resource object with allocator callbacks, allocates a 24-byte internal buffer, and configures size parameters. Part of decompression/stream system.

0x00517adc.name: sub_517ADC
0x00517adc.label: InflateBlockProcessor
0x00517adc.summary: Processes a deflate-compressed data block through a state machine (header parsing, optional dictionary, decompression via sub_527752, and CRC/adler32 checksum verification). Part of zlib decompression system.

0x00517f35.name: ByteArrayToInt
0x00517f35.label: ByteArrayBEToInt
0x00517f35.summary: Converts a 4-byte big-endian byte array to an integer value. Utility function.

0x00517f58.name: sub_517F58
0x00517f58.label: CRC32UpdateBlock
0x00517f58.summary: Dispatches a callback via CallbackDispatchWithNullGuard, then conditionally updates a CRC32 accumulator from the data block. Part of CRC tracking system.

0x00517f72.name: AnimationStateCheck
0x00517f72.label: AnimationStateCheck
0x00517f72.summary: Evaluates animation state flags to determine whether animation state has changed, by comparing current state bytes (via ByteArrayToInt) against stored CRC32 accumulator. Calls CallbackDispatchWithNullGuard regardless.

0x00518032.name: JPEGHuffmanDecoder
0x00518032.label: BitStreamPixelUnpacker
0x00518032.summary: Unpacks packed pixel data from a source buffer into individual pixel slots, handling 1/2/4/8+ bits per pixel formats. Reads from a source data pointer (+1 offset) and expands into output buffer based on bit depth.

0x00518248.name: TextureHorizontalStretch
0x00518248.label: TextureHorizontalStretch
0x00518248.summary: Stretches a single-row texture horizontally by duplicating/repeating pixels to fill a target width. Handles 1/2/4/8+ bits per pixel formats using stride table for output dimensions.

0x0051868c.name: AudioBufferSizeCalc
0x0051868c.label: TextureBufferSizeSetup
0x0051868c.summary: Calculates and allocates texture/surface buffer dimensions (row stride, buffer size) based on image width, bit depth, color type, and interlace/compression flags. Part of image decoding pipeline.

0x00518828.name: sub_518828
0x00518828.label: CRCErrorCheckAndDispatch
0x00518828.summary: Processes a data block through CRC update, checks if animation state changed, and dispatches a "CRC error" message via either DoubleBufferInit or TwoStepDelegation depending on control flags. Part of data integrity system.

0x005188b4.name: sub_5188B4
0x005188b4.label: PNGu0001HDRChunkParser
0x005188b4.summary: Parses and validates a PNG IHDR (image header) chunk. Checks chunk length==13, validates width, height, bit depth, color type, compression, filter, and interlace values, then stores parsed parameters and computes bytes-per-pixel. Part of PNG image decoder.

0x00518aaa.name: sub_518AAA
0x00518aaa.label: PNGPLTEChunkParser
0x00518aaa.summary: Parses and validates a PNG PLTE (palette) chunk. Checks chunk ordering (requires IHDR first, no IDAT before PLTE, no duplicate PLTE), validates palette length is multiple of 3, allocates and fills palette entries, and stores palette info. Part of PNG decoder.

0x00518bd4.name: sub_518BD4
0x00518bd4.label: PNGIENDChunkHandler
0x00518bd4.summary: Handles PNG IEND (image end) chunk. Validates that image was present (IHDR and IDAT processed), sets done flags (0x18), optionally warns on non-zero chunk length, and runs CRC error check. Part of PNG decoder.

0x00518c1e.name: sub_518C1E
0x00518c1e.label: PNGu0000ChunkParser
0x00518c1e.summary: Parses and validates a PNG gAMA (gamma) chunk. Checks chunk ordering (requires IHDR first, no duplicate before IDAT, no gAMA after IDAT), validates 4-byte length, converts gamma value to float, and stores at this+0x130. Part of PNG decoder.

0x00518d29.name: sub_518D29
0x00518d29.label: PNGu0000ChunkParser
0x00518d29.summary: Parses and validates a PNG sRGB chunk. Checks chunk ordering (requires IHDR first, no duplicate before IDAT, no sRGB after IDAT), validates 1-byte length, reads rendering intent byte, and stores sRGB info. Part of PNG decoder.

0x00518e18.name: sub_518E18
0x00518e18.label: PNGtRNSChunkParser
0x00518e18.summary: Parses and validates a PNG tRNS (transparency) chunk. Handles palette-indexed (color type 3: per-index alpha) and direct-color (type 0/2: single transparent color) transparency data. Stores alpha values and sets transparent color entries. Part of PNG decoder.

0x00518fcf.name: sub_518FCF
0x00518fcf.label: UnknownCriticalChunkHandler
0x00518fcf.summary: Handles an unknown critical PNG chunk by checking control flags, potentially dispatching an error message, setting done flag bits, and running CRC error check. Part of PNG decoder.

0x00519019.name: sub_519019
0x00519019.label: PNGIDATDecompress
0x00519019.summary: Decompresses PNG IDAT (image data) chunks using inflate decompression. Manages interlaced (Adam7) and non-interlaced row decoding, reads successive IDAT chunks, feeds them to the inflater, validates decompression completion, and sets done flags. Core PNG data decompression routine.

0x00519361.name: SurfaceMemoryAllocate
0x00519361.label: SurfaceMemoryAllocate
0x00519361.summary: Sets surface memory stride/pitch to 48 bytes then delegates allocation to the object's vtable function. Part of surface/texture memory management.

0x00519375.name: VertexBufferOffsetSetup
0x00519375.label: VertexBufferOffsetSetup
0x00519375.summary: Allocates and populates vertex buffer offset arrays for each animation/render element. Computes per-element buffer start and end offsets based on element dimensions and stride. Part of rendering pipeline.

0x0051941d.name: TextureRowCopy
0x0051941d.label: TextureRowCopy
0x0051941d.summary: Copies texture row data for each render element between source and destination buffers, applying horizontal expansion/interpolation and offset calculations. Part of rendering/animation playback pipeline.

0x0051954e.name: PerIndexBufferCopyWithInterleavedOffset
0x0051954e.label: PerIndexBufferCopyWithInterleavedOffset
0x0051954e.summary: Copies per-element buffer data between source and destination arrays with interleaved offset pattern. For each element, copies content from source to destination while mirroring/repeating across adjacent positions. Part of rendering/animation buffer management.

0x00519622.name: ArrayProcessingWithScaling
0x00519622.label: ArrayProcessingWithScaling
0x00519622.summary: Processes element data arrays with scaling and modulo-based offset calculation. Computes per-element size from descriptors, applies modulo wrap for data positioning, and copies mirrored data between buffers. Part of rendering/animation buffer management.

0x005196b8.name: BufferedDataStreamWrite
0x005196b8.label: BufferedDataStreamWrite
0x005196b8.summary: Writes data to a buffered stream. Initializes the buffer on first call, dispatches data write via vtable callback, tracks buffer fill level, and resets buffer when full. Part of buffered output stream system.

0x00519720.name: AudioStreamBufferFill
0x00519720.label: AudioStreamBufferFill
0x00519720.summary: Fills audio/stream buffer using a 3-state machine (init, write, flush). Manages double-buffering with XOR toggle, tracks write cycles, and dispatches per-index buffer copy when cycle completes. Part of streaming output system.

0x00519828.name: RendererVtableDispatchWrapper
0x00519828.label: RendererVtableDispatchWrapper
0x00519828.summary: Dispatches a renderer call through a vtable function pointer at *(this+0x188)+4, passing three zero-valued initial arguments followed by the three caller arguments. Simple wrapper for renderer API calls.

0x0051984b.name: PlaybackStateController
0x0051984b.label: PlaybackStateRouter
0x0051984b.summary: Dispatches playback state transitions by selecting stream buffer callbacks (AudioStreamBufferFill, BufferedDataStreamWrite, or RendererVtableDispatchWrapper) and zeroing state fields based on command parameter a2.

0x005198b3.name: MediaBufferAlloc
0x005198b3.label: MediaBufferAllocAndSetup
0x005198b3.summary: Allocates a media playback buffer (80 bytes), sets its vtable to PlaybackStateController, conditionally patches vtable entries, then fills frame buffer slots from sub-struct dimension data via VertexBufferOffsetSetup.

0x00519986.name: SpriteFrameSelector
0x00519986.label: SpriteFrameSelector
0x00519986.summary: Selects current sprite frame index based on position within an animation sequence, writing frame data and zeroing output fields on the frame info struct.

0x005199c5.name: InitAndChain
0x005199c5.label: InitAndChain
0x005199c5.summary: Resets animation current index to 0 and chains to SpriteFrameSelector to select the initial frame.

0x005199d5.name: CompositingPass
0x005199d5.label: CompositingPass
0x005199d5.summary: Renders composited sprite scan lines onto a buffer by iterating through visible sprite objects and dispatching their draw functions, advancing frame when current line completes.

0x00519bb2.name: CompositingCopy
0x00519bb2.label: CompositingCopy
0x00519bb2.summary: Copies composited sprite pixel data into destination buffers through sprite object descriptors, advancing frame when the current copy line reaches the buffer limit.

0x00519d51.name: DrawableObjectBatchProcessor
0x00519d51.label: DrawableObjectBatchProcessor
0x00519d51.summary: Processes a batch of drawable sprite objects by waiting for position synchronization, allocating per-object buffers, and dispatching render calls for visible objects.

0x00519eb7.name: RenderStateCopyWithValidation
0x00519eb7.label: RenderStateCopyWithValidation
0x00519eb7.summary: Copies validated render state data from source buffer to destination, checking that all sprite object pointer fields are non-null and the source state values are non-negative.

0x00519f9a.name: AudioSubbandSynthesisFilterbank
0x00519f9a.label: MpegAudioSynthesisFilterbank
0x00519f9a.summary: Performs MPEG audio subband synthesis — applies inverse quantization, inverse modified DCT, and polyphase filterbank to reconstruct PCM samples from 32 subband frequency-domain data. Part of the MPEG Layer 2/3 audio decoding subsystem.

0x0051a4b7.name: ProtocolStateHandler
0x0051a4b7.label: ProtocolStateHandler
0x0051a4b7.summary: Selects processing handler (AudioSubbandSynthesisFilterbank or DrawableObjectBatchProcessor) based on render state validation flag, then resets position counter.

0x0051a4f2.name: UIListComboBoxConstructor
0x0051a4f2.label: UIListComboBoxConstructor
0x0051a4f2.summary: Allocates and initializes a rendering state buffer (116 bytes) with function pointers and per-object or flat buffer allocations, selecting between copy mode and compositing mode based on a2 parameter.

0x0051a794.name: sub_51A794
0x0051a794.label: BitstreamReaderWithEscape
0x0051a794.summary: Reads bytes into a bit accumulator, handling 0xFF escape sequences (MPEG start code emulation), refilling from a callback when data runs out.

0x0051a87e.name: HuffmanArithmeticBitstreamSymbolDecoder
0x0051a87e.label: HuffmanArithmeticBitstreamSymbolDecoder
0x0051a87e.summary: Decodes a Huffman-coded symbol from a bitstream by extracting a code word, walking the Huffman tree if needed, and returning the decoded symbol from a lookup table.

0x0051a968.name: AudioBufferReset
0x0051a968.label: AudioBufferReset
0x0051a968.summary: Resets audio decode buffer state by accumulating byte count into total, zeroing per-channel arrays, setting a reference value, and clearing the ready flag.

0x0051a9c6.name: TextureDecompression
0x0051a9c6.label: TextureDecompression
0x0051a9c6.summary: Decompresses one block of texture data using Huffman-coded bitstream with run-length and distance encoding (DEFLATE-like), processing up to this->0x13C sub-blocks per call.

0x0051ad93.name: ArrayProcessingWithValidation
0x0051ad93.label: ArrayProcessingWithValidation
0x0051ad93.summary: Validates per-object channel indices (0-3 with non-null buffers), copies channel data via sub_51A5EA, then resets decode state fields and counters.

0x0051aec2.name: HuffmanCtxAlloc
0x0051aec2.label: HuffmanCtxAlloc
0x0051aec2.summary: Allocates a Huffman decode context (88 bytes), sets vtable methods to ArrayProcessingWithValidation and TextureDecompression, and zeros internal state slots.

0x0051aefc.name: CounterUpdateWithZero
0x0051aefc.label: CounterUpdateWithZero
0x0051aefc.summary: Resets decode counter state by accumulating byte count into total, zeroing per-channel counters, setting a reference value, and clearing the ready flag.

0x0051af57.name: BitstreamDecoder
0x0051af57.label: BitstreamDecoder
0x0051af57.summary: Decodes one block of bitstream data by reading Huffman-coded symbols from sub-blocks, applying extra bits from tables, and writing shifted results to output.

0x0051b154.name: sub_51B154
0x0051b154.label: HuffmanDecodeWithRunLength
0x0051b154.summary: Decodes a range of Huffman-coded symbols with run-length and distance encoding, writing decoded values shifted by a scale factor to an output array.

0x0051b37d.name: PlaneVisibilityTestWithBitfieldOutput
0x0051b37d.label: PlaneVisibilityTestWithBitfieldOutput
0x0051b37d.summary: Reads one bit per plane-sub-block from bitstream and ORs a mask into visibility bitfield output words, indicating which planes/layers are visible.

0x0051b45f.name: sub_51B45F
0x0051b45f.label: HuffmanDecodeSignedDelta
0x0051b45f.summary: Decodes Huffman-coded delta values with sign adjustment, incrementally modifying existing coefficient values in a range, with rollback on failure.

0x0051b7cd.name: sub_51B7CD
0x0051b7cd.label: PlaneVisibilityRangeSetup
0x0051b7cd.summary: Validates and configures bitstream/visibility plane ranges — fills a 256-entry per-plane table with a target value over a specified index range, then selects and assigns decoder callback functions (BitstreamDecoder, sub_51B154, PlaneVisibilityTestWithBitfieldOutput, or sub_51B45F) to the output object based on mode flags and bitstream presence.

0x0051ba70.name: HuffmanTreeAlloc
0x0051ba70.label: HuffmanTreeAlloc
0x0051ba70.summary: Allocates Huffman tree context (80 bytes) with vtable method sub_51B7CD, plus a flat table buffer (count * 256 bytes) initialized to -1/0xFF.

0x0051bad1.name: FAILOverviewSaysFIRCrossfeedButDispatchesToIMDCT
0x0051bad1.label: AudioProcessingModeDispatch
0x0051bad1.summary: Dispatches per-object audio processing based on mode field (AudioSampleLookup, AudioFIRConvolutionFilter, FixedPointIDCT, render branch, audio mixing) and performs optional data transformation (copy, round-multiply, or float-multiply).

0x0051bc88.name: UIListComboBoxBufferAllocator
0x0051bc88.label: UIListComboBoxBufferAllocator
0x0051bc88.summary: Allocates per-object 256-byte buffers initialized to zero, stores them at object+80, and initializes a dispatch state with FAILOverviewSaysFIRCrossfeedButDispatchesToIMDCT vtable.

0x0051bcfc.name: RenderCommandDispatch
0x0051bcfc.label: RenderCommandDispatch
0x0051bcfc.summary: Processes a render data chunk through a processing function, writes output to destination buffer, and returns count of items processed.

0x0051bd61.name: AudioRingBufferManager
0x0051bd61.label: AudioRingBufferWrite
0x0051bd61.summary: Writes audio data to a ring buffer. On first call, allocates the buffer via vtable. Copies input samples, zero-fills newly written region if fill level advanced, and wraps cursor when buffer is full. Returns buffer capacity.

0x0051bdf1.name: BufferedDataReader
0x0051bdf1.label: Ring buffer read manager
0x0051bdf1.summary: Reads audio data from a ring buffer into an output buffer, with clamping against available data and a size limit. Allocates read buffer on first use, copies via virtual dispatch, and wraps read position at buffer capacity.

0x0051be7d.name: SoundEffectStateCallback
0x0051be7d.label: Sound effect state transition handler
0x0051be7d.summary: Handles state transitions for a sound effect audio object. Selects the appropriate ring buffer function (read/write/render dispatch) based on state parameter a2, allocates buffer on first use, and resets ring buffer position on each transition.

0x0051bf23.name: PlaybackBufferAlloc
0x0051bf23.label: Audio playback buffer allocation
0x0051bf23.summary: Allocates and initializes the ring buffer sub-struct for audio playback. Creates a 28-byte control block, sets SoundEffectStateCallback as the state handler, and conditionally allocates the audio data buffer (read or write variant based on flag a2).

0x0051bfa6.name: VehicleStructFieldCopy
0x0051bfa6.label: Vehicle parameter struct copy
0x0051bfa6.summary: Copies two dimension/size values (at offsets 0x110 and 0x60) from the main struct into a target sub-struct pointed to by offset 0x19C. Unconditional field-level copy within a vehicle or physics system.

0x0051bfc0.name: AudioBufferMixing
0x0051bfc0.label: Audio channel mixing flush and copy
0x0051bfc0.summary: Mixes audio by flushing accumulated channel data when buffer is full, then copying the next block of samples to output. Iterates over active channels via virtual dispatch, clamps copy size by remaining data and output space, and updates consumed/remaining counters.

0x0051c099.name: TrackMapPixelFill
0x0051c099.label: Track map pixel expansion fill
0x0051c099.summary: Expands track map pixel data by filling memory with repeated pixel values using memset32. Reads row data from source, expands each pixel horizontally by a repeat count, then optionally duplicates rows via 2D array block copy for vertical expansion.

0x0051c176.name: MonochromeBufferByteDuplicateCopy
0x0051c176.label: Monochrome pixel double-width blit
0x0051c176.summary: Copies each source byte into two consecutive destination bytes, doubling the horizontal width. Iterates over rows by count, processing each row up to its width boundary. Used for monochrome/stencil-style bitmap expansion.

0x0051c1cd.name: BufferInterleaveCopy
0x0051c1cd.label: Interleaved pixel double-width row copy
0x0051c1cd.summary: Interleaved buffer blit that copies each source byte twice (double width) into every other destination row, then uses 2D array block copy to duplicate the filled row to the adjacent row. Steps by 2 in destination, effectively expanding a source row into two identical destination rows.

0x0051c237.name: PixelBlendFilterHorizontal
0x0051c237.label: Horizontal 3-tap pixel blend filter
0x0051c237.summary: Applies a horizontal weighted blend filter across pixel rows using a 3-tap kernel (weights 3-1-3). Processes each row of pixels, blending adjacent values with shift-divide for each output pixel.

0x0051c2db.name: ImageResampleFilter
0x0051c2db.label: Vertical resampling pixel blend
0x0051c2db.summary: Resamples image rows by blending adjacent source row pairs with weighted convolution (weights 3:1, shifts by 4). Processes two source rows per output row, applying a vertical filter kernel with per-pixel channel blending.

0x0051c3e2.name: MediaAudioDecodeDispatch
0x0051c3e2.label: Media Decode Function Table Dispatcher
0x0051c3e2.summary: Allocates a decode descriptor table and populates it with function pointers selected based on media surface format, dimensions, and resampling requirements. Dispatches to the appropriate pixel copy/blend/filter routine (monochrome duplicate, interleave copy, pixel blend, image resample, or track map fill) for each sub-surface.

0x0051c5a3.name: TableInitWithArithmeticProgression
0x0051c5a3.label: Wheel lookup table arithmetic fill
0x0051c5a3.summary: Allocates four 1024-DWORD lookup tables via vtable dispatch and fills each with arithmetic progression values (three linear sequences and one pointer-derived sequence). Used for initializing wheel/suspension suspension-damper data tables.

0x0051c653.name: F_2DBlitTextureCopy
0x0051c653.label: 2D texture column-wise blit copy
0x0051c653.summary: Copies texture pixel data with column-to-row transposition. For each output row, iterates columns, copying source row segments into destination with vertical stride equal to column count. Used for texture orientation/transpose during 2D blit operations.

0x0051c6be.name: F_2DCopyDelegation
0x0051c6be.label: 2D copy delegation to array block copy
0x0051c6be.summary: Thin wrapper that delegates a 2D rectangular copy to F_2DArrayBlockCopy with reordered parameters. Reads row width from struct offset 0x5C.

0x0051c6e1.name: sub_51C6E1
0x0051c6e1.label: Per-pixel color lookup table filter
0x0051c6e1.summary: Applies a per-pixel color transformation using four lookup tables. For each pixel, reads source channel values, indexes into the lookup tables at v5[2-5], and writes transformed RGBA output with 255-range blending. Used for color correction/adjustment in the 2D rendering pipeline.

0x0051c813.name: sub_51C813
0x0051c813.label: SIMD pixel blend/composite processing
0x0051c813.summary: Processes 4-pixel groups using MMX/SSE SIMD instructions with six QWORD constants. Reads from three source buffers, performs packed arithmetic (subtract, multiply-add, shift, pack), and writes 3 DWORDs of composite output per iteration. Likely performs color-space conversion or alpha blending in the 2D pipeline.

0x0051c94f.name: sub_51C94F
0x0051c94f.label: Row-wise color lookup table render with SIMD/scalar paths
0x0051c94f.summary: Renders per-pixel color transformations across rows using four lookup tables. Has dual code paths: SIMD (via sub_51C813 for 8-pixel groups followed by scalar remainder) and full scalar path, selected by a global rendering mode flag. Each pixel is computed by indexing into tables using source channel values with a 255-range base offset.

0x0051cb6d.name: InputBindingConfigSetup
0x0051cb6d.label: Rendering mode and function table setup
0x0051cb6d.summary: Allocates and initializes a 24-byte rendering function table based on mode parameters (offsets 0x20, 0x24, 0x28). Selects one of several 2D blit/composite functions (SIMD, scalar copy, color lookup) and initializes the table sub-struct. Conditionally clears channel state buffers and sets mode flags.

0x0051cc8e.name: WheelGeometryDataInitialization
0x0051cc8e.label: Wheel suspension table arithmetic fill
0x0051cc8e.summary: Allocates four 1024-DWORD lookup tables via vtable dispatch and fills each with arithmetic progression values (same progression constants as TableInitWithArithmeticProgression). Stores tables in a different sub-struct (at offset 0x19C) for wheel geometry/suspension data.

0x0051cd3e.name: PhysicsObjectStateSetter
0x0051cd3e.label: Physics sub-struct state initialization
0x0051cd3e.summary: Initializes a physics-related sub-struct by clearing a byte state flag to 0 and copying a parameter value from the main struct offset 0x60 to the sub-struct offset 0x2C.

0x0051cd53.name: AudioSampleStream
0x0051cd53.label: Audio sample stream with buffered partial read
0x0051cd53.summary: Streams audio samples from input to output with a single-sample buffer for handling partial reads. When a pending sample is buffered (flag set), flushes it first via block copy. Otherwise reads 1-2 samples, stores partial reads for next call, and dispatches via function pointer.

0x0051cdf9.name: VirtualDispatchWrapper_cdf9
0x0051cdf9.label: Virtual dispatch with pointer advancement
0x0051cdf9.summary: Dispatches a single-element operation via a virtual method call on a sub-struct, then advances both the input pointer and output count by 1. Thin wrapper around a vtable-based processing function.

0x0051ce2a.name: TexturePaletteColorLookup
0x0051ce2a.label: Palette-indexed texture color lookup
0x0051ce2a.summary: Converts palette-indexed texture data to RGB output using four color lookup tables. Processes source index bytes in pairs, performing table lookups to produce 6 output bytes (2 pixels) per iteration, with fallback for odd-width rows.

0x0051d166.name: StreamDecoderInit
0x0051d166.label: Stream decoder sub-struct initialization
0x0051d166.summary: Allocates and initializes a 48-byte stream decoder sub-struct. Sets function pointers for stream processing, decoder logic, and state handling based on a mode flag: audio path (flag=2) with sample stream functions and buffer allocation, or texture/palette path with dispatch wrapper and color lookup functions. Delegates to WheelGeometryDataInitialization for final setup.

0x0051d1db.name: TrackSurfaceHeightmapIncrement
0x0051d1db.label: Track surface heightmap counter increment
0x0051d1db.summary: Increments uint16 counters in a track surface heightmap grid based on 3-byte-per-pixel source data. Each pixel's bytes encode a grid position (x, y, z via shift operations), and the function increments the counter at that position, clamping overflow to 65535 (-1).

0x0051d247.name: GridOccupancyBoundingBoxScan
0x0051d247.label: GridOccupancyBoundaryShrink
0x0051d247.summary: Scans 3D occupancy grid of 16-bit cells to find tight axis-aligned bounding box of populated (non-zero) entries. Shrinks min/max bounds per axis by scanning inward from each direction and returns count of occupied cells.

0x0051d6d2.name: F_2DImageWeightedAverage
0x0051d6d2.label: WeightedCentroidCompute
0x0051d6d2.summary: Computes weighted centroid (center of mass) of non-zero pixel values within a 2D grid region. Accumulates weighted sums of X/Y/Z coordinates using pixel values as weights, normalizes by total weight, and writes 3 byte results to output.

0x0051d80a.name: RenderBufferSetup
0x0051d80a.label: VehicleRenderBufferSetup
0x0051d80a.summary: Sets up render buffer for vehicle texture rendering. Allocates bounding box array, initializes to full grid bounds, tightens via GridOccupancyBoundingBoxScan, subdivides via sub_51D57F, computes weighted centroid for each sub-region via F_2DImageWeightedAverage, stores count to output field.

0x0051d897.name: PaletteVectorQuantizationNearestNeighbor
0x0051d897.label: PaletteNearestColorSearch
0x0051d897.summary: Performs nearest-neighbor search in a three-component palette for a target color. Computes weighted squared distance per channel with threshold-based deviation penalties, returns indices of palette entries within best distance threshold to output buffer.

0x0051da17.name: sub_51DA17
0x0051da17.label: VQBlockErrorBufferFill
0x0051da17.summary: For each palette entry index in source array, computes weighted squared color difference to target components. Fills 128-element block distance buffer (4x8x4 pattern) with best-matching palette entry index per position, updating when a closer match is found.

0x0051dc01.name: PackedPixelCopyWithPaletteLookup
0x0051dc01.label: RGB565PaletteLookupPixelCopy
0x0051dc01.summary: Copies pixels from packed source to destination using RGB 5-6-5 palette lookup. Reads 3 bytes per pixel (R>>3, G>>2, B>>3) as grid key, looks up palette cell, calls BitstreamTextureBlockCopy if cell empty, writes palette index-minus-1 to output.

0x0051dcaa.name: BlockTextureDecompression
0x0051dcaa.label: BlockDitherTextureDecompress
0x0051dcaa.summary: Decompresses block-compressed texture with serpentine-scan error diffusion. Alternates left-to-right/right-to-left per row using toggle flag, looks up palette grid, calls BitstreamTextureBlockCopy for unpopulated cells, computes and distributes quantization error to neighboring pixels.

0x0051df18.name: SymmetricArrayInit
0x0051df18.label: SymmetricOffsetTableInit
0x0051df18.summary: Allocates and initializes a 256-entry symmetric offset table. Creates array with positive values on one side and negative on the other, centered at buffer midpoint, used for symmetric convolution indexing.

0x0051dfa8.name: VehicleUpdateFrameSetup
0x0051dfa8.label: VehicleFrameUpdateSetup
0x0051dfa8.summary: Sets up rendering frame for vehicle display. Copies palette pointer from context to working slot, calls RenderBufferSetup with step size parameter, sets context dirty/init flag to 1.

0x0051dfcb.name: sub_51DFCB
0x0051dfcb.label: TextureCodecModeDispatch
0x0051dfcb.summary: Dispatches between texture encoding modes based on state flag. Selects PackedPixelCopyWithPaletteLookup (mode 0/1) or BlockTextureDecompression (mode 2). Allocates dither buffer and symmetric table when entering mode 2, clears grid rows when dirty flag is set.

0x0051e0cd.name: SetVehicleFlag
0x0051e0cd.label: SetVehicleDirtyFlag
0x0051e0cd.summary: Sets the initialization/dirty flag at context offset 0x1C to 1, indicating render state needs refresh.

0x0051e0dc.name: sub_51E0DC
0x0051e0dc.label: TextureContextInit
0x0051e0dc.summary: Initializes texture processing context. Allocates main structure (44 bytes), sets dispatch function pointers, validates pixel mode (must be 3), allocates 32 row buffers (4KB each), allocates palette buffer, conditionally allocates dither resources when mode 2 activated.

0x0051e1ef.name: CombinatorialPermutationGenerator
0x0051e1ef.label: CombinatorialPermutationGenerator
0x0051e1ef.summary: Generates combinatorial permutations of indices for multi-channel encoding. Computes minimum factoradial value meeting target count, fills permutation array, and advances to next combination. Uses lookup table for index remapping in mode 2.

0x0051e2ba.name: ImageBufferStrideFill
0x0051e2ba.label: ImageBufferStrideFill
0x0051e2ba.summary: Fills image buffer with stride-based per-channel gradient values. Calls CombinatorialPermutationGenerator to determine layout, allocates output buffer, fills each channel with division-interpolated byte values across the stride.

0x0051e3e7.name: sub_51E3E7
0x0051e3e7.label: PerChannelTableGenerator
0x0051e3e7.summary: Generates per-channel lookup tables mapping index to stepped value. Two modes: normal (offset 0) and extended (offset 510) with mirrored symmetry. Allocates output table, fills 256 entries per channel, optionally duplicates across zero boundary.

0x0051e512.name: PerIndexTableGenerationWithDivision
0x0051e512.label: PerEntryDivisionTableBuild
0x0051e512.summary: Builds per-entry division lookup tables for gradient computation. For each unique entry descriptor, allocates 1024-byte table and fills with division results (65025 - 510*value) / scaled_param using global double and integer source tables.

0x0051e5d7.name: TableWeightedMix
0x0051e5d7.label: MultiTableWeightedSumMix
0x0051e5d7.summary: Mixes pixel data by summing byte values from multiple lookup tables across channels. For each pixel, adds channel contributions from table-per-index to produce output byte.

0x0051e65f.name: ChecksumComputeType03Stream
0x0051e65f.label: ThreeChannelLookupSumBlend
0x0051e65f.summary: Blends 3-channel pixel data by summing values from three lookup tables. For each source pixel (R, G, B), looks up table values and accumulates them into a single output byte per pixel.

0x0051e6ec.name: ChecksumComputeType1
0x0051e6ec.label: ConvolutionChecksumCompute
0x0051e6ec.summary: Computes convolution-based pixel checksum across channels. For each pixel, clears output, accumulates values from lookup tables using rolling 4-bit phase counter, writes summed result, advances phase for next pixel.

0x0051e7d7.name: AudioSynthesis3ChannelSampleGenerator
0x0051e7d7.label: ThreeChannelTableSampleGenerator
0x0051e7d7.summary: Generates 3-channel output samples by summing component values from phase-selected lookup tables. For each pixel, reads 3 source bytes, adds table-based offsets from three phase-indexed tables, writes accumulated output byte, advances rolling 4-bit phase counter.

0x0051e8d6.name: PixelDataConvolutionViaLookupTable
0x0051e8d6.label: PixelConvolutionErrorDiffusion
0x0051e8d6.summary: Convolves pixel data through lookup tables with serpentine-scan error diffusion. Alternates left-to-right/right-to-left per row, accumulates convolution results from indexed table lookups, computes and distributes quantization error through feedback loop.

0x0051ea5a.name: VirtualArrayFill
0x0051ea5a.label: Virtual array fill via vtable call
0x0051ea5a.summary: Fills buffer at this+0x1A4 by looping from 0 to this+0x64 and calling vtable method[1] (offset 4) with parameter 2*(this+0x5C)+4. Each call result stored at advancing position in buffer.

0x0051ea90.name: CodecModeSelect
0x0051ea90.label: Mode-based codec/processor selector
0x0051ea90.summary: Selects processing function pointer (assigned to sub-buffer+4) based on mode field at this+0x4C (values 0/1/2+) and channel count at this+0x64 (==3). Conditionally initializes sub-buffers via VirtualArrayFill, MemoryZeroFill, PerIndexTableGenerationWithDivision, and sub_51E3E7.

0x0051eb5a.name: VirtualCallWithIntegerSet
0x0051eb5a.label: WriteFieldAndCallVirtual
0x0051eb5a.summary: Writes integer constant 45 to field at offset 0x14 of the sub-object pointed to by `this->field_0`, then calls the first virtual function on `this`. Belongs to object initialization/callback dispatch system.

0x0051eb6e.name: ObjectSetupWithBoundsCheck
0x0051eb6e.label: AllocateAndInitObjectWithBoundsCheck
0x0051eb6e.summary: Allocates a sub-object via factory function at this+0x4, initializes its fields with codec/function pointers, then conditionally clamps dimensions (width/height) based on thresholds at this+0x64 (>4) and this+0x54 (>256) by writing to the sub-object and dispatching a virtual call. Part of codec/decoder initialization.

0x0051edae.name: NormalizedVectorWithThreshold
0x0051edae.label: Vec3NormalizeWithThreshold
0x0051edae.summary: Normalizes a 3-component float vector with squared-length threshold. If squared length >= global constant at dword_8D6000, computes unit vector using Newton-Raphson refined reciprocal sqrt; otherwise zeroes output. Part of 3D math library.

0x0051ee7e.name: VectorNormalizeWithThreshold
0x0051ee7e.label: Vec4NormalizeWithThreshold
0x0051ee7e.summary: Normalizes a 4-component float vector with squared-length threshold. If squared length >= global constant at dword_8D600C, computes unit vector using Newton-Raphson refined reciprocal sqrt, including W component; otherwise zeroes all four components. Part of 3D math library.

0x0051f0be.name: SSE3DCrossProductWith33Matrix
0x0051f0be.label: SSE3DCrossProductWith33Matrix
0x0051f0be.summary: Computes 3D cross product of three input vectors (a2, a3, a4) using SSE intrinsics. Loads pairs of floats from each input, applies shuffle/ multiply/ subtract/ add operations with sign-flip via XOR mask at xmmword_5D8A20, and stores result in output __m128 at a1. Part of SSE-accelerated 3D math library.

0x0051f160.name: F_4ComponentVectorNormalize
0x0051f160.label: Vec4NormalizeNewtonRaphson
0x0051f160.summary: Unconditionally normalizes a 4-component float vector using Newton-Raphson refined reciprocal square root. Computes squared length of input (a2), applies inverse sqrt with refinement using global constants dword_5D8A40 and dword_5D8A30, scales all 4 components, and stores result in output (a1). Part of SSE math library.

0x0051f200.name: SSEHermiteCubicInterp
0x0051f200.label: SSEHermiteCubicInterpolation
0x0051f200.summary: Performs Hermite cubic interpolation between 4 input float pairs (a4-a7) using SSE intrinsics. Evaluates cubic basis functions via precomputed spline coefficients (xmmword_5D8A50/60/70/80) at parameter t (a8), blends inputs, and stores interleaved result at output pointer a3. Part of SSE-accelerated spline interpolation library.

0x0051f400.name: CubicSpline
0x0051f400.label: SSECubicSplineInterpolation
0x0051f400.summary: Performs cubic B-spline interpolation between 4 input float pairs (a4-a7) using SSE intrinsics. Evaluates cubic polynomial basis at parameter t (a8) with precomputed spline coefficients (xmmword_5D8A90/AA0/AB0/AC0), blends inputs, and stores interleaved result at output pointer a3. Part of SSE-accelerated spline library.

0x0051f7ce.name: Det3x3From4x4
0x0051f7ce.label: SSE3x3DeterminantFrom4x4Matrix
0x0051f7ce.summary: Computes the determinant of the upper-left 3x3 submatrix extracted from a 4x4 matrix (4 rows of __m128 at 16-byte stride). Uses SSE shuffle/multiply/subtract/add with alignment-aware load path (unaligned via _mm_loadh_ps if address not 16-byte aligned). Returns determinant as double. Part of SSE math library.

0x0051f89e.name: PlaneFromThreePoints
0x0051f89e.label: SSEPlaneFromThreePoints
0x0051f89e.summary: Constructs a plane equation from three 3D points (a2, a3, a4) using SSE intrinsics.
