Computes two edge vectors, their cross product (plane normal), normalizes with Newton-Raphson refinement, and calculates plane distance D from dot product with point A. Stores plane as (Nx, Ny, Nz, D) in output __m128. Part of SSE math library.

0x0051f98e.name: F_4x4ReflectionOrientationMatrixMultiply
0x0051f98e.label: SSEReflectionOrientationMatrixMultiply
0x0051f98e.summary: Multiplies a 4x4 reflection/orientation matrix (a2) with a rotation-like matrix derived from normalized input vector/quaternion (a3), storing 4-row result at output (a1). Normalizes a3 using Newton-Raphson refinement with lazy one-time constant initialization via byte_8D46B0 flags. Alignment-aware store path (unaligned stores if output address not 16-byte aligned). Part of SSE 3D math library.

0x0051fb1e.name: QuaternionToRotationMatrix_fb1e
0x0051fb1e.label: QuaternionToRotationMatrixNR
0x0051fb1e.summary: Converts a quaternion (a2) to a 4x4 rotation matrix (a1) using SSE intrinsics. Loads quaternion, applies bitmask, normalizes via Newton-Raphson refined inverse sqrt, then computes 4 rotation matrix rows from quaternion component products using precomputed constants. Part of SSE math library.

0x0051fc80.name: VectorNormalizeWithNewtonRaphsonRefinement
0x0051fc80.label: Vec4NormalizeNewtonRaphsonRefined
0x0051fc80.summary: Unconditionally normalizes a 4-component float vector using Newton-Raphson refinement of reciprocal square root. Computes squared length of input (a2), applies inverse sqrt with refinement using globals dword_5D8BE0 and dword_5D8BF0, scales all 4 components, and stores result in output (a1). Part of SSE math library.

0x0051fd2e.name: Vec3NormalizeNewtonRaphson
0x0051fd2e.label: Vec3ScaleByReciprocalSqLenNR
0x0051fd2e.summary: Computes squared length of a 3-component vector loaded from a2, calculates refined reciprocal via Newton-Raphson (1/x), scales vector components by this reciprocal, applies Z sign-flip mask (xmmword_5D8C00), and stores result in output (a1). Part of SSE math library; may be used for cross-product or special vector orientation rather than standard normalization.

0x0051fd90.name: RotationMatrixToAxisAngleConversion
0x0051fd90.label: MatrixToAxisAngle
0x0051fd90.summary: Converts a 3x3 rotation matrix (a2) to axis-angle representation (a1). Computes matrix trace; if trace exceeds threshold (flt_8D611C), uses trace-based formula for axis (Rzy-Ryz, Rxz-Rzx, Ryx-Rxy) and angle = sqrt(trace + 1) * scale. Otherwise selects largest diagonal element and computes axis/angle from corresponding off-diagonals. Part of 3D math / SVD library.

0x0051febe.name: QuaternionConstructionTransform
0x0051febe.label: ColorVectorTransform
0x0051febe.summary: Takes four unsigned int color/vector components (a2-a4), packs them with constant dword_8D6160 into an SSE register, applies color channel mask (xmmword_8D6150), calls RGBAColorSpaceConversion, then performs shuffle/multiply/XOR with sign mask (xmmword_8D6140) to produce final result. Likely a color or vector space transform reusing SSE math pipeline.

0x0052035e.name: VectorNormalizeThreshold
0x0052035e.label: Vec3NormalizeThresholdB
0x0052035e.summary: Normalizes a 3-component float vector with squared-length threshold. If squared length >= dword_8D6180, applies Newton-Raphson refined inverse sqrt and scales components; otherwise zeroes output. Uses distinct global constants (dword_8D6180/84/88). Part of SSE math library.

0x0052042e.name: VelocityFrictionClampWithStictionThreshold
0x0052042e.label: Vec4NormalizeThresholdC
0x0052042e.summary: Normalizes a 4-component float vector with squared-length threshold. If squared length >= dword_8D618C, applies Newton-Raphson refined inverse sqrt and scales all 4 components; otherwise zeroes output. Uses distinct global constants (dword_8D618C/90/94). Part of SSE math library.

0x005207ce.name: SSEVectorCross
0x005207ce.label: SSEVectorCrossProduct
0x005207ce.summary: Computes 3D cross product of three vectors (a2, a3, a4) using SSE intrinsics. Algorithm is identical to SSE3DCrossProductWith33Matrix (load/shuffle/multiply/subtract/add) but uses a distinct XOR mask (xmmword_5D8C20) for sign flip. Stores result in output __m128 at a1. Part of SSE math library.

0x0052087e.name: SSEVectorMatrixInit
0x0052087e.label: SSEMatrixInitFromVector
0x0052087e.summary: Initializes a matrix/struct at output (a1) using SSE constants (xmmword_8D61B0/C0/D0) and result from EmptyStub_8bd0 called with input (a2). Writes pre-defined constants and computed shuffle/XOR results to various offsets, constructing a matrix or transform structure. Part of SSE math library.

0x005208fe.name: SSEMatrixConstructionFrom44Data
0x005208fe.label: SSEMatrix44FromData
0x005208fe.summary: Constructs a 4x4 matrix (4 rows at 0, 0x10, 0x20, 0x30) at output (a1) from input (a2) via EmptyStub_8bd0. Applies AND/shuffle operations with SSE constants (xmmword_8D61E0/F0/200/210) to compute row data, XOR for sign adjustment, and stores pre-defined constants for remaining rows. Part of SSE math library.

0x0052098e.name: PlaneFromEdgesNormalizeSSE
0x0052098e.label: SSEPlaneFromThreePointsB
0x0052098e.summary: Constructs a plane equation from three 3D points (a2, a3, a4) using SSE intrinsics. Algorithm is identical to PlaneFromThreePoints_0051f89e but uses distinct global constants (xmmword_5D8C30/40/50). Computes edge vectors, cross product (normal), Newton-Raphson normal refinement, and plane distance D. Stores result as (Nx, Ny, Nz, D) in output __m128. Part of SSE math library.

0x00520a7e.name: QuaternionToRotationMatrix_0a7e
0x00520a7e.label: QuaternionToRotationMatrixWithLazyNR
0x00520a7e.summary: Normalizes quaternion (a3) using Newton-Raphson refinement with lazy one-time constant initialization (via byte_8D46B0), then multiplies with matrix (a2) to produce 4-row rotation matrix output (a1). Uses distinct global constants (xmmword_5D8C60-CA0, dword_8D6220/24) from the related function at 0051f98e. Alignment-aware store path. Part of SSE math library.

0x00520c0e.name: SSEReciprocalSquareRootWithNewtonRaphsonQuaterni
0x00520c0e.label: QuaternionToRotationMatrixAlt
0x00520c0e.summary: Converts a quaternion (a2) to a 4x4 rotation matrix (a1) using SSE intrinsics. Loads quaternion, applies bitmask (xmmword_5D8D20), normalizes via Newton-Raphson refined inverse sqrt using constants dword_5D8D00/D10, then computes 4 rotation matrix rows from quaternion component products with distinct constants (xmmword_5D8CB0-5D8CF0). Similar algorithm to QuaternionToRotationMatrix_fb1e but with different constants. Part of SSE math library.

0x00520ce0.name: TriangleClosestPointOrNormal
0x00520ce0.label: MatrixToAxisAngleAlt
0x00520ce0.summary: Converts a 3x3 matrix (a2) to axis-angle representation (a1), algorithm identical to RotationMatrixToAxisAngleConversion_0051fd90 but with distinct global constants (flt_8D627C-8D6298, dword_8D6270). Computes matrix trace; if trace > flt_8D627C, uses trace-based formula for axis and angle; otherwise selects largest diagonal element via dword_8D6270 index LUT. Part of 3D math / SVD library.

0x00520e0e.name: SSEQuaternionCompositionFromAxisAngleComponents
0x00520e0e.label: Construct quaternion from axis-angle components via SSE
0x00520e0e.summary: Packs three axis-angle float components (a2=angle, a3/a4=axis direction) with a constant vector, multiplies by another constant, calls sub_528CC0 (quaternion composition helper), then finalizes with additional SSE shuffles/multiply/add/xor to produce a normalized quaternion in a1.

0x00520ed0.name: sub_520ED0
0x00520ed0.label: 3DNow! quaternion multiply
0x00520ed0.summary: Multiplies two quaternions (a2, a3) using 3DNow! SIMD intrinsics (pfmul, pfadd, pfsub, pfacc) with sign-bit XOR (0x80000000) for cross-term negation, writes the 4-component result to a1.

0x00520f69.name: sub_520F69
0x00520f69.label: 3DNow! vector normalization with zero-length guard
0x00520f69.summary: Computes squared length of 3DNow! packed vector a2, compares against tiny threshold (0x80000000800000LL), and if above threshold normalizes via pfrsqrt + Newton-Raphson refinement (pfrsqit1/pfrcpit2) writing result to a1; near-zero vectors produce all-zero output (pand mask).

0x00520fc6.name: sub_520FC6
0x00520fc6.label: 3DNow! conditional vector normalization with fallback
0x00520fc6.summary: Computes squared-length of 3DNow! packed vector a1, compares against small threshold (0x80000000800000LL). If below threshold: writes fallback values (1.0, -1.0, 0, 0) to output buffer a2 and 0 to a3. If above threshold: normalizes a1 into a2 via pfrsqrt + Newton-Raphson refinement, and writes scaled component to a3.

0x00521079.name: F_3DNowBarycentricInterpolationWithNormalization
0x00521079.label: 3DNow! barycentric triangle interpolation with per-region normalization
0x00521079.summary: Computes barycentric coordinates from three edge vectors constructed from a2 vertex data, determines which of four triangle regions the point falls in via packed comparison masks, then for each region normalizes the interpolated result (pfrsqrt + Newton-Raphson + 0.5 scale) and blends vertex attributes (a2[1], a2[3], a2[4]) with sign-flip XOR (0x8000000000000000) into output a1.

0x005214aa.name: QuaternionMul3DNow
0x005214aa.label: 3DNow! quaternion multiply with 0.5 scaling
0x005214aa.summary: Multiplies two quaternions (a2, a3 as __m64 pairs) using 3DNow! intrinsics: pre-scales both by 0.5 (0x3F0000003F000000LL), calls PackedFloatingPointMath three times for component setup, then computes quaternion product via pfadd/pfmul with sign-flip XOR (0x8000000000000000). Writes result to a1.

0x0052156f.name: Media3DNowMathOperation
0x0052156f.label: 3DNow! parameterized media rotation/transform from lookup
0x0052156f.summary: Looks up a 12-byte entry (v7 + v8) from sub_5262C2 using index a2, scales input float a3 by 0.5 via 3DNow!, calls PackedFloatingPointMath for component expansion, then multiplies lookup entries with scaled components to produce output quaternion/vector in a1.

0x005215db.name: SIMDVectorNormalization
0x005215db.label: 3DNow! vector slerp/interpolation with angle-dependent normalization
0x005215db.summary: Computes dot product of input vectors a2 and a3, extracts sign and magnitude. If |dot| is below ~0.9999 threshold (0x3F7FFF58), computes sin via pfrsqrt(1-dot²) with Newton-Raphson refinement (F_3DVectorNormalize_8f00/sub_529700 helpers) and derives angle-based interpolation factors; otherwise uses simple (1-t, t) blend. Final result = (1-t_factor)*a2 + t_factor*a3 written to a1.

0x00521831.name: F_3DVectorNegateAndNormalize
0x00521831.label: 3DNow! negate and divide by squared-length with zero guard
0x00521831.summary: Computes squared length of 3DNow! vector a2 via pfadd/pfmul, inverts it with pfrcp + Newton-Raphson refinement (pfrcpit1/pfrcpit2), negates input components with XOR 0x80000000 sign flip, masks with threshold comparison, and writes (-a2) * (1/length²) to a1.

0x00521895.name: F_3DAudioListenerTransform
0x00521895.label: 3DNow! 3D audio listener orientation normalization
0x00521895.summary: Processes 4-component listener orientation vector a2: checks if the 4th component (high dword of a2[1]) is >= 1.0 → copies directly to output. If < 1.0, computes SquareRootApproximation, checks if |4th component| >= small threshold (0x34000000), and if so scales all vector components by refined reciprocal of 4th component via pfrcp + Newton-Raphson. Writes normalized orientation to a1.

0x005219e1.name: Quaternion3DMath
0x005219e1.label: 3DNow! multi-quaternion composition with sign optimization and normalization
0x005219e1.summary: Processes up to 4 input quaternions (a5, a6, a7, a8): compares sum-vs-difference squared lengths to determine optimal sign flips (shortest path), negates selected inputs via XOR 0x80000000, computes negate-and-divide-by-squared-length of a6, performs quaternion multiplications with cross-term accumulation (pfadd/pfsub/pfmul/pfacc), normalizes intermediate results via >=1.0 guard with SquareRootApproximation and pfrcp refinement, and writes three output quaternions (a2, a3, a4).

0x0052243a.name: F_4x4MatrixMultiply_243a
0x0052243a.label: 3DNow! 4x4 matrix multiply
0x0052243a.summary: Multiplies two 4x4 matrices (a2 * a3) using 3DNow! intrinsics: transposes a3 into column-major halves via punpckldq/punpckhdq, then multiplies each of a2's 8 row-halves by the 4 column-halves of a3 with pfacc/pfmul/pfadd accumulation, writing the result 4x4 matrix to a1.

0x0052266c.name: F_4ElementDeterminant
0x0052266c.label: 3DNow! 4-element matrix determinant (cofactor expansion)
0x0052266c.summary: Computes a determinant from a packed matrix/struct a1 via 3DNow! cofactor expansion: computes three 2x2 sub-determinants (v3, v4, v5) using pfsub/pfmul of shuffled elements, then accumulates them weighted by matrix row elements into v6. Returns pfacc(v6, v6) as a single float (cast to double).

0x0052273b.name: F_3DNowMatrixConstructor
0x0052273b.label: 3DNow! construct 4x4 transformation matrix from 3 components
0x0052273b.summary: Initializes a 4x4 matrix (8 __m64 values) in a1 with identity-like rotation (1.0/0 constants at specific cells) and packs three float parameters (a2, a3, a4) plus 1.0 into the last row via punpckldq to form the translation part of a transformation matrix.

0x0052278b.name: F_3DNowQuaternionFromAngle
0x0052278b.label: 3DNow! construct 4x4 rotation matrix from quaternion + normalized axis
0x0052278b.summary: Normalizes input a3 via F_3DVectorNormalize_7578 into stacked v14/v15 (16 bytes), then combines with quaternion/vector a2 via dot-product-like operations (pfmul/pfadd) and negated copies (XOR 0x80000000) to fill all 8 __m64 slots of output a1, forming a 4x4 rotation matrix.

0x00522876.name: QuaternionTo4x4RotationMatrix
0x00522876.label: 3DNow! convert quaternion to 4x4 rotation matrix
0x00522876.summary: Normalizes quaternion from a2 via F_3DVectorNormalize_7578 into v11/v12, then constructs a 4x4 rotation matrix in a1 using the standard quaternion-to-matrix formula: computes terms -2*q² and -2*qu with pfmul(0xC0000000 = -2.0f), shuffles components via punpckldq/punpckhdq, and fills all 8 __m64 slots with pfadd/pfmul combinations including identity elements (1065353216 = 1.0f).

0x00522952.name: F_3DNowTransformationMatrixConstruction
0x00522952.label: 3DNow! construct 4x4 transformation matrix from angle parameter
0x00522952.summary: Loads single float parameter a2 into mm0, expands via PackedFloatingPointMath to populate both dword halves, then builds a 4x4 transformation matrix in a1 with identity-like rotation elements, the parameter and its negated copy (XOR 0x80000000) placed at specific matrix cells, forming an axis-specific rotation or shear transformation.

0x005229b5.name: SymmetricTransformMatrix3DNow
0x005229b5.label: 3DNow! construct symmetric 4x4 transformation matrix from parameter
0x005229b5.summary: Loads packed float parameter a2, masks low dword with pand(0xFFFFFFFF), shifts high dword via psrlqi(32), calls PackedFloatingPointMath for setup, then builds a 4x4 matrix in a1 with symmetric entries: parameter value at diagonal positions (a1[0]=a1[5]), negated high dword at a1[1], identity elements (0x3F800000=1.0f) at a1[2]/a1[7], and high dword at a1[4].

0x00522a13.name: F_3DNowQuaternionFromEncodedAxisAngle
0x00522a13.label: 3DNow! decode axis-angle parameter to 4x4 transformation matrix
0x00522a13.summary: Loads encoded axis-angle value a2 into mm0, expands via PackedFloatingPointMath, then builds a 4x4 matrix in a1: the encoded value goes to a1[0], a negated reshuffled copy (via punpckhdq/punpckldq with XOR 0x80000000) to a1[2], identity 1.0f elements at a1[5] and a1[7], and zeros elsewhere.

0x00522a6c.name: F_4x4TransformMatrixFrom3Ints
0x00522a6c.label: 3DNow! construct diagonal 4x4 scale matrix from 3 integer-reinterpreted floats
0x00522a6c.summary: Constructs a 4x4 diagonal scale matrix in a1 from three parameters (a2, a3, a4): a2 placed as low dword of a1[0], a3 shifted left 32 bits to high dword of a1[2], a4 as low dword of a1[5], with identity homogeneous row (0, 0, 0, 1.0) at a1[7] and zeros elsewhere. Forms 3-axis scaling matrix with 1.0 at bottom-right.

0x00522b22.name: sub_522B22
0x00522b22.label: 3DNow! construct 4x4 identity matrix
0x00522b22.summary: Builds a 4x4 identity matrix in a1 using 3DNow! intrinsics: loads 1.0f (0x3F800000), sets diagonal cells (a1[0], a1[2], a1[5], a1[7]) to 1.0 via direct store and punpckldq reshuffle, zeroes off-diagonal entries (a1[1], a1[3], a1[4], a1[6]).

0x00522b5b.name: F_3x3MatrixInverse3DNow
0x00522b5b.label: 3DNow! 3x3 matrix inverse (rotation submatrix) embedded in 4x4
0x00522b5b.summary: Computes 3x3 inverse of rotation submatrix from input a2 using the adjugate/transpose method: doubles source elements (pfadd), unpacks for cross-term computation, computes cofactor-like products (pfmul) with 1.0 - trace/determinant (pfsubr 0x3F8000003F800000LL), reshuffles via punpck into the 3x3 output positions of a1. Sets a1[6] = 0 and a1[7] = {0, 1.0f} for homogeneous last row.

0x00522ce2.name: F_3DNowMatrixVectorMath
0x00522ce2.label: 3DNow! composite transformation matrix from rotation, translation, and scale components
0x00522ce2.summary: Composes a 4x4 transformation matrix from up to 6 optional input parameters: computes 3x3 inverse of rotation a3 (same algorithm as sub_522B5B), constructs identity + translation from a2, applies a4 parameter data, then optionally post-multiplies by a6 rotation and adds translation a7. Handles all null-pointer cases with identity matrix fallback. Accumulates results iteratively over all non-null inputs.

0x00523e7a.name: F_3DNowPackedFloatMatrixQuaternionOps
0x00523e7a.label: 3DNow! multiply quaternions and convert to 4x4 rotation matrix
0x00523e7a.summary: Scales input quaternions a2 and a3 by 0.5 (0x3F0000003F000000LL), multiplies them via 3DNow! quaternion multiplication with component shuffling and sign flips, then converts the result to a 4x4 rotation matrix using the cofactor/adjugate pattern (same as sub_522B5B): 2x multiplications, cross-term products, 1.0 - trace subtraction (pfsubr 0x3F8000003F800000LL), and homogeneous row {0, 0, 0, 1.0}.

0x0052401f.name: F_4x4TransformationMatrixConstructor
0x0052401f.label: 3DNow! construct 4x4 transform from scale, rotation, and translation
0x0052401f.summary: Builds composite 4x4 transformation matrix: starts with diagonal scale matrix from parameter a2 (repeated at a1[0], a1[2] high, a1[5]), then if a4 (rotation) is non-null, computes 3x3 adjugate/inverse rotation matrix (same pattern as sub_522B5B) and optionally applies a3 translation by subtraction + matrix multiply. Finally applies a5 additive translation if non-null.

0x00524553.name: SIMDQuaternionRotationArithmetic
0x00524553.label: QuaternionRotationMatrixSIMD
0x00524553.summary: Build 4x4 rotation matrix from quaternion and angle scalar using 3DNow! SIMD intrinsics (pfmul, pfadd, pfsub, punpck). Core 3D math routine for transform system.

0x00526392.name: CubicInterp3DNow
0x00526392.label: CubicHermiteInterp3DNow
0x00526392.summary: Compute cubic Hermite spline interpolation between 4 control points using 3DNow! SIMD. Evaluates standard Hermite basis functions (h00, h10, h01, h11) from factor t, blends packed float values from 4 input vectors, stores result as two __m64 components.

0x00526466.name: QuadrilinearInterp3DNow
0x00526466.label: QuarticInterp3DNow
0x00526466.summary: Compute quadrilinear (quartic) interpolation between 4 control points using 3DNow! SIMD. Evaluates higher-order weight coefficients from factor t, blends packed float values from 4 input vectors, scales result by 0.5.

0x005267a7.name: QuaternionTransformComposition
0x005267a7.label: QuaternionTransformCompose
0x005267a7.summary: Compose up to 3 quaternion/transform inputs based on which are non-null (a6/a7/a8), apply resulting transform to vector via F_4DVectorTransform, optionally blend output with a5 weighting. Core 3D transform composition routine.

0x0052692f.name: MatrixInterpolationBlend
0x0052692f.label: MatrixInterpolationBlendSkeletal
0x0052692f.summary: Compose up to 3 transform inputs (a6/a7/a8) based on null-state switch, normalize composed result via sub_525E9A, interpolate between input vector a4 and blend weight a5, then apply transform. Used for skeletal animation blending.

0x00526b55.name: F_3DNowVectorTransform
0x00526b55.label: F_3DNowVectorTransformAndInvert
0x00526b55.summary: Compose up to 3 transform inputs (a6/a7/a8), invert composed result via F_4x4MatrixInversion, optionally blend input vector with weight a5, then apply inverse transform. Differs from MatrixInterpolationBlend by inverting the composed matrix.

0x00526d9a.name: sub_526D9A
0x00526d9a.label: CubicHermiteInterpPacked
0x00526d9a.summary: Cubic Hermite spline interpolation of packed float pairs using 3DNow! SIMD. Computes standard Hermite basis functions (h00, h10, h01, h11) from factor t, blends 4 control point pairs (a2-a5), writes single __m64 result.

0x00526e7b.name: sub_526E7B
0x00526e7b.label: F_3DNowVector2Normalize
0x00526e7b.summary: Normalize 2-component vector (packed float pair) using 3DNow! reciprocal sqrt with Newton-Raphson refinement. Guards against division by zero by comparing squared length to threshold.

0x00526ebe.name: sub_526EBE
0x00526ebe.label: QuarticInterpPacked
0x00526ebe.summary: Quartic/quadrilinear interpolation of packed float pairs using 3DNow! SIMD. Computes higher-order weight coefficients from factor t, blends 4 control points (a2-a5), scales result by 0.5.

0x0052704a.name: QuaternionProduct3DNow
0x0052704a.label: QuaternionProduct3DNow
0x0052704a.summary: Compute quaternion product using 3DNow! SIMD packed float arithmetic. Combines two input quaternions with cross-product-like terms via pfsub, pfmul, pfacc operations with sign-flip constants.

0x00527393.name: sub_527393
0x00527393.label: QuaternionPartialProduct
0x00527393.summary: Compute partial quaternion product using 3DNow! SIMD. Copies input quaternion a3 component pairs to output, computes negated 3D dot product of vector parts of a2 and a3, stores as high component of output second pair.

0x005273d6.name: sub_5273D6
0x005273d6.label: NormalizedCrossDirection
0x005273d6.summary: Compute normalized perpendicular/cross direction from three input vectors using 3DNow! SIMD. Computes difference vectors and cross-product-like perpendicular, normalizes via rsqrt with Newton refinement and zero-guard.

0x005274ba.name: sub_5274BA
0x005274ba.label: WeightedVectorLerp3DNow
0x005274ba.summary: Weighted linear interpolation (lerp) between two vectors using 3DNow! SIMD. Computes interpolation weight from dot product differences of weight vector a2 with endpoints a3 and a4, guards against zero divisor.

0x00527578.name: F_3DVectorNormalize_7578
0x00527578.label: F_3DVectorNormalize4
0x00527578.summary: Normalize 4-component vector (x,y,z,w) using 3DNow! SIMD. Computes squared length via pfmul+pfacc, reciprocal sqrt with Newton-Raphson refinement, zero-guard against near-zero length.

0x0052765a.name: sub_52765A
0x0052765a.label: ResourceStateResetCallback
0x0052765a.summary: Reset animation/resource state struct and invoke type-specific callbacks based on field a1[0] value (4,5,6). Clears state, copies tracking values, calls optional final callback and stores result.

0x005276c5.name: sub_5276C5
0x005276c5.label: ResourceBufferAllocInit
0x005276c5.summary: Allocate and initialize resource buffer struct via callback-based allocator. Allocates primary struct (size 64), secondary fixed buffer (size 1440), and variable-size buffer (size a3). Initializes fields, calls sub_52765A reset, with cleanup on allocation failure.

0x00527752.name: sub_527752
0x00527752.label: InflateDecompress
0x00527752.summary: DEFLATE/inflate decompression state machine that processes compressed blocks (stored, fixed Huffman, dynamic Huffman) and writes decompressed output. Part of the data compression/decompression subsystem (zlib-compatible).

0x00527eed.name: sub_527EED
0x00527eed.label: ResourceBufferFreeCleanup
0x00527eed.summary: Free resource buffer struct and its sub-allocations via callback-based deallocator. Calls sub_52765A reset, then frees variable buffer, secondary buffer, and struct itself in order.

0x0052855a.name: RenderingBranchOnDAT005d79dc
0x0052855a.label: AudioRenderingBranchOnMode
0x0052855a.summary: Branch between MPEG audio codec transforms based on global rendering mode flag. Routes same parameters to either AudioCodecMDCTFFTTransform or MPEGAudioLayer3IMDCT depending on byte_5D79DC.

0x005285f2.name: AudioMixing
0x005285f2.label: AudioIMDCTSynthesisFilter
0x005285f2.summary: MDCT/IMDCT synthesis filter bank for MPEG audio decoding. Performs 8-sample inverse transform with standard trigonometric rotation constants (√2, cos(π/8), cos(3π/8)). Handles zero-sample short-circuit path. Writes 8 output bytes via CRTFtol float-to-int conversion.

0x005289e0.name: RGBAColorSpaceConversion
0x005289e0.label: RGBAColorSpaceDecodeSSE
0x005289e0.summary: Decode RGBA color from compressed/encoded format using SSE SIMD. Performs channel bit masking, dequantization via coefficients, polynomial approximation, and conditional blend between two decode paths based on zero-comparison.

0x00528bd0.name: EmptyStub_8bd0
0x00528bd0.label: SSEPolynomialApproximation
0x00528bd0.summary: SSE SIMD polynomial approximation with coefficient table chain. Despite "EmptyStub" name, performs substantial computation: multiply-add polynomial evaluation across 13 XMM constants, integer shift/compare, conditional blend between two shuffle paths.

0x00528cc0.name: sub_528CC0
0x00528cc0.label: ColorSpaceDecodeSSE2
0x00528cc0.summary: Decode packed color data to two output vectors using SSE SIMD polynomial approximation. Performs input masking, linear transform, residual computation, integer bit extraction, conditional blend between two decode branches.

0x00528f00.name: F_3DVectorNormalize_8f00
0x00528f00.label: EmptyStub
0x00528f00.summary: Empty function — no-op stub with no instructions. Body consists only of a semicolon.

0x00529000.name: SquareRootApproximation
0x00529000.label: EmptyStub
0x00529000.summary: Empty function — no-op stub with no instructions. Body consists only of a semicolon.

0x00529200.name: EmptyStub_9200
0x00529200.label: EmptyStub
0x00529200.summary: Empty function — no-op stub with no instructions. Body consists only of a semicolon.

0x005295e0.name: PackedFloatingPointMath
0x005295e0.label: MMX PackedFloatAbsoluteValue
0x005295e0.summary: Computes absolute value of lower 32-bit float in MMX register by clearing sign bit (0x80000000). Used by 3DNow! math routines for packed float abs.

0x00529b2c.name: sub_529B2C
0x00529b2c.label: InflateDecompressionStateMachine
0x00529b2c.summary: Core inflate/deflate decompression loop implementing literal/length and distance code decoding via state machine (cases 0-9). Part of zlib-style stream decompressor.

0x0052a4a5.name: sub_52A4A5
0x0052a4a5.label: InflateHuffmanTreeBuild
0x0052a4a5.summary: Builds Huffman decoding trees for literal/length codes and distance codes during inflate decompression setup. Calls HuffmanCodingFrequencyTable twice and sets error strings on failure.

0x0052a5a8.name: ArithmeticComparison_a5a8
0x0052a5a8.label: GetAudioCodecBasePointers
0x0052a5a8.summary: Returns four global base pointers (audio decode table, texture heap base, texture atlas, buffer) via output parameters. Used during audio codec initialization to expose internal data addresses to caller.

0x0052a5d7.name: sub_52A5D7
0x0052a5d7.label: InflateCopyWindowToOutput
0x0052a5d7.summary: Copies decompressed data from circular output window to destination buffer, handling circular wrap-around when write pointer reaches window end. Fires optional callout callback before each copy segment.

0x0052a6ec.name: MPEGAudioLayer3IMDCT
0x0052a6ec.label: MPEGLayer3IMDCT
0x0052a6ec.summary: Inverse Modified Discrete Cosine Transform (IMDCT) for MPEG Audio Layer 3 decoding. Converts frequency-domain subband samples to time-domain audio via butterfly rotation and windowed overlap-add with coefficient table lookup.

0x0052ab4e.name: AudioCodecMDCTFFTTransform
0x0052ab4e.label: Audio Codec MDCT/FFT Butterfly Transform (MMX)
0x0052ab4e.summary: Performs an 8-point radix-2 MDCT/FFT butterfly transform on packed 16-bit audio data using MMX SIMD instructions. Two-pass: first computes 16 frequency-domain outputs via fixed-point multiply-accumulate with precomputed twiddle constants, then post-processes and quantizes to 8-bit PCM via lookup table. Part of the audio codec pipeline.

0x0052b561.name: QuaternionMultiplySurfaceSample
0x0052b561.label: MMXQuaternionTransformTextureSample
0x0052b561.summary: Performs MMX/3DNow! packed 16-bit quaternion rotation and vector transform on 16 lanes of data, then samples a 1024-entry surface lookup table (texture/CLUT) using transformed coordinates. Part of 3D rendering texture-mapping pipeline.

0x0052d8d0.name: ThreadedObjectCreatorWithSEH
0x0052d8d0.label: RenderObjectCreatorWithCleanup
0x0052d8d0.summary: Allocates and constructs a RenderObject (11584 bytes) via operator new, calls constructor, then initializes via vtable dispatch (offset +4). On failure frees object via VirtualCleanup. Skips if pointer already non-null.

0x0052d990.name: VirtualCleanup
0x0052d990.label: VirtualObjectDestructorAndNull
0x0052d990.summary: Calls virtual destructor/deleter on an object through its vtable (first entry, called with arg 1 for operator delete), then zeroes the stored pointer. Guarded against null pointer.

0x0052d9b0.name: CConstructor
0x0052d9b0.label: GameObjectConstructorWithDeferredCheck
0x0052d9b0.summary: Sets vtable pointer (off_5B47E8) on object and conditionally calls DeferredDeactivation based on flag byte at offset 0x24EC. Part of GameObject construction.

0x0052d9f0.name: ObjectVTableInitialization
0x0052d9f0.label: GameObjectVTableAndFieldInit
0x0052d9f0.summary: Initializes GameObject by setting vtable pointer to off_5B47E8 and zeroing fields at offsets 0x24EC (flag byte) and 0x24F0 (default header word). Called during RenderObject construction.

0x0052da30.name: CMpegBase_ProcessHeader
0x0052da30.label: MPEGAudioHeaderParser
0x0052da30.summary: Parses a 32-bit MPEG audio frame header, extracting layer, bitrate, sampling rate, channel mode, protection, and other fields into the decoder state structure. Computes frame size and samples-per-frame from lookup tables. Part of the MPEG audio decoding subsystem.

0x0052dc90.name: MediaFileDecodeHeader
0x0052dc90.label: MpegFileDecodeHeader
0x0052dc90.summary: Reads 4-byte MPEG sync word from I/O interface, byte-swaps, and processes via CMpegBase_ProcessHeader. Validates frame size; on corruption sets flag and zeros frame size field.

0x0052dd50.name: BitstreamDecoder_dd50
0x0052dd50.label: BitstreamMpegHeaderDecode
0x0052dd50.summary: Decodes MPEG audio frame header from bitstream buffer. Reads 32-bit sync word from buffer at current bit position, processes via CMpegBase_ProcessHeader, then advances bit position by frame size + 32 bits on success.

0x0052ddc0.name: NetworkPacketSend
0x0052ddc0.label: IOReadMpegHeaderDecode
0x0052ddc0.summary: Reads 4-byte MPEG sync word from I/O interface vtable read function, byte-swaps, and processes via CMpegBase_ProcessHeader. Returns 0 on valid header, -1 on failure.

0x0052de00.name: NetworkColorIsDefault
0x0052de00.label: BitstreamMpegHeaderCheck
0x0052de00.summary: Reads next MPEG sync word from bitstream buffer (or uses default) and tests whether CMpegBase_ProcessHeader accepts it. Returns TRUE (1) if header is invalid, FALSE (0) if valid.

0x0052de60.name: AudioNetworkBufferTimingCalc
0x0052de60.label: MpegAudioTimingCalc
0x0052de60.summary: Computes MPEG audio buffer timing parameters: buffer size (768 or 2304 × multiplier based on mode), timing quotient/remainder (28800 × 5×mode / sample_rate), and sets ready flag. Called during audio decoder open.

0x0052df10.name: sub_52DF10
0x0052df10.label: CodecTypeDispatchDecoder
0x0052df10.summary: Dispatches to CompressedAudioDecoder (codec type 1) or TextureDecompression_1250 (codec type 2) based on codec type field at offset 0x2490. Calls vtable-based precondition check first.

0x0052df90.name: CPUIDFeatureCheck
0x0052df90.label: CPUIDCheckMMXSupport
0x0052df90.summary: Executes CPUID with EAX=1 and checks EDX bit 23 (MMX feature flag at unk_800000). Returns 1 if MMX supported, 0 otherwise. Clears MMX state via _m_empty() before returning.

0x0052e090.name: CMpegBase_Open
0x0052e090.label: CMpegBaseOpen
0x0052e090.summary: Opens CMpegBase audio decoder: checks and handles deferred deactivation flag, initializes buffer state and sync word, validates audio device settings, then computes buffer timing, performance state, and buffer sizes. Core initialization for MPEG audio playback.

0x0052e170.name: RenderObjectConstructor_e170
0x0052e170.label: RenderObjectFullConstructor
0x0052e170.summary: Constructs RenderObject by first calling ObjectVTableInitialization for GameObject base, storing I/O interface pointers, then overriding vtable to SSE-optimized vtable (off_5B4810). Core constructor for render objects used in media playback.

0x0052e1d0.name: CMpegFilePlayer_Open
0x0052e1d0.label: CMpegFilePlayer_Open
0x0052e1d0.summary: Opens/initializes an MPEG file player by validating file format magic, computing audio buffer sizes via 64-bit integer division, setting up network buffer timing, and activating the underlying audio stream device. Part of the audio/video playback system.

0x0052e2f0.name: LapPerformanceStateReset
0x0052e2f0.label: MpegLapPerformanceReset
0x0052e2f0.summary: Resets MPEG audio lap/performance tracking state: zeroes frame counter, bit position, and residual counters; copies current buffer level to tracking field. Called during decoder open.

0x0052e320.name: DeferredDeactivation
0x0052e320.label: DeferredDeactivationWithStubs
0x0052e320.summary: Conditionally clears the deferred deactivation flag and sync word, then calls two stub functions. Used to handle pending deactivation requests during MPEG decoder re-initialization.

0x0052e350.name: MPEGBuffer
0x0052e350.label: MpegBufferFill
0x0052e350.summary: Fills output buffer with decoded MPEG audio data. Decodes frames via sub_52DF10 codec dispatch, handles partial frame data via residual tracking and qmemcpy, accumulates total decoded bytes. Core buffer-fill for audio playback.

0x0052e5a0.name: ShortComputation_e5a0
0x0052e5a0.label: CopyAudioBufferPointer
0x0052e5a0.summary: Copies audio buffer pointer from dword_8B0118 into D3D buffer struct (dword_8B0110[0]) and returns the old D3D buffer address. Quick pointer assignment for audio data routing.

0x0052e5e0.name: DecodeHuffmanPair
0x0052e5e0.label: HuffmanDecodeSymbolPair
0x0052e5e0.summary: Decodes two Huffman-coded symbols from bitstream using lookup tables (dword_5B4788, dword_5B4820). Reads code length and value from code table, advances bit position per symbol, writes decoded 16-bit results to output array.

0x0052e6e7.name: VTablePointerInitializer
0x0052e6e7.label: VTable pointer setter
0x0052e6e7.summary: Sets vtable pointer (first DWORD of object) to global audio buffer vtable at dword_8B0118. C++ constructor helper.

0x0052e6f0.name: CompressedAudioDecoder
0x0052e6f0.label: Compressed audio frame decoder
0x0052e6f0.summary: Decodes one frame of compressed audio from bitstream buffer. Reads nibble-coded codebook selectors, decodes Huffman-coded VQ indices, dequantizes to float samples, resamples to output rate, and converts to 16-bit PCM. Core MP3/ADPCM-style audio decoding pipeline.

0x00530050.name: MP3AudioDecoderHuffmanSampleRendering
0x00530050.label: Huffman sample render to float buffer
0x00530050.summary: Renders Huffman-decoded audio samples into float output buffer. Iterates over subbands and samples, reads codebook selectors, Huffman-decodes bitstream data, applies DCT coefficients and scale factors, writes 3 interleaved float samples per iteration. Zero-fills unused output slots based on subband count and stereo flag.

0x00530840.name: sub_530840
0x00530840.label: Huffman sample render to word buffer
0x00530840.summary: Renders Huffman-decoded audio samples into 16-bit word output buffer. Reads codebook selectors, Huffman-decodes VQ indices from bitstream, applies scale table (a2) and index offsets (a5), writes 3 interleaved output words per iteration. Zero-fills unused output slots based on subband count and stereo flag.

0x00531250.name: TextureDecompression_1250
0x00531250.label: Audio frame decompression dispatcher
0x00531250.summary: Decodes one frame of compressed audio: reads Huffman codebook header, decodes codebook selectors and delta-coded side information from bitstream, then dispatches to either hardware-accelerated (sub_530840 + AudioResampler) or software (MP3AudioDecoderHuffmanSampleRendering + AudioMixerFloatingPointTo16BitPCMConversion) decode path based on dword_8B0108 flag. Audio codec entry point for frame decompression.

0x005317c0.name: LargeTableCopyFromROMData
0x005317c0.label: ROM-to-RAM table copy (interleaved)
0x005317c0.summary: Copies two audio/DCT lookup tables from ROM (unk_5B6F0C, unk_5B730C) into runtime buffer unk_8B1924 with interleaved 32-byte stride pattern. Initializes AudioWavetableBuffer from ROM data.

0x00531830.name: AudioMixerFloatingPointTo16BitPCMConversion
0x00531830.label: Float MDCT mix to 16-bit PCM
0x00531830.summary: Converts floating-point MDCT-transformed audio samples to 16-bit PCM output. Runs MDCT transform per channel, applies matrix mixing with coefficients from unk_5B666C, clamps to signed 16-bit range [-32768, 32767], and writes interleaved stereo/mono output. Core audio mixer stage.

0x00531b50.name: F_32PointMDCTAudioTransform
0x00531b50.label: Audio32PointMDCT
0x00531b50.summary: Performs a 32-point Modified Discrete Cosine Transform (MDCT) on 32 input samples, producing two interleaved sub-band output buffers. Uses precomputed cosine coefficients in a 5-stage butterfly decomposition. Audio codec system (MP3/MPEG layer decompression).

0x00532aa0.name: AudioResampler
0x00532aa0.label: MMX-accelerated audio resampler
0x00532aa0.summary: Resamples audio via MMX-accelerated polyphase filter matrix multiplication. Reads phase counter, calls F_3DTransformWithSIMD for frequency-domain transform, then applies MMX pmaddwd convolution with coefficient tables (stereo: unk_8B3724, mono: unk_5B730C + unk_5B6F0C). Writes interleaved 16-bit PCM output.

0x00534120.name: F_3DTransformWithSIMD
0x00534120.label: MMX subband synthesis transform
0x00534120.summary: MMX-accelerated subband synthesis / IMDCT transform for audio decoder. Takes 8 __m64 input values, computes sum/difference pairs, applies 32 stages of pmaddwd matrix multiplication with constant tables (unk_8D7200–unk_8D73F8, qword_8D7000), writes 272 16-bit output words to two buffers (a1[0..256], a2[0..240]). Core polyphase filter bank computation.

0x00534b10.name: sub_534B10
0x00534b10.label: File stream open/context allocator
0x00534b10.summary: Allocates and initializes a file stream context based on mode character: 'r' (read) or 'w'/'a' (write). Parses mode flags ('f'=binary, 'h'=flag), allocates 16KB buffer, opens file by handle or path. File I/O system.

0x00534d50.name: sub_534D50
0x00534d50.label: File header/protocol parser (stream reader)
0x00534d50.summary: Reads and validates a 2-byte protocol magic from a buffered stream, then parses block header (size, flags) and skips content based on flag bits (0x4, 0x8, 0x10, 0x2). File I/O/stream parsing system.

0x00534e70.name: sub_534E70
0x00534e70.label: Buffered stream byte reader
0x00534e70.summary: Reads one byte from a buffered file stream context. Returns cached byte from buffer if available; otherwise calls ThreadSafeReadWrapper to refill the 16KB buffer and returns first byte. File I/O system.

0x00534ee0.name: FileHandleDestructorWithModeCheck
0x00534ee0.label: File handle destructor with mode-specific cleanup
0x00534ee0.summary: Frees a file stream context: calls mode-appropriate cleanup ('w' → sub_5361D0 flush/close, 'r' → GuardedFunctionCallCleanup), closes file handle, frees buffers, and deallocates the struct. File I/O system.

0x005351d0.name: LineInputReader
0x005351d0.label: Line-input reader from buffered file
0x005351d0.summary: Reads characters from a buffered file stream into buffer `a2` until newline (0x0A) or max length `a3`, null-terminates the string, returns pointer to buffer. Returns 0 if no characters read. File I/O / text parsing system.

0x005354e0.name: sub_5354E0
0x005354e0.label: Buffered file reset/reopen for read
0x005354e0.summary: Resets a buffered file stream context back to read mode: validates mode='r', resets buffer state, reinitializes allocator, seeks to given offset or closes handle. File I/O system.

0x00535560.name: F_4BitFieldPack
0x00535560.label: 4-byte little-endian bitfield pack from stream
0x00535560.summary: Reads 4 bytes from buffered stream via sub_534E70 and packs them into a 32-bit integer (little-endian order). File I/O / binary data reading system.

0x005355a0.name: StreamFileTypeCheckWithDispatch
0x005355a0.label: Stream file close with write flush
0x005355a0.summary: Closes a file stream: if mode is 'w' (write), flushes remaining buffered data via FileReadLoop, copies state, then calls FileHandleDestructorWithModeCheck for cleanup. File I/O system.

0x00535620.name: ArithmeticComparison_5620
0x00535620.label: Context state reset/init
0x00535620.summary: Resets internal state counters to zero and calls StateResetWithCallback. Sets referenced object's first field to 7 or 0 based on a flag. File I/O / stream context management system.

0x005356a0.name: sub_5356A0
0x005356a0.label: Decompression stream initializer
0x005356a0.summary: Initializes a decompression stream context: validates version magic string, sets up allocator/deallocator callbacks, allocates a work block with 2^a2 byte capacity, validates power-of-2 size (8-15). File I/O / compression system.

0x005357e0.name: sub_5357E0
0x005357e0.label: Decompression state machine (stream decoder)
0x005357e0.summary: Processes compressed data through a state machine with states 0-13: validates compression header (method=8, window size), reads 4-byte header fields, decompresses data blocks via sub_537110, reads 4-byte uncompressed size, and reports errors via string pointers. Deflate-style decompression system.

0x00535c10.name: sub_535C10
0x00535c10.label: Compression stream initializer
0x00535c10.summary: Initializes a compression stream: validates version string and parameters (compression level 1-9, window size 8-15, block size), allocates 5809-byte compression context with multiple work buffers, sets up allocator callbacks. Deflate-style compression system.

0x00535e10.name: ConditionalMultiFieldReset
0x00535e10.label: ElementConditionalInit
0x00535e10.summary: Resets multiple object fields to zero/default values after validating pointers and sub-object pointer (v1). Part of UI/element initialization system.

0x00535e80.name: sub_535E80
0x00535e80.label: CodecFrameEncoder
0x00535e80.summary: Encodes a single frame or data chunk through a codec pipeline. Validates object state, selects codec handler via function table (funcs_536014), and handles audio/video format modes (42, 113, 666 constants). Part of media codec/compression system.

0x00536160.name: BufferCopyWithSizeTracking
0x00536160.label: BufferCopyWithTracking
0x00536160.summary: Copies min(source_remaining, dest_remaining) bytes from source to destination buffer. Advances both read and write pointers, decrements remaining sizes, and accumulates total copied count. Part of compression/decompression data pipeline.

0x005361d0.name: sub_5361D0
0x005361d0.label: CodecSubObjectTeardown
0x005361d0.summary: Tears down codec sub-object by calling cleanup function pointers for codec state flags. Resets the sub-object pointer to zero. Returns different status based on codec mode (113 vs other). Part of codec resource management system.

0x00536260.name: sub_536260
0x00536260.label: AudioCodecInit
0x00536260.summary: Initializes audio codec context fields: computes buffer sizes, zeroes state flags, and loads codec configuration tables (word_5B77E8/EA/EC/EE) indexed by codec type. Part of audio codec initialization pipeline.

0x00536440.name: TextBufferDecompressor
0x00536440.label: Inflate input buffer refill
0x00536440.summary: Refills the decompression input buffer for zlib inflate. Manages sliding window by shifting data when read position nears window end, updates hash chain offsets, reads more compressed data from stream via virtual call, and computes initial hash value from new bytes. Core buffer management helper for inflate.

0x005365d0.name: ZlibInflateDecompressionCore
0x005365d0.label: Deflate block compression core
0x005365d0.summary: Core deflate compression loop. Manages hash table for LZ77 matching, encodes literals and length/distance pairs, writes to output buffers, and flushes via HuffmanBitStreamEncoder when buffers are full. Uses Zlib lookup tables (byte_5B82F8, byte_5B83F8, byte_5B84F8) for length/distance encoding. Main compression state machine for deflate streams.

0x00536e90.name: sub_536E90
0x00536e90.label: CRC32Compute
0x00536e90.summary: Computes CRC32 checksum over a data buffer using dword_5B7860 lookup table. Unrolled main loop processes 8 bytes per iteration, then handles remaining bytes individually. Returns bitwise-complemented CRC result. Part of data integrity/checksum system.

0x00537000.name: StateResetWithCallback
0x00537000.label: StateResetCallbackInvoke
0x00537000.summary: Resets object state by zeroing pointers and restoring a saved state value from backup. Conditionally invokes vtable callbacks or IndirectCallViaVTable0x24 based on current state (modes 4, 5, or 6). Optionally calls and updates a function pointer result. Part of object lifecycle/state management system.

0x00537110.name: sub_537110
0x00537110.label: InflateDecompressStateMachine
0x00537110.summary: Core DEFLATE decompression state machine handling stored, fixed, and dynamic Huffman block types. Reads bitstream input, builds Huffman decode tables, decodes symbols, and copies decompressed output via AudioRingBufferCopy. Part of zlib/inflate decompression pipeline.

0x00537e40.name: UIElementInitialization
0x00537e40.label: AudioCodecContextInit
0x00537e40.summary: Initializes audio codec context object by setting up vtable pointers (off_5DA928, off_5DA93C), internal buffer self-pointers, a D3D shader/state pointer (unk_5DA950), and zeroing the bitstream shift register state. Part of audio codec initialization pipeline.

0x00537f30.name: BitstreamWriteBits
0x00537f30.label: BitstreamShiftWrite
0x00537f30.summary: Writes 3 bits at a time into a bitstream shift register. When the accumulator exceeds 13 bits, flushes 2 bytes to the output buffer and shifts remaining bits. Always calls ChecksummedBufferWriter for output tracking. Part of bitstream encoding pipeline.

0x00537fe0.name: BitstreamEncoder
0x00537fe0.label: BitstreamEndBlockEncode
0x00537fe0.summary: Encodes end-of-block marker (binary '10' followed by zero padding) into the bitstream. Flushes accumulated bits to output buffer when shift register exceeds capacity. Resets buffer capacity to 7 at completion. Part of bitstream/audio encoding pipeline.

0x005381f0.name: HuffmanBitStreamEncoder
0x005381f0.label: Deflate Huffman bitstream encoder
0x005381f0.summary: Encodes deflate symbols into Huffman-coded bitstream. Manages dynamic Huffman tree construction via sub_5383D0, writes symbols using bit-packing buffer (a1+5803/5805), calls BitstreamWriteBits and BitBufferWriter for output, and flushes via ScorecardZero. Core entropy coding stage for deflate compression.

0x005383d0.name: sub_5383D0
0x005383d0.label: Huffman tree builder (heap-based)
0x005383d0.summary: Builds optimal Huffman code tree from symbol frequency table. Collects non-zero frequency entries, ensures minimum 2 symbols, constructs binary tree via min-heap (HeapSiftDown), assigns code lengths, then calls RankRedistribution to enforce max-length constraint and FrequencyTableConstruction to generate canonical Huffman codes. Core tree construction for deflate encoder.

0x005386c0.name: RankRedistribution
0x005386c0.label: Huffman code length limiter
0x005386c0.summary: Enforces maximum Huffman code length constraint (length limiting). Redistributes tree depths by decrementing overflowed length counts and reassigning reduced depths to symbols while updating bit cost accumulators. Ensures Huffman codes fit within deflate's 15-bit max length constraint.

0x00538940.name: PerformanceSectorTimeAccumulator
0x00538940.label: Huffman tree cost estimator
0x00538940.summary: Computes bit cost overhead for encoding the Huffman tree itself in deflate. Calls RunLengthAnalyzer on length+distance tree frequency tables, builds encoding tree via sub_5383D0, then scans code length frequencies to determine the tree description size (3*result + 17 bits). Accumulates total bit cost in this+5787.

0x005389b0.name: RunLengthAnalyzer
0x005389b0.label: Code length RLE frequency analyzer
0x005389b0.summary: Analyzes run-lengths of Huffman code length sequence for deflate tree encoding. Walks through code length array tracking consecutive identical values, accumulates frequency counts for short/long runs of zeros and non-zero code lengths. Feeds frequency data into Huffman tree builder for code length encoding.

0x00539200.name: HuffmanBitStreamDecoder
0x00539200.label: Deflate symbol-to-bitstream encoder
0x00539200.summary: Encodes buffered literal/length/distance symbols into Huffman-coded bitstream. Iterates through pending symbols from output buffer (a1+5771, a1+5783), writes Huffman codes for literals, lengths, and distances using bit-packing with overflow-to-byte flushing. Applies Zlib lookup tables (byte_5B82F8, byte_5B83F8, byte_5B84F8) for length/distance base values and extra bits. Finalizes with end-of-block code.

0x00539600.name: BufferChecksumValidator
0x00539600.label: Frequency table ratio check
0x00539600.summary: Validates Huffman frequency distribution by summing word counts from three table ranges (literal/length/distance frequency tables). Checks if total code length frequency sum (v2) is within ratio of distance table sum (v1>>2). Sets status byte at this+28 (offset 0x1C) to indicate valid/invalid ratio. Used for deflate block validation.

0x00539690.name: BitStreamWriter
0x00539690.label: BitstreamFlushRegister
0x00539690.summary: Flushes accumulated bitstream data to output buffer. If bit count is exactly 16, writes both bytes and resets accumulator. If bit count is 8-15, writes one byte and shifts remaining bits. Part of bitstream encoding pipeline.

0x00539870.name: sub_539870
0x00539870.label: InflateHuffmanDecodeCont
0x00539870.summary: Huffman symbol decode continuation of inflate decompression. Decodes literal/length and distance codes from bitstream using dword_5DBB90 lookup table, copies matches from output history ring buffer, and outputs literal bytes. Part of zlib/inflate decompression pipeline.

0x00539f60.name: IndirectCallViaVTable0x24
0x00539f60.label: VTableDispatch0x24
0x00539f60.summary: Dispatches a virtual method call through vtable offset 0x24 (function pointer at a2+36) with context argument at a2+40 and pass-through parameter a1. Acts as a generic thunk for indirect method invocation. Part of object-oriented dispatch system.

0x00539f70.name: sub_539F70
0x00539f70.label: HuffmanCodeLenTableBuild
0x00539f70.summary: Builds Huffman decode table for the 19-element code length alphabet used in DEFLATE dynamic Huffman blocks. Allocates table via vtable, calls sub_53A020 to construct it from code lengths, handles oversubscribed/incomplete dynamic header errors. Part of inflate decompression pipeline.

0x0053a4d0.name: sub_53A4D0
0x0053a4d0.label: HuffmanLiteralDistTableBuild
0x0053a4d0.summary: Builds literal/length (288 symbols max) and distance Huffman decode tables for DEFLATE decompression. Allocates working table via vtable, calls sub_53A020 twice (first for literals/lengths, then for distances), and handles error conditions with descriptive string messages. Part of inflate decompression pipeline.

0x0053a630.name: ArithmeticComparison_a630
0x0053a630.label: LoadFourGlobalPtrs
0x0053a630.summary: Loads four global pointer constants (dword_5DA998, dword_5DA99C, unk_5DA9A0, unk_5DB9A0) into output parameters. Returns 0. Part of initialization/tables setup for Huffman table building in inflate decompression.

0x0053a660.name: AudioRingBufferCopy
0x0053a660.label: AudioRingBufferReadCopy
0x0053a660.summary: Copies audio data from ring buffer to destination buffer, handling ring buffer wrap-around when read pointer reaches the end. Updates buffer pointers (read, write, remaining sizes), invokes optional callback for each contiguous segment copied. Part of audio output data pipeline.

0x0053ab20.name: SoundBufferAllocator
0x0053ab20.label: Sound buffer constructor
0x0053ab20.summary: Initializes a sound buffer object. Stores size parameter, computes log2-based index via CRTFtol, allocates (8*size+16) byte buffer via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, zeroes counters, and calls CurveSplinePointGenerator for curve/spline setup. Constructor for sound/graphics buffer with logarithmic size indexing.

0x0053ab70.name: SingleFieldFree
0x0053ab70.label: Buffer pointer free
0x0053ab70.summary: Frees the buffer pointer at this[3] (offset 0xC) via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Destructor helper for sound buffer object.

0x0053ab80.name: CurveSplinePointGenerator
0x0053ab80.label: Spline curve table generator
0x0053ab80.summary: Generates normalized spline curve values into a lookup table. For each step from 1 to size (this[0]), computes normalized position t = i/size, calls curve function sub_5881F0, stores float value and delta-difference in buffer at this[3]. Final entry is set to 1.0. Used for audio envelope/volume curve generation.

0x0053ac40.name: TableLookupScale
0x0053ac40.label: Curve table lookup with scale
0x0053ac40.summary: Looks up a value from a precomputed curve/spline table. Indexes into buffer at this[3] using floor(this[0] * a2) as offset, reads float value, multiplies by 255.0. Used for gamma/volume/alpha scaling from normalized input.

0x0053ad50.name: sub_53AD50
0x0053ad50.label: Multi-field object destructor
0x0053ad50.summary: Destructor that restores vtable pointer to off_5B8910, then frees three heap allocations (this[4], this[8], this[12]) via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Calls EmptyStub_0170 at end. Cleanup for multi-buffer object.

0x0053ad80.name: F_3x3MatrixTransformVector
0x0053ad80.label: SSE 3x3 matrix × vector transform
0x0053ad80.summary: SSE-accelerated 3x3 matrix transformation of integer 3-component vector. Copies input vector and 3 matrix columns to working buffers, computes dot product via SSE shuffle/mul/add, stores result as 3 integers. Used for 3D coordinate transform without translation.

0x0053ae00.name: SSEMatrixVectorTransform
0x0053ae00.label: SSE 4×4 matrix × 4-component vector transform
0x0053ae00.summary: SSE-accelerated 4x4 matrix transformation of integer 3-component vector with implicit w=1. Copies input vector and 4 matrix columns to working buffers, sets 4th component to 1.0f, computes full 4-component dot product via SSE shuffle/mul/add, stores result as 3 integers. Used for 3D transform with translation (affine matrix).

0x0053b0d0.name: ArithmeticComparison_b0d0
0x0053b0d0.label: RenderCompositorSingletonAllocInit
0x0053b0d0.summary: Allocates and initializes a render compositor singleton for the UI rendering system. Stores the pointer in both NetConfigData and D3DDeviceWrapperPtr globals.

0x0053b170.name: ThreeFieldAccessor
0x0053b170.label: ThreeFieldBatchGetter
0x0053b170.summary: Reads three consecutive DWORD fields from a struct (offsets 0x4, 0x8, 0xC) and writes them to caller-provided output pointers. Each output is conditionally written only if the pointer is non-null.

0x0053b1d0.name: TripleFieldGetter_b1d0
0x0053b1d0.label: TripleFieldBatchGetter_1C_20_24
0x0053b1d0.summary: Reads three consecutive DWORD fields from a struct (offsets 0x1C, 0x20, 0x24) and writes them to caller-provided output pointers. Each output is conditionally written only if the pointer is non-null.

0x0053b200.name: MultiFieldSetter
0x0053b200.label: SetPositionScaleAndOne
0x0053b200.summary: Copies three input parameters (position/scale components) into primary fields at offsets 4, 8, 0xC and duplicate reference fields at 0x58, 0x5C, 0x60. Sets field at 0x64 to 1.0f. Part of 3D transformation/position initialization.

0x0053b240.name: EulerAngleToRotationMatrix
0x0053b240.label: EulerToRotationMatrix3x3
0x0053b240.summary: Converts three Euler angles into a 3x3 rotation matrix stored as 15 float fields. Uses sin/cos trigonometric functions for each angle and computes cross-product terms for the rotation matrix. Part of 3D transformation/math library.

0x0053b330.name: sub_53B330
0x0053b330.label: SetFlagAndParams
0x0053b330.summary: Sets bit 1 in flags at offset 0, stores three input parameters at offsets 0x1C, 0x20, 0x24. Returns a4. Part of parameter/configuration initialization.

0x0053b350.name: ConditionalScaleApply
0x0053b350.label: ConditionalScaleApplyTransform
0x0053b350.summary: Conditionally applies three scale factors to groups of fields in a transform/data struct based on a bit flag. Clears the flag after applying to prevent re-application.

0x0053b4c0.name: sub_53B4C0
0x0053b4c0.label: QuaternionToRotationMatrix
0x0053b4c0.summary: Converts a quaternion (4 components at offsets 0, 4, 8, 0xC) into a 3x3 rotation matrix written to output array. Computes cross-product and diagonal terms using double-precision arithmetic. Part of 3D math/quaternion library.

0x0053b5b0.name: QuaternionSphericalInterpolation
0x0053b5b0.label: QuaternionSLERP
0x0053b5b0.summary: Performs spherical linear interpolation (SLERP) between two quaternions. Computes dot product, handles shortest-path negation, and blends either via trigonometric SLERP (sin-based) or linear approximation for small angles. Part of 3D math/quaternion library.

0x0053b6f0.name: QRDecomposition
0x0053b6f0.label: QRDecompose3x3
0x0053b6f0.summary: Performs QR decomposition on a 3x3 matrix using Givens rotations with up to 50 iterations for eigenvalue computation. Accumulates eigenvectors in the output matrix. Applies convergence thresholds and early exit when off-diagonal sum reaches zero. Part of physics/math library for matrix diagonalization.

0x0053bb30.name: ForceVectorComputationWithAccumulator
0x0053bb30.label: ForceVectorFractionComputation
0x0053bb30.summary: Computes a 3-component force/torque vector contribution using SSE SIMD: scales direction components by a magnitude factor, applies transform constants, optionally accumulates with an existing vector, and multiplies by 255 fixed-point scale. Used in physics force computation.

0x0053bce0.name: ForceScaleCalculation
0x0053bce0.label: ForceAxisScaleComputation
0x0053bce0.summary: Computes a 3-component force vector for one axis using SSE: multiplies scaled direction components from a1 (indices 6-9) by transform constants from a2 (indices 17-19) and a fixed 255 scale factor. Used in physics force computation.

0x0053bde0.name: F_4ElementDotProduct
0x0053bde0.label: FourElementReverseDotProduct
0x0053bde0.summary: Computes a dot product between a reversed-order integer vector (with zero first component) and a float vector using SSE shuffle-add. Returns scalar float result. Used in physics constraint evaluation.

0x0053c2c0.name: EngineInitBlock
0x0053c2c0.label: EngineStateBlockInit
0x0053c2c0.summary: Initializes an engine state block by zeroing fields and setting global renderer/audio state constants. Empties MMX state via _m_empty(). Called during system initialization.

0x0053c360.name: RenderUISystemGlobalInit
0x0053c360.label: InitializeRenderAndAudioSystems
0x0053c360.summary: Initializes global render and audio system state — zeroes entry arrays, sets default flags (visibility mask, audio init, mipmap, texture effects), applies audio quality presets (medium or high) based on init flags, starts audio subsystems, and allocates network config (160 bytes) and render resource (12 bytes) handles.

0x0053c4d0.name: GlobalResourceCleanup
0x0053c4d0.label: GlobalResourceMultiCleanup
0x0053c4d0.summary: Frees multiple global render and network resources (handles, config data, sound manager) and zeros the pointers. Called during shutdown/cleanup sequence.

0x0053c5d0.name: LinkedListAppend_c5d0
0x0053c5d0.label: DoublyLinkedListAppend_1E4_1E8
0x0053c5d0.summary: Appends a node to a global doubly-linked list (head at dword_8B8F28) with prev/next pointers at offsets 0x1E4/0x1E8. Walks to tail if list non-empty, or initializes head if empty.

0x0053c630.name: DoublyLinkedListUnlink
0x0053c630.label: DoublyLinkedListUnlink_1E4_1E8
0x0053c630.summary: Unlinks a node from the global doubly-linked list (offsets 0x1E4/0x1E8) by splicing out its prev/next connections. Updates head pointer (dword_8B8F28) if removing the first node.

0x0053c6f0.name: sub_53C6F0
0x0053c6f0.label: StringTableRegisterEntry
0x0053c6f0.summary: Registers a null-terminated string into a global string table (max 32 entries, stride 132 bytes). Checks for duplicates via strcmp; if new, inserts at front shifting existing entries right. Used in scene file parsing.

0x0053c900.name: StringMatchWithFlagSet
0x0053c900.label: StringTableLookupOrRegister
0x0053c900.summary: Searches a global string table for a matching entry. If found, sets a 0x400 flag on that entry. Always delegates to SearchPathPrune for further processing regardless of match outcome.

0x0053ca00.name: SearchPathPrune
0x0053ca00.label: StringTablePruneFlagged
0x0053ca00.summary: Prunes entries from the global string table that have flag 0x400 set. Compacts surviving entries to the front of the table and zeros remaining slots. Used to remove processed/matched entries from the active set.

0x0053cac0.name: ObjectAllocationWithInit
0x0053cac0.label: AudioChannelObjectAllocInit
0x0053cac0.summary: Allocates and initializes a 48-byte audio channel object. Stores result in output pointer and returns status from a subsequent guarded initialization call.

0x0053cb20.name: MemoryAllocation_cb20
0x0053cb20.label: AudioEmitterAllocTryRegister
0x0053cb20.summary: Allocates and creates an audio emitter object. Attempts registration via sub_5429B0; if registration fails leaves object intact (return 0), if registration succeeds frees the freshly-created object (return -1).

0x0053cbc0.name: sub_53CBC0
0x0053cbc0.label: CubeMapMASFileLoader
0x0053cbc0.summary: Loads and validates a .MAS cube map file: searches registered path prefixes, reads 12-byte header magic, allocates and initializes a 308-byte physics object for Cubemas410 format. Links object into a linked list at offset 304 with global head at dword_8B8F14.

0x0053ce10.name: ErrorHandlerSet
0x0053ce10.label: MASLoadWithErrorFlagSet
0x0053ce10.summary: Wrapper around MAS file loader that sets bit 3 (value 8) at offset 0x114 of the loaded object on success. Marks the object for error handling state.

0x0053ce40.name: PhysicsObjectLinkedListRemoval
0x0053ce40.label: PhysicsObjectLinkedListRemoveNode
0x0053ce40.summary: Removes a physics object node from the global doubly-linked list (prev/next at offsets 0x12C/0x130, head at dword_8B8F14). Patches neighbor pointers, updates head if removing first node, cleans up fields, frees memory, and decrements global count.

0x0053ced0.name: DoublyLinkedListNodeRemovalByFlag
0x0053ced0.label: ListPruneByFlag8
0x0053ced0.summary: Walks the global doubly-linked list (head at dword_8B8F14, offsets 0x12C/0x130) and removes all nodes that have bit 3 (value 8) set at offset 0x114. Decrements global count for each removal.

0x0053cfe0.name: sub_53CFE0
0x0053cfe0.label: ResourceCacheLookupOrAllocInit
0x0053cfe0.summary: Searches a resource registry linked list by filename (extension stripped). Returns existing entry if found. If not found, allocates 2164-byte entry, attempts registration; on registration success frees the object (return -1), on failure appends to list (return 0).

0x0053d130.name: StringCompareLinkedListSearch
0x0053d130.label: RegistryMatchAndCleanupNode
0x0053d130.summary: Searches the registry linked list for a node whose name string (offset 0x14) matches a1's name. If match found, unlinks a1 from the list, calls resource cleanup, and frees memory.

0x0053d340.name: LinkedListAppend_d340
0x0053d340.label: DoublyLinkedListAppend_86C_870
0x0053d340.summary: Appends a node to the global registry doubly-linked list (head at dword_8B8E20) with prev/next pointers at offsets 0x86C/0x870. Walks to tail if list non-empty, or initializes head if empty.

0x0053d3a0.name: DoublyLinkedListNodeRemoval_d3a0
0x0053d3a0.label: DoublyLinkedListUnlink_86C_870
0x0053d3a0.summary: Unlinks a node from the global registry doubly-linked list (offsets 0x86C/0x870, head at dword_8B8E20). Patches neighbor pointers, updates head if removing first node, and zeros the node's own link fields.

0x0053d4f0.name: DirectXDeviceSurfaceInitialization
0x0053d4f0.label: DirectXDeviceSurfaceInitialization
0x0053d4f0.summary: Initializes a DirectX renderer configuration structure — zeroes state flags and counters, runs StructZeroInitConstructor on 8 rendering-pass sub-structures, sets default viewport resolution (640×480) with internal buffer dimensions (7680×1200), and configures default rendering parameters (identity scale values 1.0f, texture/buffer size limits 8192/32768, and a debug color key 11513775).

0x0053d750.name: sub_53D750
0x0053d750.label: Direct3DInitialization
0x0053d750.summary: Initializes Direct3D8: releases old D3D interfaces, creates new D3D8 object (SDK version 220), configures rendering mode based on config settings, zeros render state fields, and calls sub_540760 for further setup. Called during rendering system global init.

0x0053d850.name: ObjectReleaseWithVtableCall
0x0053d850.label: Sub-object release via vtable call
0x0053d850.summary: Calls cleanup helper sub_540760, then if this+0x10FC is non-null, calls vtable method[2] (offset 8) on it for release, stores return to *this, and nulls this+0x10FC.

0x0053d8e0.name: sub_53D8E0
0x0053d8e0.label: GUID/UUID binary-to-string conversion
0x0053d8e0.summary: Formats a 16-byte binary UUID/GUID structure into a standard hyphenated hex string using format "%.8X-%.4X-%.4X-%.2X%.2X-%.2X%.2X%.2X%.2X%.2X%.2X".

0x0053d930.name: StateIntSetter4
0x0053d930.label: Conditional state integer quad-setter
0x0053d930.summary: Sets four state fields at offsets 0x1508-0x1514 from parameters a2-a5, each only when the value is >= 0 (allowing partial update by passing -1).

0x0053d970.name: sub_53D970
0x0053d970.label: Display mode capability enumeration
0x0053d970.summary: Enumerates display modes via vtable method[4] (offset 16), tests surface format capabilities (20-25) via vtable[9] (offset 36), builds capability bitmask, and calls sub_53D8B0 with valid mode data. Also zero-fills an entry array before enumeration.

0x0053db90.name: sub_53DB90
0x0053db90.label: Display mode capability query with format validation
0x0053db90.summary: Queries DirectX display adapter for surface format capabilities across formats 20-25, tests multisample types (2,3,4,6,16), builds capability bitmask in *a2, then enumerates display modes, filtering by resolution constraints from state fields at 0x1508-0x1510 and calling sub_55BC00 for valid modes.

0x0053e070.name: sub_53E070
0x0053e070.label: Direct3DDeviceInitializer
0x0053e070.summary: Creates and configures a Direct3D rendering device — selects display mode, back buffer format, multisample type, depth/stencil format, swap chain, and queries hardware capability bits (including DXT1-DXT5 texture compression support). Part of the Direct3D rendering initialization subsystem.

0x0053ead0.name: RendererResourceCleanup
0x0053ead0.label: Renderer resource cleanup with sub-resource release
0x0053ead0.summary: Calls RenderTargetCleanup, then frees three sub-resources (this[1355], this[1353], this[1354]) via sub_53F6E0/EmptyStub_7470/FreeWrapper_7bcf, and releases sub-object at this+0x1100 via vtable[2] call, nulling all pointers.

0x0053eb70.name: sub_53EB70
0x0053eb70.label: Direct3D Render State / Vertex Buffer Initializer
0x0053eb70.summary: Performs one-time Direct3D render state setup: configures render states, creates vertex buffers and index buffers, initializes surface/audio emitters, and sets up rendering pipeline state for subsequent frame drawing. Guarded by a flag (this+0x1258 bit 0x10000000) to run only once.

0x0053f270.name: RenderTargetCleanup
0x0053f270.label: Comprehensive render target cleanup
0x0053f270.summary: Conditionally releases render target resources when flag at this+0x5032 has 0x10000000 bit set. Frees audio network stream, D3D resources, UI iterator objects via multiple helper calls, and resets state fields to 0.

0x0053f3f0.name: sub_53F3F0
0x0053f3f0.label: Surface format negotiation with retry
0x0053f3f0.summary: Negotiates surface format between source and destination capability bitmasks, tries up to 3 approaches (format variants 71/77/80) to create a compatible surface via vtable[10] and vtable[12] calls. Falls back with error if all attempts fail.

0x0053f6e0.name: sub_53F6E0
0x0053f6e0.label: Sub-object vtable release wrapper
0x0053f6e0.summary: Reads a sub-object pointer from a2+12, calls vtable method[2] (offset 8) on it to release, nulls the pointer on success. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure with error log.

0x0053f720.name: sub_53F720
0x0053f720.label: Surface allocation with format fallback chain
0x0053f720.summary: Allocates DirectX surfaces through multiple vtable pathways (flags-driven: 0x1, 0x2, 0x40008, 0x8, 0x4) with format negotiation. Creates audio emitter and fills surfaces as needed. Returns -1 on all failures.

0x0053fd40.name: DirectXDeviceSurfaceCreationWithFormatCapability
0x0053fd40.label: DirectX surface blit with format-aware sourcing
0x0053fd40.summary: Selects source and destination surfaces based on flag bitmask (a3/a5 params: 1/2/4/8), performs blit via SurfaceBlitOperation with alpha fill color, releases temporary surfaces via vtable[2] call, and optionally performs D3DSurfaceCopyBlit when a4[11] > 1.

0x0053fed0.name: RenderingCompositionSetup
0x0053fed0.label: Rendering compositing setup with lock and blit
0x0053fed0.summary: Sets up compositing surfaces via LockUnlockWrapper on source rectangle, calls sub_53F720 for surface allocation, selects output surface based on flag (1/2/4/8), then performs compositing blit via sub_5008E4 with alpha channel management.

0x00540150.name: BitmaskVirtualDispatch
0x00540150.label: Bitmask-based virtual dispatch to surface accessors
0x00540150.summary: Dispatches to one of three surface getters based on lower 3 bits of selector (a3 or this+0x18). Bit 1 → direct pointer at this+0x8; bit 2 → vtable[10] call via this+0xC; bit 4 → vtable[17] call via this+0x16. Returns result or fallthrough.

0x00540250.name: F_2DSurfaceCompositing
0x00540250.label: 2D surface compositing with clip regions
0x00540250.summary: Composites source surface region (a3,a4,a8,a9) onto destination surface region (a6,a7,a8,a9), selecting surfaces by flag bitmask (1/2/4/8). Handles clipping (if a10==-2 or depth>8), calls vtable[28] for clipped path or vtable[9] for direct blit. Releases temporary surfaces via vtable[2] call.

0x005404d0.name: F_2DSurfaceBlitFill
0x005404d0.label: SurfaceBlitFillDispatch
0x005404d0.summary: Dispatches 2D surface blit/fill operations based on surface flags. Handles texture blit path (0x40000 flag), surface lock/unlock via vtable calls, and pixel fill loops for 32-bit RGBA (case 8) and 16-bit (default) formats using memset32. Part of 2D rendering/surface management system.

0x00540760.name: sub_540760
0x00540760.label: AudioStreamChainCleanup
0x00540760.summary: Iterates four linked lists of audio stream resource nodes, calls virtual destructor (vtable+8) on each nested sub-object, then frees all node memory via FreeWrapper. Guarded by an enable flag at this+0x13DC; returns 0.

0x005408f0.name: GraphicsConfigStateSetter
0x005408f0.label: Graphics configuration state setter (0/1/2)
0x005408f0.summary: Sets two state fields at 0x13DC-0x13E0 based on mode parameter: 0→both 0, 1→both 1, 2→0x13E0=2 and 0x13DC=1.

0x00540940.name: sub_540940
0x00540940.summary: Allocates rectangular regions in a texture atlas for sprite/texture packing. Creates 36-byte horizontal-region nodes and 28-byte vertical-region nodes, inserting them into sorted linked lists keyed by available space. Supports two allocation dimensions (guarded by bit 0x20 in flags). Returns -1 on validation failure.

0x00540cb0.name: AudioResourceFree
0x00540cb0.label: Audio resource conditional free
0x00540cb0.summary: Frees audio sub-resources (buffers at a2+28 and a2+36) based on state flag at this+0x13DC. If flag set → direct FreeWrapper_7bcf. If clear → ObjectResetWithVirtualRelease + DrainingLoopFinalizer for proper teardown.

0x00540d40.name: ConditionalFieldSetter_0d40
0x00540d40.label: Conditional buffer/surface setter via bitmask
0x00540d40.summary: Conditionally allocates buffer lock at a1[8] (via BufferLockAllocate) when a2 bit 4 set, and surface blit lock at a1[10] (via SurfaceBlitLockWithFlagCheck) when a2 bit 8 set. No-op if a1 is null.

0x00540da0.name: ConditionalBitmaskCleanup
0x00540da0.label: Conditional buffer/surface cleanup via bitmask
0x00540da0.summary: Conditionally resets buffer lock at a1[8] (via ArithmeticComparison_0f90) when a2 bit 4 set, and surface lock at a1[10] (via GuardedVirtualDecrement) when a2 bit 8 set. Zeroes the pointer after cleanup.

0x00540df0.name: sub_540DF0
0x00540df0.label: Vertex/index buffer creation with format flags
0x00540df0.summary: Creates a vertex or index buffer via vtable[23] call (offset 92) on sub-object at this+0x1100. Builds usage flags from input descriptor fields (a2[0] bits 0x2/0x10/0x20) and checks this+0x1138 for additional mode. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error.

0x00540f00.name: BufferLockAllocate
0x00540f00.label: Buffer allocation with lock flags
0x00540f00.summary: Allocates a buffer through an allocator vtable, storing result pointer in `*this`. Returns 0 on success, or buffer ID on failure (incrementing failure counter).

0x00540fc0.name: sub_540FC0
0x00540fc0.label: Index buffer creation with usage flags
0x00540fc0.summary: Creates an index buffer via vtable[24] call (offset 96) on sub-object at this+0x1100. Computes usage flags from a2[0] bits (0x2/0x10→8, 0x20→0x200). Buffer size = 2 * a2[1]. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error.

0x00541120.name: AudioBufferFormatSetup
0x00541120.label: Audio buffer format setup with channel config
0x00541120.summary: Configures audio buffer format: initializes struct, sets channel count at this+0x1170 (2304/256/1280 variants), bit depth, sample rate, and audio mode flags. Dispatches to sub-setters (StructInitWithDefaultValues, PropertyValueSetterWithRefreshOnChange, etc.) for property updates.

0x00541340.name: TextureSurfaceAllocation
0x00541340.label: Sub-allocated texture surface setup
0x00541340.summary: Allocates a 76-byte structure with two 36-byte surface descriptor blocks via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, initializes each with format/width/height fields (322/24 and 34), then calls sub_540DF0 twice to create both surfaces.

0x00541420.name: SubBufferFree
0x00541420.label: Sub-buffer free with virtual release
0x00541420.summary: Releases two sub-buffers at this[1107] and this[1107]+36 via ObjectResetWithVirtualRelease, frees the base allocation via FreeWrapper_7bcf, and nulls the pointer.

0x00541470.name: AudioBufferClear
0x00541470.label: Clear audio buffer via lock-allocate
0x00541470.summary: Checks if an audio buffer pointer at offset 0x114C is non-null, then calls BufferLockAllocate to lock (prepare for write) 96 bytes at a computed sub-offset within that buffer.

0x005414c0.name: UIToggleState
0x005414c0.label: Toggle UI boolean state (0↔1)
0x005414c0.summary: Toggles an integer state field at offset 0x1148 between 0 and 1. Returns the new value.

0x00541500.name: SceneStateSetup
0x00541500.label: Initialize scene state node
0x00541500.summary: Creates a new scene state object via vtable call with type-dependent initialization parameters (a2: 1, 2, or 4). Increments state counter at 0x13B4 on success.

0x00541670.name: VTableDispatchWithFieldCheck
0x00541670.label: Dispatch vtable call with guard check
0x00541670.summary: Checks guard flag at 0x13D8, then calls virtual function at vtable+0xC8 on the object at 0x1100 with parameter 139 and a2. Stores result in this[0].

0x005416a0.name: DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup
0x005416a0.label: Setup texture coordinates in DX vertex buffer
0x005416a0.summary: Computes scaled texture coordinate values from a descriptor struct (a2) and calls vtable functions to configure a DirectX vertex buffer with those coordinates. Returns -1 on failure, 0 on success.

0x00541810.name: SoundInstanceUpdate
0x00541810.label: Update sound instance list
0x00541810.summary: Replaces the sound instance ID list: clears existing entries via vtable call (flag=0), then sets new entries from source array a3 (each entry 56 bytes) via vtable call (flag=1). Returns the new instance count.

0x005418b0.name: ConstructorInit
0x005418b0.label: Constructor initializer — zero fields
0x005418b0.summary: Calls global zero-init helper to clear the object, then explicitly zeros four specific fields at offsets 0x80, 0x19C, 0x1B4, and 0x1B8.

0x005418e0.name: SoundInstanceInit
0x005418e0.label: 3D Sound Instance Constructor / Default Initialiser
0x005418e0.summary: Constructs a 3D sound-emitter instance with default parameter values: initialises volume, distance attenuation, cone angles, audio-device pointer, channel config, and runtime playback fields to zero; copies the sound name via strcpy; sets up 3D position/orientation to origin via UtilityFunction_1cd0.

0x005419d0.name: LinkedListInsertTail
0x005419d0.label: Unlink node and insert at tail of list
0x005419d0.summary: Unlinks node a2 from its current linked list position (updating prev/next pointers and global tail if a2 was the global tail), then appends it to the tail of this list. Sets a2's list owner to this.

0x00541a70.name: TransformWheelForcesToChassis
0x00541a70.label: Transform wheel suspension forces to chassis frame
0x00541a70.summary: Copies a 4×4 rotation matrix from offset 0x15C, then iterates over 6 wheels (each 16 bytes starting at 0x104) transforming suspension forces via D3D device wrapper. Accumulates chassis position offset (0x24, 0x28, 0x2C) into the result.

0x00541b70.name: CameraProjectionUpdate
0x00541b70.label: Update camera projection and view matrices
0x00541b70.summary: Builds a camera projection matrix (perspective or orthographic) and/or view matrix based on flag bits in a2. Uses near/far plane (0x4, 0x8), FOV (0x1C), aspect ratio (0x20), and flags at 0x80 to compute the transform via D3D device wrapper.

0x00541ca0.name: sub_541CA0
0x00541ca0.label: Flag bit-3 set/clear
0x00541ca0.summary: Sets bit 3 (value 0x8) or clears it in field `this[0x80]` based on boolean parameter `a2`. Returns updated field value.

0x00541d10.name: OrientationRotationMatrixUpdate
0x00541d10.label: Update orientation rotation matrix
