0x00541d10.summary: Stores orientation input vector (a2,a3,a4) at 0x24-0x2C, multiplies a 3×3 rotation matrix at 0x15C-0x184 by the vector to compute transformed orientation at 0x18C-0x194, and writes 1.0f to 0x198 (4×4 matrix homogeneous element).

0x00541db0.name: RandomRotationMatrixFromEulerAngles
0x00541db0.label: Build rotation matrix from Euler angles
0x00541db0.summary: Computes a 3×3 rotation matrix from Euler angle inputs (a2,a3,a4) using sin/cos, writes it to offsets 0x15C-0x188 (zeros in column 4, 1.0f at 0x198), then transforms the orientation vector at 0x24-0x2C by the new matrix into 0x18C-0x194.

0x00541f60.name: sub_541F60
0x00541f60.label: Compute aim/turn angles toward target point
0x00541f60.summary: Computes pitch and yaw angles to face toward target position (a2,a3,a4) from current position at 0x24-0x2C. Stores result at 0x30-0x34 and calls orientation helper UtilityFunction_1cd0.

0x00542050.name: sub_542050
0x00542050.label: Camera Frustum Matrix Builder
0x00542050.summary: Constructs camera frustum plane tangents, projection sub-matrices, and a view-rotation matrix from horizontal/vertical FOV values and screen dimensions. Used by camera/viewport rendering pipeline.

0x00542200.name: sub_542200
0x00542200.label: Setup viewport dimensions and projection params
0x00542200.summary: Computes viewport width/height in pixels from normalized input values (scaled by screen dimensions if ≤1.0), computes center coordinates, and derives half-width/FOV and half-height/aspect values for camera projection.

0x005423c0.name: TwoFieldSetterCall
0x005423c0.label: Set two fields and trigger update call
0x005423c0.summary: Stores a2 at offset 0x4 and a3 at offset 0x8, then calls sub_542050 with float parameters from offsets 0x6C and 0x70 and flag 1.

0x005423e0.name: ColorPack
0x005423e0.label: Pack RGB color components into DWORD
0x005423e0.summary: Packs three byte-like values (a2, a3, a4) into a single 32-bit value as (a2<<16 | a3<<8 | a4) and stores result at offset 0x7C.

0x00542460.name: TripleFieldGetter_2460
0x00542460.label: Get three fields (position/orientation X, Y, Z)
0x00542460.summary: Reads values at offsets 0x24, 0x28, 0x2C and writes them through output pointers a2, a3, a4 respectively. Each output pointer is individually null-guarded.

0x00542490.name: F_3FieldGetter
0x00542490.label: Get three fields (orientation angles / facing)
0x00542490.summary: Reads values at offsets 0x30, 0x34, 0x38 and writes them through output pointers a2, a3, a4 respectively. Each output pointer is individually null-guarded.

0x005424c0.name: TwoFieldGetter
0x005424c0.label: Get two fields at offsets 0x6C, 0x70
0x005424c0.summary: Reads values at offsets 0x6C and 0x70 and writes them through output pointers a2, a3 respectively. Each output pointer is null-guarded.

0x005424e0.name: sub_5424E0
0x005424e0.label: Get four fields (viewport dimensions)
0x005424e0.summary: Reads values at offsets 0x54, 0x58, 0x64, 0x68 and writes them through output pointers a2, a3, a4, a5 respectively. Each output pointer is null-guarded.

0x00542520.name: DoubleFieldGetter
0x00542520.label: Get two fields at offsets 0x4, 0x8
0x00542520.summary: Reads values at offsets 0x4 and 0x8 and writes them through output pointers a2, a3 respectively. Each output pointer is null-guarded.

0x00542540.name: PointerStorePair2
0x00542540.label: Store two pointer values at 0x1A4, 0x1A8
0x00542540.summary: Stores a2 at offset 0x1A4 and a3 at offset 0x1A8. Returns a2.

0x00542560.name: SuspensionPhysicsParameterSet
0x00542560.label: Store parameter and trigger viewport setup
0x00542560.summary: Stores a2 at offset 0x19C (if non-zero), then calls sub_542200 (viewport setup) with viewport dimensions from offsets 0x54, 0x58, 0x64, 0x68 and flag 1.

0x005425a0.name: ViewportPositionClamping
0x005425a0.label: Project 3D point to screen and clamp to viewport
0x005425a0.summary: Transforms a 3D coordinate (a2) to screen space via D3D device wrapper, converts to integer pixel coordinates, then clamps within viewport bounds defined by offsets 0x54, 0x58, 0x64, 0x68.

0x00542680.name: ConditionalFloatSetter
0x00542680.label: ConditionalFloatSetter
0x00542680.summary: Sets float field at this+0x88 (this[34]) to a2 if a2 is positive. Acts as guard against setting a value to zero or negative numbers.

0x005426e0.name: sub_5426E0
0x005426e0.label: StreamModeConfigSetter
0x005426e0.summary: Maps audio/video stream mode values (1-13) to bitmask flags stored at this+0x24. Validates that the video stream mode global is defined before proceeding; reports "UndefinedVideo" error if not.

0x005427d0.name: sub_5427D0
0x005427d0.label: LocateBitmapFileInRegistrationDirs
0x005427d0.summary: Searches for a bitmap file across registered data directories and a linked list of objects. Iterates through the registered entry array (byte_8B5A3C, stride 0x84) and the object linked list (dword_8B8F14), verifying each concatenated path with sub_543130. Reports "Could not locate bitmap file" failure.

0x00542950.name: UtilityFunction_2950
0x00542950.label: StreamConfigAndSoundRegistration
0x00542950.summary: Initializes stream configuration fields on `this` and optionally registers with the sound manager. Delegates mode validation to sub_5426E0; if `a5 & 0xF` is nonzero, registers the object with the sound manager via sub_53F720.

0x005429b0.name: sub_5429B0
0x005429b0.label: TextureCreationWithAudioEmitterBinding
0x005429b0.summary: Creates a DirectX texture surface with an associated audio emitter from a bitmap file. Handles MIP mapping, audio emitter allocation/registration with SoundManager, and surface creation via DirectXDeviceSurfaceCreationWithFormatCapability. Processes multiple configuration flags (0x800, 0x4000, 0x1000000, MMX flag).

0x00542e50.name: sub_542E50
0x00542e50.label: AudioEmitterDestructor
0x00542e50.summary: Destroys and resets an audio emitter object. Unregisters from the SoundManager via sub_53FB80, frees the buffer at this+4, zeros all fields, and sets the default mode to 6. Reports "Error deallocating" if unregistration fails.

0x00542ec0.name: sub_542EC0
0x00542ec0.label: LocateBitmapFileInDefaultDir
0x00542ec0.summary: Searches for a bitmap file across registered data directories and a linked list, starting from the default application directory prefix (byte_5EA438). Checks each concatenated path with sub_543050 and the linked list with sub_560050. Reports "Could not locate bitmap file" if not found.

0x00543050.name: sub_543050
0x00543050.label: BitmapFileLoader
0x00543050.summary: Opens a bitmap file from disk, reads it into an allocated buffer, and passes the raw data to RenderingCompositionSetup for surface initialization. Reports "Error opening bitmap file" if the file cannot be opened.

0x005432f0.name: ClippedRectRender
0x005432f0.label: Clipped2DRectangleRender
0x005432f0.summary: Renders a clipped 2D rectangle surface using F_2DSurfaceCompositing. Applies clipping bounds via sub_543540, converts float dimensions to integers, and clears the 0x400 compositing flag on the target surface.

0x00543440.name: RenderDrawOperationWithClipping
0x00543440.label: Clipped surface blit render
0x00543440.summary: Clips draw parameters (position, dimensions, source pointer) via helper sub_543540, then performs 2D surface blit/fill if clipped region has positive dimensions. Clears status bit 0x400 in field offset 0x18 on completion.

0x005434a0.name: sub_5434A0
0x005434a0.label: BlitFillRectangle
0x005434a0.summary: Fills a 2D rectangle area on a surface using F_2DSurfaceBlitFill. Reads dimensions from this[7] and this[8], applies scaling factors, validates bounds via sub_543540, and clears the 0x400 compositing flag.

0x00543540.name: sub_543540
0x00543540.label: Blit rectangle clipping against surface bounds
0x00543540.summary: Clips blit source/destination rectangle (x, y, width, height) against surface dimensions stored at `this[0x1C]` and `this[0x20]`. Adjusts source pointer offset when destination coordinate is negative.

0x005435c0.name: sub_5435C0
0x005435c0.label: TextureSurfaceIndexSetter
0x005435c0.summary: Simple setter that stores an integer index/identifier into this[13] (offset 0x34). Used to track the current texture surface index for later rendering operations.

0x005437e0.name: ReleaseSceneNode
0x005437e0.label: SceneNodeRelease
0x005437e0.summary: Releases a scene graph node by calling sub_53CAF0 on the child pointer stored at this[68] (offset 0x110), then calls EmptyStub_0170.

0x00543800.name: F_3DPositionSetWithUIRefresh
0x00543800.label: RGBColor3DSetWithUIRefresh
0x00543800.summary: Converts three integer color components (0-255 range) to normalized floats (multiply by 1/255) and stores them as 3D color/position values at this[95..97] (offsets 0x17C, 0x180, 0x184). Dispatches a color update via VTableDispatchWithFieldCheck and sets the UI refresh flag (0x800) on the UI root context.

0x00543870.name: UIElementPositionSetter
0x00543870.label: UIElementPositionSetter
0x00543870.summary: Sets the X/Y/Z position of a UI element (offsets 0x188, 0x18A, 0x18C) from short integer parameters and sets the 0x10000 update flag at offset 0xEC.

0x005438b0.name: AudioPanUpdate
0x005438b0.label: AudioPanSetter
0x005438b0.summary: Sets left/right audio pan values and marks the UI for update. Stores left pan (a2) at offset 0x194 if non-negative. Sets right pan (offset 0x198) to left-pan value when a3 < left, otherwise to a3.

0x00543920.name: BoundedFloatSetterWithFlag
0x00543920.label: BoundedFloatSetterWithFlag
0x00543920.summary: Stores a float value (offset 0x190) clamped to range [0.0, 1.0] and sets the 0x10000 UI update flag. Values outside the valid range are silently rejected.

0x00543960.name: DisplayModeSetter
0x00543960.label: DisplayModeSetter
0x00543960.summary: Sets a display mode value (offset 0x19C) from one of three recognized constants (0x20000, 0x40000, 0x80000) or clears it, and always sets the 0x10000 UI update flag.

0x005439f0.name: ShortFieldAccessor
0x005439f0.label: UIPositionGetter
0x005439f0.summary: Reads three 16-bit UI position values (X, Y, Z at offsets 0x188, 0x18A, 0x18C) and stores them into caller-provided output pointers if non-null. Complement to UIElementPositionSetter.

0x00543a30.name: GetOrientationAngleValues
0x00543a30.label: GetOrientationAngleValues
0x00543a30.summary: Copies two orientation/angle values (offsets 0x194 and 0x198) from the object into caller-provided output pointers. Non-null pointers are written; null pointers are skipped.

0x00543a80.name: MemoryAllocationWithFallback
0x00543a80.label: AudioStreamFallbackAllocation
0x00543a80.summary: Allocates two audio stream emitter handles (globals dword_8B8DBC, dword_8B8DC0) as fallback when primary stream initialization via sub_55B6B0 returns 0. Cleans up fallback emitters if sub_55B6B0 succeeds (non-zero return).

0x00543bf0.name: ResourceCleanupDestructionForDirectXObjects
0x00543bf0.label: RenderResourceDestructor
0x00543bf0.summary: Destroys and deallocates all DirectX and render-related resources, walking linked lists and arrays to call per-element destructors (scene graph nodes, 3D sound sources, mesh/compositor arrays, and various render object pools). Zeros out pointers after destruction to prevent dangling references.

0x00543fa0.name: VertexBufferResourceAllocation
0x00543fa0.label: VertexBufferSetupAndAllocate
0x00543fa0.summary: Allocates and configures D3D vertex buffers for scene graph rendering — frees old buffers, allocates new draw-element arrays, categorizes elements by render-state flags into four buckets, and sets up per-element vertex format descriptors (type, stride, texture flags) for each draw batch.

0x00544740.name: sub_544740
0x00544740.label: ShadowTextureResourceAllocator
0x00544740.summary: Manages shadow texture/map resource allocation and lifecycle. Allocates an array of shadow texture objects, initializes them with formatted names ("SHADOWTEX000", etc.), creates texture surfaces, and manages linked lists of dependent objects for priority-based processing.

0x00544af0.name: AudioNetworkStreamCleanup
0x00544af0.label: AudioNetworkStreamCleanup
0x00544af0.summary: Cleans up audio network stream resources: releases array of sub-streams (stride 96, count at this[88]) with flag 0x100000, destroys stream handle globals (dword_8B8DBC, dword_8B8DC0), checks tree active states for linked lists at this[64] and this[66], processes texture flags at this[82], and finalizes with sub_540760.

0x00544c50.name: TreeNodeAccumulator
0x00544c50.label: Recursive tree-node accumulation
0x00544c50.summary: Recursively traverses a tree (scene graph or actor hierarchy) starting at node `a2`, accumulating values from child-linked lists into counters at offsets 0x34, 0x38, 0x3C, and 0x64. Zeroes WORD fields, folds DWORD bits, and calls TwoCounterIncrements per child entry.

0x00544db0.name: PriorityQueueRecursiveProcess
0x00544db0.label: PriorityQueueRecursiveProcess
0x00544db0.summary: Recursively processes a priority queue/scene graph structure. Checks child nodes at offsets 0x44 and 0x4C (recursing when non-null), then iterates a linked list at offset 0x204 (with next pointer at +16), calling sub_54CA00 on each element.

0x00544e90.name: sub_544E90
0x00544e90.label: SoundInstanceAllocator
0x00544e90.summary: Allocates a 444-byte sound instance object via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, initializes it via ConstructorInit and SoundInstanceInit, and stores the caller-provided `this` pointer as the first field. Reports "Error creating vertex" on allocation/init failure.

0x00544ef0.name: SceneGraphTreeDestructor
0x00544ef0.label: SceneGraphTreeDestructor
0x00544ef0.summary: Recursively destroys a scene graph tree structure. Processes child nodes at offsets 0x1B0 and 0x1B8 (conditional on both 0x1AC and 0x1B8 being non-null), removes the node from its doubly linked list via DoublyLinkedListNodeRemoval_5090, and frees memory.

0x00544f50.name: TwoLevelWideStringSearch
0x00544f50.label: TwoLevelWideStringSearch
0x00544f50.summary: Searches a two-level linked list for a node matching a given string. Iterates through first-level nodes (next at +440/0x1B8), comparing strings at +140. Each first-level node may have a second-level child at +432/0x1B0 that is also compared before advancing.

0x00545030.name: DoublyLinkedListTailInsertion
0x00545030.label: DoublyLinkedListTailInsertion
0x00545030.summary: Inserts a node at the tail of a doubly linked list. Traverses the list from head (this[62], stored at offset 0xF8) using next pointers at +440 to find the end, then links the new node with previous/next pointers at +436/+440. If list is empty, sets the new node as head.

0x00545090.name: DoublyLinkedListNodeRemoval_5090
0x00545090.label: Remove linked list node from scene graph tree
0x00545090.summary: Removes a doubly-linked list node (`a2`) from a list managed by `this`. Updates `prev->next` and `next->prev` pointers (offsets 436/440), and advances `this->head` (offset 0xF8) when the removed node was the head.

0x005450e0.name: MeshResourceAllocator
0x005450e0.label: Mesh resource object allocator and initializer
0x005450e0.summary: Allocates a 572-byte mesh resource object, runs its constructor, stores an ID at offset 0x3C, copies a name string into it, and returns the pointer via `*a1`. On string-copy failure, runs destructor and frees memory, returning -1.

0x00545150.name: F_3DSoundSourceDestructor
0x00545150.label: 3D sound source destructor with scene graph cleanup
0x00545150.summary: Destructor for a 3D sound source object (`a2`) in the audio system (`this`). Recursively frees sub-sound sources, checks scene graph association, cleans up audio buffer/resource at offset 0x230, nulls references in manager's registration array, removes from linked list, and frees memory.

0x00545250.name: ActorNodeLinkedListAppend
0x00545250.label: Append actor node to scene tree linked list
0x00545250.summary: Appends an actor node (`a2`) to a singly-linked list managed by `this`. Sets bit 3 at node offset 0x3C, clears forward link, registers with tree accumulator, then either appends to tail (non-empty list) or sets as new head (empty list).

0x005452b0.name: LinkedListRemove
0x005452b0.label: Doubly-linked list node removal (head at offset 0x108)
0x005452b0.summary: Removes node `a2` from a doubly-linked list with prev/next pointers at offsets 0x48 and 0x4C. Updates `prev->next` and `next->prev`, and advances `this->head` (offset 0x108) if the removed node was head.

0x005452f0.name: AudioNetworkNodeCount
0x005452f0.label: Count nodes across two audio/scene linked lists
0x005452f0.summary: Walks two linked lists — first a chain of audio network nodes (head at 0x100) counting all sub-nodes in each, then a second list (head at 0x108) counting standalone nodes. Returns total count.

0x00545340.name: LinkedListNodeFinder
0x00545340.label: Find Nth node across two hierarchical linked lists
0x00545340.summary: Walks two linked lists — first a chain of audio network nodes (head at 0x100) with per-node sub-lists, then a second list (head at 0x108) — and returns the pointer to the node at index `a2`. Returns 0 if index exceeds total nodes.

0x005453a0.name: EvaluateSceneNodeProperty
0x005453a0.label: Evaluate scene node property via recursive string search
0x005453a0.summary: Searches for a property value (`a2`) across scene node trees. If `a3` is non-zero, searches the provided tree directly. Otherwise iterates through audio network nodes (first list at 0x100) probing sub-lists, then falls back to second list (head at 0x108). Returns found value or 0.

0x00545430.name: sub_545430
0x00545430.label: Drawable object allocator and initializer
0x00545430.summary: Allocates a 112-byte drawable object, initializes it with float defaults and a string copy, then registers it with DrawableObjectNodeManager. On allocation failure, logs "could not create" error. Returns -1 on failure, 0 on success with pointer in `*a1`.

0x005454d0.name: DrawableObjectNodeManager
0x005454d0.label: Drawable object node append and flat array rebuild
0x005454d0.summary: Appends drawable object node `a2` to a category-specific singly-linked list, updates category counters, then rebuilds a flat array of 56-byte zero-initialized entries sized to the total count. Frees the old array before allocating the new one.

0x005455f0.name: DoublyLinkedListRemove
0x005455f0.label: Remove drawable node from category-linked list and decrement counter
0x005455f0.summary: Removes node `a2` from a doubly-linked list in the drawable object manager. Uses `*a2 & 7` to select the category-specific counter and head pointer. Decrements category count after unlinking.

0x00545670.name: CameraPositionGetter
0x00545670.label: Read drawable object category counters into output pointers
0x00545670.summary: Reads three category counters from the drawable object manager at offsets 0x11C, 0x124, 0x12C and writes them to caller-supplied output pointers. Skips null output pointers.

0x005456b0.name: sub_5456B0
0x005456b0.label: Find drawable node by string match across three category lists
0x005456b0.summary: Searches three category-linked lists (1, 4, 2) in the drawable object manager for a node whose string at offset 0x58 matches `a2`. Uses category counters as loop bounds. Returns matching node pointer or 0.

0x005457c0.name: LinkedListTraversal
0x005457c0.label: Indexed access into category 1 drawable list with bounds check
0x005457c0.summary: Returns the node at index `a2` from category 1 linked list. Validates index against `this[71]` (category 1 counter) and walks forward from head using next pointers at offset 0x6C.

0x005457f0.name: LinkedListNthElement
0x005457f0.label: Indexed access into category 4 drawable list with bounds check
0x005457f0.summary: Returns the node at index `a2` from category 4 linked list. Validates index against `this[73]` (category 4 counter) and walks forward from head using next pointers at offset 0x6C.

0x00545820.name: LinkedIndexedAccess
0x00545820.label: Indexed access into category 2 drawable list with bounds check
0x00545820.summary: Returns the node at index `a2` from category 2 linked list. Validates index against `this[75]` (category 2 counter) and walks forward from head using next pointers at offset 0x6C.

0x00545850.name: ClearBuffersLoop
0x00545850.label: Clear scene graph flag across all audio network and linked nodes
0x00545850.summary: Iterates through all audio network nodes and their sub-nodes, then through a second linked list, calling BitmaskClear and SceneGraphFlagPropagation (flag 0x10000000) on each node to clear a scene graph flag.

0x00545930.name: LinkedListNodeInsert_5930
0x00545930.label: Allocate 56-byte node, link into scene/list with optional parent
0x00545930.summary: Allocates and initializes a 56-byte node with parameter linking, appends it to either a child list under parent `a3` or the manager's main linked list (head at 0x15C). Increments node counter at 0x158.

0x005459d0.name: LinkedListRemove_59d0
0x005459d0.label: Doubly-linked node removal (head at 0x15C, prev/next at 0x30/0x34)
0x005459d0.summary: Removes node `a2` from a doubly-linked list with prev/next pointers at offsets 0x30 and 0x34. Updates `prev->next` and `next->prev`, and advances `this->head` (offset 0x15C) if the removed node was head.

0x00545a10.name: UILinkedListCleanupIterator
0x00545a10.label: Iterate and cleanup list nodes via sub_560C10
0x00545a10.summary: Walks linked list from head at offset 0x15C, calling `sub_560C10(this, 0)` on each node. Advances via next pointer at offset 0x34. Returns 0.

0x00545a40.name: sub_545A40
0x00545a40.label: Rebuild filtered array of flagged audio/scene nodes
0x00545a40.summary: Rebuilds a filtered array of 24-byte entries from audio network nodes and second list nodes. Filters by flag 0x4000 at offset 0x14 within a sub-chain at offset 0x204. Frees old array, allocates new one sized to `this[79]`, then populates with matching nodes.

0x00545bb0.name: SceneInstanceCollection
0x00545bb0.label: Rebuild filtered array of scene instance nodes
0x00545bb0.summary: Rebuilds a filtered array of 24-byte entries from audio network and second list nodes, filtering where a sub-chain at offset 0x204 has flag 0x20000 set at offset 0x14. Frees old array, allocates new one sized to `this[93]`, then populates with matching nodes.

0x00545d00.name: sub_545D00
0x00545d00.label: Flag-controlled scene data structure traversal and update
0x00545d00.summary: Processes scene/audio data based on flag bits in `a2` and `a3`. Iterates audio network nodes calling RecursiveTraversal, updates flags in a chain structure (offset 0x9C/0xC0), then processes up to 4 pairs of pointer/count arrays, clearing fields in 132-byte elements based on flag patterns (0x800/0x1000/0x1800).

0x00545f50.name: AudioVolumeLoadComputation
0x00545f50.label: Compute audio buffer load and call system callback
0x00545f50.summary: Computes audio buffer load percentage based on buffer state counter (1/2/3). Calculates fill ratio using buffer sizes and data pointers, then invokes a callback function pointer with the computed float load value. Returns 0 when callback is null or load is below 0.25 threshold.

0x00546010.name: AudioEngineInitialization
0x00546010.label: AudioEngineInitialization
0x00546010.summary: Initializes the audio engine: allocates audio buffers via system callback, creates an audio mixer channel, allocates vertex buffer resources, and walks the audio node linked list to initialize each node's processing pipeline.

0x005461b0.name: MutexSemaphoreCleanup
0x005461b0.label: Mutex/semaphore object cleanup with DirectX resource release
0x005461b0.summary: Cleans up a mutex/semaphore object: releases DirectX resources, unlinks from doubly linked list, releases scene node, frees memory, and clears global UI root context pointer. Aborts with -1 if DirectX cleanup fails.

0x00546370.name: ArrayCleanupWithDualFree
0x00546370.label: Cleanup array with per-element dual free
0x00546370.summary: Frees array of 148-byte stride structures at this+0xA8. For each element, frees allocation at +76 and at +144 (calling EmptyStub_7470 before second free). Then frees the entire array block (allocated with count prefix at -4). Resource manager cleanup.

0x00546430.name: FAILCallChainSaysAccumulatesButFunctionZEROS0x94
0x00546430.label: Conditional zero fields at 0x94 and 0x98
0x00546430.summary: If flag bit 2 at this+0x9C is clear, zeros two fields at offsets 0x94 and 0x98. Despite call-chain name suggesting accumulation, this function only ever clears those fields. Resource manager state reset.

0x00546450.name: sub_546450
0x00546450.label: TextureResourceLoader
0x00546450.summary: Loads texture resources (D3D textures) for UI/sprite elements from file paths, iterating over an array of 148-byte resource descriptors. Manages audio stream handle cleanup, linked-list resource tracking, and allocates per-frame resource blocks (96 bytes each). Part of the rendering/resource management system.

0x005469c0.name: ReferenceCountedResourceRelease
0x005469c0.label: Reference-counted resource release with sub-resource cleanup
0x005469c0.summary: Decrements reference count at this+0x88; when it reaches zero, iterates sub-resources at this+0xA8 to find matching linked-list nodes (via this+0xB8+0x28), decrements their ref count, destructs per-element data, removes from linked list, and sets this+0x9C flags |= 3. Resource manager reference tracking.

0x00546aa0.name: sub_546AA0
0x00546aa0.label: Resource object construction with D3D texture creation
0x00546aa0.summary: Allocates and initializes a resource object at this+0xA8 array slot selected by `a2` flag bits. Copies string paths, searches linked list for existing match, allocates 96-byte stride sub-arrays, creates D3D textures via D3DTextureCreation, updates linked list with LinkedListFloatSearch/LinkedListNodeAppend_89a0, and restores this+0x9C flags. Resource/texture manager.

0x00546f30.name: sub_546F30
0x00546f30.label: Conditional config setter with field 0xA4 range check
0x00546f30.summary: Checks if a2 < this+0xA4 and this+0xA4 < 8; if both true, calls SimpleSetter_fc40(0x100000). Resource object configuration.

0x00546f70.name: sub_546F70
0x00546f70.label: Conditional multi-setter with field 0xA4 range check
0x00546f70.summary: Checks if a2 < this+0xA4 and this+0xA4 < 8; if both true, calls multiple setters (SimpleSetter_fc40, DualFieldSetter, ShortComputation_fd30, FieldSetter_fca0) and sets flag bit 7 at this+0x9C. Resource object configuration.

0x00546fe0.name: sub_546FE0
0x00546fe0.label: Conditional multi-setter with literal 0x400000
0x00546fe0.summary: Checks if a2 < this+0xA4 and this+0xA4 < 8; if both true, calls SimpleSetter_fc40(0x400000), DualFieldSetter, ShortComputation_fd30, FieldSetter_fca0(4). Resource object configuration, variant with 0x400000 argument.

0x00547100.name: ConditionalCheckCall
0x00547100.label: Conditional setter with 0x80000000 argument
0x00547100.summary: Checks if a2 < this+0xA4 and this+0xA4 < 8; if both true, calls SimpleSetter_fc40(0x80000000) and FieldSetter_fca0(4). Resource object configuration with highest-bit flag.

0x005471c0.name: SimpleSetter_71c0
0x005471c0.label: Set this+0xB0 from parameter
0x005471c0.summary: Stores a2 into this+0xB0 and returns a2. Direct field setter with no guards.

0x005471d0.name: SwitchBasedFloatSetter
0x005471d0.label: Float field setter by channel index
0x005471d0.summary: Converts integer a3 to normalized float (multiply by 1/255, approx 0.0039215689) and stores in one of four float fields (this+0x50/0x60/0x70/0x80) based on a2 channel index (1-4). Color/alpha channel configuration.

0x00547240.name: sub_547240
0x00547240.label: Validate and set two WORD fields with flag update
0x00547240.summary: Validates a2 and a3 in range [1,8]; if valid, stores as WORD at this+0xAC and this+0xAE. Unless (a2==2 && a3==1), sets flag bit 5 at this+0x9C. Dimension/size configuration for resource objects.

0x00547280.name: DualFieldSetterByKey
0x00547280.label: Set this+0x8C or this+0x90 by key comparison
0x00547280.summary: If a3 == 4096 (0x1000), stores a2 in this+0x8C. If a3 == 8192 (0x2000), stores a2 in this+0x90. Key-value config setter.

0x005472d0.name: FloatToIntSwitch
0x005472d0.label: Float-to-int conversion by channel index
0x005472d0.summary: Multiplies selected float field (this+0x50/0x60/0x70/0x80 based on a2 channel index 1-4) by 255.0 and converts to int via CRTFtol, storing result in *a3. Inverse of SwitchBasedFloatSetter (float = byte/255, here byte = float*255). Color channel readback.

0x00547390.name: ArithmeticComparison_7390
0x00547390.label: Field selector getter
0x00547390.summary: Reads one of two fields (offset 0x8C or 0x90) based on selector constant `a3` (4096 or 0x2000). Writes selected value to output pointer `*a2` and returns it.

0x005473c0.name: TwoCounterIncrements
0x005473c0.label: Two-counter increment
0x005473c0.summary: Increments two adjacent counters at offsets 0x84 and 0x88 by 1 each.

0x00547420.name: TwoListCleanup
0x00547420.label: Clean up two linked lists with per-node cleanup
0x00547420.summary: Walks and frees two separate linked lists rooted at this+0x24 and this+0x2C. First list (from this+0x24 via this+0x40): traverses via node[48], calls ArrayCleanupWithDualFree on node[47]+0xBC? and frees node[47]. Second list (from this+0x2C): traverses via node[5] (offset 0x14), calls SingleFieldFree on node[4] (offset 0x10) and frees node. Resource manager bulk cleanup.

0x005474d0.name: ResourceObjectCreationWithConfig
0x005474d0.label: Resource object allocation and initialization
0x005474d0.summary: Allocates 196-byte resource object via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, initializes with ConstructorInputControlInit, copies string identifier, allocates 148-byte stride sub-resource array (count from this+0xA4+1, plus optional a6 suffix), calls setters (sub_546F30/sub_546F70/ConditionalCheckCall) based on input flags, stores config at sub-resource slot[0]+0x40, sets this+0x9C flags, and returns. Resource manager entry point.

0x00547670.name: sub_547670
0x00547670.label: Append resource node to doubly linked list with counters
0x00547670.summary: Appends a2 to object's linked list (rooted at this+0x24): walks to tail via node[48] (offset 0xC0), links bidirectionally, sets a2[47] (offset 0xBC) to previous tail and a2[48] to 0. Then increments counters at this+0x10/0x14/0x18/0x1C/0x20 based on a2[39] (offset 0x9C) flag bits 5 and 8. Resource manager linked list insertion.

0x00547710.name: sub_547710
0x00547710.label: Remove resource node from linked list with decremented counters
0x00547710.summary: Calls ReferenceCountedResourceRelease on a2. If successful (ref count reaches 0), unlinks a2 from doubly linked list (anode[47] and anode[48]), decrements category counter at this+0x10/0x14/0x18/0x1C/0x20 based on a2[39] flag bits (inverse of sub_547670), calls ArrayCleanupWithDualFree, EmptyStub_7470, FreeWrapper_7bcf, and decrements this+0x10. Resource manager linked list removal.

0x005477f0.name: ArithmeticComparisonBinarySearch
0x005477f0.label: String search in linked list
0x005477f0.summary: Walks linked list starting at this+0x24 (via node[48] at offset 0xC0), compares each node's string with a2 using strcmp. Returns matching node pointer or 0 if not found. Resource manager name-based lookup.

0x00547860.name: sub_547860
0x00547860.label: Append node to doubly linked list (tail)
0x00547860.summary: Walks linked list starting at this+0x28 (via node[23] at offset 0x5C) to find tail, appends a2 at end with bidirectional links. If list empty, sets this+0x28 = a2. Increments this+0xC (node count). Doubly linked list insertion.

0x005478b0.name: DoublyLinkedListNodeRemovalWithArrayCleanup
0x005478b0.label: Remove linked list node and free its array
0x005478b0.summary: Unlinks node a2 from doubly linked list (rooted at this+0x28 via prev[22]/next[23] at offsets 0x58/0x5C), updates head pointer at this+0x28 if removing head, then frees the array allocation at a2 (with 96-byte stride count prefix at a2[-4]) calling EmptyStub_7470 on each element in reverse. Decrements this+0xC.

0x00547920.name: StringSearchInLinkedList
0x00547920.label: String search in linked list with normalization
0x00547920.summary: Searches linked list (rooted at this+0x28 via node[23] at offset 0x5C) for node matching string a2. For single-string nodes (count == 1), compares directly. For multi-string nodes (count > 1), iterates 96-byte stride sub-entries. Uses sub_589901 for string normalization and StringDotFinder for dot-extension matching. Returns matching node pointer or 0.

0x00547b40.name: DirectXMeshVertexBufferParsingAndLoading
0x00547b40.label: Mesh vertex buffer parsing and resource loading
0x00547b40.summary: Reads mesh data stream via ArithmeticComparison_a5c0 calls (parsing fixed-size chunks: 4, 32, 16-byte blocks), allocates 196-byte resource objects per mesh entry, calls ConstructorInputControlInit/SelfCopyStringToBuffer for each, configures with setters (sub_546F30/sub_546F70/setters based on flag bytes), creates D3D textures, appends to resource linked list via sub_547670, and deduplicates via ArithmeticComparisonBinarySearch. Graphics resource loading.

0x00548190.name: D3DTextureResourceCreation
0x00548190.label: D3D texture resource creation from stream
0x00548190.summary: Reads texture data stream via ArithmeticComparison_a5c0, allocates 196-byte resource objects per texture entry, configures flags, dimensions (sub_547240), and per-sub-resource settings (sub_546F30/sub_546F70/sub_546FE0/GuardedRenderStateSet/ConditionalRenderStateSetup). For sub-resources, allocates 148-byte stride arrays and reads additional data. Deduplicates via ArithmeticComparisonBinarySearch. Appends via sub_547670. Graphics texture loading.

0x00548620.name: sub_548620
0x00548620.label: Texture material library file lookup and loading
0x00548620.summary: Searches for material library file (.mtl equivalent) by name a2. First tries direct file open via sub_587DB0; if found, calls D3DTextureResourceCreation. Then iterates registered entry paths (byte_8B5A3C array, stride 0x84, count dword_8B8E30), formatting full path and trying file open. Finally walks linked list head dword_8B8F14 via sub_560230. Reports "Unable to locate" error if all searches fail.

0x005487a0.name: LinkedListWalkInterlockedDec
0x005487a0.label: Walk linked list calling sub_546450 until match
0x005487a0.summary: Walks linked list rooted at this+0x24 via node[48] (offset 0xC0), calls sub_546450(v1, -1) on each node. If sub_546450 returns non-zero (match found), returns -1. Otherwise decrements global Addend via InterlockedDecrement and calls AudioVolumeLoadComputation(0). Resource scanning with system-side-effect.

0x005487e0.name: LinkedListWalkWithExitCheck
0x005487e0.label: ReleaseReferenceCountedResourcesInChain
0x005487e0.summary: Walks a linked chain of reference-counted resources, releasing each via ReferenceCountedResourceRelease. Returns -1 if any release fails, 0 if all succeed or list is empty.

0x00548810.name: LinkedListAccumulation
0x00548810.label: AccumulateNodeValuesIntoCounters
0x00548810.summary: Walks a linked list starting from this[0x24], calls a per-node cleanup/reset function, then accumulates two DWORD fields from each node (offsets 0xDC and 0xE0) into this[0] and this[4].

0x00548850.name: sub_548850
0x00548850.label: LinkedListIndexedNodeLookup
0x00548850.summary: Walks a linked list from this[0x24] and returns the Nth node matching index `a2`. Returns 0 if index is out of bounds or list ends before reaching that position.

0x00548890.name: sub_548890
0x00548890.label: LinkedListCaseInsensitiveStringSearch
0x00548890.summary: Normalizes input string via sub_589901, then walks a linked list searching for a node whose name matches the normalized input using case-insensitive comparison. Returns matching node pointer or 0.

0x005489a0.name: LinkedListNodeAppend_89a0
0x005489a0.label: DoublyLinkedListNodeAppend
0x005489a0.summary: Allocates a new sound-buffer node (24 bytes) via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and SoundBufferAllocator, then appends it to the doubly-linked list tracked by this. Returns pointer to the new node.

0x00548a00.name: LinkedListFloatSearch
0x00548a00.label: LinkedListFloatValueSearch
0x00548a00.summary: Walks a linked list from this[0x2C] and returns the first node whose float field at offset 0x8 matches search value `a2`. Returns 0 if list is empty or no match found.

0x00548ad0.name: sub_548AD0
0x00548ad0.label: VehicleReflectionMapInit
0x00548ad0.summary: Scans a data array for a valid reflection map entry matching MMX flag and bit-2 requirements. If a2==2, allocates (444 bytes) and initializes a reflection view object with sound instance, color, and physics parameters. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error.

0x00548c20.name: SceneRenderTransform
0x00548c20.label: SceneOrientationAndTransformUpdate
0x00548c20.summary: Computes orientation offsets from a dual matrix transform, updates rotation matrices (orientation and random Euler), then processes wheel forces, camera projection (param 14), and recursive state traversal for an audio/scene node. Returns result from sub_5550E0 or the count field.

0x00548d40.name: LinkedListNodeAppenderWithLazyAllocation
0x00548d40.label: LazyLinkedListNodeAppend
0x00548d40.summary: Appends a new 28-byte node to a singly-linked list (next pointer at offset 0x18). Lazily allocates the head node on first call. Each new node is initialized via ArithmeticComparison_8aa0 then sub_548AD0 (VehicleReflectionMapInit). Increments node counter at this[0x16C].

0x00548dd0.name: AudioNodeIterator
0x00548dd0.label: AudioNodeListIterator
0x00548dd0.summary: Walks a linked list of nodes from this[0x170], calling SceneRenderTransform on each node with this as context and 0 as the third argument. Returns the last SceneRenderTransform result.

0x00548e00.name: ShortComputation_8e00
0x00548e00.label: ObjectMultiFieldZeroInit
0x00548e00.summary: Zero-initializes the object via GlobalZeroInit_c2a0, then explicitly clears byte at offset 0x0 and DWORDs at offsets 0x10 and 0x14. Returns this pointer.

0x00548e80.name: SelfCopyStringWithOffset
0x00548e80.label: CopyStringToInternalBuffer
0x00548e80.summary: Copies a string from a2 to the internal buffer at this+8, calls sub_589901 string normalization, then stores the caller value a3 into this[4]. Returns a3.

0x00548eb0.name: MultiListFreeWithTraversal
0x00548eb0.label: MultiLinkedListFreeWithTraversal
0x00548eb0.summary: Frees 5 linked lists rooted at offsets 0xE8, 0xEC, 0xF0, 0xF8, and 0xFC. Each list is traversed, every node freed (via EmptyStub_0170 + FreeWrapper_7bcf, or sub_549110 for the list at offset 0xEC), then the root pointer is zeroed.

0x00549020.name: StringListAppend
0x00549020.label: StringNodeListAppend
0x00549020.summary: Appends a new 24-byte string node to a singly-linked list (next pointer at offset 0x14). Copies input string `a2` into the new node via strcpy, then normalizes it via sub_589901. Lazily allocates head node on first call.

0x005490b0.name: DoublyLinkedListAppend_90b0
0x005490b0.label: DoublyLinkedNodeAppend
0x005490b0.summary: Appends node `a2` to a linked list rooted at this[0xEC]. Handles both empty and non-empty lists, updates next (offset 0x4C) and prev (offset 0x48) pointers, zeros fields at offsets 0x44. Returns previous tail or 0.

0x00549110.name: sub_549110
0x00549110.label: RecursiveTreeNodeFree
0x00549110.summary: Recursively frees a tree/list node. First recurses into child at offset 0x44, then conditionally into sibling at offset 0x4C (when offset 0x40 is also non-null). Calls SceneGraph validation, runs TwoFunctionCallChain teardown, then frees the node.

0x00549166.name: DWORDZeroAtOffset68
0x00549166.label: ZeroFieldAtOffset68
0x00549166.summary: Zeroes the DWORD at offset 0x44 (68) of the object passed as the second parameter (a2/EDX). The first and third parameters are unused.

0x00549170.name: ArithmeticComparison_9170
0x00549170.label: MoveMatchingTreeNodesToList
0x00549170.summary: Iterates a linked list from this[0xE8], searches each node's tree for a matching child via RecursiveTreeStringSearch, and moves any found node from the source list (*this) to the target list (this) using LinkedListRemove and DoublyLinkedListAppend_90b0.

0x005491d0.name: sub_5491D0
0x005491d0.label: LazyLinkedListNodeAppend_56Byte
0x005491d0.summary: Appends a new 56-byte node to a singly-linked list (next pointer at offset 0x34). Lazily allocates the head node on first call. Initializes each node via StructZeroInitWithBaseCall. Returns pointer to new node or 0 on allocation failure.

0x00549250.name: LinkedListByteBufferInsert
0x00549250.label: LinkedByteBufferNodeInsert
0x00549250.summary: Inserts node `a2` into a doubly-linked list (next at offset 0x6C, prev at offset 0x68). Bit 4 of a2's first byte selects the head pointer source (this[0]+0x128 vs *a2). Handles first-insertion and subsequent-append based on this[0xF4] flag.

0x005492b0.name: LinkedListWalkWithDispatch
0x005492b0.label: Walk linked list and dispatch found entries to buffer
0x005492b0.summary: Walks linked list starting at this+0xF0 via next pointer at node+0x34. For each node, looks up string (at node data base + 0x58) via sub_5456B0; if found, removes entry from source doubly linked list and inserts into byte buffer via LinkedListByteBufferInsert. Part of audio engine initialization/dispatch system.

0x005492f0.name: LinkedListStringInsert
0x005492f0.label: Insert string node at end of linked list
0x005492f0.summary: Appends a new string node to a linked list of strings. If list head (this+0xF8) is non-null, walks to tail via node+0x14 next pointer; otherwise sets head. Allocates 24-byte node, initializes via ShortComputation_8e00, copies input string via strcpy, and calls sub_589901 for final processing. Part of string/name registration system.

0x00549380.name: LinkedListUpdate
0x00549380.label: Update linked list nodes with dictionary lookup results
0x00549380.summary: Walks a linked list starting at this+0xF8, following next pointers at node+0x14. For each node, calls StringLookupInLinkedDictionary and stores the result at node+0x10. Part of audio engine initialization — resolves string names to dictionary IDs/pointers for each entry.

0x005493b0.name: StringCopyNodeAlloc
0x005493b0.label: Allocate and append string copy node to list
0x005493b0.summary: Appends a new string copy node to a linked list (head at this+0xFC). Walks to tail via node+0x14 next pointer if non-empty; otherwise sets head. Allocates 24-byte node, initializes via ShortComputation_8e00, copies input string with strcpy, and returns result of sub_589901. Mirror of LinkedListStringInsert pattern with different list head offset.

0x00549440.name: AudioNodeUpdateWalk
0x00549440.label: Walk audio node list and resolve dictionary references
0x00549440.summary: Walks linked list of audio nodes starting at this+0xFC, following next pointers at node+0x14. For each node, calls StringLookupInLinkedDictionary and stores resolved value at node+0x10. Called during audio engine initialization to map string names to dictionary entries.

0x00549470.name: sub_549470
0x00549470.label: Compute OBB and bounding sphere from scene mesh data
0x00549470.summary: Three-pass computation of oriented bounding box (OBB) and bounding sphere from vertex data in scene graph. First pass accumulates covariance matrix from all vertices and calls QRDecomposition to derive orientation axes. Second pass transforms vertices through resulting rotation matrix via D3D device wrapper and computes axis-aligned bounding box in local frame. Third pass computes farthest vertex distance for bounding sphere radius. Final loop builds 8 OBB corner points with axes and half-extents. Stores results in `this` offsets 0x18 (sphere radius), 0x1C-0x70 (OBB corners via D3D transforms), 0x7C-0x84 (center), 0x8C-0xE8 (OBB axes/half-extents). Called during audio engine initialization for spatial audio geometry.

0x00549fb0.name: SphereVsFrustumVisibilityTest
0x00549fb0.label: Test sphere visibility against view frustum
0x00549fb0.summary: Tests whether a bounding sphere (center at this+0x7C, radius at this+0x18) is visible within a 6-plane view frustum. First checks a "force hidden" flag at this+0x4 bits 4 or 6; if clear, performs sphere-sphere distance check against frustum bounding volume, then tests against all 6 frustum planes. Writes visibility result into flag bits at this+0x4. Part of scene culling system.

0x0054a0a0.name: TestFrustumPlanes
0x0054a0a0.label: Test AABB corners against 6 frustum planes
0x0054a0a0.summary: Tests 8 corner vertices of an axis-aligned bounding box (starting at this+0x24) against 6 view frustum planes. Checks each plane: if all 8 corners are on the negative side, the box is fully culled. If any corner is outside a plane, the box is partially visible. If all corners of all 6 planes are inside, the box is fully visible. Writes result to flag bits at this+0x4. Part of scene culling system.

0x0054a270.name: LinkedListAppend_a270
0x0054a270.label: Append node to doubly linked list tail
0x0054a270.summary: Appends a node to the tail of a doubly linked list (head at this+0x100, prev/next links at node+0x100/+0x104). If list is non-empty, walks to tail via node+0x104 next pointers; if empty, sets head to new node. Sets prev pointer of new node to old tail (or 0) and next to 0. Returns old head (or new node if list was empty).

0x0054a2d0.name: StringLookupInLinkedDictionary
0x0054a2d0.label: Look up string in linked dictionary by linear search
0x0054a2d0.summary: Searches a linked dictionary for a matching string. Reads head at this+0x100, then walks nodes via next pointer at node+0x104 comparing each node's string (at node+0x08) against the input using strcmp. Returns node pointer on match or 0 if not found. Called by LinkedListUpdate and AudioNodeUpdateWalk to resolve string names to dictionary entries.

0x0054a340.name: SpatialTreeNearestNeighborQuery
0x0054a340.label: Find nearest visible object to query point
0x0054a340.summary: Finds the nearest spatial object to a 3D query point that passes a 6-plane frustum visibility test. First attempts tree walk from spatial index (this+0x2A0), iterating child nodes via +0x10 child pointer and +0x14 sibling next. Falls back to linear walk of linked list (head at this+0x100, next at node+0x104) if tree unavailable. Computes squared distance from query point to each candidate's bounding sphere; if within radius and better than current best, tests against 6 frustum planes. Stores best result at this+0x1A4. Part of scene/audio spatial culling.

0x0054a770.name: SceneGraph
0x0054a770.label: Scene graph node destructor / resource cleanup
0x0054a770.summary: Destructor/cleanup for a scene graph node. Frees three separate linked lists/arrays: (1) nodes at this+0x204 with next at +0x10 — each unlinked and freed via QueueResourceCleanup, DoublyLinkedListUnlink, FreeWrapper; (2) conditionally calls FieldCleanupWithNullCheck and LinkedNodeDestruction on child resources; (3) nodes at this+0x224 with next at +0x04 — freed in a loop; (4) array at this+0x22C (56-byte stride) — iterates calling EmptyStub_0170 per element then freed. All pointers zeroed after cleanup.

0x0054a870.name: sub_54A870
0x0054a870.label: Load and register mesh file from disk/paths
0x0054a870.summary: Loads a mesh file referenced by string name. Validates filename starts with "mts_", then attempts to open the file directly or via registered search paths (byte_8B5A3C array, stride 0x84). On failure, searches object linked list at dword_8B8F14 to find mesh data. Reads file contents via sub_54AC70 into buffer. On success, stores context pointer in loaded data (v16+312), optionally passes mesh dimensions to sub_54B4D0 based on flag bit at this+0x3C bit 4, registers mesh via sub_54B570 and LinkedListAppend_abe0, and clears flag bit 15 at this+0x3C. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure with error message.

0x0054abe0.name: LinkedListAppend_abe0
0x0054abe0.label: Append node to doubly linked list (second variant)
0x0054abe0.summary: Appends a node to the tail of a doubly linked list (head at this+0x204, next at node+0x10, prev at node+0x140). If list is non-empty, walks to tail via node+0x10 next pointers; if empty, sets head to new node. Initializes new node's prev to old tail (or 0) and next to 0. Returns old head (or new node if list was empty). Similar to LinkedListAppend_a270 but with different link offsets.

0x0054ac30.name: DoublyLinkedListUnlink_ac30
0x0054ac30.label: Unlink node from doubly linked list
0x0054ac30.summary: Removes a node from a doubly linked list (prev at node+0x140, next at node+0x10, head at this+0x204). Updates prev node's next pointer to skip the removed node, updates next node's prev pointer to skip it. If removed node is the head, updates head to the next node. Returns 0. Used during scene graph cleanup.

0x0054ac70.name: sub_54AC70
0x0054ac70.label: DirectX mesh/texture binary file loader
0x0054ac70.summary: Loads and parses a binary mesh/texture file for DirectX 3D rendering — reads the file into memory (optionally decrypting/decompressing via a5 context), identifies the format by magic string ("CUBE_MTS_410" for textures, "CUBE_MTS_401" for meshes), creates D3D resources, and walks linked-list sub-objects calling per-element processors. Part of the 3D resource loading pipeline.

0x0054b190.name: sub_54B190
0x0054b190.label: Copy mesh header and bounding data to output buffer
0x0054b190.summary: Copies mesh structure fields from source (a1) into a destination char buffer (a2). First copies string "cube.mts" via strcpy, then copies: two DWORD fields at a1+0x14 and a1+0x18; bulk copy of 0x60 bytes from a1+0x1C (qmemcpy); bounding sphere center at a1+0x7C-0x84; and OBB/plane data fields from a1+0x94 through a1+0xD4. Returns 0. Called during mesh data serialization/copying.

0x0054b2c0.name: SceneGraphFlagPropagation
0x0054b2c0.label: Propagate flags through scene graph hierarchy
0x0054b2c0.summary: Propagates flag bits through a scene graph tree: sets flag a2 on current node (this+0x3C), sets flag a3 on all children in linked list (child list at this+0x204, next at node+0x10, flag field at node+0x14). Recursively propagates to siblings if this+0x44 is non-null. Walks up to parent (this+0x4C) when a4=1. Used during buffer clear/reset operations to propagate dirty/visible flags through hierarchy.

0x0054b3b0.name: ThreeFieldSetterWithSubCall
0x0054b3b0.label: Three-field setter with bitmask clear
0x0054b3b0.summary: Assigns three parameters to fields at offsets 0x20, 0x24, 0x28, then clears a bitmask at offset 0x40 via BitmaskClear.

0x0054b420.name: TripleFieldQuery
0x0054b420.label: Triple field query
0x0054b420.summary: Reads three adjacent fields (offsets 0x20, 0x24, 0x28) and writes them to caller-provided output pointers if non-null. Returns `a4`.

0x0054b450.name: sub_54B450
0x0054b450.label: Three-float field setter with bitmask clear
0x0054b450.summary: Stores three float parameters at offsets 0x2C, 0x30, 0x34 (calling InterruptDispatch on each), then clears a bitmask at offset 0x40 via BitmaskClear.

0x0054b4a0.name: ArithmeticComparison_b4a0
0x0054b4a0.label: Triple float field query
0x0054b4a0.summary: Reads three adjacent fields (offsets 0x2C, 0x30, 0x34) and writes them to caller-provided output pointers if non-null. Returns `a4`.

0x0054b4d0.name: sub_54B4D0
0x0054b4d0.label: Six-field setter with bitmask clear
0x0054b4d0.summary: Sets three integer fields (offsets 0x20, 0x24, 0x28) and three float fields (offsets 0x2C, 0x30, 0x34, each via InterruptDispatch), then clears bitmask at offset 0x40.

0x0054b570.name: sub_54B570
0x0054b570.label: SceneNodeTransformMatrixBuilder
0x0054b570.summary: Builds a 4x4 world transformation matrix from Euler rotation angles and translation for a 3D scene node, with flag-driven rotation adjustments (PI-flip, negation) and multi-buffer output selection.

0x0054b770.name: TransformationMatrixUpdate
0x0054b770.label: Scene node transform matrix update with hierarchy and scaling
0x0054b770.summary: Updates the world transformation matrix for a scene node. Concatenates with parent's world matrix if parent exists, applies XYZ scale factors when scaling flag is set, and stores final combined matrix at `this+0x1A0`.

0x0054b950.name: SceneNodePositionGetter
0x0054b950.label: Scene node position getter (lazy transform)
0x0054b950.summary: Lazily computes a scene node's world position transform via D3D device wrapper vtable+4 when cache flag is not set, then reads XYZ coordinates from node offsets 0xE8/0xEC/0xF0 into caller-provided output pointers.

0x0054ba00.name: DoublyLinkedListNodeMover
0x0054ba00.label: Doubly-linked list node move to tail
0x0054ba00.summary: Unlinks node `a2` from its current doubly-linked list, optionally processes its subtree via TreeNodeAccumulator, then appends it to the tail of `this` list. Handles sublist merging when both source and destination have sublists.

0x0054baa0.name: DoublyLinkedListNodeTransplant
0x0054baa0.label: Doubly-linked list node transplant to global list
0x0054baa0.summary: Unlinks node `a2` from its current container list and inserts it at the tail of a global list (via `dword_8B8F28+264`). Transplants sublist if present.

0x0054bb40.name: UIListNodeManager
0x0054bb40.label: Create and append UI list node from template
0x0054bb40.summary: Creates a new UI list node (40 bytes) from source template, initializes via sub_5510F0, and appends to linked list (head at this+0x214, next at node+0x24). Walks to tail if non-empty; sets head on first node. Configures item count (v8[5]), initializes sequential indices in item array (v8[6]), registers via EntityFlagSetSubInitChain, stores source pointer (v8[7]), and conditionally calls sub_559200. Part of UI scene node setup.

0x0054bc60.name: RecursiveTreeStringSearch
0x0054bc60.label: Recursive depth-first tree string search
0x0054bc60.summary: Recursively searches a tree structure for a node whose base address string matches input a2. First traverses subtree at this+0x44, then subtree at this+0x4C, then compares this node's string via strcmp. Uses a3 as found-flag (int *): skips string comparison if *a3 already set (short-circuit). Stores found node pointer in *a3. Part of scene node property evaluation system.

0x0054bcd0.name: RecursiveTraversal
0x0054bcd0.label: Recursive scene graph traversal with state dispatch
0x0054bcd0.summary: Recursively traverses a scene graph tree (subtree at this+0x44, then subtree at this+0x4C) and dispatches state processing to either StateArrayWordSignExtension (if a4 non-null) or UIElementBitfieldStateSetter (if a4 null). Part of scene graph initialization/update — propagates state and bitfield updates through the hierarchy.

0x0054bd30.name: SceneGraphRenderWalk
0x0054bd30.label: Walk scene graph and collect visible nodes for render
0x0054bd30.summary: Walks scene graph tree via sibling chain (this+0x4C) and recursively via child pointer (this+0x44). For each node, checks children linked list (head at this+0x204, next at node+0x10) searching for any child with visibility flag bit 0x80000 at node+0x14. If found, registers current node into global render list at dword_8B8F28+336 (indexed by counter at dword_8B8F28+332). Collects nodes whose children have visible flag set for render submission.

0x0054bdc0.name: UIElementBitfieldStateSetter
0x0054bdc0.label: Set/clear UI element bitfield states with color processing
0x0054bdc0.summary: Walks UI element linked list (head at this+0x204, next at node+0x10). For each element, applies bitfield mask: sets bits from a2, clears bits from ~a3 on each state entry (array at node+0x11C, count at node+0x118). When bit 5 (0x20) is set in a2, processes color/texture data: encodes color from global counter (dword_8B8F28+0x1B0), updates sub-element color bytes, and increments counter. When bit 5 is cleared in a3, dispatches to state change callbacks based on low 2 bits (sub_55DA50, sub_55E320, sub_55D900). Part of UI scene node update system.

0x0054bf10.name: StateArrayWordSignExtension
0x0054bf10.label: Sign-extend upper 16 bits of state array words
0x0054bf10.summary: Walks UI element linked list (head at this+0x204, next at node+0x10). For each element, iterates state array entries (count at node+0x118, array at node+0x11C). For each state word: reads upper 16 bits as signed 16-bit value, sign-extends to 32 bits, and writes result back, effectively replicating the signed upper half into the lower half. Ensures signed 16-bit state values are correctly extended for downstream processing. Part of UI scene node state initialization.

0x0054bf60.name: PitCrewAnimationOffsetUpdate
0x0054bf60.label: Update pit crew animation vertex offsets
0x0054bf60.summary: Walks UI/animation element linked list (head at this+0x204, next at node+0x10) and updates vertex position offsets for entries matching a given type ID (a2). For each matching entry, iterates vertices with stride 48 bytes and adds offset (a4, a5) to X/Y position components. Attribute offset base depends on a3: 0 updates offsets at data_ptr+32/36, 1 updates at data_ptr+40/44. Sets dirty flag bit 0x800 at entry+0x30. Part of pit crew animation system called during camera/viewport render setup.

0x0054c030.name: FlagFieldBitManipulation
0x0054c030.label: Flag field bit manipulation with recursive propagation
0x0054c030.summary: Sets or clears bits 1 (0x2) and 2 (0x4) in flag field at offset 0x3C based on parameters `a2` and `a3`. Optionally propagates the operation to linked child objects when `a4==1`.

0x0054c0e0.name: sub_54C0E0
0x0054c0e0.label: Test visibility/classification mask against render state
0x0054c0e0.summary: Tests whether this object's visibility/classification mask (at this+0x38) is compatible with the current renderer visibility state. Returns TRUE if mask is 0 (unconditional pass) or if all bits of the mask are contained in the intersection of global render visibility mask (dword_8B8E34) and the target object's mask (a2+0x84). Used as a visibility filter during scene traversal.

0x0054c110.name: RenderFlagSetter
0x0054c110.label: Render flag field selector
0x0054c110.summary: Selects between two render flag fields (0x800 or 0x1000) on a scene/render node, sets the corresponding field from an input value, and records the flag bit in a flags word at +0x3C. Part of the scene graph rendering system.

0x0054c150.name: FlagPropertyGetter
0x0054c150.label: Render flag field reader
0x0054c150.summary: Reads back render flag values set by the corresponding setter function. Checks flag bits via the second byte of an integer parameter and returns the value stored at +0x234 or +0x238 depending on which flag is active. Peer to RenderFlagSetter_0054c110.

0x0054c190.name: BitClear
0x0054c190.label: Clear bits 1 and 2 in flag field
0x0054c190.summary: Clears bits 1 (0x2) and 2 (0x4) in the flag field at offset 0x3C using mask 0xFFFFFFF9.

0x0054c1b0.name: UIWidgetRecursiveStateUpdate
0x0054c1b0.label: UI widget recursive state update
0x0054c1b0.summary: Recursively propagates a state update to linked child widgets, then sets or clears a global state flag based on parameter `a2`.

0x0054c210.name: SceneGraphChildCount
0x0054c210.label: Linked list child node count
0x0054c210.summary: Counts nodes in a singly-linked list starting at `this[0x204]`, following next pointers at offset 0x10. Returns the count.

0x0054c410.name: QueueResourceCleanup
0x0054c410.label: Queued resource cleanup
0x0054c410.summary: Frees multiple types of queued resources: audio resources, linked-list managed objects, an array of 56-byte structures, and a single object pointer. Called during scene graph teardown to release all pending allocations.

0x0054c510.name: sub_54C510
0x0054c510.label: Mesh vertex buffer update with material search
0x0054c510.summary: Updates mesh vertex buffer base pointers by adding an offset, processes vertex elements through a material lookup system, and sets render flags based on material properties. Part of the scene graph mesh rendering pipeline.

0x0054c6c0.name: VertexBufferTransform
0x0054c6c0.label: Vertex transform with D3D device
0x0054c6c0.summary: Applies position and rotation transforms to vertex buffer data via the D3D device, then clears transform accumulators and allocates new empty vertex structures. Runs once (guarded by a 0x4000000 done flag). Part of the scene graph mesh rendering pipeline.

0x0054ca00.name: sub_54CA00
0x0054ca00.label: Mesh vertex material transform processor
0x0054ca00.summary: Processes a mesh's vertex element array, applying material-based UV/texture coordinate transforms to vertex data. Has two paths selected by a flags word: a 16-DWORD vertex stride path with D3D-transformed data, or a 12-DWORD stride path for untransformed data. Part of scene graph mesh rendering pipeline.

0x0054d030.name: SceneNodeChildrenClear
0x0054d030.label: Scene node child element audio cleanup
0x0054d030.summary: Frees audio resources for each child element in the vertex element array when the 0x8000000 active flag is set, then clears the flag. Companion teardown to the mesh processing functions.

0x0054d080.name: sub_54D080
0x0054d080.label: Triangle mesh bounding sphere computation
0x0054d080.summary: For each triangle in a mesh, computes centroid, bounding sphere radius (max vertex distance from centroid), and dominant normal axis. Handles both 48-byte and 64-byte vertex strides based on MMX flag.

0x0054d4e0.name: ConditionalFloatFieldSetter
0x0054d4e0.label: Conditional float field setter with sentinel
0x0054d4e0.summary: Sets two float fields on an object, but only if the input values are not the -1.0 sentinel (indicating "no change"). Used by scene node initialization to optionally override default values.

0x0054d520.name: F_3DBoundingBoxExtentsComputation
0x0054d520.label: 3D Bounding Box Extents Computation
0x0054d520.summary: Scans vertex buffer entries to compute axis-aligned bounding box min/max extents (X, Y, Z) and writes the 24 corner coordinates plus center point into the output struct. Optionally computes the bounding sphere radius.

0x0054d7a0.name: CollisionContactStateDetection
0x0054d7a0.label: Collision contact state detection
0x0054d7a0.summary: Determines collision contact state (contact, near-contact, or separated) between two collision objects by computing distance and testing against threshold radii. Evaluates collision plane equations for contact classification. Part of the physics/collision detection system.

0x0054d910.name: AABBFrustumVisibilityClassification
0x0054d910.label: AABB frustum visibility classification
0x0054d910.summary: Classifies an axis-aligned bounding box against frustum planes by testing all 8 corners. Determines whether the AABB is fully visible, fully culled, or intersecting the view frustum. Part of the visibility/culling system.

0x0054d9f0.name: MeshBoundingBoxComputation
0x0054d9f0.label: Mesh Bounding Box Computation
0x0054d9f0.summary: Computes axis-aligned bounding box (min/max XYZ) and bounding sphere radius for a mesh by iterating vertex data through D3D transform pipeline. Stores 8 corner positions, 3 center points, and the bounding sphere radius in the mesh node struct.

0x0054e080.name: FlagSetLoop
0x0054e080.label: Material flag propagation loop
0x0054e080.summary: Iterates through a secondary vertex element array, dereferences each element to a material/vertex object, and sets flag bit 0 on objects that already have flag bit 1 set. Called after vertex transform to propagate a completion state flag.

0x0054e100.name: PackedArrayTotalSize
0x0054e100.label: Packed array total size accumulation
0x0054e100.summary: Sums a size/count field at offset +8 from each element in a packed array with 64-byte stride. Returns total.

0x0054e120.name: PackedArrayIndexLookup
0x0054e120.label: Packed array index-to-pointer lookup
0x0054e120.summary: Walks packed array elements (64-byte stride), accumulating per-element size fields to locate which element contains global index `a2`. Returns pointer to the sub-element at that index within the found element.

0x0054e1a0.name: IndexedTransformRead
0x0054e1a0.label: Indexed bone/transform vector reader
0x0054e1a0.summary: Reads three 3D vectors (position/rotation/scale or similar) from a structured indexed array. Each 36-byte entry contains three 16-bit sub-indices and a base pointer to a 48-byte-stride transform array. Used for animation/skeleton pose lookups.

0x0054e270.name: BoundingBoxComputationFromVertexData
0x0054e270.label: Oriented bounding box and sphere from vertex data
0x0054e270.summary: Computes oriented bounding box (via covariance matrix and QR decomposition for OBB axes) and bounding sphere radius from mesh vertex data. Accumulates vertex statistics, transforms AABB corners through D3D matrix, and stores sphere radius at offset 0x18.

0x0054eb40.name: F_2D3DTrianglePointTest
0x0054eb40.label: 2D/3D triangle point-in-triangle test
0x0054eb40.summary: Tests whether a 3D point lies inside a triangle projected onto a 2D plane. Supports 6 projection modes (selector 0-5) choosing coordinate pair and winding direction, using cross-product edge tests.

0x0054eec1.name: ArrayFill5
0x0054eec1.label: 5-element integer array fill
0x0054eec1.summary: Fills 5 consecutive DWORD slots at a given pointer with the same integer value. A utility function for small array/struct initialization.

0x0054eed0.name: sub_54EED0
0x0054eed0.label: RenderBatchTriangleInsertion
0x0054eed0.summary: Inserts a 3D triangle into the scene render batch system by transforming vertex indices to world-space positions, testing each batch slot for frustum/sphere intersection, and populating the first available slot with the triangle's position, normal, and material data.

0x0054f2f0.name: CollisionContactDetection
0x0054f2f0.label: Collision Contact Detection Per Frame
0x0054f2f0.summary: Per-frame collision contact detection: iterates over triangle list, depth-tests triangle vertices against line segments via D3D device, performs 2D point-in-triangle test to confirm contact, and stores contact data (world position, penetration distance, triangle source) for physics response. Returns number of contacts detected.

0x0054f5c0.name: SceneBatchRenderCheck
0x0054f5c0.label: BatchRenderVisibilityAndCollisionCheck
0x0054f5c0.summary: Checks whether a scene entity is visible and within collision distance; if so, increments an audio collision counter. Part of the scene rendering / audio collision system.

0x0054f710.name: RenderListIteration
0x0054f710.label: RenderListElementProcessor
0x0054f710.summary: Iterates over scene render list elements: for non-type-2 elements, applies D3D matrix transforms; counts type-2 elements. Returns type-2 count.

0x0054f7a0.name: UIFocusChange
0x0054f7a0.label: SceneFocusAndRenderUpdate
0x0054f7a0.summary: Updates UI focus state, prepares rendering batch transform, processes render list elements, and runs scene batch collision detection. Called per-frame for scene/interaction updates.

0x0054f830.name: VertexParticleBufferAllocator
0x0054f830.label: ParticleVertexBufferAllocation
0x0054f830.summary: Allocates and initializes a particle vertex buffer: frees old buffer, allocates new descriptor and entry array, copies source position data, computes maximum camera-to-particle distance for LOD culling.

0x0054fa00.name: NetworkPacketDataWriter
0x0054fa00.label: NetworkPacketDataEntryWriter
0x0054fa00.summary: Writes 6 data fields from a source struct into a specific entry slot of a network/communication packet buffer array, marking the entry as dirty (bit 3).

0x0054fa50.name: LinkedNodeDestruction
0x0054fa50.label: LinkedBufferNodeDestructor
0x0054fa50.summary: Frees a linked buffer node's data array and descriptor struct, then clears the reference pointer. Used for particle/scene buffer cleanup.

0x0054fae0.name: BufferEntryClear
0x0054fae0.label: RenderBufferEntryClear
0x0054fae0.summary: Clears the active/dirty flag (bit 0) and resets a status field to zero on one or all render buffer entries, resetting them for the next frame.

0x0054fb40.name: SceneNodeVisibilityToggle
0x0054fb40.label: SceneNodeVisibilityToggle
0x0054fb40.summary: Sets or clears the visibility flag (bit 6, 0x40) on a scene render node based on a boolean parameter.

0x0054fb70.name: LinkedListFlagBitExtraction
0x0054fb70.label: Linked list node flag bit extractor
0x0054fb70.summary: Extracts bit 6 (0x40) from a flag byte at offset +0x14 of a linked list node pointed to by this+0x204. Returns 0 or 1 as a boolean value. Used during scene extent computation to query a property flag.

0x0054fc50.name: FloatToIntMultiply
0x0054fc50.label: Float-to-color packed ARGB conversion
0x0054fc50.summary: Converts a float (0-100 scale) to a packed 32-bit ARGB color by multiplying by 2.55 to reach byte range, then replicating the byte across all 4 channels using constant 0x01010101. Stores the result as a texture/color parameter.

0x0054fc70.name: sub_54FC70
0x0054fc70.label: Current material/index field setter
0x0054fc70.summary: Stores an integer (material slot index or vertex processing counter) into a field at this+0x6C. Used during mesh vertex buffer parsing and material coordinate processing to track the current working index.

0x0054fc80.name: DualFieldSetter
0x0054fc80.label: Dual render state field setter
0x0054fc80.summary: Stores two integer values into consecutive fields at this+0x70 and this+0x74. Used by render state setup functions to set paired state parameters.

0x0054fca0.name: FieldSetter_fca0
0x0054fca0.label: Render state field setter
0x0054fca0.summary: Stores a single integer value into a field at this+0x64. Used by render state setup functions to set a state parameter.

0x0054fcc0.name: sub_54FCC0
0x0054fcc0.label: Render state default value initializer
0x0054fcc0.summary: Sets a field at this+0x84 to the constant value 191 (0xBF), regardless of the input parameter a2. The switch statement's intermediate values (0, 63, 127) are immediately overwritten and have no effect. Used during mesh/texture creation to initialize a render state parameter to its default.

0x0054fd30.name: ShortComputation_fd30
0x0054fd30.label: Paired render state field setter
0x0054fd30.summary: Stores two integer values into consecutive fields at this+0x78 and this+0x7C. Used by render state setup functions to set paired state parameters.

0x0054fd50.name: PlaybackRateConfigSetter
0x0054fd50.label: Mode selector with rate parameter
0x0054fd50.summary: Sets a two-bit mode field (values 0, 4, or 8) at this+0x40 and a rate/value field at this+0x44 based on input parameters. Mode 8 uses a3 as the rate (with -1 sentinel for invalid input < 1); mode 4 uses a3 directly; default clears mode and sets rate to 1.

0x0054fda0.name: ArrayCopyWithRealloc
0x0054fda0.label: Reallocating DWORD array copy
0x0054fda0.summary: Replaces an integer array at this+0x4C by freeing the old allocation, allocating a new buffer of a3 DWORDs, copying from a source array, and updating the count at this+0x50. Used during mesh vertex buffer loading to store per-element integer data.

0x0054fe00.name: InverseScale
0x0054fe00.label: Reciprocal scale factor setter
0x0054fe00.summary: Computes the inverse (1.0 / a2) of an input float and stores it at this+0x58. Used during mesh vertex buffer loading to pre-compute a reciprocal scale factor for vertex data processing.

0x0054fe50.name: sub_54FE50
0x0054fe50.label: Audio emitter creation with filename extraction
0x0054fe50.summary: Allocates and creates an audio emitter, stores its pointer at this+0x54, extracts the filename portion from a resource path, and copies it to a string buffer at this+4. Used during resource loading to associate audio emitters with objects.

0x0054fec0.name: sub_54FEC0
0x0054fec0.label: Texture creation with power-of-2 validation
0x0054fec0.summary: Creates a texture by validating that width and height are powers of two (standard sizes 1-4096), setting up an audio emitter association via sub_54FE50, and calling the main texture initialization function. Reports error and cleans up on failure.

0x00550080.name: D3DTextureCreation
0x00550080.label: TextureCreationWithScalingAndFormatSelect
0x00550080.summary: Creates D3D texture with mip level calculation, size scaling against sound manager limits, and render format selection based on flags and device capabilities.

0x005502c0.name: DestructorWithConditionalFreeFlagClear
0x005502c0.label: ConditionalFreeThenFlagClear
0x005502c0.summary: Conditionally frees a sub-object pointer, calls cleanup, then clears the free flag. Used as error-path or release destructor across texture/sound/resource systems.

0x00550300.name: StructFieldSetterAt0x4c
0x00550300.label: FieldSetterAt0x4c
0x00550300.summary: Simple inline setter that stores an integer value at this+0x4C and returns it. No guards or side effects.

0x00550310.name: D3DAnimationTimeUpdate
0x00550310.label: AnimationTimerAdvance
0x00550310.summary: Advances per-entry animation timers by delta time, triggering InterruptDispatch on completion and setting/resetting a completion flag bit.

0x005503a0.name: sub_5503A0
0x005503a0.label: AnimationTrackInterpolationUpdate
0x005503a0.summary: Updates animation track interpolation values across a linked list of animation nodes, supporting wrap (case 1), clamp (case 2), ping-pong (case 3), and one-shot (case 4) looping modes.

0x005504d0.name: IndexedArrayLookupWithBoundsCheck
0x005504d0.label: ArrayFrameLookupWithBinkReset
0x005504d0.summary: Bounds-checked lookup into an array of animation/material frames (148-byte stride), with optional Bink video decoder reset when frame type is terminal and texture effect gate is set.

0x005505a0.name: LinkedListAnimationTimerDecrement
0x005505a0.label: AnimationTrackValueDecrement
0x005505a0.summary: Walks linked list of animation nodes, decrementing track values by the entry's step value for tracks referencing a specific animation data entry, gated by entry type and timer threshold.

0x005507e0.name: StructInitWithVtableZero
0x005507e0.label: StructInitZeroVtableAndFields
0x005507e0.summary: Zero-initializes the struct via global helper, then explicitly zeros vtable pointer and three dword fields at offsets 0x20, 0x24, 0x28.

0x00550820.name: ArrayOfStructDestructorWithCountdown
0x00550820.label: CountedArrayDestructorBackward
0x00550820.summary: Frees a counted array of 8-byte elements by iterating backward, destroying each element via sub_550810, then freeing the entire block including the count prefix.

0x005508a0.name: sub_5508A0
0x005508a0.label: MeshFileLoadWithPathSearch
0x005508a0.summary: Loads a mesh/animation file by name, searching registered paths and linked animation objects (MAS). Initializes result struct, validates filename, opens file or locates via path search, then delegates to mesh loader.

0x00550ad0.name: MeshVertexIndexBufferLoader
0x00550ad0.label: MeshDataFileLoader
0x00550ad0.summary: Loads mesh data from file handle or memory block, parsing header flags to determine format (material blocks vs texture/animation blocks), allocating sub-arrays, and inverting scale factor.

0x00550f70.name: sub_550F70
0x00550f70.label: MeshDataDualFormatDestructor
0x00550f70.summary: Destructor for loaded mesh data, handling both material-block format (bit 0) and texture/animation-block format (bit 1). Walks sub-arrays freeing allocations and decrementing refcounts, then frees the top-level array.

0x005510f0.name: sub_5510F0
0x005510f0.label: UIListTextureManagerInit
0x005510f0.summary: Initializes a UI list/texture manager struct: zero-init, allocates and initializes a sub-object, allocates array of scale-default elements (136-byte stride), sets count and constant flag 0x20000.

0x005511a0.name: ObjectDestructorWithArrayCleanup
0x005511a0.label: ObjectAndArrayDestructor
0x005511a0.summary: Frees a single allocated object at this+0x0, then destroys a counted array of 136-byte elements at this+0x18 using backward iteration, and zeros both pointers.

0x00551210.name: sub_551210
0x00551210.label: AnimationTrackInterpolator
0x00551210.summary: Interpolates skeletal animation tracks at a given time fraction: computes frame indices, performs quaternion spherical interpolation (slerp) for rotation, and linearly interpolates position/scale components across tracks.

0x00551390.name: PerEntityDataBlockCopyFromParameterTable
0x00551390.label: PerEntityDataCopyFromParameterTable
0x00551390.summary: Copies parameter data from a parameter table into per-entity data blocks (136-byte stride) based on indexed entries, sets a flag, and optionally clears a bitmask on the source.

0x00551440.name: EntityFlagSetSubInitChain
0x00551440.label: EntityDataInitWithTimerStart
0x00551440.summary: Sets flag bits on the entity data struct, copies parameter table data via PerEntityDataBlockCopyFromParameterTable, starts and resets a high-resolution timer, and zeros the timer field.

0x00551480.name: AudioFlagSet
0x00551480.label: AudioTimerFlagSet
0x00551480.summary: Sets flag bit 0x1000 and clears bits 0x7000 on the entity flags, then returns the accumulated QPC timer value.

0x005514c0.name: TimerBasedStateUpdateWithCap
0x005514c0.label: TimedStateUpdateWithCascadeDispatch
0x005514c0.summary: Updates entity timer via QPC, caps at a maximum duration, and dispatches to cascade update or sub-init chain based on flag state. Resets accumulator on audio flag.

0x00551560.name: sub_551560
0x00551560.label: AnimationNodeCreateFromDataBlocks
0x00551560.summary: Creates a new animation/entity node in a linked list, allocates and populates data blocks by copying from source and matching names against a parameter table, then triggers sub-init chain.

0x00551760.name: LinkedListTraversalWithConditionalTimerUpdate
0x00551760.label: LinkedListNodeTimedUpdateWalk
0x00551760.summary: Walks linked list of animation/entity nodes starting at this+0x13C, calling TimerBasedStateUpdateWithCap on each node that has a non-null time cap pointer at offset +28.

0x00551790.name: LinkedListStringKeyRemoval
0x00551790.label: LinkedListNodeStringKeyedFlagClear
0x00551790.summary: Walks linked list of animation nodes, clears cascade flag (bit 0x20000) on nodes whose name string matches the given key, then triggers audio flag update.

0x00551830.name: WideStringComparisonWalkingLinkedList
0x00551830.label: LinkedListNodeStringMatchFind
0x00551830.summary: Walks linked list starting at this+0x13C, comparing each node's name string against the given key, returning the first matching node pointer or 0 if not found.

0x005518a0.name: sub_5518A0
0x005518a0.label: MeshNodeListInsertOrFind
0x005518a0.summary: Loads mesh file into new 52-byte node via sub_5508A0, then either inserts it into linked list (appending to tail) or returns existing node if name already matches — deduplication by string comparison.

0x005519e0.name: DoublyLinkedListNodeRemoval_19e0
0x005519e0.label: DoublyLinkedListNodeUnlinkAndFree
0x005519e0.summary: Unlinks a node from a doubly linked list by updating prev/next pointers, updates head pointer if removing the head node, then calls cleanup callback and frees the node.

0x00551a30.name: StructInitWithDefaultScale
0x00551a30.label: StructInitZeroWithUnitScale
0x00551a30.summary: Zero-initializes struct via global helper, zeros two leading dword fields, and sets the fourth field (scale) to 1.0f.

0x00551a50.name: sub_551A50
0x00551a50.label: BinkVideoOpen
0x00551a50.summary: Opens a Bink video file (.bik). Sets up audio system (Miles or DirectSound) by flag bits, builds flags for BinkOpen, opens file directly then falls back to searching registered audio directories. Stores Bink handle and video dimensions (summary) in object fields.
