0x00551ce0.name: BinkVideoClose
0x00551ce0.label: BinkVideoClose
0x00551ce0.summary: Closes a Bink video handle by calling BinkClose on field at this+0x0. Returns 0.

0x00551cf0.name: BinkVideoFrameRender
0x00551cf0.label: BinkVideoFrameRender
0x00551cf0.summary: Renders a Bink video frame onto a render surface. Waits for frame readiness, decompresses current frame via BinkDoFrame, advances to next frame, updates frame counter, then copies rendered frame to target buffer via BinkCopyToBuffer. Returns true when frame counter wraps to 0 (indicating loop completion).

0x00551dd0.name: BinkVideoFrameDecoder
0x00551dd0.label: BinkVideoFrameDecoder
0x00551dd0.summary: Decodes a Bink video frame to a surface (variant of render, uses different surface lock method). Waits for next frame, decompresses, advances frame index, then copies decoded frame to buffer via BinkCopyToBuffer with additional flag bits from a5. Returns result from surface unlock call.

0x00551eb0.name: sub_551EB0
0x00551eb0.label: BinkVideoSetVolume
0x00551eb0.summary: Sets playback volume on a Bink video object. Guards: only updates if new volume differs from current and is in [0.0, 1.0] range. Converts float to Bink integer scale (multiply by 32768.0) and calls BinkSetVolume.

0x00551fd0.name: sub_551FD0
0x00551fd0.label: BmpGrabScreenLoadAndDisplay
0x00551fd0.summary: Loads a GRAB_XXX.BMP screenshot file from disk, reads its header, creates a render surface matching dimensions, converts BMP pixel data (RGB555/565/24/32 depending on this[12]) to the surface format, renders it via ClippedRenderRegion, then frees temporary resources. Uses a global counter (dword_8CBF48) for unique filenames.

0x00552470.name: sub_552470
0x00552470.label: FontTextureLoadAndInit
0x00552470.summary: Loads a font texture file, validates the extension, parses dimensions, creates a vertex buffer surface, rounds texture dimensions up to nearest power of two (32-2048), allocates a font texture object, renders the font glyph sheet onto the surface, and replaces the original surface with the font texture's surface. Stores flags in field 0x24.

0x00552760.name: AudioResourceCleanup
0x00552760.label: FontTextureCleanup
0x00552760.summary: Cleans up font/texture resources. Calls sub_53CB90 on the source surface pointer (offset 0x64) then zeroes it. If texture mode flag (bit 0x20000 in offset 0x24) is set, also releases the audio surface via ObjectResetWithVirtualRelease, frees the raw pointer at offset 0xC, and frees the font texture object at offset 0x868.

0x005527c0.name: VertexBufferSurfaceInit
0x005527c0.label: VertexBufferSurfaceInit
0x005527c0.summary: Initializes a vertex buffer for rendering a texture (only when flag bit 0x20000 at offset 0x24 is set). Allocates a 36-byte vertex buffer descriptor, configures primitive type (34 = D3DPT_TRIANGLESTRIP?), vertex stride (dword_8CEF78), and vertex count (768). Allocates the actual vertex buffer via BufferLockAllocate with 96-byte elements, then zeroes two fields per vertex (offset 0x8 = 0, offset 0xC = 1.0f) and calls ArithmeticComparison_0f90 to finalize.

0x005528b0.name: ConditionalFreeByFlag_28b0
0x005528b0.label: ConditionalFreeByFlag
0x005528b0.summary: Conditionally frees a graphics surface object. If flag bit 0x20000 at offset 0x24 is set, calls ObjectResetWithVirtualRelease on the pointer at offset 0xC, frees it via FreeWrapper_7bcf, and zeroes the field.

0x005528f0.name: ConditionalUICleanupDispatch
0x005528f0.label: ConditionalUICleanupDispatch
0x005528f0.summary: Conditionally dispatches UI cleanup on the font texture object. If flag bit 0x20000 at offset 0x24 is set and the pointer at offset 0x868 is non-null, calls UICleanupIterator on it.

0x00552910.name: sub_552910
0x00552910.label: FontGlyphRenderQuad
0x00552910.summary: Renders a single font glyph as a textured quad. Guards on glyph index (a2 < 0x20 or >= glyph count at offset 0x44). Two rendering paths: if bit 0x10000 at offset 0x24 is set, calls ClippedRenderRegion directly; otherwise builds 6 vertices (two triangles) in vertex buffer at offset 0x10 with computed position and UV coordinates from the font texture, advancing the vertex counter at offset 0x8 by 6.

0x00552ba0.name: sub_552BA0
0x00552ba0.label: FontTextureSheetAnalyzer
0x00552ba0.summary: Analyzes a font texture sheet to compute glyph cell layout. Locks the texture surface, scans pixel data to find horizontal and vertical divisions (glyph cell boundaries) by searching for sentinel color values. Computes cell stride and count, builds a per-cell lookup table (glyph index → sheet position, row/column), and adjusts pixel transparency (alpha key) based on comparison with key colors.

0x00552d70.name: sub_552D70
0x00552d70.label: FontTextureSheetAnalyzer32
0x00552d70.summary: 32-bit RGBA variant of font texture sheet analysis. Locks texture surface, scans 32-bit pixel data to find horizontal and vertical cell divisions via sentinel color comparison. Builds per-cell lookup table for glyph positions. Replaces key colors (transparency sentinel) with 0xF0F0F0 and adds full alpha (0xFF000000) to non-key pixels. Mirrors sub_552BA0 but operates on 32-bit pixel format (7 or 8).

0x00552f20.name: TexturePathParsingAndDimensionCalculation
0x00552f20.label: TexturePathParsingAndDimensionCalculation
0x00552f20.summary: Parses font texture file path and computes texture coordinate scale factors. Dispatches to sub_552BA0 (16-bit pixel format 5/6) or sub_552D70 (32-bit pixel format 7/8) for font sheet analysis. Extracts filename without path or extension (stored at this+0x14). Computes 1.0/width and 1.0/height as floats for UV calculation, stores at offsets 0x0 and 0x4. Sets the texture's field 13 (offset 0x34) to the key color from offset 0x2C.

0x00552fc0.name: FieldSetterAt0x48
0x00552fc0.label: FieldSetterAt0x48
0x00552fc0.summary: Simple field setter. Writes the parameter a2 to this[18] (offset 0x48) and returns a2. No guards.

0x00552fd0.name: MaskedFieldSetter
0x00552fd0.label: MaskedFieldSetter
0x00552fd0.summary: Writes masked flag values to two fields. Stores (a2 & 0x20) to this[19] (offset 0x4C) and (a3 & 0xC0) to this[20] (offset 0x50). Returns the masked a2 value.

0x00552ff0.name: SwitchBasedParameterFieldSetWithFlags
0x00552ff0.label: AlphaBlendParamSetter
0x00552ff0.summary: Sets two render state fields. Writes a2 to this[21] (offset 0x54, texture coordinate/scale parameter). Maps a3 (0-4) to an alpha blend value in this[22] (offset 0x58): case 0=191, 1=127, 2=63, 3=0, 4=255. Returns a3. Values out of 0-4 range skip the switch.

0x00553050.name: TwoFieldSetter_3050
0x00553050.label: TwoFieldSetter
0x00553050.summary: Simple two-field setter. Writes a2 to this[23] (offset 0x5C) and a3 to this[24] (offset 0x60). Returns a2. No guards.

0x00553070.name: sub_553070
0x00553070.label: FontStringRender
0x00553070.summary: Renders a text string one character at a time through font glyph rendering. Two paths: if bit 0x20000 at offset 0x24 is set (hardware path), allocates a vertex buffer via BufferLockAllocate, iterates characters calling FontGlyphRenderQuad (sub_552910), finalizes with ArithmeticComparison_0f90 and AudioBufferFormatSetup with render state (font texture, masks, alpha). If clear (software path), iterates characters directly via sub_552910 with no buffer setup.

0x005531f0.name: sub_5531F0
0x005531f0.label: FontStringMeasure
0x005531f0.summary: Measures rendered width and height of a text string. Height from scale factor at offset 0x5C (or a5). Width by summing per-glyph widths from the lookup table at this+8*char-148, filtered to printable chars (>= 0x20) and valid glyph range (< offset 0x44). Scales final width by the same factor. Outputs via pointers a3 (width) and a4 (height).

0x00553310.name: ConditionalResourceCleanup_3310
0x00553310.label: ResourceCleanupByTypeFlag
0x00553310.summary: Frees graphics resources based on type flags at offset 0x0. If bit 0 or bit 1 set: frees the raw pointer at offset 0x18. Always: if pointer at offset 0x14 is non-null, calls ObjectResetWithVirtualRelease then FreeWrapper_7bcf and zeroes field. Calls global EmptyStub_0170.

0x00553370.name: sub_553370
0x00553370.label: RenderBufferInitByType
0x00553370.summary: Initializes a render vertex buffer for type 1 (384-byte, 24-byte source stride) or type 2 (448-byte, 28-byte source stride with brightness/volume scaling). Allocates buffer descriptor and vertex memory, copies source vertex data with layout transformation (24→28 or 28→24 byte conversion depending on type). Sets primitive type (34), vertex count (16), and stride (322/324).

0x00553620.name: SetterWrites0x10Returns0
0x00553620.label: SetterWrites0x10Returns0
0x00553620.summary: Writes parameter a2 to this[4] (offset 0x10) and returns 0. No guards.

0x00553630.name: TwoFieldSetter_3630
0x00553630.label: TwoFieldSetter
0x00553630.summary: Simple two-field setter. Writes a2 to this[2] (offset 0x8) and a3 to this[3] (offset 0xC). Returns a2. No guards.

0x00553650.name: sub_553650
0x00553650.label: VertexBufferInsert
0x00553650.summary: Inserts a vertex into a vertex buffer at index a2. Part of rendering system for 2D/UI primitives.

0x00553700.name: sub_553700
0x00553700.label: Audio/Rendering Buffer Update and Format Dispatch
0x00553700.summary: Updates audio vertex buffers with particle/sprite data when dirty flag is set, configures audio buffer format parameters, sets up audio quality/renderer state, and dispatches vtable-based rendering calls. Part of the audio-visual rendering pipeline for particle effects and UI elements.

0x00553980.name: ObjectConstructorWithAllocationAndSubInit
0x00553980.label: ObjectConstructorWithAllocationAndSubInit
0x00553980.summary: Allocates 36-byte object via OperatorNew, zero-initializes it, then conditionally sets sub-fields through multiple setters. Returns allocated object pointer via output parameter a1.

0x005539f0.name: ResourceCascadeCleanup
0x005539f0.label: ResourceCascadeCleanup
0x005539f0.summary: Unlinks a node from a doubly-linked list, then conditionally calls cleanup handler and frees the node. Generic resource cleanup cascading through list removal, custom cleanup, and deallocation.

0x00553a20.name: FloatToIntConversionChain
0x00553a20.label: FloatToIntConversionChain
0x00553a20.summary: Converts float array values to integers via CRTFtol, then dispatches to sub_553AA0. Has an alternate path (sub_55C860) when flag 0x40000 is set on this[6]. Part of geometry/transform processing.

0x00553aa0.name: sub_553AA0
0x00553aa0.label: LinePolygonRasterizer
0x00553aa0.summary: Bresenham-style line/polygon rasterizer. Selects pixel format conversion and fill routines (16-bit or 32-bit) based on object config, then dispatches to horizontal span, vertical span, or diagonal line drawing functions.

0x00553e10.name: sub_553E10
0x00553e10.label: StateObjectInitializer
0x00553e10.summary: Initializes an object's state fields with default values and synchronizes them to the global GameDeviceObject via virtual dispatch. Sets fields 1-19 with values 0, 1, or 2, notifying the device when changed.

0x00553fc0.name: sub_553FC0
0x00553fc0.label: StateMachineTransitionSetter
0x00553fc0.summary: Dispatches a state transition (a2 from 0-12) by setting mode fields (this[1], this[2], this[3]) to values per case, notifying GameDeviceObject via vtable+252. Skips if a2 == this[9] (already in that state) or a2 == -1.

0x00554260.name: EnumToFieldOffsetSetter
0x00554260.label: EnumToFieldOffsetSetter
0x00554260.summary: Maps an enum value (a2, range 1-14) to a specific field offset within `this` and conditionally sets it to a3 if different. Returns 1 if field was changed, 0 if skipped or invalid enum.

0x005542f0.name: sub_5542F0
0x005542f0.label: SecondaryStateMachineTransitionSetter
0x005542f0.summary: Second state machine transition handler setting fields at offsets 0x18, 0x1C, 0x20 (this[6-8]). Dispatches a2 (0-4) to set mode sub-fields with GameDeviceObject notification via vtable+252.

0x005544c0.name: GameStateSettingViaVirtualDispatch
0x005544c0.label: GameStateSettingViaVirtualDispatch
0x005544c0.summary: Sets game state parameter 13 on GameDeviceObject via vtable+252 with value mapped from a2 (0→1, 1→3, 2→2). Records a2 in this[14] and skips if a2 == this[14] or a2 == -1.

0x00554510.name: EnumToIDMappingWithVTableNotify
0x00554510.label: EnumToIDMappingWithVTableNotify
0x00554510.summary: Maps enum a2 (0,1,2) to state parameter 14 values (1,3,2) and dispatches to GameDeviceObject via vtable+252. Records a2 in this[15]; skips if unchanged or a2==-1.

0x00554560.name: sub_554560
0x00554560.label: State18ConditionalSetter
0x00554560.summary: Sets GameDeviceObject state 18 via vtable+252, with value depending on a2 and the byte_8B8C48 sound routing flag. For a2=1, uses flag bit to choose value 2 vs 1. For a2=0, sets 0. Stores result in this[13].

0x005545e0.name: SetterWithNotification
0x005545e0.label: SetterWithNotification
0x005545e0.summary: Sets GameDeviceObject state 11 to a2 value directly via vtable+252, then stores a2 in this[11]. Skips if a2 == this[11] or a2 == -1.

0x00554610.name: StateParameterSetterWithVirtualDeviceNotify
0x00554610.label: StateParameterSetterWithVirtualDeviceNotify
0x00554610.summary: Sets a parameter on GameDeviceObject via vtable+244. If a2 is non-null, reads value from a2+84+20 as the parameter; if null, sends 0. Stores a2 in this[12].

0x00554660.name: FloatStateSetterWithChangeNotification
0x00554660.label: FloatStateSetterWithChangeNotification
0x00554660.summary: Sets float field this[16] to a2 and notifies GameDeviceObject via vtable+252 with state 19 if the value changed. Floats compared by value.

0x005546a0.name: MultiFieldSetterDispatchingTo7SubSetters
0x005546a0.label: MultiFieldSetterDispatchingTo7SubSetters
0x005546a0.summary: Orchestrator that sets this[0]=a3 then dispatches to 7 sub-setters using values from a2 array indices 8-14. Coordinates state machine transitions and GameDeviceObject notifications.

0x00554700.name: PropertyValueSetterWithRefreshOnChange
0x00554700.label: PropertyValueSetterWithRefreshOnChange
0x00554700.summary: Updates property values via virtual dispatch on a device object. If a2 is non-null, reads a2[8] and a2[1] and updates this[1254]/this[1255] with change notification (vtable+332/304). If null, resets to 0.

0x00554790.name: sub_554790
0x00554790.label: BitfieldPropertyUpdater
0x00554790.summary: Compares a2 bitmask against current state this[1117], builds change list of property IDs and values for each changed bit, dispatches all changes to device object via vtable+200. Handles resolution/format mode flags with sub-field updates.

0x00554b20.name: ResourceFactoryViaVTableDispatch
0x00554b20.label: ResourceFactoryViaVTableDispatch
0x00554b20.summary: Creates or configures a resource via virtual dispatch on device object. Extracts parameters via sub_5424E0, conditionally clips render region, then dispatches to vtable+144 with format/mode selected by a2 byte flags.

0x00554be0.name: ModeStateSetterThroughVtable
0x00554be0.label: ModeStateSetterThroughVtable
0x00554be0.summary: Sets mode property 14 on device object via vtable+200. Maps a2 boolean (0/1) to value (0/1) and stores in this[1256]. Updates *this with dispatch result.

0x00554d70.name: UICleanupIterator
0x00554d70.label: UICleanupIterator
0x00554d70.summary: Iterates UI resource slot array, releasing each via virtual dispatch and resetting state via StateParameterSetter. Also releases and clears a shared resource pointer (v2[5]) and resets its flags/float fields.

0x00554e10.name: D3DResourceListCleanup
0x00554e10.label: D3DResourceListCleanup
0x00554e10.summary: Two-phase cleanup: first resets device parameters for all slots via StateParameterSetter, then traverses a linked list of resource groups calling UICleanupIterator on each non-protected item (those without flag 0x80000).

0x00554e90.name: sub_554E90
0x00554e90.label: TextureResourceCreator
0x00554e90.summary: Creates a texture resource via virtual dispatch. Checks if already initialized (returns -2 if so). Maps format enum (9-13) to DXT FourCC codes (DTX1-DTX5) for compressed textures, or delegates to sub_55C650 for uncompressed. Dispatches to device vtable+80 for final creation.

0x00554f80.name: sub_554F80
0x00554f80.label: ResourceAcquisitionWithReuse
0x00554f80.summary: Acquires a texture resource. Creates via sub_554E90; if resource already exists (-1), searches linked list for matching resource to reuse. Falls back to D3DResourceListCleanup + retry if no match. After acquisition, dispatches to vtable+116 for final setup.

0x005550a0.name: VTableGetterWrapper
0x005550a0.label: VTableGetterWrapper
0x005550a0.summary: Calls device object vtable+136 method and stores result in *this. Thin wrapper returning a value obtained from the device.

0x005550c0.name: VTableDispatchGetter
0x005550c0.label: VTableMethodCallAndStoreResult
0x005550c0.summary: Retrieves a sub-object pointer from `this+0x1100`, calls a vtable method at offset 0x8C on it, stores the returned integer at `*this` (offset 0x0). Used as a generic getter dispatch via interface vtable.

0x005550e0.name: sub_5550E0
0x005550e0.label: Display Mode Render Dispatcher
0x005550e0.summary: Per-frame render-state dispatcher for multi-mode display (replay, live TV, etc.): iterates over 4 display slots, processes element grids with per-element sprite/camera/sound updates, handles state transitions via vtable dispatch to the render context, computes color blend values, and manages session-event logging.

0x00555e50.name: sub_555E50
0x00555e50.label: D3DDeviceResetAndRestoreResources
0x00555e50.summary: Handles Direct3D device reset after device loss. Checks device state via vtable calls, resets display mode, recreates swap chains and render targets, restores device states. Part of D3D graphics display management.

0x00556040.name: GraphicsDisplayStateSyncWithVehicle
0x00556040.label: SyncVehicleDashboardDisplayState
0x00556040.summary: Synchronizes vehicle dashboard/HUD display parameters from vehicle state struct to D3D device render states. Caches values to avoid redundant D3D calls. Part of graphics display system for in-car HUD rendering.

0x00556260.name: sub_556260
0x00556260.label: HighResolutionTimerInit
0x00556260.summary: Initializes high-resolution timer structure with either QueryPerformanceCounter (mode 1) or RDTSC (mode 2) backend. Stores frequency reciprocal (2^32 / freq) for fast tick-to-time conversion. Called from multiple engine initialization paths.

0x00556330.name: TimerAccumulateViaQueryPerformanceCounter
0x00556330.label: AccumulateElapsedTimerTick
0x00556330.summary: Computes elapsed timer ticks since last query (QPC or RDTSC) and adds them to running accumulator at offsets 0x28/0x2C. Clears the previous-timestamp fields (0x30/0x34) after accumulation. Part of high-resolution timer system.

0x005563e0.name: TimerStartViaQueryPerformanceCounter
0x005563e0.label: TimerStartCapture
0x005563e0.summary: Records a fresh timestamp into the timer's previous-query fields (offset 0x30/0x34) for subsequent delta computation. Only writes if timer is initialized and both timestamp fields are currently zero (no pending measurement). Part of high-resolution timer system.

0x00556440.name: HighResolutionTimerReset
0x00556440.label: TimerResetAndClearAccumulators
0x00556440.summary: Queries a fresh timestamp (QPC or RDTSC), stores it at offsets 0x18/0x1C, and clears all accumulator fields (0x10/0x14, 0x28/0x2C, 0x30/0x34) to zero. Copies the new timestamp to offset 0x20/0x24 as snapshot. Called from multiple initialization and state-update paths to reset timer state.

0x005564b0.name: QueryPerformanceCounterWrapperWithModeDispatch
0x005564b0.label: TimerQueryDispatcher
0x005564b0.summary: Dispatches timestamp query to either QueryPerformanceCounter (mode bit 0) or RDTSC (mode bit 1) based on timer mode flags at offset 0x48. Stores HighPart/LowPart into caller-provided output pointers. Part of high-resolution timer abstraction layer.

0x00556510.name: PerformanceCounterTimerWithScaling
0x00556510.label: TimerGetElapsedTimeSeconds
0x00556510.summary: Computes elapsed time in seconds since last call. Queries current timestamp via TimerQueryDispatcher, computes delta from previous timestamp (offset 0x20/0x24), stores new timestamp, and returns `delta / frequency` using the reciprocal conversion factor at offset 0x8. Part of high-resolution timer system.

0x005565b0.name: HighPrecisionTimerCounterArithmetic
0x005565b0.label: TimerQueryAdjustedElapsedTime
0x005565b0.summary: Computes elapsed time from a reference timestamp (offset 0x18/0x1C), subtracts an accumulated delta (offset 0x28/0x2C), and adds a base accumulated time (offset 0x10). Does not modify any stored fields. Part of high-resolution timer adjustment system.

0x00556650.name: HighResolutionTimerDeltaCalculation
0x00556650.label: TimerQueryDeltaSinceReset
0x00556650.summary: Computes elapsed time in seconds from the reference timestamp at offset 0x18/0x1C to the current time. Calls TimerQueryDispatcher for current timestamp, subtracts stored reference, and converts ticks to time using frequency and reciprocal. Does not update any stored fields. Part of high-resolution timer system.

0x00556730.name: sub_556730
0x00556730.label: AudioChannelGetTimerElapsed
0x00556730.summary: Returns elapsed time from an audio channel's high-resolution timer. Bounds-checks channel index against global audio channel count. Part of audio system timing.

0x00556900.name: AddFloatToAnimationChannels
0x00556900.label: AnimChannelAddFloatToFlagged
0x00556900.summary: Iterates a linked list of animation channel nodes starting from `this+0x110 + 0x28`. For each channel whose flags at offset 0x18 have bit 0x400 set, adds a float parameter to the accumulator at offset 0x38. Part of animation system.

0x00556930.name: RecursiveStateTraversalWithFlagCheck
0x00556930.label: SceneNodeVisibilityCulledTraverse
0x00556930.summary: Traverses a scene graph sibling-linked list rooted at `this`. For each node, checks a visibility mask against the global render visibility mask; if visible, dispatches animation and optionally recurses into children. Part of scene graph render/animation traversal.

0x00556980.name: AnimationDispatchWithSkipFlag
0x00556980.label: AnimationChannelDispatchWithFlagFilter
0x00556980.summary: Iterates a linked list of animation nodes from `this+0x204`. Calls sub_54B570 for setup; if skip flag at this+0x3C bit 4 is clear, processes each node: optionally clears flag bits (0x20000028) based on sub_54B570 result, then dispatches to SceneNodeStateUpdateWithTransform or sub_556B10 depending on node property at offset 0x13C. Part of animation/scene update system.

0x005569f0.name: SceneNodeStateUpdateWithTransform
0x005569f0.label: SceneNodeFullUpdateWithWorldTransform
0x005569f0.summary: Performs full scene node state update including world-matrix transform, collision detection, bounding-box computation, bone transform copies, and optional deferred rendering setup. Called for animation nodes that have a transform property. Part of scene graph animation/rendering update system.

0x00556b10.name: sub_556B10
0x00556b10.label: SceneNodeUpdateWithoutWorldTransform
0x00556b10.summary: Performs scene node state update without setting a full world transform. Branches on node type flag (bit 0x10 at this+0x3C): transform path uses collision at offset 0x232 and AABB classification; non-transform path uses collision at offset 0x220 and AABB at offset 0x28. Handles bone transform copies, visibility classification, and deferred rendering setup. Part of scene graph animation/rendering update system.

0x00556cd0.name: D3DMarkDirty
0x00556cd0.label: MarkD3DBuffersDirty
0x00556cd0.summary: Marks D3D resources as dirty for re-upload. Checks flags at offset 0x44/0x4C for unconditional or conditional dirty marking, then iterates a linked list at offset 0x204 to set dirty bit 0x400 on each element and call sub_55D720. Part of D3D resource update system.

0x00556e70.name: sub_556E70
0x00556e70.label: SceneMultilevelCullAndUpdateDispatch
0x00556e70.summary: Main scene graph culling and update dispatcher. Processes visibility through spatial tree queries, frustum tests, and recursive state traversal. Handles physics (wheel forces), camera projection, and optional extra render passes. Can recurse for sub-scenes. Part of scene management / rendering system.

0x005570c0.name: NestedLinkedListTraversalWithDirtyMark
0x005570c0.label: NestedSceneNodeDirtyMarkTraversal
0x005570c0.summary: Iterates two levels of linked lists rooted at `this+0x100` and `this+0x108`, calling D3DMarkDirty on each node. First traverses parent nodes with nested child lists (at offset 0xEC), then a flat sibling list. Used to mark scene graph resources as dirty for D3D re-upload.

0x00557120.name: sub_557120
0x00557120.label: RenderFrameUpdate
0x00557120.summary: Per-frame rendering update: clears render flags, traverses sub-node array and render node linked list, updates audio nodes, animation time, and dispatches graphics vtable calls.

0x00557240.name: sub_557240
0x00557240.label: VertexBufferResourceInit
0x00557240.summary: Initialize vertex buffer resource struct: zero-fill entire struct, init 8 sub-struct slots with default values, then zero 3 trailing state fields.

0x00557280.name: CleanupFunction
0x00557280.label: VertexBufferSubResourceCleanup
0x00557280.summary: Free vertex buffer sub-resource pointer at offset 0x20C if non-null, zero the field, then call stub.

0x005572b0.name: sub_5572B0
0x005572b0.label: ClearSubResourceFlags
0x005572b0.summary: Zero flag field at offset 520 within four arrays of sub-resource structures (stride 528 bytes), guarded by element counts. Called during render cleanup.

0x005574b0.name: sub_5574B0
0x005574b0.label: ResourceNodeCleanup
0x005574b0.summary: Cleanup/free function for a resource node: frees sub-resource array entries (with audio and vtable cleanup), frees multiple standalone pointer allocations, and dispatches texture flag cleanup. Called from doubly-linked list node removal.

0x005575f0.name: FlagCheckWithConditionalPathDispatch
0x005575f0.label: FlagGuardedInitDispatch
0x005575f0.summary: Check object flags: if bit 0x400 is set, return immediately (already initialized). Otherwise dispatch to one of two init paths based on bit 0x8, then set bit 0x400 on success.

0x00557670.name: sub_557670
0x00557670.label: Particle System Initializer and Vertex Buffer Setup
0x00557670.summary: Initializes a particle/particle-rendering system from source data: allocates particle vertex arrays, copies vertex attribute data (position, color, texcoords), sets up index buffers, and registers with the audio/rendering subsystems. Part of the particle effects / rendering initialization pipeline.

0x00557ce0.name: sub_557CE0
0x00557ce0.label: UI Render Element Constructor
0x00557ce0.summary: Constructs a render-element (sprite/quad display list) from a configuration descriptor: allocates vertex/index buffers, initializes per-element color/UV structs with float constants, and configures rendering mode (2D vs 3D, indexed vs non-indexed) based on flag bits from the source config.

0x00558310.name: sub_558310
0x00558310.label: 3D Mesh Index Buffer Builder
0x00558310.summary: Builds triangle-strip index buffers for a 3D mesh object: allocates vertex/index memory, sets up rendering state blocks, and generates index patterns for two LOD/quality levels (controlled by bit 0 vs bit 1 of this+0x20).

0x00558990.name: ResourceTeardownWithStateArrayReset
0x00558990.label: RenderResourceTeardown
0x00558990.summary: Teardown render resources: free audio sub-resources (virtual release + drain + free), clear flag bit 8, then reset state struct array (clear bit 6 and two fields per element), zero counters.

0x00558a30.name: sub_558A30
0x00558a30.label: TextureSlotAllocator
0x00558a30.summary: Allocates a texture slot from a pool: returns existing slot from free chain if available, or allocates new texture memory and links slot into the active list.

0x00558b30.name: sub_558B30
0x00558b30.label: TextureSlotDeallocate
0x00558b30.summary: Remove a texture/render slot from allocation pool by index: validates bounds and in-use flag, then either unlinks from doubly-linked list or updates pointer array with data copy, clears in-use bit, decrements count.

0x00558c60.name: TextureLayerFlagSet
0x00558c60.label: TextureLayerDirtyFlagSetter
0x00558c60.summary: Sets the 0x1000 dirty/update flag on a texture layer entry at given index (bounds-checked), and clears a related dirty tracking flag on the parent.

0x00558cb0.name: ArrayElementFlagSetWithBoundsCheck
0x00558cb0.label: ArrayElementFlagSetter
0x00558cb0.summary: Sets the 0x4000 flag on an array element at given index (bounds-checked), calling a multi-field update helper.

0x00558cf0.name: BoundsCheckedArrayWrite
0x00558cf0.label: BoundsCheckedElementFieldWrite
0x00558cf0.summary: Writes a value to offset 0xC of an array element at given index with bounds checking against the array element count.

0x00558d10.name: TextureAllocationWithFormatSizeFlags
0x00558d10.label: TextureBufferAllocation
0x00558d10.summary: Allocates a texture buffer via BufferLockAllocate, selecting entry size (96 or 32 bytes) based on format flag bit 7, and stores the allocated handle.

0x00558d80.name: TextureSurfaceUnlockRelease
0x00558d80.label: TextureSurfaceUnlockReleaseByIndex
0x00558d80.summary: Unlock/release a texture surface by index: if bit 8 (0x100) flag is set, clear it, release the associated audio resource via ArithmeticComparison_0f90, and zero the tracking field.

0x00558dc0.name: PixelAttributeWriteToTexture
0x00558dc0.label: PixelAttributeWriteToTexture
0x00558dc0.summary: Write pixel attribute value into texture buffer at position computed from slot index (a2) and offset (a3), guarded by mode==1 and flag bit 31 set.

0x00558e10.name: PixelWriteToTextureBuffer
0x00558e10.label: PixelDataTextureWriter
0x00558e10.summary: Writes pixel/vertex data (4 values: colour/attribute) into a texture buffer at a computed offset, gated on format type and overflow flag. Allocates texture buffer if needed.

0x00558e70.name: sub_558E70
0x00558e70.label: Geometry Rendering With Render-To-Texture Surfaces
0x00558e70.summary: Renders 3D geometry meshes onto textured surfaces: computes Euler rotation matrices from object transforms, iterates a linked list of renderable mesh objects, processes per-vertex position and color data, manages render-to-texture surface lock/unlock cycles, and dispatches draw calls through the D3D device wrapper.

0x00559200.name: sub_559200
0x00559200.label: ListNodeAllocateAndAppend
0x00559200.summary: Allocate a new list node (108 bytes), zero-init it, validate via FlagConditionalBranchDispatch, then append to tail of singly-linked list (with back-pointer). Increment count and return new node via output pointer.

0x005592b0.name: DoublyLinkedListNodeRemovalByPointer
0x005592b0.label: DoublyLinkedListNodeRemovalByPointer
0x005592b0.summary: Remove a specific node from doubly-linked list by pointer comparison. Unlink target (update prev->next and next->prev), call ResourceNodeCleanup, free node, update head and decrement count.

0x00559330.name: SmallStructInitWithParentCall
0x00559330.label: ListNodeZeroInit

0x00559350.name: StringCopyFieldInit

0x005593b0.name: StructZeroInit_93b0
0x005593b0.label: SmallStructZeroInit3Fields

0x005593c6.name: SetPhysicsStateFieldToZero

0x005593c6.summary: Zero the dword at offset 0x1C. Parameters a2 and a3 are unused.

0x005593d0.name: sub_5593D0
0x005593d0.label: FreeThreeLinkedLists
0x005593d0.summary: Free three singly-linked lists rooted at offsets 0, 4, 8. Each node has next pointer at offset 0x1C. Traverse each list, free every node via stub + FreeWrapper, then null the head.

0x005594b0.name: sub_5594B0
0x005594b0.label: ActorNodeAllocateAndAppend
0x005594b0.summary: Allocate and append a new actor node to singly-linked list. Check for duplicate name first via UTF16StringSearchInLinkedList; if found, format error and return -1. Otherwise allocate (32 bytes), init, append to tail via offset 0x1C link field, fill with StringCopyFieldInit.

0x00559570.name: sub_559570
0x00559570.label: ResponseNodeAllocateAndAppend
0x00559570.summary: Allocate and append a new response node to singly-linked list rooted at this+4. Check for duplicate via BinaryTreeSearch first; if found, format error "Response %s already exists" and return -1. Otherwise allocate (32 bytes), init, append at tail via offset 0x1C link field, fill via StringCopyFieldInit.

0x00559630.name: LinkedListNodeSearchAllocation
0x00559630.label: LinkedListNodeSearchAllocation
0x00559630.summary: Search singly-linked list for node matching tuple keys (a2, a3). If found, return node pointer. If not found, allocate new node (32 bytes), init, append at tail, set keys via StructFieldInit_9390.

0x005596e0.name: FunctionPointerDispatchViaLinkedTraversal
0x005596e0.label: FunctionPointerDispatchViaLinkedTraversal
0x005596e0.summary: Walk linked list of function dispatch entries, compare selector field (+0x14) against target (+0x220), and call the matching handler via function pointer at +0x20. Also check direct handler slot on context object as fallback.

0x00559760.name: UTF16StringSearchInLinkedList
0x00559760.label: StringNodeListSearch
0x00559760.summary: Walk linked list of string nodes, compare each node's string with target via strcmp, return matching node pointer or 0 if not found.

0x005597c0.name: BinaryTreeSearch
0x005597c0.label: LinkedListStringSearch
0x005597c0.summary: Walk linked list rooted at this+4, compare each node's string with target via strcmp, return matching node pointer or 0 if not found.

0x00559820.name: sub_559820
0x00559820.label: ResourceLookupAndBind
0x00559820.summary: Look up actor/resource by name in linked list via UTF16StringSearchInLinkedList. If found, store node pointer at this+0x220 and value a3 at this+0x21C. If not found or handle invalid, log error and return -1.

0x005598b0.name: sub_5598B0
0x005598b0.label: ActorResponseLinkAllocate
0x005598b0.summary: Look up actor by name (UTF16StringSearchInLinkedList) and response by name (BinaryTreeSearch). Create/retrieve mapping via LinkedListNodeSearchAllocation, then append 8-byte mapping list node to list at a1+0x224.

0x00559a70.name: LineReaderFromBuffer
0x00559a70.label: ReadLineFromInputBuffer
0x00559a70.summary: Reads one line from a buffer into internal line buffer, copying bytes until newline (0x0A) or buffer exhaustion. Part of scene file line-by-line reader system.

0x00559ad0.name: sub_559AD0
0x00559ad0.label: ConfigLineTokenizer
0x00559ad0.summary: Parses a single key=value config line from a buffer. Trims leading/trailing whitespace, lowercases the key side, strips quotes from values, and stores pointer to '=' separator. Returns 0 on success, 1 if line is blank/comment, 2 on format error.

0x00559d10.name: StringTableLookup_9d10
0x00559d10.label: StringSplitLookupByPrefix
0x00559d10.summary: Copies a string from offset 0xC to 0x18C, splits it by delimiter ".", and checks if the result matches a given key. Part of scene file property lookup system.

0x00559d80.name: sub_559D80
0x00559d80.label: HotChainStringLookup
0x00559d80.summary: Copies string from offset 0xC to 0x18C, then walks a chain of ".HOT"-delimited tokens looking for a match against key a2. Part of scene file property lookup with extension chaining.

0x00559e20.name: sub_559E20
0x00559e20.label: SceneLinePropertyLookup
0x00559e20.summary: Dispatches line parsing: counts '=' characters in the line buffer; if exactly 1, uses StringTableLookup_9d10, otherwise uses sub_559D80. Copies result to offset 0x18C area and splits by delimiter string. Part of scene file property reader.

0x00559f00.name: sub_559F00
0x00559f00.label: ParseUpTo4IntArgsFromLookup
0x00559f00.summary: Calls sub_559D80 to look up a property, then parses up to 4 integer values from the result using CallWrapperWith0 (atoi). Stores parsed values into optional output pointers. Part of scene file numeric property parser.

0x0055a060.name: sub_55A060
0x0055a060.label: SceneViewParser
0x0055a060.summary: Parses a "View" element from a scene file token stream, extracting attributes (color, clipplanes, orient, dir, size, center, clear, bgmap, separatesurfac) and configuring a view object. Handles orientation via rotation matrices and supports recursive nested view parsing.

0x0055a500.name: sub_55A500
0x0055a500.label: LightScenePropertyParser
0x0055a500.summary: Reads lines from a scene file buffer via LineReaderFromBuffer, parsing light properties: Type (Directional/StaticOmni/MovingOmni), Color (RGB), Direction, Range, Intensity, and Active flag. Sets UI properties via sub-setters. Part of scene file light definition loader.

0x0055a790.name: sub_55A790
0x0055a790.label: SceneInstanceLinkParser
0x0055a790.summary: Allocates a 264-byte instance node struct, reads lines from scene file buffer parsing Instance, Light, Link, and Adjacent properties into linked lists. Part of scene file instance/linkage loader.

0x0055a910.name: SceneNode
0x0055a910.label: SceneNodeParser
0x0055a910.summary: Parses a scene file node definition from a line buffer, creating a 572-byte scene graph node and populating its properties (mesh file, animations, visibility groups, shadow/render flags, LOD distances, collision targets, view orientation) by matching keyword-value pairs from the scene description. Appends the constructed node into the scene graph via linked list operations. Part of the scene file loading/parsing system.

0x0055b200.name: SceneFileTopLevelParser
0x0055b200.label: scene MAS file top-level parser (ambient, fog, view, instance, light, group directives)
0x0055b200.summary: Parses the top-level directives of a scene definition file (MAS format): includefile, searchpath, groupmethod, fontfile, masfile, ambientcolor, fogmode/fogcolor/fogin/fogout/fogdensity, and dispatches view/group/instance/light sub-blocks to specialized parsers. Populates scene-state struct fields with parsed values.

0x0055b6b0.name: sub_55B6B0
0x0055b6b0.label: SceneFileLoadWithPathSearch
0x0055b6b0.summary: Loads and parses a scene file by name, searching registered audio entry paths and a linked list of resource locations. Opens file with "rb" mode, calls SceneFileTopLevelParser. Part of scene file loading system.

0x0055b8c0.name: sub_55B8C0
0x0055b8c0.label: MeshInstanceCounterInSceneFile
0x0055b8c0.summary: Counts "MeshFile" entries within "Instance" blocks in a scene file. Opens the file, reads lines, and counts mesh file references. Part of scene file resource inventory system.

0x0055bb20.name: F_6FieldStructSetter
0x0055bb20.label: SixFieldStructWrite
0x0055bb20.summary: Writes 6 integer/pointer parameters into consecutive DWORD fields (offsets 0x4 through 0x18) of a struct. Returns 0. Generic struct field setter for linked list nodes.

0x0055bb50.name: DualFieldSetToSameValue
0x0055bb50.label: ZeroInitAndSetDualField
0x0055bb50.summary: Calls GlobalZeroInit_c2a0 to zero the struct, then sets fields at offsets 0x104 and 0x108 to the same value a2. Returns pointer to the struct. Part of display mode / sound manager node initialization.

0x0055bba0.name: LinkedListFreeWithTraversalAndNulling
0x0055bba0.label: LinkedListFreeTraverseAndNullHead
0x0055bba0.summary: Traverses a singly-linked list starting at this[72], freeing each node via FreeWrapper_7bcf, then sets the head pointer to null. Nodes use offset 0x20 (field [8]) as next pointer. Part of resource cleanup system.

0x0055bc00.name: sub_55BC00
0x0055bc00.label: ListNodeAllocOrDuplicateCheck
0x0055bc00.summary: Searches a linked list (head at this[72]) for a node matching fields (a2, a3, a4, a5). If found, returns -3 (duplicate). Otherwise allocates a 36-byte node via SmallStructInit_baf0 and appends it, setting 6 fields via F_6FieldStructSetter. Part of linked list node management.

0x0055bd20.name: sub_55BD20
0x0055bd20.label: AudioConfigNodeLookupAndApply
0x0055bd20.summary: Walks linked list from this[72] to find a node matching audio config parameters (width, height, format, loop flag), then sets global screen/audio variables and calls audio subsystem setup. Part of audio configuration system.

0x0055bde0.name: sub_55BDE0
0x0055bde0.label: LinkedListNodeGetByIndex
0x0055bde0.summary: Walks the linked list (head at this[72]) and returns the node pointer at index a2. Each node uses offset 0x20 (field [8]) as next pointer. If index out of range or chain broken, returns current node or 0. Part of linked list accessor utilities.

0x0055be20.name: sub_55BE20
0x0055be20.label: StringAndTwoFieldReader
0x0055be20.summary: Copies a null-terminated string from this+4 into output buffer a2 (if non-null), and writes two DWORD fields (this[68], this[69]) into output pointers a3 and a4. Part of display mode / audio config data accessor.

0x0055be80.name: sub_55BE80
0x0055be80.label: DisplayModeArrayAllocFromSoundManager
0x0055be80.summary: Allocates an array of 292-byte display mode structs from sound manager entries. Iterates sound manager entries via FieldAccessor, creates per-entry struct with DualFieldSetToSameValue, initializes via PartialStructZeroInit, and calls DisplayModeEnumeratorWrapper. Part of display mode / audio initialization system.

0x0055bf70.name: ArrayOfPointersCleanupWithFreeLoop
0x0055bf70.label: PointerArrayFreeWithLinkedListCleanup
0x0055bf70.summary: Iterates an array of pointers (this[2] onward), calling LinkedListFreeWithTraversalAndNulling on each, then freeing the pointer itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf and nulling the slot. Part of global resource cleanup system.

0x0055c070.name: sub_55C070
0x0055c070.label: RenderResourcePropertyBinder
0x0055c070.summary: Sets up render properties from a resource descriptor: allocates vertex buffers, copies vertex data via BufferLockAllocate, and configures rendering state via vtable calls. Part of render resource initialization.

0x0055c2a0.name: sub_55C2A0
0x0055c2a0.label: DoublyLinkedListTailAppend
0x0055c2a0.summary: Appends a node to the tail of a doubly-linked list. Walks to end of list using next pointers at offset 0x20 (field [8]), then links new node. If list empty, sets new node as head at this[1350]. Part of resource/linked list management.

0x0055c2e0.name: DoublyLinkedListNodeUnlinkByMatch
0x0055c2e0.label: DoublyLinkedListUnlinkByPointer
0x0055c2e0.summary: Finds a node by pointer match (a2) in a doubly-linked list (head at this[1350]) and unlinks it by updating prev/next pointers. If the removed node is head, advances head to next. Part of resource/linked list cleanup system.

0x0055c330.name: sub_55C330
0x0055c330.label: DirectXDisplayModeGetCurrent
0x0055c330.summary: Calls DirectX device method to get current display mode parameters (width, height, format, refresh rate). Returns mode data via output pointers and optionally sets display mode via sub_55C450. Part of DirectX display configuration.

0x0055c650.name: sub_55C650
0x0055c650.label: D3DFormatToFourCCLookup
0x0055c650.summary: Maps (bit depth, format) pairs to FourCC codes (41, 21, 23, 25, 20, 827611204, 844388420, 861165636, 877942852, 894720068). Handles formats 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 and bit depths 0, 32, 24, 16, 8. Part of DirectX format translation system.

0x0055c7b0.name: sub_55C7B0
0x0055c7b0.label: DisplayModeGetWithContext
0x0055c7b0.summary: Wraps sub_55C450 with this[1274] as the first parameter, passing current instance pointer as output context. Returns the modified v2 pointer. Part of display mode / DirectX configuration.

0x0055c7d0.name: InputStateQueryWrapper
0x0055c7d0.label: Wraps input-state query via sub_55C450
0x0055c7d0.summary: Calls sub_55C450 with a field at offset 0x13EC (an input-state handle), constant 0, and the this pointer; returns this. Acts as thin wrapper around an input-state query.

0x0055c7f0.name: KeyEventDispatchToSubHandlers
0x0055c7f0.label: Dispatches key events to input-state sub-handlers
0x0055c7f0.summary: Filters key events by message type (0x200000) and key code; routes space key (32) to InputStateQueryWrapper and shift key (16) to sub_55C7B0. Part of input/UI event processing system.

0x0055c860.name: sub_55C860
0x0055c860.label: BufferAllocateUpdateProperties
0x0055c860.summary: Allocates a 64-byte buffer, copies caller data (a3, a4, a5) into it, then invokes multiple vtable methods to update UI properties. Initializes a state flag (0x13C4) to 1 if not already set. Part of UI property-update system.

0x0055ca40.name: EnumToVTableCallMapper
0x0055ca40.label: Maps enum action ID to vtable call with parameter
0x0055ca40.summary: Maps an action enum (a2: 1, 2, or 4) to a vtable call at entry 37 (offset 0x94) with a corresponding integer parameter (256, 2, or 3). Result stored in this[0]. Part of action/command dispatch system.

0x0055ca90.name: sub_55CA90
0x0055ca90.label: D3DRenderStateTextureSetup
0x0055ca90.summary: Sets up Direct3D render states for texture/surface binding: handles texture material loading from file or memory, manages surface lock/unlock, and applies transforms. Part of the 2D surface rendering pipeline.

0x0055cc20.name: sub_55CC20
0x0055cc20.label: ConfigUpdateFromSourceStruct
0x0055cc20.summary: Reads configuration fields from source struct (a2), packs them into a local array, then calls vtable methods to apply the configuration. Conditionally sets a mode flag (0x13A4) to 2 or 3 based on a bit flag (0x10) in a2+128. Optionally performs chained thunk operations if field 0x13D4 is set. Part of camera/projection configuration system.

0x0055cdf0.name: TripleVtableQueryAndStore
0x0055cdf0.label: Three sequential vtable queries stored into struct fields
0x0055cdf0.summary: Makes three vtable calls to query property values: two via entry 38 (offset 0x98) with enum args 2 and 3, storing results at this+0x1458 and this+0x1498; one via entry 41 (offset 0xA4) storing at this+0x14D8. Part of UI property query/readback system.

0x0055ce50.name: SetUITextFieldsViaVtableCalls
0x0055ce50.label: Three sequential vtable property sets from stored fields
0x0055ce50.summary: Makes three vtable calls to set properties: two via entry 37 (offset 0x94) with enum args 2 and 3, reading values from this+0x1458 and this+0x1498; one via entry 40 (offset 0xA0) reading from this+0x14D8. Counterpart to TripleVtableQueryAndStore — writes previously queried values back.

0x0055cf50.name: sub_55CF50
0x0055cf50.label: IterativePropertyUpdateWithFlags
0x0055cf50.summary: Complex iterative UI property update: reads source struct (a3) fields and flags, builds bitmask at this+0x1170, iterates over indexed entries from source, sets sub-properties via MultiFieldSetterDispatchingTo7SubSetters, then applies final property through vtable entry 71 (offset 0x11C) with parameters split differently based on flag bit 0x10. Manages initialization flags 0x13C4 and 0x13CC.

0x0055d2a0.name: StringCopyWithFlagUnion
0x0055d2a0.label: String copy with flag union and scene state setup
0x0055d2a0.summary: ORs parameter flags into this+0x0, copies source string (a2) into this+0x58, and stores scene state setup result (via SceneStateSetup with SoundManager global) into this+0x4. Returns 0. Part of sound/scene property initialization.

0x0055d2e0.name: ClearByteFlagReturn0
0x0055d2e0.label: Clear byte flag and return 0
0x0055d2e0.summary: Clears byte at this+0x58 to 0 and returns 0. Minimal flag-reset helper.

0x0055d2f0.name: BitFlagSetterWithDXUpdate
0x0055d2f0.label: Bit-7 flag set/clear with DirectX texture update
0x0055d2f0.summary: Sets or clears bit 7 (0x80) of this+0x0 based on boolean parameter a2, then calls DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup with SoundManager, this pointer, field at +0x4, and constant 1. Part of DirectX vertex/texture management.

0x0055d320.name: sub_55D320
0x0055d320.label: ByteColorToFloatWithDXUpdate
0x0055d320.summary: Converts byte RGB values (a3-a5, 0-255) to floats scaled by per-group factor (1/255), stores into one of three color groups selected by a2 (1/2/3), then calls DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup to update vertex buffer. Sets dirty flag 0x800 on UI root context. Part of UI color/alpha update pipeline.

0x0055d410.name: UIPropertyValueSetter
0x0055d410.label: AlphaScaleFactorSetterWithDXUpdate
0x0055d410.summary: Stores integer value a3 into one of three alpha/scale factor fields (offset 0x14/0x24/0x34) selected by a2 (1/2/3), then calls DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup to update vertex buffer and sets dirty flag 0x800 on UI root context. Companion to sub_55D320 which uses these scale factors for byte-to-float color conversion.

0x0055d460.name: sub_55D460
0x0055d460.label: NormalizeAndStoreVectorWithDXUpdate
0x0055d460.summary: Stores a 3-component vector (a2, a3, a4) as floats at offsets 0x44/0x48/0x4C, normalizes to unit length if non-zero, then calls DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup with mode 5 and sets dirty flag 0x800. Part of DirectX vertex buffer normal/vector update.

0x0055d4f0.name: SetUIPropertyGroupWithChainUpdate
0x0055d4f0.label: StoreThreeValuesWithDXUpdate
0x0055d4f0.summary: Stores three integer parameters a2, a3, a4 at offsets 0x38/0x3C/0x40, then calls DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup with mode 6 and sets dirty flag 0x800. Part of DirectX vertex buffer property update chain.

0x0055d530.name: StateFieldSetterWithGlobalDirtyFlag
0x0055d530.label: Set single state field with DX update
0x0055d530.summary: Stores value a2 at offset 0x50, then calls DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup with mode 7 and sets dirty flag 0x800. Part of DirectX vertex buffer state update chain.

0x0055d560.name: FieldGetterByIndex
0x0055d560.label: Read alpha/scale factor by group index
0x0055d560.summary: Reads one of three alpha/scale factor fields (offset 0x14/0x24/0x34) based on index a2 (1/2/3), writes to output pointer a3 if non-null. Getter counterpart to UIPropertyValueSetter_0055d410.

0x0055d590.name: TripleFieldGetter_d590
0x0055d590.label: Read vector components from struct
0x0055d590.summary: Reads three consecutive fields at offsets 0x44/0x48/0x4C (this[17/18/19]) and writes to output pointers a2, a3, a4 if non-null. Getter counterpart to sub_55D460 vector store.

0x0055d5c0.name: sub_55D5C0
0x0055d5c0.label: SceneRelativeDirectionVectorCompute
0x0055d5c0.summary: Computes a normalized direction vector from a scene node position (plus a2[9-11] offset) to a target found via context node list iteration, storing result at offsets 0x100/0x104/0x108. Sets dirty flag 0x40000 at this+0x14. Part of scene node direction/lighting calculation.

0x0055d720.name: sub_55D720
0x0055d720.label: RenderStateBufferAllocAndCopy
0x0055d720.summary: Render path selection: if SimpleGetter_14f0(SoundManager) returns 0 (complex render state), allocates vertex buffer and copies data with full color/strided copy, dispatching to sub_55E320/DA50/D900 based on this[0] flags. If SimpleGetter returns non-zero (simple state), allocates buffer and copies with small stride, sets flag 0x200, and optionally calls sub_55EBA0 based on sign bit at this+0xA0. Part of DirectX vertex buffer management.

0x0055d900.name: sub_55D900
0x0055d900.label: VertexColorPackWithMMX
0x0055d900.summary: Two-path vertex color processing: if bit 0x20 at this[1]+156 is set, copies color data directly from source to dest. Otherwise, computes lighting/transform through D3D device (vtable entries 24 and 20), multiplies alpha (this[1]+80) by 255.0, packs RGBA via MMX _m_packuswb, and writes packed color to all vertices. Part of rendering/vertex buffer fill.

0x0055da50.name: sub_55DA50
0x0055da50.label: 3D Mesh Vertex Processing With Per-Triangle Lighting
0x0055da50.summary: Processes 3D mesh vertices for rendering: transforms world-space positions to screen space, computes per-vertex diffuse and specular lighting using material properties and light direction, applies texture coordinates, and packs final RGBA color values into vertex buffer using MMX SIMD pack instructions.

0x0055e320.name: sub_55E320
0x0055e320.label: 3D Mesh Vertex Transform & Color Lighting Pipeline
0x0055e320.summary: Performs per-vertex 3D transformation, lighting, and color computation for a mesh. Reads vertex positions from scene data, applies world-to-screen transforms (frustum culling), computes specular lighting via lookup table, handles MMX-accelerated color packing (packuswb), and writes transformed vertices + lighting colors to output buffer.

0x0055eb30.name: sub_55EB30
0x0055eb30.label: MMXVertexColorBlend
0x0055eb30.summary: Performs MMX-based vertex color blending: for each vertex, reads source color (this[3]+24) and dest color (this[8]+24), unpacks to words, adds blend offset (qword_8B8E40), multiplies, shifts right 8, and packs back to byte. Clears MMX state via _m_empty(). Part of vertex buffer color blend pipeline.

0x0055eba0.name: sub_55EBA0
0x0055eba0.label: BillboardDirectionCompute
0x0055eba0.summary: For each vertex, computes a reflected direction vector using D3D device transforms: transforms source position, adds offset from a2[9-11], normalizes, computes reflection via half-vector formula, maps to [0,1] range, stores at vertex buffer offsets +40 and +44. Checks MMX flag at this[6]+20 to select stride (16 vs 12). Part of billboard/reflection shader setup.

0x0055ed10.name: sub_55ED10
0x0055ed10.label: SceneNodeListBuilder
0x0055ed10.summary: Traverses linked node list starting from this[74] (offset 0x128), collecting nodes whose byte at offset 0 matches pattern (byte & 0xA0 == 0x80). Stores found nodes (up to 8) into array at a3+272 with inverse-distance weight (1.0 / node[+80]). Skips if a3+20 bit 0x20 is set, and uses SceneNodePositionGetter if a2+60 bit 0x10 is not set. Part of scene node dependency/resource management.

0x0055ee20.name: sub_55EE20
0x0055ee20.label: MatrixTransformVertices
0x0055ee20.summary: Transforms an array of 3D position vectors (from this[3], 12-byte stride) through a 4x4 transformation matrix (a2), storing resulting 3D vectors (6-float stride) at this[15]. Updates global dword_5DC470 with vertex count. Performs standard matrix*vector multiplication for each vertex.

0x0055ef88.name: F_4x4MatrixMultiply_ef88
0x0055ef88.label: 4x4 matrix multiply (row-based)
0x0055ef88.summary: Multiplies two 4x4 float matrices (a1 * a2) and stores result in a3. Pure math utility.

0x0055f0d0.name: sub_55F0D0
0x0055f0d0.label: CPUDetectionAndBenchmark
0x0055f0d0.summary: Detects CPU vendor, model, and feature set via CPUID instruction, measures approximate clock speed using RDTSC timing, and queries system memory via GlobalMemoryStatus. Assigns a CPU performance tier (0–4) used for graphics/audio quality auto-configuration. Part of the render/UI system initialization.

0x0055fbe0.name: sub_55FBE0
0x0055fbe0.label: cube map struct zero-init + name set
0x0055fbe0.summary: Initializes a cube map texture struct: zeroes entire struct via helper, copies cube map filename string at base, then explicitly zeroes selected DWORD/byte fields.

0x0055fc40.name: sub_55FC40
0x0055fc40.label: cube map MAS file loader
0x0055fc40.summary: Loads a cube map MAS file: copies filename, opens file (with search in audio entry array fallback), validates header magic against known cube map names, reads header fields, allocates buffer, reads data. Returns 0 on success, negative on error.

0x0055fe30.name: DualFieldCleanupWithNullChecks
0x0055fe30.label: cube map struct cleanup (file + buffer)
0x0055fe30.summary: Cleans up a cube map struct: closes the open file handle (if non-null) and frees the allocated data buffer (if non-null). Both fields zeroed after release.

0x0055fe70.name: sub_55FE70
0x0055fe70.label: BitmapFileLoad
0x0055fe70.summary: Load bitmap resource from archive by filename. Reads bitmap data (raw or processed) from archive using file handle in struct, allocates buffers, calls ResourceLoadWithOutput on SoundManager, frees buffers.

0x00560050.name: sub_560050
0x00560050.label: RenderingBitmapFileLoad
0x00560050.summary: Load bitmap file into rendering composition system, gated by audio initialization flag. Reads bitmap data from archive using file handle, allocates buffers, passes them to RenderingCompositionSetup, frees buffers. Similar to sub_55FE70 but targets rendering instead of SoundManager resource load.

0x00560230.name: sub_560230
0x00560230.label: FilenameLookupAndSeek
0x00560230.summary: Validate filename exists in packed resource archive and seek to its data entry. Strips directory path from filename, normalizes string, scans 256-byte resource table entries for match. On success writes entry index to this[73] and seeks file offset.

0x00560340.name: sub_560340
0x00560340.label: RenderingResourceLoad
0x00560340.summary: Load three rendering resources (vertex buffer related) via vtable interface when feature flag at this[0x13D4] is set. Otherwise initialize globals to defaults (zero pointers, stride 324). Returns -1 on any resource load failure.

0x00560547.name: sub_560547
0x00560547.label: ImagePatternedCopy
0x00560547.summary: Copy/mix image data between two buffers using a run-length pattern array to control copy segments. Alternates copy direction per segment (via dword_5DD83C toggle). Uses stride values from source/destination structs.

0x0056068e.name: sub_56068E
0x0056068e.label: TextureDecodePixelKernel_A
0x0056068e.summary: Processes a 16-bit pixel buffer row-by-row using lookup tables and rotation operations — likely a texture decompression or color format conversion kernel. Uses MultiplyLUT and ClipTable indexed by nibble-extracted channel bits from a7 parameter.

0x005607c1.name: sub_5607C1
0x005607c1.label: TextureDecodePixelKernel_B
0x005607c1.summary: Variant of 16-bit pixel processing kernel with different bit extraction (6-bit channels) and rotation constants compared to sub_56068E. Uses MultiplyLUT, AlphaBlendSumTable, and MulLookupTable for pixel reconstruction.

0x005608f6.name: sub_5608F6
0x005608f6.label: ImageBlitTransparent16
0x005608f6.summary: Blit 16-bit pixel image with transparent-color support. When transparent color is 0xFFFF and width aligned to 8 bytes, uses 64-bit MMX copy; otherwise pixel-by-pixel copy skipping transparent color.

0x005609de.name: sub_5609DE
0x005609de.label: ImageBlitTransparent24
0x005609de.summary: Blit 24-bit RGB pixel image with transparent-color support. When transparent color is 0xFFFFFF, uses bulk qmemcpy per scanline; otherwise pixel-by-pixel copy (3 bytes per pixel) skipping transparent color.

0x00560b30.name: ConditionalFreeOfStructField
0x00560b30.label: ConditionalFreeField
0x00560b30.summary: Free memory pointer at this[107] (offset 0x1AC) if non-null, then zero the field. Returns the old pointer value.

0x00560b60.name: IntArrayAllocation
0x00560b60.label: IntArrayAllocate
0x00560b60.summary: Initialize struct with zero count and allocate integer array of size a2. Stores count=0 at this[0], pointer to allocated array at this[1].

0x00560ba0.name: ObjectInitWithParameterLinking
0x00560ba0.label: ObjectInitAndLink
0x00560ba0.summary: Initialize object with default values and link it to a2's child list at offset 560. Sets float default (0.2f), zeroes most fields, stores a3 parameter, sets state flag to 2.

0x00560c00.name: StateFlagSetterCleanup
0x00560c00.label: StateFlagSet2
0x00560c00.summary: Set state/flag field at this[9] to 2 and call empty stub. Called during 3D sound source destruction.

0x00560c10.name: sub_560C10
0x00560c10.label: Shadow-Map Cascade View Initializer
0x00560c10.summary: Initializes a shadow-map cascade view for directional light rendering: allocates and constructs a 444-byte shadow view object, sets projection/frustum from light direction, creates viewport from shadow-map resolution, and recursively initializes sibling/child views. Part of the shadow rendering system.

0x00560e50.name: MultiFieldObjectDestructorWithCleanupCalls
0x00560e50.label: SoundSubObjectDestructor
0x00560e50.summary: Destructor for 3D sound source sub-objects. Frees three allocated sub-objects at offsets 0xC, 0x1C, 0x20, calling cleanup stubs before each free. Part of 3D sound source teardown.

0x00560eb0.name: AppendNodeToDoublyLinkedListTail
0x00560eb0.label: DoublyLinkedListTailAppend
0x00560eb0.summary: Appends a node to the tail of a doubly linked list, updating prev/next pointers between old tail and new node, setting bit 2 in node flags.

0x00560f40.name: DoublyLinkedNodeRemovalGlobalListReInsert
0x00560f40.label: DoublyLinkedListNodeReinsertGlobal
0x00560f40.summary: Removes a node from its current doubly linked list, then re-inserts it at the tail of a global UI/context linked list (dword_8B8F28+348), clearing the node's active flag (bit 2).

0x00560fe0.name: sub_560FE0
0x00560fe0.label: WheelShadowCameraUpdate
0x00560fe0.summary: Recursively updates shadow-map camera projection for vehicle wheel nodes, computing frustum parameters from wheel positions and suspension state, and dispatching to transform/render pipelines. Part of the vehicle rendering/shadow system.

0x005613e0.name: sub_5613E0
0x005613e0.label: TimedVertexProjectionUpdate
0x005613e0.summary: Performs timed 3D-to-2D vertex projection for rendering: when update interval elapses, projects tree-node vertices to screen coordinates using D3D transform, otherwise resets timer and traverses render tree to collect new vertex data.

0x00561620.name: RecursiveTreeNodeTraversal
0x00561620.label: TransformTreeNodeTraverse
0x00561620.summary: Recursively traverse a tree of transform/position nodes. Visits child (offset 0x44) first, then sibling via offset 0x40 (if child at 0x4C exists), then calls sub_561660 to process the current node. Skips if flag at offset 0x3C bit 1 is set.

0x00561660.name: sub_561660
0x00561660.label: TransformNodeProcessBatched
0x00561660.summary: Process transform nodes with frustum culling and screen-space projection. Iterates linked list of nodes, checks visibility bit, performs plane-distance tests against camera frustum, and appends transformed vertices to batched output buffer (up to 1023 entries).

0x00561940.name: FieldCleanupWithNullCheck
0x00561940.label: SceneGraphFieldFree
0x00561940.summary: Free pointer at this[123] (offset 0x1EC) if non-null, then zero the field. Called during SceneGraph cleanup.

0x00561b2a.name: AudioMixLookupTableInit
0x00561b2a.label: LookupTableInitAll
0x00561b2a.summary: Initialize four lookup tables used by audio mixing / pixel processing. Fills MultiplyLUT (256x32, 8-bit), MulLookupTable (256x64, 8-bit), SoundMixClipTable (32x32, clipped sum), and AlphaBlendSumTable (64x64, clipped sum).

0x00561bf0.name: sub_561BF0
0x00561bf0.label: UdpSocketBindAndConnect
0x00561bf0.summary: Create UDP socket, bind to port in range [hostshort, hostshort+100], connect to GameSpy master server address. Uses socket() with AF_INET/SOCK_DGRAM/UDP, scans ports for successful bind, then calls sub_561FF0 to finalize connection.

0x00561e30.name: NetworkPacketReceive
0x00561e30.label: UdpPacketReceive
0x00561e30.summary: Poll UDP socket for incoming packets using select() with zero timeout. For each received packet, null-terminate buffer and dispatch to FilePathNameLookup. Returns select result or this[57] flag check.

0x00561ed0.name: TickCountComparisonHandleInactivityTimeout
0x00561ed0.label: InactivityTimeoutHandler
0x00561ed0.summary: Track inactivity timeout using GetTickCount. If last activity timestamp is non-zero and elapsed time is within valid range (<=300s), check 30s threshold to increment retry counter (capped at 10). On timeout, reset through sub_562AC0.

0x00561f80.name: SocketCloseAndCleanup
0x00561f80.label: SocketCloseAndCleanup
0x00561f80.summary: Close primary and secondary sockets, reset handles to -1, clear flags. Optionally free socket struct if not the default singleton. Call WSACleanupThunk at the end.

0x00562010.name: sub_562010
0x00562010.label: SockAddrBuild
0x00562010.summary: Build sockaddr_in structure from host string and port. Fills address family (AF_INET), port (htons), and IP address. Attempts inet_addr first; on failure falls back to gethostbyname DNS resolution. Special-cases broadcast address "255.255.255.255".

0x005622c0.name: FilePathNameLookup
0x005622c0.label: PacketFileSystemDispatch
0x005622c0.summary: Dispatch incoming network packet or file path request. If packet starts with ';' (ASCII 59), call vtable function pointer at this[63]. Otherwise iterate through scene file data pointer table, call sub_562530 for each, and accumulate result strings through case-based buffer init routines.

0x00562530.name: sub_562530
0x00562530.label: FilePathLookupByString
0x00562530.summary: Search for file path matching input string. Prepends backslash to search string, calls sub_587C20 for location, extracts filename portion (after last backslash) from result into alternating file-path buffer.

0x005626b0.name: StackBufferZeroInitWithCallback
0x005626b0.label: InitStackBufferWithAppDirPathAndCallback
0x005626b0.summary: Initializes a 1400-byte stack buffer seeded with first byte of default application directory, zero-fills remainder, invokes a path-resolution callback (this+0xC8) to populate the buffer, then delegates to sub_562710 to compose final path into output buffer.

0x005629b0.name: sub_5629B0
0x005629b0.label: BuildAndSendValidateMessage
0x005629b0.summary: Constructs a network message with optional Base64-encoded validation data and a mandatory final segment, then sends it via UDP socket. Used in game networking for player/session validation.

0x00562ac0.name: sub_562AC0
0x00562ac0.label: SendHeartbeatMessage
0x00562ac0.summary: Sends a UDP heartbeat/keepalive message containing game ID, game name, and optional state-changed notification. Records the send timestamp to track last heartbeat time.

0x00562b50.name: MemoryObjectAllocator
0x00562b50.label: CreateNetworkSessionObject
0x00562b50.summary: Allocates and initializes a 1464-byte network session/connection structure with string configuration strings, an array of elements, callback function pointers, and the default application directory path. Calls NetworkStartup to initialize networking.

0x00562c50.name: NetworkCleanup
0x00562c50.label: NetworkSessionDestructor
0x00562c50.summary: Tears down a network session object by freeing sub-objects at offsets +4, +8, and +0x94, then freeing the object itself and calling WSACleanup.

0x00562d20.name: SocketArrayCreate
0x00562d20.label: CreateUdpSocketArray
0x00562d20.summary: Creates a pre-allocated array of UDP sockets (AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP) using a 28-byte entry stride, storing each handle at entry+0 and zero-initializing entry+4 and entry+8. Truncates the count if a socket creation fails.

0x00562d90.name: sub_562D90
0x00562d90.label: TcpSocketConnect
0x00562d90.summary: Creates a TCP socket and connects to a host identified by name (global `::name`) on port 0x70E4 (28900). Stores socket handle at this[34] (offset 0x88). Returns 0 on success, error codes 1-3 on failure.

0x00562e30.name: sub_562E30
0x00562e30.label: SendGameServerListQuery
0x00562e30.summary: Receives a session key from the game server via TCP socket (a1+136), validates/decodes it with XOR using a per-session key, sends a game/server list query message, then sends a \list\...\final\ query with optional where clause (a2). Signals completion via AudioValueSetterCall.

0x00563080.name: CreateUdpBroadcastSocket
0x00563080.label: CreateUdpBroadcastSocket (self)
0x00563080.summary: Creates a UDP socket (AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP), enables the SO_BROADCAST option, and stores the socket handle at this+0x88. Returns true (failure) if socket() or setsockopt() fails.

0x005630d0.name: sub_5630D0
0x005630d0.label: UdpBroadcastStatusSend
0x005630d0.summary: Sends UDP broadcast packets containing an 8-byte status string (aStatus) across a range of ports. After sending, calls an audio setter and records current tick count. Used for LAN discovery or heartbeat broadcast.

0x00563160.name: ConditionalNetworkUtility
0x00563160.label: AllocateAndDispatchNetworkStruct
0x00563160.summary: Allocates a new struct via StructAllocInitWithSwitchBasedType using type selector this+0x94, then dispatches it through a callback/function pointer at this+0x4 via SingleFunctionCallWrapper_48c0. Returns the allocated struct.

0x00563260.name: NetworkConnection
0x00563260.label: ProcessNetworkConnectionOrInit
0x00563260.summary: Manages network socket array initialization and server entry processing during connection setup. If socket array does not exist (a1[0]==0), creates it, processes server entries, and optionally enters a polling loop. If already initialized, handles lookup results by updating entry fields or counting display-mode queries.

0x005633d0.name: DisplayModeQueryWrapper
0x005633d0.label: AllocateStructAndPushAudio
0x005633d0.summary: Allocates a struct via StructAllocInitWithSwitchBasedType using type selector from this+0x94, then pushes to the audio stack via AudioStackPushWithOverflowRealloc. Returns the allocated struct.

0x00563410.name: sub_563410
0x00563410.label: AudioStreamNetworkReceiver
0x00563410.summary: Network receiver for audio streaming data that handles TCP and UDP socket I/O, optional XOR/RC4 decryption, and dispatches received audio note/parameter commands to the audio system. Part of the network audio streaming subsystem.

0x00563870.name: sub_563870
0x00563870.label: MultistatePathProcessorStateMachine
0x00563870.summary: Three-state path/data processing machine controlled by a1+1460. State 0: counts backslashes and initializes global glyph/entry count (dword_8CFA88) and clears socket buffer array (dword_8CFA90). State 1: extracts and copies a path segment, stores it into the first free slot of dword_8CFA90, advances state to 2 when full. State 2: queries context with all accumulated entries, appends a backslash, and invokes a callback at a1+120.

0x00563ab0.name: sub_563AB0
0x00563ab0.label: Network Audio Stream Receiver and Socket Manager
0x00563ab0.summary: Manages a UDP socket array for receiving and processing real-time audio stream packets. Polls up to 64 sockets non-blocking via select(), feeds received data through an audio mixer, detects "final" completion markers to trigger callbacks, times out idle sockets after 3 seconds, and dynamically activates new sockets from a LinearInterpolation pool with sendto() handshake.

0x00563dc0.name: NetworkSocketArrayCleanup
0x00563dc0.label: CloseSocketArray
0x00563dc0.summary: Iterates over the socket array (28-byte stride, count at this+0x6C, base at this+0x8) and closes each socket via closesocket().

0x00563df0.name: SetFlagIfPointerNonNull
0x00563df0.label: SetRunningFlagIfInitialized
0x00563df0.summary: Checks if the object at this+0x0 is non-null (already initialized). If so, sets this+0x74 (running/active flag) to 1.

0x00563e00.name: DirectDrawDisplayModeInit
0x00563e00.label: ReinitSessionSubObjects
0x00563e00.summary: Reinitializes the session's internal sub-objects: cleans up the existing batch at this+0x4, allocates a new 0x18-byte sub-struct, frees and reallocates the audio array at this+0x94, and resets this+0x98 to 0. Returns 4 if already initialized (*this non-zero).

0x00563ec0.name: SwitchParamStoreGlobalSet
0x00563ec0.label: SetParamStoreAndDispatchCallback
0x00563ec0.summary: Selects a function pointer based on type parameter (a4): 0→sub_563F20, 1→PhysicsSignDirectionFunction, 2→PhysicsObjectNameCompare, default→sub_564090. Stores parameters a2/a3 in the struct, updates global context pointer (dword_8D46B4), and dispatches via sub_564A00 with the selected callback.

0x00563f20.name: sub_563F20
0x00563f20.label: IndirectStringComparisonWithContext
0x00563f20.summary: Comparison function that compares two indirect string pointers against a reference string from the global network context (dword_8D46B4+128) using StringComparisonWithConstantDispatch. If a direction flag (dword_8D46B4+132) is zero, the result is negated for reverse sort order.

0x00564090.name: sub_564090
0x00564090.label: IndirectAddrStringComparisonWithContext
0x00564090.summary: Comparison function that resolves two indirect address/name strings via sub_5644B0 using the app directory byte_5EA438 and context reference string, then compares results via sub_588410. Supports reverse sort via direction flag at dword_8D46B4+132.

0x005640f0.name: sub_5640F0
0x005640f0.label: AudioContainerSubStructDestructor
0x005640f0.summary: Destructor callback that frees the audio array at sub-struct offset +0xC via DestroyAudioArrayFreeElementsThenContainer, then frees the sub-struct itself via sub_58AA6F.

0x00564110.name: sub_564110
0x00564110.label: ProcessTokenizedServerEntries
0x00564110.summary: Allocates a new struct, tokenizes a path string by backslash, then iterates each token against a lookup table: matches "ip" → calls NetworkAddressParser to resolve the address; matches "other" (and type==6) → calls AudioMixerPollingUpdateLoop; otherwise → allocates singletons via SingletonGlobalAccessorWithFallbackAlloc and dispatches through a function pointer. Uses byte_5EA438 as default path when tokenizer returns null.

0x005642f0.name: StructAllocInitWithSwitchBasedType
0x005642f0.label: Allocate20ByteStructWithTypedArray
0x005642f0.summary: Allocates a 20-byte struct, initializes fields with a1 (data), a2 (short), a3 (type), and a4 (extra). Based on type a3 (0-3 → size 2, default → size 4), allocates a sub-array via AllocateIntArrayViaFactory with sub_5645F0 as factory and IntegerDifferenceComparator for comparison.

0x00564530.name: StringComparisonWithConstantDispatch
0x00564530.label: StringDispatchCompareOrPing
0x00564530.summary: Compares input string to "ping" constant; if matched, returns ShortToIntFieldGetter on a1 (interprets short as int). Otherwise dispatches via DoubleCallWrapper and returns the callback result from v4[1], or returns default a3 if dispatch returns null.

0x00564740.name: DestroyAudioArrayFreeElementsThenContainer
0x00564740.label: FreePointerArrayAndContainer
0x00564740.summary: Iterates over a pointer array (element count at lpMem+4, buffer at *lpMem), frees each element via BatchLoopWithMemoryCleanup, then frees the buffer and the container struct via sub_58AA6F.

0x00564860.name: BatchLoopWithMemoryCleanup
0x00564860.label: batch-processing array with sub-resource cleanup
0x00564860.summary: Iterates over array using count at offset 0, calls IndirectCallViaFunctionPointer on each element, then frees two resources via sub_58AA6F (element[5] and the array itself). Part of audio/networking resource cleanup subsystem.

0x005648d0.name: AudioStackPushWithOverflowRealloc
0x005648d0.label: push element with realloc-on-full and shift
0x005648d0.summary: Pushes element onto dynamic stack/buffer. If count equals capacity, triggers realloc via AccumulatorWithReallocOnGrowth. If inserting before current top, shifts elements forward with LinearInterpolation + sub_58B130 (memmove). Copies new element via AlignedMemoryCopyFromStructBuffer. Audio buffer management.

0x00564930.name: AccumulatorWithReallocOnGrowth
0x00564930.label: realloc buffer with growth increment
0x00564930.summary: Grows dynamic audio buffer: adds growth increment to capacity, calls sub_58B5D4 (realloc) to resize buffer, updates capacity (offset 0x4) and buffer pointer (offset 0x14). Called by AudioStackPushWithOverflowRealloc when buffer is full.

0x00564a20.name: BufferIndexComputation
0x00564a20.label: buffer element search with binary/linear dispatch
0x00564a20.summary: Searches buffer for element matching key, returns index via (ptr - base) / stride. Two paths: binary search (arg4 true) or linear stride search (arg4 false). Early exit on null pointer or empty buffer. Audio buffer management.

0x005651b0.name: sub_5651B0
0x005651b0.label: ConfigLineParser
0x005651b0.summary: Parses a configuration/INI file line: strips C++-style comments (//), handles quoted strings and parenthesis tracking, trims trailing whitespace, and returns a classification code (0=empty, 1=space/brace, 2=closing-brace, 3=comment, 4=value).

0x00565400.name: sub_565400
0x00565400.label: ConfigKeyTokenParser
0x00565400.summary: Parses a dot-delimited config key path: copies key from offset 0x198 to string start, splits on '.', checks each token against a lookup table, and advances through the key hierarchy.

0x005654a0.name: sub_5654A0
0x005654a0.label: ConfigKeyValueStringExtractor
0x005654a0.summary: Parses a dot-delimited config key path, validates the first token against a lookup table, and extracts the resulting string value into an output buffer.

0x00565520.name: sub_565520
0x00565520.label: ConfigKeyValueProcessor
0x00565520.summary: Parses config lines with either "key=value" or dot-delimited path syntax: counts '=' separators, dispatches to StringBasedLookup (single '=') or sub_565400 (path), then copies result and extracts value strings.

0x005655f0.name: sub_5655F0
0x005655f0.label: ConfigIntTupleParser
0x005655f0.summary: Parses config string values as integer tuples (1-4 values) from parenthesized format strings after key token extraction, storing results through optional output pointers as booleans (non-zero check).

0x00565bb0.name: sub_565BB0
0x00565bb0.label: comparator dispatch by sort mode
0x00565bb0.summary: Compares two objects (this vs a2) using sort mode at ([this]+0x220). Modes: 1 = alphabetical ascending, 2 = file time ascending, 3 = file time descending, default = alphabetical descending. Used for sorting directory entries.

0x00565d50.name: EnhancedListCleanupWithSubObjectDelete
0x00565d50.label: linked list destructor with sub-object cleanup
0x00565d50.summary: Frees entire linked list: frees sub-resource at data[81] if non-null, frees data if flag at node+8 set, frees each node, then zeroes list head's four fields. Part of directory/linked-list resource cleanup.

0x00565e20.name: LinkedListDestructorWithChildCleanup
0x00565e20.label: two-level list destructor with inner cleanup
0x00565e20.summary: Destroys two-level linked list. Calls EnhancedListCleanupWithSubObjectDelete on inner list, frees extra resource at v3[132] (offset 0x210), then iterates outer nodes freeing data (with sub-object ShortComputation_4370) and nodes. Finally zeroes list head and frees head structure. Directory/file enumeration cleanup.

0x00565eb0.name: sub_565EB0
0x00565eb0.label: list cleanup with flag reset
0x00565eb0.summary: Cleans up linked list via EnhancedListCleanupWithSubObjectDelete, then clears field at obj+0x21C to zero and returns list head pointer. Part of directory/file resource cleanup.

0x00565ed0.name: LinkedListNodeDataPeek
0x00565ed0.label: peek first node data payload
0x00565ed0.summary: Returns pointer to data payload (+4 offset) from first linked list node, or 0 if list empty or node has no data. Lite accessor for file/directory enumeration.

0x00565f20.name: LinkedListNodePeek
0x00565f20.label: advance linked list iterator to next node
0x00565f20.summary: Advances enumeration cursor: replaces list head's current node slot (obj+0x8) with next node (offset 4 of current node). Returns true if new node exists and has data. Used for sequential file/directory enumeration.

0x00565f50.name: LinkedListPopFront_5f50
0x00565f50.label: reset iterator to first node
0x00565f50.summary: Sets list cursor (offset 8) to first node address (offset 0) — equivalent to pop front conceptually but repositions cursor rather than removing node. Returns true if list non-empty and first node has data. Used to begin file/directory enumeration.

0x00565f80.name: sub_565F80
0x00565f80.label: recursive directory file enumerator
0x00565f80.summary: Enumerates files matched by pattern recursively through directory tree. Uses obj+0x21C as reentrancy semaphore.
