For each non-directory file found, constructs full path (with subdirectory prefix) and adds entry via sub_565CA0. Recurses into subdirectories when a3 flag is set. File/resource scanning system.

0x005662d0.name: DirectoryEntryIterator
0x005662d0.label: build full path from directory entry
0x005662d0.summary: Constructs full file path by concatenating base directory (at data+0x144) with entry name (at data+48) into buffer at list_head+16. If flag at list_head+0x218 is set, normalizes path via sub_566810. Returns pointer to constructed path or 0. File/resource enumeration subsystem.

0x00566380.name: sub_566380
0x00566380.label: merge sort linked list
0x00566380.summary: Sorts linked list via merge sort: counts nodes, splits in half, recursively sorts each half via sub_5664A0, then merges using sub_565BB0 comparator keyed by sort mode at obj+0x220. Rebuilds head (offset 0), tail (offset 4), and cursor (offset 8) pointers. File/directory sorting.

0x005665b0.name: sub_5665B0
0x005665b0.label: StringBufferConcatAlloc
0x005665b0.summary: Concatenates a string to a dynamic buffer: reallocates if existing buffer is too small for the combined length, or delegates to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc if buffer pointer is null.

0x00566650.name: StringCopyWithBufferRealloc
0x00566650.label: StringCopyWithRealloc
0x00566650.summary: Copies a source string into a dynamically-allocated buffer, reallocating if the current buffer is null or too small. Returns 0 on success, -1 on null input.

0x00566940.name: sub_566940
0x00566940.label: open file or serial port with mode dispatch
0x00566940.summary: Opens file or serial port based on mode parameter. File mode (a3=0): resolves path from global buffers and opens via sub_587DB0. Comm/mode access (a3>0): builds mode string from global lookup tables (byte_5E5164/5E5168/5E516C), optionally sets text mode flag, and opens via sub_534B00. Saves handle and copies path string. Config/IO subsystem.

0x00566a70.name: sub_566A70
0x00566a70.label: open file with binary read/write mode
0x00566a70.summary: Opens file in binary mode. If a4 (this[3]) is non-zero, opens for read using unk_5E517C path; else opens for write using unk_5E5180 path. Saves handle at this[0], zeroes flag at this[6], copies resolved path string. Config/file IO subsystem.

0x00566b20.name: AudioStreamOpen
0x00566b20.label: OpenAudioStream
0x00566b20.summary: Opens an audio stream file: closes previous handle, allocates 1024-byte string buffer, opens file via sub_534B00, stores handle and flags, copies filename string if handle valid.

0x00566b90.name: ConditionalFileHandleCloseWithFlagDispatch
0x00566b90.label: ConditionalFileHandleClose
0x00566b90.summary: Conditionally closes a file handle stored in this[0]. If this[4] flag is 0, closes directly via FileCloseWithLock; if non-0, dispatches through StreamFileTypeCheckWithDispatch for type-specific close. Sets handle to 0 after close.

0x00566bd0.name: ConditionalDispatch_6bd0
0x00566bd0.label: dispatch read: buffer or file
0x00566bd0.summary: Routes read operation based on mode flag at this[4] (offset 0x10). If non-zero, reads from buffer with timeout via BufferFillWithTimeout. If zero, reads from file with lock via FileReadWrapperWithLock. File/buffer I/O dispatch.

0x00566c30.name: BufferWriteWithStringLengthCheck
0x00566c30.label: formatted string write with file/buffer dispatch
0x00566c30.summary: Formats variadic string via SafeStringFormat. If mode flag at this[4] is zero, writes directly to file via FileWriteWrapperWithLock. If non-zero, formats to local buffer and writes via BufferFillWithTimeout, verifying all bytes written. Config/data serialization.

0x00566e20.name: ResourceLookupDispatcher
0x00566e20.label: dispatch resource query: buffer or file
0x00566e20.summary: Returns resource data/size based on mode flag at this[4]. If non-zero, reads from audio stream buffer via AudioStreamBufferRead. If zero, queries file size via FileSizeQueryWrapper. Resource loading subsystem.

0x00566e40.name: EulerToRotationMatrix
0x00566e40.label: EulerAnglesToRotationMatrix
0x00566e40.summary: Converts 3 Euler angles (a1[0..2] = pitch, yaw, roll) into a 3x3 rotation matrix (a2[0..8], row-major). Pure trigonometric computation, no side effects.

0x00566ee0.name: RotationMatrixToEuler
0x00566ee0.label: RotationMatrixToEulerAngles
0x00566ee0.summary: Extracts 3 Euler angles (x, y, z) from a 3x3 row-major rotation matrix. Handles gimbal lock singularity by setting z-angle to 0 and computing y-angle from the combined rotation.

0x00566f40.name: F_33RotationMatrixFromQuaternion
0x00566f40.label: QuaternionToRotationMatrix
0x00566f40.summary: Converts a unit quaternion (a1[0]=w, a1[1]=x, a1[2]=y, a1[3]=z) to a 3x3 row-major rotation matrix (a2[0..8]). Standard quaternion-to-matrix formula with no branching.

0x00567120.name: sub_567120
0x00567120.label: AngleAxisRotateMatrixToEuler
0x00567120.summary: Applies an angle-axis rotation (a2) to a 3x3 matrix (this) using Rodrigues' rotation formula, then extracts Euler angles to output buffer (a3). Skips rotation if axis magnitude is zero/NaN but always extracts Euler angles.

0x00567340.name: RotationMatrixYAxisRotationEulerExtraction
0x00567340.label: ApplyXRotationThenExtractEuler
0x00567340.summary: Rotates a 3x3 row-major matrix (this) around the X axis by angle a2 (right-multiply by Rx(-a2)), then extracts Euler angles to output buffer a3. Handles gimbal lock singularity in Euler extraction.

0x00567400.name: RotationMatrixY
0x00567400.label: ApplyYRotationThenExtractEuler
0x00567400.summary: Rotates a 3x3 row-major matrix (this) around the Y axis by angle a2 (right-multiply by Ry(a2): replaces columns 0 and 2 using sin/cos), then extracts Euler angles to output buffer a3. Handles gimbal lock singularity.

0x005674c0.name: RotateMatrixAndExtractAngles
0x005674c0.label: rotate 3x3 matrix and extract Euler angles
0x005674c0.summary: Rotates a 3x3 matrix by angle a2 using sin/cos. Updates all 9 elements. Then extracts Euler angles (yaw, pitch, roll) into output at a3. Handles gimbal lock when center element this[5] is ±1. Camera/3D math subsystem.

0x005676c0.name: FloatToIntConversionWithRemainder
0x005676c0.label: convert seconds to minutes with remainder
0x005676c0.summary: Converts float seconds to integer minutes and float seconds remainder. Multiplies input by 1/60 (0.016666668), truncates via CRTFtol, stores integer minutes at a1, remainder (input - minutes*60) at a2. Timing/time display subsystem.

0x00567900.name: StructInitWithConditionalDefaultRead
0x00567900.label: struct init with conditional field get
0x00567900.summary: Initializes struct: stores pointer a2 at offset 0, sets sentinels (-1) at offsets 0x14 and 0x1C, zeroes offsets 0x4-0x10, 0x18, 0x24, 0x28. If a2 is non-null, retrieves value via FieldGetter_79d0 into offset 0x20; else keeps -1. File data processing init.

0x00567940.name: DualPointerCleanup
0x00567940.label: free two pointers
0x00567940.summary: Frees pointer at offset 0x18 first (if non-null), then frees pointer at offset 0x10 (if non-null). Returns result of last free. Tree/node cleanup.

0x00567970.name: DataEntryAccessor
0x00567970.label: GetDataEntryPathOrDefault
0x00567970.summary: Returns the custom data entry path stored at this[6] if non-null, otherwise falls back to the default application directory (byte_5EA438). Simple accessor with null check.

0x00567980.name: LinkedListCount
0x00567980.label: count linked list nodes
0x00567980.summary: Counts linked list nodes by traversing from this[2] (offset 0x8), following next pointers at node+4 until null. Returns node count.

0x00567a30.name: LinkedListDestructorWithInnerFree
0x00567a30.label: linked list destructor with inner pointer free
0x00567a30.summary: Calls F_9PointerArrayCleanup first, then iterates linked list from this[9], freeing each node's data sub-pointer (if exists) and data, then node. Zeroes list head fields at offsets 0x24-0x30. Resource cleanup.

0x00567b10.name: sub_567B10
0x00567b10.label: StringTrimAndTruncate
0x00567b10.summary: Trims leading and trailing characters matching CharacterClassCheck from input string, truncates at QuoteDelimiter character. Returns 1 if non-empty result, 0 if NULL or empty input.

0x00567bb0.name: FileSettingsDataLoad
0x00567bb0.label: ConfigFileSectionParser
0x00567bb0.summary: Parses a settings/config data structure line by line. Handles nested sections delimited by {} braces, splits keys at '.' delimiter, and dispatches key-value pairs to FileDataProcessor for storage.

0x00567cc0.name: sub_567CC0
0x00567cc0.label: RecursiveTreeStructFree
0x00567cc0.summary: Recursively frees a tree-like data structure. Calls itself on three child pointers (offsets 0x4, 0x8, 0xC), then performs cleanup and frees the current node.

0x00567e10.name: HashTableListInsert
0x00567e10.label: HashTableListInsertOrFind
0x00567e10.summary: Searches a hash table linked list for a string key (offset +4 in input structure). If found, returns match indicator. If not found, allocates a new entry and appends it to the linked list, updating list pointers and counters.

0x00567fb0.name: FileDataProcessor
0x00567fb0.label: DataEntryProcessorWithHashIndex
0x00567fb0.summary: Normalizes key and value strings via helper functions, hashes the key to index into a hash table (max 9 buckets), allocates a 44-byte data entry struct, and inserts it into either a caller-provided linked list (a5) or the hash table indexed by hash value. Handles special case via AudioChannelStop for audio-related entries.

0x00568220.name: HashTableEntrySearch
0x00568220.label: HashTableEntryLookupOrCreate
0x00568220.summary: Searches hash table linked list for a string key. If found and its stored value is not -1, returns that value. Otherwise, allocates a new entry with a fresh index, inserts it into the list, and returns the new index. Implements get-or-create semantics.

0x00568560.name: ReplaceSpecialCharsWithUnderscoreHyphen
0x00568560.label: FilenameCharSanitizer
0x00568560.summary: Replaces path separator characters ('.', '/', '\\') with underscore '_', and characters matching StringPrefixPatternCheck with hyphen '-'. Used to sanitize strings for use as file/directory names.

0x005685b0.name: StringPrefixPatternCheck
0x005685b0.label: CheckPlusTildePrefixPattern
0x005685b0.summary: Checks if string matches prefix pattern: starts with '+' (0x2B = 43), '~' (0x7E = 126), followed by two characters passing sub_589BC6 validation. Requires minimum 4 characters.

0x00568620.name: sub_568620
0x00568620.label: StringSanitizeEncodeHexEscape
0x00568620.summary: Sanitizes a string by copying valid ASCII chars directly and encoding special/invalid chars as hex escape sequences (prefix "+~" + nibbles). Respects output buffer size limit (a3). Used for path/string normalization.

0x005687f0.name: sub_5687F0
0x005687f0.label: IsReservedDosDeviceName
0x005687f0.summary: Checks if the input string matches a reserved DOS device name (CON, PRN, AUX, CLOCK$, COM1-COM9, LPT1-LPT9). Truncates at path separators and extracts up to 7 chars before comparison. Returns 1 if matched, 0 otherwise.

0x00568910.name: sub_568910
0x00568910.label: StringEscapeDecoderWithHex
0x00568910.summary: Decodes a string with "+~XX" hex escape sequences into an output buffer with length limit. Characters not matching the escape pattern are copied verbatim. Returns 1 on success, 0 on null input or buffer overflow.

0x00568a60.name: UtilityFunction_8a60
0x00568a60.label: WeightedFileChecksumCalculator
0x00568a60.summary: Opens a file in binary read mode, computes a weighted checksum over its bytes using a cycling multiplier. Each byte read is multiplied by the current multiplier value (which cycles modulo a2), accumulated into the output dword. Returns 1 on success, 0 if file cannot be opened.

0x00568b00.name: sub_568B00
0x00568b00.label: FileCopyViaReadWrite
0x00568b00.summary: Copies file content from source path to destination path using a 2048-byte buffer. Opens source file in binary read mode, opens/creates destination file using a config directory path, reads chunks from source and writes them to destination. Returns 1 on success, 0 on any open failure.

0x00568be0.name: QPCTimerInitialization
0x00568be0.label: HighResTimerInitWithQPC
0x00568be0.summary: Initializes a high-resolution timer structure using QueryPerformanceCounter/QueryPerformanceFrequency. Stores frequency and computes a scale factor (2^32 / frequency) for converting QPC ticks to time units. Zeroes all timing accumulators. Returns 0.

0x00568c60.name: TimerResetUsingQueryPerformanceCounter
0x00568c60.label: HighResTimerReset
0x00568c60.summary: Resets the high-resolution timer by capturing a new QPC timestamp and zeroing all timing accumulators. If the timer mode bit 0 is set, reads a fresh QPC value; otherwise reuses the existing counter snapshot. Returns the current counter LowPart.

0x00568cb0.name: QPCTimestampReadWrapper
0x00568cb0.label: ConditionalQPCCounterRead
0x00568cb0.summary: Conditionally reads the QueryPerformanceCounter value if the timer is initialized (frequency non-zero) and mode bit 0 is set. Outputs HighPart and LowPart via pointer parameters. Returns 0.

0x00568e30.name: ShortComputation_8e30
0x00568e30.label: ZeroInitFourFields
0x00568e30.summary: Zeros four struct fields at offsets 0x0, 0x230, 0x238, 0x240, then calls MultiFieldPointerCleanupWithNullChecks. Simple initialization routine.

0x00568e70.name: sub_568E70
0x00568e70.label: InitInertiaTensorParameters
0x00568e70.summary: Initializes physics inertia tensor parameters: allocates and copies a name string, stores a scalar double value (mass?) and its reciprocal, copies a 3-component vector (inertia diagonal?) plus per-component reciprocals, then calls InertiaTensorWorldSpaceTransform.

0x00568fb0.name: sub_568FB0
0x00568fb0.label: BuildConstraintJacobianMatrix
0x00568fb0.summary: Builds a constraint Jacobian matrix in buffer a2 from three groups of elements stored in the struct (this[140], this[142], this[144]). Each element is classified into a type (1/2/3) and the corresponding matrix block is initialized to identity (diagonal = 1.0, off-diagonal = 0). Part of physics constraint/contact solver initialization.

0x005691d0.name: F_3x3RotationTensorMatrixTransform
0x005691d0.label: ComputeInertiaTimesAngularVelocity
0x005691d0.summary: Converts Euler angles (a2) to rotation matrix, transforms inertia tensor to world space via F_3x3InertiaTensorTransform, then computes three dot products of transformed inertia rows with angular velocity vector, storing result as torque/force at offsets 0x7C, 0x84, 0x8C.

0x005692a0.name: F_3x3InertiaTensorTransform
0x005692a0.label: TransformDiagonalInertiaToWorld
0x005692a0.summary: Transforms a diagonal inertia tensor from local to world space using the rotation matrix R: computes R * I * R^T where I is diagonal (elements at offsets 0xD4, 0xDC, 0xE4) and R is the 3x3 rotation matrix at offsets 0x1C-0x5C. Exploits symmetry by computing upper triangle then copying to lower triangle.

0x00569410.name: InertiaTensorWorldSpaceTransform
0x00569410.label: ComputeAngularAccelerationFromTorque
0x00569410.summary: Computes world-space angular acceleration from torque using rotation matrix and diagonal inverse inertia: alpha = R * I_body^(-1) * R^T * torque. Reads torque vector (0x7C/0x84/0x8C), rotation matrix (0x1C-0x5C), and inertia reciprocals (0xBC/0xC4/0xCC); writes angular acceleration result (0x94/0x9C/0xA4).

0x005694e0.name: VehicleProjectedPosition
0x005694e0.label: ComputeContactConstraintResponse
0x005694e0.summary: Computes collision contact constraint response: projects contact point (a2) relative to vehicle position (offsets 0x4/0xC/0x14) onto contact normal (a3), computes velocity along normal (a4), impulse correction (a5) using world-space inertia tensor (0xEC-0x12C), and optionally outputs body-space contact offset (a6). Part of collision detection physics pipeline.

0x00569670.name: F_3DVectorCrossProductRotationAccumulation
0x00569670.label: AccumulateContactImpulse
0x00569670.summary: Accumulates collision contact impulse (a2) into vehicle state: updates linear momentum (offsets 0x64/0x6C/0x74) scaled by factor at 0xB4, updates angular momentum (offsets 0x94/0x9C/0xA4) via cross product of impulse and contact offset (a3), then recomputes torque from world inertia times angular momentum (offsets 0x7C/0x84/0x8C).

0x005697a0.name: StructCopyWithReciprocalDivision
0x005697a0.label: CopyInertiaDiagonalsAndReciprocals
0x005697a0.summary: Copies 3 inertia tensor diagonal components (3 doubles) from a2 to offset 0xBC, computes their reciprocals at offsets 0xD4/0xDC/0xE4, then calls InertiaTensorWorldSpaceTransform to update world-space inertia.

0x005697f0.name: TripleBufferAllocation
0x005697f0.label: AllocateConstraintGroupBuffers
0x005697f0.summary: Allocates three buffers for constraint/joint element groups: first group count*56 bytes to this[140], second group count*132 bytes to this[142], third group count*88 bytes to this[144]. Resets all counts to 0 after allocation.

0x00569860.name: F_3DPositionDeltaToBodyFrameVectorTransform
0x00569860.label: AppendBodyFramePositionEntry
0x00569860.summary: Transforms a world-space position delta (a2 minus vehicle position at offsets 0x4/0xC/0x14) into body frame using rotation matrix and appends it to a buffer at this[560]. Increments element count at this[556] (offset 0x22C). Each entry is 56 bytes with body-frame vector plus metadata.

0x005698e0.name: BufferEntryAppendWithMatrixInit
0x005698e0.label: AppendSecondGroupEntry
0x005698e0.summary: Appends a 132-byte entry to the second constraint group buffer (this[142], stride 132). Stores metadata parameters at offsets 120/124/128, initializes a 3x3 matrix at offsets 24 and 48 via sub_56C3A0, and increments element count at this[141] (offset 0x234).

0x00569990.name: F_3DVectorTransformWithBufferWrite
0x00569990.label: WriteRelativeTransformedPosition
0x00569990.summary: Transforms world-space position to local space using object position and rotation matrix, writes result plus metadata into a ring buffer with 88-byte stride. Part of vehicle physics constraint point batching.

0x00569a20.name: ApplyImpulseToRigidBodyWithTorque
0x00569a20.label: ApplyLinearAndAngularImpulse
0x00569a20.summary: Applies impulse vector to rigid body at a world-space point: accumulates impulse into linear momentum, computes torque via cross product (lever arm × impulse), accumulates into angular momentum. Part of collision response constraint solver.

0x00569ad0.name: AccumulateAngularMomentum
0x00569ad0.label: ApplyImpulseAtLocalOffset
0x00569ad0.summary: Accumulates impulse (a3) into linear momentum and cross product (lever arm a2 × impulse) into angular momentum. Same physics as ApplyImpulseToRigidBodyWithTorque but takes pre-computed lever arm vector as a2 parameter instead of computing it from world position.

0x00569c10.name: sub_569C10
0x00569c10.label: Physics Body Position and Angular Velocity Integrator
0x00569c10.summary: Performs one integration step for a physics rigid body: updates linear position (position += velocity * dt), angular position (rotation += angular_velocity * dt), and computes new angular velocity via inertia tensor transform. Part of the vehicle physics rigid-body integration system.

0x00569de0.name: sub_569DE0
0x00569de0.label: SuspensionStateIntegratorWithVelocityClamp
0x00569de0.summary: Integrates suspension position and velocity states using a variable timestep, applying a velocity-damping clamp when displacement exceeds 25% of reference magnitude. Also transforms angular velocity through the inertia tensor. Part of vehicle physics numerical integration.

0x0056a150.name: VehiclePhysicsStateCopyTransform
0x0056a150.label: CopyStateAndComputeVelocity
0x0056a150.summary: Copies physics state (position, rotation, linear/angular momentum) from internal prediction buffer to working offsets, then computes angular velocity = world_inv_inertia * angular_momentum. Part of rigid body integration loop.

0x0056a240.name: InertialTensorVectorTransform
0x0056a240.label: PreConstraintVelocityUpdate
0x0056a240.summary: Computes gyroscopic torque (ω × L), subtracts from applied torque, transforms result through inverse inertia to get angular velocity delta, computes linear velocity from momentum, then invokes constraint preparation sub-functions and stiffness matrix assembly.

0x0056a390.name: sub_56A390
0x0056a390.label: BuildConstraintForceBuffer
0x0056a390.summary: Iterates over constraint entries, computes constraint-space force values from angular velocity delta and linear velocity, accumulates into a force buffer. Part of vehicle physics constraint solver preparation.

0x0056a5d0.name: sub_56A5D0
0x0056a5d0.label: ProcessConstraintVelocityVectors
0x0056a5d0.summary: Processes joint constraint velocity vectors: transforms velocities through rotation matrices via Matrix3x3VectorMultiply, computes cross products, scales by traction constants, accumulates into constraint force buffer. Part of vehicle physics constraint solver.

0x0056a840.name: sub_56A840
0x0056a840.label: BuildContactConstraintScalar
0x0056a840.summary: Iterates over contact constraint entries (stride 88), computes scalar constraint values from body position, linear velocity, angular velocity, and tire traction constants, accumulates into force buffer. Part of vehicle physics contact processing.

0x0056aa60.name: sub_56AA60
0x0056aa60.label: BuildConstraintStiffnessMatrixOffDiagonal
0x0056aa60.summary: Assembles off-diagonal constraint stiffness matrix blocks. For each constraint pair, computes cross products of constraint axes with world-space inverse inertia tensor rows, accumulates into a sparse 3x3 block matrix indexed by constraint IDs. Core of vehicle physics constraint solver setup.

0x0056b5d0.name: sub_56B5D0
0x0056b5d0.label: AssembleJointConstraintMatrix
0x0056b5d0.summary: Assembles diagonal and off-diagonal blocks of the constraint stiffness matrix for joint constraints (stride 132) and contact constraints (stride 88), using world-space inverse inertia tensor rows. Part of vehicle physics constraint solver matrix construction.

0x0056baf0.name: ConstraintStiffnessMatrixAssembly
0x0056baf0.label: AssembleContactConstraintMatrix
0x0056baf0.summary: Builds diagonal and off-diagonal constraint stiffness matrix blocks for contact constraints. Computes cross product of constraint axes, transforms through world-space inverse inertia tensor, scales by inverse mass, accumulates into sparse block matrix. Part of vehicle physics constraint solver.

0x0056bd40.name: EulerAnglesTo33RotationMatrix
0x0056bd40.label: EulerAnglesToRotationMatrix
0x0056bd40.summary: Converts Euler angles (x, y, z) from a2 to a 3x3 rotation matrix stored at `this`. Uses standard sin/cos trigonometric rotation formula. Part of vehicle physics orientation math.

0x0056bde0.name: sub_56BDE0
0x0056bde0.label: AngleAxisToRotationMatrix
0x0056bde0.summary: Converts angle-axis rotation vector (a2) to a 3x3 rotation matrix using Rodrigues' rotation formula. Optionally extracts Euler angles from resulting matrix when a3 is non-null. Part of vehicle physics orientation math.

0x0056c020.name: sub_56C020
0x0056c020.label: RotateMatrixByAngleAxis
0x0056c020.summary: Composes existing 3x3 rotation matrix with angle-axis rotation: computes Rodrigues rotation matrix from axis-angle vector a2, right-multiplies with current matrix (this). Part of vehicle physics orientation integration.

0x0056c2d0.name: F_33RotationMatrixAroundXAxis
0x0056c2d0.label: RotateMatrixAroundXAxis
0x0056c2d0.summary: Applies X-axis rotation to columns 1 and 2 of a 3x3 matrix using sin/cos of angle a2. Column 0 (X direction) is unchanged. Optionally extracts Euler angles if a3 is non-null. Part of vehicle physics suspension orientation setup.

0x0056c3a0.name: sub_56C3A0
0x0056c3a0.label: BuildOrthonormalBasisFromQuaternion
0x0056c3a0.summary: Normalizes quaternion input, builds orthonormal basis: picks perpendicular vector using |x| >= 0.7 threshold, computes cross products, normalizes all three output vectors. Used for constraint axis construction.

0x0056c540.name: CrossProductNormalize
0x0056c540.label: CrossProductNormalized
0x0056c540.summary: Computes cross product a1 × a2, stores in a3, then scales by dot(a1,a2)/|cross| factor (cosine of angle over sine). Skips normalization if cross product is zero. Used for constraint axis vector computation.

0x0056c640.name: sub_56C640
0x0056c640.label: TriangleNormalCompute
0x0056c640.summary: Computes normalized surface normal from three points: cross product of (a1-a2) × (a3-a2) then normalize. Returns -1 for degenerate (collinear) case. Used for collision contact face normal computation.

0x0056c830.name: sub_56C830
0x0056c830.label: SparseMatrixPatternBuild
0x0056c830.summary: Builds sparse matrix CSR (compressed sparse row) storage structure from dense a2 connectivity matrix. Computes symbolic pattern, allocates memory for row pointers this[0], column indices this[1], value arrays this[2] and this[3]. Used for constraint matrix symbolic factorization setup.

0x0056cd70.name: sub_56CD70
0x0056cd70.label: SparseTriangularSolve
0x0056cd70.summary: Performs forward and backward substitution using sparse CSR matrix. Solves triangular system L*x=b (forward) and U*x=b (backward) for constraint solver factorization.

0x0056cf70.name: F_3x3MatrixVectorMultiply
0x0056cf70.label: Matrix3x3VectorMultiply
0x0056cf70.summary: Performs two independent 3x3 matrix-vector multiplications. Each reads 3-component input vector and writes 3-component result to same buffer (6-double workspace). Used in vehicle physics system (suspension/joint force transforms).

0x0056d020.name: F_3x3MatrixInverseCoordinateTransform
0x0056d020.label: Matrix3x3InverseCoordinateTransform
0x0056d020.summary: Computes 3x3 inverse coordinate transform for vehicle physics. Transforms two vectors via Matrix3x3VectorMultiply, computes cross products and cofactor-based inverse matrix, then applies additional matrix-vector multiplies. Transforms forces/torques between coordinate frames (chassis-local to world).

0x0056d1c0.name: RelativeVelocityCompute
0x0056d1c0.label: RelativeVelocityCompute
0x0056d1c0.summary: Computes relative velocity magnitude between two points/objects in vehicle physics. Transforms each local velocity through its 3x3 rotation matrix + translation to world space, then computes Euclidean distance (sqrt of squared differences). Result stored at two output locations.

0x0056d2d0.name: sub_56D2D0
0x0056d2d0.label: ComputeConstraintAnchorOffset
0x0056d2d0.summary: Computes world-space offset between two rigid body constraint anchor points. Transforms local anchor offsets through body rotation matrices via Matrix3x3VectorMultiply, adds body positions, computes difference vector, normalizes to unit length. Part of constraint solver anchor setup.

0x0056d430.name: sub_56D430
0x0056d430.label: SparseMatrixBandwidthReduce
0x0056d430.summary: Computes optimized variable ordering for sparse constraint matrix to reduce bandwidth. Builds adjacency from body/joint connectivity graph, performs iterative permutation optimization (Cuthill-McKee-like algorithm), allocates working arrays, stores permutation/reverse-permutation results in constraint structures. Part of vehicle physics sparse constraint solver setup.

0x0056d880.name: ZeroFillArraysAndCallInitRoutineRepeatedly
0x0056d880.label: VehiclePhysicsJointInitRoutine
0x0056d880.summary: Zero-fills arrays of 8-byte elements pointed to by each pointer in a2, then calls sub_568FB0 init routine for each vehicle physics joint struct (stride 580 bytes) in this struct's array.

0x0056d8f0.name: sub_56D8F0
0x0056d8f0.label: ErrorModelLogOpenAndFormatWrite
0x0056d8f0.summary: Opens a model error text log file, writes a formatted string to it, then closes the file.

0x0056d930.name: VehiclePhysicsJointSystemLoader
0x0056d930.label: Physics Joint System File Parser and Solver Initializer
0x0056d930.summary: Parses a vehicle physics joint-system configuration file (bodies, joints, hinges, bars), allocates arrays for each entity type, populates their geometric/constraint data, and initializes the physics solver matrix. Part of the vehicle physics joint-constraint system loader.

0x0056ead0.name: LinearSearchWithLargeStructStride
0x0056ead0.label: LinearSearchVehiclePhysicsBodyByString
0x0056ead0.summary: Searches a linear array of 580-byte vehicle physics body structs for an element matching the given string, returning a pointer to the matching element or 0 if not found.

0x0056eb30.name: LinearSearchInStructArrayByString
0x0056eb30.label: LinearSearchSuspensionBarByString
0x0056eb30.summary: Searches a linear array of 72-byte suspension bar structs for an element matching the given string, skipping null entries, returning pointer to matching element or 0.

0x0056eb90.name: sub_56EB90
0x0056eb90.label: ZeroFillVehiclePhysicsJointWorkFields
0x0056eb90.summary: Zeroes fields at DWORD offsets 77-88 (byte offsets 308-352) in each vehicle physics joint struct (stride 580) — clearing working state for the joint constraint solver.

0x0056ec00.name: BatchProcessingLoop3Passes
0x0056ec00.label: BatchProcessMatrixTransform3Passes
0x0056ec00.summary: Processes three batches of physics constraint data: 3x3 matrix-vector multiply, 3x3 matrix inverse coordinate transform, and constraint-specific solve (sub_56D2D0), each operating on arrays of 48 or 72-byte structs.

0x0056ec70.name: MatrixIdentityInitialization
0x0056ec70.label: MatrixColumnRowIdentityInit
0x0056ec70.summary: Initializes one column and one row of a matrix to identity values (sets diagonal element to 1.0, all others to 0), or delegates to a virtual method if the vtable pointer is present.

0x0056ecf0.name: sub_56ECF0
0x0056ecf0.label: PhysicsConstraintSolverStep
0x0056ecf0.summary: Executes the physics constraint solver step: zeroes the constraint matrix, transforms wheel/suspension/constraint data, computes inertia tensor transforms, and reinitializes identity matrices for active bodies flagged by bit 0 of byte at offset +44 or +68.

0x0056ee40.name: sub_56EE40
0x0056ee40.label: AccumulateConstraintImpulsesAndForces
0x0056ee40.summary: Accumulates angular momentum and computes force contributions from constraint rows across three groups of physics bodies (wheel/suspension/other), reading 3D vectors and applying them to body struct offsets.

0x0056f090.name: IterateAndFindMinimumValueFromFunction
0x0056f090.label: FindMinimumPenetrationDepth
0x0056f090.summary: Iterates over an array of 580-byte vehicle physics body structs, calls sub_569DE0 on each with a parameter, and returns the minimum result value (penetration depth), defaulting to 1.0 if no bodies exist.

0x0056f100.name: sub_56F100
0x0056f100.label: TransformBodiesToLocalReferenceFrame
0x0056f100.summary: Selects active bodies (via flag byte), transforms their positions and rotation matrices from global to a local reference frame defined by Euler angles and a target body, updating the orientation matrix and Euler angles for each active body.

0x0056f818.name: sub_56F818
0x0056f818.label: DataPatternSequenceValidator
0x0056f818.summary: Validates a 2D double array (41 arrays of 40 doubles each) against a hardcoded zero/non-zero run-length encoded pattern. Each element is checked for equality to 0.0, and the alternating zero/non-zero run sequence must match the expected pattern. Returns true if complete pattern matches.

0x0056fa96.name: BlockLDLTSparseConstraintFactorization
0x0056fa96.label: Block LDL^T Sparse Constraint Matrix Factorization (Dynamics Solver)
0x0056fa96.summary: Performs block-LDL^T factorization of a sparse constraint matrix for the vehicle dynamics physics engine, computing L and D factors plus the solution vector via forward/backward substitution. Standalone numeric routine with no callees — all computation done on global double workspace arrays and index tables.

0x00575bbd.name: MatrixFactorizeLDLT
0x00575bbd.label: Block-Structured LDL^T Factorization for Vehicle Dynamics Solver
0x00575bbd.summary: Performs a block-structured LDL^T factorization (symmetric indefinite factorization, a variant of Cholesky decomposition) on the vehicle dynamics constraint system matrix. Iterates through each pivot block: computes the reciprocal of the diagonal block, scales the corresponding column to form the L factor, and subtracts rank-1 outer-product updates from the remaining submatrix. All data resides in global double-precision arrays; no parameters, no callees, pure numerical computation.

0x00578f76.name: InitPhysicsTransformIdentity
0x00578f76.label: InitPhysicsConstraintMatrixRow
0x00578f76.summary: Initializes a single row of the physics dynamics constraint/solver matrix to identity (diagonal = 1.0, all other elements = 0.0). For rows 3+, also zeroes the preceding block of row elements via sub_58BB10. Part of the vehicle physics dynamics solver system.

0x00579ccf.name: PhysicsStateZeroInit
0x00579ccf.label: PhysicsSolverStateZeroInit
0x00579ccf.summary: Zero-initializes the global physics/dynamics constraint solver state. Sets all solver matrix blocks, bias vectors, and workspace arrays to zero using either direct double assignment (0.0) or block memsets via sub_58BB10.

0x0057a0f0.name: ByteAlignedMemoryCopyWithOffset
0x0057a0f0.label: SelfOffsetMemoryCopy48
0x0057a0f0.summary: Copies 48 bytes from a source address (computed as dest + offset) to a destination buffer using an offset-based self-copy pattern. Copies first 16 bytes byte-by-byte, then the remaining 32 bytes using a second loop.

0x0057a160.name: ConstructorVTableSetInit
0x0057a160.label: PhysicsVtableConstructor
0x0057a160.summary: Constructor that sets the PhysicsVtable pointer at offset 0 and calls SmallStructFieldInit to initialize remaining fields. Returns this pointer.

0x0057a270.name: StructFieldSerialization
0x0057a270.label: StructFieldBufferSerializer
0x0057a270.summary: Serializes struct fields starting at offset 4 into a contiguous buffer using DwordAlignedMemoryCopy. Copies fixed-size fields (4 bytes, 0x20 bytes, five 1-byte fields) followed by a variable-length copy at offset 45 with byte count from offset 44. Returns the total bytes written via a4.

0x0057a420.name: NetworkSocketObjectCreate
0x0057a420.label: NetworkSocketObjectAllocInit
0x0057a420.summary: Allocates and initializes a 3064-byte network socket object. Validates config parameter (must be <= 1), allocates memory, calls sub_57BA10 for initialization. On error, cleans up via vtable destructor call and nulls the output pointer. Returns this (pointer slot).

0x0057a4c0.name: VTableDestructorThenNullPointer
0x0057a4c0.label: VTableScopedDestructAndNull
0x0057a4c0.summary: Safely destroys an object through its vtable: calls destructor at vtable+0x4C, then operator delete at vtable+0x44 with flag 1, and nulls the pointer. Returns the result of the destructor call.

0x0057a4f0.name: VirtualFunctionDispatchWithStackFrames
0x0057a4f0.label: ContextDrivenVirtualDispatch
0x0057a4f0.summary: Dispatches multiple virtual calls using a context structure. Reads a byte flag at offset 0x2B (43), calls vtable init at +0x68 with context, forwards stack arguments to AllocationWrapper, calls vtable finalize at +0xC0, clears byte at offset 0x5D, and copies a string. Returns the context structure pointer.

0x0057a570.name: ByteFieldSetterAtOffset0x5d
0x0057a570.label: FlagByteAtOffset0x5DSetter
0x0057a570.summary: Sets the byte at offset 0x5D of the object pointed to by *this to the value of a2. Returns the object pointer.

0x0057a580.name: VTableCallViaOffset0x6c
0x0057a580.label: VTableDispatchAtOffset0x6C
0x0057a580.summary: Dispatches a virtual method call at vtable offset 0x6C (entry 27) on the object pointed to by *this. Returns the result of the virtual call.

0x0057a590.name: sub_57A590
0x0057a590.label: MutexGuardedValueReadAndClear
0x0057a590.summary: Threadsafe read of a shared integer value protected by a mutex with 5ms timeout. If wait succeeds, reads and clears the value at offset 0x5C4, optionally shifts a string at offset 0x5C8 by a2 bytes, zeroes the string start, then releases mutex. Returns the read value.

0x0057a5a0.name: AnimationTimingUpdateWithParamSet
0x0057a5a0.label: TimedAnimationFlagUpdate
0x0057a5a0.summary: Reads a mutex-guarded timer value, dispatches a vtable call at offset 0x58 to get an animation object, sets a flag byte at offset +4 of the animation object's data, stores the timer, and conditionally dispatches further vtable calls. Used for animation timing updates.

0x0057a660.name: DualVirtualDispatchWrapper
0x0057a660.label: DualSequentialVTableDispatch
0x0057a660.summary: Makes two sequential virtual method calls on the object pointed to by *this. Calls vtable entry at offset 0x74 (entry 29) with no extra arguments, then vtable entry at offset 0x9C (entry 39) with two zero arguments. Returns 1.

0x0057a680.name: COMVTableCallVia0x60
0x0057a680.label: VTableCallMethodAtOffset0x60
0x0057a680.summary: Calls virtual method at vtable offset 0x60 on a COM-like object. Passes `*this` as the `this` pointer to the callee.

0x0057a690.name: VirtualMethodDispatch
0x0057a690.label: VTableCallMethodAtOffset0x64
0x0057a690.summary: Calls virtual method at vtable offset 0x64 on a COM-like object. Passes `*this` as the `this` pointer to the callee.

0x0057a6a0.name: NetworkSendDispatch
0x0057a6a0.label: NetworkSendDispatch
0x0057a6a0.summary: Dispatches network data send. Gets sender object via vtable offset 0x58; returns 10 if null. If payload (a4) present, calls sub-object vtable method at offset 0x20 to set data; else sets flag byte. Calls sub_586800 and SingleFunctionCallWrapper_6a00 unconditionally. Final conditional dispatch via VTableDispatchWithConditionalCall or sub_585270 based on a8.

0x0057a750.name: SingleFunctionCallWrapper_a750
0x0057a750.label: ClampedValueStore
0x0057a750.summary: Computes a reference value via sub_587890, stores min(a3, computed result) at obj+0x80. Returns the computed result. Acts as a clamp/saturate operation.

0x0057a760.name: SEHProtectedDataCopy
0x0057a760.label: SEHProtectedDataCopyWithValidation
0x0057a760.summary: SEH-guarded data copy operation. Validates state via sub_5853B0; on success copies bounded data from a3 to a2, stores result size in a3 and state dword in a4. Returns 0 on success, 11 on failure.

0x0057a820.name: ShortComputation_a820
0x0057a820.label: MutexGuardedComputation
0x0057a820.summary: Acquires mutex at obj+0x640 with timeout from obj+0x644 (WaitForSingleObject). On acquire (WAIT_OBJECT_0 or WAIT_ABANDONED), runs ShortComputation_7210 on sub-struct at obj+0x624. Always releases mutex. Returns computed result.

0x0057a830.name: VTableBooleanTestWrapper
0x0057a830.label: VTableBooleanInvertTest
0x0057a830.summary: Calls virtual method at vtable offset 0x9C, passes a2, a3. Returns TRUE if method returns 0, FALSE otherwise. Boolean inversion wrapper.

0x0057a850.name: VTableBoolCheck
0x0057a850.label: VTableBoolCheckAt0xA0
0x0057a850.summary: Calls virtual method at vtable offset 0xA0 with three arguments. Returns TRUE if method returns 0, FALSE otherwise.

0x0057a880.name: VTableQueryWithStackBufferResult
0x0057a880.label: VTableQueryWithIntResult
0x0057a880.summary: Calls virtual method at vtable offset 0x78. Method fills an int and a 4-byte buffer on stack. If method returns non-zero, returns the int value; otherwise returns 0.

0x0057a8b0.name: VTableCallViaOffset0x7c
0x0057a8b0.label: VTableCallMethodAtOffset0x7C
0x0057a8b0.summary: Calls virtual method at vtable offset 0x7C on a COM-like object. Passes `*this` as the `this` pointer to the callee.

0x0057a8c0.name: VirtualDispatchWrapper_a8c0
0x0057a8c0.label: VTableCallMethodAtOffset0xC0
0x0057a8c0.summary: Calls virtual method at vtable offset 0xC0 with one argument (a2). Always returns 0.

0x0057a8e0.name: COMVTableCallVia0xc4
0x0057a8e0.label: VTableBoolCheckAtOffset0xC4
0x0057a8e0.summary: Calls virtual method at vtable offset 0xC4 with one argument. Returns TRUE if method returns 0, FALSE otherwise.

0x0057aa50.name: sub_57AA50
0x0057aa50.label: GlobalListAndCounterReset
0x0057aa50.summary: Zeroes four global DWORDs: module init list head, generic list tail, task list tail, and pool alloc counter. Initialization/reset function.

0x0057aa80.name: sub_57AA80
0x0057aa80.label: ModuleListShutdownCleanup
0x0057aa80.summary: Traverses module init list (dword_8D3BFC head). For each node with flag at offset 12 set, destroys object pointer at node+0 via vtable destructor, then frees it. After traversal resets all list globals to 0. Guarded by re-entry flag at byte_8D3BFB bit 0.

0x0057aaf0.name: StackBufferCopyPredicateCall
0x0057aaf0.label: StackBufferCopyAndPredicateCheck
0x0057aaf0.summary: Copies 48-byte buffer from a1 to stack, zeroes *a2, then calls sub_57ABB0 with all 12 DWORDs as individual args plus a2 pointer. Returns true if sub_57ABB0 returns 0.

0x0057ab50.name: sub_57AB50
0x0057ab50.label: ModuleListCleanupUnconditional
0x0057ab50.summary: Traverses module init list head dword_8D3BFC. For each node with flag at offset 12 set, destroys object pointer at node+0 via VTableDestructorThenNullPointer and frees it. Resets all list globals to 0. Same logic as sub_57AA80 but without re-entry guard.

0x0057abb0.name: sub_57ABB0
0x0057abb0.label: NetworkModuleCreateAndRegister
0x0057abb0.summary: Creates a network socket object from 12 parameter DWORDs, validates it via status flag and vtable method at offset 0x48, registers it into a global doubly-linked list (ModuleInitListHead). Allocates a 16-byte list node with flag byte at +12 set to 1. Increments pool alloc counter on success.

0x0057acb0.name: sub_57ACB0
0x0057acb0.label: ModuleListFindAndRemoveNode
0x0057acb0.summary: Calls method on a1's sub-object, then searches global module init list for node whose data pointer matches a1. Unlinks node from doubly-linked list. If flag at node+12 set, destroys data object via vtable destructor and frees it. Frees node. Decrements pool alloc counter.

0x0057aec0.name: StructInitializationWithVTable
0x0057aec0.label: DynamicsSolverObjectInit
0x0057aec0.summary: Initializes a dynamics solver object struct: stores vtable pointer (DynamicsSolverObj_VTable) at offset 0, zeroes byte at offset 4 and 8 DWORDs at offsets 8 through 0x24.

0x0057aef0.name: sub_57AEF0
0x0057aef0.label: DynamicsSolverObjectCleanup
0x0057aef0.summary: Destructor for dynamics solver object. Frees two embedded linked lists (heads at offsets 0x18 and 0x8): walks each, frees data pointer if node flag at offset 8 set, frees node. Zeroes all fields. Switches vtable from DynamicsSolverObj_VTable to PTR_VTABLE_5B8A40.

0x0057afa0.name: NetworkPacketConstructor
0x0057afa0.label: NetworkAddressListAppend
0x0057afa0.summary: Allocates 16-byte network address struct (AF_INET, zero IP/port), overwrites with 4 DWORDs from a2. Creates 12-byte list node with flag at +8 set to 1, appends to embedded linked list in `this`. Increments counter at offset 0x14.

0x0057b050.name: LinkedListNodeRemovalWithMemoryFree
0x0057b050.label: NetworkAddressListRemoveAndFree
0x0057b050.summary: Searches embedded linked list for node whose data matches a2. Unlinks node, decrements counter at offset 0x14. If node flag at offset 8 set, frees data. Frees node. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure. Inverse of NetworkAddressListAppend.

0x0057b0d0.name: IndexedLinkedListNodeGetter
0x0057b0d0.label: NetworkAddressListGetByIndex
0x0057b0d0.summary: Returns data pointer (node+0) from linked list at index a2. Bounds-checked against counter at offset 0x14. Walks list from head (offset 0x8) via next pointers (node+4). Returns 0 on bounds failure or node not found.

0x0057b100.name: LinkedListBufferManagerDestructor
0x0057b100.label: DoubleLinkedListBufferManagerDestructor
0x0057b100.summary: Frees two embedded linked lists (heads at offsets 0x8 and 0x18). For each node with flag at +8 set, frees data pointer at node+0. Frees nodes via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Zeroes all list fields (head, tail, tail2, counter for each list) and byte flag at offset 4.

0x0057b230.name: IntSetInsert
0x0057b230.label: IntSetInsertWithDedup
0x0057b230.summary: Checks if integer a2 exists in set (linked list at offset 0x18). Linear scan comparing node data against a2. If found returns 1 (already present). If not found allocates 4 bytes for value, appends node via LinkedListNodeAppend_6000, returns 0.

0x0057b330.name: NetworkConnectionListDuplication
0x0057b330.label: DuplicateNetworkConnectionLists
0x0057b330.summary: Clones source object's two linked lists (socket address entries and opaque data entries) into destination object. Frees destination's existing nodes first, then allocates fresh copies from source.

0x0057b530.name: RingBufferHeadTailReset
0x0057b530.label: ResetRingBufferHeadTail
0x0057b530.summary: Resets ring buffer head and tail indices to 0, marking buffer as empty.

0x0057b550.name: RingBufferPushWithWrapCheck
0x0057b550.label: PushBytesToRingBuffer
0x0057b550.summary: Pushes a3 bytes from source buffer a2 into 4096-byte ring buffer at computed write position (head+tail mod 4096). Returns 0 if insufficient space remains, 1 on success.

0x0057b5c0.name: RingBufferPopWithWrapCheck
0x0057b5c0.label: PopBytesFromRingBuffer
0x0057b5c0.summary: Reads a3 bytes from ring buffer into output buffer a2. Advances head position by a3 (mod 4096) and decrements tail count by a3. Returns 0 if insufficient data available.

0x0057b630.name: ReadBytesFromCircularBufferWithWrapAround
0x0057b630.label: PeekBytesFromRingBuffer
0x0057b630.summary: Copies a3 bytes from ring buffer at current head position into output buffer without consuming them (head/tail unchanged). Wraps read position at 4096-byte boundary. Returns 0 if insufficient data.

0x0057b780.name: ObjectInitWithVTableFieldSet
0x0057b780.label: InitDynamicsObjectWithVTable
0x0057b780.summary: Initializes object with DynamicsObj vtable pointer and zeros field at offset 0x1C. Delegates base vtable chain setup to ObjectInitWithVTableSetup.

0x0057b7f0.name: VTablePointerInit
0x0057b7f0.label: SetDynamicsObjVTablePointer
0x0057b7f0.summary: Sets vtable pointer to DynamicsObj vtable (off_5B8A64) and tail-calls further initialization routine.

0x0057b840.name: NetworkMessageEventComparisonWithShortMasking
0x0057b840.label: MatchNetworkMessageEventToQuery
0x0057b840.summary: Compares network event structure (referenced by this[7]) against two-component query key from a2. Two alternative match patterns within the event are tried; returns true if either matches.

0x0057b8c0.name: SocketAddressInitialization
0x0057b8c0.label: InitSocketAddressPair
0x0057b8c0.summary: Initializes two socket address entries (local/remote pair) with AF_INET family (2), zero IP and zero port in network byte order. Delegates additional setup to SockAddrPairInit.

0x0057b910.name: SockAddrPairInit
0x0057b910.label: InitDualSocketAddresses
0x0057b910.summary: Initializes two socket address structures (first at offset 0, second at offset 0x10) with AF_INET family, zero IP and zero port in network byte order. Returns the port value (0).

0x0057b950.name: NetworkSocketAddressQuery
0x0057b950.label: QuerySocketAddressWithMetadata
0x0057b950.summary: Stores metadata (namelen, a3, a4, a5) into buffer then calls getsockname to retrieve the socket's local address into buffer+16. Returns true on success.

0x0057ba10.name: sub_57BA10
0x0057ba10.label: Network Socket Object Constructor
0x0057ba10.summary: Constructs and initializes a network socket object. Copies 0x30 bytes from the source (a2) into this+0x908 (dword index 578). Sets up vtable pointers (off_5B8B3C, off_5B8A68), creates 8 Win32 mutexes for async socket operations, initializes socket address structures, and registers the object as a global serialization header (dword_8D3E24). Calls sub_57E480 for final socket initialization.

0x0057bc70.name: SingleVTablePointerSet
0x0057bc70.label: SetPhysicsVTablePointer
0x0057bc70.summary: Assigns Physics vtable pointer (off_5B8A00) to object's first field.

0x0057bc80.name: AudioStreamStateReset
0x0057bc80.label: ResetAudioStreamState
0x0057bc80.summary: Resets two audio stream state fields (WORD at 0x12C and DWORD at 0x130) to zero, then calls SmallStructFieldInit for further initialization.

0x0057bcb0.name: NetworkGetPort
0x0057bcb0.label: GetNetworkPort
0x0057bcb0.summary: Reads network port from offset 0x12C and converts from network to host byte order via ntohs.

0x0057bce0.name: sub_57BCE0
0x0057bce0.label: NetworkPhysicsDestructorChain
0x0057bce0.summary: Destructor for a network/physics/IO composite object: closes Win32 handles guarded by byte flags, destroys linked lists with vtable-based destructors, frees allocated resources, and chains into sub_583AE0 for final cleanup.

0x0057bee0.name: NetworkSocketCreate
0x0057bee0.label: InitAndCreateSocket
0x0057bee0.summary: Calls vtable initializer method (at offset 0x74) on the object, then creates a TCP socket via socket(AF_INET=2, SOCK_STREAM=1, 0).

0x0057bf00.name: sub_57BF00
0x0057bf00.label: NetworkCommandDispatch
0x0057bf00.summary: Dispatches incoming network command strings received via UDP to appropriate handlers — status reply with IP/port info, socket-based connection with port scanning, or mutex-protected state change (values 1–5) — forming the server-side command processing for a multiplayer game lobby/session.

0x0057c7b0.name: SocketBindPortScan
0x0057c7b0.label: BindSocketWithPortScan
0x0057c7b0.summary: Binds socket to port starting from a2, scanning up to 100 ports forward on non-EINVAL bind failure. Returns bound port on success, -1 on failure.

0x0057c8e0.name: SocketGracefulClose
0x0057c8e0.label: GracefulSocketClose
0x0057c8e0.summary: Gracefully closes a socket: optionally calls shutdown(SD_SEND) and drains pending recv data, then closes socket and marks handle as -1 (INVALID_SOCKET).

0x0057c950.name: ThreadSafeLinkedListLookupWithMutexDataCopy
0x0057c950.label: ThreadSafeListLookupAndCopyData
0x0057c950.summary: Thread-safe linked list lookup by index with mutex protection. Acquires mutex, walks list to indexed node, transforms internal data via sub_4B3DB0, and copies 16 bytes to output. When index pointer is NULL, copies cached WORD from offset 0x910 instead.

0x0057ca10.name: sub_57CA10
0x0057ca10.label: ParseConfigStringToOutputBuffer
0x0057ca10.summary: Parses a configuration/command string using two delimiter types (byte_5C3F6C and word_5BEB48) into extracted byte values stored at a2. Returns 1 on success, 0 if any segment lookup fails.

0x0057cb50.name: sub_57CB50
0x0057cb50.label: NetworkSocketReceiveAndDispatch
0x0057cb50.summary: Network receive loop: polls a socket via select(), reads data with recv/recvfrom, pushes into per-connection ring buffers, parses message headers (2-byte size fields), and dispatches complete messages through a vtable-based handler. Uses mutex-protected linked lists for connection and message-event lookup.

0x0057d400.name: sub_57D400
0x0057d400.label: WSAErrorToString
0x0057d400.summary: Translates a Winsock error code into a human-readable error message string. If the input parameter is -1 (SOCKET_ERROR sentinel), calls WSAGetLastError to obtain the actual error code, then returns the corresponding string via a switch table mapping standard WSA error codes to message pointers.

0x0057d5d0.name: StructuredMemoryCopyWithHeaderPrepend
0x0057d5d0.label: BuildStructuredPacketWithHeader
0x0057d5d0.summary: Builds structured packet in output buffer: writes byte count (from bit field at source+0x24) and FieldAccessor result as header, copies payload from source+0x14, then appends a final copy using BufferQueryReturnPtrSizeIfValid's adjusted pointer/size.

0x0057d660.name: BufferUnpackWithSizeCheckByteWordCopy
0x0057d660.label: UnpackAndVerifyStructuredPacket
0x0057d660.summary: Unpacks structured packet from input buffer a1: verifies payload size against expected size from a2, conditionally copies payload to *(a2+20), then copies remaining data via MemcpyLikeWithRealloc.

0x0057d6c0.name: sub_57D6C0
0x0057d6c0.label: BuildAndSendStructuredPacket
0x0057d6c0.summary: Builds a structured packet from a2 via StructuredMemoryCopyWithHeaderPrepend, sends it via UDP socket (this+0x93C) to address a3. On send failure, dispatches WSA error handling: logs networking errors via MutexProtectedLinkedListLookupByID, retries on WSAENOBUFS via queue.

0x0057d8d0.name: NetworkPacketSendWithQueryMatching
0x0057d8d0.label: SendPacketToMatchingConnections
0x0057d8d0.summary: Builds structured packet from a2 via StructuredMemoryCopyWithHeaderPrepend. If a3 is non-null, sends to specific connection matched by ID in mutex-protected list. If null, broadcasts to all connections whose query criteria (from a2+0x48 list) match the connection's event fields.

0x0057db80.name: sub_57DB80
0x0057db80.label: MatchConnectionNodeToQuery
0x0057db80.summary: Compares node field at offset 4 (DWORD) against a3 and field at offset 2 (WORD) against HIWORD(a2). Returns true if both match — used as secondary match validator for connection ID queries.

0x0057dbb0.name: VtableCallFormatDispatchTimerDispatchChain
0x0057dbb0.label: DispatchTimerPacketChain
0x0057dbb0.summary: Dispatches timer-driven packet construction chain: calls vtable getter (offset 0x58), reads guarded timer, wraps timer value, constructs network packet from getter result, and thread-safely dispatches via mutex.

0x0057dc10.name: sub_57DC10
0x0057dc10.label: DuplicateConnectionCheckRegister
0x0057dc10.summary: Checks incoming network connection against existing linked list for duplicate address/port pairs. Acquires mutex, walks connection list comparing socket address fields, marks duplicates via debug string, appends new connection, releases mutex.

0x0057dd40.name: sub_57DD40
0x0057dd40.label: ConnectionFindByAddressPortUpdate
0x0057dd40.summary: Acquires mutex, walks connection linked list searching for entry whose address/port fields match caller-provided values (a2). On match, updates node via SetterAt0x24(a3) and writes to offset 28. Returns 1 if found/updated, 0 if no match or list empty. Network connection lookup.

0x0057de30.name: sub_57DE30
0x0057de30.label: ConnectionCleanupDisconnect
0x0057de30.summary: Removes a connection node from active linked list under mutex, frees it, clears connection struct fields, resets ring buffer, and reprepends to free list. Coordinates three mutexes for list access, struct field protection, and connection allocation. Calls vtable callback at offset 0x94 after cleanup. Network connection teardown.

0x0057dff0.name: MutexProtectedLinkedListLookupByID
0x0057dff0.label: ListFindAndDisconnectByAddrPort
0x0057dff0.summary: Acquires mutex, searches active connection linked list for node matching address (HIWORD(a2)) and port (a3). On match, calls ConnectionCleanupDisconnect (sub_57DE30) on found node with a6 parameter. Returns 1 if disconnected, 0 if no match. Network connection management.

0x0057e0a0.name: sub_57E0A0
0x0057e0a0.label: ConnectionTimeoutMonitor
0x0057e0a0.summary: Decrements countdown timer by delta. On expiry, acquires mutex and scans connection linked list for idle connections (exceeding timeout threshold). Drops connections with drop flag set or exceeding threshold, dispatching format timer chain callbacks before cleanup. Network connection maintenance.

0x0057e280.name: sub_57E280
0x0057e280.label: PeriodicUpdateDispatch
0x0057e280.summary: Timer-driven periodic update (0.125s interval). Acquires mutex, iterates managed objects via vtable, processes entries matching specific condition via sub_585870, then drains pending callback queue via MutexCallbackDispatch. Network/audio update tick.

0x0057e3a0.name: MutexCallbackDispatch
0x0057e3a0.label: PendingCallbackQueueProcess
0x0057e3a0.summary: Acquires mutex, walks a callback/action linked list, invoking CounterIncrementDecrementByFlag(0) for each entry. Releases mutex after traversal. Drains queued callbacks in a network/audio context.

0x0057e410.name: WindowsMessagePump
0x0057e410.label: StandardMessageLoop
0x0057e410.summary: Standard Windows message pump: PeekMessage → GetMessage → TranslateMessage → DispatchMessage loop. Processes available window messages until WM_QUIT or no messages remain. Returns result from last PeekMessage/GetMessage call.

0x0057e480.name: sub_57E480
0x0057e480.label: CreateAsyncSocketWindow
0x0057e480.summary: Creates a hidden Window for async socket message dispatching. Registers a window class with WindowProcIgnore6666, then creates an off-screen window via CreateWindowExA. Stores handle in global dword_8D3E28 (SocketAsyncWindowHandle). Returns 1 if already created or successful, 0 on failure. Network async socket support.

0x0057e530.name: sub_57E530
0x0057e530.label: DestroyAsyncSocketWindow
0x0057e530.summary: Destroys the hidden async socket window via DestroyWindow, unregisters the window class via UnregisterClassA, and zeros the global handle dword_8D3E28. Returns 1 if destroyed, 0 if no window existed. Network async socket cleanup.

0x0057e570.name: sub_57E570
0x0057e570.label: NetworkConnectionCleanup
0x0057e570.summary: Cleans up stale network connections: acquires mutex, walks a linked list of connection records, removes each node, resets its internal state (zeroes fields, ring buffer, sentinel), re-queues into list, and releases mutexes.

0x0057e6e0.name: ThreadSafeLinkedListDestructionWithMutex
0x0057e6e0.label: MutexProtectedListDestroyAll
0x0057e6e0.summary: Acquires mutex, iterates a linked list destroying every node. For each node with flag byte at offset 8 set, calls vtable destructor (first vtable entry, arg=1). Frees all nodes via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Zeros head/tail/cursor/count. Releases mutex. Network list cleanup.

0x0057e760.name: MutexProtectedLinkedListFlushDestroy
0x0057e760.label: mutex-protected list destroy (flush all nodes)
0x0057e760.summary: Destroys a mutex-protected singly-linked list: waits on mutex, iterates all nodes freeing data pointer (if byte flag at +8 set) and node itself, zeros list head fields, releases mutex.

0x0057e7e0.name: MutexProtectedLinkedListDestruction
0x0057e7e0.label: second mutex-protected list destroy (flush all nodes)
0x0057e7e0.summary: Destroys a second mutex-protected singly-linked list (offset 0xB1C vs first at 0xB00): waits on mutex, iterates all nodes freeing data pointer (if byte flag at +8 set) and node itself, zeros list head fields, releases mutex.

0x0057e860.name: UDPSocketBind
0x0057e860.label: UDP socket bind with address setup
0x0057e860.summary: Builds a sockaddr_in (AF_INET, INADDR_ANY, port 0), copies to struct at this+0xA84 (673 DWORDs), then dispatches to either query-matching or direct bind path based on sub_586CA0 result.

0x0057e8d0.name: NetworkGetLocalIP
0x0057e8d0.label: get local IP address as string
0x0057e8d0.summary: Initializes an in_addr to INADDR_ANY, copies address struct to network context, converts to dotted-decimal string via inet_ntoa, copies result to output buffer with null terminator. Returns 1 on success.

0x0057e940.name: NetworkReceivePacket
0x0057e940.label: receive network packet from queue
0x0057e940.summary: Sets up local sockaddr_in, copies to context, then searches a mutex-protected linked list (at this+0xAC8) for a matching node via NetworkMessageEventComparisonWithShortMasking. On match, reads field at offset 0x14 from node and stores to output.

0x0057ea30.name: NetworkMessageQueueDequeue
0x0057ea30.label: dequeue message from network queue
0x0057ea30.summary: Searches a mutex-protected linked list (head at this+0xB00) for a node whose data's first DWORD matches INADDR_ANY. On match, reads second DWORD offset from node data into output. Returns 1 if found, 0 otherwise.

0x0057ead0.name: NetworkPacketSend_ead0
0x0057ead0.label: send/queue network packet with aggregation
0x0057ead0.summary: Mutex-protected network send: searches linked list for existing entry matching INADDR_ANY. If found, updates entry with new value `a2`; if not found, allocates new data node and list node. Accumulates `a2` into sum and increments counter on every send.

0x0057ec10.name: sub_57EC10
0x0057ec10.label: cross-list lookup by index (bridge two linked lists)
0x0057ec10.summary: Two-phase mutex-protected lookup: (1) finds node by index `a2` in first linked list (head at 0xAC8), reads data+0x1C to derive an ID via sub_4B3DB0; (2) searches second linked list (head at 0xB00) for matching ID and stores data[1] into output. Returns 1 if found.

0x0057edd0.name: NetworkThreadConnectionCleanup
0x0057edd0.label: zero out connection send data for cleanup
0x0057edd0.summary: Mutex-protected cleanup: searches linked list (head at this+0xB00) for node matching INADDR_ANY, zeros its data fields at offsets 4, 8, 12 (counter, accumulated sum, latest value). Releases mutex.

0x0057ee80.name: ThreadSafeMutexQueueWithTimedWait
0x0057ee80.label: timed-wait mutex queue dequeue with event matching
0x0057ee80.summary: Waits on mutex with caller-specified timeout. Searches linked list (head at this+0xAC8) comparing nodes against a2 via NetworkMessageEventComparisonWithShortMasking. On match, reads field at node data+0x14 into output. Returns 1 if found, 0 on timeout/no match.

0x0057ef80.name: VtableDeleteWrapper
0x0057ef80.label: virtual destructor delete wrapper
0x0057ef80.summary: Calls through object vtable to invoke scalar deleting destructor (slot 0, flag=1). Null-safe: returns 0 if pointer is NULL.

0x0057f0c8.name: NetworkSocketAddressInit
0x0057f0c8.label: socket address init and connection attempt
0x0057f0c8.summary: Initializes sockaddr_in struct (AF_INET), parses IP string via inet_addr, sets port from context field, constructs network packet, and issues thread-safe connection call. Returns 1 on invalid IP (error path via vtable).

0x0057f2b0.name: NetworkSessionStart
0x0057f2b0.label: start network session via vtable dispatch
0x0057f2b0.summary: Initiates a network session: queries sub-object (at this+0x940) via vtable, sets up session config buffer, allocates connection object via vtable+88, configures socket parameters, dispatches conditional call based on a2. Returns result of VTableDispatchWithConditionalCall.

0x0057fb90.name: WinsockInit
0x0057fb90.label: Winsock startup (WSAStartup) initializer
0x0057fb90.summary: One-time Winsock initialization: checks flag at this+0xA74, calls WSAStartup(2.2) if not yet initialized, stores WSADATA at this+0x778. Sets flag on success, calls error handler on failure. Returns current flag state.

0x0057fbe0.name: NetworkCleanup_fbe0
0x0057fbe0.label: full network subsystem cleanup
0x0057fbe0.summary: Performs network shutdown: drains both mutexes (first at 0xAD8, second at 0xAF4), destroys all linked lists (two lists cleared via flush+destroy calls), calls virtual method at vtable+48, then calls WSACleanup if Winsock was initialized. Returns 1 if WSACleanup was called.

0x0057fc80.name: NetworkConnectionThread
0x0057fc80.label: network connection thread (TCP+UDP socket init)
0x0057fc80.summary: Thread entry: calls virtual init, zeros socket handles, initializes Winsock, destroys first linked list (at 0xAC8) under mutex, signals a flag at 0xB38, creates TCP (type=1) and UDP (type=2) sockets, configures both via TCPSocketInit, and marks thread ready (0xA75=1). Returns 0 on success.

0x0057fde0.name: AudioStreamingThreadShutdown
0x0057fde0.label: audio streaming thread shutdown and cleanup
0x0057fde0.summary: Shuts down audio streaming thread: calls virtual shutdown callback, terminates thread, gracefully closes TCP and UDP sockets, destroys first linked list (at 0xAC8) freeing nodes via virtual delete, then calls full network cleanup. Returns 0 on success, 8 if not initialized, 9 if NetworkCleanup fails.

0x00580190.name: NetworkAccept
0x00580190.label: NetworkAccept
0x00580190.summary: Accepts incoming TCP connections on a listen socket (select + accept), stores accepted sockets in a mutex-guarded linked list, applies TCP_NODELAY, and processes pending connections from an internal queue. Returns a boolean activity flag indicating whether any connection event occurred.

0x005804a0.name: NetworkSocketInitializationAndListen
0x005804a0.label: bind both sockets, listen TCP, store IP config
0x005804a0.summary: Initializes network listener: calls virtual init, binds UDP socket to port and TCP socket to port+50, copies IP string to config buffer, configures byte flags, starts TCP listen with large backlog, then dispatches post-listen callbacks. Returns 0 on success, 6 if bind fails.

0x005805c0.name: NetworkPacketQueueReader
0x005805c0.label: dual-list packet queue reader with transfer
0x005805c0.summary: Reads from two mutex-protected linked lists: processes first list (at this+0xB74), extracts a node element via sub_583430 validation, or if none found, processes second list (at this+0xB48) with cleanup and element removal. Writes result from second list into first list's data field at offset +72. Returns element value.

0x00580c10.name: NetworkPacketSend_0c10
0x00580c10.label: alloc and queue network packet with counter
0x00580c10.summary: Allocates and enqueues a network packet: increments send counter (under mutex at 0xB3C), allocates 32-byte data block, initializes via ObjectInitWithVTableFieldSet, optionally copies additional buffer headers (under mutex at 0x640), links into list (at 0xAC8) with 12-byte node. Returns 1.

0x00580de0.name: sub_580DE0
0x00580de0.label: NetworkQueryResponseProcessor
0x00580de0.summary: Processes a network query response by searching a mutex-protected linked list of pending queries, removing the matched node, marking the result object as complete, and optionally re-sending follow-up network packets based on the query state (state 3 triggers a virtual callback, state 4 re-sends with updated data).

0x00581070.name: sub_581070
0x00581070.label: search list node by data field match and copy buffers
0x00581070.summary: Searches linked list (head at 0xAC8) for a node whose data field at offset 0x14 matches parameter a2. On match, calls CopyBufferHeaderFieldsCallInit on node data and then again on local buffer under second mutex (0x640). Initializes local buffer via SetVtablePointerAndCallInit. Returns 1 if found.

0x0058119a.name: NetworkFileTransferAcceptHandler
0x0058119a.label: File transfer accept/reject handler with mutex sync
0x0058119a.summary: Accepts or rejects file transfer request based on NegatedPredicate check. Acquires mutex at this+0x640 before decision, releases before return. On accept path (predicate false), increments counter and calls sub_57E280 with this and 1.0.

0x005813e0.name: sub_5813E0
0x005813e0.label: Transfer context lookup-or-create from parsed request
0x005813e0.summary: Parses incoming binary packet via BinaryPacketFieldParser, searches linked list of transfer contexts at this+0xAC8 for matching ID (node+0x14). Found: copies parsed data into existing node via ObjectInitWithCopy. Not found: allocates new node+link wrapper, appends to list, increments count. When context type==2 and output condition met (a4 flag or MutexProtectedPointerReadRelease==3), copies sockaddr and calls sub_57DD40 to send response.

0x00581600.name: NetworkBufferSearch
0x00581600.label: Linked list search by ID with buffer write
0x00581600.summary: Searches mutex-protected linked list for node matching a2 via ReadFieldAtOffset0x14. On match, writes data to output buffer at a3+4 via BufferWriteWithParams and optionally increments counter via CounterIncrementDecrementByFlag. Returns 1 if found, 0 if not.

0x005816b0.name: ThreadPoolJobDequeueByType
0x005816b0.label: Linked list dequeue by type identifier
0x005816b0.summary: Searches mutex-protected linked list for node matching type a2 via ReadFieldAtOffset0x14. On match, dequeues node data into a3 via sub_57B800. Returns 1 if found and dequeued, 0 if not found.

0x00581780.name: LinkedListNodeAdvance
0x00581780.label: Linked list iterator advance
0x00581780.summary: Advances linked list iteration cursor. Reads current node pointer from this+0x8, advances it to next node via offset-0xC link, returns data value at offset 0 of new current node. Returns 0 if cursor reaches end.

0x00581820.name: LinkedListDestroyCloseHandle
0x00581820.label: Linked list destroy with handle close and data free
0x00581820.summary: Destroys linked list: optionally closes handle at this+0x10 if flag at this+0x18 is set. Walks list from head freeing each node's data via FreeWrapper_7bcf when node's free-flag (node+0x8) is set and data pointer (node+0x0) is non-null. Frees all node wrappers. Zeros all list structure fields.

0x00581880.name: LinkedListDestructionWithVTableReleaseCall
0x00581880.label: Linked list destroy with vtable destructor on data
0x00581880.summary: Destroys linked list: walks nodes calling first vtable entry (Release/Delete) on each node's data pointer with argument 1, then frees node wrapper via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Zeros all list structure fields after iteration. No handle close.

0x005818e0.name: ListDestructionWithHandleClose
0x005818e0.label: List destroy with handle close and vtable destructor
0x005818e0.summary: Destroys linked list: optionally closes handle at this+0x10 if flag at this+0x18 is set. Walks list calling first vtable entry (Release/Delete with arg 1) on each node's data when the node's destructor-flag is set. Frees all node wrappers via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Zeros all list structure fields.

0x00581940.name: sub_581940
0x00581940.label: Linked list node removal by ID with vtable release
0x00581940.summary: Searches linked list for node whose data pointer matches a2, unlinks it, updates head/tail/cursor/count. Optionally clears node's release-flag (node+8) based on a3. If release-flag is set, calls vtable entry 1 (offset +4) on data object with refcount 1. Frees node wrapper via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Returns 1 if found and removed, 0 otherwise.

0x005819c0.name: LinkedListDestroyWithVtableDestructorCall
0x005819c0.label: Linked list destroy with vtable entry 1 destructor
0x005819c0.summary: Destroys linked list: walks nodes calling vtable entry 1 (offset +4, second destructor/release method) on each node's data with argument 1 when node's flag (node+8) is set and data pointer is non-null. Frees all node wrappers via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Zeros all list structure fields.

0x00581a20.name: HandleCloseLinkedListDestructionWithVTableReleas
0x00581a20.label: List destroy with handle close and vtable entry 1 destructor
0x00581a20.summary: Destroys linked list: optionally closes handle at this+0x10 if flag at this+0x18 is set. Walks list calling vtable entry 1 (offset +4, second destructor) on each node's data with argument 1 when node's flag is set. Frees all node wrappers via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Zeros all list structure fields.

0x00581b30.name: sub_581B30
0x00581b30.label: Dual linked list destruction with handle close and two-pass cleanup
0x00581b30.summary: Destroys two embedded linked lists (at this+0x0 and this+0x10) with different cleanup. First pass (list1 at this+0x10): calls vtable[0] destructor with arg 1 on each node's data, frees wrappers. Second pass (list2 at this+0x0): calls vtable[0] destructor with arg 3 on data, frees data objects and wrappers. Optionally closes handle at this+0x20. Zeros all 8 list fields.

0x00581c20.name: sub_581C20
0x00581c20.label: Dual list destruction with SEH-guarded callback cleanup
0x00581c20.summary: Destroys two embedded linked lists with SEH-protected cleanup. First list (this+0x10): calls SEHGuardedFunctionWithExceptionHandling on each node's data, frees data and wrapper. Second list (this+0x0): calls NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH with arg 84 on adjusted data pointer, then frees data and wrappers. Optionally closes handle at this+0x20. Zeros all 8 list fields.

0x00581d40.name: sub_581D40
0x00581d40.label: Audio stream list manager initialization with mutex
0x00581d40.summary: Initializes dual-list manager object. Allocates two AudioStream objects (620 bytes each) via NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb with AudioStreamConstructWithVTableInit and SingleVTablePointerSet callbacks. Wraps them and appends to list1 via LinkedListNodeAppend_6000. Pre-allocates 2 empty nodes into list2. Creates mutex via CreateMutexA at this+0x20, sets flag at this+0x28 on success. Sets this+0x24 to -1.

0x00581e80.name: AudioStreamConstructWithVTableInit
0x00581e80.label: Audio stream object constructor with vtable
0x00581e80.summary: Initializes audio stream object: sets vtable to off_5B8B3C via ConstructorVTableSetInit, zeros WORD at +0x12C and DWORD at +0x130, calls SmallStructFieldInit for additional field zeroing/init. Returns this pointer.

0x00581ee0.name: sub_581EE0
0x00581ee0.label: Dual list destruction with vtable entry 1 and handle close
0x00581ee0.summary: Destroys two embedded linked lists using vtable entry 1 (offset +4) for destructor calls. First pass (list1 at this+0x10): vtable[1] destructor with arg 1 on data, frees wrappers. Second pass (list2 at this+0x0): vtable[1] destructor with arg 3 on data, frees data objects and wrappers. Optionally closes handle at this+0x20. Zeros all 8 list fields.

0x00581fd0.name: sub_581FD0
0x00581fd0.label: Socket address list manager initialization with mutex
0x00581fd0.summary: Initializes dual-list manager object for socket addresses. Allocates two SocketAddress objects (8316 bytes each) via NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb with SocketAddressInit and EmptyStub_aa60 callbacks. Wraps them and appends to list1 via LinkedListNodeAppend_6000. Pre-allocates 2 empty nodes into list2. Creates mutex via CreateMutexA at this+0x20, sets flag at this+0x28 on success. Sets this+0x24 to -1.

0x00582110.name: SocketAddressInit
0x00582110.label: Socket address structure initialization
0x00582110.summary: Initializes socket address structure: temporarily sets two sockaddr_in blocks (AF_INET=2, INADDR_ANY, port 0), resets ring buffer at offset 54 via RingBufferHeadTailReset, then zeroes all fields from offset 0 to 0x34. Sets this+0x20 to -1 (0xFFFFFFFF). Returns this pointer.

0x00582190.name: sub_582190
0x00582190.label: Dual list destruction with NTime callback loop and handle close
0x00582190.summary: Destroys two embedded linked lists. First pass (list1 at this+0x10): frees each node's data via FreeWrapper_7bcf, then frees wrapper. Second pass (list2 at this+0x0): calls NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH with size 4156 and EmptyStub_aa60 callback on adjusted data pointer, then frees data and wrappers. Optionally closes handle at this+0x20 with flag at this+0x28. Zeros all 8 list fields.

0x00582310.name: CloseHandleWrapper
0x00582310.label: Conditional handle close wrapper
0x00582310.summary: Checks byte flag at this+0x18. If set, calls CloseHandle on handle at this+0x10. On success, zeros the handle field. Returns the CloseHandle result (0=fail, non-zero=success).

0x00582340.name: VTableCallWithFlagCheck
0x00582340.label: Conditional vtable entry 1 call with flag check
0x00582340.summary: If flag byte at this+0x8 is set, calls vtable entry 1 (offset +4) on object at this+0x0 with refcount arg 1. Returns the flag byte value (callers check for side effect or return value).

0x00582360.name: Win32MutexCreateRecreate
0x00582360.label: Mutex create/recreate with close existing
0x00582360.summary: If flag at this+0x18 indicates mutex exists, closes old handle via CloseHandle and zeros it. Creates new unnamed inheritable mutex via CreateMutexA with default security attributes, stores at this+0x10. Sets flag at this+0x18 to 1 on success. Returns flag value (1=mutex ready, 0=failed).

0x005823c0.name: sub_5823C0
0x005823c0.label: Struct array initialization with dual linked list setup
0x005823c0.summary: Allocates and initializes a 164-byte object containing 4 sub-structs (40 bytes each) via NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb with StructInitializationWithVTable and sub_57AEF0 callbacks. Wraps the object into a 12-byte node and appends to list1 (this+0x0). Pre-allocates 4 nodes into list2 (this+0x10), one per sub-struct slot, with free-flag=0. Returns final count.

0x005824f0.name: sub_5824F0
0x005824f0.label: Large struct array initialization with dual linked lists (16 slots)
0x005824f0.summary: Allocates and initializes a 644-byte object containing 16 sub-structs (40 bytes each) via NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb with StructInitializationWithVTable and sub_57AEF0 callbacks. Wraps object into a 12-byte node and appends to list1 (this+0x0). Pre-allocates 16 nodes into list2 (this+0x10), one per sub-struct slot, with free-flag=0. Returns this pointer.

0x00582650.name: sub_582650
0x00582650.label: Dual list destruction with vtable entry 0 (no handle close)
0x00582650.summary: Destroys two embedded linked lists using vtable entry 0 (first destructor). List1 (this+0x10): vtable[0] destructor with arg 1 on data, frees wrappers. List2 (this+0x0): vtable[0] destructor with arg 3 on data, frees data objects and wrappers. No handle close. Zeros all 8 list fields. Uses __fastcall convention.

0x00582720.name: sub_582720
0x00582720.label: MutexInitOrReinit
0x00582720.summary: Initializes or reinitializes a mutex on an object. Closes existing handle if present and flag set, creates a new mutex via CreateMutexA, stores handle and sets ready flag.

0x00582780.name: sub_582780
0x00582780.label: TimerCallbackListInit4Entries
0x00582780.summary: Initializes a timer callback list structure with 4 callback entries (84 bytes each, total 340-byte block). Allocates linked-list nodes for the callback block and for individual timer entries, linking them into the object's two linked lists (active and free/pending).

0x005828b0.name: sub_5828B0
0x005828b0.label: TimerCallbackListInit16Entries
0x005828b0.summary: Zeros out an 8-field timer callback list structure, then allocates and initializes 16 callback entries (84 bytes each, total 1348-byte block). Links the callback block node and individual timer entry nodes into the object's two linked lists, similar to sub_582780 but with 16 entries instead of 4.

0x00582a10.name: sub_582A10
0x00582a10.label: TimerCallbackListDestructor
0x00582a10.summary: Tears down a timer callback list structure by walking both linked lists. For flagged nodes (byte+8 != 0), calls SEH-wrapped cleanup on callback entries (via SEHGuardedFunctionWithExceptionHandling or NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH) before freeing data blocks and nodes. Zeros all list pointers and counts after teardown.

0x00582b10.name: LinkedListElementRemovalWithCleanup
0x00582b10.label: LinkedListRemoveByValueWithCleanup
0x00582b10.summary: Removes a linked-list node by matching its data value against the first node's value. Searches through list, unlinks matching node, decrements count, and if the node's cleanup flag is set, calls SEH-guarded cleanup on its data before freeing node and data.

0x00582ba0.name: sub_582BA0
0x00582ba0.label: AudioStreamTimerCallbackListInit
0x00582ba0.summary: Initializes a timer callback list for audio stream construction with 2 callback entries of 308 bytes each (total 620-byte block). Uses AudioStreamConstructWithVTableInit and SingleVTablePointerSet as callbacks. Structure identical to other timer list inits but with larger per-entry size and different callbacks.

0x00582ce0.name: sub_582CE0
0x00582ce0.label: VirtualDestructorListCleanup
0x00582ce0.summary: Tears down a two-list structure by calling virtual destructor methods on each flagged node's data. Calls second vtable entry (offset 0x4) with arg=1 for second-list data, and with arg=3 for first-list data. Frees all nodes and data blocks, zeros all list pointers and counts.

0x00582dc0.name: LinkedBufferCleanup
0x00582dc0.label: BufferListTeardownWithTimerCleanup
