0x00582dc0.summary: Tears down a two-list buffer structure. For second-list nodes, frees data directly. For first-list flagged nodes, calls NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH with 4156-byte entries and EmptyStub_aa60 callback, then frees callback block. Zeros all list fields after teardown.

0x00582eb0.name: LinkedListNodeRemovalWithCleanupCallback
0x00582eb0.label: LinkedListRemoveByValueFreeData
0x00582eb0.summary: Removes a linked-list node by matching its data value against the first node's value. Unlinks node, decrements count, and if cleanup flag is set, frees the node's data via FreeWrapper_7bcf before freeing the node itself. Similar to 582B10 but without SEH callback invocation.

0x00582f60.name: SEHProtectedLinkedListDestruction
0x00582f60.label: LinkedListDestroyWithVirtualDestructor
0x00582f60.summary: Destroys a singly-linked list by walking each node, calling a virtual destructor (vtable entry at offset 0x4, arg=1) on flagged nodes' data, then freeing each node. Zeros all list fields after destruction.

0x00582fd0.name: sub_582FD0
0x00582fd0.label: LinkedListDestroyWithSEHCleanup
0x00582fd0.summary: Destroys a singly-linked list by walking each flagged node, calling SEHGuardedFunctionWithExceptionHandling on its data, freeing data and node. Zeros all list fields after destruction.

0x00583050.name: DestroyLinkedListWithSEHCallDestructors
0x00583050.label: LinkedListDestroyWithVirtualDestructor_2
0x00583050.summary: Destroys a singly-linked list by walking each flagged node and calling a virtual destructor (vtable entry at offset 0x4, arg=1) on its data before freeing the node. Zeros all list fields after destruction. Code identical to SEHProtectedLinkedListDestruction_00582f60 but with a different SEH handler.

0x005830c0.name: ObjectAllocationWithSEH
0x005830c0.label: SocketAddressCallbackBlockAlloc
0x005830c0.summary: Allocates a 8316-byte callback block for 2 socket address entries (each 4156 bytes). Initializes via NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb with SocketAddressInit and EmptyStub_aa60 callbacks. Stores pointer to callback area in *this.

0x00583150.name: FlaggedDestructor
0x00583150.label: FlaggedDestructorWithTimerCleanup
0x00583150.summary: Dispatches destruction of an object based on flag bits. When bit 2 is set, treats object as placement-allocated (has prepended count header), calls NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH with 40-byte entries and sub_57AEF0 callback, then optionally frees from header. When bit 2 is clear, calls sub_57AEF0 directly then optionally frees. Bit 1 controls whether memory is freed.

0x005831b0.name: PlacementDeleteDispatcher
0x005831b0.label: PlacementDeleteDispatcherWithVTable
0x005831b0.summary: Dispatches destruction based on flag bits. When bit 2 is set, treats object as placement-allocated with count header, calls NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH with 308-byte entries and SingleVTablePointerSet callback, then optionally frees from header. When bit 2 is clear, calls SingleVTablePointerSet directly then optionally frees. Bit 1 controls memory deallocation.

0x005832e0.name: sub_5832E0
0x005832e0.label: LinkedListRemoveByValueWithFlaggedCleanup
0x005832e0.summary: Removes a node from a linked list by searching for a matching data value. Unlinks the node, decrements count, optionally clears the node's cleanup flag based on parameter a3. If the node's flag was set, calls a virtual destructor (vtable entry at offset 0x4, arg=1) on its data. Frees the node and returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

0x00583360.name: LinkedListDestructorChain
0x00583360.label: LinkedListDestroyWithTimerCallbackCleanup84
0x00583360.summary: Destroys a linked list, calling NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH (84-byte entries, SEHGuardedFunctionWithExceptionHandling callback) on each flagged node's data before freeing. Frees intermediate data blocks and nodes, zeros all list fields.

0x005833e0.name: WalkLinkedListCallDestructorFreeNodes
0x005833e0.label: LinkedListDestroyWithSEHCleanupDirect
0x005833e0.summary: Destroys a linked list by walking each flagged node, calling SEHGuardedFunctionWithExceptionHandling on its data, then freeing both data and node. Zeros all list fields after completion.

0x00583570.name: ListDestructionWithCOMRelease
0x00583570.label: LinkedListDestroyWithTimerCallbackCleanup4156
0x00583570.summary: Destroys a linked list by walking flagged nodes and calling NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH (4156-byte entries, EmptyStub_aa60 callback) on each data block before freeing. Frees intermediate allocs and nodes, zeros all list fields.

0x005835f0.name: TimerInitWithSEH
0x005835f0.label: QPCTimerStructInit
0x005835f0.summary: Initializes a high-precision timer structure by zero-initializing the data area, setting up a QPC (QueryPerformanceCounter) timer, and calling FloatSetWithTimingCall to configure timing parameters.

0x00583700.name: sub_583700
0x00583700.label: InputStateUpdateWithDataCopy
0x00583700.summary: Validates type ID and time delta, then updates state fields and conditionally copies attached payload data buffer. Part of an input/event delivery system.

0x00583790.name: PhysicsQueryGetterWithReadyFlag
0x00583790.label: PhysicsStateGetterWithData
0x00583790.summary: Reads a physics/animation state value and optional attached data buffer, guarded by a ready flag. Part of a physics query system consuming previously stored state.

0x005837f0.name: sub_5837F0
0x005837f0.label: ThreadedWorkerInitializerWithMutexes
0x005837f0.summary: Initializes a multi-threaded worker object with multiple mutex-protected quad buffers, SEH-based timer callbacks, and I/O buffers. Sets up vtable, default timing values (7.76f, 90.0f), and a self-referencing pointer. Constructor-style function for a threaded processing system.

0x00583aa0.name: CloseHandlePairWrapper
0x00583aa0.label: CloseTwoHandlesWithFlags
0x00583aa0.summary: Closes two kernel handles (guarded by per-handle validity flags), clearing each handle field to 0 on success. Thin wrapper around CloseHandle API.

0x00583ae0.name: sub_583AE0
0x00583ae0.label: Complex Object Destructor with Handle & Linked-List Cleanup
0x00583ae0.summary: Destructor for a complex multi-sub-object structure — sets vtable, walks linked lists to free nodes, closes OS handles (files/events), invokes destructors on nested sub-objects, and runs a timed SEH-protected callback loop. Object lifecycle / resource cleanup system.

0x00583d90.name: StartAddress
0x00583d90.label: FloatAnimationThreadProc
0x00583d90.summary: Thread start routine that runs a float-accumulation loop, polling two state conditions (vtable dispatch at offsets 0x50/0x54), and dispatching accumulated values via vtable entry 0xC when a 0.333 threshold is reached. Part of an animation/interpolation subsystem.

0x00583f50.name: sub_583F50
0x00583f50.label: LinkedListTimerTickWithExpiryCheck
0x00583f50.summary: Walks two linked lists of timer nodes, decrementing each node's deadline by a computed time budget (a2 converted to ms). Expired nodes are unlinked, freed, and appended to a free list. Part of a timer/event scheduling subsystem.

0x005840d0.name: MutexWaitWith1msTimeoutRelease
0x005840d0.label: MutexWait1msAndRelease
0x005840d0.summary: Waits on a mutex (1ms timeout) and immediately releases it if the wait succeeded. Used as a mutex protection flush/yield point.

0x00584130.name: sub_584130
0x00584130.label: NodeAllocOrSearchThenFieldSet
0x00584130.summary: Searches a linked list for a node matching an ID (a3). If not found, allocates a node from a second list, initializes its back-pointer, and appends it to a free list. Then sets a field via dispatch and calls a processing function. Part of an object/node management subsystem.

0x00584230.name: sub_584230
0x00584230.label: Multiplayer Session Protocol Message Dispatcher
0x00584230.summary: Network message dispatcher for the multiplayer session protocol. Reads a bitmask of pending handshake/connection IDs from the packet buffer, then dispatches to 15 message-type handlers (connection request, ping, node-add, HST, clock sync, data transfer, etc.) via a switch statement. Default case returns 0 for unhandled messages.

0x00584c70.name: ThreadSafeCallWithMutex
0x00584c70.label: MutexGuardedListAppend
0x00584c70.summary: Acquires a mutex, appends a node to a linked list (via LinkedListNodeAppend_6000), then releases the mutex. Thread-safe list insertion wrapper.

0x00584cd0.name: sub_584CD0
0x00584cd0.label: MutexGuardedListPopFirst
0x00584cd0.summary: Acquires a mutex, removes the first node from a linked list, optionally invokes SEH-guarded cleanup and frees the node's data, then returns the node's value. Thread-safe list pop/consume operation.

0x00584dd0.name: sub_584DD0
0x00584dd0.label: MutexGuardedListAppend_B
0x00584dd0.summary: Acquires a mutex, appends a node to a linked list (via LinkedListNodeAppend_6000), then releases the mutex. Thread-safe list insertion, variant B with different field offsets.

0x00584e30.name: sub_584E30
0x00584e30.label: MutexGuardedListPopFirst_B
0x00584e30.summary: Acquires a mutex, removes the first node from a linked list, optionally invokes SEH-guarded cleanup and frees the node's data, then returns the node's value. Thread-safe list pop variant B with different field offsets.

0x00584f30.name: MutexProtectedFunctionCallWithWait
0x00584f30.label: MutexGuardedListAppend_C
0x00584f30.summary: Acquires a mutex, appends a node to a linked list (via LinkedListNodeAppend_6000), then releases the mutex. Thread-safe list insertion, variant C with different field offsets.

0x00584f90.name: MutexGuardedTimerRead
0x00584f90.label: MutexGuardedTimerRead
0x00584f90.summary: Acquires a mutex, reads a timer value (via FloatAdditionReturnsFUN00568d90Param1), releases the mutex, and returns the timer value. Thread-safe timer read.

0x00584ff0.name: StringCopyToBufferWithLengthCap
0x00584ff0.label: StringCopyWith16ByteCap
0x00584ff0.summary: Copies a source string to an internal 16-byte buffer with null-termination, clearing the buffer first. Safe string copy with fixed max length.

0x00585040.name: sub_585040
0x00585040.label: DrainTwoListsWithMutexCleanup_A
0x00585040.summary: Drains two linked lists: first calls sub_584CD0 (mutex-guarded pop) in a loop dispatching each value via vtable+0x5C, then drains a second list under mutex, processing nodes with SEH cleanup and freeing memory. Part of an audio/streaming shutdown sequence.

0x00585130.name: sub_585130
0x00585130.label: DrainTwoListsWithMutexCleanup_B
0x00585130.summary: Drains two linked lists: first calls sub_584E30 (mutex-guarded pop) in a loop dispatching each value via vtable+0x5C, then drains a second list under mutex, processing nodes with SEH cleanup and freeing memory. Variant B with different list offsets.

0x00585220.name: StatusCheckViaVTableDispatch
0x00585220.label: StatusCheckWithVTableThreshold
0x00585220.summary: Reads a status byte flag and compares a vtable-dispatched function result against a threshold, returning true only if both conditions are met. Status query with dual condition check.

0x00585270.name: sub_585270
0x00585270.label: IterateAndAllocWithVTableDispatch
0x00585270.summary: Iterates items from an object via vtable dispatch, calling sub_584130 for each item to allocate/search nodes, then calls a final dispatch. Two iteration paths selected by a flag byte. Part of a network send dispatch system.

0x00585320.name: LinkedListWalkWithInputDispatch
0x00585320.label: LinkedListWalkAndDispatchOnMatch
0x00585320.summary: Walks a linked list of nodes, calling a dispatch function (sub_5878A0) and setting a field to -1 for each node whose getter does not return -1. Iterates via a saved iterator pointer.

0x00585380.name: VTableDispatchWithConditionalCall
0x00585380.label: ConditionalListAppendThenVTableDispatch
0x00585380.summary: Conditionally appends an item to a list via ThreadSafeCallWithMutex (if a2 non-NULL), then always dispatches via vtable+0x38. Returns 0 if appended, 2 if skipped.

0x005853b0.name: sub_5853B0
0x005853b0.label: PopFromListProcessAndDispatchAPC
0x005853b0.summary: Dispatches a vtable function, queues an APC callback, pops a node from a list (via sub_584E30), processes it with ShortComputation, and dispatches via vtable+0x5C. Part of an async work processing pipeline.

0x00585400.name: VTableDispatchWithConditionalBranch
0x00585400.label: BitmapTestThenListAppendOrVTableDispatch
0x00585400.summary: Tests a bitmap range for occupancy: if occupied, appends to a list via sub_584DD0; if free, dispatches via vtable+0x2C and vtable+0x5C with a sub_584230 call. Part of a resource/buffer tracking system.

0x00585470.name: sub_585470
0x00585470.label: ThreadCreateWithMutexStateInit
0x00585470.summary: Creates a worker thread via CreateThread (CREATE_SUSPENDED), initializing two mutex-protected state bytes (clear one, set another) and setting thread priority to +1 before returning the handle. Part of network connection thread initialization.

0x00585550.name: ThreadTerminationWithWaitCleanup
0x00585550.label: ThreadTerminateWithWaitAndClose
0x00585550.summary: Retries ThreadResumeWithMutexWait (up to 10× with 250ms sleep), sets a termination flag under mutex, waits INFINITE on the thread handle, closes it, and clears handle/ID fields. Thread shutdown and cleanup.

0x005855e0.name: ThreadSuspendWithMutexWaitLock
0x005855e0.label: ThreadSuspendWithRetryAndMutex
0x005855e0.summary: Suspends a thread under mutex protection, retrying SuspendThread up to 50 times with increasing sleep delays if the thread has prior suspend count. Sets a suspend flag once suspended. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

0x00585680.name: ThreadResumeWithMutexWait
0x00585680.label: ResumeThreadWithMutexWait
0x00585680.summary: Waits on mutex at offset 0xD4, performs float operations on sub-object at 0x84 via FloatSetWithTimingCall, then waits on second mutex at offset 0x20 and resumes thread handle at offset 0x4 if suspended flag at offset 0x1C is set. Returns success/failure flag.

0x00585770.name: ThreadSafeIntReadWithMutex
0x00585770.label: MutexProtectedIntRead
0x00585770.summary: Acquires mutex at offset 0xF0, reads integer value from offset 0xEC under protection, releases mutex, and returns the read value. Thread-safe read accessor for a shared integer field.

0x005857c0.name: MutexProtectedFieldWrite
0x005857c0.label: MutexProtectedIntWrite
0x005857c0.summary: Acquires mutex at offset 0xF0, writes parameter `a2` to integer field at offset 0xEC under protection, releases mutex, and returns pointer to written field. Thread-safe write accessor for a shared integer field.

0x00585870.name: sub_585870
0x00585870.label: TriggerProcessingWithLinkedListBuildAndDecode
0x00585870.summary: Complex trigger/event processing function. Initializes mutex-protected state, iterates objects via vtable calls, builds a linked list of qualifying objects (allocating 12-byte nodes), then processes each through a decompression/decode chain (DecompressionDecode) with vtable dispatch. Cleans up allocated nodes at end.

0x00585bf0.name: IterateTriggersViaVtableCallHandlersPerTick
0x00585bf0.label: DispatchTriggerHandlersPerTick
0x00585bf0.summary: Iterates objects (triggers) via vtable methods (start iteration at +200, get count at +164, get item at +28, check predicate at +172), dispatches each qualifying item through a handler at vtable offset +52 with parameters from DualQueryIntoTwoOutputParams, FieldGetter_5cc0, and ReadFieldAtOffset0x14. Releases items via vtable+32 and ends iteration via vtable+204.

0x00585cd0.name: ThreadSafeWriteWithMutex
0x00585cd0.label: MutexProtectedFieldWriteAt5B4
0x00585cd0.summary: Acquires mutex at offset 0x5B8, writes parameter `a2` to integer field at offset 0x5B4 under protection, releases mutex, and returns pointer to written field. Thread-safe write accessor for shared field at offset 0x5B4.

0x00585d20.name: MutexProtectedPointerReadRelease
0x00585d20.label: MutexProtectedPointerReadAt5B4
0x00585d20.summary: Acquires mutex at offset 0x5B8, reads pointer value from offset 0x5B4 under protection, releases mutex, and returns the read value. Thread-safe read accessor for shared pointer field at offset 0x5B4.

0x00585de0.name: QueueUserAPCAsyncProcedureCall
0x00585de0.label: QueueUserAPCAsyncCall
0x00585de0.summary: Calls QueueUserAPC with global pfnAPC as function pointer, thread handle from `this+4` as target thread, and `this` as ULONG_PTR parameter. Queues an asynchronous procedure call for execution in the target thread.

0x00585ea0.name: MutexPairInitializer
0x00585ea0.label: InitializeMutexPairWithLists
0x00585ea0.summary: Initializes a structure with two linked-list head/tail pointer pairs (offsets 0x0/0x4 and 0x10/0x14) and creates two mutexes (offsets 0xC, 0x1C) via CreateMutexA with INFINITE timeouts (offsets 0x10, 0x20). Sets created flags (offsets 0x14, 0x24) to 1 on success.

0x00585f60.name: MutexWaitWithSuccessCheck
0x00585f60.label: MutexWaitWithSuccessCheck
0x00585f60.summary: Waits on mutex handle at offset 0x50 with timeout at offset 0x54. Returns `this` if wait succeeds (WAIT_OBJECT_0 or WAIT_ABANDONED), or 0 if handle is NULL or wait fails/times out.

0x00585f90.name: ReleaseMutexWrapperReturningSuccess
0x00585f90.label: ReleaseMutexWithNullCheck
0x00585f90.summary: Checks if mutex handle at offset 0x50 is non-NULL, then calls ReleaseMutex and returns the result. Returns FALSE if handle is NULL.

0x00586070.name: sub_586070
0x00586070.label: DestroyDoubleLinkedListWithSEHCleanup
0x00586070.summary: Destroys two linked lists rooted at offsets 0x10 and 0x0. First list: frees node data pointer if node flag byte at +8 is set, with EmptyStub_0170 call, then frees node. Second list: calls NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH on node data pointer before freeing. Zeroes all head/tail fields after cleanup.

0x00586170.name: HandleCloseLinkedListCleanup
0x00586170.label: HandleCloseAndLinkedListFree
0x00586170.summary: Closes handle at offset 0x10 if flag at offset 0x18 is set and CloseHandle succeeds, then destroys linked list rooted at offset 0x0 by freeing each node's data pointer (with SEHGuardedFunctionWithExceptionHandling call if node flag at +8 is set) and freeing the node itself. Zeroes all head/tail fields after cleanup.

0x00586240.name: LinkedListDestructionWithSEHAllocCleanup
0x00586240.label: DestroySimpleLinkedList
0x00586240.summary: Frees all nodes in a single linked list rooted at offset 0x0. For each node, if flag byte at node+8 is set and data pointer at node+0 is non-null, calls EmptyStub_0170 then frees the data pointer. Frees the node itself. Clears all list head/tail fields (offsets 0x0-0xC) to 0.

0x005862c0.name: MutexCreatorWithErrorHandling
0x005862c0.label: MutexCreateOrReplace
0x005862c0.summary: Conditionally closes existing mutex handle at offset 0x50 if flag at offset 0x58 is set and CloseHandle succeeds (clearing the handle), then creates a new unnamed mutex via CreateMutexA. Sets flag at offset 0x58 to 1 on success and returns the flag value.

0x00586320.name: sub_586320
0x00586320.label: InitializeDoubleLinkedListWithSEHCallbackNodes
0x00586320.summary: Sets up two linked lists in the structure (list 1 at offsets 0x0-0xC, list 2 at offsets 0x10-0x1C). Allocates a 2100-byte buffer, initializes it via NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH with BufferedCharIOInit callback, creates list 1 node pointing into buffer. Then iterates 2096 bytes in 1048-byte steps, creating list 2 nodes with computed offsets from buffer content.

0x00586460.name: DestroyLinkedListWithVTableDestructorDispatch
0x00586460.label: DestroyLinkedListWithCallbackLoop
0x00586460.summary: Frees all nodes in linked list rooted at offset 0x0. For each node with flag byte set at +8 and non-null data pointer at +0, dereferences the data pointer's first DWORD (vtable-like) and calls NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH on it (size 1048, count from *(data-4), callback EmptyStub_0170). Frees adjusted data pointer, freed data wrapper, and node. Clears all list fields to 0.

0x00586500.name: MutexCreateRecreate
0x00586500.label: MutexCreateRecreate
0x00586500.summary: Conditionally closes existing mutex handle at offset 0x4 if flag at offset 0xC is set and CloseHandle succeeds, then creates a new unnamed mutex via CreateMutexA. Sets flag at offset 0xC to 1 on success and returns flag value.

0x00586560.name: MutexCreateReplaceWrapper
0x00586560.label: MutexCreateReplaceAt54
0x00586560.summary: Conditionally closes existing mutex handle at offset 0x54 if flag at offset 0x5C is set and CloseHandle succeeds, then creates a new unnamed mutex via CreateMutexA. Sets flag at offset 0x5C to 1 on success and returns flag value.

0x005865c0.name: CreateMutexViaWin32API
0x005865c0.label: MutexCreateReplaceAt1C
0x005865c0.summary: Conditionally closes existing mutex handle at offset 0x1C if flag at offset 0x24 is set and CloseHandle succeeds, then creates a new unnamed mutex via CreateMutexA. Sets flag at offset 0x24 to 1 on success and returns flag value.

0x00586620.name: NodeDestructionWithVirtualCall
0x00586620.label: ConditionalVirtualDestructorCall
0x00586620.summary: Checks flag byte at offset 0x8; if non-zero and vtable pointer at offset 0x0 is non-null, calls virtual destructor method with parameter 1. Returns the flag value.

0x00586700.name: SEHProtectedDirectXRenderStateSetup
0x00586700.label: RenderStateBitmapAllocationSetup
0x00586700.summary: Initializes render state by calling sub_587460(0) and sub_59B2F0(8,1,16,8), then registers 5 bitmap allocation tracker entries at offsets 0x34-0x44 from `this` with modes 1,8,1,2,16. Calls sub_586AA0 to finalize bitmap field initialization.

0x00586800.name: sub_586800
0x00586800.label: MultiBlockBitfieldEncoder
0x00586800.summary: Encodes multiple bitfield blocks (j, a3, a5, a6) into a bitmap array using metadata from a lookup table at this[7]. For each block, reads bit count and start position from table entries indexed by this[13], this[14], this[15], this[16], builds bitmask, and sets/clears corresponding bits in the array via IndexToBitmaskConversion and BitSetClearOperation. Returns BitfieldEncoder result for a4 flag.

0x00586aa0.name: sub_586AA0
0x00586aa0.label: MultiBlockBitfieldReset
0x00586aa0.summary: Resets/initializes multi-block bitmap state. Clears first DWORD at this, processes 4 bitmap blocks using metadata at this[7] with indices at this[13]-this[16]: sets bit 0 of first block, clears all bits in blocks 2-4. Calls BitfieldEncoder(this[17], 0), SimpleSetter_7500 on offset 0x8, and zeroes fields at offsets 0x48, 0x4C, 0x50.

0x00586ca0.name: sub_586CA0
0x00586ca0.label: AnyBitSetInBitmapField
0x00586ca0.summary: Checks if any bit is set in a bitmap field defined by metadata at this[7] with index this[15]. Iterates bits using count from metadata entry, tests each bit position in the byte array at this[5], and returns true if any bit is found set.

0x00586d00.name: BitmapRangeOccupancyTestViaBitOps
0x00586d00.label: Test bitmap occupancy for a range descriptor
0x00586d00.summary: Reads a range descriptor (start + count) from an array indexed by field 0x34, then tests which positions within that range have bits set in a bitmap at field 0x14. Returns a bitmask of occupied positions.

0x00586d70.name: TestBitmapBitsInTextureRegion
0x00586d70.label: Test bitmap occupancy for region range
0x00586d70.summary: Identical logic to BitmapRangeOccupancyTestViaBitOps but uses field 0x38 (instead of 0x34) as the range descriptor index. Reads start+count from descriptor table at field 0x1C, then tests bitmap at field 0x14 for occupied bits within range, returning bitmask.

0x00586de0.name: BitmaskGenerationFromBitArray
0x00586de0.label: Generate occupancy bitmask from bitmap range
0x00586de0.summary: Same pattern as BitmapRangeOccupancyTestViaBitOps but reads range index from field 0x44. Reads start+count from descriptor table at field 0x1C, tests bitmap at field 0x14, returns bitmask of occupied positions in range.

0x00586e50.name: ShortComputation_6e50
0x00586e50.label: Copy struct fields with buffer and sub-calls
0x00586e50.summary: Copies selected fields from input `a2` to `this` struct: two initial DWORDs (offsets 0x0, 0x4), then calls BufferWriteWithParams and sub_59B3B0 on `a2` sub-structs, then copies two trailing DWORDs (offsets 0x4C, 0x50). Acts as a partial struct copy/initializer with side-effect calls.

0x00587030.name: ObjectInitWithVTableSetup
0x00587030.label: Task object init with vtable and parameters
0x00587030.summary: Initializes a TaskBase-derived object: calls sub_587460(0), sets vtable pointer to off_5B8C30 (VTable_TaskBase), and stores three parameters (a4→0x10, a2→0x14, a3→0x18) with byte at 0x19 cleared to 0.

0x005870d0.name: SetVtablePointerAndCallInit
0x005870d0.label: Set vtable and free pointer field
0x005870d0.summary: Sets vtable at offset 0x0 to VTable_TaskBase, then frees pointer at offset 0x4 (calls FreeIfNonNull on this+1). Partial cleanup/re-init pattern for TaskBase objects.

0x005870e0.name: FieldResetWithSubCall
0x005870e0.label: Reset fields with sub-call initializer
0x005870e0.summary: Calls SimpleSetter_7500 on field at offset 0x4, then resets fields at offsets 0x10→0, 0x14→-1, 0x18→0, 0x19→0. Acts as a multi-field reset/initializer for a TaskBase-like struct.

0x00587200.name: sub_587200
0x00587200.label: Set byte field at offset 0x18
0x00587200.summary: Simple byte setter — stores `a2` into field at offset 0x18 and returns the same value.

0x00587230.name: CounterIncrementDecrementByFlag
0x00587230.label: Increment or decrement byte counter at offset 0x19
0x00587230.summary: Adjusts byte counter at offset 0x19: if `a2` is non-zero, increments; otherwise decrements (but only if current value > 0). Returns the value before modification.

0x00587260.name: DecompressionDecode
0x00587260.label: Decode/decompress data block with appended fields
0x00587260.summary: Validates output buffer capacity via AddConstantWrapper, copies variable-length data block from queried buffer, then appends three struct fields (DWORD at 0x10, DWORD at 0x14, BYTE at 0x18). Returns total written size in `*a3`.

0x00587310.name: BinaryPacketFieldParserWithOffsetMath
0x00587310.label: Parse binary packet header with field extraction
0x00587310.summary: Parses a binary packet: header WORD encodes total payload size less 11. If non-zero, copies payload via MemcpyLikeWithRealloc, then extracts three trailing fields (DWORD at 0x10, DWORD at 0x14, BYTE at 0x18) from the end of the payload and stores into struct.

0x00587370.name: CopyBufferHeaderFieldsCallInit
0x00587370.label: Copy buffer header fields with sub-init
0x00587370.summary: Calls BufferWriteWithParams on source field at offset 0x4, then copies four header fields (DWORD 0x10, DWORD 0x14, BYTE 0x18, BYTE 0x19) from source `a2` to `this`. Acts as a buffer/header copy initializer.

0x00587500.name: SimpleSetter_7500
0x00587500.label: Zero field at offset 0x8
0x00587500.summary: Clears DWORD at offset 0x8 to 0. Trivial field reset.

0x00587510.name: MemcpyLikeWithRealloc
0x00587510.label: Reallocate buffer and copy data
0x00587510.summary: Manages a growable buffer (ptr at 0x0, capacity at 0x4, stored size at 0x8). If `a3` exceeds capacity, frees old buffer and allocates new one of size `a3`. Copies `a3` bytes from `a2` into buffer. Returns 1 on success.

0x00587580.name: BufferQueryReturnPtrSizeIfValid
0x00587580.label: Query buffer pointer and size if valid
0x00587580.summary: Returns buffer pointer (offset 0x0) and stored size (offset 0x8) via output parameters if capacity (offset 0x4) is > 0. Otherwise zeroes outputs and returns 0.

0x005875c0.name: BufferReallocationAndDataCopy
0x005875c0.label: Reallocate buffer with size extension
0x005875c0.summary: Computes new buffer size as `a2 + capacity(offset 0x4)`, allocates via OperatorNewWithResultCheck, copies existing data (offset 0x8 bytes) from old buffer, frees old buffer, stores new pointer at offset 0x0. Always returns 0.

0x005876f0.name: BufferedCharIOInit
0x005876f0.label: Initialize buffer/Tail fields and call global init
0x005876f0.summary: Sets DWORD at offset 0x410 to -1 and DWORD at offset 0x414 to 0, then calls FieldConstantsInitialization global init. Likely initializes buffer tail-position tracking fields in a larger struct.

0x00587710.name: FieldSetterAt0x410
0x00587710.label: Set DWORD at offset 0x410
0x00587710.summary: Simple DWORD setter — stores `a2` into field at offset 0x410 and returns the same value.

0x00587730.name: sub_587730
0x00587730.label: Serialize/encode fields into buffer with overflow check
0x00587730.summary: Encodes data from input `a2` into a buffer tracked at offset 0x400. Computes byte counts, copies fields via qmemcpy, checks against capacity at dereferenced `*(this+0x414)+0x80`. Calls sub_5878A0 on overflow. Increments counter at 0x408; stores bitmask result at 0x40C on first call (counter was 0).

0x005878a0.name: sub_5878A0
0x005878a0.label: Overflow handler with vtable dispatch and reset
0x005878a0.summary: Called when buffer overflow is detected. Checks buffer position against `a2` threshold. On valid overflow, calls vtable function on sub-struct (at this+0x414) to create an object, then chains sub_586800, SingleFunctionCallWrapper_6a00, a second vtable call, and VTableDispatchWithConditionalCall. Resets state via FieldConstantsInitialization.

0x00587930.name: BufferCopyViaVirtualTypeDispatch
0x00587930.label: Parse typed buffer entries with vtable dispatch
0x00587930.summary: Iterates `a3` times through buffer `a2`, using vtable dispatch (offset 0x58) on sub-struct at this+0x414 to create typed objects. For each entry: compares size byte against expected type size, optionally copies data into object, reads next length byte, copies variable data via MemcpyLikeWithRealloc, sets config value `a4` on object.

0x005879f0.name: FieldConstantsInitialization
0x005879f0.label: Reset buffer state fields to defaults
0x005879f0.summary: Resets three zero fields (offsets 0x400, 0x404, 0x408) and sets field at 0x40C to constant 500. Acts as buffer state reset/initialization.

0x00587ac0.name: sub_587AC0
0x00587ac0.label: Push integer onto thread-local cleanup stack
0x00587ac0.summary: Thread-safe push of `a1` onto a custom DWORD stack managed by globals `dword_8D5A50` (top) and `dword_8D5A54` (base). Auto-grows stack via sub_58B5D4 when full. Uses critical section for synchronization. Returns pushed value on success, 0 on allocation failure.

0x00587b7f.name: InitWrapperCalling3Subroutines
0x00587b7f.label: CRT init wrapper with three subroutine calls
0x00587b7f.summary: CRT initialization stub: calls InitCRTFloatConversionFunctionPointers, stores result of sub_58BCA6 in global dword_8D3E44, calls TwoArgCallWrapper, clears x87 FPU exceptions (fnclex). Returns TwoArgCallWrapper result.

0x00587b97.name: InitCRTFloatConversionFunctionPointers
0x00587b97.label: Populate CRT float conversion vtable
0x00587b97.summary: Initializes six global function pointer entries (off_5E6730–off_5E6744) with CRT float conversion/dispatch routines (sub_58BD29, CfltcvtCRTFloatConversionDispatch, sub_58BD8F, sub_58BCCF, sub_58BD77). Returns CfltcvtCRTFloatConversionDispatch.

0x00587d33.name: MSVCCRTFileClose
0x00587d33.label: MSVCCRTFileCloseInternal
0x00587d33.summary: Flushes the write buffer, frees the internal buffer heap allocation, closes the OS file handle, and resets the file state flags. Implements MSVC CRT `_close`-like behavior.

0x00587ece.name: sub_587ECE
0x00587ece.label: WhitespaceSkipAndStringToInt
0x00587ece.summary: Skips whitespace characters (tab/space category 8), then parses a decimal integer with optional sign prefix, returning the signed integer value.

0x00587f90.name: FileTellSeekPositionQuery
0x00587f90.label: FileSeekPosition
0x00587f90.summary: Implements file seek/tell: validates file state, flushes buffer, computes absolute position from relative offset (supports seek_cur via sub_58AD08), calls OS-level seek via sub_58C724, and manages file error flags.

0x00588212.name: sub_588212
0x00588212.label: FPUExponentiationWithEdgeCases
0x00588212.summary: Computes floating-point exponentiation (FYL2X-based) with full IEEE 754 edge-case handling: NaN/infinity propagation, zero-to-zero, infinity-to-zero, sign handling, and FPU exception state management via fsave/frstor.

0x00588410.name: sub_588410
0x00588410.label: CaseInsensitiveStringCompare
0x00588410.summary: Compares two null-terminated strings case-insensitively, with two code paths: a locale-aware path using character-type tables (MultiByteToWideChar via sub_591FA1) and a simple ASCII path using inline case folding (tolower via bit-0x20 mask for A-Z).

0x0058850f.name: sub_58850F
0x0058850f.label: StringToDoubleWithLocale
0x0058850f.summary: Skips leading whitespace from a string and then parses the remainder as a double value using locale-aware encoding detection, returning the parsed double.

0x00588821.name: FileOpWithGlobalBuffer
0x00588821.label: FormattedOutputWithCriticalSection
0x00588821.summary: Writes formatted output into global buffer `unk_5E6768` under critical section protection. Saves buffer state before format, restores after, returns format result.

0x005888a6.name: MSVCRTSEHFrameUnwinder
0x005888a6.label: SEHFrameUnwindToTryLevel
0x005888a6.summary: Unwinds MSVC CRT SEH scope table from current trylevel down to target trylevel. Iterates through scope entries calling registered unwind handlers for each level. Core of CRT `_local_unwind`.

0x0058895c.name: ScriptFrameProcessor
0x0058895c.label: SEHExceptHandler3or4
0x0058895c.summary: MSVC CRT `_except_handler3`/`_except_handler4` frame handler. Evaluates exception filters and dispatches to catch handlers. Walks scope table trylevels, calls filter functions, performs global + local unwind on match.

0x00588a19.name: LocalUnwindWrapper
0x00588a19.label: LocalUnwindDispatch
0x00588a19.summary: Thin wrapper that reads SEH scope frame pointer and target trylevel from a struct at +0x18 and +0x1C, then dispatches to SEH frame unwinder. MSVC CRT helper for `_local_unwind`.

0x00588a34.name: sub_588A34
0x00588a34.label: NetworkSessionParameterConfig
0x00588a34.summary: Configures network session parameters from indexed values or LC_-prefixed configuration strings. Parses key=value pairs, matches against function table, sets session parameters under critical section with spinlock wait.

0x00588c7a.name: sub_588C7A
0x00588c7a.label: SessionParameterSetter
0x00588c7a.summary: Sets a network session parameter at given index (a1) with string value (lpMem). Parses input, allocates memory, updates session table slot with rollback on validation failure. Handles special indexes 1 (code page conversion buffer) and 2 (default code page).

0x00588d95.name: sub_588D95
0x00588d95.label: SessionCreateOrReinit
0x00588d95.summary: Creates or reinitializes network session structure. Allocates 849-byte buffer if needed, clears it, then iterates through function pointer table calling setup/configuration functions for each subsystem.

0x00588e4e.name: sub_588E4E
0x00588e4e.label: LocaleStringParser
0x00588e4e.summary: Parses locale/configuration string input. Handles special case "C" (ASCII 67) as default locale. Matches input against locale compare strings, tokenizes via sub_588F8B, and updates global locale data state.

0x00588f8b.name: sub_588F8B
0x00588f8b.label: LocaleTokenSplitter
0x00588f8b.summary: Splits locale string into up to 3 tokens delimited by "_.," characters. Writes primary token at buffer offset 0, secondary at offset 64, remainder at offset 128. Returns -1 on malformed input.

0x00589057.name: sub_589057
0x00589057.label: LocaleDataApply
0x00589057.summary: Applies parsed locale data by normalizing the compare string buffer and calling setup functions for secondary and tertiary locale subtokens. Part of locale configuration pipeline.

0x0058928f.name: sub_58928F
0x0058928f.label: StringToIntegerWithBaseDetection
0x0058928f.summary: Parses a string to an integer with automatic base detection (8/10/16), supporting 0x/0X prefix for hex, leading 0 for octal, optional sign, and overflow detection with errno reporting.

0x005895a2.name: sub_5895A2
0x005895a2.label: FPURoundingAndNaNHandler
0x005895a2.summary: Handles FPU rounding and NaN/infinity values: for NaN/Inf checks the FPU exception type via UtilityFunction_1d2e and dispatches math error handling; for normal numbers applies FrndMSVCCRTRounding for rounding.

0x005896ee.name: sub_5896EE
0x005896ee.label: SystemTimeToInternalTimeConvert
0x005896ee.summary: Gets local and system time, caches timezone/DST info with invalidation check. Converts system time to internal time format via sub_591EDF. Optionally writes result to output pointer.

0x00589901.name: sub_589901
0x00589901.label: StringToUppercaseWithLocale
0x00589901.summary: Converts a null-terminated ASCII string to uppercase in-place. Uses locale-aware WideCharToMultiByte conversion when locale is available; otherwise applies simple ASCII tolower (subtract 32 for 'a'-'z').

0x00589a35.name: sub_589A35
0x00589a35.label: CharToUppercaseWithLocale
0x00589a35.summary: Converts a single character to uppercase. Uses locale-aware conversion via sub_589AA4 when locale is available; otherwise applies simple ASCII tolower (subtract 32 for 'a'-'z').

0x00589aa4.name: sub_589AA4
0x00589aa4.label: LocaleAwareCharUppercase
0x00589aa4.summary: Converts a single character to uppercase using the system locale via LCMapString (sub_591FA1). Handles multi-byte characters by swapping byte order and returns the uppercased result as a 1 or 2-byte value.

0x00589c77.name: sub_589C77
0x00589c77.label: LocaleDataInitCallbacks
0x00589c77.summary: Initializes locale/CRT data by calling optional system event callback, then initializing data ranges from unk_5BE000 to unk_5BE3BC and module init lock to end pointer.

0x00589cc6.name: sub_589CC6
0x00589cc6.label: CRTProcessExitHandler
0x00589cc6.summary: CRT process exit/termination handler. Runs atexit-registered functions, performs cleanup on CRT data ranges, conditionally calls TerminateProcess or ExitProcess based on flags.

0x00589e6c.name: sub_589E6C
0x00589e6c.label: TimeSecondsToBrokenDownTime
0x00589e6c.summary: Converts time value (seconds) to broken-down time structure with timezone bias and DST correction. Handles negative adjustments, normalizes seconds/minutes/hours/days/ months.

0x00589fcc.name: StreamGetcWithUnderflowHandler
0x00589fcc.label: StreamGetChar
0x00589fcc.summary: Reads one byte from buffered stream. Decrements remaining count, if underflow occurs calls refill handler, otherwise reads byte and advances pointer. Thread-safe via critical section.

0x0058a02c.name: MemoryBlockValidationCheck
0x0058a02c.label: FileBufferValidationAndFlush
0x0058a02c.summary: Flushes the file write buffer, then checks flag at offset +13 for write error (bit 6); if error is set, validates the OS handle via sub_592891 to determine if the handle is invalid.

0x0058a05a.name: BufferFlushWrite
0x0058a05a.label: BufferFlushToOS
0x0058a05a.summary: Flushes the internal write buffer to the OS file handle if the buffer contains data and the file is in write mode (flags & 3 == 2 and flags & 0x108 != 0). Resets buffer pointers after flush.

0x0058a0bf.name: sub_58A0BF
0x0058a0bf.label: HeapSlotValidateAll
0x0058a0bf.summary: Iterates all thread heap slots from the global slot array (dword_8D4A24), acquires per-slot critical sections, and validates open file streams via MemoryBlockValidationCheck. Mode a1=1 counts valid streams; mode a1=0 returns -1 if any writable stream has errors.

0x0058a19e.name: sub_58A19E
0x0058a19e.label: WinMainEntryPoint
0x0058a19e.summary: Program entry point (equivalent to WinMain): retrieves Windows version info, initializes TLS and runtime subsystems, parses command line and startup info, then calls GameMainEntry — exiting with error handler if any early init step fails.

0x0058a2a6.name: CRTAmsgExit
0x0058a2a6.label: CRuntimeAssertMsgExit
0x0058a2a6.summary: C runtime assertion/error exit handler. Checks error display flag; if set, shows error dialog. Then processes the error code and calls registered exit function pointer with code 0xFF. Used by CRT stubs for allocation failures and runtime errors.

0x0058a2cb.name: ErrorHandlerWithOptionalCleanupThenExit
0x0058a2cb.label: FatalErrorExit
0x0058a2cb.summary: Fatal error handler. Optionally displays an error message via sub_5932BA if flag is set, then runs cleanup via sub_5932F3 and terminates process with exit code 0xFF.

0x0058a331.name: SEHUnwindHandler
0x0058a331.label: SEHUnwindWithCleanup
0x0058a331.summary: SEH unwind handler that calls RtlUnwind to a known landing pad, clears UNWIND bit (0x02) in ExceptionFlags, and updates the exception list pointer. Standard CRT SEH unwind helper.

0x0058a42f.name: SEHExceptionHandlerTrampolineSetup
0x0058a42f.label: SEHTrampolineBuilder
0x0058a42f.summary: Builds an SEH exception handler trampoline structure with callback (RenderStateSetupWithFlagChecks), parameters, and link to current exception chain. Retrieves TLS handler and dispatches via vtable offset +104.

0x0058a55a.name: BinaryIntervalSearchForMatchingRange
0x0058a55a.label: IntervalRangeSearch
0x0058a55a.summary: Searches a sorted interval table for a value within a range. Walks entries backward from end, finds match where target <= entry upper bound, returns pointer to matching entry. Used for font glyph rendering range lookup.

0x0058a5f7.name: NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH
0x0058a5f7.label: ReverseStepCallbackN
0x0058a5f7.summary: Calls a callback function N times while stepping backward through a memory array. Starts from end pointer, decrements by step size each iteration. Generic destructor/cleanup iterator used by many cleanup functions.

0x0058a677.name: sub_58A677
0x0058a677.label: StepAndCallCallback
0x0058a677.summary: Simple loop calling a callback N times while decrementing pointer by step size. Delegate used by NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH variants for iterator dispatch.

0x0058a6d5.name: StreamMagicNumberCheck
0x0058a6d5.label: MagicNumberDispatchCheck
0x0058a6d5.summary: Checks if a double-indirect pointer's first DWORD matches magic value -529697949 (0xE0D8B623). If match, dispatches to SEH handler function; otherwise returns 0.

0x0058a6eb.name: NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb
0x0058a6eb.label: ForwardStepCallbackN
0x0058a6eb.summary: Calls a callback function N times while stepping forward through memory. Starts from base pointer, increments by step size each iteration. Forward-iterating counterpart to NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH.

0x0058a770.name: LongjmpMSVCCRT
0x0058a770.label: CRTLongjmp
0x0058a770.summary: MSVC CRT `longjmp` implementation. Unwinds stack frames (global + SEH local) to the saved jmp_buf state, calls cleanup handler if cookie validates, then jumps to saved return point.

0x0058a973.name: sub_58A973
0x0058a973.label: OS-version-conditional aligned memory allocator
0x0058a973.summary: Internal CRT memory allocator dispatching between pool allocator and HeapAlloc based on OS version code (2=Win2K pool path, 3=WinXP sub-allocation path, else HeapAlloc). Rounds allocation size up to 16-byte alignment.

0x0058aa6f.name: sub_58AA6F
0x0058aa6f.label: OS-version-dispatched memory deallocation
0x0058aa6f.summary: Memory free/dispose function dispatching to pool-based free or HeapFree based on OS version code (2=Win2K pool, 3=WinXP pool, else HeapFree). NULL-safe — returns immediately on null pointer.

0x0058ab58.name: sub_58AB58
0x0058ab58.label: Aligned counted-element allocator with debug heap retry
0x0058ab58.summary: Multi-strategy memory allocator (count * size) with 16-byte alignment and zero-initialization. Dispatches to pool allocator (Win2K or WinXP style) or HeapAlloc based on OS version and size. Retries via debug heap callback when CRT_DebugHeapFlag is set and primary allocation fails.

0x0058ad08.name: sub_58AD08
0x0058ad08.label: File stream position with text-mode newline adjustment
0x0058ad08.summary: CRT file stream position/remaining-bytes calculator. Queries file size, accounts for buffered read position, and adjusts for text-mode newline (0x0A) expansion. Sets errno to EINVAL (22) on invalid mode flag combination.

0x0058ae69.name: sub_58AE69
0x0058ae69.label: _fdopen: file descriptor to FILE stream with mode parsing
0x0058ae69.summary: CRT `_fdopen` implementation that allocates a FILE stream structure for an open OS file handle and parses the mode string ("r", "w", "a" with modifiers "+tbcnSRTD"). Increments global file open count.

0x0058af5c.name: ErrorIDLookupTable
0x0058af5c.label: OS error code to CRT errno mapper
0x0058af5c.summary: CRT error mapping function that translates Windows GetLastError codes to CRT errno values. Uses a two-column lookup table (error code → errno) with range-based fallbacks for common error families. Stores both original OS error code and resulting errno in TLS.

0x0058afe1.name: sub_58AFE1
0x0058afe1.label: fclose: flush and close file stream
0x0058afe1.summary: CRT `fclose` implementation that flushes buffered writes, clears the file handle from critical section tracking, closes the OS handle via sub_58C724, and releases the stream structure.

0x0058b077.name: sub_58B077
0x0058b077.label: StringToDoubleConvert
0x0058b077.summary: Converts string to double (strtod/atof equivalent). Skips leading whitespace, parses number via locale-aware conversion, handles infinity/NaN/special values, sets TLS errno on range error.

0x0058b130.name: sub_58B130
0x0058b130.label: Memory Copy With Overlap Handling (memmove)
0x0058b130.summary: Low-level memory copy with overlapping buffer detection: copies `a3` bytes from `a2` (src) to `a1` (dst). When source and destination overlap (dst between src and src+size), copies backward to avoid corruption; otherwise copies forward using optimized DWORD moves with tail byte handling.

0x0058b59f.name: GetSystemTimeAsFileTimeTo64BitTick
0x0058b59f.label: GetSystemTimeAsFileTime to 64-bit tick
0x0058b59f.summary: Wraps GetSystemTimeAsFileTime, combines dwLowDateTime + (dwHighDateTime << 32) into a single 64-bit tick value, stores to global qword_8D3EC0, and returns it. No branching.

0x0058b5d4.name: sub_58B5D4
0x0058b5d4.label: MemoryReallocWithOSVersionFallback
0x0058b5d4.summary: Memory reallocation wrapper with three paths: if lpMem is NULL → allocate; if dwBytes is 0 → free; else realloc using strategy selected by OS version code (dword_8D4908 == 3 uses SEH-guarded region tracking; == 2 uses pool allocator; else uses raw HeapReAlloc). Retries allocation after running out-of-memory callback if dword_8D41B0 (CRT_DebugHeapFlag) is set.

0x0058b92a.name: sub_58B92A
0x0058b92a.label: DriveLetterPathResolution
0x0058b92a.summary: Resolves a file path to its full path. If FileName is provided, validates it via sub_58B9FF, prepends a drive letter (v3+64 = 'A'-'Z'), prepends ":.\", and calls GetFullPathNameA. If FileName is NULL, uses GetCurrentDirectoryA. Returns result in caller-provided buffer or newly allocated memory via sub_58FCA0.

0x0058ba36.name: ToggleFileReadOnlyAttributeViaWin32API
0x0058ba36.label: ToggleFileReadOnlyAttribute
0x0058ba36.summary: Toggles the read-only attribute (bit 0) on a file via Win32 API. Gets current attributes with GetFileAttributesA; if a2 >= 0 sets read-only flag (OR 1), if a2 < 0 clears it (AND 0xFE). Calls SetFileAttributesA and returns 0 on success, -1 on failure with error lookup.

0x0058ba75.name: FileAttributeCheckWithErrorHandling
0x0058ba75.label: FileAttributeCheckReadOnlyFlag
0x0058ba75.summary: Checks file attributes via GetFileAttributesA. Returns -1 with error lookup if file does not exist. If file has read-only attribute (bit 0) AND a2's bit 1 is set (a2 & 2), sets TLS error codes (13 and 5) and returns -1. Otherwise returns 0.

0x0058bb68.name: sub_58BB68
0x0058bb68.label: MemoryBlockSizeQuery
0x0058bb68.summary: Returns the usable size of a memory allocation. On OS version 3, reads size from allocation header (*(lpMem - 1) - 9) via sub_593E1B region lookup. On OS version 2, reads pool block size (16 * *v3) via MemoryRegionValidationHeapLookup. Falls back to HeapSize if region lookup fails or OS version is neither 2 nor 3.

0x0058bca6.name: sub_58BCA6
0x0058bca6.label: IsProcessorFeaturePresentQuery
0x0058bca6.summary: Dynamically resolves IsProcessorFeaturePresent from kernel32.dll via GetModuleHandleA/GetProcAddress and calls it with argument 0 (PF_XMMI — SSE instruction set). Falls back to sub_58BC68 if the API is unavailable.

0x0058bccf.name: sub_58BCCF
0x0058bccf.label: DecimalSeparatorReplaceAndShift
0x0058bccf.summary: Scans string for first character that is not a digit (sub_58B465 returns != 101), replaces it with decimal separator (byte_5E6BD8), then left-shifts remaining characters by one position. Returns the displaced character. Used for inserting decimal separator into formatted number string.

0x0058bd29.name: sub_58BD29
0x0058bd29.label: TrailingZeroTrimAfterDecimalSeparator
0x0058bd29.summary: Trims trailing zeros from the fractional part of a formatted floating-point string. Scans for decimal separator (byte_5E6BD8), then for exponent marker 'e'/'E', then removes trailing zeros before the exponent. If removal exposes decimal separator as last char before exponent, also removes it. Shifts exponent portion left to fill gap.

0x0058bd77.name: sub_58BD77
0x0058bd77.label: DoubleIsNonNegative
0x0058bd77.summary: Checks if a double value is non-negative. Returns TRUE if *a1 >= 0.0, FALSE otherwise.

0x0058be2e.name: sub_58BE2E
0x0058be2e.label: FloatToStrExponentAndDecimalFormat
0x0058be2e.summary: Formats a floating-point number's string representation: writes sign character '-', inserts decimal separator at correct position, appends exponent marker 'E' and decomposes exponent value into digits (hundreds/tens/units) added to pre-initialized '0' characters. Called by floating-point-to-string conversion routines.

0x0058bf45.name: UtilityFunction_bf45
0x0058bf45.label: FloatToStrZeroPadAndDecimalInsert
0x0058bf45.summary: Formats floating-point output buffer: writes leading '-' if negative, fills with '0' padding, inserts decimal separator (byte_5E6BD8) after the integer part, and pads with '0' characters (0x30) for negative exponent positions. Handles zero-value special case with '0\0' termination.

0x0058c1b1.name: StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection
0x0058c1b1.label: Stream critical section enter dispatch
0x0058c1b1.summary: Enters the critical section guarding a file stream. For streams in the CRT global array, computes index from array offset and uses lazy-init indexed CS. For external streams (outside array range), calls EnterCriticalSection on embedded CRITICAL_SECTION at offset +0x20.

0x0058c203.name: AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave
0x0058c203.label: Stream critical section leave dispatch
0x0058c203.summary: Leaves the critical section protecting a file stream. Mirror of StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection: for CRT global array streams uses indexed CritSectLeave; for external streams calls LeaveCriticalSection on embedded CRITICAL_SECTION at offset +0x20.

0x0058c255.name: sub_58C255
0x0058c255.label: _filbuf: file stream buffer refill on underflow
0x0058c255.summary: CRT `_filbuf` implementation that refills the read buffer when a get/read operation finds the buffer empty. Reads from OS handle via sub_58C9B4, handles buffer allocation, text-mode translation, and auto-grows default 512-byte buffer to 4096 when possible.

0x0058c331.name: sub_58C331
0x0058c331.label: _close: file handle close with validation
0x0058c331.summary: CRT `_close` implementation that validates the file handle index is within range and currently open, enters the per-handle critical section, closes via HandleCloseWithErrorReporting, and sets errno to EBADF (9) on invalid handle.

0x0058c38e.name: HandleCloseWithErrorReporting
0x0058c38e.label: CloseHandle with cleanup and error mapping
0x0058c38e.summary: Closes an OS handle by CRT index, with special handling for shared stdout/stderr handles. Clears the handle's open-state byte in the critical section array and maps any CloseHandle failure to CRT errno via ErrorIDLookupTable.

0x0058c411.name: sub_58C411
0x0058c411.label: File stream buffer deallocation on close
0x0058c411.summary: Frees the allocated buffer of a FILE stream if the stream owns it (flag 0x08 set). Clears buffer ownership flags and zeroes buffer pointers. Part of CRT stream close/teardown.

0x0058c5ac.name: sub_58C5AC
0x0058c5ac.label: FILE stream structure pool allocator
0x0058c5ac.summary: Allocates a FILE stream structure from the CRT's global stream pool (dword_8D4A24 array). Searches for an available slot — either allocates a new 56-byte stream via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc or reuses an inactive slot with no I/O flags set. Initializes stream with handle=-1 and zeroed fields under critical section protection.

0x0058c789.name: FileSeekViaSetFilePointer
0x0058c789.label: _lseek: file seek via SetFilePointer
0x0058c789.summary: CRT `_lseek` implementation that positions a file handle using SetFilePointer. Validates handle index, clears the EOF tracking flag on success, and maps OS errors to CRT errno via ErrorIDLookupTable.

0x0058ca19.name: sub_58CA19
0x0058ca19.label: _read: file read with text-mode translation
0x0058ca19.summary: CRT `_read` implementation that reads bytes from a file handle via ReadFile with text-mode translation (\r\n → \n, Ctrl-Z EOF handling, pushback character support). Handles pipe break and access-denied error mapping.

0x0058cc00.name: MemoryCopy_cc00
0x0058cc00.label: Optimized memcpy With Overlap Handling
0x0058cc00.summary: Custom memcpy implementation with source/destination overlap detection and backward-copy fallback. Uses DWORD-aligned bulk copy with Duff's device-style switch fall-through for remainder bytes, providing optimized memory block transfer.

0x0058cf35.name: sub_58CF35
0x0058cf35.label: fputc/_flsbuf: character output to file stream
0x0058cf35.summary: CRT character output function that writes a single byte to a FILE stream. Handles stream initialization (buffer allocation, read→write mode transition), buffer fill, and direct unbuffered write via sub_58E22B. Sets error flag on failure.

0x0058d04d.name: sub_58D04D
0x0058d04d.label: fprintf: formatted output to file stream
0x0058d04d.summary: CRT `fprintf`/`printf` core implementation. Parses a format string with full specifier support (flags `#+-0`, width, precision, size prefixes `h/l/w/I64`, conversion characters `d/i/o/u/x/X/c/s/p/n/e/E/f/g/G/Z/C/S`) and writes formatted output to a file stream. Uses a state machine driven by format-classification table byte_5B8D88.

0x0058da70.name: Trandisp1
0x0058da70.label: FloatDisplayControlWordAndDispatch
0x0058da70.summary: Floating-point display formatting helper. Checks byte at (a1+14) for value 5 to select x87 FPU control word (63 vs 4927), then examines ST0 via `fxam`, performs xlat-based dispatch table lookup, and calls through a virtual function table at (a1+16). Part of CRT float formatting infrastructure.

0x0058de2c.name: sub_58DE2C
0x0058de2c.label: Double special-case classifier for binary math operation
0x0058de2c.summary: CRT math helper that classifies special IEEE 754 double values (infinity, NaN, zero, one, compared to 1.0) for a binary double operation. Computes one of several constant results based on the combination of input classifications and returns a flag indicating whether the result is a special case.

0x0058dfc1.name: sub_58DFC1
0x0058dfc1.label: CriticalSectionArrayInit
0x0058dfc1.summary: Initializes four critical sections (lpCriticalSection, off_5E6CB4, off_5E6CA4, off_5E6C84) via InitializeCriticalSection. Called once at startup to prepare synchronization primitives for allocation/thread management.

0x0058dfea.name: CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter
0x0058dfea.label: _lock: lazy-initializing critical section enter
0x0058dfea.summary: CRT `_lock` implementation that enters a critical section by index from the global lock table. Lazily allocates and initializes the CRITICAL_SECTION on first use with thread-safe double-checked locking. Exits fatally via CRTAmsgExit if allocation fails.

0x0058e060.name: TLSAllocationThreadIDInit
0x0058e060.label: TLSAllocAndThreadIDInit
0x0058e060.summary: One-time initialization of thread-local storage for allocation tracking. Calls sub_58DFC1 to init critical sections, allocates TLS index via TlsAlloc, allocates 116-byte per-thread block via sub_58AB58, stores it in TLS via TlsSetValue, initializes it via TwoFieldInitializer_e0b4, and records current thread ID. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

0x0058e0b4.name: TwoFieldInitializer_e0b4
0x0058e0b4.label: Object vtable and field initializer
0x0058e0b4.summary: Initializes a C++ object's vtable pointer at offset +0x50 and an integer field at offset +0x14 to 1. Constructor fragment or init helper called during TLS/thread object setup.

0x0058e0c7.name: TLSValueRetrievalWithInit
0x0058e0c7.label: _getptd: per-thread data retrieval with lazy init
0x0058e0c7.summary: CRT `_getptd` (get per-thread data) implementation that retrieves the thread-local storage data block via TlsGetValue, lazily allocating a 116-byte structure and initializing it with thread ID and vtable on first access per thread. Preserves GetLastError across the call.

0x0058e12e.name: EncodingLocaleDetectionFromParseResult
0x0058e12e.label: Locale/code page encoding detection
0x0058e12e.summary: Parses a locale or encoding string to detect code page and encoding flags. Returns bitmask flags (0x80=ANSI/SBCS, 0x100=Unicode/DBCS?, 0x200=OEM), a double parameter, and byte count consumed. Used during CRT locale initialization.

0x0058e290.name: sub_58E290
0x0058e290.label: _write: file write with text-mode newline translation
0x0058e290.summary: CRT `_write` implementation that writes bytes to a file handle. In text mode, translates \n (0x0A) to \r\n (0x0D 0x0A) via 1024-byte chunks. Handles append-mode seeking, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED mapping to EBADF, and returns ENOSPC (28) on empty write without error.

0x0058e41b.name: sub_58E41B
0x0058e41b.label: BufferedIOContextInit
0x0058e41b.summary: Initializes a buffered I/O context struct for either file (unk_5E6768) or asset-bank (unk_5E6788) I/O. Validates handle, allocates 4KB heap buffer or falls back to 2-byte inline buffer, sets capacity and flags.

0x0058e4d2.name: sub_58E4D2
0x0058e4d2.label: FormattedInputScanFromIO (vfscanf-style)
0x0058e4d2.summary: Parses input from a buffered I/O context using a scanf-style format string. Handles integers (%d/%i/%u/%o/%x/%p), floats (%f/%e/%g), strings (%s/%S), character sets (%{...}), width, precision, and length modifiers. Returns count of successful conversions.

0x0058ef2e.name: BufferedByteReader
0x0058ef2e.label: ReadNextByteFromBuffer
0x0058ef2e.summary: Reads the next byte from a buffered I/O context. Decrements remaining count; if exhausted (negative), calls sub_58C255 to refill; otherwise returns byte at cursor and advances cursor.

0x0058ef83.name: PhysicsAllocatorNodeInit
0x0058ef83.label: PhysicsAllocatorNodeInit
0x0058ef83.summary: Initializes a physics allocator node and exception handler chain. If dword_8D3F44 (CRT DLL switch) is nonzero, allocates 172-byte block, initializes via sub_58F014, stores in off_5E99D0 (IOFunctionPtr), replaces old CRT exception handler (dword_8D3F58) with new block and frees old one. If switch is zero, sets IO function pointer to D3D callback and clears exception handler.

0x0058f362.name: sub_58F362
0x0058f362.label: Physics Allocator Node Destructor / Resource Cleanup
0x0058f362.summary: Iterates over 43 sub-object pointer slots in a physics allocator node and calls sub_58AA6F (a resource deallocation function) on each non-null pointer. Memory/resource management system.

0x0058f4f2.name: AudioCodecBufferAllocation
0x0058f4f2.label: LocaleDataInitAndDecimalSeparatorSet
0x0058f4f2.summary: Initializes locale data for number formatting. If locale flag (dword_8D3F40) is set, queries system locale info for digit grouping (0xE), leading zero (0xF), and decimal separator (0x10) via sub_5968F6, converts via InPlaceDigitCharConversionStripSemicolons, stores three buffers in off_5E9AC0, and sets byte_5E6BD8 (decimal separator). If flag is zero, allocates empty 2-byte buffers. Returns 0 on success, -1 on allocation failure.

0x0058f6c7.name: InPlaceDigitCharConversionStripSemicolons
0x0058f6c7.label: DigitCharToNibbleAndStripSemicolons
0x0058f6c7.summary: Converts a locale digit string in-place: ASCII '0'-'9' chars are converted to their nibble values (subtract 48), semicolons (';' = 59) are removed by left-shifting remaining characters, other characters are left unchanged. Used to parse locale digit grouping/format strings like "3;2;1" into binary array [3, 2, 1].

0x0058f6fe.name: PhysicsAllocatorNodeInit_f6fe
0x0058f6fe.label: AllocatorNodeInitWithLocaleData
0x0058f6fe.summary: Initializes an allocator node with locale data. If dword_8D3F3C (MemPool_AllocFlag) is set, allocates 48-byte block, calls sub_58F7C9 to populate locale fields, stores in off_5E9AC0, replaces ListManagerHead (dword_8D3F68). If flag is zero, copies off_5E9AC0 pointers to static sentinel (off_5E9A90/94/98) and clears the list manager.

0x0058f7c9.name: sub_58F7C9
0x0058f7c9.label: LocaleInfoQueryBulk
0x0058f7c9.summary: Queries system locale information for multiple LCTYPE categories (0x15 through 0x57) into a 48-byte structure. Fills fields at offsets +12 through +47 with locale data for currency grouping, currency decimals, currency symbols, positive/negative formatting, and other locale settings. Calls InPlaceDigitCharConversionStripSemicolons on the grouping field at +28.

0x0058f8eb.name: MultiFieldFree_f8eb
0x0058f8eb.label: MultiFieldFreeGuard
0x0058f8eb.summary: Frees 7 pointer fields (indices 3-9, offsets 0xC-0x24) from a structure via sub_58AA6F, but only if the structure's third field (index 3, offset 0xC) does not point to the static sentinel word_8D41CC. This protects static/read-only locale data from being freed.

0x0058f939.name: sub_58F939
0x0058f939.label: CodePageCharTypeTableInit
0x0058f939.summary: Initializes character type tables for the current code page. If dword_8D3F38 (DefaultLocale) is nonzero, queries code page info via GetCPInfo, builds 256-entry SBCS/DBCS character maps, converts to type tables via sub_595DC8/sub_596A2E, marks lead byte ranges with flag 0x8000 for DBCS, and stores in off_5E69C8/off_5E69CC. If zero, uses static table word_5E69D2.

0x0058fd90.name: sub_58FD90
0x0058fd90.label: LocaleResolveAndValidate
0x0058fd90.summary: Resolves a locale from language/region strings. Initializes locale info function pointer based on OS (GetLocaleInfoA on NT, sub_5904F7 on Win9x). Performs binary search matches of language string (a1) and region string (a1+64) against locale tables. Validates resulting code page and locale. Fills output structure with locale ID, language ID, and code page. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

0x0058ff65.name: sub_58FF65
0x0058ff65.label: LocaleEnumInitAndDispatch
0x0058ff65.summary: Initiates system locale enumeration to find a matching locale. Checks if language string is 3-letter code (vs alphabetical name), sets charset mode accordingly, then calls EnumSystemLocalesA with LocaleEnumProc callback. Validates that dword_8D3FB0 has required flags (0x100, 0x200, 0x7), resets to 0 if validation fails.

0x0058ffec.name: LocaleEnumProc
0x0058ffec.label: LocaleEnumProc
0x0058ffec.summary: Callback for EnumSystemLocalesA. Parses locale hex string to integer, queries locale region/language names via dword_8D3FB8 (locale info function), compares against target strings via sub_588410. Sets validation flags (dword_8D3FB0 bits) to track match quality: bit 0 = partial match, bit 1 = close match, bit 8 = region matched, bit 9 = charset matched. Returns TRUE to continue enumeration, FALSE to stop.

0x005901f0.name: sub_5901F0
0x005901f0.label: LocaleDetectionInit
0x005901f0.summary: Detects if language string is 3-letter ISO code, sets charset mode accordingly, then enumerates system locales to populate locale data.

0x00590246.name: sub_590246
0x00590246.label: LocaleEnumCallback
0x00590246.summary: Callback for EnumSystemLocalesA; checks each enumerated locale against the current language string and sets locale IDs on match.

0x00590303.name: sub_590303
0x00590303.label: LocaleRegionDetectionInit
0x00590303.summary: Detects if language region string is 3-letter and enumerates system locales with a callback for region matching.

0x0059033a.name: sub_59033A
0x0059033a.label: LocaleRegionEnumCallback
0x0059033a.summary: Callback for locale region enumeration; checks if locale ID region matches via range check against static table.

0x005903c0.name: sub_5903C0
0x005903c0.label: GetUserDefaultLocale
0x005903c0.summary: Gets the user default locale ID via Win32 API and stores it in locale globals.

0x005903da.name: sub_5903DA
0x005903da.label: GetCodePageLocaleName
0x005903da.summary: Retrieves locale name for a code page; uses CPInfo vtable if available, otherwise queries locale info via callback.

0x0059045f.name: sub_59045F
0x0059045f.label: LocaleIDValidation
0x0059045f.summary: Validates a locale ID by checking consistency against locale info data and language string characteristics.

0x005904f7.name: sub_5904F7
0x005904f7.label: LocaleInfoLookupWrapper
0x005904f7.summary: Binary-searches locale lookup table for known locale IDs; returns cached strings for common LCType values, falls back to GetLocaleInfoA for unknown locales or types.

0x0059070a.name: sub_59070A
0x0059070a.label: FPUExceptionHandler
0x0059070a.summary: Handles FPU arithmetic exceptions (underflow, overflow, precision) with FSCALE adjustments and dispatches to math error handler if configured.

0x005908b0.name: ExtendedPrecisionDivisionWithOverflowFixup
0x005908b0.label: ExtendedPrecisionDivWithOverflowCorrection
0x005908b0.summary: Performs extended-precision (80-bit _TBYTE) division with overflow fixup using table-guided scaling to avoid precision loss.

0x005910b6.name: sub_5910B6
0x005910b6.label: FPRemainderPrecisionHandler
0x005910b6.summary: Computes FP remainder with precision fixup; handles denormal/infinity/NaN cases and uses iterative subtraction or FPREM based on exponent difference.

0x0059163b.name: MathDispatchWithErrorFallback
0x0059163b.label: FloatParseDispatchWithFPEGuard
0x0059163b.summary: Gate for floating-point parsing — if FPE exception flag (dword_5E9AD0) is set, writes error code 33 to TLS slot, resets FPU control word with mask 0xFFFF, and returns input double unchanged; otherwise delegates to FloatParsingWithErrorHandling.

0x0059168f.name: ConditionalMathWithDAT005e9ad0Flag
0x0059168f.label: MathDispatchWithFpeGuardAndExceptionDecode
0x0059168f.summary: Dispatches floating-point operation based on decoded exception code bit flags. If sub_5919DA returns false, calls sub_591727 for exception context setup. Then if FPE flag (dword_5E9AD0) is set or decoded mode is zero, sets error code, resets FPU, returns fallback (a4); otherwise forwards to FloatParsingWithErrorHandling.

0x00591727.name: sub_591727
0x00591727.label: BuildFPUExceptionContextAndRaise
0x00591727.summary: Constructs an FPU exception context record from decoded exception code bits, FPU status/control word info, and two double operands; calls RaiseException to signal the exception; then translates the exception context results back to output parameters (precision/rounding mode, status flags).

0x005919da.name: sub_5919DA
0x005919da.label: FpuExceptionHandlerByControlWord
0x005919da.summary: Checks FPU exception code bits (a1, lower 5 bits) against FPU control word mask bits (a3). For each masked exception (divide-by-zero, denormal, underflow, overflow, inexact), applies the appropriate result value based on rounding mode and clears the bit. Returns TRUE when all exception bits are consumed/handled.

0x00591c79.name: SetErrorCodeBasedOnInputRange
0x00591c79.label: SetTlsErrorCodeByRange
0x00591c79.summary: Maps input integer to a TLS error code: value 1 → error 33, values 2-3 → error 34, other values → no-op. Returns either TLS slot address or input cast as pointer.

0x00591edf.name: sub_591EDF
0x00591edf.label: LocalTimeToTimestamp
0x00591edf.summary: Converts local date/time components to Unix timestamp with DST adjustment.

0x00591fa1.name: sub_591FA1
0x00591fa1.label: LocaleMapStringWithCodePageConversion
0x00591fa1.summary: Performs locale-sensitive string mapping (LCMapString — upper/lower case, sortkey, etc.) with automatic code-page conversion. Detects WideChar mode at runtime; in mode 2 calls LCMapStringA directly; in mode 1 converts ANSI→Wide→LCMapStringW→Wide→ANSI (or LCMapStringW→sortkey). Returns mapped length or 0 on failure.

0x005921c5.name: LazyInitSingletonWithFlagGuard
0x005921c5.label: LazyInitSingletonWithGuard
0x005921c5.summary: Thread-safe lazy initialization of CRT singleton via double-checked locking.

0x005921f3.name: sub_5921F3
0x005921f3.label: Timezone initialization (_tzset / CRT timezone setup)
0x005921f3.summary: Initializes the C runtime timezone globals by reading the Windows timezone information (GetTimeZoneInformation/WideCharToMultiByte) or parsing the TZ environment variable. Part of the CRT startup / locale initialization system.

0x0059249b.name: sub_59249B
0x0059249b.label: Daylight Saving Time (DST) Transition Check
0x0059249b.summary: Determines whether a given timestamp falls within Daylight Saving Time by checking against the Windows TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION structure. If the year has changed since last configuration, re-computes DST start/end transition dates via sub_592647.

0x00592647.name: sub_592647
0x00592647.label: DSTTransitionDateCalculator
0x00592647.summary: Calculates DST transition start/end dates based on year, month, week-of-month, day-of-week rules or fixed dates.

0x00592787.name: sub_592787
0x00592787.label: SecondsToCalendarTime
0x00592787.summary: Converts Unix timestamp to broken-down calendar time (year/month/day/hour/minute/second) with leap year handling, stored in TLS buffer.

0x00592891.name: sub_592891
0x00592891.label: FlushFileByIndex
0x00592891.summary: Flushes file buffers for an open file identified by index. Validates index against open file count, checks active flag in per-slot bitfield, enters critical section, calls FlushFileBuffers, reports errors via TLS. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure with TLS error 9.

0x00592924.name: sub_592924
0x00592924.label: CrtExceptionFilter
0x00592924.summary: CRT exception filter that maps structured exception codes to signal numbers and dispatches to registered exception handlers.

0x00592a9c.name: sub_592A9C
0x00592a9c.label: CommandLineSkipExeName
0x00592a9c.summary: Skips past the executable name in command line and returns pointer to argument list.

0x00592af4.name: sub_592AF4
0x00592af4.label: CRTEnvironmentParseInit
0x00592af4.summary: Parses the CRT environment string block into an array of individual environment variable pointers.

0x00592bad.name: sub_592BAD
0x00592bad.label: CommandLineToArgvParse
0x00592bad.summary: Parses command line into argc/argv array using two-pass parser, allocating required memory.

0x00592c46.name: sub_592C46
0x00592c46.label: CommandLineTokenParser
0x00592c46.summary: Parses command line string into argv array and argument strings, handling quotes, backslash escaping, and whitespace delimiters.

0x00592dfa.name: sub_592DFA
0x00592dfa.label: GetEnvironmentStringsBlock
0x00592dfa.summary: Retrieves process environment strings block, attempting Unicode (W) variant first with fallback to ANSI (A). Caches which variant succeeded in global flag for subsequent calls.

0x00592f2c.name: sub_592F2C
0x00592f2c.label: CRT_LowioInit
0x00592f2c.summary: Initializes CRT low-level I/O file entry table with inherited handles from parent process. Allocates 32-slot default table, extends if needed, and populates stdin/stdout/stderr slots.

0x005930e8.name: PEImageBaseAddressDetection
0x005930e8.label: ReadPEHeaderLinkerVersion
0x005930e8.summary: Retrieves the PE optional header linker major/minor version from the current process image's NT headers. Stores MajorLinkerVersion at field offset 0, MinorLinkerVersion at field offset 1, returns MinorLinkerVersion.

0x00593115.name: sub_593115
0x00593115.label: CRTHeapSelect
0x00593115.summary: Selects CRT heap implementation type using priority: Windows version check (NT 5+ → 1), `__MSVCRT_HEAP_SELECT` environment variable with global-heap or msvcrt-heap dispatch, or fallback based on PE linker major version.

0x0059325d.name: sub_59325D
0x0059325d.label: CRTHeapAndAllocatorInit
0x0059325d.summary: Creates CRT private heap via HeapCreate and initializes the sub-allocator matching heap selection (msvcrt heap or slab/buddy allocator). Stores heap type code in global for downstream use.

0x005932ba.name: sub_5932BA
0x005932ba.label: ErrorCleanupAndExitDisplay
0x005932ba.summary: Conditionally performs error cleanup and exit display. If ErrorDisplayFlag is 1 or console is attached (ConsoleAttachedFlag == 1 when flag unset), calls sub_5932F3(0xFC) for cleanup, runs optional InitCallbackFunc, then sub_5932F3(0xFF) for termination display. Otherwise returns 0 (no display needed).

0x005932f3.name: sub_5932F3
0x005932f3.label: ShowRuntimeErrorWithCodeLookup
0x005932f3.summary:
Looks up error code in a table of (code, string) pairs. If console is available, writes error string to stderr via WriteFile. Otherwise builds a "Runtime Error!

Program: <exe>

<description>" message box string displayed via sub_597234. Used as CRT error display handler.

0x00593446.name: sub_593446
0x00593446.label: CppExceptionHandlerDispatch
0x00593446.summary: C++ exception handler dispatch for CRT. Validates scope table magic and exception code, then routes to SEH-aware virtual dispatch or calls handler function pointer from exception record.

0x005934e1.name: sub_5934E1
0x005934e1.label: CppExceptionHandlerCall
0x005934e1.summary: C++ exception handler dispatch. Validates exception record (code 0xE06D7363), unwinds nested exceptions via TLS, binary-searches scope table for matching try-level range, and dispatches to matched catch handler by type comparison.

0x0059373e.name: StructMatchingWithBitFlagsStrcmp
0x0059373e.label: CppTypeDescriptorMatch
0x0059373e.summary: C++ exception type descriptor (RTTI) matching for catch handler selection. Compares type names via string comparison and validates const/volatile qualifier compatibility through bit flags.

0x0059379b.name: SEHAwareVirtualCallDispatchLoop
0x0059379b.label: ScopeTableUnwindLoop
0x0059379b.summary: C++ exception unwind loop that iterates scope table entries from current try level to target index, calling cleanup/destructor functions for each level traversed.

0x005938b4.name: SEHWrapperAroundCRTFunctionCall
0x005938b4.label: CxxExceptionSEHFrameWrapper
0x005938b4.summary: SEH wrapper that saves/restores TLS exception context around a try-block execution. On C++ exception (code 0xE06D7363) with non-zero return, dispatches through SEHWrappedRenderDispatchCall after abnormal termination check.

0x005939cf.name: FileMagicNumberValidator
0x005939cf.label: CppExceptionRecordValidate
0x005939cf.summary: Validates that a double-indirected pointer points to a well-formed C++ exception record: checks exception code 0xE06D7363, NumberParameters == 3, magic 0x19930520, and no nested continuation (ExceptionInformation[2] == 0).

0x005939f9.name: sub_5939F9
0x005939f9.label: SEHFrameSetupAndFixup
0x005939f9.summary: Sets up SEH frame data for C++ exception handling: validates source/destination pointers via IsBadReadPtr/IsBadWritePtr, computes frame offsets, and copies or dispatches through lock/unlock indirect call based on configuration flags.

0x00593bbd.name: SEHWrappedRenderDispatchCall
0x00593bbd.label: CppCatchHandlerDispatch
0x00593bbd.summary: Dispatches C++ catch handler by reading handler function pointer from exception record's handler table and calling via atomic lock/unlock wrapper with handler context data.

0x00593c9c.name: SEHWrapperDispatchingToHandlerFunction
0x00593c9c.label: CrtTerminateHandlerDispatch
0x00593c9c.summary: Checks TLS for a registered termination/cleanup handler (slot 24), calls it if present, then performs standard CRT cleanup sequence with fixed parameters and the passed parameter.

0x00593cfd.name: SEHGuardedFunctionPointerCall
0x00593cfd.label: LastResortSEHGuardFrame
0x00593cfd.summary: Sets up an SEH guard frame (__except_handler3) around an optional global function pointer call (off_5E7960, likely atexit/onexit handler), then delegates to CrtTerminateHandlerDispatch for final processing.

0x00593d53.name: EmptyStub_3d53
0x00593d53.label: EmptySuccessStub
0x00593d53.summary: Stub function that unconditionally returns 1. Used as placeholder or default handler in exception handling context.

0x00593dd3.name: sub_593DD3
0x00593dd3.label: MsvcrtHeapInit
0x00593dd3.summary: Initializes msvcrt CRT heap sub-allocator by allocating a 0x140-byte block from the private heap (hHeap) and initializing global heap state variables (cursor, max size, capacity, counters).

0x00593e46.name: sub_593E46
0x00593e46.label: SlabHeapFreeCoalesceBlock
0x00593e46.summary: Coalesces and frees a block in a custom slab buddy allocator. Merges adjacent free blocks, updates two-level free block bitmap (64 size classes), updates free-list pointers. Deallocates entire slab via VirtualFree/HeapFree when slab becomes empty. Updates allocator metadata globals.

0x0059416f.name: sub_59416F
0x0059416f.label: SlabHeapAllocateBlock
0x0059416f.summary: Allocates a block from the custom slab buddy allocator. Rounds request size up to 16-byte boundary, searches slab descriptors for suitable free block (wrapping cursor), splits remainder, updates two-level free bitmap and free lists. Returns pointer to allocated memory or 0 on failure.

0x00594478.name: sub_594478
0x00594478.label: SlabHeapAllocateNewSlab
0x00594478.summary: Allocates a new slab (32KB block) for the custom heap allocator. Grows slab descriptor array via HeapReAlloc if capacity exhausted. Allocates bitmap/free-list metadata (0x41C4 bytes) via HeapAlloc and slab memory (1MB reserve) via VirtualAlloc. Initializes descriptor fields and bitmap. Returns descriptor pointer or 0 on failure.

0x00594529.name: sub_594529
0x00594529.label: SlabHeapInitBitmapAndFreeLists
0x00594529.summary: Initializes a newly allocated slab for first use. Commits 32KB slab virtual memory via VirtualAlloc, initializes 64 free-list heads, sets up per-block header linked lists (free block chain), configures bitmap tracking entries, and updates slab descriptor flags. Returns slab size class index or -1 on VirtualAlloc failure.

0x00594624.name: sub_594624
0x00594624.label: SlabBuddyFree
0x00594624.summary: Frees a memory block in the slab/buddy allocator. Coalesces adjacent free blocks, splits oversize blocks, and updates the bitmap tracking for the appropriate size class.

0x0059491a.name: SlabBuddyAllocatorInitialization
0x0059491a.label: SlabBuddyAllocatorInit
0x0059491a.summary: Initializes the slab buddy allocator. Selects context (static pool or HeapAlloc), reserves 4MB virtual address space, commits initial 64KB, initializes per-block free lists and block headers in committed region. Returns allocator context pointer or 0 on allocation failure.

0x00594a5e.name: sub_594A5E
0x00594a5e.label: SlabBuddyAllocatorDestroy
0x00594a5e.summary: Destroys a slab buddy allocator context. Releases committed virtual memory via VirtualFree, unlinks from allocator linked list, frees context structure via HeapFree (for dynamic pools) or resets HeapMarker to static pool mode. Handles both dynamic and static pool contexts.

0x00594ab4.name: sub_594AB4
0x00594ab4.label: TrimAllocatorFreePages
