0x00594ab4.summary: Walks the allocator context linked list and decommits free pages (state 240) via VirtualFree, up to a given page limit. Updates live page counter and lowest-free pointer. If all 1024 pages in a context become free, destroys the entire context via sub_594A5E.

0x00594bcd.name: CounterThreshold
0x00594bcd.label: AllocatorPageCounterAndTrim
0x00594bcd.summary: Adds a byte value to a per-page counter in the allocator tracking array. When the counter reaches 240 and the total live page count hits 32, triggers a page trim (sub_594AB4 with limit 16). Clears the source byte after adding.

0x00594c12.name: sub_594C12
0x00594c12.label: SlabBuddyAllocateMemory
0x00594c12.summary: Allocates memory from the slab buddy allocator system. Iterates existing allocator contexts searching for a free block of sufficient size via sub_594E1A. If none found, creates a new context via SlabBuddyAllocatorInitialization. Returns allocated pointer or 0 on failure.

0x00594e1a.name: sub_594E1A
0x00594e1a.label: SlabSubAllocatorCarveBlock
0x00594e1a.summary: Carves a block from a pre-committed slab region using a bump/sub-allocator with byte-size headers. Tries the current cursor first; if insufficient space, scans previously allocated blocks for free gaps. Returns pointer to allocated memory or 0 if no fit.

0x005953b8.name: sub_5953B8
0x005953b8.label: ExtendedFloatToOutputFormat (80-bit to 32/64-bit)
0x005953b8.summary: Converts an internal 80-bit extended-precision float (stored as word array) to 32-bit or 64-bit IEEE float output. Extracts sign, biased exponent (bias 0x3FFF), mantissa; applies normalization, rounding, overflow/underflow detection. Returns status code (0=normal, 1=range-exceeded, 2=underflow).

0x005955aa.name: sub_5955AA
0x005955aa.label: FloatToStringDigitFormatter
0x005955aa.summary: Formats numeric digits into a string buffer with zero-padding and rounding. Handles carry propagation on rounding overflow and adjusts leading digit for floating-point to string conversion within CRT printf family.

0x005957bd.name: MemoryAllocatorInit
0x005957bd.label: BufferedIOContextInitSimple
0x005957bd.summary: Initializes a buffered I/O context with a 4KB heap buffer (via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc) or fallback 2-byte inline buffer. Sets cursor, remaining count (0), buffer base, size, and flags (heap=bit 3, inline=bit 2). Increments global file open counter.

0x00595801.name: sub_595801
0x00595801.label: AllocateFileSlot
0x00595801.summary: Allocates a file slot from the global file descriptor array (dword_8D4920, 32 slots per group, 36 bytes each). Scans for free slot (bit 0 clear), initializes per-slot critical section if needed, marks slot in-use. If no slot found, allocates new group. Returns slot index or -1 on failure.

0x00595924.name: sub_595924
0x00595924.label: CRTFileHandleAssign
0x00595924.summary: Assigns a Windows handle to a CRT file descriptor slot in the global array. Maps indices 0/1/2 to console standard handles (STD_INPUT/OUTPUT/ERROR) when console-attached flag (dword_5E65B4) is set.

0x00595a1f.name: sub_595A1F
0x00595a1f.label: CRTFileHandleRead
0x00595a1f.summary: Returns the raw Windows handle from a CRT file descriptor entry if the entry is marked open (bit 0 of flags at offset+4). Otherwise sets TLS error 9 and returns -1.

0x00595a61.name: CriticalSectionEnterWithLazyInit
0x00595a61.label: CRTFileCriticalSectionEnter
0x00595a61.summary: Enters the critical section for a CRT file descriptor index (a1). Lazily initializes the CRITICAL_SECTION at offset+12 via CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter/CritSectLeave guard if the init count at offset+8 is zero.

0x00595af9.name: sub_595AF9
0x00595af9.label: CRTFileOpenCreate
0x00595af9.summary: CRT file open/create wrapper around CreateFileA. Parses flag field (a2) into access mode, share mode, creation disposition, and flags-and-attributes; allocates a descriptor slot via sub_595801, assigns the handle via sub_595924, optionally reads first byte for EOF marker (0x1A) detection, and returns the file descriptor index or -1 on error.

0x00595dc8.name: sub_595DC8
0x00595dc8.label: CharacterStringTypeClassifier
0x00595dc8.summary: Classifies character types (via GetStringTypeW or GetStringTypeA) using a cached codepage mode. Mode detection first probes GetStringTypeW (Unicode path), falling back to GetStringTypeA (ANSI path). On Unicode path, converts input from multi-byte to wide char first via MultiByteToWideChar.

0x00596030.name: sub_596030
0x00596030.label: LocaleAwareWideCharToMultiByte
0x00596030.summary: Wrapper around sub_596089 (wide-to-multi-byte conversion) with thread-safe locale initialization guard. Increments heap lock counter, conditionally enters critical section (slot 19) if thread locale refcount (dword_8D5A58) is non-zero, then calls conversion and releases accordingly.

0x00596089.name: sub_596089
0x00596089.label: WideCharToMultiByteSingle
0x00596089.summary: Converts a single wide character (WideCharStr) to multi-byte via WideCharToMultiByte using the default CodePage. If no locale is set (dword_8D3F38 == 0) and the character is <= 0xFF, does a direct truncation. Returns byte count written, or -1 (TLS error 42) on failure.

0x00596175.name: sub_596175
0x00596175.label: MathErrorHandlerDispatch
0x00596175.summary: MSVCRT math error handler dispatcher. Examines the error type code at a2, selects a handler action (4, 17, 18, 8, 16) based on sequential comparisons, optionally invokes sub_5919DA for error logging, calls sub_591727 to set up arguments, and returns error code via SetErrorCodeBasedOnInputRange depending on FPE exception flag (dword_5E9AD0) and stub result.

0x00596245.name: sub_596245
0x00596245.label: CRTStringToFloatParser
0x00596245.summary: Parses a decimal/hexadecimal floating-point string into a packed 96-bit representation with sign, exponent, and mantissa. Handles leading whitespace, sign, integer/fractional digits, exponent suffix (e/E), and optional hex prefix. Returns classification code (0-4) indicating result type (zero, normal, overflow, underflow, NaN/etc).

0x00596773.name: sub_596773
0x00596773.label: MultiByteToWideCharSingle
0x00596773.summary: Converts a single multi-byte character to a wide character. If no locale is set (dword_8D3F38 == 0), does direct byte-to-wchar assignment. Otherwise uses CharTypeTable to check lead byte, then MultiByteToWideChar with the default CodePage, handling lead-byte sequences via cbMultiByte. Returns number of bytes consumed or -1 (TLS error 42) on failure.

0x005968f6.name: sub_5968F6
0x005968f6.label: LocaleInfoRetrieval
0x005968f6.summary: Retrieves Windows locale information (LCTYPE) for CRT locale support. Mode 1 returns string data with dynamic buffer allocation; mode 0 returns parsed numeric data from locale bytes.

0x00596a2e.name: sub_596A2E
0x00596a2e.label: CRTGetStringType
0x00596a2e.summary: Retrieves character type (ctype) information for a Unicode string. Auto-detects whether GetStringTypeW or GetStringTypeA is available, caches mode, and falls back to ANSI conversion when Unicode API is unavailable.

0x00596c80.name: sub_596C80
0x00596c80.label: StricmpLocaleAware
0x00596c80.summary: Case-insensitive string comparison with locale-aware (via character conversion helper) and ASCII-fast paths. Uses critical section for thread safety in locale mode.

0x00596d81.name: sub_596D81
0x00596d81.label: EnvStringLookupByKey
0x00596d81.summary: Searches a CRT string table (environment variables / command-line args) for a key=value pair. Returns pointer to the value after '=' using case-insensitive collation matching.

0x00596e40.name: sub_596E40
0x00596e40.label: CRTInitCodePage
0x00596e40.summary: Initializes CRT code page character type tables. Searches built-in code page table for matching entry; if found, copies character class ranges; otherwise falls back to system GetCPInfo. Establishes lead byte ranges for DBCS and locale constant mapping.

0x00596fed.name: sub_596FED
0x00596fed.label: CodePageResolver
0x00596fed.summary: Resolves special code page identifiers (0xFFFFFFFE=OEM, 0xFFFFFFFD=ANSI, 0xFFFFFFFC=default) to actual system code pages via GetOEMCP/GetACP. Sets global auto-flag for caller.

0x0059706a.name: sub_59706A
0x0059706a.label: LocaleStateReset
0x0059706a.summary: Resets locale/codepage global state variables to zero. Called during locale subsystem initialization to clear character bitmaps, code page flags, and locale pointers.

0x00597093.name: sub_597093
0x00597093.label: CharTypeTableInit
0x00597093.summary: Initializes character type classification table (byte_8D47E1) and case-mapping table (byte_8D46E0) using GetCPInfo for the current locale, or falls back to ASCII-only classification if code page info is unavailable. Part of the CRT locale/character-type subsystem.

0x00597234.name: sub_597234
0x00597234.label: MessageBoxWithActivePopup
0x00597234.summary: Displays a MessageBoxA using the last active popup window as parent. Lazily loads user32.dll and resolves MessageBoxA, GetActiveWindow, GetLastActivePopup function pointers on first call. Returns the MessageBox result or 0 if DLL load/resolution fails.

0x005972bd.name: sub_5972BD
0x005972bd.label: SEHExceptionFilterDispatch
0x005972bd.summary: SEH exception filter that inspects the exception record for a C++ exception signature (code 0xE06D7363, specific parameters). If matched, dispatches to the SEH wrapper handler; otherwise validates and calls a global exception handler pointer. Part of CRT exception handling infrastructure.

0x00597388.name: sub_597388
0x00597388.label: CRTHandlerDispatchByCommand
0x00597388.summary: Dispatches CRT handler operations (onexit, atexit, signal, exception, per-thread cleanup) by command ID. Acquires critical section, retrieves the appropriate function pointer from a global or TLS slot, calls it, restores saved state. Part of CRT initialization/teardown infrastructure.

0x00597568.name: CRTAdd12
0x00597568.label: UInt96Add
0x00597568.summary: Adds two 96-bit unsigned integers (stored as three dwords each: [0]=low, [1]=mid, [2]=high) with overflow propagation. Uses OverflowCheckedUnsignedAddition for each limb, cascading carry through low→mid→high.

0x005976e8.name: sub_5976E8
0x005976e8.label: FloatToStringFormatBCD
0x005976e8.summary: Converts a double/__int64 floating-point value to a formatted decimal string representation using BCD (96-bit packed) arithmetic. Handles special cases (zero, infinity, NaN, signaling NaN) and rounding. Part of the CRT locale-aware string formatting system.

0x0059797b.name: sub_59797B
0x0059797b.label: FileTruncateOrExtend
0x0059797b.summary: Truncates or extends a file to a specified size (lDistanceToMove). Saves current position, seeks to end to get file size, then either truncates via SetEndOfFile (if shrinking) or extends by writing zeros in 4096-byte chunks (if growing). Restores original file position on completion.

0x00597aa0.name: sub_597AA0
0x00597aa0.label: Packed96BitMultiply
0x00597aa0.summary: Multiplies two packed 96-bit floating-point values (sign+exponent in WORD at +10, mantissa in three dwords at +0/+2/+6). Extracts and adds exponents, computes sign (XOR), multiplies mantissas via 6-term cross-multiplication loop, normalizes result via shift-left/shift-right, rounds with guard bit, and packs result back. Returns the new exponent in EAX.

0x00597cc0.name: BitPackedDataDecodeViaLookupTable
0x00597cc0.label: Packed96BitScaleByPowerOf10
0x00597cc0.summary: Scales a packed 96-bit floating-point value (a1) by 10^a2 using lookup tables. Positive a2 uses dword_5E9C38-based table (powers of 10), negative a2 uses unk_5E9D98-based table (reciprocal powers). Each iteration processes 3 bits of the exponent (octal), selecting a precomputed table entry and multiplying via sub_597AA0. If a3 is zero, initializes output to zero first.

0x00597d3c.name: sub_597D3C
0x00597d3c.label: LocaleInfoStringGetter
0x00597d3c.summary: Retrieves locale information as a wide-character string, auto-detecting whether the system supports GetLocaleInfoW (Unicode) or requires fallback via GetLocaleInfoA + MultiByteToWideChar conversion. Caches the detected system locale type in dword_8D4200. Part of CRT locale support.

0x00597e4f.name: sub_597E4F
0x00597e4f.label: LocaleInfoAnsiGetter
0x00597e4f.summary: Retrieves locale information as an ANSI/multibyte string. Auto-detects whether GetLocaleInfoW is available; if so, fetches wide data and converts via WideCharToMultiByte; otherwise uses GetLocaleInfoA directly. Caches system type in dword_8D4204. Pair function to sub_597D3C (the wide-getter). Part of CRT locale support.

0x00597fac.name: WideCharMultiByteStringConversionWithAllocLoop
0x00597fac.label: WideStrListToMultiByteConvert
0x00597fac.summary: Iterates through a linked list of wide-character strings, converts each to multibyte via WideCharToMultiByte, allocates a buffer for each, calls sub_598323 to store the converted string. Returns 0 on success (full list processed), -1 on conversion or allocation failure. Part of CRT startup command-line/locale string processing.

0x0059807b.name: sub_59807B
0x0059807b.label: LocaleCompareStringAnsi
0x0059807b.summary: Compares two ANSI strings using locale-aware comparison. Auto-detects whether CompareStringW is available; if so, converts both strings to wide char via MultiByteToWideChar and uses CompareStringW; otherwise uses CompareStringA directly. Handles DBCS lead-byte edge cases for empty-string comparisons. Part of CRT locale string collation.

0x00598323.name: sub_598323
0x00598323.label: EnvStringTableInsert
0x00598323.summary: Parses a "KEY=VALUE" pair from an ANSI string and inserts it into a case-insensitive string table. Handles adding new entries, replacing existing ones, or removing (when value is empty). Optionally forwards to SetEnvironmentVariableA. Manages table memory allocation and wide-string conversion for the argument list. Part of CRT environment/locale string setup.

0x00598569.name: sub_598569
0x00598569.label: MbStrChrWithDBCS
0x00598569.summary: Searches for a character value in a multibyte string, handling DBCS lead bytes properly. If code page tables are uninitialized (dword_8D46CC == 0), delegates to a simple fallback. Otherwise uses character classification table to skip DBCS lead/trail byte pairs and compares against the target character. Under critical section. Part of CRT multibyte string handling.

0x00598731.name: ConstructorWithVTableFixup
0x00598731.label: IStreamVTableInit
0x00598731.summary: Initializes an std::istream object by writing the vftable pointer at the location derived from the vtable offset (vtable[1]) and chains to the next constructor step. Part of C++ standard library stream object construction.

0x00598775.name: VtableFixupWithDestructor
0x00598775.label: OStreamVTableWriteAndChain
0x00598775.summary: Writes the std::ostream vftable pointer into a stream object at the offset derived from the vtable metadata (vtable[1]), then chains to the next initialization/construction step. Part of C++ standard library stream object destruction/cleanup path.

0x00598994.name: RefCountDecrementWithCleanup
0x00598994.label: RefCountDecrementWithCleanup
0x00598994.summary: Decrements a global reference counter (dword_5E9EF4) and, if it reaches zero, performs cleanup by dispatching status/error checks on locale management and exception type descriptor globals. Locked via sub_59A54D/sub_59A5E9. Part of CRT locale/exception infrastructure teardown.

0x005989d7.name: LocaleObjectConstructorWithVtableInit
0x005989d7.label: LocaleStreamObjectConstruct
0x005989d7.summary: Constructs a locale-related C++ stream object by initializing vtable pointers (streambuf, ios, ostream), checking conditional fields for sub-object construction flags. Part of the C++ standard library locale/stream object initialization chain.

0x00598a41.name: sub_598A41
0x00598a41.label: LocaleStreamObjectConstructSimplified
0x00598a41.summary: Constructs a locale-related C++ stream object with vtable initialization for streambuf, ios, and ostream. Conditionally initializes sub-object based on a flag field, then chains to sub_59A8FA. Simpler variant of LocaleObjectConstructorWithVtableInit. Part of C++ locale/stream object construction.

0x00598aa0.name: StatusCheckWithErrorDispatch
0x00598aa0.label: StatusCheckWithErrorDispatch
0x00598aa0.summary: Examines an object's status via its vtable-dispatch function; if the status indicates failure (function returns -1) or the error flags are clear, calls sub_59A5FE to dispatch an error notification. Used for cleanup/teardown validation in the locale/exception infrastructure.

0x00598aea.name: VtableSetSubCall_8aea
0x00598aea.label: IosVtableSetAndTailCall
0x00598aea.summary: Sets the object's vtable pointer to std::ios::vftable, then tail-calls to another initialization routine at 0x59A86C. Part of C++ stream object construction chain.

0x00598af5.name: ObjectConstructorWithVTableSetupAndSEH
0x00598af5.label: IStreamObjectConstructWithInit
0x00598af5.summary: Constructs an istream-derived object with SEH handler setup. Conditionally initializes primary and ios vtables based on a flag, always sets istream vtable and calls ObjectInitWithVTableFlagSet. Part of C++ standard library stream construction.

0x00598b5d.name: ObjectConstructorWithSEHVtableInit
0x00598b5d.label: IStreamObjectConstructSimple
0x00598b5d.summary: Constructs an istream-derived object with SEH handler setup. Conditionally initializes primary and ios vtables based on a flag, always sets istream vtable, then chains to sub_59A8FA for final initialization. Part of C++ standard library stream construction.

0x00598bbc.name: ObjectConstructorWithSEHVTableInitChain
0x00598bbc.label: StreambufObjectConstructChain
0x00598bbc.summary: Constructs a streambuf-derived object with multi-phase vtable initialization. Acquires locale references for two sub-objects, sets up self-referential buffer pointers, and transitions vtable through multiple states (streambuf → off_5B9BCC). Part of C++ standard library streambuf construction with locale management.

0x00598c1c.name: LocaleRefcountAcquireUnderLock
0x00598c1c.label: LocaleRefcountAcquireUnderLock
0x00598c1c.summary: Stores a value (from sub_59AAB9) into this-owned storage, then under lock increments a global reference counter on the encoding singleton. Part of the CRT locale reference-counting mechanism for stream buffer objects.

0x00598c88.name: RefcountDecrementWithLock
0x00598c88.label: RefcountDecrementWithLock
0x00598c88.summary: Under lock, decrements the reference count field at offset 0x4 if non-zero and not -1 (sentinel). Returns the object pointer if the count reaches zero (indicating caller should clean up), otherwise returns 0. Part of the reference counting mechanism for locale/lock objects.

0x00598cc1.name: SetLocaleVTableCall
0x00598cc1.label: StreambufVtableResetAndDispatch
0x00598cc1.summary: Resets the object's vtable to std::streambuf::vftable (destructor-time vtable fixup) and dispatches a call through the locale sub-object at offset +52 (this+13). Part of C++ streambuf destructor chain.

0x00598cdc.name: StdBasicStreambufUflow
0x00598cdc.label: StreambufUflow
0x00598cdc.summary: Implements std::streambuf::uflow() (underflow) virtual method. Calls the virtual overflow/sync function at vtable offset 0x10 (slot 4) to refill the get area; if successful (not -1), reads one byte via MSVCStreambufGninc and returns it. Standard GCC/MSVC streambuf underflow implementation.

0x00598cf9.name: InputStreamReadWithBufferedFill
0x00598cf9.label: BufferedReadWithFill
0x00598cf9.summary: Reads bytes from buffered input stream. Copies from internal buffer if available; otherwise calls vtable function at index 5 to refill buffer or read single byte. Returns total bytes read.

0x00598d6d.name: OutputStreamWriteWithBufferFlushAbstraction
0x00598d6d.label: BufferedWriteWithFlush
0x00598d6d.summary: Writes bytes to buffered output stream. Copies to internal buffer if space available; otherwise calls vtable function at index 1 to flush buffer or write single byte. Returns total bytes written.

0x00598e2e.name: VTableInitOnly
0x00598e2e.label: VTablePointerInit
0x00598e2e.summary: Initializes object's vtable pointer (offset 0x0) to `off_5B9BCC`. Returns `this`. Unused second parameter.

0x00598e39.name: DestroyLocaleObjectFreeResourcesCallDtor
0x00598e39.label: LocaleObjectDtorWithFileAndBufferFree
0x00598e39.summary: Destructor for locale/file stream object. Closes file handle if byte at this+0x48 is set, decrements refcount and frees buffer at this+0x44, dispatches virtual cleanup on sub-object slots, transitions vtable to base `std::streambuf` vtable.

0x00598e9e.name: sub_598E9E
0x00598e9e.label: BufferedCharWriteWithCodecvtConversion
0x00598e9e.summary: Writes a single character to buffered output with optional codecvt encoding conversion. Handles direct buffer write, overflow via vtable dispatch, and multi-byte conversion via codecvt facet vtable call at index 5. Returns character written or -1 on error.

0x00598fd4.name: CharValidationAgainstEncodingTableWithLocaleFall
0x00598fd4.label: PutbackOrValidateCharWithCodecvt
0x00598fd4.summary: Validates a character for putback or output, handling encoding table check and codecvt conversion. Either returns character to putback buffer, validates backward scan with truncation, or writes raw byte to output. Returns character or -1 on error.

0x00599081.name: BufferedStreamReadWithFallbackVtableCall
0x00599081.label: BufferedReadSingleByte
0x00599081.summary: Reads one byte from buffered input stream. Returns buffered byte directly if available; otherwise calls vtable[5] (underflow) then vtable[2] (sputc) to refill and process.

0x005990ae.name: sub_5990AE
0x005990ae.label: BufferedReadCharWithCodecvtDecode
0x005990ae.summary: Reads one decoded character from buffered input stream with codecvt encoding conversion. Returns buffered byte directly if available; otherwise reads via StreamGetcWithUnderflowHandler, converts through codecvt vtable[4] (do_in), and handles partial/error results.

0x005991c3.name: LocaleEncodingStateQuery
0x005991c3.label: EncodingStateQueryWithLocaleFallback
0x005991c3.summary: Queries encoding state structure from locale object. Returns 24-byte state blob copied to output buffer. Falls back to default state if encoding doesn't match or stream read fails.

0x00599232.name: ConditionalDelegateCallWithNullGuard
0x00599232.label: DelegateCallWithNullGuard
0x00599232.summary: Calls delegate function via pointer at this+0x50. Returns this on success, 0 if delegate is NULL or call fails.

0x005992ef.name: BufferAppendWithMemset
0x005992ef.label: BufferAppendWithMemsetFill
0x005992ef.summary: Appends `a2` bytes of value `a3` to a growable buffer. Checks for overflow, validates new position, fills via sub_58BB10 (memset-like), updates size at this+0x8, and null-terminates. Returns this.

0x00599348.name: BufferTruncationShrink
0x00599348.label: BufferTruncateRemoveRange
0x00599348.summary: Removes `a3` bytes from buffer starting at offset `a2`. Shifts remaining data, updates size at this+0x8, and null-terminates. Validates bounds before operation.

0x005993af.name: ReferenceCountDecrementWithConditionalFree
0x005993af.label: RefCountDecWithConditionalFree
0x005993af.summary: Decrements byte-sized reference count stored at data[-1]. Frees allocation if refcount reaches 0 or 0xFF. Zeroes offsets 0x4, 0x8, 0xC on completion. Skip decrement if a2 flag is 0.

0x005993eb.name: ObjectInitWithVTableFlagSet
0x005993eb.label: ObjectInitFieldsWithFlagCheck
0x005993eb.summary: Initializes object fields: zeroes this+0x2C, sets this+0x28 to a2, sets this+0x30 flag byte to 32. Calls StructFieldInitWithConditionalCall. If a2 is NULL, sets bit 2 on flag at this+0x4 and calls sub_59A5FE. Optionally calls sub_59A8FA if a3 is set.

0x0059942b.name: sub_59942B
0x0059942b.label: EncodingStateObjectInit
0x0059942b.summary: Initializes encoding state object: sets offset 0x0 to a2, zeroes offsets 0x8 and 0xC, calls locale init sub_59A54D, sets offset 0x10 from CRT global dword_8D5A6C, calls cleanup sub_59A5E9. Returns this.

0x00599465.name: RefCountIncDec
0x00599465.label: BufferPositionIncDec
0x00599465.summary: Adjusts buffer position counters: increments value at this+0x2C (remaining/available count) and decrements value at this+0x1C (read pointer offset). Returns decremented value. Used for putback operation.

0x00599475.name: MSVCStreambufGninc
0x00599475.label: StreambufGetPtrIncrement
0x00599475.summary: MSVC streambuf get-pointer increment (gninc). Pre-decrements remaining count at this+0x2C, then returns current byte from read pointer at this+0x1C and increments it. Advances buffer read position by one byte.

0x00599485.name: sub_599485
0x00599485.label: StreambufPutPtrIncrement
0x00599485.summary: MSVC streambuf put-pointer increment (write side). Pre-decrements remaining space count at this+0x30, then returns current byte from write pointer at this+0x20 and increments it. Advances buffer write position by one byte.

0x005994bc.name: ObjectInitializationWithBufferBoundsSetup
0x005994bc.label: StreambufConstructorWithBufferBounds
0x005994bc.summary: Constructs MSVC streambuf object. Sets up buffer boundary pointers (eback/gptr/egptr/pptr/epptr), acquires locale refcount if a3==0, initializes self-referential pointer ring, sets capacity from dword_8D5A68. Returns this.

0x00599534.name: BufferBoundaryMarkerCheckSet
0x00599534.label: BufferBoundaryMarkerCheckAndSet
0x00599534.summary: Checks buffer boundary marker byte at data[-1] (this+0x4). If marker is non-zero and not 0xFF, validates via sub_599560. Then unconditionally sets marker to 0xFF (sentinel). Returns previous marker value.

0x00599560.name: sub_599560
0x00599560.label: BufferValidateAndResize
0x00599560.summary: Validates buffer state via boundary marker at data[-1] (this+0x4). Handles three scenarios: decrement refcount with cleanup, set size to zero and null-terminate, or trigger reallocation via BufferAllocationWithSizeRounding. Returns 0 (ok) or 1 (needs reallocation). Size parameter passed via stack.

0x00599615.name: BufferWriteWithNullTerminate
0x00599615.label: BufferWriteWithNullTerminate
0x00599615.summary: Writes `a3` bytes from source `a2` to buffer at this+0x4. Validates/resizes buffer via sub_599560 first, then copies data, updates size at this+0x8 to `a3`, and null-terminates. Returns this.

0x0059964a.name: BufferAllocationWithSizeRounding
0x0059964a.label: BufferReallocWithSizeRounding
0x0059964a.summary: Reallocates growable buffer with size rounded up to 32-byte boundary. Allocates via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper with +2 bytes for boundary marker, copies old data, frees old buffer via ReferenceCountDecrementWithConditionalFree, updates data pointer (this+0x4), size (this+0x8), capacity (this+0xC). Returns new data pointer.

0x005998a1.name: VTableFixupDuringConstruction
0x005998a1.label: VTableConstructorFixup
0x005998a1.summary: C++ constructor vtable fixup: reads vcall offset from vtable slot at index 1 (offset 0x4), then writes `std::basic_istream<unsigned short>::vftable` to `this + offset`. Tail-calls to 0x599BE5.

0x005998e5.name: VTableSetSubCall
0x005998e5.label: VTableConstructorFixupOStream
0x005998e5.summary: C++ constructor vtable fixup for ostream base: reads vcall offset from vtable slot at index 1 (offset 0x4), writes `std::basic_ostream<unsigned short>::vftable` at `this + offset`. Tail-calls to 0x599BE5.

0x00599ad9.name: RefCountDecrementWithCheck
0x00599ad9.label: Ref count decrement with zero-check cleanup
0x00599ad9.summary: Decrements reference counter at dword_5EA04C; if counter reaches zero, dispatches cleanup/status check on three objects (byte_8D4568, dword_8D4400, dword_8D4440). Wrapped by SEH frame setup/teardown.

0x00599b1c.name: CEHFrameSetup
0x00599b1c.label: CEH frame setup with conditional stream init
0x00599b1c.summary: Registers SEH handler for C++ exception handling, conditionally initializes a stream object's vtable chain (basic_ostream/basic_ios) and optionally calls StreamCreationWithFlagInit to open a stream if the flag at offset 0x10 is set.

0x00599b86.name: ObjectConstructorWithVtableSetup
0x00599b86.label: Object constructor with vtable chain setup
0x00599b86.summary: Registers SEH handler, conditionally initializes an object's vtable chain (basic_ostream, basic_ios, unk_5B9C54) when guard at offset 0xC is non-zero, then calls sub_59A8FA on the vtable-adjusted this pointer to complete object construction.

0x00599be5.name: SetLocaleVTableDtor
0x00599be5.label: Set locale vtable and destruct
0x00599be5.summary: Sets vtable pointer to basic_ios vtable for locale object, then calls ObjectDestructorWithRefCountDecrement on the same object.

0x00599bf0.name: LocaleObjectAllocAndVtableSetup
0x00599bf0.label: Locale/istream object alloc and vtable setup
0x00599bf0.summary: Registers SEH handler, allocates locale/istream object with conditional vtable chain (locale vtable + basic_ios), then calls StreamCreationWithFlagInit to complete stream construction.

0x00599c58.name: CConstructorWithSEH
0x00599c58.label: Istream constructor with SEH and locale vtable init
0x00599c58.summary: Registers SEH handler, conditionally applies locale vtable chain (locale vtable + basic_ios), sets up istream vtable on adjusted this pointer, and calls sub_59A8FA to complete istream construction.

0x00599cb7.name: LocaleObjectConstructorWithVTableSetup
0x00599cb7.label: Locale streambuf constructor with refcount and buffer init
0x00599cb7.summary: Registers SEH handler, acquires reference counts on two locale facets (at offsets 0x34 and 0x4C), initializes self-referential pointer ring, sets up vtable chain (basic_streambuf → custom vtable off_5B9C68), and assigns buffer data pointer via ObjectInitWithBufferDataPointerAssignment.

0x00599d52.name: StreamCharReaderWithBufferFillGetcFallback
0x00599d52.label: Stream char reader with buffer fill and getc fallback
0x00599d52.summary: Reads wide characters from stream buffer using chunk copy (fast path) when internal buffer is available and non-empty; falls back to per-character virtual getc call (vtable slot 5) when buffer is exhausted. Returns total characters read.

0x00599dd9.name: sub_599DD9
0x00599dd9.label: Stream char writer with buffer flush and putc fallback
0x00599dd9.summary: Writes wide characters to stream write buffer (fast path using chunk copy) when internal buffer is available and has space; falls back to per-character virtual putc call (vtable slot 1) when buffer is full. Returns total characters written.

0x00599e66.name: VTablePointerSetter
0x00599e66.label: VTable pointer setter to off_5B9C68
0x00599e66.summary: Sets this->vtable to off_5B9C68 and returns this pointer.

0x00599e71.name: CDestructorWithVTableChain
0x00599e71.label: Streambuf destructor with vtable chain teardown
0x00599e71.summary: Tears down streambuf/locale object under SEH protection: sets vtable to off_5B9C68, conditionally runs cleanup callback based on flag at offset 0x48, frees allocated buffer at offset 0x44 after ref-count decrement, virtual-dispatches cleanup on locale facets at offsets 0x4C and 0x34, resets vtable to basic_streambuf.

0x0059a103.name: sub_59A103
0x0059a103.label: Locale-aware char extraction with format conversion
0x0059a103.summary: Extracts wide character from stream with locale-aware format conversion. Fast path returns buffered char via StdGninc; main path reads chars through a format-conversion pipeline using virtual vtable[4] callback on locale facet at offset 0x38; falls back to IOFormatWrapper when no facet exists.

0x0059a221.name: sub_59A221
0x0059a221.label: Formatted input read with buffer setup and fallback
0x0059a221.summary: Reads formatted input from stream at this+0x50 through a forwarding/filtering pipeline (FileIOForwardingWrapper, sub_587F64, StringStreamReadWithMaskCheck). On success, resets buffer at this+0x44 and stores status at this[16]; on failure, generates default result via sub_59942B. Copies 0x18-byte result structure to output.

0x0059a3a9.name: StreamCreationWithFlagInit
0x0059a3a9.label: Stream creation with flag init and optional finalize
0x0059a3a9.summary: Initializes stream object: stores handle at offset 0x28, resets flag at offset 0x2C to 0, writes a space byte to stream at offset 0x30, conditionally opens stream (via sub_59A5FE) when handle is null by setting bit 2 on flags at offset 0x4, and optionally calls sub_59A8FA to finalize construction based on a3 parameter.

0x0059a3f3.name: PointerAdjustment
0x0059a3f3.label: Buffer pointer adjustment after read/write
0x0059a3f3.summary: After reading or writing `a2` wide characters, decrements remaining character count (via double-indirect pointer at this+0x2C) and advances buffer position (via double-indirect pointer at this+0x1C) by 2*a2 bytes.

0x0059a407.name: PointerOffsetAdjuster
0x0059a407.label: Buffer pointer putback/ungetc adjustment
0x0059a407.summary: Reverses one wide-character read: increments remaining character count (via double-indirect at this+0x2C) and moves buffer position back by 2 bytes (via this+0x1C). Implements putback/ungetc operation.

0x0059a428.name: DoubleIndirectCounterUpdate
0x0059a428.label: Write buffer pointer adjustment after write
0x0059a428.summary: After writing `a2` wide characters to write buffer, decrements remaining space (via double-indirect pointer at this+0x30) and advances buffer position (via double-indirect pointer at this+0x20) by 2*a2 bytes.

0x0059a43c.name: StreamBufferPointerAdjust
0x0059a43c.label: Consume next char from buffer with pointer advance
0x0059a43c.summary: Consumes next wide character from buffer: decrements remaining count at this+0x30, reads current value from position pointer at this+0x20, then advances that pointer by 2 bytes. Returns the consumed character value.

0x0059a473.name: ObjectInitWithBufferDataPointerAssignment
0x0059a473.label: Buffer/stream object init with data pointer and capacity
0x0059a473.summary: Initializes buffer/stream object: stores flag at offset 0x48 based on a3 parameter, conditionally acquires locale reference count on facet at offset 0x4C, calls SelfReferentialPointerRingInit, stores external buffer data pointer at offset 0x50, and sets capacity boundaries from global dword_8D5A60.

0x0059a4c9.name: SelfReferentialPointerRingInit
0x0059a4c9.label: Self-referential pointer ring init for buffer
0x0059a4c9.summary: Initializes a self-referential ring of pointers within the object: each buffer control slot at offsets 0xC, 0x10, 0x1C, 0x20, 0x2C, 0x30 is set to point to another field within the same object (forming a ring topology), and all pointed-to target fields are zeroed. Establishes the internal buffer position/metadata pointer structure for a streambuf-style object.

0x0059a54d.name: sub_59A54D
0x0059a54d.label: Critical section init-and-enter with spin wait
0x0059a54d.summary: Thread-safe one-time initialization of global critical section at 008d45f8. Uses InterlockedExchange for atomic state machine (Target: 0=uninit, 1=initializing, 2=ready); spins with Sleep(1) while another thread initializes. On completion, enters the critical section.

0x0059a5fe.name: sub_59A5FE
0x0059a5fe.label: IO state check and error exception throw
0x0059a5fe.summary: Checks iostream state bits (ios::eofbit/failbit/badbit) against a mask; if error bits are set, constructs and throws a std::ios_base::failure exception with appropriate error message string ("ios::eofbit set", "ios::failbit set", or "ios::badbit set").

0x0059a69a.name: CExceptionInitHandler
0x0059a69a.label: C++ runtime_error exception init handler
0x0059a69a.summary: Initializes a C++ std::runtime_error exception object: copies string from byte_5EA438, stores first byte from caller-provided buffer at this+0xC, decrements reference count on embedded sub-object at this+0xC, calls sub_59A9CA, and sets vtable to runtime_error.

0x0059a6fe.name: GetterOrFallback
0x0059a6fe.label: Getter with null fallback to sentinel
0x0059a6fe.summary: Returns pointer at this+0x10 if non-null, otherwise returns fallback sentinel &unk_5B9D34 (null-string placeholder).

0x0059a728.name: ExceptionCleanupWithDestructorCall
0x0059a728.label: Exception cleanup with runtime_error vtable and destructor
0x0059a728.summary: Sets vtable to std::runtime_error, decrements reference count on embedded sub-object at offset 0xC with conditional free flag, then calls MSVCExceptionDestructor to finalize exception object cleanup.

0x0059a781.name: ExceptionObjectConstructor
0x0059a781.label: Exception object constructor with string copy and flag transfer
0x0059a781.summary: Constructs `std::runtime_error` exception object. Copies source string via StrlenAllocCopyConstructorPattern, transfers a byte flag from source to new object at offset 0xC, initializes SEH handler, and sets vtable.

0x0059a7de.name: DestructorWithSEHVTableReset
0x0059a7de.label: Exception destructor with vtable reset and SEH
0x0059a7de.summary: Destructor for `std::runtime_error` exception object. Resets vtable to runtime_error, decrements reference count on internal buffer, and chains to MSVCExceptionDestructor.

0x0059a81b.name: CExceptionThrowWrapper
0x0059a81b.label: C++ exception throw wrapper for ios_base::failure
0x0059a81b.summary: Throws `std::ios_base::failure` exception. Calls sub_59A854 to construct the exception, invokes CxxThrowException8 with the failure type info, then runs destructor cleanup. If the stack buffer flag bit 0 is set, frees allocated memory.

0x0059a854.name: sub_59A854
0x0059a854.label: ios_base::failure exception constructor
0x0059a854.summary: Constructs `std::ios_base::failure` exception object. Calls ExceptionObjectConstructor to build the runtime_error base, then overrides vtable pointer with ios_base::failure vtable.

0x0059a86c.name: ObjectDestructorWithRefCountDecrement
0x0059a86c.label: Object destructor with reference count array decrement
0x0059a86c.summary: Destructor that decrements object's reference count in a global array at byte_8D463C. If count reaches zero or index is null, calls sub_59A980 for full cleanup. Calls NullCheckWithVirtualDispatch on offset 0x20.

0x0059a8d8.name: CallbackChainIteration
0x0059a8d8.label: Callback chain linked-list iteration
0x0059a8d8.summary: Iterates a singly-linked callback list rooted at this+0x1C. For each node, calls the function pointer at node offset 0x8 with (a2, this, node_userdata), where node_userdata is at offset 0x4.

0x0059a8fa.name: sub_59A8FA
0x0059a8fa.label: CRT termination table registration
0x0059a8fa.summary: Registers `this` object in the global CRT termination function table (dword_8D4618). Searches for an empty or self-matching slot (index < 8), stores pointer, increments ref count in byte_8D463C at that index.

0x0059a980.name: sub_59A980
0x0059a980.label: Object teardown with callback chain free
0x0059a980.summary: Tears down object by invoking callbacks via CallbackChainIteration, then frees two singly-linked callback lists (at this+0x18 and this+0x1C) via FreeWrapper_7bcf and clears their head pointers.

0x0059a9ca.name: sub_59A9CA
0x0059a9ca.label: String buffer subrange assignment
0x0059a9ca.summary: Assigns a subrange of source string buffer `a2` to destination `this`. If self-assignment, truncates via BufferTruncationShrink. Otherwise attempts reference-counted sharing when copying the full string; falls back to allocation + memcpy for partial ranges or large strings.

0x0059aab9.name: sub_59AAB9
0x0059aab9.label: Encoding singleton lazy initializer
0x0059aab9.summary: Lazily initializes encoding singleton at dword_8D4650. On first call, allocates 40-byte object, constructs it via ObjectConstructorWithVTableAndStringInit, sets code page ID at offset 0x10 to 63, copies a string from dword_5B9D44 into buffer at offset 0x18, links it to global manager pointers, and increments reference count.

0x0059abcd.name: ObjectConstructorWithVTableAndStringInit
0x0059abcd.label: Locale facet object constructor with vtable and string init
0x0059abcd.summary: Constructs a locale facet object. Sets ref count to 1, initial vtable to std::locale::facet, copies flag bytes from parameters to offsets 0x14 and 0x18, zeroes offsets 0x8-0x10, initializes a null-terminated string buffer at offset 0x18 from global word_5C406C, then overrides vtable with off_5B9D4C.

0x0059ac3f.name: VTablePointerSetter_ac3f
0x0059ac3f.label: VTable reset to std::locale::facet
0x0059ac3f.summary: Overwrites this->vtable with std::locale::facet vtable pointer. Minimal single-write function used during destructor vtable reset.

0x0059ac46.name: StdLocaleFacetDestructor
0x0059ac46.label: std::locale::facet destructor with conditional free
0x0059ac46.summary: Destructor for `std::locale::facet`. Resets vtable to facet vtable, then conditionally frees the object if flag `(a2 & 1)` is set.

0x0059ac7f.name: ObjectTeardownWithIteratorCleanup
0x0059ac7f.label: Locale facet array-based object teardown
0x0059ac7f.summary: Destroys a locale facet object containing an array of facet pointers. Iterates the facet array (count at this+0xC, array at this+0x8), decrements each facet's reference count via RefcountDecrementWithLock and conditionally destroys it. Frees the array allocation, releases the string buffer at this+6, and resets vtable to std::locale::facet.

0x0059ad49.name: sub_59AD49
0x0059ad49.label: Throw std::length_error exception
0x0059ad49.summary: Constructs and throws a `std::length_error` exception with message "string too long". Initializes the exception via CExceptionInitHandler_ada3, sets length_error vtable, then calls CxxThrowException8 with the length_error type info.

0x0059ada3.name: CExceptionInitHandler_ada3
0x0059ada3.label: C++ logic_error exception initializer
0x0059ada3.summary: Constructs a `std::logic_error` exception object. Copies a string from byte_5EA438 via StringCopyConstructor, transfers a flag byte from the parameter struct to new object at offset 0xC, replaces the string buffer with a copy from the parameter, and sets vtable to std::logic_error.

0x0059ae24.name: ExceptionDestructorSEHWrapper
0x0059ae24.label: std::logic_error destructor with SEH
0x0059ae24.summary: Destructor for `std::logic_error` exception object. Resets vtable to logic_error, decrements reference count on internal buffer, and chains to MSVCExceptionDestructor.

0x0059ae7d.name: CObjectConstructorWithVtable
0x0059ae7d.label: logic_error exception object constructor
0x0059ae7d.summary: Constructs `std::logic_error` exception object. Copies source string via StrlenAllocCopyConstructorPattern, transfers a byte flag from source to new object at offset 0xC, initializes SEH handler, replaces string buffer via sub_59A9CA, and sets vtable.

0x0059aeda.name: ExceptionDestructor
0x0059aeda.label: std::logic_error destructor with SEH
0x0059aeda.summary: Destructor for `std::logic_error` exception object. Resets vtable to logic_error, decrements reference count on internal buffer, and chains to MSVCExceptionDestructor.

0x0059af17.name: CExceptionThrowWrapper_af17
0x0059af17.label: C++ exception throw wrapper for std::length_error
0x0059af17.summary: Throws `std::length_error` exception. Calls VTableConstructor to build the exception, invokes CxxThrowException8 with length_error type info, then runs ExceptionDestructor cleanup. If the stack buffer flag bit 0 is set, frees allocated memory.

0x0059af50.name: VTableConstructor
0x0059af50.label: std::length_error exception vtable constructor
0x0059af50.summary: Constructs `std::length_error` exception object. Calls CObjectConstructorWithVtable (logic_error base), then overrides vtable pointer with std::length_error vtable.

0x0059af68.name: sub_59AF68
0x0059af68.label: Throw std::out_of_range exception
0x0059af68.summary: Constructs and throws a `std::out_of_range` exception with message "invalid string position". Initializes the exception via CExceptionInitHandler_ada3, sets out_of_range vtable, then calls CxxThrowException8 with the out_of_range type info.

0x0059afc2.name: ExceptionObjectDestructorWithSEH
0x0059afc2.label: std::logic_error destructor with SEH
0x0059afc2.summary: Destructor for `std::logic_error` exception object. Resets vtable to logic_error, decrements reference count on internal buffer, and chains to MSVCExceptionDestructor.

0x0059afff.name: ExceptionThrowWrapper
0x0059afff.label: C++ exception throw wrapper for std::out_of_range
0x0059afff.summary: Throws `std::out_of_range` exception. Calls ObjectInitWithVTable_b038 to build the exception, invokes CxxThrowException8 with out_of_range type info, then runs ExceptionObjectDestructorWithSEH cleanup. If the stack buffer flag bit 0 is set, frees allocated memory.

0x0059b038.name: ObjectInitWithVTable_b038
0x0059b038.label: std::out_of_range exception vtable constructor
0x0059b038.summary: Constructs `std::out_of_range` exception object. Calls CObjectConstructorWithVtable (logic_error base), then overrides vtable pointer with std::out_of_range vtable.

0x0059b260.name: sub_59B260
0x0059b260.label: VersionedArgumentPackParser
0x0059b260.summary: Packs four parameters into argument array, validates against version string "1.13" (a113_0) via ArgumentReorderWrapper, dispatches to sub-function sub_5357E0 for processing, and writes output pointer to *a2 on success. Part of data/serialization loading system (callers include MeshVertexIndexBufferLoader).

0x0059b2f0.name: sub_59B2F0
0x0059b2f0.label: SurfaceAllocationConstructor
0x0059b2f0.summary: Allocates and initializes a DirectX surface/bitmap structure with pixel buffer (size a2) and clip-rectangle array (count a4), storing dimensions a3/a5 (defaulted to 1 if zero).

0x0059b3b0.name: sub_59B3B0
0x0059b3b0.label: SurfaceCopyReallocAssign
0x0059b3b0.summary: Copies surface structure fields from source (a2) to destination (this), reallocating pixel buffer and clip-rect array if destination capacity is too small, then copies pixel data and clip-rect data.

0x0059b490.name: sub_59B490
0x0059b490.label: BitmapAllocGrow
0x0059b490.summary: Grows bitmap allocation buffer when needed, using geometric growth (adding growth stride +0x18 per iteration) capped at 128000 bytes; copies old data and frees previous buffer.

0x0059b530.name: GrowDynamicElementArray
0x0059b530.label: GrowElementArray
0x0059b530.summary: Grows the clip-rect/element array (2 WORDs per entry) when current count+1 exceeds capacity, using stride-based geometric growth.

0x0059b5c0.name: BitmapAllocationTracker
0x0059b5c0.label: AllocateBitmapRange
0x0059b5c0.summary: Allocates a range of `a2` units in a bitmap tracker: clears bits (marks used) in underlying bitmap, records allocation in element array with cumulative counter, returns slot index via `*a3`.

0x0059b650.name: sub_59B650
0x0059b650.label: FileHandleDupTransfer
0x0059b650.summary: Duplicates an open file handle from slot `a1` into a new slot via DuplicateHandle, transfers it to a new index, and updates status flags under critical section protection.

0x0059b760.name: sub_59B760
0x0059b760.label: QueryFileInformationToBuffer
0x0059b760.summary: Queries file information (type, attributes, size, timestamps) for open file slot `a1` and populates a result buffer at `TotalBytesAvail`; handles disk files, character devices, and pipes with different field layouts.

0x0059ba1d.name: sub_59BA1D
0x0059ba1d.label: SetPerDriveCurrentDir
0x0059ba1d.summary: Sets the per-drive current directory environment variable (e.g., "=C:") by changing to the specified path, retrieving the full directory, and calling SetEnvironmentVariableA; skips UNC paths.

0x0059baa3.name: TypeInfoDestructor
0x0059baa3.label: TypeInfoDestructor
0x0059baa3.summary: Destructor for MSVC RTTI type info object: restores vtable pointer and frees the type descriptor name string under critical section 27.

0x0059bb00.name: sub_59BB00
0x0059bb00.label: StreamBufferSetup
0x0059bb00.summary: Configures stream buffer for I/O: validates mode/size parameters, selects internal (embedded) buffer, external caller buffer, or heap-allocated buffer; initializes buffer pointers, size, and flags under critical section.

0x0059bbd9.name: sub_59BBD9
0x0059bbd9.label: StreamWriteWChar
0x0059bbd9.summary: Writes a WCHAR character to an output stream buffer; in wide mode stores directly, in narrow mode converts to multibyte sequence via sub_596030 before writing each byte.

0x0059bcfc.name: sub_59BCFC
0x0059bcfc.label: StreamUngetWChar
0x0059bcfc.summary: Pushes a WCHAR character back into input stream buffer (analogous to ungetwc); handles wide (direct WCHAR push) and narrow (multibyte conversion via sub_596030) modes.

0x0059be0c.name: sub_59BE0C
0x0059be0c.label: StreamReadWChar
0x0059be0c.summary: Reads one WCHAR from input stream; wide mode reads 2 bytes directly from buffer, narrow mode reads 1-2 multibyte bytes and converts to WCHAR via sub_596716.

0x0059bf19.name: StringCopyConstructor
0x0059bf19.label: ExceptionStringCopyCtor
0x0059bf19.summary: Copy constructor for exception string: copies message from source exception into newly allocated buffer, sets vtable (exception vftable) and refcount to 1.

0x0059bf56.name: StrlenAllocCopyConstructorPattern
0x0059bf56.label: SharedStringCopyCtor
0x0059bf56.summary: Copy constructor for exception string with conditional deep copy: if source refcount at a2+8 is non-zero, allocates new buffer and copies string; if zero, shares source pointer without copy.

0x0059bfa0.name: MSVCExceptionDestructor
0x0059bfa0.label: MSVCExceptionDestructor
0x0059bfa0.summary: Destructor for MSVC exception object: frees owned string buffer if refcount is non-zero; skips free if string is borrowed/shared (refcount == 0).

0x0059bfb6.name: ExceptionMessageGetter
0x0059bfb6.label: ExceptionWhat
0x0059bfb6.summary: Returns exception message string (equivalent to `std::exception::what()`): returns pointer from this[1] if non-null, otherwise returns "Unknown exception".

0x0059c0ac.name: sub_59C0AC
0x0059c0ac.label: CharToUpper
0x0059c0ac.summary: Converts a character to uppercase: uses ctype lookup tables (byte_8D47E1/byte_8D46E0) for ANSI and locale-aware LCMapString (sub_591FA1) for multibyte characters.

0x008d8000.name: start
0x008d8000.label: EntryPoint
0x008d8000.summary: Program entry point: allocates global data buffer, loads and initializes plugin DLLs (oph.dll, steeringwheel.dll), resolves IsDebuggerPresent, and launches main application via sub_58A19E if no debugger detected.
